do
	local okE, E = pcall(function() return (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G end)
	E = (okE and type(E) == "table") and E or _G
	local r = E.UhhhhhhSession
	if E.UhhhhhhLoaded == "V10" and type(r) == "table" and os.time() - (tonumber(r.Beat) or 0) <= 25 then
		local okP, lp = pcall(function() return game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer end)
		local okJ, job = pcall(function() return game.JobId end)
		if (not okP or lp == nil or r.Player == nil or r.Player == lp) and (not okJ or r.Job == nil or r.Job == job) then
			warn("[Nooby's UH Reanimation] already running in this session (V10) - not starting a second copy")
			return
		end
	end
end

local UhhhhhhVersion = "V10"
local UHMergeBuild = "a_very_cool_script_v42"
do
	-- execution guard: one shared environment (getgenv or _G), claimed immediately, released when the session is gone
	local okE, E = pcall(function() return (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G end)
	E = (okE and type(E) == "table") and E or _G
	local okP, lp = pcall(function() return game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer end)
	local okJ, job = pcall(function() return game.JobId end)
	local r = E.UhhhhhhSession
	if E.UhhhhhhLoaded == UhhhhhhVersion and type(r) == "table" and r.Version == UhhhhhhVersion
		and os.time() - (tonumber(r.Beat) or 0) <= 25
		and (not okP or lp == nil or r.Player == nil or r.Player == lp)
		and (not okJ or r.Job == nil or r.Job == job) then
		return
	end
	local rec = {Version = UhhhhhhVersion, Beat = os.time(), Started = os.time(), Player = okP and lp or nil, Job = okJ and job or nil, Ready = false, Cleared = false}
	E.UhhhhhhSession = rec
	E.UhhhhhhLoaded = UhhhhhhVersion
	if E ~= _G then pcall(function() _G.UhhhhhhLoaded = UhhhhhhVersion end) end
	task.spawn(function()
		while E.UhhhhhhSession == rec do
			if not rec.Ready and os.time() - rec.Started > 300 then break end
			rec.Beat = os.time()
			task.wait(3)
		end
	end)
end

gethiddengui = get_hidden_gui or gethui
request = request or http_request or (syn and syn.request) or (http and http.request)

local Util = {}
Util.Roles = {Entries = {}, ByName = {}, ById = {}, VById = {}, VByName = {}, LoadedAt = 0, Base = nil}
Util.Roles.Fetch = function(base, force)
local R = Util.Roles
if base then R.Base = base end
if not R.Base then return false end
if not force and R.LoadedAt > 0 and os.clock() - R.LoadedAt < 20 then return true end
local okGet, body = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(R.Base .. "roles.json?t=" .. os.time()) end)
if not okGet or type(body) ~= "string" then return false end
local okJson, data = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, body)
if not (okJson and type(data) == "table" and type(data.entries) == "table") then return false end
local entries, byName, byId = {}, {}, {}
local vById, vByName = {}, {}
for _, e in ipairs(data.entries) do
if type(e) == "table" then
local role = tostring(e.role or ""):lower()
if role == "verified" then -- verified players: kept apart from owner / co-owner so existing role logic is untouched
local vn = type(e.username) == "string" and e.username or nil
if vn and not (#vn >= 3 and #vn <= 20 and vn:match("^[%w_]+$")) then vn = nil end
local vid = math.floor(tonumber(e.userId) or 0)
if vn then vByName[vn:lower()] = true end
if vid > 0 then vById[vid] = true end
end
if role == "owner" or role == "co-owner" then
local name = type(e.username) == "string" and e.username or nil
if name and not (#name >= 3 and #name <= 20 and name:match("^[%w_]+$")) then name = nil end
local id = math.floor(tonumber(e.userId) or 0)
if name or id > 0 then
entries[#entries + 1] = {username = name, userId = id > 0 and id or nil, role = role}
if name then byName[name:lower()] = role end
if id > 0 then byId[id] = role end
end
end
end
end
R.Entries, R.ByName, R.ById, R.LoadedAt = entries, byName, byId, os.clock()
R.VById, R.VByName = vById, vByName
return true
end
Util.Roles.Of = function(plr)
local R = Util.Roles
if not plr then return nil end
return R.ById[plr.UserId] or R.ByName[tostring(plr.Name):lower()]
end
Util.Roles.OwnerName = function()
for _, e in ipairs(Util.Roles.Entries) do
if e.role == "owner" and e.username then return e.username end
end
end
-- Animation Studio access: owner / co-owner (always) + verified players (roles.json role "verified", or the script's existing verified whitelist). Fails closed.
Util.Roles.CanUseStudio = function(plr, refresh)
local R = Util.Roles
if typeof(plr) ~= "Instance" or not plr:IsA("Player") or plr.UserId <= 0 then return false end
if refresh then pcall(R.Fetch) end
local role = R.Of(plr)
if role == "owner" or role == "co-owner" then return true end
if R.VById[plr.UserId] or R.VByName[tostring(plr.Name):lower()] then return true end
local f = R.BannerRole
if type(f) == "function" then
local ok, r = pcall(f, plr.UserId)
if ok and r then return true end
end
return false
end
Util.RandomString = function(length)
length = length or math.random(32, 256)
local str = ""
for _=1, length do
str ..= string.char(math.random(32, 126))
end
return str
end
Util.DeepcopyTable = function(t)
local c = {}
for k, v in pairs(t) do
if type(v) == "table" then
v = Util.DeepcopyTable(v)
end
c[k] = v
end
return c
end
Util.ParseHex = function(s)
if type(s) ~= "string" then return nil end
s = s:gsub("%s+", ""):gsub("^#", "")
if #s == 3 then
s = s:sub(1, 1):rep(2) .. s:sub(2, 2):rep(2) .. s:sub(3, 3):rep(2)
end
if not s:match("^%x%x%x%x%x%x$") then return nil end
return Color3.fromRGB(tonumber(s:sub(1, 2), 16), tonumber(s:sub(3, 4), 16), tonumber(s:sub(5, 6), 16))
end

-- ===== FAST EXECUTION MODE: persistent startup cache =====
-- UhhhhhhReanim/FastExecution.cache is a small self-validating text file (format + build + length + checksum). It only remembers which bundled /
-- copied asset files (theme + intro songs, UI graphics) were already verified, so the next launch skips re-reading them just to check their size.
-- It never stores code, bytecode, player data or tokens. Missing / corrupt / outdated cache = rebuilt on the spot; any failure = normal startup.
-- Setting: Main page > Performance > "Fast Execution Mode" (default ON, saved in SaveData.Custom.FastExec). OFF = cache is neither read nor written.
do
local FE = {Fmt = 1, Rev = "fx1", Dir = "UhhhhhhReanim", Path = "UhhhhhhReanim/FastExecution.cache", Tmp = "UhhhhhhReanim/FastExecution.cache.tmp",
Hits = 0, Misses = 0, Writes = 0, Errors = 0, State = "unloaded"}
Util.FastExec = FE
FE.Build = tostring(UhhhhhhVersion) .. "|" .. tostring(UHMergeBuild) .. "|" .. FE.Rev
local function okKey(k)
return type(k) == "string" and #k > 0 and #k < 200 and not k:find("%c")
end
local function sum(s)
local a, b = 1, 0
for i = 1, #s do
a = (a + s:byte(i)) % 65521
b = (b + a) % 65521
end
return string.format("%04x%04x", b, a)
end
local function num(n)
return string.format("%d", math.floor(n))
end
local function blank()
return {files = {}, gfx = {}}
end
local function encode(d)
local out, keys = {}, {}
for k in pairs(d.files) do keys[#keys + 1] = k end
table.sort(keys)
for _, k in ipairs(keys) do out[#out + 1] = "F\t" .. k .. "\t" .. num(d.files[k]) end
keys = {}
for k in pairs(d.gfx) do keys[#keys + 1] = k end
table.sort(keys)
for _, k in ipairs(keys) do
local g = d.gfx[k]
out[#out + 1] = "G\t" .. k .. "\t" .. num(g.cdn) .. "\t" .. num(g.size)
end
return table.concat(out, "\n")
end
local function decode(body)
local d = blank()
for line in (body .. "\n"):gmatch("([^\n]*)\n") do
if line ~= "" then
local t = {}
for part in (line .. "\t"):gmatch("([^\t]*)\t") do t[#t + 1] = part end
local n3, n4 = tonumber(t[3]), tonumber(t[4])
if t[1] == "F" and #t == 3 and okKey(t[2]) and n3 and n3 >= 0 then
d.files[t[2]] = n3
elseif t[1] == "G" and #t == 4 and okKey(t[2]) and n3 and n4 and n4 >= 0 then
d.gfx[t[2]] = {cdn = n3, size = n4}
else
return nil
end
end
end
return d
end
local function pack(d)
local body = encode(d)
return "UHFX" .. FE.Fmt .. "\n" .. FE.Build .. "\n" .. #body .. "\n" .. sum(body) .. "\n" .. body
end
local function parse(raw)
if type(raw) ~= "string" then return nil, "unreadable" end
local fmt, build, len, cs, body = raw:match("^UHFX(%d+)\n([^\n]*)\n(%d+)\n(%x+)\n(.*)$")
if not fmt then return nil, "corrupt" end
if tonumber(fmt) ~= FE.Fmt or build ~= FE.Build then return nil, "outdated" end
if tonumber(len) ~= #body or cs ~= sum(body) then return nil, "corrupt" end
local d = decode(body)
if not d then return nil, "corrupt" end
return d, "hit"
end
FE.Pack, FE.Parse = pack, parse
local function guard(fn, default)
return function(...)
local ok, r = pcall(fn, ...)
if ok then return r end
FE.Errors = FE.Errors + 1
if FE.Errors >= 5 then FE.Broken = true end
return default
end
end
function FE.Bind(save)
if type(save) == "table" then FE.Save = save end
end
function FE.Pref()
local S = FE.Save
local c = type(S) == "table" and S.Custom or nil
if type(c) == "table" and type(c.FastExec) == "boolean" then return c.FastExec end
return true
end
function FE.Fs()
if FE.FsOk == nil then
FE.FsOk = type(readfile) == "function" and type(writefile) == "function" and type(isfile) == "function"
and type(makefolder) == "function" and type(isfolder) == "function"
end
return FE.FsOk
end
function FE.On()
return FE.Save ~= nil and FE.Broken ~= true and FE.Fs() and FE.Pref()
end
FE.Load = guard(function()
if FE.Data then return FE.Data end
FE.Data, FE.State, FE.Last = blank(), "missing", nil
local found = false
for _, p in ipairs({FE.Path, FE.Tmp}) do
local okE, ex = pcall(isfile, p)
if okE and ex == true then
found = true
local okR, raw = pcall(readfile, p)
local d, why = parse(okR and raw or nil)
if d then
FE.Data, FE.State = d, "hit"
if p == FE.Path then
FE.Last = raw
else
FE.State, FE.Dirty = "recovered", true
end
return FE.Data
end
FE.State = why
end
end
if found then FE.Dirty = true end
return FE.Data
end)
FE.Flush = guard(function()
if not FE.Dirty or not FE.Data or not FE.On() then return false end
local text = pack(FE.Data)
if text == FE.Last then
FE.Dirty = false
return false
end
if not isfolder(FE.Dir) then makefolder(FE.Dir) end
writefile(FE.Tmp, text)
if readfile(FE.Tmp) ~= text then error("cache tmp verify failed") end
writefile(FE.Path, text)
if type(delfile) == "function" then pcall(delfile, FE.Tmp) end
FE.Last, FE.Dirty = text, false
FE.Writes = FE.Writes + 1
return true
end, false)
function FE.Touch()
FE.Dirty = true
if FE.Pending then return end
FE.Pending = true
task.delay(2, function()
FE.Pending = false
FE.Flush()
end)
end
FE.FileOk = guard(function(path, size)
if not FE.On() or not okKey(path) or type(size) ~= "number" then return false end
FE.Load()
local v = FE.Data.files[path]
if v ~= nil and v == size then
FE.Hits = FE.Hits + 1
return true
end
FE.Misses = FE.Misses + 1
return false
end, false)
FE.FileSet = guard(function(path, size)
if not FE.On() or not okKey(path) or type(size) ~= "number" or size ~= size or size < 0 then return end
FE.Load()
if FE.Data.files[path] ~= size then
FE.Data.files[path] = size
FE.Touch()
end
end)
FE.FileDrop = guard(function(path)
if FE.On() and FE.Data and FE.Data.files[path] ~= nil then
FE.Data.files[path] = nil
FE.Touch()
end
end)
FE.GfxOk = guard(function(name, cdn)
if not FE.On() or not okKey(name) or type(cdn) ~= "number" then return false end
FE.Load()
local g = FE.Data.gfx[name]
if g and g.cdn == cdn then
FE.Hits = FE.Hits + 1
return true
end
FE.Misses = FE.Misses + 1
return false
end, false)
FE.GfxSet = guard(function(name, cdn, size)
if not FE.On() or not okKey(name) or type(cdn) ~= "number" or type(size) ~= "number" or size ~= size or size < 0 then return end
FE.Load()
local g = FE.Data.gfx[name]
if not g or g.cdn ~= cdn or g.size ~= size then
FE.Data.gfx[name] = {cdn = cdn, size = size}
FE.Touch()
end
end)
-- toggled in the UI: ON starts from an empty manifest (nothing recorded while it was OFF is trusted), OFF just stops using it (nothing is deleted)
function FE.Apply(on)
if on == true then
FE.Data, FE.State, FE.Last, FE.Broken, FE.Errors = blank(), "reset", nil, nil, 0
FE.Touch()
end
end
end
if ismissing(sethiddenproperty) and not ismissing(setscriptable) and not ismissing(isscriptable) then
sethiddenproperty = function(inst, prop, value)
local ok, old = pcall(isscriptable, inst, prop)
if ok and old == false then pcall(setscriptable, inst, prop, true) end
local success, err = pcall(function() inst[prop] = value end)
if ok and old == false then pcall(setscriptable, inst, prop, false) end
return success, err
end
end

local _native_xpcall = xpcall
local pcall = function(func, ...)
return _native_pcall(func, ...)
end
local xpcall = function(func, handler, ...)
return _native_xpcall(func, handler, ...)
end

Util.FX = (function()
local FX = {}
local RealTweenService = TweenService
local Lighting = cloneref(game:GetService("Lighting"))
local RawCfg = {}
local RawSettings = {Blur = true, Transitions = true, ExtraSounds = true, Ambient = true}
local LOWEND_SETTINGS = {Blur = false, Transitions = false, ExtraSounds = false, Ambient = false}
local LOWEND_CFG = {
UIParticles = false, UIGradient = false, UITrail = false, UIGlow = false, RbxIconTheme = false, RbxBarTheme = false, ChatStyle = false,
TriNodes = false, TriFaces = true, TriExplode = false, TriMusic = false,
UIAnimSpeed = 3, NotifSpeed = 3, LiquidGlass = false,
}
FX.LowEndTriFPS = 30
FX.LowEndUIFPS = 30
FX.LowEndHooks = {}
local PROF_SETTINGS, PROF_CFG
function FX.SetProfile(s, c) PROF_SETTINGS, PROF_CFG = s, c end
function FX.IsLowEnd()
return RawCfg.LowEnd == true
end
function FX.OnLowEnd(fn)
FX.LowEndHooks[#FX.LowEndHooks + 1] = fn
end
local Gov = {Stride = 1}
FX.Gov = Gov
function FX.Lite()
if RawCfg.LowEnd == true or Gov.Stride > 1 then return true end
local d = FX.Device
if not d then return false end
local t = d.Tier or 4
return t <= 1 or (t == 2 and d.Mobile == true)
end
do
-- Adaptive Performance Engine v2: 5 profiles, multi-source device seed, windowed FPS governor (sustained drops, stability, cap-aware, hysteresis, gated probing), priority-ordered budgeted workload scaling
local Perf = {}
FX.Perf = Perf
local floor, max, min, clock, sqrt = math.floor, math.max, math.min, os.clock, math.sqrt
local NAMES = {"Ultra", "High", "Balanced", "Low", "Potato"}
Perf.Names = NAMES
Gov.Level = 1
-- stride: UI/chrome frame skipping | vfx: particle Rate multiplier | trail/beam/shad/spot/bloom/sun/dof: feature kept on
-- gs: GlobalShadows | q: QualityLevel | deco: terrain decoration+water | mesh: cap mesh detail | capM/capD: fps cap mobile/desktop
-- sim: SimulationRadius refresh interval (s) | ray: void-raycast stride in RC loop | uifps: LowEnd UI fps | low: (unused - engine never auto-enables LowEnd UI mode)
local P = {
{stride = 1, vfx = 1, trail = true, beam = true, shad = true, spot = true, bloom = true, sun = true, dof = true, gs = true, deco = true, sim = 0, ray = 1, uifps = 30},
{stride = 1, vfx = 0.75, trail = true, beam = true, shad = true, spot = true, bloom = true, sun = true, dof = false, gs = true, deco = true, sim = 0, ray = 1, uifps = 30},
{stride = 1, vfx = 0.5, trail = true, beam = true, shad = false, spot = true, bloom = true, sun = false, dof = false, gs = false, q = 5, deco = true, sim = 0.25, ray = 1, uifps = 30},
{stride = 1, vfx = 0.25, trail = false, beam = false, shad = false, spot = true, bloom = true, sun = false, dof = false, gs = false, q = 3, deco = false, mesh = true, capM = 60, sim = 0.5, ray = 2, uifps = 30},
{stride = 2, vfx = 0.08, trail = false, beam = false, shad = false, spot = false, bloom = false, sun = false, dof = false, gs = false, q = 1, deco = false, mesh = true, capM = 30, sim = 1, ray = 3, uifps = 30},
}
Perf.Profiles = P
local Cur = P[1]
local level, ceiling, startLv, mode, seeded = nil, 1, 1, "auto", false
local userLow, engineSet = false, false
local listeners = {}
Perf.RayStride = 1
-- ---------- instance scaling (particles / trails / beams / lights / post effects) ----------
local CLS = {ParticleEmitter = 1, Trail = 2, Beam = 3, PointLight = 4, SpotLight = 4, SurfaceLight = 4, BloomEffect = 5, SunRaysEffect = 5, DepthOfFieldEffect = 5}
local POST = {BloomEffect = "bloom", SunRaysEffect = "sun", DepthOfFieldEffect = "dof"}
-- tracked instances live in 6 buckets, most expensive first: 1 post fx, 2 lights, 3 heavy emitters, 4 emitters, 5 beams, 6 trails
local NB = 6
local BKT = {[1] = 4, [2] = 6, [3] = 5, [4] = 2, [5] = 1}
local Rec = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local L, LN, dirty = {{}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}}, {0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0}, {false, false, false, false, false, false}
local G, GA = {}, {gs = false, q = false, m = false, deco = false, cap = false}
local wN, wS, wQ, wM = 0, 0, 0, 0
local S = {
qh = 1, qt = 0, Q = {}, dq = {}, dqN = 0, active = false, restoring = false, PA = P[1],
sweepOn = false, prune = false, swB = 1, swI = 1, scOn = false, scD = 0, scL = {}, scI = {}, lastScan = 0,
rescan = false, pruneT = 0, bAp = 0.0012, bDi = 0.0012, simT = 0,
ring = {0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0}, tmp = {0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0}, rn = 0, ri = 0, cv = 0,
badS = 0, goodS = 0, headS = 0, lastChange = 0, lastDir = 0, settleUntil = 0, lastUp = -1e9,
holdUntil = 0, holdDur = 300, flaps = 0, bonus = 0, spikeAt = -1e9,
cap = 0, capAt = -1e9, lockN = 0, lockC = 0, seedAt = 0, memP = 0, probeT = 15, stress = 0, stab = 1, T = 60,
gI = 1, gT = 0,
}
local function offBool(inst, r, prop, off)
if off then
if inst[prop] == true then inst[prop] = false r[prop] = true end
elseif r[prop] then
if inst[prop] == false then inst[prop] = true end
r[prop] = nil
end
end
local function applyOne(inst, p)
local r = Rec[inst]
if not r then return end
local k = r.k
if k == 1 then
local cur, a = inst.Rate, r.a
if p.vfx >= 1 then
if a ~= nil then
if cur == a then inst.Rate = r.o end
r.a, r.o = nil, nil
end
else
local base = (a ~= nil and cur == a) and r.o or cur
local want = base * p.vfx
r.o, r.a = base, want
if cur ~= want then inst.Rate = want end
end
elseif k == 2 then offBool(inst, r, "Enabled", not p.trail)
elseif k == 3 then offBool(inst, r, "Enabled", not p.beam)
elseif k == 4 then
offBool(inst, r, "Shadows", not p.shad)
if r.nl then offBool(inst, r, "Enabled", not p.spot) end
else offBool(inst, r, "Enabled", not p[r.pk]) end
end
-- O(1) removal: swap the last entry into the freed slot (a moved, not-yet-swept entry is applied right away)
local function untrack(inst, r)
local b, i = r.b, r.i
local list, n = L[b], LN[b]
local last = list[n]
if last ~= inst then
list[i] = last
local rl = Rec[last]
if rl then rl.i = i end
if dirty[b] and b == S.swB and i < S.swI then pcall(applyOne, last, S.PA) end
end
list[n] = nil
LN[b] = n - 1
Rec[inst] = nil
end
local function track(inst)
if Rec[inst] ~= nil then return end
local cn = inst.ClassName
local k = CLS[cn]
if not k then return end
local b = BKT[k]
if k == 1 and inst.Rate >= 20 then b = 3 end
local n = LN[b] + 1
LN[b] = n
L[b][n] = inst
local r = {k = k, b = b, i = n}
if k == 4 then r.nl = cn ~= "PointLight" elseif k == 5 then r.pk = POST[cn] end
Rec[inst] = r
pcall(applyOne, inst, S.PA)
end
local function onAdded(d)
if CLS[d.ClassName] then
local qt = S.qt
if qt - S.qh > 3000 then S.rescan = true return end
qt = qt + 1
S.qt = qt
S.Q[qt] = d
end
end
local function onRemoving(d)
if Rec[d] ~= nil then
local n = S.dqN + 1
S.dqN = n
S.dq[n] = d
end
end
local function drainDQ()
local dq, n = S.dq, S.dqN
S.dqN = 0
for i = 1, n do
local inst = dq[i]
dq[i] = nil
local r = Rec[inst]
if r then
if inst.Parent == nil then
untrack(inst, r)
elseif not inst:IsDescendantOf(game) then
pcall(applyOne, inst, P[1])
untrack(inst, r)
end
end
end
end
local function startScan()
S.lastScan = clock()
S.scOn = true
local sl, si = S.scL, S.scI
for i = #sl, 1, -1 do sl[i] = nil end
sl[1], si[1], S.scD = {workspace, Lighting}, 1, 1
end
-- incremental depth-first scan: no giant GetDescendants table, always time-sliced
local function scanStep(t0, bud)
local sl, si = S.scL, S.scI
local d, n = S.scD, 0
while d > 0 do
local l, i = sl[d], si[d]
local inst = l[i]
if inst == nil then
sl[d] = nil
d = d - 1
else
si[d] = i + 1
if CLS[inst.ClassName] then track(inst) end
local kids = inst:GetChildren()
if kids[1] ~= nil then
d = d + 1
sl[d], si[d] = kids, 1
end
n = n + 1
if n % 48 == 0 and clock() - t0 > bud then S.scD = d return end
end
end
S.scD = 0
S.scOn = false
end
local function startAdded()
if not S.cA then S.cA = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(onAdded) end
if not S.cB then S.cB = Lighting.DescendantAdded:Connect(onAdded) end
if not S.cC then S.cC = workspace.DescendantRemoving:Connect(onRemoving) end
if not S.cD then S.cD = Lighting.DescendantRemoving:Connect(onRemoving) end
end
local function stopAdded()
if S.cA then S.cA:Disconnect() S.cA = nil end
if S.cB then S.cB:Disconnect() S.cB = nil end
if S.cC then S.cC:Disconnect() S.cC = nil end
if S.cD then S.cD:Disconnect() S.cD = nil end
end
function S.clearQ()
local Q = S.Q
for i = S.qh, S.qt do Q[i] = nil end
S.qh, S.qt = 1, 0
end
local function resetTracking()
for b = 1, NB do
local l = L[b]
for i = LN[b], 1, -1 do l[i] = nil end
LN[b] = 0
dirty[b] = false
end
Rec = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
end
-- re-applies only the buckets whose profile fields changed, most expensive bucket first, inside a time budget
local function sweep(bud)
local t0, p, c = clock(), S.PA, 0
local pr = S.prune
while S.swB <= NB do
local b = S.swB
if dirty[b] then
local list = L[b]
local i = S.swI
while i <= LN[b] do
local inst = list[i]
if inst.Parent == nil then
untrack(inst, Rec[inst])
else
if not pr then pcall(applyOne, inst, p) end
i = i + 1
end
c = c + 1
if c % 32 == 0 and clock() - t0 > bud then S.swI = i return true end
end
dirty[b] = false
end
S.swB = b + 1
S.swI = 1
end
S.sweepOn, S.prune, S.swB, S.swI = false, false, 1, 1
if S.restoring then
S.restoring = false
if not S.active then resetTracking() end
end
return false
end
local function work()
if S.dqN > 0 then drainDQ() end
if S.sweepOn and sweep(S.bAp) then return end
if not S.active then return end
local t0 = clock()
if S.rescan and not S.scOn and t0 - S.lastScan > 30 then
S.rescan = false
S.clearQ()
startScan()
end
local Q, bud, c = S.Q, S.bDi, 0
while S.qh <= S.qt do
local qh = S.qh
local inst = Q[qh]
Q[qh] = nil
S.qh = qh + 1
if inst.Parent ~= nil then track(inst) end
c = c + 1
if c % 32 == 0 and clock() - t0 > bud then return end
end
if S.qt > 0 then S.qh, S.qt = 1, 0 end
if S.scOn then scanStep(t0, bud) end
end
local function markDirty(old, p)
local any = false
if old.vfx ~= p.vfx then dirty[3], dirty[4], any = true, true, true end
if old.shad ~= p.shad or old.spot ~= p.spot then dirty[2], any = true, true end
if old.bloom ~= p.bloom or old.sun ~= p.sun or old.dof ~= p.dof then dirty[1], any = true, true end
if old.beam ~= p.beam then dirty[5], any = true, true end
if old.trail ~= p.trail then dirty[6], any = true, true end
return any
end
local function retarget(old)
if level ~= nil and level >= 2 then
local wasR = S.restoring
S.restoring, S.PA = false, Cur
local fresh = not S.active
if fresh then
S.active = true
startAdded()
startScan()
end
local any = false
if wasR then
for b = 1, NB do dirty[b] = true end
any = true
elseif not fresh then
any = markDirty(old, Cur)
end
if any then S.sweepOn, S.prune, S.swB, S.swI = true, false, 1, 1 end
elseif S.active then
S.active = false
stopAdded()
S.scOn, S.scD = false, 0
S.clearQ()
S.restoring, S.PA = true, P[1]
for b = 1, NB do dirty[b] = true end
S.sweepOn, S.prune, S.swB, S.swI = true, false, 1, 1
end
end
-- ---------- global rendering knobs (originals saved lazily; each knob only writes when its state really changes) ----------
local KN = {dn = {"gs", "deco", "q", "m", "cap"}, up = {"cap", "m", "q", "deco", "gs"}}
function KN.gs(p)
local want = p.gs == false
if GA.gs == want then return false end
GA.gs = want
pcall(function()
if want then
if G.gs == nil then G.gs = Lighting.GlobalShadows end
Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
elseif G.gs ~= nil then
Lighting.GlobalShadows = G.gs
G.gs = nil
end
end)
return true
end
function KN.q(p)
local want = p.q or false
if GA.q == want then return false end
GA.q = want
pcall(function()
local R = settings().Rendering
if want then
if G.q == nil then G.q = R.QualityLevel end
R.QualityLevel = string.format("Level%02d", want)
elseif G.q ~= nil then
R.QualityLevel = G.q
G.q = nil
end
end)
return true
end
function KN.m(p)
local want = p.mesh == true
if GA.m == want then return false end
GA.m = want
pcall(function()
local R = settings().Rendering
if want then
if G.m == nil then G.m = R.MeshPartDetailLevel end
R.MeshPartDetailLevel = Enum.MeshPartDetailLevel.Level04
elseif G.m ~= nil then
R.MeshPartDetailLevel = G.m
G.m = nil
end
end)
return true
end
function KN.deco(p)
local want = p.deco == false
if GA.deco == want then return false end
local done = false
pcall(function()
local T = workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
if not T then return end
if want then
if not G.t then G.t = {T.Decoration, T.WaterWaveSize, T.WaterWaveSpeed, T.WaterReflectance} end
T.Decoration, T.WaterWaveSize, T.WaterWaveSpeed, T.WaterReflectance = false, 0, 0, 0
elseif G.t then
local t = G.t
G.t = nil
T.Decoration, T.WaterWaveSize, T.WaterWaveSpeed, T.WaterReflectance = t[1], t[2], t[3], t[4]
end
GA.deco = want
done = true
end)
return done
end
function KN.cap(p)
if type(setfpscap) ~= "function" then return false end
local d = FX.Device
local want = (d and d.Mobile == true and p.capM) or false
if GA.cap == want then return false end
local done = false
pcall(function()
if want then
if G.cap == nil then G.cap = (type(getfpscap) == "function" and tonumber(getfpscap())) or false end
setfpscap(want)
elseif G.cap ~= nil then
local o = G.cap
G.cap = nil
setfpscap((o and o > 0) and o or ((d and d.Mobile == true) and 120 or 999))
end
GA.cap = want
done = true
end)
return done
end
-- staged apply: first changing knob now, the rest ~0.12s apart (most expensive first when degrading, cheapest first when recovering)
local function gStep()
local ord, p = S.gO, S.gP
while S.gI <= #ord do
local key = ord[S.gI]
S.gI = S.gI + 1
if KN[key](p) then S.gT = 0.12 return end
end
S.gP = nil
end
local function applyGlobals(p, dir)
S.gO, S.gP, S.gI, S.gT = (dir and dir < 0) and KN.up or KN.dn, p, 1, 0
gStep()
end
local function applyAllNow(p)
S.gP = nil
for _, key in ipairs(KN.dn) do KN[key](p) end
end
-- ---------- profile switching ----------
local conn
local function emit()
for i = 1, #listeners do pcall(listeners[i], level, mode) end
end
local function resetGov()
wN, wS, wQ, wM = 0, 0, 0, 0
S.rn, S.badS, S.goodS, S.headS, S.avg, S.fps, S.capAt, S.stress = 0, 0, 0, 0, nil, nil, -1e9, 0
end
local function setLevel(n)
n = max(1, min(5, floor(n)))
if n == level then return end
local dir = level and (n > level and 1 or -1) or 0
level = n
local old = Cur
local p = P[n]
Cur = p
Perf.Level, Perf.RayStride = n, p.ray
Gov.Stride, Gov.Level = p.stride, n
FX.LowEndTriFPS, FX.LowEndUIFPS = p.uifps, p.uifps
FX.SetProfile(nil, nil) -- engine never overrides UI settings (no low-end-style UI from profiles)
local wantLow = userLow -- engine never turns Low End UI Mode on by itself; only the user's own toggle counts
if wantLow ~= true and (RawCfg.LowEnd == true) ~= wantLow then
engineSet = true
pcall(FX.SetLowEnd, wantLow)
engineSet = false
elseif Util and Util.UIPlus and Util.UIPlus.Apply then
pcall(Util.UIPlus.Apply)
end
if FX.Store then FX.Store.AutoLow = false end
applyGlobals(p, dir)
retarget(old)
resetGov()
local now = clock()
S.lastChange, S.lastDir = now, dir
S.settleUntil = now + 2.5
emit()
end
FX.OnLowEnd(function(on)
if not engineSet then
userLow = on
if FX.Store then FX.Store.AutoLow = false end
end
end)
function Perf.Seed(tier, mobile, score, conf)
tier = max(1, min(4, floor(tonumber(tier) or 3)))
local c, s
if tier == 1 then
c, s = 4, 5
elseif tier == 2 then
if mobile then c, s = 3, 4 else c, s = 2, 2 end
elseif tier == 3 then
c = mobile and 2 or 1
s = c
else
c, s = 1, 1
end
score = tonumber(score)
if score and conf ~= "none" and conf ~= "low" then
if score >= 75 and s > c then s = s - 1
elseif score < 28 and s < 5 and tier <= 3 then s = s + 1 end
end
seeded, ceiling = true, c
S.seedAt, S.bonus = clock(), 0
startLv = level and max(startLv, s) or s
local store = FX.Store
if not level then userLow = RawCfg.LowEnd == true and not (store and store.AutoLow == true) end
if mode == "auto" then
setLevel(level and max(level, s) or s)
elseif level then
applyGlobals(P[level])
end
end
function Perf.Boot()
local v = floor(tonumber(RawCfg.PerfProfile) or 1)
if v >= 2 and v <= 6 then
mode = "manual"
local store = FX.Store
userLow = RawCfg.LowEnd == true and not (store and store.AutoLow == true)
setLevel(v - 1)
else
mode = "auto"
end
end
function Perf.Select(v)
v = floor(tonumber(v) or 1)
if v >= 2 and v <= 6 then
if mode == "manual" and level == v - 1 then return end
mode = "manual"
S.stress, Perf.RayStride = 0, Cur.ray
if level == v - 1 then emit() else setLevel(v - 1) end
else
if mode == "auto" then return end
mode = "auto"
resetGov()
S.holdLevel, S.flaps, S.bonus = nil, 0, 0
S.settleUntil = clock() + 3
if seeded then
if level then setLevel(max(level, startLv)) end
elseif level then
setLevel(1)
end
emit()
end
end
function Perf.Manual() return mode == "manual" end
function Perf.OnChange(fn) listeners[#listeners + 1] = fn end
function Perf.SetProbe(fn) S.probe, S.probeT = fn, 12 end
function Perf.Status()
return {Level = level, Name = level and NAMES[level] or nil, Mode = mode, FPS = S.fps or (S.avg and 1 / S.avg) or nil, Ceiling = ceiling, Seeded = seeded, Target = S.T, Stability = S.stab, Pressure = S.memP, Stress = S.stress}
end
function Perf.SimDue()
local iv = Cur.sim
if S.stress >= 2 then iv = max(iv * 1.5, 0.15) end
if iv <= 0 then return true end
local t = clock()
if t - S.simT >= iv then S.simT = t return true end
return false
end
FX.SimDue = Perf.SimDue
-- ---------- FPS governor: 0.5s windows -> median-of-windows, frame-time consistency, weighted leaky badness, gated recovery ----------
local function medianLast(k)
local n = S.rn
if n > k then n = k end
local ring, tmp, ri = S.ring, S.tmp, S.ri
for j = 1, n do
local v = ring[(ri - j) % 6 + 1]
local m = j - 1
while m >= 1 and tmp[m] > v do
tmp[m + 1] = tmp[m]
m = m - 1
end
tmp[m + 1] = v
end
if n % 2 == 1 then return tmp[(n + 1) / 2] end
return (tmp[n / 2] + tmp[n / 2 + 1]) * 0.5
end
local function evaluate(s)
local n, q, m = wN, wQ, wM
wN, wS, wQ, wM = 0, 0, 0, 0
local mean = s / n
local fps = 1 / mean
local avg = S.avg
S.avg = avg and (avg + (mean - avg) * 0.4) or mean
local now = clock()
if now < S.settleUntil then return end
local var = q / n - mean * mean
local cv = var > 0 and sqrt(var) / mean or 0
S.cv = S.cv + (cv - S.cv) * 0.3
if m > 0.15 then S.spikeAt = now end
local ri = S.ri % 6 + 1
S.ri = ri
S.ring[ri] = fps
if S.rn < 6 then S.rn = S.rn + 1 end
if S.rn < 3 then return end
-- target FPS: real cap (executor cap, our own applied cap, or a steady undeclared lock), never assume more than 60
local cap = S.cap
if now - S.capAt > 10 then
S.capAt = now
cap = 0
if type(getfpscap) == "function" then
local ok, v = pcall(getfpscap)
if ok then cap = tonumber(v) or 0 end
end
S.cap = cap
end
local T = (cap > 0 and cap < 90) and cap or 60
local ac = GA.cap
if ac and ac < T then T = ac end
if cap <= 0 and not ac then
if cv < 0.06 and fps > 22 and fps < 47 then
local c = fps < 27 and 24 or (fps < 35 and 30 or (fps < 42.5 and 40 or 45))
local d = fps - c
if d < 0 then d = -d end
if d <= c * 0.045 then
if S.lockC == c then S.lockN = S.lockN + 1 else S.lockC, S.lockN = c, 1 end
if S.lockN >= 10 then S.lockV = c end
else
S.lockN = max(0, S.lockN - 1)
end
else
S.lockN = max(0, S.lockN - 1)
if S.lockV and fps > S.lockV * 1.2 then S.lockV = nil end
end
if S.lockV and S.lockV < T then T = S.lockV end
else
S.lockV, S.lockN = nil, 0
end
S.T = T
local m6, m3 = medianLast(6), medianLast(3)
S.fps = m6
local r6, r3 = m6 / T, m3 / T
local cvA = S.cv
S.stab = 1 - min(1, cvA * 2)
local bad = r6 < 0.78
-- adaptive workload budgets: spend more on applying reductions when struggling, pause background discovery
if r3 < 0.45 then S.bAp, S.bDi = 0.0025, 0.0004
elseif bad then S.bAp, S.bDi = 0.0018, 0.0007
elseif r6 < 0.93 then S.bAp, S.bDi = 0.0012, 0.0012
else S.bAp, S.bDi = 0.0010, 0.0022 end
local st = (r6 < 0.6 and 2) or (bad and 1) or 0
if st ~= S.stress then
S.stress = st
Perf.RayStride = min(4, Cur.ray + (st >= 2 and 1 or 0))
end
local w = 0
if r3 < 0.45 then w = 4
elseif r6 < 0.62 then w = 2.5
elseif bad then w = 1
elseif cvA > 0.38 and r6 < 0.92 then w = 0.6 end
if w > 0 then
S.badS = min(S.badS + w * s, 8)
S.goodS = max(0, S.goodS - s)
S.headS = 0
if S.badS >= 4 and level < 5 then
local prev = level
setLevel(level + ((r3 < 0.35) and 2 or 1))
if now - S.lastUp < 60 and level ~= prev then
S.holdLevel, S.holdUntil = level, now + S.holdDur
S.holdDur = min(S.holdDur * 2, 1800)
S.flaps = min(S.flaps + 1, 4)
S.bonus = 0
end
end
return
end
S.badS = max(0, S.badS - s * 1.5)
if not (r6 >= 0.93 and cvA < 0.28 and now - S.spikeAt > 6) then
S.goodS = max(0, S.goodS - s)
S.headS = 0
return
end
S.goodS = S.goodS + s
if S.memP > 0 then return end
local warm = now - S.seedAt < 60
local need = (r6 >= 1.25 and 6 or 10) * (1 + 0.5 * S.flaps)
if warm then need = need * 0.6 end
local cool = warm and 8 or (S.lastDir > 0 and 25 or 15)
local pf = min(ceiling, max(2, ceiling - 1))
local lim = max(ceiling - S.bonus, pf)
local held = S.holdLevel and now < S.holdUntil
if held then lim = max(lim, S.holdLevel) end
if level > lim then
if S.goodS >= need and now - S.lastChange >= cool then
S.lastUp = now
setLevel(level - 1)
end
elseif S.bonus == 0 and pf < ceiling and level <= ceiling and not held then
-- sustained steady performance at the hardware-prior best level earns one probe level beyond it (failed probes are remembered)
S.headS = S.headS + s
if S.headS >= 75 and now - S.lastChange >= 30 then S.headS, S.bonus = 0, 1 end
end
end
local function step(dt)
if S.sweepOn or S.scOn or S.qh <= S.qt or S.dqN > 0 or S.rescan then work() end
if S.gP then
S.gT = S.gT - dt
if S.gT <= 0 then gStep() end
end
if S.probe then
S.probeT = S.probeT - dt
if S.probeT <= 0 then
S.probeT = 15
local ok, pr = pcall(S.probe)
pr = ok and tonumber(pr) or 0
S.memP = pr
if pr >= 2 and mode == "auto" and seeded and level and level < 3 then setLevel(3) end
end
end
if S.active then
S.pruneT = S.pruneT + dt
if S.pruneT > 90 then
S.pruneT = 0
if not S.sweepOn then
for b = 1, NB do dirty[b] = true end
S.sweepOn, S.prune, S.swB, S.swI = true, true, 1, 1
end
end
end
if mode ~= "auto" or not seeded or not level then return end
if dt > 1 then
wN, wS, wQ, wM = 0, 0, 0, 0
S.rn, S.badS, S.goodS = 0, 0, 0
S.settleUntil = clock() + 2
return
end
if dt > 0.25 then dt = 0.25 end
wN = wN + 1
wS = wS + dt
wQ = wQ + dt * dt
if dt > wM then wM = dt end
if wS >= 0.5 then evaluate(wS) end
end
function Perf.Start()
if not conn then conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(step) end
end
function Perf.Stop()
if conn then conn:Disconnect() conn = nil end
stopAdded()
for b = 1, NB do
local l = L[b]
for i = 1, LN[b] do pcall(applyOne, l[i], P[1]) end
end
resetTracking()
S.active, S.sweepOn, S.prune, S.scOn, S.scD, S.restoring, S.PA, S.rescan, S.dqN = false, false, false, false, 0, false, P[1], false, 0
S.clearQ()
table.clear(S.dq)
applyAllNow(P[1])
Gov.Stride, Gov.Level, Cur, Perf.RayStride = 1, 1, P[1], 1
FX.SetProfile(nil, nil)
if level and P[level].low and not userLow and (RawCfg.LowEnd == true) then
engineSet = true
pcall(FX.SetLowEnd, false)
engineSet = false
end
level, seeded, Perf.Level = nil, false, nil
end
do
local genv = (type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv()) or _G
local old = genv.__UHPerf
if type(old) == "table" and old ~= Perf and type(old.Stop) == "function" then pcall(old.Stop) end
genv.__UHPerf = Perf
end
Perf.Start()
end

return RawSettings[k]

__newindex = function(_, k, v)

end,
})

local EOut, EIn, EInOut = Enum.EasingDirection.Out, Enum.EasingDirection.In, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut
