-- ═══ transition styles: dur = how long the cut plays, bl = blur-peak scale, out = blur release, lead = how early the blur starts to build ═══
local KD = {
	flash = {dur = 0.9, bl = 1.0, out = 0.75, lead = 0.2},
	bloom = {dur = 1.5, bl = 1.25, out = 1.15, lead = 0.35},
	slam = {dur = 0.8, bl = 0.8, out = 0.6, lead = 0.2},
	tear = {dur = 1.1, bl = 0.9, out = 0.85, lead = 0.25},
	glitch = {dur = 0.7, bl = 0.7, out = 0.5, lead = 0.15},
	burst = {dur = 1.1, bl = 1.1, out = 0.95, lead = 0.2},
}
local PKS = {1, 0.9, 0.66, 0.42, 0.24}
local QS, QM, QG, QF = {7, 6, 4, 2, 0}, {14, 11, 7, 3, 0}, {4, 3, 2, 1, 0}, {3, 3, 2, 1, 0}
local DI = {0, 0, 0.033, 0.042, 0.05}
local KGH, GAH = {0.55, 1.0, 1.45, 1.9}, {0.34, 0.2, 0.3, 0.18}

return function(stage, E, id, d, K, zb)
	K = K or {}
	local mkP = PROF[id]
	local INT = cl(tonumber(K.INT) or 1, 0, 1.5)
	if not mkP or INT <= 0.01 or not stage then return nil end
	local okP, P = pcall(mkP, K, type(d) == "table" and d or {})
	if not okP or type(P) ~= "table" or type(P.pal) ~= "table" or type(P.cuts) ~= "table" or #P.pal == 0 then return nil end
	local INT1 = min(INT, 1)
	local CFG = FX.Cfg or {}
	local dyn = P.dyn and true or false
	local rig, mc = P.rig, P.mot
	local rigs = (rig and rig.rigs) or {}
	if #rigs == 0 then rig = nil end

	-- ── cached glow textures (the UI cache builds them once); every glow degrades gracefully when the cache is off ──
	local TEX = {}
	local function tex(name)
		local v = TEX[name]
		if v == nil then
			v = false
			local Cc = FX.Cache
			if Cc and Cc.Enabled and Cc.VFX then
				local okE, en = pcall(Cc.Enabled)
				if okE and en then
					local okV, tid = pcall(Cc.VFX, name)
					if okV and tid then v = tid end
				end
			end
			TEX[name] = v
		end
		return v or nil
	end
	-- fb: "hband" = soft-edged band, "disc" = flat disc, "none" = skipped entirely (null object, costs nothing)
	local function LIGHT(parent, z, name, col, fb)
		local tid = tex(name)
		local o, im
		if tid then
			o = mk("ImageLabel", parent, {AnchorPoint = V2(0.5, 0.5), Position = U2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = U2.fromOffset(10, 10), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false, Image = tid, ImageColor3 = col, ImageTransparency = 1})
			im = true
		elseif fb == "hband" then
			o = F(parent, z, V2(0.5, 0.5), U2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), U2.fromOffset(10, 10), col, 1)
			grad(o, 0, {{0, 1}, {0.5, 0}, {1, 1}})
			im = false
		elseif fb == "disc" then
			o = round(F(parent, z, V2(0.5, 0.5), U2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), U2.fromOffset(10, 10), col, 1))
			im = false
		else
			return {ok = false, tr = 1, im = false, o = {}, col = col}
		end
		local s = SL(o, im)
		s.col, s.ok = col, true
		return s
	end

	-- ── roots: grade + light sit under the HUD, transitions + flare over everything ──
	local W, H = 1280, 720
	do
		local sz = stage.AbsoluteSize
		if sz.X > 10 and sz.Y > 10 then W, H = sz.X, sz.Y end
	end
	local U = min(W, H)
	local lo = F(stage, 6, V2(0, 0), U2.new(), U2.fromScale(1, 1), BLACK, 1)
	local hi = F(stage, 3000, V2(0, 0), U2.new(), U2.fromScale(1, 1), BLACK, 1)
	lo.ClipsDescendants, hi.ClipsDescendants = true, true
	lo.Visible, hi.Visible = false, false

	-- ── performance profile ──
	local function qlevel()
		local lv = 1
		if FX.VQ then
			local ok, v = pcall(FX.VQ)
			if ok and type(v) == "number" then lv = v end
		end
		local G = FX.Gov
		if type(G) == "table" and type(G.Stride) == "number" and G.Stride > 1 then lv = max(lv, 4) end
		return cl(floor(lv + 0.5), 1, 5)
	end
	local Q = qlevel()

	-- ── shots: cuts + palette per shot ──
	local CUTS = {}
	do
		local src = P.cuts
		table.sort(src, function(a, b) return a[1] < b[1] end)
		local last = -99
		for _, c in ipairs(src) do
			if KD[c[2]] and c[1] - last >= 0.9 and c[1] > 1.2 then
				CUTS[#CUTS + 1] = {t = c[1], kind = c[2], str = c[3] or 1}
				last = c[1]
			end
		end
	end
	local need = {}
	for _, c in ipairs(CUTS) do need[c.kind] = true end
	local pal, palN = P.pal, #P.pal
	local cur = {sh = BLACK, hi = WHITE, a = WHITE, b = WHITE}
	local PF, PT, palT0 = nil, nil, -9
	if not dyn then
		local p = pal[1]
		cur.sh, cur.hi, cur.a, cur.b = p.sh, p.hi, p.a, p.b
		PF, PT = p, p
	end
	local skC, hkC = 0.14, 0.3
	local accC, accT, userC, userT = WHITE, -9, nil, -9
	local acA, acB = WHITE, WHITE
	local function userAcc()
		local m = CFG.IntroColorMode
		if m == 2 then
			local okH, c = pcall(Util.ParseHex, CFG.IntroColor)
			if okH and typeof(c) == "Color3" then return c end
		elseif m == 3 then
			return WHITE
		elseif m == 4 and Util.Color and typeof(Util.Color.Cur) == "Color3" then
			return Util.Color.Cur
		end
		return nil
	end

	-- ── pooled objects (built once, only ever re-used) ──
	local sSh = SL(F(lo, 1, V2(0, 1), U2.fromScale(0, 1), U2.fromScale(1, 0.7), BLACK, 1))
	grad(sSh.o, 90, {{0, 1}, {1, 0}})
	local sHi = SL(F(lo, 1, V2(0, 0), U2.new(), U2.fromScale(1, 1), WHITE, 1))
	grad(sHi.o, 45, {{0, 0}, {0.55, 0.78}, {1, 1}})
	local gGlow = LIGHT(lo, 1, "halo", WHITE, "none")

	local VG = {}
	if (P.vig or 0) > 0 then
		local function vgf(ap, pos, size, rot)
			local f = F(lo, 3, ap, pos, size, BLACK, 1)
			grad(f, rot, {{0, 0}, {1, 1}})
			return SL(f)
		end
		VG[1] = vgf(V2(0, 0), U2.new(), U2.fromScale(1, 0.34), 90)
		VG[2] = vgf(V2(0, 1), U2.fromScale(0, 1), U2.fromScale(1, 0.34), 270)
		VG[3] = vgf(V2(0, 0), U2.new(), U2.fromScale(0.26, 1), 0)
		VG[4] = vgf(V2(1, 0), U2.fromScale(1, 0), U2.fromScale(0.26, 1), 180)
	end

	local SHF = {}
	if rig then
		for i = 1, min(rig.n or 4, 7) do
			local s = LIGHT(lo, 2, "beam", WHITE, "hband")
			s.ph, s.w, s.a = random() * TAU, 0.35 + random() * 0.65, 0.55 + random() * 0.45
			SHF[i] = s
		end
	end

	local MO = {}
	if mc then
		for i = 1, min(mc.n or 8, 20) do
			local z = 0.35 + random() * 0.65
			local px = lerp(mc.s1, mc.s2, random() ^ 1.6) * (0.55 + 0.6 * z)
			local s
			if mc.kind == "rain" then
				local f = F(lo, 4, V2(0.5, 0.5), U2.new(), U2.fromOffset(2, px), WHITE, 1)
				f.Rotation = 12
				s = SL(f)
			elseif mc.kind == "rect" then
				s = SL(F(lo, 4, V2(0.5, 0.5), U2.new(), U2.fromOffset(px * 0.7, px), WHITE, 1))
			else
				s = LIGHT(lo, 4, mc.kind, WHITE, "disc")
				s.o.Size = U2.fromOffset(px, px)
			end
			s.x, s.y, s.z, s.ph, s.w = random(), random(), z, random() * TAU, 0.6 + random() * 1.6
			MO[i] = s
		end
	end

	local FG = {}
	for i = 1, min(P.fog or 0, 3) do
		local s = SL(F(lo, 2, V2(0.5, 0.5), U2.fromScale(0.5, 0.6 + 0.16 * (i - 1)), U2.fromScale(1.5, 0.26), WHITE, 1))
		grad(s.o, 90, {{0, 1}, {0.5, 0.25}, {1, 1}})
		s.ph, s.y0 = random() * TAU, 0.6 + 0.16 * (i - 1)
		FG[i] = s
	end

	local vW = SL(F(hi, 1, V2(0, 0), U2.new(), U2.fromScale(1, 1), WHITE, 1))
	local vG = LIGHT(hi, 1, "halo", WHITE, "none")
	local fS = LIGHT(hi, 5, "streak", WHITE, "hband")
	local fC = LIGHT(hi, 6, "halo", WHITE, "none")
	local fGh = {}
	for i = 1, min(P.gh or 0, 4) do fGh[i] = LIGHT(hi, 5, (i % 2 == 1) and "ring" or "halo", WHITE, "none") end

	local tF = SL(F(hi, 10, V2(0, 0), U2.new(), U2.fromScale(1, 1), WHITE, 1))
	local swB = SL(F(hi, 8, V2(0.5, 0.5), U2.new(), U2.fromOffset(10, 10), WHITE, 1))
	grad(swB.o, 0, {{0, 1}, {0.5, 0}, {1, 1}})
	local swC = SL(F(hi, 9, V2(0.5, 0.5), U2.new(), U2.fromOffset(10, 10), WHITE, 1))
	grad(swC.o, 0, {{0, 1}, {0.5, 0}, {1, 1}})
	local frL = SL(F(hi, 7, V2(0, 0), U2.new(), U2.fromScale(0.07, 1), WHITE, 1))
	grad(frL.o, 0, {{0, 0}, {1, 1}})
	local frR = SL(F(hi, 7, V2(1, 0), U2.fromScale(1, 0), U2.fromScale(0.07, 1), WHITE, 1))
	grad(frR.o, 180, {{0, 0}, {1, 1}})

	local bT, bB
	if need.slam then
		bT = F(hi, 9, V2(0, 0), U2.new(), U2.fromScale(1, 0), BLACK, 0.04)
		bB = F(hi, 9, V2(0, 1), U2.fromScale(0, 1), U2.fromScale(1, 0), BLACK, 0.04)
		bT.Visible, bB.Visible = false, false
	end
	local SLC = {}
	if need.glitch then
		for i = 1, 6 do
			local s = SL(F(hi, 9, V2(0, 0.5), U2.new(), U2.fromOffset(10, 10), WHITE, 1))
			SLC[i] = s
		end
	end
	local RY, RN = {}, {}
	if need.burst then
		for i = 1, 8 do
			local s = SL(F(hi, 8, V2(0.5, 0.5), U2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), U2.fromOffset(4, 10), WHITE, 1))
			grad(s.o, 90, {{0, 1}, {0.5, 0}, {1, 1}})
			RY[i] = s
		end
	end
	if need.burst or need.flash then
		for i = 1, 2 do RN[i] = LIGHT(hi, 7, "ring", WHITE, "none") end
	end

	local tS, tBand, tCore
	if type(P.tt) == "number" then
		tS = F(hi, 6, V2(0.5, 0.5), U2.fromScale(0.5, P.ty or 0.5), U2.fromScale(1, 0.34), BLACK, 1)
		tS.ClipsDescendants = true
		tS.Visible = false
		tBand = SL(F(tS, 1, V2(0.5, 0.5), U2.fromScale(0, 0.5), U2.fromOffset(10, 10), WHITE, 1))
		grad(tBand.o, 0, {{0, 1}, {0.5, 0}, {1, 1}})
		tBand.o.Rotation = 14
		tCore = SL(F(tS, 2, V2(0.5, 0.5), U2.fromScale(0, 0.5), U2.fromOffset(10, 10), WHITE, 1))
		grad(tCore.o, 0, {{0, 1}, {0.5, 0}, {1, 1}})
		tCore.o.Rotation = 14
	end

	local function layout()
		local big = max(W, H)
		gGlow.o.Size = U2.fromOffset(U * 1.9, U * 1.9)
		vG.o.Size = U2.fromOffset(big * 1.9, big * 1.9)
		fS.o.Size = U2.fromOffset(W * 1.25, max(14, U * 0.05))
		fC.o.Size = U2.fromOffset(U * 0.24, U * 0.24)
		local gs = {0.15, 0.3, 0.1, 0.22}
		for i, g in ipairs(fGh) do g.o.Size = U2.fromOffset(U * gs[i], U * gs[i]) end
		swB.o.Size = U2.fromOffset(W * 0.34, H * 2.6)
		swC.o.Size = U2.fromOffset(max(3, W * 0.035), H * 2.6)
		for _, r in ipairs(RY) do r.o.Size = U2.fromOffset(max(3, U * 0.006), U * 1.9) end
		if tBand then
			tBand.o.Size = U2.fromOffset(W * 0.16, H * 1.2)
			tCore.o.Size = U2.fromOffset(max(3, W * 0.012), H * 1.2)
		end
		for _, s in ipairs(SHF) do
			s.L = max(W, H) * 1.8
			s.o.Size = U2.fromOffset(U * (0.05 + 0.1 * s.w), s.L)
		end
	end
	layout()

	-- ── camera: the master only adds a delta on top of the intro's own camera (never replaces it) ──
	local MC = {z = 0, r = 0, x = 0, y = 0, owner = stage}
	if P.base then FX.MasterCam = MC end
	local wd = E and E.world
	local zo = E and (E.zoom or E.zs or E.ws)
	local cam = {}
	local function camBase(key, curv, tol)
		if cam[key] == nil or abs(curv - cam[key]) > tol then cam[key .. "b"] = curv end
		return cam[key .. "b"]
	end
	local function applyCam(dz, dr, dx, dy)
		if not wd or not wd.Parent then return end
		if zo then
			local bz = camBase("z", zo.Scale, 1e-4)
			zo.Scale = bz * (1 + dz)
			cam.z = zo.Scale
		end
		local br = camBase("r", wd.Rotation, 0.01)
		wd.Rotation = br + dr
		cam.r = wd.Rotation
		local pos = wd.Position
		local bx, by = camBase("x", pos.X.Offset, 0.6), camBase("y", pos.Y.Offset, 0.6)
		local ox, oy = floor(bx + dx + 0.5), floor(by + dy + 0.5)
		wd.Position = U2.new(pos.X.Scale, ox, pos.Y.Scale, oy)
		cam.x, cam.y = ox, oy
	end
	local function spr(s, target, w, z, dt)
		local n = max(1, ceil(dt * 90))
		local h = dt / n
		for _ = 1, n do
			s[2] = s[2] + (w * w * (target - s[1]) - 2 * z * w * s[2]) * h
			s[1] = s[1] + s[2] * h
		end
		return s[1]
	end
	local zS, rS, xS, yS = {0, 0}, {0, 0}, {0, 0}, {0, 0}

	-- ── blur: everything goes through the shared controller; the UI veil mirrors it (and a local mirror when blur is off) ──
	local O = {v0 = 0, pk = 0, t0 = -99, i = 0.1, o = 0.5, h = 0}
	local function ownVal(now)
		local a = now - O.t0
		if a < 0 then return O.v0 end
		if a < O.i then return lerp(O.v0, O.pk, c01(a / O.i) ^ 0.6) end
		a = a - O.i
		if a < O.h then return O.pk end
		return O.pk * exp(-(a - O.h) / (O.o * 0.38))
	end
	local function reqBlur(peak, inT, outT, hold, now)
		O.v0 = ownVal(now)
		O.pk = cl(peak * (PKS[Q] or 1), 1.4, 20)
		O.t0, O.i, O.o, O.h = now, max(inT, 0.01), outT, hold or 0
		pcall(FX.BlurPulse, peak, inT, outT, true, hold or 0)
	end

	-- ── choreography state ──
	local ACT, EV = {}, {}
	local ci, ei, sgn = 0, 1, 1
	local beatE, prevPu, lastBeat, puS, lvS = 0, 0, -9, 0, 0
	local titleT, slT, accD, qT = nil, -9, 0, 0
	local firstStep, dead, hid = true, false, false
	local RGc = rig and {ox = rigs[1].ox, oy = rigs[1].oy, a0 = rigs[1].a0, sp = rigs[1].sp} or nil
	local te0 = K.DUR or 60

	local function onCut(now, e)
		local c = e.a
		ACT[#ACT + 1] = {t0 = now, kind = c.kind, str = c.str, sg = sgn}
		sgn = -sgn
	end
	local function onPre(now, e)
		local c = e.a
		local kd = KD[c.kind]
		local bl = (P.bl or 9) * c.str * kd.bl
		if e.st == 1 then reqBlur(bl * 0.38, 0.5, kd.out, 0.6, now) else reqBlur(bl, kd.lead, kd.out, 0.1, now) end
	end
	for _, c in ipairs(CUTS) do
		local kd = KD[c.kind]
		EV[#EV + 1] = {t = c.t - kd.lead - 0.4, f = onPre, a = c, st = 1}
		EV[#EV + 1] = {t = c.t - kd.lead, f = onPre, a = c, st = 2}
		EV[#EV + 1] = {t = c.t, f = onCut, a = c}
	end
	EV[#EV + 1] = {t = 0.4, f = function(now) ACT[#ACT + 1] = {t0 = now, kind = "tear", str = 0.55, sg = 1} end}
	EV[#EV + 1] = {t = te0 - (P.cbAt or 0.85), f = function(now) reqBlur(P.cb or 11, P.cbIn or 0.55, P.cbOut or 1.7, 0.25, now) end}
	if type(P.tt) == "number" then EV[#EV + 1] = {t = P.tt, f = function(now) titleT = now end} end
	table.sort(EV, function(a, b) return a.t < b.t end)

	local function hideAll()
		setTr(sSh, 1) setTr(sHi, 1) setTr(gGlow, 1) setTr(vW, 1) setTr(vG, 1) setTr(fS, 1) setTr(fC, 1) setTr(tF, 1)
		setTr(swB, 1) setTr(swC, 1) setTr(frL, 1) setTr(frR, 1)
		for _, s in ipairs(VG) do setTr(s, 1) end
		for _, s in ipairs(SHF) do setTr(s, 1) end
		for _, s in ipairs(MO) do setTr(s, 1) end
		for _, s in ipairs(FG) do setTr(s, 1) end
		for _, s in ipairs(fGh) do setTr(s, 1) end
		for _, s in ipairs(SLC) do setTr(s, 1) end
		for _, s in ipairs(RY) do setTr(s, 1) end
		for _, s in ipairs(RN) do setTr(s, 1) end
		if bT then bT.Visible, bB.Visible = false, false end
		if tS then tS.Visible = false end
		MC.z, MC.r, MC.x, MC.y = 0, 0, 0, 0
	end

	local function step(t, dt, S)
		if dead then return end
		if not stage.Parent then
			dead = true
			if FX.MasterCam == MC then FX.MasterCam = nil end
			return
		end
		dt = dt or 0.016
		if dt > 0.1 then dt = 0.1 elseif dt < 0.0005 then dt = 0.0167 end
		local te = (S and S.tEnd) or te0
		local life = 1 - c01((t - (te - 0.9)) / 0.7)
		if life <= 0.002 then
			if not hid then hid = true hideAll() end
			return
		end
		hid = false
		-- viewport
		local sz = stage.AbsoluteSize
		if sz.X > 10 and sz.Y > 10 and (firstStep or abs(sz.X - W) > 1.5 or abs(sz.Y - H) > 1.5) then
			W, H = sz.X, sz.Y
			U = min(W, H)
			layout()
		end
		if firstStep then
			firstStep = false
			lo.Visible, hi.Visible = true, true
			reqBlur(P.op or 11, 0.12, 2.1, 0.3, t)
		end
		qT = qT + dt
		if qT >= 1 then
			qT = 0
			local nq = qlevel()
			if nq ~= Q then Q = nq end
		end
		accD = accD + dt
		local doDecor = accD >= DI[Q]
		local dd = accD
		if doDecor then accD = 0 end

		-- events + shots
		while EV[ei] and t >= EV[ei].t do
			local e = EV[ei]
			ei = ei + 1
			if t - e.t < 0.35 then e.f(e.t, e) end
		end
		while CUTS[ci + 1] and t >= CUTS[ci + 1].t do
			ci = ci + 1
			if not dyn then
				PF = {sh = cur.sh, hi = cur.hi, a = cur.a, b = cur.b}
				PT = pal[cl(ci + 1, 1, palN)]
				palT0 = t
			end
		end

		-- audio-reactive envelopes (the intro's own beat state; the choreography never depends on them)
		local pu = (S and (S.pulse or S.kick)) or 0
		if pu > 1.2 then pu = 1.2 end
		local lv = (S and S.lv) or 0
		puS = lerp(puS, pu, 1 - exp(-16 * dt))
		lvS = lerp(lvS, max(lv, puS * 0.6), 1 - exp(-6 * dt))
		if pu > 0.55 and prevPu <= 0.55 and t - lastBeat > 0.2 then
			lastBeat = t
			beatE = max(beatE, c01(pu))
		end
		prevPu = pu
		beatE = beatE * exp(-9 * dt)

		-- palette
		if t - userT > 1 then userT, userC = t, userAcc() end
		if dyn then
			if t - accT > 0.08 then
				accT = t
				accC = userC or Util.DiscoColor(os.clock() * 0.48)
			end
			local p = pal[cl(ci + 1, 1, palN)]
			local k = 1 - exp(-3 * dt)
			skC, hkC = lerp(skC, p.sk, k), lerp(hkC, p.hk, k)
			cur.a, cur.b = accC, mix(accC, WHITE, 0.55)
			cur.hi, cur.sh = mix(accC, WHITE, hkC), mix(BLACK, accC, skC)
			acA, acB = cur.a, cur.b
		else
			local k = ss(palT0, palT0 + 0.9, t)
			if k < 1 then
				cur.sh, cur.hi, cur.a, cur.b = mix(PF.sh, PT.sh, k), mix(PF.hi, PT.hi, k), mix(PF.a, PT.a, k), mix(PF.b, PT.b, k)
			else
				cur.sh, cur.hi, cur.a, cur.b = PT.sh, PT.hi, PT.a, PT.b
			end
			acA = userC and mix(cur.a, userC, 0.5) or cur.a
			acB = userC and mix(cur.b, userC, 0.3) or cur.b
		end
		local sh, hiC = cur.sh, cur.hi

		-- cut envelopes
		local imp, flA, barH, frA = 0, 0, 0, 0
		local swRec, slRec, ryRec, rnRec, rollK = nil, nil, nil, nil, 0
		local ai = 1
		while ai <= #ACT do
			local r = ACT[ai]
			local kd = KD[r.kind]
			local a = t - r.t0
			if a > kd.dur then
				table.remove(ACT, ai)
			else
				ai = ai + 1
				local s = r.str * INT1
				local ke = env(a, 0.05, 0.32) * r.str
				imp = max(imp, ke)
				rollK = rollK + r.sg * ke
				frA = max(frA, env(a, 0.03, 0.22) * s)
				if r.kind == "flash" then
					local f
					if a < 0.045 then f = 0.95 elseif a < 0.085 then f = 0.12 elseif a < 0.16 then f = 0.72 else f = 0.72 * exp(-(a - 0.16) / 0.17) end
					flA = max(flA, f * 0.9 * s)
					swRec, rnRec = r, r
				elseif r.kind == "bloom" then
					flA = max(flA, 0.5 * s * env(a, 0.08, 0.55))
					swRec = r
				elseif r.kind == "slam" then
					flA = max(flA, 0.38 * s * env(a, 0.02, 0.15))
					barH = max(barH, 0.17 * s * env(a, 0.06, 0.25))
				elseif r.kind == "tear" then
					flA = max(flA, 0.3 * s * env(a, 0.03, 0.2))
					swRec = r
				elseif r.kind == "glitch" then
					flA = max(flA, 0.22 * s * env(a, 0.02, 0.1))
					slRec = r
				elseif r.kind == "burst" then
					flA = max(flA, 0.7 * s * env(a, 0.03, 0.2))
					ryRec, rnRec, swRec = r, r, r
				end
			end
		end
		-- anticipation: the frame tightens and warms before the next cut
		local nxt = CUTS[ci + 1]
		local tn = 0
		if nxt then
			local ant = nxt.t - t
			local win = (nxt.kind == "bloom") and 0.9 or 0.55
			if ant > 0 and ant < win then
				tn = (1 - ant / win) ^ 2
				if nxt.kind == "bloom" then flA = max(flA, 0.2 * tn * INT1) end
			end
		end
		local openK = 1 - ss(0, 2.4, t)
		local closeK = ss(te0 - 1.5, te0 - 0.25, t)
		local ttE, ttA = 0, -9
		if titleT then
			ttA = t - titleT
			ttE = env(ttA, 0.12, 1.1)
		end

		-- shared-blur-driven defocus veil
		local vv
		local S_ = FX.Settings
		if S_ and S_.Blur then
			local bf, bs = FX.BlurFx, FX.BlurState
			local extra = 0
			if bf then extra = max(0, (bf.Size or 0) - ((bs and bs.base) or 0)) end
			vv = c01(extra / 15)
		else
			vv = c01(ownVal(t) / 15) * 0.6
		end
		local gate = INT1 * life

		-- grade + light
		setCol(sSh, sh)
		setTr(sSh, 1 - (0.14 + 0.07 * tn + 0.08 * lvS) * gate)
		setCol(sHi, hiC)
		setTr(sHi, 1 - (0.07 + 0.1 * puS + 0.16 * imp) * gate)
		if gGlow.ok then
			setCol(gGlow, hiC)
			setTr(gGlow, 1 - ((0.06 + 0.16 * lvS + 0.3 * imp + 0.28 * ttE + 0.14 * openK) * gate + ((P.noGlow and 0 or 0.26) * closeK) * INT1))
		end
		if VG[1] then
			local vc = mix(sh, BLACK, 0.6)
			local va = (P.vig or 0) * (0.55 + 0.3 * tn + 0.25 * openK - 0.15 * imp) * gate
			for i = 1, 4 do
				setCol(VG[i], vc)
				setTr(VG[i], 1 - va)
			end
		end
		if rig then
			local tg = rigs[(ci % #rigs) + 1]
			local k = 1 - exp(-2.2 * dt)
			RGc.ox, RGc.oy, RGc.a0, RGc.sp = lerp(RGc.ox, tg.ox, k), lerp(RGc.oy, tg.oy, k), lerp(RGc.a0, tg.a0, k), lerp(RGc.sp, tg.sp, k)
		end
		if doDecor then
			-- volumetric shafts
			if rig then
				local n = min(#SHF, QS[Q])
				local kc = (rig.key == "hi" and hiC) or (rig.key == "a" and acA) or acB
				local ox, oy = RGc.ox * W, RGc.oy * H
				local sa = gate * (1 + 1.4 * imp + 0.5 * ttE)
				for i = 1, #SHF do
					local s = SHF[i]
					if i <= n then
						local u = (n > 1) and ((i - 1) / (n - 1) - 0.5) or 0
						local a = (RGc.a0 + u * RGc.sp + rig.sway * sin(t * 0.44 * s.w + s.ph)) / DEG
						local L = s.L
						s.o.Position = U2.fromOffset(ox + sin(a) * L * 0.5, oy + cos(a) * L * 0.5)
						s.o.Rotation = -a * DEG
						local br = (0.5 + 0.5 * sin(t * (0.5 + s.w) + s.ph)) * (0.55 + 0.45 * s.a)
						setTr(s, 1 - rig.al * sa * br * (0.55 + 0.9 * lvS + 0.8 * puS))
						setCol(s, kc)
					else
						setTr(s, 1)
					end
				end
			end
			-- depth motif / bokeh
			if mc then
				local n = min(#MO, QM[Q])
				local mcol = (mc.col == "hi" and hiC) or (mc.col == "a" and acA) or acB
				local ma = gate * (0.7 + 0.5 * lvS + 0.6 * vv)
				for i = 1, #MO do
					local p = MO[i]
					if i <= n then
						local z = p.z
						p.x = p.x + (mc.vx + sin(t * 0.4 + p.ph) * mc.sw) * z * dd
						p.y = p.y + mc.vy * z * dd
						if p.x > 1.08 then p.x = -0.08 elseif p.x < -0.08 then p.x = 1.08 end
						if p.y > 1.1 then p.y = -0.1 elseif p.y < -0.1 then p.y = 1.1 end
						p.o.Position = U2.fromScale(p.x, p.y)
						local tw = 1 - mc.tw + mc.tw * (0.5 + 0.5 * sin(t * p.w * 2 + p.ph))
						setTr(p, 1 - mc.al * z * tw * ma)
						setCol(p, mcol)
					else
						setTr(p, 1)
					end
				end
			end
			-- atmosphere bands
			if #FG > 0 then
				local fc = mix(hiC, sh, 0.55)
				for i = 1, #FG do
					local f = FG[i]
					if i <= QF[Q] then
						f.o.Position = U2.fromScale(0.5 + sin(t * 0.06 + f.ph) * 0.07, f.y0 + sin(t * 0.11 + f.ph) * 0.012)
						setTr(f, 1 - (0.1 + 0.05 * lvS) * gate * (0.8 + 0.4 * vv))
						setCol(f, fc)
					else
						setTr(f, 1)
					end
				end
			end
		end

		-- defocus veil: haze + bloom, both locked to the shared blur controller
		setCol(vW, mix(hiC, WHITE, 0.6))
		setTr(vW, 1 - 0.34 * vv * gate)
		if vG.ok then
			vG.o.Position = U2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
			setCol(vG, hiC)
			setTr(vG, 1 - 0.7 * vv * gate)
		end

		-- impact flash (a closing glow creeps in under the intro's own hand-off flash)
		local closeF = (P.noGlow and 0 or 0.2) * closeK * INT1 * (1 - ss(te0 - 0.25, te0, t))
		setCol(tF, mix(WHITE, hiC, 0.22))
		setTr(tF, 1 - max(flA * life, closeF))

		-- light sweep
		if swRec then
			local a = t - swRec.t0
			local dur = (swRec.kind == "bloom") and 1.3 or 0.7
			local k = c01(a / dur)
			local x = lerp(-0.3, 1.3, eo5(k)) * W
			if swRec.sg < 0 then x = W - x end
			local pw = sin(pi * k) ^ 1.2 * swRec.str * gate * ((swRec.kind == "bloom") and 0.5 or 1)
			swB.o.Position, swC.o.Position = U2.fromOffset(x, H * 0.5), U2.fromOffset(x + W * 0.02 * swRec.sg, H * 0.5)
			swB.o.Rotation, swC.o.Rotation = 18 * swRec.sg, 18 * swRec.sg
			setCol(swB, mix(WHITE, acA, 0.35))
			setCol(swC, WHITE)
			setTr(swB, 1 - 0.55 * pw)
			setTr(swC, 1 - 0.9 * pw)
		else
			setTr(swB, 1)
			setTr(swC, 1)
		end

		-- chromatic edge fringe
		setCol(frL, acB)
		setCol(frR, acA)
		setTr(frL, 1 - 0.6 * frA * life)
		setTr(frR, 1 - 0.6 * frA * life)

		-- shutter slam
		if bT then
			if barH > 0.002 then
				bT.Visible, bB.Visible = true, true
				bT.Size, bB.Size = U2.fromScale(1, barH), U2.fromScale(1, barH)
			else
				bT.Visible, bB.Visible = false, false
			end
		end
		-- glitch slices
		if #SLC > 0 then
			if slRec then
				local a = t - slRec.t0
				local fall = 1 - c01(a / 0.5)
				local re = t - slT > 0.05
				if re then slT = t end
				for i = 1, #SLC do
					local s = SLC[i]
					if re then
						s.o.Size = U2.fromOffset(W * (0.3 + random() * 0.7), (0.008 + random() * 0.05) * H)
						s.o.Position = U2.fromOffset(random() * W * 0.4, random() * H)
						s.rc = (i % 3 == 0) and WHITE or ((i % 3 == 1) and acA or acB)
						s.ra = 0.3 + random() * 0.35
					end
					if s.rc then setCol(s, s.rc) end
					setTr(s, 1 - (s.ra or 0.4) * fall * slRec.str * gate)
				end
			else
				for i = 1, #SLC do setTr(SLC[i], 1) end
			end
		end
		-- burst rays + shock rings
		if #RY > 0 then
			if ryRec then
				local a = t - ryRec.t0
				local k = c01(a / 0.9)
				local len = U * (0.3 + 1.6 * eo5(k))
				local ra = (1 - k) ^ 1.5 * ryRec.str * gate
				local rc = mix(WHITE, acA, 0.4)
				for i = 1, #RY do
					local r = RY[i]
					r.o.Size = U2.fromOffset(max(3, U * 0.006), len)
					r.o.Rotation = (i - 1) * (180 / #RY) + a * 30 * ryRec.sg
					setCol(r, rc)
					setTr(r, 1 - 0.8 * ra)
				end
			else
				for i = 1, #RY do setTr(RY[i], 1) end
			end
		end
		if #RN > 0 then
			if rnRec and RN[1].ok then
				local a = t - rnRec.t0
				for i = 1, #RN do
					local k = c01((a - 0.12 * (i - 1)) / (0.9 + 0.1 * (i - 1)))
					local r = RN[i]
					local sz2 = U * (0.12 + (1.5 + 0.4 * (i - 1)) * eo5(k))
					r.o.Size = U2.fromOffset(sz2, sz2)
					setCol(r, (i == 1) and acA or hiC)
					setTr(r, (k > 0 and k < 1) and (1 - 0.75 * (1 - k) ^ 1.3 * rnRec.str * gate) or 1)
				end
			else
				for i = 1, #RN do setTr(RN[i], 1) end
			end
		end

		-- lens flare from the key light (cuts, title, closing and the beat feed it)
		local fi = c01(max(imp * 0.9, ttE * 0.8, closeK * 0.5 * (P.noGlow and 0 or 1), 0.22 * puS)) * gate
		if fi > 0.02 and rig then
			local lx, ly = cl(RGc.ox, 0.06, 0.94) * W, cl(RGc.oy, 0.06, 0.94) * H
			local fc = mix(hiC, WHITE, 0.4)
			fS.o.Position = U2.fromOffset(lx, ly)
			setCol(fS, fc)
			setTr(fS, 1 - 0.75 * fi)
			if fC.ok then
				fC.o.Position = U2.fromOffset(lx, ly)
				setCol(fC, mix(WHITE, hiC, 0.25))
				setTr(fC, 1 - 0.9 * fi)
			end
			local cx, cy = W * 0.5, H * 0.5
			for i = 1, #fGh do
				local g = fGh[i]
				if i <= QG[Q] and g.ok then
					g.o.Position = U2.fromOffset(lx + (cx - lx) * KGH[i], ly + (cy - ly) * KGH[i])
					setCol(g, (i % 2 == 1) and acA or acB)
					setTr(g, 1 - GAH[i] * fi)
				else
					setTr(g, 1)
				end
			end
		else
			setTr(fS, 1)
			setTr(fC, 1)
			for i = 1, #fGh do setTr(fGh[i], 1) end
		end

		-- title glint: a specular sweep crosses the title band, the frame blooms and the camera pushes in
		if tS then
			if ttA > -0.05 and ttA < 2 then
				tS.Visible = true
				local k = c01(ttA / 1.25)
				local x = lerp(-0.2, 1.2, eo3(k))
				local pw = sin(pi * k) ^ 1.2 * gate
				tBand.o.Position, tCore.o.Position = U2.new(x, 0, 0.5, 0), U2.new(x + 0.012, 0, 0.5, 0)
				setCol(tBand, mix(WHITE, hiC, 0.3))
				setCol(tCore, WHITE)
				setTr(tBand, 1 - 0.5 * pw)
				setTr(tCore, 1 - 0.85 * pw)
			elseif tS.Visible then
				tS.Visible = false
				setTr(tBand, 1)
				setTr(tCore, 1)
			end
		end

		-- camera: dolly inside the shot, anticipation creep, impact punch with natural overshoot, opening settle, closing push
		local seg0 = (ci > 0) and CUTS[ci].t or 0
		local seg1 = nxt and nxt.t or te0
		local zt = (P.push or 0.02) * ss(seg0, seg1, t)
		zt = zt + 0.04 * openK + (P.bp or 0.004) * beatE + 0.02 * tn + 0.05 * imp
		if titleT then zt = zt + 0.028 * ss(titleT, titleT + 2.6, t) end
		zt = zt + 0.03 * closeK
		local rt = (P.roll or 1) * rollK + 0.25 * sin(t * 0.41) + 0.9 * openK
		local xt = sin(t * 0.33) * W * 0.0025
		local yt = cos(t * 0.27) * H * 0.002
		local cf = (P.cam or 1) * gate
		local dz = spr(zS, zt, 13, 0.7, dt) * cf
		local dr = spr(rS, rt, 9, 0.55, dt) * cf
		local dx = spr(xS, xt, 7, 0.8, dt) * cf
		local dy = spr(yS, yt, 7, 0.8, dt) * cf
		if P.base then
			MC.z, MC.r, MC.x, MC.y = dz, dr, dx, dy
		else
			applyCam(dz, dr, dx, dy)
		end
	end
	local function kill()
		dead = true
		MC.z, MC.r, MC.x, MC.y = 0, 0, 0, 0
		if FX.MasterCam == MC then FX.MasterCam = nil end
		pcall(function() lo:Destroy() end)
		pcall(function() hi:Destroy() end)
	end
	return step, kill
end
]==]
function FX.MountMaster(stage, E, id, d, K, zb)
if FX.MasterFn == nil then
FX.MasterFn = false
local ls = loadstring or load
if ls then
local okC, fn, cerr = pcall(ls, FX.IntroMasterSrc, "=IntroMaster")
if okC and type(fn) == "function" then
local okR, mod = pcall(fn, Util, FX)
if okR and type(mod) == "function" then
FX.MasterFn = mod
else
warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro master layer unavailable: " .. tostring(mod))
end
else
warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro master layer unavailable: " .. tostring(cerr or fn))
end
end
end
if not FX.MasterFn then return nil end
local ok, up, kill = pcall(FX.MasterFn, stage, E, id, d, K, zb)
if ok and type(up) == "function" then return up, kill end
if not ok then warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro master layer mount failed: " .. tostring(up)) end
return nil
end
function FX.AttachMaster(stage, E, id, d, K, zb)
local step, kill = FX.MountMaster(stage, E, id, d, K, zb)
if type(step) ~= "function" then return nil end
local alive, last = true, os.clock()
return function(t, dt, S)
if not alive or type(t) ~= "number" then return end
local now = os.clock()
if type(dt) ~= "number" or dt <= 0 then dt = now - last end
last = now
local ok, err = pcall(step, t, dt, S)
if not ok then
alive = false
warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro master layer error (continuing): " .. tostring(err))
if type(kill) == "function" then pcall(kill) end
end
end
end
function FX.IntroBlurOut(peak)
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, peak or 12, 0.2, 1.7, true, 0.12)
end
function FX.IntroUpgrade(stage, E, id, d, K, zb)
local ms = FX.AttachMaster(stage, E, id, d, K, zb)
local base = FX.IUBase(stage, E, id, d, K, zb)
local rm = FX.MountRemaster(stage, E, id, d, K, zb)
if type(ms) ~= "function" then ms = nil end
if type(base) ~= "function" then base = nil end
if type(rm) ~= "function" then rm = nil end
if not ms and not base and not rm then return nil end
return function(t, dt, S)
if ms then ms(t, dt, S) end
if base then base(t, dt, S) end
if rm then rm(t, dt, S) end
end
end

local function clamp01(x)
return math.max(0, math.min(1, x))
end
local function lerp(a, b, k)
return a + (b - a) * k
end
local function smooth(u)
return u * u * (3 - 2 * u)
end
local function accent()
if CFG.IntroColorMode == 2 then
return Util.ParseHex(CFG.IntroColor) or WHITE
elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 3 then
return WHITE
elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 4 and Util.Color then
return Util.Color.Cur
end
return Color3.fromRGB(150, 196, 255):Lerp(Color3.fromRGB(196, 166, 255), 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(os.clock() * 0.35))
end
local function mk(class, parent, props)
local o = Util.Instance(class, parent)
if props then
for k, v in pairs(props) do
o[k] = v
end
end
return o
end
local function txt(parent, z, font, ax, ay, pos, size, xa)

TextColor3 = WHITE, TextXAlignment = xa or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, TextScaled = true, Text = "", TextTransparency = 1,
ZIndex = z, Interactable = false,
})
end
local function scr(s, frac)
local n = math.floor(#s * clamp01(frac))
if n >= #s then return s end
local out = s:sub(1, n)
for i = n + 1, #s do
if s:sub(i, i) == " " then
out = out .. " "
else
local k = math.random(1, #GLYPHS)
out = out .. GLYPHS:sub(k, k)
end
end
return out
end
local function itick(pitch, vol)
if not FX.Settings.ExtraSounds then return end
local base = opts.ClickSnd
if not base or base.Volume <= 0 then return end
pcall(function()
local s = base:Clone()
s.PlaybackSpeed = pitch * (0.96 + math.random() * 0.08)
s.Volume = base.Volume * vol
s.Parent = base.Parent
s:Play()
Debris:AddItem(s, 2.5)
end)
end
local function modStatus()
local f = Util.GetModuleStatus
if type(f) ~= "function" then return "BOOTING UI..." end
local ok, s = pcall(f)
return (ok and type(s) == "string") and s or ""
end
local function spend(n)
if S.tokens >= n then
S.tokens = S.tokens - n
return true
end
return false
end
local function follow(key, target, w, z, dt, init)
local st = S.sp[key]
if not st then
st = {init or target, 0}
S.sp[key] = st
end
local n = math.max(1, math.ceil(dt * 90))
local h = dt / n
for _ = 1, n do
st[2] = st[2] + (w * w * (target - st[1]) - 2 * z * w * st[2]) * h
st[1] = st[1] + st[2] * h
end
return st[1]
end
local function parse(s)
local a = {}
for t, k in tostring(s):gmatch("([%d%.]+):(%d)") do
a[#a + 1] = {tonumber(t), tonumber(k)}
end
return a
end
local function parseCut(s)
local a = {}
for t0, t1 in tostring(s):gmatch("([%d%.]+):([%d%.]+)") do
a[#a + 1] = {tonumber(t0), tonumber(t1)}
end
return a
end

E.orbs[i] = {f = f, gl = gl, hl = hl, rk = 0.018 + 0.016 * ((i * 7) % 5) / 4, x = 0, y = 0, vx = 0, vy = 0, a = (i / 11) * 6.283, zi = 10}
end
E.shoot = {}
for i = 1, 6 do
local f = box(E.world, 9, 0.5, 0.5, C5, UDim2.fromOffset(120, 2), WHITE, 0)
f.Visible = false
local g = Util.Instance("UIGradient", f)
g.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0)})
E.shoot[i] = {f = f, age = 9, life = 1, x = 0, y = 0, vx = 0, vy = 0, len = 120}
end
local half, full = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
E.tF = box(E.world, 14, 0.5, 0.5, C5, UDim2.fromScale(0.86, 0.2), WHITE, 1)
E.tS = Util.Instance("UIScale", E.tF)
E.tR = txt(E.tF, 14, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, 0.5, 0.5, half, full)
E.tC = txt(E.tF, 15, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, 0.5, 0.5, half, full)
E.tM = txt(E.tF, 16, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, 0.5, 0.5, half, full)
E.tR.TextColor3, E.tC.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(190, 150, 255), Color3.fromRGB(130, 205, 255)
E.sub = txt(E.world, 14, Enum.Font.Code, 0.5, 0.5, C5, UDim2.fromScale(0.6, 0.035))
E.cards = {}
local CARDS = {
{"ORIGINAL CREATOR", CREATOR, Color3.fromRGB(150, 200, 255)},
{"MODDED BY", "NOOBY", Color3.fromRGB(192, 160, 255)},
{"SOUNDTRACK", ((SONG.Title or "Moonlight"):gsub("%s*%b()", "")):upper(), Color3.fromRGB(255, 226, 160)},
}
for i, c in ipairs(CARDS) do
local f = box(E.world, 12, 0.5, 0.5, C5, UDim2.fromOffset(300, 108), Color3.fromRGB(10, 14, 38), 0.08)
f.Visible = false
Util.Instance("UICorner", f).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 10)
mk("UIStroke", f, {Thickness = 2, Color = c[3], Transparency = 0.1})
box(f, 13, 0, 0, UDim2.fromScale(0, 0), UDim2.new(0, 8, 1, 0), c[3], 0)
local role = txt(f, 13, Enum.Font.Code, 0, 0, UDim2.new(0, 22, 0.12, 0), UDim2.new(1, -34, 0.22, 0), Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
local name = txt(f, 13, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, 0, 0, UDim2.new(0, 22, 0.42, 0), UDim2.new(1, -34, 0.42, 0), Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
role.Text, name.Text = c[1], c[2]
role.TextColor3, role.TextTransparency, name.TextTransparency = c[3], 0, 0
E.cards[i] = f
end
E.barT = box(stage, 20, 0.5, 0, UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), BLACK, 0)
E.barB = box(stage, 20, 0.5, 1, UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 1), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0), BLACK, 0)
E.flash = box(stage, 40, 0.5, 0.5, C5, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), WHITE, 1)
do local ok, up = pcall(FX.IntroUpgrade, stage, E, 2, {M2, M3, M4}, K, 24) if ok and type(up) == "function" then E.up = up end end
local function hud(ax, ay, pos, xa)
return mk("TextLabel", stage, {
AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = pos, Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 18), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = Enum.Font.Code,
TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = WHITE, TextTransparency = 1, TextXAlignment = xa, ZIndex = 21, Interactable = false, Text = "",
})
end
E.tc = hud(0, 0, UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 14), Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
E.np = hud(0, 1, UDim2.new(0, 16, 1, -22), Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
E.ms = hud(1, 1, UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -22), Enum.TextXAlignment.Right)
E.prog = box(stage, 22, 0, 1, UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 3), WHITE, 0)
E.term = mk("TextLabel", stage, {
Position = UDim2.new(0, 46, 0, 90), Size = UDim2.new(1, -92, 0.5, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 16,
TextColor3 = WHITE, TextTransparency = 1, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top,
ZIndex = 21, Interactable = false, Text = "",
})
E.skip = mk("TextButton", stage, {
AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 14), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(168, 30), BackgroundColor3 = BLACK,
BackgroundTransparency = 0.3, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = WHITE, Text = "SKIP INTRO  >>  OPEN UI",

end)

local function shoot(n)
for _ = 1, n do
for _, s in ipairs(E.shoot) do
if s.age >= s.life then
local dir = math.random() < 0.5 and 1 or -1
local ang = 0.35 + math.random() * 0.35
local sp = S.sx * (0.9 + math.random() * 0.5)
s.life, s.age = 0.55 + math.random() * 0.3, 0
s.len = S.sy * (0.14 + math.random() * 0.12)
s.x, s.y = (math.random() - 0.5) * S.sx * 0.9 - dir * S.sx * 0.2, -S.sy * (0.5 + math.random() * 0.1)
s.vx, s.vy = dir * math.cos(ang) * sp, math.sin(ang) * sp
s.f.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(s.vy, s.vx))
s.f.Visible = true
break
end
end
end
end
local function loop()
do
local w0, lim = os.clock(), opts.ReadyWait or 8
while opts.Ready and not opts.Ready() and os.clock() - w0 < lim and not S.skipped do
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then break end
local prog = SONG.Progress
E.term.Text = "> LOADING SOUNDTRACK" .. string.rep(".", math.floor(os.clock() * 3) % 4)
.. ((type(prog) == "number" and prog > 0 and prog < 1) and string.format("  %d%%", math.floor(prog * 100)) or "")
E.term.TextTransparency = 0.3
E.term.TextColor3 = accent()
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
end
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then
S.fallback = true
return
end
E.term.Text = ""
S.began = os.clock()
S.wall0 = S.began
end
local seed = math.random() * 50
local function onMode(m, t, col, w, h)
local I = K.INT
S.modeAt = t
local mp = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, S.moonY)
if m == 2 then
for i, b in ipairs(E.orbs) do
b.x, b.y = 0, S.moonY
local a = (i / #E.orbs) * 6.283 + math.random() * 0.4
b.vx, b.vy = math.cos(a) * w * (0.14 + math.random() * 0.2), -h * (0.7 + math.random() * 0.6)
end
S.mk = S.mk + 0.3
S.flashK, S.zk, S.chroma, S.shake = math.max(S.flashK, 0.8 * I), S.zk - 0.2 * I, 40, 12 * I
FX.Sparks(E.world, col, 24, 320, 0.9)
FX.Ring(E.world, WHITE, 900, 0.9, 6, mp)
FX.Ring(E.world, col, 600, 0.7, 4, mp)
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 14, 0.16, 0.81)
shoot(3)
itick(0.5, 1)
elseif m == 3 then
S.mk = S.mk + 0.22
S.flashK, S.zk, S.chroma, S.shake = math.max(S.flashK, 0.7 * I), S.zk - 0.14 * I, 30, 10 * I
FX.Sparks(E.world, col, 16, 260, 0.8)
FX.Ring(E.world, WHITE, 800, 0.8, 5, mp)
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 10, 0.16, 0.68)
shoot(2)
itick(0.55, 1)
elseif m == 4 then
S.sp.tsc = {0.35, 0}
S.mk = S.mk + 0.3
S.flashK, S.chroma, S.zk, S.shake = math.max(S.flashK, 0.9 * I), 44, S.zk - 0.2 * I, 14 * I
FX.Sparks(E.world, col, 22, 300, 0.9)
FX.Ring(E.world, WHITE, 950, 0.9, 6, mp)
FX.Ring(E.world, col, 650, 0.7, 4, mp)
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 14, 0.16, 0.81)
shoot(3)
itick(0.5, 1)
end
end
local function bassHit(k, t, m, col, w, h)
local I = K.INT
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, (0.1 + 0.1 * k) * I)
S.mk = S.mk + 0.045 * k
S.zk = S.zk - 0.05 * k * I
S.rk = S.rk + S.dir * (1.2 + k) * I
S.dir = -S.dir
S.xk = S.xk + S.dir * w * 0.008 * k * I
S.shake = math.max(S.shake, (4 + 4 * k) * I)
S.chroma = S.chroma + 10 * k
if m == 3 then S.stormK = 1 end
itick(0.55, 0.8)
if spend(1) then FX.Ring(E.world, col, 460 + 140 * k, 0.75, 2 + k, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, S.moonY)) end
if spend(1) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 3 + 3 * k, 0.16, 0.47) end
if m == 2 and t - S.modeAt > 0.15 then
for _, b in ipairs(E.orbs) do
b.vy = -h * (0.4 + 0.22 * k) * (0.8 + math.random() * 0.4)
end
end
end
local function snareHit(k, m, col, w, h)
local I = K.INT
S.pulse = math.max(S.pulse, 0.75)
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, (0.12 + 0.1 * k) * I)
S.zk = S.zk - 0.03 * k * I
S.rk = S.rk + S.dir * 2 * k * I
S.dir = -S.dir
S.shake = math.max(S.shake, 5 * I)
S.chroma = S.chroma + 8 * k
shoot(k > 1 and 2 or 1)
if m == 1 then
S.step = S.step + 1
S.mk = S.mk + 0.05
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.3 * I)
itick(0.9 + 0.1 * S.step, 0.9)
FX.Ring(E.world, col, 380 + 80 * S.step, 0.7, 3, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, S.moonY))
else
if spend(1) then FX.Sparks(E.world, col, 5 + 3 * k, 150, 0.5) end
if m == 2 then
for _, b in ipairs(E.orbs) do
b.vy = -h * (0.3 + 0.25 * math.random())
end
end
end
end
local function accHit(k, m, col, h)
local I = K.INT
S.pulse = math.max(S.pulse, 0.25 + 0.15 * k)
S.zk = S.zk - 0.01 * k * I
if m == 3 then S.stormK = math.max(S.stormK, 0.35 * k) end
if m == 4 then
S.rk = S.rk + S.dir * 1.5 * k * I
S.dir = -S.dir
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.08 * I)
end
if m == 2 then
E.orbs[math.random(1, #E.orbs)].vy = -h * (0.4 + 0.4 * math.random())
end
end
local function rv(t, n)
return 1 - clamp01((t - M2 - K.BEAT * n) / (K.BEAT * 0.6))
end
while true do
local dt = math.min(RunService.Heartbeat:Wait(), 0.1)
local t = os.clock() - S.began
do
local okP, pos, playing = pcall(function() return Music.TimePosition, Music.IsPlaying end)
if okP and playing and type(pos) == "number" and pos > 0.05 then
local d = pos - t
if math.abs(d) > 0.6 then
S.began = os.clock() - pos
else
S.began = S.began - d * 0.2
end
t = os.clock() - S.began
end
end
if S.skipped and S.tEnd == K.DUR then
S.tEnd = t + 0.35
S.flashLen = 0.35
end
if t >= S.tEnd or t > K.DUR + 8 or os.clock() - S.wall0 > K.DUR + 10 then break end
local sw = Util.GetScreenSize()
local sx, sy = sw.X, sw.Y
S.sx, S.sy = sx, sy
local col = accent()
S.tokens = math.min(3, S.tokens + dt * 2.5)
local bar = math.clamp(math.floor((t - K.OFF) / K.BAR) + 1, 1, 16)
local bt = math.max(0, (t - K.OFF) / K.BEAT)
local beatIdx = math.floor(bt)
local mode = t < M2 and 1 or (t < M3 and 2 or (t < M4 and 3 or 4))
local floorY = sy * 0.27
local R3 = math.min(sy * 0.34, sx * 0.42)
local rm0 = sy * 0.15
local u1 = clamp01((t - K.OFF) / (M2 - K.OFF))
local u3 = clamp01((t - M3) / (M4 - M3))
local u4 = clamp01((t - M4) / (K.DUR - M4))
local inCut = false
for _, c in ipairs(CUTS) do
if t >= c[1] and t < c[2] then inCut = true end
end
if inCut and not S.inCut then
S.chroma = S.chroma + 18
S.zk = S.zk + 0.05 * K.INT
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 6, 0.22, 0.81)
end
S.inCut = inCut
S.ecl = lerp(S.ecl, inCut and 1 or 0, 1 - math.exp(-(inCut and 9 or 40) * dt))
if mode ~= S.mode then
S.mode = mode
onMode(mode, t, col, sx, sy)
end
if beatIdx ~= S.bi then
S.bi = beatIdx
S.pulse = (beatIdx % 4 == 0) and 1 or 0.5
if mode == 1 then
itick((beatIdx % 4 == 0) and 1.5 or 1.2, 0.3)
if beatIdx % 4 == 0 and spend(1) then FX.Ring(E.world, col, 220 + 6 * beatIdx, 0.8, 2, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, S.moonY)) end
if beatIdx >= 28 and beatIdx <= 31 then itick(0.9 + 0.12 * (beatIdx - 28), 0.8) end
end
end
S.pulse = S.pulse * math.exp(-5 * dt)
S.stormK = S.stormK * math.exp(-4 * dt)
S.mk = S.mk * math.exp(-7 * dt)
while S.ei < #BASS and t >= BASS[S.ei + 1][1] do
S.ei = S.ei + 1
if t - BASS[S.ei][1] < 0.3 then bassHit(BASS[S.ei][2], t, mode, col, sx, sy) end
end
while S.si < #SNARE and t >= SNARE[S.si + 1][1] do
S.si = S.si + 1
if t - SNARE[S.si][1] < 0.3 then snareHit(SNARE[S.si][2], mode, col, sx, sy) end
end
while S.ai < #ACC and t >= ACC[S.ai + 1][1] do
S.ai = S.ai + 1
if t - ACC[S.ai][1] < 0.3 then accHit(ACC[S.ai][2], mode, col, sy) end
end
while S.wi < #TW and t >= TW[S.wi + 1][1] do
S.wi = S.wi + 1
if t - TW[S.wi][1] < 0.3 and #E.dust > 0 then
E.dust[math.random(1, #E.dust)].fl = 1
if mode >= 3 then E.dust[math.random(1, #E.dust)].fl = 1 end
end
end
local li = math.floor(t * 20) + 1
S.lv = lerp(S.lv, (tonumber(D.level:sub(li, li)) or 0) / 9, 1 - math.exp(-12 * dt))
S.ts = lerp(S.ts, inCut and 0.3 or 1, 1 - math.exp(-6 * dt))
S.br = lerp(S.br, mode == 1 and (0.28 + 0.18 * S.step) or 1, 1 - math.exp(-5 * dt))
local br = S.br * (1 - 0.88 * S.ecl)
local MYF = -sy * 0.07
local e1 = smooth(u1)
local mscT, myT = 1, MYF
if mode == 1 then
mscT = 0.55 + 0.45 * e1
myT = lerp(floorY + rm0 * mscT * 1.15, MYF, e1)
elseif mode == 3 then
mscT = 0.84
elseif mode == 4 then
mscT = 1 + 0.5 * u4 ^ 3
end
local msc = follow("msc", mscT, 9, 0.7, dt, 0.55)
local myy = follow("my", myT, 9, 0.8, dt, floorY + rm0 * 0.55 * 1.15)
S.moonY = myy
local tz, tx, ty, tr = 1, 0, 0, 0
if mode == 1 then
tz = 1 + 0.05 * u1 + 0.22 * u1 ^ 3
tr = math.sin(t * 0.5) * 1.2 * (1 - u1)
tx = math.sin(t * 0.4) * sx * 0.012
elseif mode == 2 then
tz = 1.03 + 0.05 * S.ecl
tr = ((bar % 2 == 1) and 1 or -1) * 1.2 * K.INT
ty = math.sin(t * 0.9) * sy * 0.01
elseif mode == 3 then
tx = math.sin(u3 * 6.283) * sx * 0.04
tr = math.sin(u3 * 6.283 + 1.2) * 1.8 * K.INT
tz = 1.05 + 0.03 * math.sin(u3 * 12.566) + 0.05 * S.ecl
else
tz = 1.06 + 0.5 * u4 ^ 3
tr = (1 - u4) * -2 * K.INT
end
local hk = K.INT * (mode == 4 and 1.5 or 1)
tx = tx + math.noise(t * 1.3, seed) * sx * 0.006 * hk
ty = ty + math.noise(t * 1.1, seed + 5) * sy * 0.006 * hk
tr = tr + math.noise(t * 0.9, seed + 9) * 0.5 * hk
local kd = math.exp(-6 * dt)
S.zk, S.rk, S.xk = S.zk * kd, S.rk * kd, S.xk * kd
S.shake = S.shake * math.exp(-9 * dt)
local cx = follow("cx", tx + S.xk, 12, 0.6, dt)
local cy = follow("cy", ty, 12, 0.6, dt)
local cz = follow("cz", tz + S.zk, 10, 0.62, dt)
local cr = follow("cr", tr + S.rk, 11, 0.45, dt)
E.world.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, cx + math.noise(t * 38, seed + 1) * S.shake, 0.5, cy + math.noise(t * 38, seed + 3) * S.shake)
E.world.Rotation = cr
E.zoom.Scale = math.clamp(cz, 0.6, 2.3)
if E.up then E.up(t, dt, S) end
E.bgG.Color = ColorSequence.new(
SKYT:Lerp(BLACK, 0.6 * S.ecl),
SKYB:Lerp(col, 0.05 + 0.1 * S.pulse * S.br):Lerp(BLACK, 0.7 * S.ecl)
)
E.glow.BackgroundColor3 = col
E.glow.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.95 - 0.1 * S.pulse * S.br - (mode > 1 and 0.16 * S.lv or 0), 0.35, 1)
local starsOn = clamp01(t / (M2 * 0.8))
local starCol = WHITE:Lerp(col, 0.25)
for _, d in ipairs(E.dust) do
d.x = (d.x + dt * S.ts * (0.004 + 0.01 * S.lv) * d.z) % 1
d.fl = d.fl * math.exp(-5 * dt)
d.f.Position = UDim2.new(d.x * 2.4 - 0.7, -cx * d.z * 0.3, d.y * 1.6 - 0.3, 0)
local tw = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * (1.2 + d.z) + d.ph)
if d.i <= (0.15 + 0.85 * starsOn) * #E.dust then
d.f.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.7 - 0.35 * tw - 0.8 * d.fl + 0.5 * S.ecl, 0, 1)
else
d.f.BackgroundTransparency = 1
end
d.f.BackgroundColor3 = starCol
local sz = d.sz * (1 + 2.2 * d.fl)
d.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sz, sz)
end
for _, c in ipairs(E.clouds) do
c.x = (c.x + dt * S.ts * c.sp * (1 + 2 * S.lv)) % 1
c.f.Position = UDim2.new(c.x * 1.7 - 0.35, -cx * 0.15, 0.5, c.y * sy)
c.f.Size = UDim2.new(c.w, 0, 0, sy * c.h)
c.f.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(110, 122, 200):Lerp(col, 0.25)
c.f.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.92 - 0.04 * S.lv - 0.03 * S.pulse - 0.04 * S.br, 0.8, 1)
end
local md = 2 * rm0 * math.max(0.05, msc) * (1 + 0.035 * S.pulse + S.mk)
local mpos = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, myy)
for i, h in ipairs(E.halos) do
h.Position = mpos
local hs = md * (1.2 + 0.4 * (i - 1)) * (1 + 0.08 * S.lv + 0.1 * S.mk)
h.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(hs, hs)
h.BackgroundColor3 = MOON:Lerp(col, 0.4)
h.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(1 - br * (0.1 + 0.08 * S.lv + 0.08 * S.pulse) / i, 0.55, 1)
end
E.moon.Position = mpos
E.moon.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(md, md)
E.moon.BackgroundColor3 = DIM:Lerp(MOON, S.br)
E.moonS.Color = col:Lerp(MOON, 0.5)
E.moonS.Thickness = 2 + 5 * S.ecl + 2 * S.pulse
E.moonS.Transparency = math.clamp(0.6 - 0.45 * S.ecl - 0.2 * S.pulse, 0.05, 1)
E.shade.Position = mpos
E.shade.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(md, md)
E.shade.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - 0.88 * S.ecl
E.sea.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, floorY)
E.sea.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE:Lerp(Color3.new(0.3, 0.3, 0.4), 0.6 * S.ecl)
E.hz.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, floorY)
E.hz.BackgroundColor3 = MOON:Lerp(col, 0.3)
E.hz.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.7 - 0.4 * br - 0.2 * S.pulse, 0.1, 1)
local scroll = (bt * 0.5) % 1
for i, l in ipairs(E.lines) do
local u = (i - 1 + scroll) / 9
local w = sy * (0.05 + 0.5 * u) * (0.75 + 0.25 * math.sin(t * 3 + i * 1.7))
l.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.sin(t * 2.2 + i * 2.1) * sx * 0.006 * (1 + 3 * u), 0.5, floorY + 3 + u * u * sy * 0.55)
l.Size = UDim2.new(0, w, 0, 1 + math.floor(u * 3))
l.BackgroundColor3 = MOON:Lerp(col, 0.3)
l.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.9 - 0.55 * br - 0.25 * S.lv - 0.2 * S.pulse * (1 - u) + 0.15 * u, 0.1, 1)
end
local sdt = dt * S.ts
for i, b in ipairs(E.orbs) do
local r = sy * b.rk
local bw, bh, vis = 2 * r, 2 * r, mode >= 2
local zi = 10
if mode == 2 then
b.vy = b.vy + sy * 1.5 * sdt
b.vx = b.vx * (1 - 0.3 * sdt)
b.x, b.y = b.x + b.vx * sdt, b.y + b.vy * sdt
if b.y > floorY - r then
b.y = floorY - r
b.vy = -math.max(math.abs(b.vy) * 0.72, sy * 0.28)
end
local hw = sx * 0.5 - r
if b.x > hw then b.x, b.vx = hw, -math.abs(b.vx) * 0.9 elseif b.x < -hw then b.x, b.vx = -hw, math.abs(b.vx) * 0.9 end
local st = math.clamp(math.abs(b.vy) / (sy * 5), 0, 0.18)
bw, bh = bw * (1 - st * 0.35), bh * (1 + st)
elseif mode >= 3 then
local R, rev = R3 * (1 + 0.12 * S.stormK), (t - M3) / K.BAR
if mode == 4 then
R, rev = R3 * (1 - u4 * u4), (t - M4) / (K.BAR * 0.5)
bw, bh = bw * (1 - 0.55 * u4 ^ 3), bh * (1 - 0.55 * u4 ^ 3)
end
local a = b.a + rev * 6.283
local kk = 1 - math.exp(-9 * dt)
local sa = math.sin(a)
b.x, b.y = lerp(b.x, math.cos(a) * R, kk), lerp(b.y, myy + sa * R * 0.55, kk)
b.vx, b.vy = 0, 0
bw, bh = bw * (1 + 0.22 * sa), bh * (1 + 0.22 * sa)
if sa < 0 then zi = 2 end
end
if zi ~= b.zi then
b.zi = zi
b.f.ZIndex = zi
end
b.f.Visible = vis
if vis then
b.f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, b.x, 0.5, b.y)
b.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(bw, bh)
b.f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.5 * S.ecl
b.gl.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.86 - 0.2 * S.lv - 0.2 * S.pulse, 0.5, 1)
end
end
for _, s in ipairs(E.shoot) do
if s.age < s.life then
s.age = s.age + dt
local k = clamp01(s.age / s.life)
s.x, s.y = s.x + s.vx * dt, s.y + s.vy * dt
s.f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, s.x, 0.5, s.y)
s.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(s.len * (0.4 + 0.6 * math.sin(k * 3.1416)), 2)
s.f.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(1 - math.sin(k * 3.1416) * 0.95, 0.05, 1)
if s.age >= s.life then s.f.Visible = false end
end
end
local td = t - M2
if td >= 0 then
local reveal = clamp01(td / (K.BEAT * 1.5))
if reveal < 1 then
local s = scr(NAME, reveal)
E.tM.Text, E.tR.Text, E.tC.Text = s, s, s
elseif not S.titleDone then
S.titleDone = true
E.tM.Text, E.tR.Text, E.tC.Text = NAME, NAME, NAME
end
local ty3, ts3 = -sy * 0.1, 1
if mode == 3 then
ty3, ts3 = -sy * 0.36, 0.4
elseif mode == 4 then
ty3, ts3 = -sy * 0.08, 1.15 + 0.2 * u4
end
ts3 = ts3 * (1 - 0.1 * S.ecl)
local tyy = follow("ty", ty3, 9, 0.7, dt)
local tss = follow("tsc", ts3, 9, 0.62, dt, 2.6)
E.tF.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, tyy)
E.tS.Scale = math.max(0.05, tss * (1 + 0.04 * S.pulse))
S.chroma = S.chroma * math.exp(-5 * dt)
local ch = S.chroma + (mode == 4 and 20 * u4 or 0)
E.tR.Position, E.tC.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, ch, 0.5, ch * 0.25), UDim2.new(0.5, -ch, 0.5, -ch * 0.25)
local ca = math.clamp(1 - ch / 16, 0.25, 1)
E.tR.TextTransparency, E.tC.TextTransparency, E.tM.TextTransparency = ca, ca, 0.55 * S.ecl
E.tM.TextColor3 = WHITE:Lerp(col, 0.18)
E.sub.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, tyy + sy * 0.12 * (mode == 3 and 0.5 or 1))
E.sub.TextColor3 = col
if inCut then
E.sub.Text = "-   E C L I P S E   -"
E.sub.TextTransparency = 0.2 + 0.2 * math.sin(t * 9)
else
E.sub.Text = SUB
E.sub.TextTransparency = (mode == 2 and (1 - clamp01((td - K.BEAT * 2) / K.BEAT))) or (mode == 4 and 0.2) or 1
end
end
for i, f in ipairs(E.cards) do
local w0, w1 = CARDWIN[i][1], CARDWIN[i][2]
local show = t >= w0 and t < w1
f.Visible = show
if show then
local cw = math.clamp(math.min(sx * 0.62, sy * 1.5), 220, 460)
local side = (i % 2 == 1) and -1 or 1
local uin, uout = clamp01((t - w0) / (K.BEAT * 0.9)), clamp01((t - (w1 - K.BEAT * 0.7)) / (K.BEAT * 0.7))
local ex = side * (sx * 0.5 + cw)
local x = lerp(lerp(ex, side * math.max(0, (sx - cw) * 0.3), easeOutBack(uin)), -ex, uout * uout)
f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cw, cw * 0.36)
f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, x, 0.5, (i - 2) * sy * 0.07 + math.sin(t * 2 + i) * sy * 0.004)
f.Rotation = (1 - uin) * side * 6 + S.rk * 0.5
end
end
local bhh = follow("bar", CFG.IntroScan and sy * (mode == 1 and 0.15 or ((mode == 4 or S.ecl > 0.5) and 0.12 or 0.075)) or 0, 8, 0.8, dt, 0)
E.barT.Size, E.barB.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.max(0, bhh)), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.max(0, bhh))
local hudOn = CFG.IntroHud ~= false
E.tc.Text = string.format("T+ %05.2f / %05.2f", math.min(t, K.DUR), K.DUR)
E.np.Text = "NOW PLAYING: " .. string.upper(SONG.Title or "")
E.ms.Text = modStatus()
E.tc.TextTransparency = hudOn and math.max(0.12, rv(t, 0)) or 1
E.np.TextTransparency = hudOn and math.max(0.12, rv(t, 1)) or 1
E.ms.TextTransparency = hudOn and math.max(0.12, rv(t, 2)) or 1
for _, l in ipairs({E.tc, E.np, E.ms}) do l.TextColor3 = col end
E.prog.Size = UDim2.new(clamp01(t / K.DUR), 0, 0, 3 + math.floor(S.pulse * 2))
E.prog.BackgroundColor3 = col
E.skipS.Color, E.skip.TextColor3 = col, col
E.skipS.Transparency = 0.2 + 0.2 * math.sin(t * 3)
if mode == 1 then
local L = {"> NIGHT SKY ONLINE", "> LUNAR SYNC  " .. string.format("%d", math.floor((SONG.Bpm or 128) + 0.5)) .. " BPM", "> STARS x" .. #E.dust .. "  LOADED", "> MOONRISE  IN PROGRESS", "> " .. modStatus(), "> FULL MOON  CONFIRMED"}
local out = {}
for i, ln in ipairs(L) do
if bt >= (i - 1) * 4 then out[#out + 1] = scr(ln, (bt - (i - 1) * 4) / 1.4) end
end
if bt >= 28 then out[#out + 1] = "> DROP IN " .. (32 - beatIdx) end
E.term.Text = table.concat(out, "\n")
E.term.TextSize = math.clamp(math.floor(sy * 0.035), 12, 20)
E.term.Position = UDim2.new(0, 46, 0, sy * 0.2)
E.term.TextColor3 = col
E.term.TextTransparency = 0.25
elseif E.term.Text ~= "" then
E.term.Text = ""
end
S.flashK = S.flashK * math.exp(-9 * dt)
local fa = clamp01((t - (S.tEnd - S.flashLen)) / S.flashLen)
local flashA = math.max(fa, math.min(0.85, S.flashK))
if mode == 4 then flashA = math.max(flashA, S.pulse * 0.12 * u4 * K.INT) end
local fadeIn = 1 - clamp01(t / (K.BEAT * 3))
if fadeIn > 0.01 and flashA < 0.05 then
E.flash.BackgroundColor3, E.flash.BackgroundTransparency = BLACK, 1 - fadeIn
else
E.flash.BackgroundColor3, E.flash.BackgroundTransparency = WHITE:Lerp(col, 0.35 * (1 - fa)), 1 - flashA
end
end
end
local ok, err = pcall(function()
build()
loop()
end)
if not ok then
warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro 2 error (continuing): " .. tostring(err))
end
for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
end
pcall(function() stage:Destroy() end)
FX.IntroCamBusy = false
if S.fallback then return "fallback" end
FX.IntroActive = false
pcall(function()
local fl = mk("Frame", MainFrame, {
Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(K.INT, 0, 1) * 0.9, BorderSizePixel = 0,
Interactable = false, ZIndex = 256,
})
tween(fl, 1, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
Debris:AddItem(fl, 1.1)
FX.Ring(MainFrame, accent(), 1000, 0.9, 6)
FX.Ring(MainFrame, WHITE, 700, 0.7, 3)
FX.IntroBlurOut(16)
end)
return true
end

function FX.Intro3(MainFrame, Music, _, opts)

K.BAR = K.BEAT * 4
K.DUR = K.OFF + 32 * K.BAR
local function B(n)
return K.OFF + n * K.BAR
end
local M2, M3, M4, TN = B(8), B(16), B(24), B(27)
local NS = 23
local NAME = (tostring(CFG.IntroTitle):gsub("[^\32-\126]", "")):sub(1, 20):upper()
if NAME == "" then NAME = "STEVETHEREALONE" end
local HERO = "JEALOUSY"
local CREATOR = "STEVETHEREALONE"
local SUB = (CFG.IntroSub ~= "" and tostring(CFG.IntroSub):gsub("[^\32-\126]", ""):sub(1, 80)) or string.format("MY JEALOUSY  //  %d BPM", math.floor((SONG.Bpm or 106.92) + 0.5))
local conns, E = {}, {}
local BLACK = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
local EMER, CRIM, LILAC = Color3.fromRGB(64, 255, 150), Color3.fromRGB(255, 52, 88), Color3.fromRGB(196, 150, 255)
local MODEC = {EMER, EMER, CRIM, LILAC}

}
local function clamp01(x)
return math.max(0, math.min(1, x))
end
local function lerp(a, b, k)
return a + (b - a) * k
end
local function smooth(u)
return u * u * (3 - 2 * u)
end
local function accent()
if CFG.IntroColorMode == 2 then
return Util.ParseHex(CFG.IntroColor) or WHITE
elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 3 then
return WHITE
elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 4 and Util.Color then
return Util.Color.Cur
end
return S.mc
end
local function mk(class, parent, props)
local o = Util.Instance(class, parent)
if props then
for k, v in pairs(props) do
o[k] = v
end
end
return o
end
local function txt(parent, z, font, ax, ay, pos, size, xa)
return mk("TextLabel", parent, {
AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = pos, Size = size, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = font,
TextColor3 = WHITE, TextXAlignment = xa or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, TextScaled = true, Text = "", TextTransparency = 1,
ZIndex = z, Interactable = false,
})
end
local function scr(s, frac)
local n = math.floor(#s * clamp01(frac))
if n >= #s then return s end
local out = s:sub(1, n)
for i = n + 1, #s do
if s:sub(i, i) == " " then
out = out .. " "
else
local k = math.random(1, #GLYPHS)
out = out .. GLYPHS:sub(k, k)
end
end
return out
end
local function itick(pitch, vol)
if not FX.Settings.ExtraSounds then return end
local base = opts.ClickSnd
if not base or base.Volume <= 0 then return end
pcall(function()
local s = base:Clone()
s.PlaybackSpeed = pitch * (0.96 + math.random() * 0.08)
s.Volume = base.Volume * vol
s.Parent = base.Parent
s:Play()
Debris:AddItem(s, 2.5)
end)
end
local function modStatus()
local f = Util.GetModuleStatus
if type(f) ~= "function" then return "BOOTING UI..." end
local ok, s = pcall(f)
return (ok and type(s) == "string") and s or ""
end
local function spend(n)
if S.tokens >= n then
S.tokens = S.tokens - n
return true
end
return false
end
local function follow(key, target, w, z, dt, init)
local st = S.sp[key]
if not st then
st = {init or target, 0}
S.sp[key] = st
end
local n = math.max(1, math.ceil(dt * 90))
local h = dt / n
for _ = 1, n do
st[2] = st[2] + (w * w * (target - st[1]) - 2 * z * w * st[2]) * h
st[1] = st[1] + st[2] * h
end
return st[1]
end
local function parse(s)
local a = {}
for t, k in tostring(s):gmatch("([%d%.]+):(%d)") do
a[#a + 1] = {tonumber(t), tonumber(k)}
end
return a
end
local function parseCut(s)
local a = {}
for t0, t1 in tostring(s):gmatch("([%d%.]+):([%d%.]+)") do
a[#a + 1] = {tonumber(t0), tonumber(t1)}
end
return a
end
local function blinkMul(tb, t)
local u = (t - tb) / 0.2
if u < 0 or u > 1 then return 1 end
return 1 - 0.92 * math.sin(u * 3.1416)
end
local BASS, HAT, ACC, VOC, CUTS = parse(D.bass), parse(D.hat), parse(D.acc), parse(D.voc), parseCut(D.cut)
local CARDWIN = {{B(17), B(18) + 0.8 * K.BAR}, {B(19), B(20) + 0.8 * K.BAR}, {B(21), B(22) + 0.8 * K.BAR}}
local stage = mk("Frame", MainFrame, {
Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = BLACK, BackgroundTransparency = 0, BorderSizePixel = 0,
ZIndex = 1000000, ClipsDescendants = true, Active = true,
})
conns[#conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if os.clock() - S.began < 0.4 then return end
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
local k = input.KeyCode
if k == Enum.KeyCode.Space or k == Enum.KeyCode.Return or k == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then
S.skipped = true
end
end
end)
local function build()
local C5 = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
local function box(parent, z, ax, ay, pos, size, color, tr)
return mk("Frame", parent, {
AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = pos, Size = size, BackgroundColor3 = color or WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = tr or 0,
BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false,
})
end
local function round(f)
Util.Instance("UICorner", f).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
return f
end

local function drawEye(EW, open, ix, iy, ir, prx, pry, irisCol, rimCol, sclCol, rimT)
local A = EW * 0.5
E.line.Visible = open < 0.09
if E.line.Visible then
E.line.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(EW * (0.45 + 0.5 * clamp01(open * 11)), 2)
E.line.BackgroundColor3 = rimCol
E.line.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15 + 0.4 * clamp01(open * 11)
end
if open < 0.025 then
for i = 1, NS do
E.rim[i].Visible, E.scl[i].Visible, E.iri[i].Visible, E.pup[i].Visible = false, false, false, false
end
E.hl.Visible, E.hl2.Visible = false, false
return
end
local Bh = math.max(1, EW * 0.21 * open)
local RR = (A * A / Bh + Bh) * 0.5
local dd = (A * A / Bh - Bh) * 0.5
local h = (2 * Bh) / NS
for i = 1, NS do
local y = (i - (NS + 1) / 2) * h
local ay = math.abs(y)
local w2 = RR * RR - (ay + dd) * (ay + dd)
local w = w2 > 0 and math.sqrt(w2) or 0
local rim, sc, iv, pu = E.rim[i], E.scl[i], E.iri[i], E.pup[i]
if w < 0.6 then
rim.Visible, sc.Visible, iv.Visible, pu.Visible = false, false, false, false
else
local k = ay / Bh
rim.Visible = true
rim.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, y)
rim.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2 * w + 8, h + 5)
rim.BackgroundColor3 = rimCol
rim.BackgroundTransparency = rimT
sc.Visible = true
sc.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, y)
sc.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2 * w, h + 1.5)
sc.BackgroundColor3 = sclCol:Lerp(BLACK, 0.55 * k * k)
local dy = y - iy
if math.abs(dy) < ir then
local ch = math.sqrt(ir * ir - dy * dy)
local lo, hi = math.max(ix - ch, -w), math.min(ix + ch, w)
if hi - lo > 0.8 then
iv.Visible = true
iv.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((lo + hi) * 0.5, y)
iv.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(hi - lo, h + 1.5)
local kk = math.abs(dy) / ir
iv.BackgroundColor3 = irisCol:Lerp(BLACK, 0.12 + 0.62 * kk * kk)
else
iv.Visible = false
end
else
iv.Visible = false
end
if math.abs(dy) < pry then
local pc = prx * math.sqrt(1 - (dy / pry) ^ 2)
local lo, hi = math.max(ix - pc, -w), math.min(ix + pc, w)
if hi - lo > 0.8 then
pu.Visible = true
pu.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((lo + hi) * 0.5, y)
pu.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(hi - lo, h + 1.5)
else
pu.Visible = false
end
else
pu.Visible = false
end
end
end
local hlOn = open > 0.55
E.hl.Visible, E.hl2.Visible = hlOn, hlOn
if hlOn then
E.hl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(ix - ir * 0.36, iy - ir * 0.4)
E.hl.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(ir * 0.3, ir * 0.3)
E.hl2.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(ix + ir * 0.3, iy + ir * 0.34)
E.hl2.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(ir * 0.14, ir * 0.14)
end
end
local function crack(n, amt)
for _ = 1, n do
local c = E.cracks[math.random(1, #E.cracks)]
c.tgt = math.min(S.sx * 0.5, c.tgt + S.sx * amt * (0.6 + math.random() * 0.8))
end
end
local function loop()
do
local w0, lim = os.clock(), opts.ReadyWait or 8
while opts.Ready and not opts.Ready() and os.clock() - w0 < lim and not S.skipped do
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then break end
local prog = SONG.Progress
E.term.Text = "> LOADING SOUNDTRACK" .. string.rep(".", math.floor(os.clock() * 3) % 4)
.. ((type(prog) == "number" and prog > 0 and prog < 1) and string.format("  %d%%", math.floor(prog * 100)) or "")
E.term.TextTransparency = 0.3
E.term.TextColor3 = accent()
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
end
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then
S.fallback = true
return
end
E.term.Text = ""
S.began = os.clock()
S.wall0 = S.began
end
local seed = math.random() * 50
local function onMode(m, t, col, w, h)
local I = K.INT
S.modeAt = t
local mp = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, S.eyeY)
if m == 2 then
for i, b in ipairs(E.orbs) do
b.x, b.y = 0, S.eyeY
end
S.sp.tsc = {2.6, 0}
S.mk = S.mk + 0.3
S.flashK, S.zk, S.chroma, S.shake = math.max(S.flashK, 0.85 * I), S.zk - 0.2 * I, 40, 13 * I
FX.Sparks(E.world, col, 24, 320, 0.9)
FX.Ring(E.world, WHITE, 900, 0.9, 6, mp)
FX.Ring(E.world, col, 600, 0.7, 4, mp)
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 14, 0.16, 0.81)
for _, c in ipairs(E.cracks) do c.tgt = w * 0.09 end
itick(0.5, 1)
elseif m == 3 then
S.sp.tsc = {1.9, 0}
S.mk = S.mk + 0.25
S.flashK, S.zk, S.chroma, S.shake = math.max(S.flashK, 0.8 * I), S.zk - 0.16 * I, 36, 12 * I
FX.Sparks(E.world, col, 22, 300, 0.9)
FX.Ring(E.world, WHITE, 950, 0.9, 6, mp)
FX.Ring(E.world, col, 650, 0.7, 4, mp)
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 14, 0.16, 0.81)
itick(0.5, 1)
elseif m == 4 then
S.flashK, S.zk, S.chroma, S.shake = math.max(S.flashK, 0.35 * I), S.zk + 0.04 * I, 20, 5 * I
FX.Ring(E.world, col, 800, 1.1, 4, mp)
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 8, 0.18, 1.08)
for _, c in ipairs(E.cracks) do c.tgt = 0 end
itick(0.7, 0.9)
end
end
local function bassHit(k, t, m, col, w, h)
local I = K.INT
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, (0.1 + 0.1 * k) * I)
S.mk = S.mk + 0.05 * k
S.pk, S.vk = 1, 1
S.zk = S.zk - 0.05 * k * I
S.rk = S.rk + S.dir * (1.1 + k) * I
S.dir = -S.dir
S.xk = S.xk + S.dir * w * 0.008 * k * I
S.shake = math.max(S.shake, (4 + 4 * k) * I)
S.chroma = S.chroma + 10 * k
if m == 3 then S.stormK = 1 end
itick(0.55, 0.8)
if spend(1) then FX.Ring(E.world, col, 460 + 140 * k, 0.75, 2 + k, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, S.eyeY)) end
if spend(1) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 3 + 3 * k, 0.16, 0.47) end
if k > 1 and (m == 2 or m == 3) then crack(1, 0.07) end
end
local function hatHit(m)
S.rainK = math.min(1, S.rainK + 0.45)
if m >= 2 and #E.rain > 0 then E.rain[math.random(1, #E.rain)].fl = 1 end
end
local function accHit(k, m, col)
local I = K.INT
S.pulse = math.max(S.pulse, 0.25 + 0.15 * k)
S.fl, S.gl = 1, 1
S.mk = S.mk + 0.015 * k
S.zk = S.zk - 0.01 * k * I
if m == 1 and spend(1) then FX.Ring(E.world, col, 260 + 90 * k, 0.8, 2, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, S.eyeY)) end
if m == 3 then
S.rk = S.rk + S.dir * 1.2 * k * I
S.dir = -S.dir
S.stormK = math.max(S.stormK, 0.35 * k)
end
end
local function vocHit(t, m)
local I = K.INT
S.blinkT, S.capT = t, t
local list = CAPS[m] or CAPS[1]
S.capN = (S.capN % #list) + 1
S.capTxt = list[S.capN]
S.gtx = (math.random() < 0.5 and -1 or 1) * (0.35 + 0.5 * math.random())
S.gty = (math.random() - 0.5) * 0.7
S.pulse = math.max(S.pulse, 0.6)
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.05 * I)
S.chroma = S.chroma + 6
if m == 4 then S.zk = S.zk - 0.02 * I end
itick(1.35, 0.5)
end
local function rv(t, n)
return 1 - clamp01((t - M2 - K.BEAT * n) / (K.BEAT * 0.6))
end
while true do
local dt = math.min(RunService.Heartbeat:Wait(), 0.1)
local t = os.clock() - S.began
do
local okP, pos, playing = pcall(function() return Music.TimePosition, Music.IsPlaying end)
if okP and playing and type(pos) == "number" and pos > 0.05 then
local d = pos - t
if math.abs(d) > 0.6 then
S.began = os.clock() - pos
else
S.began = S.began - d * 0.2
end
t = os.clock() - S.began
end
end
if S.skipped and S.tEnd == K.DUR then
S.tEnd = t + 0.35
S.flashLen = 0.35
end
if t >= S.tEnd or t > K.DUR + 8 or os.clock() - S.wall0 > K.DUR + 10 then break end
local sw = Util.GetScreenSize()
local sx, sy = sw.X, sw.Y
S.sx, S.sy = sx, sy
S.tokens = math.min(3, S.tokens + dt * 2.5)
local bt = math.max(0, (t - K.OFF) / K.BEAT)
local beatIdx = math.floor(bt)
local mode = t < M2 and 1 or (t < M3 and 2 or (t < M4 and 3 or 4))
local u1 = clamp01((t - K.OFF) / (M2 - K.OFF))
local u4 = clamp01((t - B(30)) / (K.DUR - B(30)))
local ck = 1 - math.exp(-3 * dt)
S.mc = S.mc:Lerp(MODEC[mode], ck)
S.ic = S.ic:Lerp(IRISC[mode], 1 - math.exp(-6 * dt))
S.bgT = S.bgT:Lerp(SKYT[mode], ck)
S.bgB = S.bgB:Lerp(SKYB[mode], ck)
local col = accent()
local inCut, bigCut = false, false
for _, c in ipairs(CUTS) do
if t >= c[1] and t < c[2] then
inCut = true
bigCut = (c[2] - c[1]) > 0.5
end
end
if inCut and not S.inCut then
S.chroma = S.chroma + (bigCut and 24 or 10)
S.zk = S.zk + (bigCut and 0.06 or 0.02) * K.INT
if bigCut then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 7, 0.22, 0.94) end
end
S.inCut, S.bigCut = inCut, bigCut
S.ecl = lerp(S.ecl, inCut and 1 or 0, 1 - math.exp(-(inCut and 26 or 12) * dt))
if mode ~= S.mode then
S.mode = mode
onMode(mode, t, col, sx, sy)
end
if beatIdx ~= S.bi then
S.bi = beatIdx
S.pulse = (beatIdx % 4 == 0) and 1 or 0.5
if mode == 1 then
itick((beatIdx % 4 == 0) and 1.4 or 1.1, 0.25)
if beatIdx >= 28 and beatIdx <= 31 then itick(0.9 + 0.12 * (beatIdx - 28), 0.8) end
end
end
S.pulse = S.pulse * math.exp(-5 * dt)
S.stormK = S.stormK * math.exp(-4 * dt)
S.mk = S.mk * math.exp(-7 * dt)
S.pk = S.pk * math.exp(-8 * dt)
S.vk = S.vk * math.exp(-5 * dt)
S.rainK = S.rainK * math.exp(-6 * dt)
S.fl = S.fl * math.exp(-9 * dt)
S.gl = S.gl * math.exp(-6 * dt)
while S.ei < #BASS and t >= BASS[S.ei + 1][1] do
S.ei = S.ei + 1
if t - BASS[S.ei][1] < 0.3 then bassHit(BASS[S.ei][2], t, mode, col, sx, sy) end
end
while S.hi < #HAT and t >= HAT[S.hi + 1][1] do
S.hi = S.hi + 1
if t - HAT[S.hi][1] < 0.3 then hatHit(mode) end
end
while S.ai < #ACC and t >= ACC[S.ai + 1][1] do
S.ai = S.ai + 1
if t - ACC[S.ai][1] < 0.3 then accHit(ACC[S.ai][2], mode, col) end
end
while S.vi < #VOC and t >= VOC[S.vi + 1][1] do
S.vi = S.vi + 1
if t - VOC[S.vi][1] < 0.3 then vocHit(t, mode) end
end
local li = math.floor(t * 20) + 1
S.lv = lerp(S.lv, (tonumber(D.level:sub(li, li)) or 0) / 9, 1 - math.exp(-12 * dt))
S.ts = lerp(S.ts, inCut and (bigCut and 0.3 or 0.6) or 1, 1 - math.exp(-6 * dt))
S.br = lerp(S.br, mode == 1 and (0.3 + 0.45 * u1) or 1, 1 - math.exp(-5 * dt))
local br = S.br * (1 - 0.8 * S.ecl)
local EWb = math.min(sx * 0.68, sy * 1.15)
local ewT, eyT, openT, prxT, pryT = 0.9, -sy * 0.08, 1, 0.34, 0.34
if mode == 1 then
local fb = clamp01((t - B(7)) / K.BAR)
ewT = 0.6 + 0.3 * u1
eyT = -sy * 0.03
openT = 0.03 + 0.6 * smooth(clamp01((t - 2.0) / 14.5)) + 0.37 * fb ^ 2 + 0.22 * S.fl
prxT = 0.36 - 0.22 * fb
pryT = prxT
elseif mode == 2 then
local q = clamp01((t - B(15)) / K.BAR)
ewT = 1
eyT = -sy * 0.1
openT = lerp(1, 0.32, smooth(q)) + 0.06 * S.pk
prxT = 0.34 + 0.5 * S.pk
pryT = prxT
elseif mode == 3 then
local q = clamp01((t - B(23)) / K.BAR)
ewT = 0.88
eyT = sy * 0.07
openT = lerp(1.06, 0.7, q) + 0.06 * S.pk
prxT = 0.1 + 0.2 * S.pk
pryT = 0.97
else
ewT = 0.92 + 5.5 * u4 ^ 3
eyT = -sy * 0.06 * (1 - u4)
openT = 0.86 + 0.14 * S.pk + 0.3 * u4
prxT = 0.36 + 0.4 * S.pk + 0.55 * u4
pryT = prxT
end
local blink = blinkMul(S.blinkT, t)
local ew = follow("ew", ewT, 9, 0.7, dt, 0.6) * EWb * (1 + 0.04 * S.pulse + S.mk)
local ey = follow("ey", eyT, 8, 0.8, dt, -sy * 0.03)
local open = follow("eo", openT, 16, 0.62, dt, 0) * blink * (1 - S.ecl)
open = math.clamp(open, 0, 1.4)
S.eyeY = ey

S.gtx = S.gtx * math.exp(-(mode == 1 and 0.9 or 3) * dt)
S.gty = S.gty * math.exp(-(mode == 1 and 0.9 or 3) * dt)

local gy = follow("gy", S.gty + math.sin(t * 0.31) * 0.2 * wander, 16, 0.55, dt, 0)

local pry = follow("pry", pryT, 14, 0.6, dt, 0.34) * irS

local hs = ew * (0.7 + 0.35 * (i - 1)) * (1 + 0.08 * S.lv + 0.12 * S.mk)

else

tr = tr + math.noise(t * 0.9, seed + 9) * 0.5 * hk

loop()
end)

local function clamp01(x)
return math.max(0, math.min(1, x))
end
local function lerp(a, b, k)
return a + (b - a) * k
end
local function smooth(u)
return u * u * (3 - 2 * u)
end
local function accent()
if CFG.IntroColorMode == 2 then
return Util.ParseHex(CFG.IntroColor) or WHITE
elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 3 then
return WHITE
elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 4 and Util.Color then
return Util.Color.Cur
end
return S.mc
end
local function mk(class, parent, props)
local o = Util.Instance(class, parent)
if props then
for k, v in pairs(props) do
o[k] = v
end
end
return o
end
local function txt(parent, z, font, ax, ay, pos, size, xa)
return mk("TextLabel", parent, {
AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = pos, Size = size, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = font,
TextColor3 = WHITE, TextXAlignment = xa or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, TextScaled = true, Text = "", TextTransparency = 1,
ZIndex = z, Interactable = false,
})
end
local function scr(s, frac)
local n = math.floor(#s * clamp01(frac))
if n >= #s then return s end
local out = s:sub(1, n)
for i = n + 1, #s do
if s:sub(i, i) == " " then
out = out .. " "
else
local k = math.random(1, #GLYPHS)
out = out .. GLYPHS:sub(k, k)
end
end
return out
end
local function itick(pitch, vol)
if not FX.Settings.ExtraSounds then return end
local base = opts.ClickSnd
if not base or base.Volume <= 0 then return end
pcall(function()
local s = base:Clone()
s.PlaybackSpeed = pitch * (0.96 + math.random() * 0.08)
s.Volume = base.Volume * vol
s.Parent = base.Parent
s:Play()
Debris:AddItem(s, 2.5)
end)
end
local function modStatus()
local f = Util.GetModuleStatus
if type(f) ~= "function" then return "BOOTING UI..." end
local ok, s = pcall(f)
return (ok and type(s) == "string") and s or ""
end
local function spend(n)
if S.tokens >= n then
S.tokens = S.tokens - n
return true
end
return false
end
local function follow(key, target, w, z, dt, init)
local st = S.sp[key]
if not st then
st = {init or target, 0}
S.sp[key] = st
end
local n = math.max(1, math.ceil(dt * 90))
local h = dt / n
for _ = 1, n do
st[2] = st[2] + (w * w * (target - st[1]) - 2 * z * w * st[2]) * h
st[1] = st[1] + st[2] * h
end
return st[1]
end
local function parse(s)
local a = {}
for t, k in tostring(s):gmatch("([%d%.]+):(%d)") do
a[#a + 1] = {tonumber(t), tonumber(k)}
end
return a
end
local function parseCut(s)
local a = {}
for t0, t1 in tostring(s):gmatch("([%d%.]+):([%d%.]+)") do
a[#a + 1] = {tonumber(t0), tonumber(t1)}
end
return a
end

local function round(f)
Util.Instance("UICorner", f).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)

end
local function heart(parent, z, rc, dc)
local function parts(c, zz, col)
local a = {}
a[1] = box(c, zz, 0.5, 0.5, UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.537), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), col, 0)
a[1].Rotation = 45
a[2] = round(box(c, zz, 0.5, 0.5, UDim2.fromScale(0.3232, 0.3602), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), col, 0))
a[3] = round(box(c, zz, 0.5, 0.5, UDim2.fromScale(0.6768, 0.3602), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), col, 0))
return a
end
local rimC = box(parent, z, 0.5, 0.5, C5, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), WHITE, 1)
local darkC = box(parent, z + 1, 0.5, 0.5, C5, UDim2.fromScale(0.86, 0.86), WHITE, 1)
return parts(rimC, z, rc), parts(darkC, z + 1, dc)
end
