local function crack(n, amt)
for _ = 1, n do
local c = E.cracks[math.random(1, #E.cracks)]
c.tgt = math.min(S.sx * 0.5, c.tgt + S.sx * amt * (0.6 + math.random() * 0.8))
end
end
local function paint(list, col, tr)
for _, f in ipairs(list) do
f.BackgroundColor3 = col
f.BackgroundTransparency = tr
end
end
local function loop()
do
local w0, lim = os.clock(), opts.ReadyWait or 8
while opts.Ready and not opts.Ready() and os.clock() - w0 < lim and not S.skipped do
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then break end
local prog = SONG.Progress
E.term.Text = "> LOADING SOUNDTRACK" .. string.rep(".", math.floor(os.clock() * 3) % 4)
.. ((type(prog) == "number" and prog > 0 and prog < 1) and string.format("  %d%%", math.floor(prog * 100)) or "")
E.term.TextTransparency = 0.3
E.term.TextColor3 = accent()
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
end
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then
S.fallback = true
return
end
E.term.Text = ""
S.began = os.clock()
S.wall0 = S.began
end
local seed = math.random() * 50
local function onMode(m, t, col, w)
local I = K.INT
local mp = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, S.eyeY)
if m == 2 then
S.winOn, S.winT = true, t
S.hk = 1.4
S.flashK, S.zk, S.chroma, S.shake = math.max(S.flashK, 0.9 * I), S.zk + 0.45 * I, 40, 14 * I
FX.Sparks(E.world, col, 24, 320, 0.9)
FX.Ring(E.world, WHITE, 900, 0.9, 6, mp)
FX.Ring(E.world, col, 600, 0.7, 4, mp)
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 14, 0.16, 0.81)
itick(0.5, 1)
elseif m == 3 then
S.winOn = false
S.blk, S.chroma, S.shake, S.zk = 1, 22, 7 * I, S.zk - 0.06 * I
for _, c in ipairs(E.cracks) do c.tgt = 0 end
FX.Ring(E.world, col, 700, 1.2, 3, mp)
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 10, 0.18, 1.22)
itick(0.4, 0.9)
elseif m == 4 then
S.winOn, S.winT = true, t
S.hk = 1.6
S.sp.tsc = {2.4, 0}
for _, b in ipairs(E.minis) do
b.x, b.y = 0, S.eyeY
end
S.flashK, S.zk, S.chroma, S.shake = math.max(S.flashK, 1.0 * I), S.zk + 0.55 * I, 44, 16 * I
FX.Sparks(E.world, col, 30, 340, 1)
FX.Ring(E.world, WHITE, 1000, 0.9, 7, mp)
FX.Ring(E.world, col, 700, 0.75, 4, mp)
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 16, 0.16, 0.94)
itick(0.5, 1)
end
end
local function milestone(i, col, w)
local I = K.INT
local mp = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, S.eyeY)
if i == 1 then
S.flashK, S.xk, S.zk, S.chroma, S.starK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.5 * I), S.xk + w * 0.09 * I, S.zk + 0.25 * I, 30, 1
FX.Ring(E.world, WHITE, 800, 0.8, 5, mp)
FX.Ring(E.world, col, 560, 0.7, 3, mp)
itick(0.7, 1)
elseif i == 2 then
S.zk, S.chroma, S.starK = S.zk - 0.1 * I, 20, 1
FX.Ring(E.world, col, 900, 1.2, 4, mp)
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 8, 0.18, 1.08)
itick(0.8, 0.9)
elseif i == 3 then
S.flashK, S.xk, S.zk, S.chroma = math.max(S.flashK, 0.5 * I), S.xk - w * 0.09 * I, S.zk + 0.3 * I, 30
FX.Ring(E.world, WHITE, 800, 0.8, 5, mp)
FX.Ring(E.world, col, 560, 0.7, 3, mp)
itick(0.7, 1)
else
S.flashK, S.zk, S.chroma, S.shake = math.max(S.flashK, 0.55 * I), S.zk - 0.15 * I, 40, 10 * I
FX.Sparks(E.world, col, 22, 300, 0.9)
FX.Ring(E.world, WHITE, 1000, 1, 6, mp)
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 12, 0.18, 1.08)
itick(0.6, 1)
end
end
local function bassHit(k, t, m, col, w)
local I = K.INT
if m == 1 then S.hk = math.max(S.hk, 0.5) return end
local dmp = (m == 3 and t < MR) and 0.4 or 1
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, (0.08 + 0.1 * k) * I * dmp)
S.hk = math.max(S.hk, dmp)
S.zk = S.zk + 0.04 * k * I * dmp
S.rk = S.rk + S.dir * (1 + k) * I * dmp
S.dir = -S.dir
S.xk = S.xk + S.dir * w * 0.007 * k * I * dmp
S.shake = math.max(S.shake, (3 + 4 * k) * I * dmp)
S.chroma = S.chroma + 9 * k * dmp
itick(0.55, 0.8 * dmp)
if spend(1) then FX.Ring(E.world, col, 420 + 140 * k, 0.75, 2 + k, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, S.eyeY)) end
if spend(1) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 3 + 3 * k, 0.16, 0.47) end
if k > 1 and m ~= 3 then crack(1, 0.07) end
end
local function snareHit(k, m, col)
if m == 1 then return end
S.sk = 1
S.zk = S.zk - 0.025 * K.INT
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.1 * K.INT)
S.rainK = math.min(1, S.rainK + 0.6)
if k > 1 and spend(1) then FX.Sparks(E.world, col, 8, 220, 0.5) end
end
local function hatHit()
S.rainK = math.min(1, S.rainK + 0.4)
S.starK = math.min(1, S.starK + 0.15)
E.rain[math.random(1, #E.rain)].fl = 1
for _ = 1, 2 do
E.win[math.random(1, #E.win)].fl = 1
end
end
local function vocHit(t, m)
local I = K.INT
S.capT = t
local list = CAPS[m] or CAPS[1]
S.capN = (S.capN % #list) + 1
S.capTxt = list[S.capN]
S.pulse = math.max(S.pulse, 0.6)
S.hk = math.max(S.hk, 0.45)
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.05 * I)
S.chroma = S.chroma + 7
S.xk = S.xk + (math.random() < 0.5 and -1 or 1) * S.sx * 0.012 * I
itick(1.35, 0.5)
end
local function rv(t, n)
return 1 - clamp01((t - K.OFF - K.BEAT * n) / (K.BEAT * 0.6))
end
while true do
local dt = math.min(RunService.Heartbeat:Wait(), 0.1)
local t = os.clock() - S.began
do
local okP, pos, playing = pcall(function() return Music.TimePosition, Music.IsPlaying end)
if okP and playing and type(pos) == "number" and pos > 0.05 then
local d = pos - t
if math.abs(d) > 0.6 then
S.began = os.clock() - pos
else
S.began = S.began - d * 0.2
end
t = os.clock() - S.began
end
end
if S.skipped and S.tEnd == K.DUR then
S.tEnd = t + 0.35
S.flashLen = 0.35
end
if t >= S.tEnd or t > K.DUR + 8 or os.clock() - S.wall0 > K.DUR + 10 then break end
local sw = Util.GetScreenSize()
local sx, sy = sw.X, sw.Y
S.sx, S.sy = sx, sy
S.tokens = math.min(3, S.tokens + dt * 2.5)
local bt = math.max(0, (t - K.OFF) / K.BEAT)
local beatIdx = math.floor(bt)
local mode = t < M2 and 1 or (t < MB and 2 or (t < M3 and 3 or 4))
local u1 = clamp01((t - K.OFF) / (M2 - K.OFF))
local fb = clamp01((t - B(3)) / K.BAR)
local u3 = clamp01((t - MB) / (MR - MB))
local ur = clamp01((t - MR) / (M3 - MR))
local u4 = clamp01((t - MF) / (K.DUR - MF))
local ck = 1 - math.exp(-3 * dt)
S.mc = S.mc:Lerp(MODEC[mode], ck)
S.bgT = S.bgT:Lerp(SKYT[mode], ck)
S.bgB = S.bgB:Lerp(SKYB[mode], ck)
local col = accent()
local inCut = false
for _, c in ipairs(CUTS) do
if t >= c[1] and t < c[2] then inCut = true end
end
if inCut and not S.inCut then
S.chroma = S.chroma + 14
S.zk = S.zk + 0.03 * K.INT
if spend(1) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 6, 0.21, 0.54) end
end
S.inCut = inCut
S.cutK = lerp(S.cutK, inCut and 1 or 0, 1 - math.exp(-(inCut and 26 or 12) * dt))
if mode ~= S.mode then
S.mode = mode
onMode(mode, t, col, sx)
end
if beatIdx ~= S.bi then
S.bi = beatIdx
S.pulse = (beatIdx % 4 == 0) and 1 or 0.5
if mode == 1 then
itick((beatIdx % 4 == 0) and 1.4 or 1.1, 0.25)
if beatIdx >= 12 and beatIdx <= 15 then itick(0.9 + 0.12 * (beatIdx - 12), 0.8) end
if beatIdx % 2 == 0 then
S.hk = math.max(S.hk, 0.5 + 0.03 * beatIdx)
S.dubAt = t + K.BEAT * 0.38
end
elseif mode == 3 and t >= B(27) then
S.capT, S.capTxt = t, tostring(112 - beatIdx)
itick(0.9 + 0.12 * (beatIdx - 108), 0.8)
end
end
if S.dubAt > 0 and t >= S.dubAt then
S.dubAt = -1
S.hk = math.max(S.hk, 0.4)
end
local ex = math.exp
S.pulse = S.pulse * ex(-5 * dt)
S.hk = S.hk * ex(-7 * dt)
S.sk = S.sk * ex(-9 * dt)
S.rainK = S.rainK * ex(-6 * dt)
while S.mi < #MIL and t >= MIL[S.mi + 1] do
S.mi = S.mi + 1
if t - MIL[S.mi] < 0.3 then milestone(S.mi, col, sx) end
end
while S.ei < #BASS and t >= BASS[S.ei + 1][1] do
S.ei = S.ei + 1
if t - BASS[S.ei][1] < 0.3 then bassHit(BASS[S.ei][2], t, mode, col, sx) end
end
while S.si < #SNARE and t >= SNARE[S.si + 1][1] do
S.si = S.si + 1
if t - SNARE[S.si][1] < 0.3 then snareHit(SNARE[S.si][2], mode, col) end
end
while S.hi < #HAT and t >= HAT[S.hi + 1][1] do
S.hi = S.hi + 1
if t - HAT[S.hi][1] < 0.3 then hatHit() end
end
while S.vi < #VOC and t >= VOC[S.vi + 1][1] do
S.vi = S.vi + 1
if t - VOC[S.vi][1] < 0.3 then vocHit(t, mode) end
end
local li = math.floor(t * 20) + 1
S.lv = lerp(S.lv, (tonumber(D.level:sub(li, li)) or 0) / 9, 1 - ex(-12 * dt))
S.ts = lerp(S.ts, ((mode == 3 and t < MR) and 0.45) or (inCut and 0.4 or 1), 1 - ex(-6 * dt))
local HS = math.min(sx * 0.46, sy * 0.76)
local szT, eyT, gapT, hv = 0.8, sy * 0.05, 0, 1
if mode == 1 then
hv = smooth(clamp01((t - 1.9) / 4.5))
szT = 0.34 + 0.42 * u1 * u1 - 0.1 * clamp01((t - (M2 - K.BEAT * 0.7)) / (K.BEAT * 0.7))
eyT = -sy * 0.02
elseif mode == 3 then
szT = 0.72 - 0.06 * u3 + 0.16 * ur * ur
eyT = -sy * 0.03 - sy * 0.02 * u3
gapT = 0.55 * ((t < MR) and smooth(u3) or (1 - smooth(ur) ^ 2))
elseif mode == 4 then
szT, eyT = 0.86, sy * 0.08
end
eyT = eyT * (1 - u4)
local ey = follow("ey", eyT, 8, 0.8, dt, -sy * 0.02)
S.eyeY = ey
local hsz = follow("hs", szT, 14, 0.5, dt, 0.3) * HS * (1 + 0.22 * S.hk + 0.05 * S.pulse) * (1 + 9 * u4 ^ 3)
local gap = follow("gap", gapT, 9, 0.7, dt, 0) * HS
local gapK = gap / (0.55 * HS)
local rimC = col:Lerp(WHITE, math.min(0.85, 0.45 * S.hk + 0.7 * u4 * u4))
if mode == 3 then rimC = rimC:Lerp(BLACK, 0.3 * (1 - ur)) end
local darkC = S.bgB:Lerp(BLACK, 0.55):Lerp(col, 0.05 + 0.08 * S.hk)
local hvT = 1 - hv * (1 - 0.85 * S.cutK)
E.hc.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, ey)
for s = 1, 2 do
local H = E.hh[s]
local cw, ch = hsz * 1.25, hsz * 2.6
H.cf.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cw, ch)
H.cf.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((s == 1 and -1 or 1) * gap * 0.5, (s == 1 and 1 or -0.6) * gapK * sy * 0.035)
H.ct.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(s == 1 and cw or 0, ch * 0.5)
H.ct.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(hsz, hsz)
H.ct.Rotation = (s == 1 and -14 or 11) * gapK + math.sin(t * 1.7 + s) * 1.5 * gapK
for i, g in ipairs(H.glow) do
g.BackgroundColor3 = col
g.BackgroundTransparency = math.min(1, math.clamp(0.95 - 0.02 * i - 0.14 * S.lv - 0.2 * S.hk, 0.5, 1) + hvT)
end
paint(H.rim, rimC, hvT)
paint(H.dark, darkC, hvT)
end
E.seam.Visible = gap > 3
if E.seam.Visible then
E.seam.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, ey)
E.seam.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3 + 3 * S.pulse, hsz * 0.92)
E.seam.BackgroundColor3 = col:Lerp(WHITE, 0.4)
E.seam.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.25 + 0.4 * math.noise(t * 25, seed), 0.1, 0.9)
end
if t - S.histT > 0.035 then
S.histT = t
table.insert(S.hist, 1, clamp01(S.lv * (0.35 + 0.65 * math.random()) + 0.55 * S.hk))
S.hist[25] = nil
end
local vizOn = (mode == 1 and 0.5 * clamp01((t - 2) / 5)) or ((mode == 3 and t < MR) and 0.45 or 1)
local bw = sx * 0.9 / 48
for i, f in ipairs(E.viz) do
local idx = (i <= 24) and (25 - i) or (i - 24)
local v = S.hist[idx] or 0
f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, ((i <= 24) and -1 or 1) * ((idx - 0.5) * bw), 0.5, ey)
f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(bw * 0.55, 3 + v * sy * 0.2 * vizOn)
f.BackgroundColor3 = col
f.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.3 + 0.5 * idx / 24 + (1 - vizOn) * 0.4, 0.2, 1)
end
local tz, tx, ty, tr = 1, 0, 0, 0
if mode == 1 then
tz = 0.8 + 0.2 * smooth(u1) + 0.12 * fb ^ 2
tr = math.sin(t * 0.5) * 1.2 * (1 - u1) + 5 * fb ^ 3
tx = math.sin(t * 0.4) * sx * 0.012
ty = sy * 0.02 * (1 - u1)
elseif mode == 2 then
local ph = (t - M2) / (MB - M2)
tz = 1 + 0.07 * ph + 0.04 * math.sin(ph * 12.566)
tx = math.sin(ph * 6.283) * sx * 0.035
tr = ((math.floor((t - K.OFF) / K.BAR) % 2 == 0) and 1 or -1) * 1.3 * K.INT * (0.6 + 0.4 * ph) - 3 * ph ^ 3
ty = math.sin(t * 0.9) * sy * 0.01
elseif mode == 3 then
if t < MR then
tz = 0.96 + 0.05 * u3
ty = -sy * 0.03 * u3
tr = math.sin(u3 * 3.1416) * 2
else
tz = 1 + 0.2 * ur * ur
tr = -7 * ur ^ 3
tx = math.sin(ur * 18) * sx * 0.006 * ur
end
else
local ph = (t - M3) / (MF - M3)
tz = 1.03 + 0.04 * math.sin(math.min(ph, 1) * 12.566) + 0.1 * u4 * u4
tx = math.sin(math.min(ph, 1) * 12.566) * sx * 0.04 * (1 - u4)
tr = math.sin(math.min(ph, 1) * 9.4) * 2.6 * K.INT * (1 - u4) + 16 * u4 ^ 3
end
local hk2 = K.INT * (mode == 4 and 0.7 or 1)
tx = tx + math.noise(t * 1.3, seed) * sx * 0.006 * hk2
ty = ty + math.noise(t * 1.1, seed + 5) * sy * 0.006 * hk2
tr = tr + math.noise(t * 0.9, seed + 9) * 0.5 * hk2
local kd = ex(-6 * dt)
S.zk, S.rk, S.xk = S.zk * kd, S.rk * kd, S.xk * kd
S.shake = S.shake * ex(-9 * dt)
local cx = follow("cx", tx + S.xk, 12, 0.6, dt)
local cy = follow("cy", ty, 12, 0.6, dt)
local cz = follow("cz", tz + S.zk, 10, 0.62, dt)
local cr = follow("cr", tr + S.rk, 11, 0.45, dt)
E.world.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, cx + math.noise(t * 38, seed + 1) * S.shake, 0.5, cy + math.noise(t * 38, seed + 3) * S.shake)
E.world.Rotation = cr
E.zoom.Scale = math.clamp(cz, 0.6, 2.3)
if E.up then E.up(t, dt, S) end
E.bgG.Color = ColorSequence.new(
S.bgT:Lerp(BLACK, 0.3 * S.blk),
S.bgB:Lerp(col, 0.05 + 0.1 * S.pulse):Lerp(BLACK, 0.8 * S.blk)
)
E.glow.BackgroundColor3 = col
E.glow.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.95 - 0.1 * S.pulse * (mode > 1 and 1 or 0.4) - 0.18 * S.lv, 0.4, 1)
S.starK = S.starK * ex(-4 * dt)
local starOn = ((mode == 1) and clamp01((t - 0.4) / 5) or 1) * ((mode == 3 and 1.3) or (mode == 1 and 0.8) or 0.55)
local starCol = WHITE:Lerp(col, 0.3)
for _, s in ipairs(E.stars) do
local tw = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(t * s.sp + s.ph)
s.f.Position = UDim2.new(s.x, -cx * s.z * 0.25, s.y, -cy * s.z * 0.15)
s.f.BackgroundColor3 = starCol
s.f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - clamp01(starOn * s.a * (0.2 + 0.8 * tw) + 0.5 * S.starK * tw)
end
local cityT = (mode == 1 and 1.5) or ((mode == 3) and (1.12 - 0.12 * ur) or 1)
local cyS = follow("city", cityT, 7, 0.75, dt, 1.5)
E.ground.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, cyS)
for _, b in ipairs(E.bld) do
b.f.Position = UDim2.new(b.x, -cx * b.z * 0.12, cyS - 0.008 * S.hk * (0.5 + b.z), 0)
b.rim.BackgroundColor3 = col
b.rim.BackgroundTransparency = 0.25 + 0.4 * (1 - S.lv)
end
for _, wd in ipairs(E.win) do
wd.fl = wd.fl * ex(-5 * dt)
local want = 1
if S.winOn and (t - S.winT) >= wd.d then
want = math.clamp(0.5 - 0.5 * wd.fl - 0.12 * S.lv + (wd.hot and 0 or 0.15) + 0.8 * S.cutK, 0.05, 1)
end
if math.abs(want - wd.tr) > 0.02 then
wd.tr = want
wd.f.BackgroundTransparency = want
wd.f.BackgroundColor3 = wd.hot and ICE or col
end
end
local rainOn = clamp01((t - 0.8) / 3)
for _, r in ipairs(E.rain) do
r.y = (r.y + dt * S.ts * (0.5 + 1.6 * S.lv) * r.z * 0.9) % 1
r.fl = r.fl * ex(-6 * dt)
r.f.Position = UDim2.new(r.x * 1.4 - 0.2, -cx * r.z * 0.2, r.y * 1.4 - 0.2, 0)
r.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(r.th, r.len * (0.6 + S.lv))
r.f.BackgroundColor3 = col:Lerp(WHITE, 0.4)
r.f.BackgroundTransparency = math.min(1, math.clamp(0.9 - 0.3 * S.lv - 0.25 * S.rainK - 0.55 * r.fl, 0.2, 1) + (1 - rainOn))
end
local ec0 = hsz * 0.18
for _, c in ipairs(E.cracks) do
c.len = lerp(c.len, c.tgt, 1 - ex(-14 * dt))
if mode == 4 then c.tgt = c.tgt * ex(-1.5 * dt) end
local show = c.len > 3 and (mode == 2 or mode == 4)
c.f.Visible = show
if show then
local d = ec0 + c.len * 0.5
c.f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.cos(c.a) * d, 0.5, ey + math.sin(c.a) * d)
c.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(c.len, c.w)
c.f.Rotation = math.deg(c.a)
c.f.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE:Lerp(col, 0.25)
c.f.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.2 + 0.35 * (1 - S.pulse), 0.1, 0.9)
end
end
for _, m in ipairs(E.minis) do
local vis = (mode == 4)
m.f.Visible = vis
if vis then
local a = m.a + ((t - M3) / (K.BAR * 2.2) + 0.2) * 6.283
local R = math.min(sy * 0.4, sx * 0.44) * (1 + 0.1 * S.hk) * (1 - 0.8 * u4 * u4)
local kk = 1 - ex(-7 * dt)
local sa = math.sin(a)
m.x, m.y = lerp(m.x, math.cos(a) * R, kk), lerp(m.y, ey + sa * R * 0.55, kk)
local sz = sy * m.rk * 2 * (1 + 0.22 * sa) * (1 + 0.3 * S.hk) * (1 - 0.7 * u4 ^ 3)
m.f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, m.x, 0.5, m.y)
m.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sz, sz)
m.f.Rotation = math.sin(t * 2 + m.ph) * 12
m.f.ZIndex = (sa < 0) and 8 or 14
m.gl.BackgroundColor3 = col
m.gl.BackgroundTransparency = math.clamp(0.88 - 0.2 * S.lv - 0.2 * S.pulse, 0.5, 1)
paint(m.rim, col, 0)
paint(m.dark, darkC, 0)
end
end
do
local ty3, ts3 = -sy * 0.34, 0.6
if mode == 3 then
ty3, ts3 = -sy * 0.33, 0.5
elseif mode == 4 then
ty3, ts3 = -sy * 0.31, (0.9 + 0.1 * math.min(1, (t - M3) / K.BAR)) * (1 - 0.5 * u4)
end
local tyy = follow("ty", ty3, 9, 0.7, dt, -sy * 0.34)
local tss = follow("tsc", ts3, 9, 0.62, dt, 0.4)
local want = ""
if mode == 2 and t >= MIL[1] then
local n = math.clamp(math.floor((t - MIL[1]) / K.BEAT) + 1, 1, #HERO)
want = HERO:sub(1, n) .. (HERO:sub(n + 1):gsub("%S", "-"))
elseif mode == 3 then
want = HERO
elseif mode == 4 then
want = scr(HERO, (t - M3) / (K.BEAT * 1.2))
end
if want == "" or want == HERO or mode == 2 then
if S.hero ~= want then
S.hero = want
E.tM.Text, E.tR.Text, E.tC.Text = want, want, want
end
else
S.hero = ""
E.tM.Text, E.tR.Text, E.tC.Text = want, want, want
end
E.tF.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, tyy)
E.tS.Scale = math.max(0.05, tss * (1 + 0.04 * S.pulse))
S.chroma = S.chroma * ex(-5 * dt)

E.tR.Position, E.tC.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, ch, 0.5, ch * 0.25), UDim2.new(0.5, -ch, 0.5, -ch * 0.25)
if want == "" then
E.tR.TextTransparency, E.tC.TextTransparency, E.tM.TextTransparency = 1, 1, 1
elseif mode == 3 then
E.tR.TextTransparency, E.tC.TextTransparency = 1, 1
E.tM.TextTransparency = inCut and 1 or math.clamp(0.74 + 0.18 * math.sin(t * 3), 0.5, 1)
else
local ca = math.clamp(1 - ch / 16, 0.25, 1)
E.tR.TextTransparency, E.tC.TextTransparency = ca, ca
E.tM.TextTransparency = math.clamp(0.14 - 0.1 * S.pulse + (mode == 4 and 0.8 * u4 * u4 or 0), 0, 1)

if mode == 4 and t >= MIL[3] then
E.sub.Text = scr(NAME, (t - MIL[3]) / (K.BEAT * 1.5))
E.sub.TextTransparency = math.clamp(0.25 + u4, 0, 1)

for i, f in ipairs(E.cards) do

if mode == 1 then

E.term.Position = UDim2.new(0, 46, 0, sy * 0.2)
E.term.TextColor3 = col
E.term.TextTransparency = 0.25
elseif E.term.Text ~= "" then
E.term.Text = ""
end
S.flashK = S.flashK * ex(-9 * dt)
S.blk = S.blk * ex(-4 * dt)
local fa = clamp01((t - (S.tEnd - S.flashLen)) / S.flashLen)
local flashA = math.max(fa, math.min(0.85, S.flashK))
if mode == 3 and t >= B(26) then
flashA = math.max(flashA, 0.18 * S.pulse * clamp01((t - B(26)) / (2 * K.BAR)) * K.INT)
end
local blackA = math.max(1 - clamp01(t / (K.BEAT * 3)), S.blk)
if flashA >= 0.05 then
E.flash.BackgroundColor3, E.flash.BackgroundTransparency = WHITE:Lerp(col, 0.35 * (1 - fa)), 1 - flashA
else
E.flash.BackgroundColor3, E.flash.BackgroundTransparency = BLACK, 1 - blackA
end
end
end
local ok, err = pcall(function()
build()
loop()
end)
if not ok then
warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro 4 error (continuing): " .. tostring(err))
end
for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
end
pcall(function() stage:Destroy() end)
FX.IntroCamBusy = false
if S.fallback then return "fallback" end
FX.IntroActive = false
pcall(function()
local fl = mk("Frame", MainFrame, {
Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(K.INT, 0, 1) * 0.9, BorderSizePixel = 0,
Interactable = false, ZIndex = 256,
})
tween(fl, 1, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
Debris:AddItem(fl, 1.1)
FX.Ring(MainFrame, accent(), 1000, 0.9, 6)
FX.Ring(MainFrame, WHITE, 700, 0.7, 3)
FX.IntroBlurOut(16)
end)
return true
end

local function clamp01(x)
return math.max(0, math.min(1, x))
end
local function lerp(a, b, k)
return a + (b - a) * k
end
local function smooth(u)
return u * u * (3 - 2 * u)
end
local function eo3(x)
return 1 - (1 - x) ^ 3
end
local function eio(x)
if x < 0.5 then return 4 * x * x * x end
return 1 - ((-2 * x + 2) ^ 3) / 2
end
local function eob(x)
local c1 = 1.70158
local c3 = c1 + 1
return 1 + c3 * (x - 1) ^ 3 + c1 * (x - 1) ^ 2
end
local function accent()
if CFG.IntroColorMode == 2 then
return Util.ParseHex(CFG.IntroColor) or WHITE
elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 3 then
return WHITE
elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 4 and Util.Color then
return Util.Color.Cur
end
return S.mc
end
local function mk(class, parent, props)
local o = Util.Instance(class, parent)
if props then
for k, v in pairs(props) do
o[k] = v
end
end
return o
end
local function txt(parent, z, font, ax, ay, pos, size, xa)
return mk("TextLabel", parent, {
AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = pos, Size = size, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = font,
TextColor3 = WHITE, TextXAlignment = xa or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, TextScaled = false, TextSize = 24, Text = "", TextTransparency = 1,
ZIndex = z, Interactable = false,
})
end
local function scr(s, frac)
local n = math.floor(#s * clamp01(frac))
if n >= #s then return s end
local out = s:sub(1, n)
for i = n + 1, #s do
if s:sub(i, i) == " " then
out = out .. " "
else
local k = math.random(1, #GLYPHS)
out = out .. GLYPHS:sub(k, k)
end
end
return out
end
local function itick(pitch, vol)
if not FX.Settings.ExtraSounds then return end
local base = opts.ClickSnd
if not base or base.Volume <= 0 then return end
pcall(function()
local s = base:Clone()
s.PlaybackSpeed = pitch * (0.96 + math.random() * 0.08)
s.Volume = base.Volume * vol
s.Parent = base.Parent
s:Play()
Debris:AddItem(s, 2.5)
end)
end
local function modStatus()
local f = Util.GetModuleStatus
if type(f) ~= "function" then return "BOOTING UI..." end
local ok, s = pcall(f)
return (ok and type(s) == "string") and s or ""
end
local function spend(n)
if S.tokens >= n then
S.tokens = S.tokens - n
return true
end
return false
end
local function follow(key, target, w, z, dt, init)
local st = S.sp[key]
if not st then
st = {init or target, 0}
S.sp[key] = st
end
local n = math.max(1, math.ceil(dt * 90))
local h = dt / n
for _ = 1, n do
st[2] = st[2] + (w * w * (target - st[1]) - 2 * z * w * st[2]) * h
st[1] = st[1] + st[2] * h
end
return st[1]
end
local function kick(key, v)
local st = S.sp[key]
if st then st[2] = st[2] + v end
end
local function parse(s)
local a = {}
for t, k in tostring(s):gmatch("([%d%.]+):(%d)") do
a[#a + 1] = {tonumber(t), tonumber(k)}
end
return a
end
local BASS, NOTE, SHIM = parse(D.bass), parse(D.note), parse(D.shim)
local LEVEL = tostring(D.level)
local function lvAt(t)
local x = t * 20
local i = math.floor(x)
local a = tonumber(LEVEL:sub(i + 1, i + 1))
if not a then return 0 end
local b = tonumber(LEVEL:sub(i + 2, i + 2)) or a
return clamp01((a + (b - a) * (x - i)) / 7)
end

S.skipped = true
end
end
end)
local function build()
local C5 = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
local function box(parent, z, ax, ay, pos, size, color, tr)
return mk("Frame", parent, {
AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = pos, Size = size, BackgroundColor3 = color or WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = tr or 0,
BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false,
})
end
local function round(f)
Util.Instance("UICorner", f).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
return f
end
local function stroke(f, th, col, tr)
return mk("UIStroke", f, {Thickness = th, Color = col or WHITE, Transparency = tr or 0.5})
end
local function seq(a, b, c)
return NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, a), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, b), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, c)})
end
local function grad(f, rot, c0, c1, ts)
local g = Util.Instance("UIGradient", f)
g.Rotation = rot
if c0 then g.Color = ColorSequence.new(c0, c1 or c0) end
if ts then g.Transparency = ts end
return g
end
local function makeRing(parent, z, n, ratio, thick)
local c = box(parent, z, 0.5, 0.5, C5, UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10 * ratio), WHITE, 1)
c.Visible = false
local R, segs = 0.46, {}
for i = 1, n do
local th = (i - 0.5) / n * math.pi * 2
local cs, sn = math.cos(th), math.sin(th)
local tx, ty = -sn, ratio * cs
local len = math.sqrt(tx * tx + ty * ty) * (math.pi * 2 / n) * R * 1.3
local f = box(c, z, 0.5, 0.5, UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + R * cs, 0.5 + R * sn), UDim2.new(len, 0, 0, thick), WHITE, 0)
f.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(ty, tx))
segs[i] = f
end
return {c = c, segs = segs, ratio = ratio, on = false, trl = -1}
end

local function ringSlot(list)
local best = list[1]
for _, r in ipairs(list) do
if not r.on then return r end
if r.t0 < best.t0 then best = r end
end
return best
end
local function ringGo(r, x, y, rad0, rad1, life, col, rev, tilt0, tilt1, follow, rel)
r.on, r.t0, r.life, r.x, r.y, r.rad0, r.rad1, r.rev, r.tilt0, r.tilt1, r.follow, r.rel = true, S.t, life, x, y, rad0, rad1, rev, tilt0 or 0, tilt1 or 0, follow, rel
r.c.Visible = true
r.trl = -1
for _, f in ipairs(r.segs) do
f.BackgroundColor3 = col
end
end
local function flat(x, y, w, life, col, rel)
ringGo(ringSlot(E.flat), x, y, w * 0.08, w, life, col, false, 0, 0, false, rel)
end
local function orbit(rad0, rad1, life, col, rev, tilt0, tilt1)
if not rev then
if S.t - S.lastRing < 0.3 then return end
S.lastRing = S.t
end
ringGo(ringSlot(E.orbR), 0, 0, rad0, rad1, life, col, rev, tilt0, tilt1, true, false)
end
local function bubble(x, y, r, vy)
for _, b in ipairs(E.bub) do
if not b.on then
b.on, b.x, b.y, b.r, b.vy, b.ph, b.wob = true, x, y, r, vy, math.random() * 6.28, 6 + math.random() * 14
b.f.Visible = true
b.s.Color = accent()
return
end
end
end
local function crown(n, x, y, spd, rel, col)
for _ = 1, n do
for _, c in ipairs(E.crown) do
if not c.on then
local a = -math.pi / 2 + (math.random() - 0.5) * 1.9
local v = spd * (0.45 + math.random() * 0.6)
c.on, c.x, c.y, c.vx, c.vy, c.sz, c.rel, c.age = true, x, y, math.cos(a) * v, math.sin(a) * v, 3 + math.random() * 5, rel, 0
c.f.BackgroundColor3 = col
c.f.Visible = true
break
end
end
end
end
local function drip(x, y)
for _, d in ipairs(E.drip) do
if not d.on then
d.on, d.x, d.y, d.vy = true, x, y, 0
d.f.BackgroundColor3 = accent()
d.f.Visible = true
return
end
end
end
local function glint(x, y)
for _, g in ipairs(E.glint) do
if not g.on then
g.on, g.x, g.y, g.t0, g.w = true, x, y, S.t, 10 + math.random() * 30
g.f.Visible = true
return
end
end
end
local function updRings(list, t)
for _, r in ipairs(list) do
if r.on then
local u = (t - r.t0) / r.life
if u >= 1 then
r.on = false
r.c.Visible = false
else
local e = r.rev and (u * u) or eo3(u)
local rad = r.rad0 + (r.rad1 - r.rad0) * e
local tr = r.rev and (0.85 - 0.75 * u) or (0.1 + 0.9 * u)
local cx, cy = r.x, r.y
if r.follow then
cx, cy = S.ox, S.oy
elseif r.rel then
cy = cy + (S.surfPx - S.sy * 0.64)
end
local W = rad / 0.46
r.c.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx, cy)
r.c.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(W, W * r.ratio)
r.c.Rotation = lerp(r.tilt0, r.tilt1, u)
if math.abs(r.trl - tr) > 0.02 then
r.trl = tr
for _, f in ipairs(r.segs) do
f.BackgroundTransparency = tr
end
end
end
end
end
end
local function paint(list, col, tr)
for _, f in ipairs(list) do
f.BackgroundColor3 = col
f.BackgroundTransparency = tr
end
end
local function loop()
do
local w0, lim = os.clock(), opts.ReadyWait or 8
while opts.Ready and not opts.Ready() and os.clock() - w0 < lim and not S.skipped do
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then break end
local prog = SONG.Progress
E.term.Text = "> LOADING SOUNDTRACK" .. string.rep(".", math.floor(os.clock() * 3) % 4)
.. ((type(prog) == "number" and prog > 0 and prog < 1) and string.format("  %d%%", math.floor(prog * 100)) or "")
E.term.TextTransparency = 0.3
E.term.TextColor3 = accent()
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
end
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then
S.fallback = true
return
end
E.term.Text = ""
E.world.Visible = true
S.began = os.clock()
S.wall0 = S.began
end
local function curTideTop(t)
if t < M5 then return 1.4 end
local pts = {{M5, 0.8}, {M6, 0.66}, {M7, 0.54}, {M8, 0.4}, {M9, -0.4}}
for i = 1, #pts - 1 do
if t < pts[i + 1][1] then
return lerp(pts[i][2], pts[i + 1][2], smooth(clamp01((t - pts[i][1]) / (pts[i + 1][1] - pts[i][1]))))
end
end
return -0.4
end
local function onMode(m, t, col)
local I = K.INT
local sx, sy = S.sx, S.sy
if m == 2 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.95 * I)
S.zk = S.zk + 0.3 * I
S.rk = S.rk + 4 * S.dir * I
S.dir = -S.dir
S.shake = S.shake + 14 * I
S.pulse, S.aura, S.vizK = 1, 1, 1
local sxm, sy0 = sx * 0.5, sy * 0.64
flat(sxm, sy0, sx * 1.1, 2.2, WHITE, true)
flat(sxm, sy0, sx * 0.62, 1.6, col, true)
orbit(S.R * 0.6, S.R * 7, 1.8, WHITE, false, 0, 30)
crown(14, sxm, sy0, sy * 1.15, true, col:Lerp(WHITE, 0.6))
for i = 1, 12 do
bubble(sxm + (math.random() - 0.5) * sx * 0.3, sy * (0.5 + math.random() * 0.4), 4 + math.random() * 12, sy * (0.12 + math.random() * 0.25))
end
E.term.Text = ""
itick(0.5, 1.2)
itick(1.6, 0.8)
if spend(2) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 16, 0.16, 1.22) end
elseif m == 3 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.12 * I)
orbit(S.R * 0.8, S.R * 4.5, 1.6, col, false, -10, 20)
elseif m == 4 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.05 * I)
S.zk = S.zk - 0.04 * I
elseif m == 5 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 1.0 * I)
S.zk = S.zk + 0.34 * I
S.yk = S.yk + sy * 0.03 * I
S.rk = S.rk - 5 * I
S.shake = S.shake + 16 * I
S.pulse, S.aura, S.vizK, S.ts, S.surge = 1, 1, 1, 1, 1
orbit(S.R * 0.9, S.R * 5.5, 1.5, col, false, 0, 40)
S.lastRing = -10
orbit(S.R * 0.9, S.R * 8.5, 1.9, WHITE, false, 10, -30)
S.lastRing = -10
orbit(S.R * 0.9, S.R * 3.6, 1.1, col:Lerp(WHITE, 0.5), false, -20, 50)
crown(12, S.ox, S.oy, sy * 0.9, false, col:Lerp(WHITE, 0.6))
for i = 1, 10 do
bubble(sx * (0.1 + math.random() * 0.8), sy * 1.05, 4 + math.random() * 12, sy * (0.3 + math.random() * 0.4))
end
S.sp.tide = {1.25, 0}
S.sp.rail = {0.2, 0}
itick(0.55, 1.2)
itick(1.2, 0.9)
if spend(2) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 14, 0.16, 1.08) end
if spend(1) then FX.Sparks(E.world, col, 14, 380, 0.9) end
elseif m == 6 or m == 7 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.4 * I)
S.xk = S.xk + S.dir * sx * 0.2 * I
S.rk = S.rk - S.dir * 6 * I
S.dir = -S.dir
S.zk = S.zk + 0.12 * I
S.shake = S.shake + 8 * I
S.lastRing = -10
orbit(S.R * 1, S.R * 6, 1.4, col, false, 0, -35)
if spend(1) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 10, 0.18, 0.94) end
if spend(1) then FX.Sparks(E.world, col, 10, 320, 0.8) end
itick(0.7, 1)
elseif m == 8 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.3 * I)
S.zk = S.zk - 0.06 * I
S.lastRing = -10
orbit(S.R * 1.2, S.R * 9, 2.0, WHITE, false, 0, 25)
itick(0.8, 1)
end
end
local function bassHit(t, k, mode)
local I = K.INT
local sx, sy = S.sx, S.sy
S.pulse = math.max(S.pulse, k == 2 and 0.9 or 0.35)
S.aura = math.max(S.aura, k == 2 and 0.9 or 0.4)
if mode == 1 then
S.hz = math.max(S.hz, k == 2 and 1 or 0.5)
return
end
if mode == 4 then
for _, h in ipairs(REV) do
if math.abs(t - h) < 0.1 then
S.pk = S.pk + 1
kick("sq", 3.4)
S.vizK = 1
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.14 * I)
S.aura = 1
orbit(S.R * 0.5, S.R * 2.6, 0.9, accent(), false, 15, 35)
itick(1 + 0.16 * S.pk, 0.9)
return
end
end
return
end
kick("sq", k == 2 and 2.2 or 0.9)
S.vizK = math.min(1, S.vizK + (k == 2 and 0.6 or 0.25))
if mode >= 5 and mode <= 7 then
S.surge = math.min(1, S.surge + (k == 2 and 0.7 or 0.25))
local th = E.thr[math.random(1, #E.thr)]
th.tp, th.ap = t, sy * (k == 2 and 0.09 or 0.04)
end
if k == 2 then
if mode >= 5 and mode <= 7 then
S.bulgeT = t
S.shake = S.shake + 3 * I
S.zk = S.zk - 0.014 * I
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.05 * I)
if t > TT + 0.4 and t < M8 and #E.letters > 0 then
local L = E.letters[math.random(1, #E.letters)]
drip(L.x, L.y + S.tsz * 0.4)
end
if spend(1) then FX.Sparks(E.world, accent(), 5, 240, 0.5) end
end
if mode ~= 8 then orbit(S.R * 0.9, S.R * (3.4 + math.random() * 1.8), 1.1, accent(), false, math.random(-35, 35), math.random(-35, 35)) end
end
end
local function noteHit(t, k, mode)
S.noteK = 1
if mode == 2 or mode == 3 then
if k == 2 and spend(1) then
local a = math.random() * 6.283
bubble(S.ox + math.cos(a) * S.R * 0.9, S.oy + math.sin(a) * S.R * 0.9, 4 + math.random() * 10, S.sy * (0.1 + math.random() * 0.14))
end
elseif mode >= 5 and mode <= 7 then
if k == 2 and spend(1) then
bubble(S.sx * (0.05 + math.random() * 0.9), S.sy * (S.tide + 0.04), 4 + math.random() * 9, S.sy * (0.12 + math.random() * 0.2))
end
end
end
local function shimHit(t, k, mode)
S.shim = 1
if mode == 1 then
glint(S.sx * (0.1 + math.random() * 0.8), S.sy * (0.66 + math.random() * 0.2))
end
end
local function rv(t, n)
return 1 - clamp01((t - K.OFF - K.BEAT * n) / (K.BEAT * 0.6))
end
while true do
local dt = math.min(RunService.Heartbeat:Wait(), 0.1)
local t = os.clock() - S.began
do
local okP, pos, playing = pcall(function() return Music.TimePosition, Music.IsPlaying end)
if okP and playing and type(pos) == "number" and pos > 0.05 then
local d = pos - t
if math.abs(d) > 0.6 then
S.began = os.clock() - pos
else
S.began = S.began - d * 0.2
end
t = os.clock() - S.began
end
end
if S.skipped and S.tEnd == K.DUR then
S.tEnd = t + 0.35
S.flashLen = 0.35
end
if t >= S.tEnd or t > K.DUR + 8 or os.clock() - S.wall0 > K.DUR + 10 then break end
S.t = t
local sw = Util.GetScreenSize()
local sx, sy = sw.X, sw.Y
S.sx, S.sy = sx, sy
S.tokens = math.min(3, S.tokens + dt * 2.5)
local I = K.INT
local mode = (t < M2 and 1) or (t < M3 and 2) or (t < M4 and 3) or (t < M5 and 4) or (t < M6 and 5) or (t < M7 and 6) or (t < M8 and 7) or 8
local bt = math.max(0, (t - K.OFF) / K.BEAT)
local beatIdx = math.floor(bt)
local R = math.min(sy * 0.125, sx * 0.2)
S.R = R
local u8 = clamp01((t - M8) / (M9 - M8))
local u9 = clamp01((t - M9) / (K.DUR - M9))
local ck = 1 - math.exp(-3.5 * dt)
S.mc = S.mc:Lerp(PA[mode], ck)
S.bgT = S.bgT:Lerp(PT[mode], ck)
S.bgB = S.bgB:Lerp(PB[mode], ck)
local col = accent()
S.ts = lerp(S.ts, mode == 4 and 0.1 or 1, 1 - math.exp(-2.2 * dt))
S.vt = S.vt + dt * S.ts
local vt = S.vt
local lvT = lvAt(t)
S.lv = lerp(S.lv, lvT, 1 - math.exp(-14 * dt))
local lv = S.lv
if mode ~= S.mode then
S.mode = mode
onMode(mode, t, col)
end
if beatIdx ~= S.bi and t >= K.OFF then
S.bi = beatIdx
S.pulse = math.max(S.pulse, (beatIdx % 4 == 0) and 0.8 or 0.4)
if mode == 1 then
itick((beatIdx % 4 == 0) and 1.3 or 1.0, 0.22)
local line = TERM[beatIdx]
if line then S.termLines[#S.termLines + 1] = line end
if beatIdx >= 12 and beatIdx <= 15 then
S.termLines[#S.termLines + 1] = "> " .. tostring(16 - beatIdx)
itick(0.9 + 0.12 * (beatIdx - 12), 0.8)
end
E.term.Text = table.concat(S.termLines, "\n")
end
end
while BASS[S.bassI] and BASS[S.bassI][1] <= t do
local ev = BASS[S.bassI]
S.bassI = S.bassI + 1
if t - ev[1] < 0.3 then bassHit(t, ev[2], mode) end
end
while NOTE[S.noteI] and NOTE[S.noteI][1] <= t do
local ev = NOTE[S.noteI]
S.noteI = S.noteI + 1
if t - ev[1] < 0.3 then noteHit(t, ev[2], mode) end
end
while SHIM[S.shimI] and SHIM[S.shimI][1] <= t do
local ev = SHIM[S.shimI]
S.shimI = S.shimI + 1
if t - ev[1] < 0.3 then shimHit(t, ev[2], mode) end
end
while S.dn <= 11 and K.OFF + S.dn * K.BEAT - 0.5 <= t do
for _, d in ipairs(E.drops) do
if not d.on then
d.on, d.L, d.x, d.big = true, K.OFF + S.dn * K.BEAT, sx * (0.18 + math.random() * 0.64), (S.dn % 4 == 0)
d.f.Visible = true
d.f.BackgroundColor3 = col:Lerp(WHITE, 0.5)
break
end
end
S.dn = S.dn + 1
end
while REV[S.revI] and REV[S.revI] - 1.25 <= t do
if t < REV[S.revI] then

E.dip.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - dipK
local endK = smooth(clamp01((t - (S.tEnd - S.flashLen)) / S.flashLen))
local fk = math.max(S.flashK, endK)
E.flash.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
E.flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.min(1, fk)
local hudOn = CFG.IntroHud ~= false
local h1 = hudOn and clamp01(1 - rv(t, 1)) or 0
local fade = 1 - endK
E.tc.Visible, E.np.Visible, E.ms.Visible, E.prog.Visible = hudOn, hudOn, hudOn, hudOn
if hudOn then
local hc = col:Lerp(mode == 8 and C(30, 12, 60) or WHITE, 0.55)
E.tc.Text = string.format("%02d:%04.1f   BAR %02d / 28   111 BPM", math.floor(t / 60), t % 60, math.min(28, math.floor(math.max(0, t - K.OFF) / K.BAR) + 1))
E.tc.TextColor3, E.np.TextColor3, E.ms.TextColor3 = hc, hc, hc
E.tc.TextTransparency = 0.35 + (1 - h1 * fade) * 0.65
E.np.Text = "NOW PLAYING  //  MITSKI - LIQUID SMOOTH (INSTRUMENTAL)"
E.np.TextTransparency = 0.45 + (1 - clamp01(1 - rv(t, 2)) * fade) * 0.55
if t - S.msT > 0.5 then
S.msT = t
S.ms = modStatus()
end
E.ms.Text = S.ms
E.ms.TextTransparency = 0.45 + (1 - clamp01(1 - rv(t, 3)) * fade) * 0.55
E.prog.Size = UDim2.new(clamp01(t / K.DUR), 0, 0, 3)
E.prog.BackgroundColor3 = col
E.prog.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2
end
E.term.TextColor3 = col:Lerp(WHITE, 0.5)
E.term.TextTransparency = mode == 1 and 0.25 or 1
E.skip.TextColor3 = mode == 8 and C(30, 12, 60) or WHITE
E.skip.BackgroundColor3 = mode == 8 and WHITE or BLACK
E.skipS.Color = mode == 8 and C(30, 12, 60) or WHITE
end
end

loop()
end)
if not ok then
warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro 5 error (continuing): " .. tostring(err))
end
for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end)
end
pcall(function() stage:Destroy() end)
FX.IntroCamBusy = false
if S.fallback then return "fallback" end
FX.IntroActive = false

})

FX.IntroBlurOut(16)
end)
return true
end

local function clamp01(x)
return math.max(0, math.min(1, x))
end
local function lerp(a, b, k)
return a + (b - a) * k
end
local function smooth(u)
return u * u * (3 - 2 * u)
end
local function eo3(x)
return 1 - (1 - x) ^ 3
end
local function eio(x)
if x < 0.5 then return 4 * x * x * x end
return 1 - ((-2 * x + 2) ^ 3) / 2
end
local function accent()
if CFG.IntroColorMode == 2 then
return Util.ParseHex(CFG.IntroColor) or WHITE
elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 3 then
return WHITE
elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 4 and Util.Color then
return Util.Color.Cur
end
return S.mc
end
local function mk(class, parent, props)
local o = Util.Instance(class, parent)
if props then
for k, v in pairs(props) do
o[k] = v
end
end
return o
end
local function txt(parent, z, font, ax, ay, pos, size, xa)
return mk("TextLabel", parent, {
AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = pos, Size = size, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = font,
TextColor3 = WHITE, TextXAlignment = xa or Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, TextScaled = false, TextSize = 24, Text = "", TextTransparency = 1,
ZIndex = z, Interactable = false,
})
end
local function scr(s, frac)
local n = math.floor(#s * clamp01(frac))
if n >= #s then return s end
local out = s:sub(1, n)
for i = n + 1, #s do
if s:sub(i, i) == " " then
out = out .. " "
else
local k = math.random(1, #GLYPHS)
out = out .. GLYPHS:sub(k, k)
end
end
return out
end
local function itick(pitch, vol)
if not FX.Settings.ExtraSounds then return end
local base = opts.ClickSnd
if not base or base.Volume <= 0 then return end
pcall(function()
local s = base:Clone()
s.PlaybackSpeed = pitch * (0.96 + math.random() * 0.08)
s.Volume = base.Volume * vol
s.Parent = base.Parent
s:Play()
Debris:AddItem(s, 2.5)
end)
end
local function modStatus()
local f = Util.GetModuleStatus
if type(f) ~= "function" then return "BOOTING UI..." end
local ok, s = pcall(f)
return (ok and type(s) == "string") and s or ""
end
local function spend(n)
if S.tokens >= n then
S.tokens = S.tokens - n
return true
end
return false
end
local function follow(key, target, w, z, dt, init)
local st = S.sp[key]
if not st then
st = {init or target, 0}
S.sp[key] = st
end
local n = math.max(1, math.ceil(dt * 90))
local h = dt / n
for _ = 1, n do
st[2] = st[2] + (w * w * (target - st[1]) - 2 * z * w * st[2]) * h
st[1] = st[1] + st[2] * h
end
return st[1]
end
local function parse(s)
local a = {}
for t, k in tostring(s):gmatch("([%d%.]+):(%d)") do
a[#a + 1] = {tonumber(t), tonumber(k)}
end
return a
end
local BASS, NOTE, SHIM, FOOT = parse(D.bass), parse(D.note), parse(D.shim), parse(D.foot)
local LEVEL = tostring(D.level)
local function lvAt(t)
local x = t * 20
local i = math.floor(x)
local a = tonumber(LEVEL:sub(i + 1, i + 1))
if not a then return 0 end
local b = tonumber(LEVEL:sub(i + 2, i + 2)) or a
return clamp01((a + (b - a) * (x - i)) / 9)
end

end
end
end)
local function build()
local sw0 = Util.GetScreenSize()
local U0 = math.min(sw0.X, sw0.Y)
local C5 = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
local function box(parent, z, ax, ay, pos, size, color, tr)
return mk("Frame", parent, {
AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = pos, Size = size, BackgroundColor3 = color or WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = tr or 0,
BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false,
})
end
local function round(f)
Util.Instance("UICorner", f).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
return f
end
local function stroke(f, th, col, tr)
return mk("UIStroke", f, {Thickness = th, Color = col or WHITE, Transparency = tr or 0.5})
end
local function grad(f, rot, c0, c1, ts)
local g = Util.Instance("UIGradient", f)
g.Rotation = rot
if c0 then g.Color = ColorSequence.new(c0, c1 or c0) end
if ts then g.Transparency = ts end
return g
end
local function seq3(a, b, c)
return NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, a), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, b), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, c)})
end
local function makeRing(parent, z, n, ratio, thick)
local c = box(parent, z, 0.5, 0.5, C5, UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10 * ratio), WHITE, 1)
c.Visible = false
local R, segs = 0.46, {}
for i = 1, n do
local th = (i - 0.5) / n * math.pi * 2
local cs, sn = math.cos(th), math.sin(th)
local tx, ty = -sn, ratio * cs
local len = math.sqrt(tx * tx + ty * ty) * (math.pi * 2 / n) * R * 1.3
local f = box(c, z, 0.5, 0.5, UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + R * cs, 0.5 + R * sn), UDim2.new(len, 0, 0, thick), WHITE, 0)
f.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(ty, tx))
segs[i] = f
end
return {c = c, segs = segs, ratio = ratio, on = false}
end

local function ringE(x, y, r0, r1, life, col)
local r = E.ringE[1]
for _, q in ipairs(E.ringE) do
if not q.on then r = q break end
end
r.on, r.t0, r.life, r.x, r.y, r.r0, r.r1 = true, S.t, life, x, y, r0, r1
r.c.Visible = true
for _, f in ipairs(r.segs) do f.BackgroundColor3 = col end
end
local function ringC(x, y, r0, r1, life, col)
local r = E.ringC[1]
for _, q in ipairs(E.ringC) do
if not q.on then r = q break end
end
r.on, r.t0, r.life, r.x, r.y, r.r0, r.r1 = true, S.t, life, x, y, r0, r1
r.f.Visible = true
r.s.Color = col
end
local function eye(x, y, sz, col)
if S.t - S.lastEye < 0.25 then return end
for _, e in ipairs(E.eye) do
if not e.on then
e.on, e.t0, e.life, e.x, e.y, e.sz, e.ph = true, S.t, 2.6 + math.random() * 1.6, x, y, sz, math.random() * 3
e.c.Visible = true
for s = 1, 2 do
e.pair[s].g.BackgroundColor3 = col
e.pair[s].e.BackgroundColor3 = col:Lerp(WHITE, 0.55)
end
S.lastEye = S.t
return
end
end
end
local function bat(dirn)
if S.t - S.lastBat < 0.12 then return end
for _, b in ipairs(E.bat) do
if not b.on then
b.on, b.t0, b.life, b.dir = true, S.t, 3.6 + math.random() * 1.4, dirn or (math.random() < 0.5 and 1 or -1)
b.x0 = b.dir > 0 and -S.sx * 0.05 or S.sx * 1.05
b.y0 = S.sy * (0.12 + math.random() * 0.4)
b.sp = S.sx * (0.2 + math.random() * 0.16)
b.sc = 0.7 + math.random() * 0.9
b.ph = math.random() * 6.28
b.c.Visible = true
S.lastBat = S.t
return
end
end
end
local function seg(f, x1, y1, x2, y2, th)
local dx, dy = x2 - x1, y2 - y1
f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((x1 + x2) / 2, (y1 + y2) / 2)
f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) + 2, th)
f.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx))
end
local function bolt(xf, power)
local b = E.bolt[1].on and E.bolt[2] or E.bolt[1]
local sx, sy = S.sx, S.sy
local pts, x, y = {}, sx * xf, -sy * 0.05
local step = (sy * (0.6 + math.random() * 0.1)) / 7
for i = 1, 8 do
pts[i] = {x, y}
x = x + (math.random() - 0.5) * sx * 0.09
y = y + step
end
local n = 0
for i = 1, 7 do
n = n + 1
seg(b.segs[n], pts[i][1], pts[i][2], pts[i + 1][1], pts[i + 1][2], 3 + 3 * power)
end
local bx, by = pts[4][1], pts[4][2]
for _ = 1, 4 do
local nx, ny = bx + (math.random() - 0.3) * sx * 0.07, by + step * 0.8
n = n + 1
seg(b.segs[n], bx, by, nx, ny, 2)
bx, by = nx, ny
end
b.on, b.t0, b.n = true, S.t, n
end
local function doStrike(st)
local I = K.INT
bolt((st == M5 or st == M7) and 0.5 or (0.15 + math.random() * 0.7), 1)
S.boltK = 1
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.5 * I)
S.shake = S.shake + 8 * I
itick(0.35, 1.2)
if spend(1) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 10, 0.16, 0.68) end
end
local HB0, HBP = 17.64, K.BEAT * 2
local function slam(i, col)
local sx, sy = S.sx, S.sy
S.glitch = 1
S.zk = S.zk + 0.09 * K.INT
S.shake = S.shake + 8 * K.INT
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.16 * K.INT)
S.pulse = 1
ringC(sx * 0.5, sy * 0.48, math.min(sx, sy) * 0.05, math.min(sx, sy) * 0.55, 0.6, col:Lerp(WHITE, 0.2))
itick(0.6 + 0.07 * i, 1)
if spend(1) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 8, 0.16, 0.54) end
if i == 4 or i == 8 then
if spend(1) then FX.Sparks(E.world, BLOOD:Lerp(WHITE, 0.3), 12, 340, 0.8) end
end
end
local function bassHit(t, k, mode)
local sx, sy = S.sx, S.sy
S.kickK = math.max(S.kickK, k == 2 and 1 or 0.5)
if mode == 5 or mode == 6 then
S.moonK = math.max(S.moonK, 0.6 * k)
for _, tb in ipairs(E.tomb) do tb.bounce = 1 end
if k == 2 then
ringE(sx * 0.5, sy * 0.88, math.min(sx, sy) * 0.08, math.min(sx, sy) * 1.1, 0.9, accent())
itick(0.5, 0.6)
end
end
end
local function noteHit(t, k, mode)
if mode == 4 then
S.noteK = 1
S.ember = 1
if k == 2 then bat() end
elseif mode == 5 or mode == 6 then
S.glitch = math.max(S.glitch, k == 2 and 0.8 or 0.3)
S.noteK = 1
end
end
local function shimHit(t, k, mode)
S.shim = 1
if (mode == 5 or mode == 6) and k == 2 and math.random() < 0.3 then bat() end
end
local function footHit(i)
local sx, sy = S.sx, S.sy
S.yk = S.yk + sy * 0.02 * K.INT
S.rk = S.rk + (i % 2 == 0 and 0.7 or -0.7) * K.INT
ringE(sx * (0.35 + 0.3 * (i % 2)), sy * 0.9, math.min(sx, sy) * 0.03, math.min(sx, sy) * 0.4, 0.8, accent())
itick(0.55, 0.9)
S.termLines[#S.termLines + 1] = TERM[2 + i] or "> STEP"
E.term.Text = table.concat(S.termLines, "\n")
end
local function loop()
do
local w0, lim = os.clock(), opts.ReadyWait or 8
while opts.Ready and not opts.Ready() and os.clock() - w0 < lim and not S.skipped do
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then break end
local prog = SONG.Progress
E.term.Text = "> LOADING SOUNDTRACK" .. string.rep(".", math.floor(os.clock() * 3) % 4)
.. ((type(prog) == "number" and prog > 0 and prog < 1) and string.format("  %d%%", math.floor(prog * 100)) or "")
E.term.TextTransparency = 0.3
E.term.TextColor3 = BONE
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
end
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then
S.fallback = true
return
end
E.term.Text = ""
E.world.Visible = true
S.began = os.clock()
S.wall0 = S.began
end
local function onMode(m, t, col)
local I = K.INT
local sx, sy = S.sx, S.sy
local U = math.min(sx, sy)
if m == 2 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.9 * I)
S.zk = S.zk + 0.26 * I
S.shake = S.shake + 12 * I
S.rk = S.rk + 3 * I
ringC(sx * 0.5, sy * 0.5, U * 0.1, U * 1.3, 0.9, BONE)
bat(1)
itick(0.45, 1.2)
if spend(2) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 14, 0.16, 1.22) end
elseif m == 3 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.15 * I)
S.zk = S.zk + 0.05 * I
elseif m == 4 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.2 * I)
S.rk = S.rk - 2 * I
bat(-1)
elseif m == 5 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 1.0 * I)
S.zk = S.zk + 0.38 * I
S.yk = S.yk + sy * 0.03 * I
S.rk = S.rk - 5 * I
S.shake = S.shake + 18 * I
S.pulse, S.moonK, S.ts = 1, 1, 1
ringC(sx * 0.5, sy * 0.3, U * 0.2, U * 1.6, 1.2, BLOOD)
ringE(sx * 0.5, sy * 0.88, U * 0.1, U * 1.6, 1.2, BLOOD)
itick(0.5, 1.2)
itick(1.2, 0.9)
if spend(2) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 16, 0.16, 1.22) end
if spend(1) then FX.Sparks(E.world, BLOOD:Lerp(WHITE, 0.4), 16, 420, 1.0) end
elseif m == 6 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.5 * I)
S.xk = S.xk + S.dir * sx * 0.22 * I
S.rk = S.rk - S.dir * 6 * I
S.dir = -S.dir
S.zk = S.zk + 0.12 * I
S.shake = S.shake + 9 * I
ringC(sx * 0.5, sy * 0.3, U * 0.2, U * 1.4, 1.0, col)
bat(1)
bat(-1)
if spend(1) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 10, 0.18, 0.94) end
elseif m == 7 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.6 * I)
S.shake = S.shake + 14 * I
S.zk = S.zk - 0.1 * I
S.rk = S.rk + 5 * I
itick(0.4, 1.2)
if spend(1) then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 12, 0.18, 1.22) end
elseif m == 8 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.3 * I)
ringC(sx * 0.5, sy * 0.32, U * 0.2, U * 1.0, 1.4, PA[8])
itick(0.8, 0.8)
end
end
local function rv(t, n)
return 1 - clamp01((t - K.OFF - K.BEAT * n) / (K.BEAT * 0.6))
end
while true do
local dt = math.min(RunService.Heartbeat:Wait(), 0.1)
local t = os.clock() - S.began
do
local okP, pos, playing = pcall(function() return Music.TimePosition, Music.IsPlaying end)
if okP and playing and type(pos) == "number" and pos > 0.05 then
local d = pos - t
if math.abs(d) > 0.6 then
S.began = os.clock() - pos
else
S.began = S.began - d * 0.2
end
t = os.clock() - S.began
end
end
if S.skipped and S.tEnd == K.DUR then
S.tEnd = t + 0.35
S.flashLen = 0.35
end
if t >= S.tEnd or t > K.DUR + 8 or os.clock() - S.wall0 > K.DUR + 10 then break end
S.t = t
local sw = Util.GetScreenSize()
local sx, sy = sw.X, sw.Y
S.sx, S.sy = sx, sy
S.tokens = math.min(3, S.tokens + dt * 2.5)
local I = K.INT
local mode = (t < M2 and 1) or (t < M3 and 2) or (t < M4 and 3) or (t < M5 and 4) or (t < M6 and 5) or (t < M7 and 6) or (t < M8 and 7) or 8
local bt = math.max(0, (t - K.OFF) / K.BEAT)
local beatIdx = math.floor(bt)
local U = math.min(sx, sy)
local ck = 1 - math.exp(-3.5 * dt)
S.mc = S.mc:Lerp(PA[mode], ck)
S.mm = S.mm:Lerp(PM[mode], ck)
S.bgT = S.bgT:Lerp(PT[mode], ck)
S.bgB = S.bgB:Lerp(PB[mode], ck)
local col = accent()
S.vt = S.vt + dt
local vt = S.vt
S.lv = lerp(S.lv, lvAt(t), 1 - math.exp(-14 * dt))
local lv = S.lv
if mode ~= S.mode then
S.mode = mode
onMode(mode, t, col)
end
if beatIdx ~= S.bi and t >= K.OFF then
S.bi = beatIdx
local down = (beatIdx % 4 == 0)
S.pulse = math.max(S.pulse, down and 0.8 or 0.4)
if mode == 5 or mode == 6 then
S.zk = S.zk + (down and 0.07 or 0.035) * I
S.shake = S.shake + (down and 4 or 2) * I
if down then
S.rk = S.rk + S.dir * 1.6 * I
S.dir = -S.dir
end
itick(down and 1.4 or 1.0, 0.3)
elseif mode == 1 then
if beatIdx % 4 == 0 and beatIdx > 0 then itick(0.5, 0.25) end
local line = (beatIdx == 1 and TERM[1]) or (beatIdx == 8 and TERM[2]) or nil
if line then
S.termLines[#S.termLines + 1] = line
E.term.Text = table.concat(S.termLines, "\n")
end
end
end
if t >= HB0 and mode >= 3 and mode <= 4 then
local hb = math.floor((t - HB0) / HBP)
if hb ~= S.hbI then
S.hbI = hb
S.pulse, S.moonK = 1, 1
S.zk = S.zk + 0.035 * I
S.dubT = t + 0.2
itick(0.4, 1.1)
if mode == 3 then
eye(sx * (0.08 + math.random() * 0.84), sy * (0.6 + math.random() * 0.2), U * 0.03, col)
end
end
if S.dubT and t >= S.dubT then
S.dubT = nil
S.pulse = math.max(S.pulse, 0.7)
S.zk = S.zk + 0.018 * I
itick(0.3, 0.9)
end
end
while BASS[S.bassI] and BASS[S.bassI][1] <= t do
local ev = BASS[S.bassI]
S.bassI = S.bassI + 1
if t - ev[1] < 0.3 then bassHit(t, ev[2], mode) end
end
while NOTE[S.noteI] and NOTE[S.noteI][1] <= t do
local ev = NOTE[S.noteI]
S.noteI = S.noteI + 1
if t - ev[1] < 0.3 then noteHit(t, ev[2], mode) end
end
while SHIM[S.shimI] and SHIM[S.shimI][1] <= t do
local ev = SHIM[S.shimI]
S.shimI = S.shimI + 1
if t - ev[1] < 0.3 then shimHit(t, ev[2], mode) end
end
while FOOT[S.footI] and FOOT[S.footI][1] <= t do
local ev = FOOT[S.footI]
local i = S.footI
S.footI = S.footI + 1
if t - ev[1] < 0.4 then footHit(i) end
end
while STRIKES[S.strikeI] and STRIKES[S.strikeI] <= t do
local st = STRIKES[S.strikeI]

K.BAR = K.BEAT * 4
K.DUR = K.OFF + 32 * K.BAR
local function B(n) return K.OFF + n * K.BAR end

local NAME = (tostring(CFG.IntroTitle):gsub("[^\32-\126]", "")):sub(1, 20):upper()
if NAME == "" then NAME = "STEVETHEREALONE" end
local TITLE, PHRASE = "PERFECT FACE", {"LOOK", "ME", "IN", "MY", "PERFECT", "FACE"}
local BLACK = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
local function C(r, g, b) return Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b) end

local function parse(s)
local o = {}
for a, b in s:gmatch("([%d%.]+):(%d)") do o[#o + 1] = {tonumber(a), tonumber(b)} end
return o
end
local BASS, HAT, VOX, LEVEL = parse(D.bass), parse(D.hat), {}, D.level

local function clamp01(x) return math.max(0, math.min(1, x)) end
local function lerp(a, b, k) return a + (b - a) * k end
local function eo3(x) return 1 - (1 - x) ^ 3 end

if CFG.IntroColorMode == 2 then

elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 3 then

local function mk(class, parent, props)
local o = Util.Instance(class, parent)
if props then
for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
end
return o
end
local function itick(pitch, vol)
if not FX.Settings.ExtraSounds then return end
local base = opts.ClickSnd
if not base or base.Volume <= 0 then return end
pcall(function()
local s = base:Clone()
s.PlaybackSpeed = pitch * (0.96 + math.random() * 0.08)
s.Volume = base.Volume * vol
s.Parent = base.Parent
s:Play()
Debris:AddItem(s, 2.5)
end)
end
local function lvAt(t)
local x = t * 10.7666
local i = math.floor(x)
local a = tonumber(LEVEL:sub(i + 1, i + 1)) or 0
local b = tonumber(LEVEL:sub(i + 2, i + 2)) or a
return clamp01((a + (b - a) * (x - i)) / 9)
end

if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
local k = input.KeyCode
if k == Enum.KeyCode.Space or k == Enum.KeyCode.Return or k == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then S.skipped = true end
end
end)

end

return {g = f, s = sgn, z = size}
end

end

E.lbB.Position, E.lbB.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
E.tR, E.tC, E.tM = txt(14, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, C(255, 30, 90), 0.5, 0.1), txt(15, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, C(30, 230, 255), 0.5, 0.1), txt(16, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, WHITE, 0.5, 0.1)
E.name = txt(16, Enum.Font.GothamBold, WHITE, 0.5, 0.18)
E.cap = txt(17, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, WHITE, 0.5, 0.9)
E.big = txt(18, Enum.Font.GothamBlack, WHITE, 0.5, 0.5)
E.flash = box(stage, 20, nil, WHITE, 1)
E.flash.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
do local ok, up = pcall(FX.IntroUpgrade, stage, E, 7, M, K, 3) if ok and type(up) == "function" then E.up = up end end
E.tc, E.np = hud(14, 21), hud(34, 21)
E.term = mk("TextLabel", stage, {Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, 56), Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0.3, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = WHITE, TextTransparency = 1, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top, ZIndex = 21, Interactable = false, Text = ""})
E.prog = box(stage, 22, Vector2.new(0, 1), WHITE, 0.2)
E.prog.Position, E.prog.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0), UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 3)
E.skip = mk("TextButton", stage, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 14), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(168, 30), BackgroundColor3 = BLACK, BackgroundTransparency = 0.3, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = WHITE, Text = "SKIP INTRO  >>  OPEN UI", ZIndex = 30, AutoButtonColor = false})
mk("UIStroke", E.skip, {Thickness = 1, Color = WHITE, Transparency = 0.2})
conns[#conns + 1] = E.skip.Activated:Connect(function() S.skipped = true end)
E.world.Visible = false
end
local function spark(col)
local q = E.sp[1]
for _, r in ipairs(E.sp) do
if not r.on then q = r break end
end
local U = math.min(S.sx, S.sy)
q.on, q.t0, q.life = true, S.t, 0.55 + math.random() * 0.4
q.x, q.y = (math.random() - 0.5) * S.sx * 0.95, (math.random() - 0.5) * S.sy * 0.9
q.f.Visible = true
q.f.BackgroundColor3 = col
end
local function ringW(r0, r1, life, col)
local q = E.rg[1]
for _, r in ipairs(E.rg) do
if not r.on then q = r break end
end
q.on, q.t0, q.life, q.r0, q.r1 = true, S.t, life, r0, r1
q.f.Visible = true
q.st.Color = col
end
local function onMode(m)
local I, U = K.INT, math.min(S.sx, S.sy)
if m == 2 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.45 * I)
S.zk = S.zk + 0.16 * I
ringW(U * 0.2, U * 1.2, 0.8, S.ac)
itick(0.6, 1)
elseif m == 3 then
S.tk = 0
elseif m == 4 or m == 7 then
S.flashK = I
S.zk = S.zk + 0.32 * I
S.shake = S.shake + 18 * I
S.rk = S.rk + 5 * I * S.dir
S.dir = -S.dir
S.crk = S.t
S.titleN = 0
ringW(U * 0.1, U * 1.6, 0.9, WHITE)
ringW(U * 0.1, U * 1.1, 0.7, S.ac2)
itick(0.4, 1.4)
if S.tokens >= 1 then
S.tokens = S.tokens - 1
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 14, 0.16, 1.22)
end
elseif m == 5 then
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.5 * I)
S.zk = S.zk + 0.2 * I
ringW(U * 0.1, U * 1.3, 0.8, S.ac2)
itick(0.8, 1)
elseif m == 6 then
S.flashK = 0
end
end
local function loop()
do
local w0, lim = os.clock(), opts.ReadyWait or 8
while opts.Ready and not opts.Ready() and os.clock() - w0 < lim and not S.skipped do
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then break end
local prog = SONG.Progress
E.term.Text = "> LOADING SOUNDTRACK" .. string.rep(".", math.floor(os.clock() * 3) % 4)
.. ((type(prog) == "number" and prog > 0 and prog < 1) and string.format("  %d%%", math.floor(prog * 100)) or "")
E.term.TextTransparency = 0.3
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
end
if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then
S.fallback = true
return
end
E.term.Text = ""
E.world.Visible = true
S.began = os.clock()
S.wall0 = S.began
end
local TL = {{2, "> LOCATING EAGLE ..."}, {6, "> WINGS LOADED"}, {10, "> MIGHTY = TRUE"}}
while true do
local dt = math.min(RunService.Heartbeat:Wait(), 0.1)
local t = os.clock() - S.began
do
local okP, pos, playing = pcall(function() return Music.TimePosition, Music.IsPlaying end)
if okP and playing and type(pos) == "number" and pos > 0.05 then
local d = pos - t
if math.abs(d) > 0.6 then S.began = os.clock() - pos else S.began = S.began - d * 0.2 end
t = os.clock() - S.began
end
end
if S.skipped and S.tEnd == K.DUR then
S.tEnd = t + 0.35
S.flashLen = 0.35
end
if t >= S.tEnd or t > K.DUR + 8 or os.clock() - S.wall0 > K.DUR + 10 then break end
S.t = t
local sw = Util.GetScreenSize()
local sx, sy = sw.X, sw.Y
S.sx, S.sy = sx, sy
S.tokens = math.min(3, S.tokens + dt * 2.5)
local I, U = K.INT, math.min(sx, sy)
local mode = (t < M[1] and 1) or (t < M[2] and 2) or (t < M[3] and 3) or (t < M[4] and 4) or (t < M[5] and 5) or (t < M[6] and 6) or 7
local ck = 1 - math.exp(-6 * dt)
S.ac, S.ac2, S.bgc = S.ac:Lerp(PA[mode], ck), S.ac2:Lerp(PB[mode], ck), S.bgc:Lerp(PT[mode], ck)
local acc, acc2 = accent(), S.ac2
S.lv = lerp(S.lv, lvAt(t), 1 - math.exp(-14 * dt))
if mode ~= S.mode then
S.mode = mode
onMode(mode)
end
local bt = math.max(0, (t - K.OFF) / K.BEAT)
local beatIdx = math.floor(bt)
local drop = mode == 4 or mode == 5 or mode == 7
if beatIdx ~= S.bi and t >= K.OFF then
S.bi = beatIdx
local down = beatIdx % 4 == 0
S.pulse = math.max(S.pulse, down and 1 or 0.55)
if drop then
S.zk = S.zk + (down and 0.07 or 0.035) * I
if down then
S.rk = S.rk + S.dir * 1.8 * I
S.dir = -S.dir
end
end
if beatIdx % 8 == 7 then S.blink = 1 end
if mode == 6 then
S.pulse = 1
itick(1.5 - 0.2 * (3 - math.floor((t - M[5]) / K.BEAT)), 1)
end
end
while BASS[S.bassI] and BASS[S.bassI][1] <= t do
local h = BASS[S.bassI]
S.bassI = S.bassI + 1
if t - h[1] < 0.25 then
S.kick = 1
if mode ~= 1 and mode ~= 6 then
S.zk = S.zk + (0.025 + 0.02 * h[2]) * I
S.shake = S.shake + h[2] * (drop and 2.4 or 1) * I
if drop and h[2] >= 3 then
S.strobe, S.glitch = 1, 1
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.1 * I)
if S.tokens >= 1 and mode ~= 5 then
S.tokens = S.tokens - 1
ringW(U * 0.15, U * 0.9, 0.55, acc2)
end
end
itick(drop and 0.7 or 0.5, 0.35)
end
end
end
while HAT[S.hatI] and HAT[S.hatI][1] <= t do
local h = HAT[S.hatI]
S.hatI = S.hatI + 1
if drop and t - h[1] < 0.2 then spark((S.hatI % 2 == 0) and acc or acc2) end
end
while VOX[S.voxI] and VOX[S.voxI] <= t do
local v = VOX[S.voxI]
S.voxI = S.voxI + 1
if t - v < 0.4 then
S.mt, S.ph = v, v
itick(1.6, 0.4)
end
end
if mode == 3 then
local rt = clamp01((t - M[2]) / (M[3] - M[2]))
if t >= S.tk then
S.tk = t + lerp(K.BEAT * 0.5, K.BEAT * 0.12, rt)
itick(1 + rt * 1.2, 0.5)
end
end
if mode == 1 then
local l = TL[S.tlI]
if l and beatIdx >= l[1] then
S.tlI = S.tlI + 1
S.lines[#S.lines + 1] = l[2]
E.term.Text = table.concat(S.lines, "\n")
end
end
local dk = math.exp(-dt)
S.pulse = S.pulse * math.exp(-6 * dt)
S.kick = S.kick * math.exp(-9 * dt)
S.zk = S.zk * math.exp(-8 * dt)
S.shake = S.shake * math.exp(-9 * dt)
S.rk = S.rk * math.exp(-4 * dt)
S.flashK = S.flashK * math.exp(-6 * dt)
S.glitch = S.glitch * math.exp(-7 * dt)
S.strobe = S.strobe * math.exp(-10 * dt)
S.blink = S.blink * math.exp(-12 * dt)
S.tp = S.tp * math.exp(-10 * dt)
S.kal = lerp(S.kal, (mode == 5 or mode == 7) and 1 or 0, 1 - math.exp(-3 * dt))
local rt = (mode == 3) and clamp01((t - M[2]) / (M[3] - M[2])) or 0
local zb = (mode == 1 and 0.12 * clamp01(t / M[1])) or (mode == 2 and 0.1 + 0.04 * S.pulse) or (mode == 3 and 0.1 + rt * 0.5) or 0.02 * S.pulse
E.zs.Scale = 1 + zb + S.zk
local sh = (S.shake + rt * rt * 6) * I
E.world.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * sh, 0.5, (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * sh)
E.world.Rotation = S.rk + math.sin(t * 0.8) * 0.8 * I * (mode >= 2 and 1 or 0.3)
if E.up then E.up(t, dt, S) end
local bgk = S.strobe * 0.5 + (mode == 3 and rt * 0.12 * (math.floor(t * 14) % 2) or 0)
E.world.BackgroundColor3 = S.bgc:Lerp(acc, bgk)
local cy = U * 0.02
local g = (S.glitch * 0.02 + rt * 0.015) * U * I
local draw = clamp01(t / (K.BAR * 2.2))
if not S.egDone then
local rv = draw * 8.6
for _, p in ipairs(E.eg) do p.f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - clamp01(rv - (p.o - 1)) end
if draw >= 1 then S.egDone = true end
end
local fxT = ((mode == 4 or mode == 5 or mode == 7) and 1) or (mode == 6 and 0.7) or (mode == 3 and 0.3 + 0.35 * rt) or (mode == 2 and 0.18 + 0.1 * clamp01((t - M[1]) / K.BAR)) or 0
S.flex = lerp(S.flex or 0, fxT, 1 - math.exp(-((mode == 4 or mode == 7) and 16 or 4) * dt))
local fx = S.flex
local trem = (mode == 3) and (math.random() - 0.5) * 4 * rt or 0
local dR = lerp(-38, 0, fx) - S.kick * 7 - S.pulse * 2 + trem
local dL = lerp(70, 0, fx) - S.kick * 7 - S.pulse * 2 + trem
local bR = lerp(75, 0, fx) + math.sin(t * 2.6) * 3
local bL = lerp(55, 0, fx) + math.sin(t * 2.6 + 1) * 3
E.arm[1].Rotation, E.arm[2].Rotation = dR, -dL
E.fa[1].Rotation, E.fa[2].Rotation = bR, -bL
local pump = 1 + S.kick * 0.07 + S.pulse * 0.03 + 0.04 * fx
E.aS[1].Scale, E.aS[2].Scale = pump, pump
local es = U * 0.88 * (1 + 0.012 * S.pulse + 0.06 * S.kal)
E.eagle.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(es, es)
E.eagle.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, cy + U * 0.04 + math.sin(t * 1.9) * U * 0.006 - S.kick * U * 0.01)
E.eagle.Rotation = math.sin(t * 0.9) * 0.8
local ot = t - S.mt
local open = ot < 0.55 and clamp01(1 - ot / 0.55) * (0.45 + 0.55 * math.abs(math.sin(ot * 24))) or 0
E.jaw.Rotation = -open * 30
E.head.Rotation = lerp(12, -5, clamp01(fx * 1.4)) + math.sin(t * 1.3) * 2 + S.pulse * 2.5 - open * 6
E.head.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.36 - 0.015 * fx + 0.006 * S.pulse)
local bl = clamp01(S.blink)
E.eye.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.12, 0.1 * (1 - 0.9 * bl))
E.eye.BackgroundColor3 = E.eyeC:Lerp(WHITE, math.min(1, rt * 0.9 + S.kick * 0.7))
E.pup.Visible = bl < 0.6
E.pup.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + (0.047 + 0.012 * math.sin(t * 1.7) * (1 - S.kick)) / 0.5, 0.27)
local rayK = clamp01((t - 0.8) / 3.5) * (mode == 6 and 0.5 or 1)
local spin = (mode == 4 or mode == 5 or mode == 7) and 9 or 3
for i, f in ipairs(E.rays) do
f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(U * 3.6, U * 0.06 * (1 + 0.5 * S.pulse + (mode >= 4 and 0.4 or 0)))
f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, cy - U * 0.05)
f.Rotation = (i - 1) * 20 + t * spin
f.BackgroundColor3 = acc:Lerp(WHITE, 0.5)
f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - rayK * (0.16 + 0.22 * S.lv + 0.1 * S.pulse)
end
local gs = U * (0.8 + 0.06 * S.pulse + 0.1 * S.kick)
E.glow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(gs, gs)
E.glow.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, cy - U * 0.02)
E.glow.BackgroundColor3 = acc:Lerp(WHITE, 0.7)
E.glow.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - rayK * (0.3 + 0.25 * S.lv + 0.2 * S.kick)
for i, h in ipairs(E.halo) do
local d = U * (0.62 + 0.2 * i) * (1 + 0.03 * S.pulse * i)
h.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(d, d)
h.f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, cy - U * 0.02)
h.st.Color = acc:Lerp(WHITE, 0.6)
h.st.Transparency = 1 - rayK * (0.45 - 0.08 * i)
h.st.Thickness = 2 + S.kick * 3
end
for i, f in ipairs(E.cl) do
local u = (i * 0.137 + t * (0.006 + 0.003 * (i % 3))) % 1
f.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.3 + 0.05 * (i % 3), 0.1 + 0.02 * (i % 2))
f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(-0.15 + u * 1.3, 0.62 + 0.04 * (i % 4))
f.BackgroundColor3 = acc:Lerp(WHITE, 0.75)
end
local ct = t - S.crk
local crOn = (mode == 4 or mode == 5 or mode == 7) and ct < 24
for i, f in ipairs(E.cr) do
f.Visible = crOn
if crOn then
f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(U * (0.25 + 0.5 * ((i * 37) % 10) / 10) * eo3(clamp01(ct / 0.25)), 3)
f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.15 + 0.7 * clamp01((ct - 1) / 16)
f.BackgroundColor3 = (i % 2 == 0) and WHITE or acc2
f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, cy)
end
end
for _, r in ipairs(E.rg) do
if r.on then
local u = (t - r.t0) / r.life
if u >= 1 then
r.on = false
r.f.Visible = false
else
local d = lerp(r.r0, r.r1, eo3(u))
r.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(d, d)
r.st.Transparency = u
r.st.Thickness = 2 + 8 * (1 - u)
end
end
end
for _, r in ipairs(E.sp) do
if r.on then
local u = (t - r.t0) / r.life
if u >= 1 then
r.on = false
r.f.Visible = false
else
local d = U * 0.025 * (1 - u * 0.5)
r.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(d, d)
r.f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, r.x, 0.5, r.y - u * U * 0.18)
r.f.BackgroundTransparency = u
end
end
end
local eqOn = (mode >= 2) and 1 or 0.3
for i, f in ipairs(E.eq) do
local h = (0.04 + 0.5 * S.lv * (0.35 + 0.65 * math.abs(math.sin(i * 1.9 + t * 7 + S.kick * 3)))) * sy * 0.28 * eqOn
f.Position = UDim2.new((i - 0.5) / 28, 0, 1, 0)
f.Size = UDim2.new(1 / 28, -3, 0, h)
f.BackgroundColor3 = (i % 2 == 0) and acc or acc2
end
S.lbv = lerp(S.lbv, (mode == 3 and 0.11) or (mode == 6 and 0.18) or 0, 1 - math.exp(-8 * dt))
E.lbT.Size, E.lbB.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, S.lbv, 0), UDim2.new(1, 0, S.lbv, 0)
if mode == 4 or mode == 5 or mode == 7 then
local a0 = (mode == 7) and M[6] or M[3]
local n = math.min(#TITLE, math.floor((t - a0) / K.BEAT) + 1)
if n ~= S.titleN then
S.titleN = n
S.tp = 1
itick(1.2, 0.5)
end
local ts = TITLE:sub(1, S.titleN)
local fs = math.floor(U * 0.11 * (1 + S.tp * 0.35))
local gx = g * 1.5 + S.tp * U * 0.01
for _, l in ipairs({E.tR, E.tC, E.tM}) do
l.Text, l.TextSize = ts, fs
end
E.tR.Position, E.tC.Position, E.tM.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, gx, 0.1, 0), UDim2.new(0.5, -gx, 0.1, 0), UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.1, 0)
E.tM.TextTransparency, E.tM.TextColor3 = 0, WHITE
E.tR.TextTransparency = gx > 1 and 0.35 or 1
E.tC.TextTransparency = gx > 1 and 0.35 or 1
else
E.tM.TextTransparency, E.tR.TextTransparency, E.tC.TextTransparency = 1, 1, 1
end
if mode == 7 and t >= B(26) then
E.name.Text = (NAME:gsub("(.)", "%1 "))
E.name.TextSize = math.floor(U * 0.045 * (1 + (t >= B(30) and 0.4 or 0)))
E.name.TextTransparency = 1 - eo3(clamp01((t - B(26)) / K.BEAT))
E.name.TextColor3 = acc2
else
E.name.TextTransparency = 1
end
if mode == 6 then
local n = 4 - math.floor((t - M[5]) / K.BEAT)
E.big.Text = tostring(math.clamp(n, 1, 4))
E.big.TextSize = math.floor(U * (0.3 + 0.12 * S.pulse))
E.big.TextTransparency = 0
E.big.TextColor3 = acc
else
E.big.TextTransparency = 1
end
local pn = math.floor((t - S.ph) / 0.2) + 1
if pn >= 1 and t - S.ph < 1.5 and mode ~= 3 and mode ~= 6 then
E.cap.Text = table.concat(PHRASE, " ", 1, math.min(#PHRASE, pn))
E.cap.TextSize = math.floor(U * 0.07 * (1 + S.kick * 0.08))
E.cap.TextTransparency = clamp01((t - S.ph - 1.1) / 0.4)
E.cap.TextColor3 = (math.floor(t * 8) % 2 == 0) and WHITE or acc2
else
E.cap.TextTransparency = 1
end
local fk = math.max(S.flashK, (mode == 7 and clamp01((t - B(31)) / K.BAR) ^ 3 * 0.9 * I) or 0)
E.flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - clamp01(fk)
local hf = clamp01(t / 2)
local hc = acc:Lerp(WHITE, 0.55)
E.tc.Text = string.format("%s  %02d:%04.1f   BAR %02d / 32   107 BPM", (math.floor(os.clock() * 2) % 2 == 0) and "* REC" or "  REC", math.floor(t / 60), t % 60, math.min(32, math.floor(math.max(0, t - K.OFF) / K.BAR) + 1))
E.np.Text = "NOW PLAYING  //  LAYDOWNROT - PERFECT FACE (SLOWED)"
E.tc.TextColor3, E.np.TextColor3, E.term.TextColor3 = hc, hc, hc
E.tc.TextTransparency = 0.35 + (1 - hf) * 0.65
E.np.TextTransparency = 0.45 + (1 - hf) * 0.55
E.term.TextTransparency = (mode <= 2) and 0.3 or 1
E.prog.Size = UDim2.new(clamp01(t / K.DUR), 0, 0, 3)
E.prog.BackgroundColor3 = acc
end
end
local ok, err = pcall(loop)
if not ok then warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro 7 error (continuing): " .. tostring(err)) end
for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
pcall(function() stage:Destroy() end)
FX.IntroCamBusy = false
if S.fallback then return "fallback" end
FX.IntroActive = false
pcall(function()
local fl = mk("Frame", MainFrame, {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0), BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(K.INT, 0, 1) * 0.9, BorderSizePixel = 0, Interactable = false, ZIndex = 256})
tween(fl, 1, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
Debris:AddItem(fl, 1.1)
FX.Ring(MainFrame, accent(), 1000, 0.9, 6)
FX.Ring(MainFrame, PB[7], 700, 0.7, 3)
FX.IntroBlurOut(16)
end)
return true

function FX.Intro8(MainFrame, Music, _, opts)
if FX.IntroCamBusy then return end
FX.IntroCamBusy = true
FX.IntroActive = true
opts = opts or {}
local CFG, D, SONG = FX.Cfg, FX.Intro8Data, opts.Song or {}
local K = {OFF = SONG.Offset or 0.09, BEAT = 60 / (SONG.Bpm or 122), INT = math.clamp(tonumber(CFG.IntroIntensity) or 1, 0, 1.5)}
K.BAR = K.BEAT * 4
K.DUR = K.OFF + 32 * K.BAR
local function B(n) return K.OFF + n * K.BAR end
local NAME = (tostring(CFG.IntroTitle):gsub("[^\32-\126]", "")):sub(1, 20):upper()
if NAME == "" then NAME = "STEVETHEREALONE" end
local TITLE = "THE AURA FARMER"
local BLACK = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
local function C(r, g, b) return Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b) end
local GOLD, PINK, CYAN, VIO, ORG = C(255, 196, 64), C(255, 52, 150), C(40, 220, 255), C(150, 70, 255), C(255, 140, 20)
local FUR, FUR2, FURL, MANE = C(96, 58, 42), C(58, 32, 26), C(134, 90, 64), C(26, 14, 12)
local SUIT, SUIT2, LAPEL, SKIN = C(94, 84, 230), C(136, 122, 255), C(224, 78, 52), C(226, 172, 132)
local function clamp01(x) return math.max(0, math.min(1, x)) end
local function lerp(a, b, k) return a + (b - a) * k end
local function eo3(x) return 1 - (1 - x) ^ 3 end
local function parse(s)
local o = {}
for a, b in s:gmatch("([%d%.]+):(%d)") do o[#o + 1] = {tonumber(a), tonumber(b)} end
return o
end
local BASS, HAT, LEVEL, VOC = parse(D.bass), parse(D.hat), D.level, D.voc
local function lvAt(str, t)
local x = t * 10
local i = math.floor(x)
local a = tonumber(str:sub(i + 1, i + 1)) or 0
local b = tonumber(str:sub(i + 2, i + 2)) or a
return clamp01((a + (b - a) * (x - i)) / 9)
end
local function Bsec(sec) return (sec - K.OFF) / K.BAR end
local SCH = {{0, 1}, {Bsec(9.88), 2}, {Bsec(27.42), 3}, {Bsec(29.25), 4}, {Bsec(35.92), 3}, {Bsec(49.67), 5}, {29, 6}}
local DROPS = {B(7), B(19), B(26), B(30.4)}
local LY = {}
for _, r in ipairs(FX.Intro8Lyrics or {}) do
local L = {a = r[1], e = r[2], st = r[3], w = {}, wt = {}}
for wd in r[4]:gmatch("%S+") do L.w[#L.w + 1] = wd end
for x in r[5]:gmatch("%S+") do L.wt[#L.wt + 1] = tonumber(x) end
if #L.w >= 1 and #L.w <= 8 and #L.wt == #L.w then LY[#LY + 1] = L end
end
local conns, E = {}, {}
local S = {
began = os.clock(), wall0 = os.clock(), tEnd = K.DUR, flashLen = 0.5, skipped = false, tokens = 3, t = 0, kick = 0, hk = 0, zk = 0, rk = 0, shake = 0,
flashK = 0, glitch = 0, dir = 1, bi = 0, hi = 0, di = 0, lv = 0, vc = 0, scene = 0, st = 0, cut = -10, z = 1, r = 0, px = 0, py = 0, cx = 0, cy = 0,
sx = 800, sy = 450, stk = 0, stY = 0.5, fallback = false, ac = C(255, 170, 40), capPop = 0, capLast = "", gt = 0, fi = 1, ri = 1, li = 1, gf = 0,
}
local function accent()
if CFG.IntroColorMode == 2 then
return Util.ParseHex(CFG.IntroColor) or WHITE
elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 3 then
return WHITE
elseif CFG.IntroColorMode == 4 and Util.Color then
return Util.Color.Cur
end
return S.ac
end
local function mk(class, parent, props)
local o = Util.Instance(class, parent)
if props then
for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
end
return o
end
local stage = mk("Frame", MainFrame, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = BLACK, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 1000000, ClipsDescendants = true, Active = true})
conns[#conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if os.clock() - S.began < 0.4 then return end
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
local k = input.KeyCode
if k == Enum.KeyCode.Space or k == Enum.KeyCode.Return or k == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then S.skipped = true end
end
end)
local function fr(par, x, y, w, h, col, tr, z, rot, rad)
local f = mk("Frame", par, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(x, y), Size = UDim2.fromScale(w, h), BackgroundColor3 = col or WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = tr or 0, BorderSizePixel = 0, Rotation = rot or 0, ZIndex = z or 1, Interactable = false})
if rad then mk("UICorner", f, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(rad, 0)}) end
return f
end
local function setLn(f, x1, y1, x2, y2, th)
local dx, dy = x2 - x1, y2 - y1
f.Position = UDim2.fromScale((x1 + x2) / 2, (y1 + y2) / 2)
f.Size = UDim2.fromScale(math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) + th * 0.6, th)
f.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx))
end
local function ln(par, x1, y1, x2, y2, th, col, z, tr)
local f = fr(par, 0.5, 0.5, 0.1, th, col, tr, z, 0, 0.5)
setLn(f, x1, y1, x2, y2, th)
return f
end
local function grad(f, c1, c2, rot) return mk("UIGradient", f, {Color = ColorSequence.new(c1, c2), Rotation = rot or 90}) end
local function txt(z, font, col, ay, ypos)
return mk("TextLabel", stage, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, ay or 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, ypos or 0.5), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 120), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = font, TextColor3 = col or WHITE, TextSize = 40, Text = "", TextTransparency = 1, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false})
end
local function hud(y, z)
return mk("TextLabel", stage, {Position = UDim2.new(0, 16, 0, y), Size = UDim2.new(0.8, 0, 0, 18), BackgroundTransparency = 1, Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = WHITE, TextTransparency = 1, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false, Text = ""})
end
local function horse(par, z)
local R = mk("Frame", par, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false})
local H = {R = R, arm = {}, lens = {}, ch = {}}
for i, sg in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
H.arm[i] = {sg = sg, u = fr(R, 0.5, 0.5, 0.1, 0.1, SUIT, 0, z + 1, 0, 0.5), l = fr(R, 0.5, 0.5, 0.1, 0.1, SUIT2, 0, z + 1, 0, 0.5), h = fr(R, 0.5, 0.5, 0.13, 0.13, FUR, 0, z + 2, 0, 0.5)}
end
fr(R, 0.5, 0.97, 1.0, 0.56, SUIT, 0, z + 3, 0, 0.5)
fr(R, 0.24, 0.9, 0.34, 0.3, SUIT2, 0.45, z + 3, -20, 0.5)

fr(R, 0.645, 0.8, 0.13, 0.34, LAPEL, 0, z + 5, -16, 0.2)

local u = i / 8
H.ch[i + 1] = fr(R, 0.37 + 0.26 * u, 0.74 + 0.1 * math.sin(math.pi * u), 0.045, 0.028, GOLD, 0, z + 7, (u - 0.5) * 60, 0.5)
end

mk("UIStroke", H.med, {Thickness = 2, Color = C(150, 90, 10)})

H.Hd = Hd
local zz = z + 10
for _, sg in ipairs({-1, 1}) do

local function hz(H, x, y, sz, rot, flex, open, glint, nod)
H.R.Position, H.R.Size, H.R.Rotation = UDim2.fromScale(x, y), UDim2.fromScale(sz, sz), rot
H.Hd.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5 + nod * 0.015)
H.Hd.Rotation = nod * 2.5
H.jaw.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.63 + open * 0.05)
H.mouth.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.17, 0.02 + open * 0.07)
H.mouth.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.612 + open * 0.03)
H.teeth.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.min(1, open * 2.2)
local gx, gt = 0.15 + 0.7 * glint, 0.45 + 0.4 * math.abs(glint * 2 - 1)
for i = 1, 2 do
H.lens[i].Position = UDim2.fromScale(gx, 0.4)
H.lens[i].BackgroundTransparency = gt
end
H.med.BackgroundColor3 = GOLD:Lerp(WHITE, clamp01(S.kick * 0.7))
for _, a in ipairs(H.arm) do
local sg = a.sg
local ex, ey = 0.5 + sg * lerp(0.46, 0.6, flex), lerp(1.04, 0.86, flex)
local fx, fy = 0.5 + sg * lerp(0.44, 0.38, flex), lerp(1.2, 0.58, flex)
setLn(a.u, 0.5 + sg * 0.36, 0.9, ex, ey, 0.17)
setLn(a.l, ex, ey, fx, fy, 0.14)
a.h.Position = UDim2.fromScale(fx, fy)
end
end

local d = {R = R}

d.sL, d.sR = fr(R, 0.4, 0.95, 0.12, 0.05, C(30, 24, 34), 0, z + 1, 0, 0.5), fr(R, 0.6, 0.95, 0.12, 0.05, C(30, 24, 34), 0, z + 1, 0, 0.5)
d.tor = fr(R, 0.5, 0.42, 0.26, 0.32, shirt, 0, z + 2, 0, 0.3)
d.aL, d.aR = fr(R, 0.5, 0.5, 0.1, 0.1, shirt, 0, z + 1, 0, 0.5), fr(R, 0.5, 0.5, 0.1, 0.1, shirt, 0, z + 1, 0, 0.5)
local hc = isHorse and FURL or SKIN
d.hL, d.hR = fr(R, 0.3, 0.55, 0.07, 0.07, hc, 0, z + 3, 0, 0.5), fr(R, 0.7, 0.55, 0.07, 0.07, hc, 0, z + 3, 0, 0.5)
d.hd = mk("Frame", R, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.2), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 0.3), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z + 4, Interactable = false})
if isHorse then
fr(d.hd, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.95, FUR, 0, 1, 0, 0.45)
fr(d.hd, 0.5, 0.78, 0.42, 0.4, FURL, 0, 2, 0, 0.5)
fr(d.hd, 0.32, 0.06, 0.14, 0.3, FUR, 0, 1, -10, 0.5)
fr(d.hd, 0.68, 0.06, 0.14, 0.3, FUR, 0, 1, 10, 0.5)
fr(d.hd, 0.5, 0.2, 0.2, 0.3, MANE, 0, 2, 0, 0.5)
fr(d.hd, 0.5, 0.38, 0.62, 0.17, C(60, 36, 18), 0, 3, 0, 0.4)
else
fr(d.hd, 0.5, 0.5, 0.8, 0.8, hc, 0, 1, 0, 0.5)
fr(d.hd, 0.5, 0.18, 0.84, 0.3, C(30, 22, 20), 0, 2, 0, 0.5)
fr(d.hd, 0.5, 0.5, 0.74, 0.16, C(20, 16, 20), 0, 3, 0, 0.4)
end
return d
end
local function dz(d, x, y, sz, ph, kk)
d.R.Position, d.R.Size = UDim2.fromScale(x, y), UDim2.fromScale(sz, sz)
local s = 0.5 + 0.5 * math.sin(ph * math.pi)
local bx = 0.03 * math.sin(ph * math.pi * 0.5)
local hy = 0.55 - 0.012 * kk
local lxL, lxR = 0.38 + bx * 2 + 0.03 * (1 - s), 0.62 + bx * 2 - 0.03 * (1 - s)
setLn(d.lL, 0.46 + bx, hy, lxL, 0.94, 0.1)
setLn(d.lR, 0.54 + bx, hy, lxR, 0.94 - 0.03 * s, 0.1)
d.sL.Position, d.sR.Position = UDim2.fromScale(lxL - 0.02, 0.955), UDim2.fromScale(lxR + 0.02, 0.955 - 0.03 * s)
d.tor.Position, d.tor.Rotation = UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + bx, 0.42 - 0.012 * kk), (s - 0.5) * 12
d.hd.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5 + bx * 1.2, 0.2 - 0.02 * kk)
local hxR, hyR = 0.74 + 0.04 * s, lerp(0.56, 0.0, s)
local hxL, hyL = 0.26 - 0.04 * (1 - s), lerp(0.0, 0.56, s)
setLn(d.aR, 0.6 + bx, 0.31, hxR + bx, hyR, 0.065)
setLn(d.aL, 0.4 + bx, 0.31, hxL + bx, hyL, 0.065)
d.hR.Position, d.hL.Position = UDim2.fromScale(hxR + bx, hyR), UDim2.fromScale(hxL + bx, hyL)
end
local function wheel(par, z)
local W = {sp = {}, g = {}}
W.ring = fr(par, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, 0.5, BLACK, 1, z, 0, 0.5)
mk("UIStroke", W.ring, {Thickness = 4, Color = C(238, 232, 236)})
W.ring2 = fr(par, 0.5, 0.5, 0.4, 0.4, BLACK, 1, z, 0, 0.5)
mk("UIStroke", W.ring2, {Thickness = 2, Color = C(220, 214, 224), Transparency = 0.3})
local pal = {C(255, 70, 70), C(255, 210, 60), C(70, 190, 255), C(255, 255, 255)}
for i = 1, 12 do
W.sp[i] = fr(par, 0.5, 0.5, 0.1, 0.004, C(232, 226, 232), 0.1, z, 0, 0.5)
W.g[i] = fr(par, 0.5, 0.5, 0.03, 0.036, pal[i % 4 + 1], 0, z + 1, 0, 0.25)
end
W.hub = fr(par, 0.5, 0.5, 0.03, 0.03, C(250, 246, 250), 0, z + 2, 0, 0.5)
return W
end
local function wz(W, x, y, r, a)
W.ring.Position, W.ring.Size = UDim2.fromScale(x, y), UDim2.fromScale(2 * r, 2 * r)
W.ring2.Position, W.ring2.Size = UDim2.fromScale(x, y), UDim2.fromScale(1.7 * r, 1.7 * r)
W.hub.Position = UDim2.fromScale(x, y)
for i = 1, 12 do
local an = a + (i - 1) * math.pi / 6
local px, py = x + r * math.cos(an), y + r * math.sin(an)
setLn(W.sp[i], x, y, px, py, 0.004)
W.g[i].Position = UDim2.fromScale(px, py + 0.02)
end
end
local function spawnRing(r0, r1, life, col)
local q = E.rg[S.ri]
S.ri = S.ri % #E.rg + 1
q.on, q.t0, q.life, q.r0, q.r1 = true, S.t, life, r0, r1
q.st.Color = col
q.f.Visible = true
end
local function spawnSL()
local q = E.sl[S.li]
S.li = S.li % #E.sl + 1
q.on, q.t0, q.life, q.a = true, S.t, 0.22 + math.random() * 0.12, math.random() * math.pi * 2
q.f.Visible = true
end
local function spawnFlare(x, y, col, sz)
local q = E.fl[S.fi]
S.fi = S.fi % #E.fl + 1
q.on, q.t0, q.life, q.sz, q.x, q.y = true, S.t, 0.4, sz, x, y
q.h.BackgroundColor3, q.v.BackgroundColor3 = col, col
q.c.Visible = true
end
local function onKick(s)
local I = K.INT
S.kick = math.min(1, 0.45 + 0.2 * s)
S.zk = S.zk + 0.01 * s * I
S.shake = S.shake + (1 + 1.6 * s) * I
if s >= 3 then
S.rk = S.rk + 0.7 * S.dir * I
S.dir = -S.dir
if I > 0 then
spawnSL()
spawnSL()
end
end
end
local function onDrop(i)
local I, U = K.INT, math.min(S.sx, S.sy)
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, (i == 4 and 0.6 or 1) * I)
S.zk = S.zk + 0.26 * I
S.shake = S.shake + 16 * I
S.rk = S.rk + 5 * I * S.dir
S.dir = -S.dir
S.glitch = 0.4 * I
S.imp = S.t
spawnRing(U * 0.1, U * 1.5, 0.9, WHITE)
spawnRing(U * 0.1, U * 1.0, 0.7, i % 2 == 0 and CYAN or PINK)
for _ = 1, 6 do
if I > 0 then spawnSL() end
end
spawnFlare(S.sx * 0.5, S.sy * 0.45, WHITE, U * 0.9)
if S.tokens >= 1 then
S.tokens = S.tokens - 1
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 14, 0.16, 1.22)
end
end
local function onScene(id, t)
local prev = S.scene
for i, o in pairs(E.sc) do o.s.Visible = (i == id) end
S.scene, S.cut, S.st, S.stk = id, t, t, 0
if prev ~= 0 then
local I, U = K.INT, math.min(S.sx, S.sy)
S.flashK = math.max(S.flashK, 0.55 * I)
S.zk = S.zk + 0.14 * I
S.glitch = 0.3 * I
S.rk = S.rk + 4 * S.dir * I
S.dir = -S.dir
spawnRing(U * 0.2, U * 1.2, 0.7, id % 2 == 0 and PINK or CYAN)
if S.tokens >= 1 then
S.tokens = S.tokens - 1
pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 12, 0.16, 1.08)
end
end
end

local PCOL = {C(255, 236, 170), C(255, 100, 220), C(255, 255, 255), C(255, 200, 90), C(255, 214, 90), C(255, 255, 255)}
local function ptUpdate(t, dt, I)
local col, sc = PCOL[S.scene] or WHITE, S.scene
for _, p in ipairs(E.pt) do
p.y = p.y - p.v * dt * ((sc == 2 or sc == 6) and 1.6 or 1)
p.x = p.x + 0.02 * math.sin(t * 0.7 + p.ph) * dt
if p.y < -0.1 then
p.y = 1.1
p.x = -0.4 + math.random() * 1.8
end
local f = p.f
f.Visible = I > 0
f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(p.x - S.cx * p.d, p.y - S.cy * p.d)
local sz = p.s * (1 + S.kick * 0.7) * (0.6 + 0.4 * p.d)
f.Size = UDim2.fromScale(sz, sz)
f.BackgroundColor3 = col
f.BackgroundTransparency = clamp01(0.35 + 0.35 * math.sin(t * 2 + p.ph) - S.hk * 0.15)
end
end
