			a.trail = {}
			for j = 1, 5 do a.trail[j] = box(W, 33, a.tcol, 1) end
			a.nose = box(W, 36, a.tcol, 1)
			a.sh = box(W, 37, WHITE, 1, (a.role == "rl") and 0.5 or nil)
			a.shs = mk("UIStroke", a.sh, {Thickness = 1.4, Color = a.col, Transparency = 1})
			if a.role == "an" then
				a.sh2 = box(W, 37, WHITE, 1)
				a.sh2s = mk("UIStroke", a.sh2, {Thickness = 1.2, Color = ICE, Transparency = 1})
			end
			if a.role == "rl" then a.sat = box(W, 38, CYAN, 1, 0.5) end
			a.core = box(W, 38, a.ccol, 1, (a.role == "rl") and 0.5 or nil)
			a.tagl = lab(W, 39, 9, a.tcol, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
		end
		-- title: wire trace, metallic face, extrusion, chromatic ghosts
		E.tl = layer(W, 44)
		E.tl.Visible = false
		E.gt = {box(E.tl, 43, GOLD, 1, 0.5), box(E.tl, 43, ICE, 1, 0.5), box(E.tl, 43, CYAN, 1, 0.5)}
		E.tline = box(E.tl, 46, ICE, 1)
		mk("UIGradient", E.tline, {Rotation = 0, Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.2, 0.15), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.8, 0.15), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})})
		E.tdL, E.tdR = box(E.tl, 46, GOLD, 1), box(E.tl, 46, GOLD, 1)
		E.ana = box(E.tl, 47, WHITE, 1)
		mk("UIGradient", E.ana, {Rotation = 90, Transparency = soft(0)})
		E.ana2 = box(E.tl, 47, GOLD, 1)
		mk("UIGradient", E.ana2, {Rotation = 0, Transparency = soft(0)})
		for _, L in ipairs(LET) do
			L.slot = box(E.tl, 45, WHITE, 1)
			L.slst = mk("UIStroke", L.slot, {Thickness = 1, Color = ICE, Transparency = 1})
			L.sf = box(E.tl, 47, ICE, 1)
			L.clip = mk("Frame", E.tl, {BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ClipsDescendants = true, ZIndex = 44, Interactable = false})
			local function tl(dz, col)
				return mk("TextLabel", L.clip, {BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, Text = L.ch, TextColor3 = col, TextSize = 60, ZIndex = 44 + dz, Interactable = false,
					TextTransparency = 1, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center})
			end
			L.e2, L.e1, L.gc, L.gv, L.lab = tl(0, C(14, 20, 40)), tl(1, C(34, 46, 86)), tl(2, CYAN), tl(2, VIO), tl(3, WHITE)
			L.gr = mk("UIGradient", L.lab, {Rotation = 25, Color = ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, C(172, 196, 228)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.42, C(206, 228, 252)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, WHITE), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.58, C(206, 228, 252)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, C(150, 174, 208))})})
			L.str = mk("UIStroke", L.lab, {Thickness = 1.5, Color = CYAN, Transparency = 1})
		end
		-- shockwave pool
		E.rg = {}
		for i = 1, 8 do
			local f = box(W, 42, WHITE, 1, 0.5)
			local st = mk("UIStroke", f, {Thickness = 2, Color = ICE, Transparency = 1})
			E.rg[i] = {f = f, st = st, t0 = -9, life = 1, mr = 100, x = 0, y = 0}
		end
		-- impact blades and burst streaks
		E.bl = {box(W, 49, GOLD, 1), box(W, 49, GOLD, 1)}
		for _, b in ipairs(E.bl) do mk("UIGradient", b, {Rotation = 0, Transparency = soft(0)}) end
		E.bs = {}
		for i = 1, 28 do E.bs[i] = {f = box(W, 49, GOLD, 1), th = (i - 1) / 28 * TAU + hash(i, 1) * 0.12, v = 0.4 + hash(i, 2) * 0.6} end
		E.wp = box(W, 29, CYAN, 1)
		E.wpG = box(W, 29, CYAN, 1)
		mk("UIGradient", E.wpG, {Rotation = 90, Transparency = NumberSequence.new(1, 0)})
		-- stage overlays
		E.lbT = mk("Frame", stage, {BackgroundColor3 = BLACK, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 70, Interactable = false, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)})
		E.lbB = mk("Frame", stage, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 1), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 1), BackgroundColor3 = BLACK, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 70, Interactable = false, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)})
		E.vg = {}
		for i = 1, 4 do
			local f = mk("Frame", stage, {BackgroundColor3 = BLACK, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 60, Interactable = false})
			mk("UIGradient", f, {Rotation = ({0, 180, 90, 270})[i], Transparency = NumberSequence.new(0, 1)})
			if i <= 2 then
				f.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.3, 1)
				f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(i == 1 and 0 or 1, 0)
				f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(i == 1 and 0 or 1, 0)
			else
				f.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.3)
				f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, i == 3 and 0 or 1)
				f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, i == 3 and 0 or 1)
			end
			E.vg[i] = f
		end
		E.cap = lab(stage, 75, 12, ICE, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Enum.Font.GothamMedium)
		E.tc = lab(stage, 75, 11, STEEL, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
		E.term = lab(stage, 75, 13, ICE)
		E.term.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		E.term.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(400, 20)
		E.flash = mk("Frame", stage, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = mix(WHITE, GOLD, 0.2), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 80, Interactable = false})
		E.skip = mk("TextButton", stage, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0), Position = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 14), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(168, 30), BackgroundColor3 = BLACK, BackgroundTransparency = 0.35, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = WHITE, Text = "SKIP INTRO  >>  OPEN UI", ZIndex = 90, AutoButtonColor = true})
		mk("UIStroke", E.skip, {Thickness = 1, Color = WHITE, Transparency = 0.3})
		conns[#conns + 1] = E.skip.Activated:Connect(function() S.skipped = true end)
	end

	local function ring(x, y, col, life, mr, th)
		local best, bt = nil, 1e9
		for _, r in ipairs(E.rg) do
			if r.t0 < bt then best, bt = r, r.t0 end
		end
		if not best then return end
		best.t0, best.life, best.mr, best.x, best.y = S.t, life, mr, x, y
		best.st.Color = col
		best.st.Thickness = th or 2
	end
	local function burst(t, mag, col, x, y)
		S.bt, S.bmag, S.bcol, S.bx, S.by = t, mag, col, x or S.cx, y or S.cy
	end

	-- ---------- rect / text drawing ----------
	local function rectGeo(r)
		return PX(r.x + r.ox + r.jx), PY(r.y + r.oy + r.jy), r.w * G.W, r.h * G.H
	end
	local function perim(r, p)
		local x0, y0, w, h = rectGeo(r)
		p = c01(p)
		local sg = p * 4
		local i = min(floor(sg), 3)
		local f = sg - i
		if i == 0 then return x0 + w * f, y0 elseif i == 1 then return x0 + w, y0 + h * f elseif i == 2 then return x0 + w * (1 - f), y0 + h end
		return x0, y0 + h * (1 - f)
	end
	local function drawRect(r)
		local dim = S.wa
		local key = r.p * 1.1 + r.q * 3.3 + r.fp * 7.7 + r.sl * 5.9 + r.lk * 11.3 + r.gl * 13.1 + (r.ox + r.jx + r.tx) * 131 + (r.oy + r.jy + r.ty) * 173 + r.trot * 2.7 + r.tsc * 17.9 + G.stamp * 0.37 + dim * 5.1 + S.tint * 2.3 + r.hit * 9.7
		if key == r.key then return end
		r.key = key
		local x0, y0, w, h = rectGeo(r)
		local fp = r.fp
		if r.fo then
			if not r.f then
				r.f = box(E.world, r.z, CYAN, 1)
				r.f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
			end
			r.f.BackgroundColor3 = mix(r.col or CYAN, GOLD, S.tint * 0.5)
			if fp <= 0 then r.f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 return end
			if r.up then
				r.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x0, y0 + h * (1 - fp))
				r.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(max(w, 1), max(h * fp, 0.5))
			else
				r.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x0, y0)
				r.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(max(w * fp, 0.5), max(h, 1))
			end
			r.f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - cl(r.fa * dim + r.hit * 0.3, 0, 1)
			return
		end
		if not r.ct then
			local z = r.z
			r.ct = mk("Frame", E.world, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10)})
			r.us = mk("UIScale", r.ct, {Scale = 1})
			local function ch(dz, col, par)
				return mk("Frame", par or r.ct, {BackgroundColor3 = col, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z + dz, Interactable = false})
			end
			r.sh = ch(0, BLACK)
			r.f0 = ch(0, C(110, 170, 230))
			r.f = ch(1, PANEL)
			mk("UIGradient", r.f, {Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence.new(WHITE, C(142, 158, 190))})
			r.scn = ch(2, ICE)
			r.hl = ch(2, ICE)
			r.gc = ch(2, WHITE)
			r.gc.ClipsDescendants = true
			r.glb = ch(3, WHITE, r.gc)
			r.glb.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			mk("UIGradient", r.glb, {Transparency = soft(0)})
			r.e = {}
			for i = 1, 4 do r.e[i] = ch(3, STEEL) end
			r.cb = {}
			if not r.nb then
				for i = 1, 4 do
					r.cb[i] = ch(3, CYAN)
					r.cb[i].AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
				end
			end
		end
		r.ct.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x0 + w / 2 + r.tx * G.W, y0 + h / 2 + r.ty * G.H)
		r.ct.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(max(w, 1), max(h, 1))
		r.ct.Rotation = r.trot
		r.us.Scale = max(r.tsc, 0.05)
		local solid = c01(max(r.sl, fp * 4))
		r.sh.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(4, 6)
		r.sh.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
		r.sh.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - solid * 0.4 * dim
		r.f0.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
		r.f0.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - cl(r.sl * (1 - fp) * 0.2 + r.hit * 0.16, 0, 1) * dim
		if fp > 0 then
			r.f.BackgroundColor3 = mix(mix(C(12, 18, 32), C(58, 82, 118), r.fa * 1.6), GOLD, S.tint * 0.18 + r.hit * 0.1)
			r.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1)
			r.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(max(w - 2, 1), max((h - 2) * fp, 0.5))
			r.f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - cl((0.3 + r.fa) * dim + r.hit * 0.22, 0, 1)
			r.hl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(1, 1)
			r.hl.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(max(w - 2, 1), 1)
			r.hl.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - 0.45 * dim
		else
			r.f.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			r.hl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		end
		if fp > 0 and fp < 1 then
			r.scn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(1, (h - 2) * fp)
			r.scn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(max(w - 2, 1), 2)
			r.scn.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - 0.75 * dim
		else
			r.scn.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		end
		r.gc.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0)
		r.gc.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h)
		if r.gl >= 0 then
			r.glb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(max(w * 0.16, 6), h * 2.6)
			r.glb.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(lerp(-w * 0.2, w * 1.2, r.gl), h / 2)
			r.glb.Rotation = 18
			r.glb.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - sin(pi * c01(r.gl)) * 0.7 * dim
		else
			r.glb.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		end
		for i = 1, 4 do
			local e = r.e[i]
			local ep = c01(r.p * 4 - (i - 1))
			local bi = c01(r.q * 4 - (i - 1))
			if ep <= 0 then
				e.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			else
				local th = (bi > 0.5) and 2 or 1
				e.BackgroundColor3 = mix(mix(C(70, 150, 200), ICE, bi), GOLD, S.tint * 0.75 + r.hit * 0.45)
				e.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - cl((0.5 + 0.5 * bi + r.hit * 0.4) * dim, 0, 1)
				if i == 1 then
					e.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0) e.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(max(w * ep, 1), th)
				elseif i == 2 then
					e.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(w - th, 0) e.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(th, max(h * ep, 1))
				elseif i == 3 then
					e.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(w * (1 - ep), h - th) e.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(max(w * ep, 1), th)
				else
					e.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, h * (1 - ep)) e.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(th, max(h * ep, 1))
				end
			end
		end
		if not r.nb then
			local bsz = lerp(3, 7, min(r.lk, 1.3))
			local ba = c01(r.p * 0.7 + r.lk)
			local pts = {{0, 0}, {w, 0}, {w, h}, {0, h}}
			for i = 1, 4 do
				local b = r.cb[i]
				b.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(pts[i][1], pts[i][2])
				b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(bsz, bsz)
				b.Rotation = 45 * c01(r.lk)
				b.BackgroundColor3 = mix(CYAN, GOLD, c01(r.lk))
				b.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - ba * dim * (r.p > 0 and 1 or 0)
			end
		end
	end
	local function drawText(o, t)
		if o.tp <= 0 then
			if o.l then o.l.TextTransparency = 1 o.c.BackgroundTransparency = 1 end
			return
		end
		if not o.l then
			o.l = lab(E.world, 30, 12, o.col, o.abs and Enum.TextXAlignment.Center or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, o.font)
			if not o.abs then o.l.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5) end
			o.l.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10)
			o.l.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.X
			o.c = box(E.world, 30, GOLD, 1)
		end
		local n = floor(o.tp * #o.text + 0.0001)
		local typing = n < #o.text and o.act
		if n ~= o.n then
			if n > o.n and n % 3 == 0 then sfx("key", 0.045, 1.55 + ((n * 7) % 5) * 0.06) end
			o.n = n
			o.cu = t
		end
		o.l.Text = o.text:sub(1, n) .. (typing and GLY[(floor(t * 40) + n) % #GLY + 1] or "")
		local sz = o.abs and max(9, floor(o.asz or 12)) or max(8, floor(G.W * o.sz))
		o.l.TextSize = sz
		local px, py
		if o.abs then px, py = o.ax, o.ay else px, py = PX(o.x), PY(o.y) end
		o.l.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(px, py)
		o.px, o.py, o.psz = px, py, sz
		o.l.TextTransparency = 1 - min(1, S.wa + (o.abs and 1 or 0))
		local on = (o.act or t - o.cu < 0.9) and floor(t * 2.4) % 2 == 0
		if on then
			local bx = o.l.TextBounds.X
			local cxp = o.abs and (px + bx / 2 + 3) or (px + bx + 2)
			place(o.c, cxp, py, 2, sz * 1.1)
			o.c.BackgroundTransparency = 0.1
		else
			o.c.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		end
	end

	-- ---------- task engine ----------
	local function setHit(r) if r then r.hit = 1 end end
	local function impact(r, t, mag)
		r.hit = 1
		r.gl = 0
		r.lockT = t
		local A = ARR[r.id]
		local dx, dy = A and A[1] or 0, A and A[2] or 0
		local l = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
		if l < 0.001 then l = 1 end
		r.jdx, r.jdy = -dx / l * mag * 0.016, -dy / l * mag * 0.016
		local x0, y0, w, h = rectGeo(r)
		ring(x0 + w / 2, y0 + h / 2, ICE, 0.9, max(w, h) * 0.6, 2)
		S.shake = max(S.shake, 0.12 + 0.5 * min(1, (w * h) / (G.W * G.H)) * mag)
		sfx("snap", 0.07, 1.0)
		sfx("glass", 0.04, 1.7)
	end
	local function applyTask(k, t)
		local u = c01((t - k.t0) / max(k.t1 - k.t0, 0.001))
		local kd, id = k.kind, k.id
		if kd == "bp" then
			RC[id].p = eio(u)
		elseif kd == "tr" then
			local r = RC[id]
			r.p = 1
			r.q = eio(u)
		elseif kd == "box" then
			local r = RC[id]
			r.p = eio(u) r.q = r.p
		elseif kd == "fill" then
			local r = RC[id]
			r.p = max(r.p, 1) r.q = max(r.q, 1) r.sl = 1
			r.fp = eo3(u)
		elseif kd == "arr" then
			local r, A = RC[id], ARR[id]
			local s = 1 - u ^ 2.3
			local arc = sin(pi * u) * 0.08
			r.p = max(r.p, 1)
			r.sl = c01(u * 3.2)
			r.tx = A[1] * s - A[2] * arc
			r.ty = A[2] * s + A[1] * arc
			r.trot = A[3] * s
			r.tsc = 1 + (A[4] - 1) * s
		elseif kd == "type" then
			local o = TX[id]
			if k.t1 - k.t0 <= 0.01 then o.tp = 1 o.act = false k.done = true return end
			o.tp = c01(u * 1.04)
			o.act = u < 1
		elseif kd == "guide" then
			GD[id].prog = eo3(u)
		elseif kd == "ruler" then
			RU[id].prog = eio(u)
		elseif kd == "dim" then
			DM[id].prog = eio(u)
		elseif kd == "link" then
			LKS[id].prog = eio(u)
		elseif kd == "bar" then
			local r = RC[id]
			r.p = 1
			r.fp = eo3(u)
		elseif kd == "tog" then
			local kn = RC["kn" .. id]
			kn.fp = 1
			kn.ox = 0.075 * eob(u)
		elseif kd == "lock" then
			local r = RC[id]
			if u >= 0.5 and not k.fired then
				k.fired = true
				r.lkT = t
				r.hit = 1
				local x0, y0, w, h = rectGeo(r)
				ring(x0 + w / 2, y0 + h / 2, GOLD, 0.8, max(w, h) * 0.35, 2)
				sfx("snap", 0.05, 1.5)
			end
		elseif kd == "snap" then
			local r = RC[id]
			if u >= 0.5 and not k.fired then
				k.fired = true
				impact(r, t, 0.55)
				r.lkT = r.lkT or t
			end
		end
		if u >= 1 and not k.done then
			k.done = true
			if kd == "arr" then
				local r = RC[id]
				r.tx, r.ty, r.trot, r.tsc, r.sl = 0, 0, 0, 1, 1
				impact(r, t, 1)
			elseif kd == "bp" or kd == "tr" or kd == "box" or kd == "guide" or kd == "link" then
				setHit(RC[id])
				if kd == "guide" then GD[id].hit = 1 end
				sfx("snap", 0.06, 1.0)
			elseif kd == "fill" then
				sfx("snap", 0.04, 1.8)
			end
			if kd == "type" then
				local o = TX[id]
				if o then o.tp = 1 o.act = false end
			end
		end
	end
	local CORN = {{0, 0}, {1, 0}, {1, 1}, {0, 1}}
	local function penPos(k, t)
		local u = c01((t - k.t0) / max(k.t1 - k.t0, 0.001))
		local kd, id = k.kind, k.id
		if kd == "bp" or kd == "box" then
			local x, y = perim(RC[id], eio(u))
			return x, y, string.format("%d x %d", floor(RC[id].w * G.W * eio(u)), floor(RC[id].h * G.H * eio(u)))
		elseif kd == "tr" then
			local x, y = perim(RC[id], eio(u))
			return x, y, "energize"
		elseif kd == "fill" then
			local r = RC[id]
			local x0, y0, w, h = rectGeo(r)
			local z = abs(2 * ((eo3(u) * 3) % 1) - 1)
			return x0 + w * z, y0 + h * eo3(u), "fill"
		elseif kd == "arr" then
			local r = RC[id]
			local x0, y0, w, h = rectGeo(r)
			return x0 + w * 0.5 + r.tx * G.W, y0 + r.ty * G.H + 6, "carry " .. id
		elseif kd == "type" then
			local o = TX[id]
			if o.px then return o.px + (o.l and o.l.TextBounds.X or 0) + (o.abs and o.l.TextBounds.X * -0.5 or 0) + 8, o.py + (o.psz or 10) * 0.9, "typing" end
			return PX(o.x), PY(o.y), "typing"
		elseif kd == "lock" or kd == "snap" then
			local r = RC[id]
			local x0, y0, w, h = rectGeo(r)
			local c = CORN[(#id + id:byte(1)) % 4 + 1]
			return x0 + w * c[1], y0 + h * c[2], (kd == "lock") and "lock" or "stabilize"
		elseif kd == "guide" then
			local g = GD[id]
			local p = eo3(u)
			if g.o == "v" then return PX(g.f), S.sy * p, string.format("x:%d", floor(g.f * G.W)) end
			return S.sx * p, PY(g.f), string.format("y:%d", floor(g.f * G.H))
		elseif kd == "ruler" then
			local p = eio(u)
			if id == "h" then return G.rx + G.W * p, G.ry - 12, "ruler" end
			return G.rx - 12, G.ry + G.H * p, "ruler"
		elseif kd == "dim" then
			local x0, y0, x1, y1 = dimGeo(id)
			local p = eio(u)
			return lerp(x0, x1, p), lerp(y0, y1, p), "measure"
		elseif kd == "link" then
			local l = LKS[id]
			local a, b = RC[l[1]], RC[l[2]]
			local p = eio(u)
			return lerp(PX(a.x + a.w / 2), PX(b.x + b.w / 2), p), lerp(PY(a.y + a.h / 2), PY(b.y + b.h / 2), p), "link"
		elseif kd == "bar" then
			local r = RC[id]
			local x0, y0, w, h = rectGeo(r)
			return x0 + w / 2, y0 + h * (1 - eo3(u)), "bar"
		elseif kd == "tog" then
			local x0, y0, w, h = rectGeo(RC["kn" .. id])
			return x0 + w / 2, y0 + h / 2, "toggle"
		end
		return S.cx, S.cy, ""
	end

	-- ---------- swarm formations and targets ----------
	local function titleGeo()
		local nC = #NAME
		local Ls = min(100, S.sx * 0.9 / (nC * 0.72), S.sy * 0.22)
		local adv = Ls * 0.72
		return Ls, adv, S.sx / 2 - nC * adv / 2, S.sy * 0.45
	end
	local function ringR(t)
		local U = S.U
		if t < 104 then return U * (0.28 + 0.16 * ss(95, 104, t)) end
		if t < 112.6 then return U * (0.44 - 0.3 * ss(104, 112.6, t)) end
		return U * (0.14 + 0.38 * ss(113, 114.6, t))
	end
	local RR = {sc = {0.47, 0.43}, rl = {0.4, 0.36}, bd = {0.31, 0.28}}
	local ANC = {{0, 0, -1, -1}, {1, 0, 1, -1}, {1, 1, 1, 1}, {0, 1, -1, 1}, {0.5, 0, 0, -1}}
	local function formBase(i, a, t)
		local sx, sy, U = S.sx, S.sy, S.U
		local cx, cy = S.cx, S.cy
		if a.role == "an" then
			local c = ANC[a.ri]
			return PX(c[1]) + c[3] * 20 + sin(t * 0.9 + a.ph) * 3, PY(c[2]) + c[4] * 20 + cos(t * 0.7 + a.ph) * 3
		end
		if a.role == "sc" and t < 27 then
			local A = U * (0.2 + 0.05 * (a.ri % 4)) * (0.6 + 0.4 * ss(a.spawn, a.spawn + 8, t))
			local lx = cx + A * 1.5 * sin(0.17 * (1 + a.ri % 3) * t + a.ph)
			local ly = cy + A * sin(0.17 * (2 + a.ri % 2) * t + a.ph * 1.7)
			local w1 = ss(21.5, 25.5, t)
			local R0 = U * (0.26 - 0.05 * ss(23, 26, t))
			local th = a.ri / 8 * TAU + t * 1.3
			local x, y = lerp(lx, cx + cos(th) * R0 * 1.4, w1), lerp(ly, cy + sin(th) * R0, w1)
			local w2 = ss(25.9, 26.9, t)
			return lerp(x, cx + cos(th) * U * 0.02, w2), lerp(y, cy + sin(th) * U * 0.02, w2)
		end
		local fr = RR[a.role]
		local th = a.ri / a.rn * TAU + a.a0 * 0.2 + t * ROT[a.role]
		return cx + cos(th) * sx * fr[1], cy + sin(th) * sy * fr[2]
	end
	local function formation(i, a, t)
		local x, y = formBase(i, a, t)
		local sx, sy = S.sx, S.sy
		local wH = ss(70, 72.5, t) * (1 - ss(78.5, 80.5, t))
		if wH > 0.001 then
			local s = (i - 1) / (NA - 1)
			x, y = lerp(x, sx * (0.07 + 0.86 * s), wH), lerp(y, S.cy + sy * 0.27 * sin(s * TAU * 1.5 + t * 1.1 + (i % 2) * pi), wH)
		end
		local wS = ss(84.5, 86.5, t) * (1 - ss(94, 96, t))
		if wS > 0.001 then
			local yy = sy * (0.12 + 0.76 * ((i - 1) / (NA - 1)))
			local xx = sx * (0.5 + 0.44 * sin(t * 0.8 + ((i % 2 == 0) and 0 or pi) + i * 0.28))
			x, y = lerp(x, xx, wS), lerp(y, yy, wS)
		end
		local wR = ss(94, 96.5, t) * (1 - ss(115, 116.4, t))
		if wR > 0.001 then
			local R0 = ringR(t)
			local mul = (a.role == "bd" and 0.72) or (a.role == "rl" and 0.9) or (a.role == "an" and 0.55) or 1.12
			local th = a.ri / a.rn * TAU + (t - 95) * 0.7 * ((a.role == "bd" or a.role == "an") and -1 or 1) + (a.role == "rl" and 0.4 or 0)
			x, y = lerp(x, sx / 2 + cos(th) * R0 * mul * 1.7, wR), lerp(y, sy * 0.45 + sin(th) * R0 * mul * 0.62, wR)
		end
		return x, y
	end
	local function agentTarget(i, a, t)
		if t >= 115.2 then
			local Ls, _, _, ty = titleGeo()
			local sp = min(S.sx * 0.04, S.sx * 0.8 / NA)
			local k = ss(115.2, 117, t)
			local ix, iy = formation(i, a, 115.2)
			return lerp(ix, S.sx / 2 + (i - (NA + 1) / 2) * sp, k), lerp(iy, ty + Ls * 1.0, k), 24, "", nil
		end
		for _, L in ipairs(LET) do
			if L.a == i and t >= L.tA - 0.8 and t < L.tA + 1.15 then
				local Ls, adv, tx0, ty = titleGeo()
				local cellH = Ls * 1.12
				local lx = tx0 + (L.cell - 0.5) * adv
				if t < L.tA then return lx - adv * 0.5, ty - cellH * 0.5, 42, "slot", nil end
				local u = (t - L.tA) / 1.15
				local f = eo3(c01(u / 0.6))
				local z = abs(2 * ((u * 4) % 1) - 1)
				return lx - adv * 0.45 + adv * 0.9 * z, ty - cellH * 0.5 + cellH * f, 120, "trace " .. L.ch, L.task
			end
		end
		for _, k in ipairs(AT[i]) do
			if t >= k.t0 - 0.35 and t < k.t1 + 0.1 and k.t1 - k.t0 > 0.01 then
				local x, y, tg = penPos(k, max(t, k.t0))
				return x, y, (t >= k.t0) and 95 or 22, tg, k
			end
		end
		local x, y = formation(i, a, t)
		return x, y, ((a.role == "an") and 4 or 7) * a.stiff, "", nil
	end
	local CAPS = {{0, "I  /  ZERO STATE"}, {12, "II  /  THE AWAKENING"}, {27, "III  /  THE BLUEPRINT"}, {45, "IV  /  RECONSTRUCTION"}, {65, "V  /  SWARM MULTIPLICATION"}, {85, "VI  /  NETWORK ASCENSION"}, {105, "VII  /  THE FINAL CONVERGENCE"}, {115, "VIII  /  THE FINAL LOCK"}}

	local function updAgents(t, dt)
		local cnt = {sc = 0, bd = 0, an = 0, rl = 0}
		local us0 = cl(S.U / 450, 0.7, 1.3)
		for i = 1, NA do
			local a = AG[i]
			if t >= a.spawn then
				cnt[a.role] = cnt[a.role] + 1
				if not a.init then
					a.init = true
					local R0 = max(S.sx, S.sy) * 0.62
					if a.mode == "fis" then
						local p = AG[a.par]
						a.x, a.y = p.x, p.y
						a.vx, a.vy = cos(a.a0) * S.U * 0.9, sin(a.a0) * S.U * 0.9
						ring(a.x, a.y, a.tcol, 0.8, S.U * 0.12, 2)
						S.sk = max(S.sk, 0.5)
					elseif a.mode == "beacon" then
						a.x, a.y = S.cx, S.cy
						a.vx, a.vy = cos(a.a0) * S.U * 1.1, sin(a.a0) * S.U * 1.1
						ring(S.cx, S.cy, CYAN, 1, S.U * 0.2, 2)
					else
						a.x, a.y = S.cx + cos(a.a0) * R0, S.cy + sin(a.a0) * R0
					end
					for j = 0, 5 do a.hist[j][1], a.hist[j][2] = a.x, a.y end
					sfx("glass", 0.05, 2.2)
				end
				local tx, ty, k, tg, task = agentTarget(i, a, t)
				if a.role == "sc" and t < 27 then
					k = 3.4 + 1.6 * ss(a.spawn, a.spawn + 6, t) * a.stiff
					if t > 25.9 then k = 14 end
				end
				a.task = task
				local wk = (task and t >= task.t0 and t < task.t1) and 1 or 0
				a.work = lerp(a.work, wk, 1 - exp(-8 * dt))
				tx = tx + sin(t * 9 + i) * a.work * 1.2
				ty = ty + cos(t * 7.3 + i * 2) * a.work * 1.2
				local z = a.zeta
				if k > 60 then z = 0.95 end
				local c = 2 * z * sqrt(k)
				local steps = max(1, floor(dt / 0.012))
				local h = dt / steps
				for _ = 1, steps do
					local ax, ay = k * (tx - a.x) - c * a.vx, k * (ty - a.y) - c * a.vy
					a.vx, a.vy = a.vx + ax * h, a.vy + ay * h
					local sp = sqrt(a.vx * a.vx + a.vy * a.vy)
					local lim = S.U * 3.2
					if sp > lim then a.vx, a.vy = a.vx / sp * lim, a.vy / sp * lim end
					a.x, a.y = a.x + a.vx * h, a.y + a.vy * h
				end
				local sp = sqrt(a.vx * a.vx + a.vy * a.vy)
				if sp > 25 then
					local want = atan2(a.vx, -a.vy) * DEG
					local d = (want - a.hd + 540) % 360 - 180
					a.hd = a.hd + d * (1 - exp(-12 * dt))
				end
				a.vis = ss(a.spawn, a.spawn + 0.7, t)
				a.hacc = a.hacc + dt
				if a.hacc >= 0.03 * (1 + 1.6 * ss(84, 100, t)) then
					a.hacc = 0
					for j = 5, 1, -1 do a.hist[j][1], a.hist[j][2] = a.hist[j - 1][1], a.hist[j - 1][2] end
					a.hist[0][1], a.hist[0][2] = a.x, a.y
				end
				local us, gl, wkn = us0 * a.sc, a.vis, a.work
				local spd = c01(sp / (S.U * 0.6))
				local hr = a.hd / DEG
				local dx, dy = sin(hr), -cos(hr)
				local gs = (20 + 18 * S.en + 10 * wkn + 12 * S.lv) * us
				place(a.g1, a.x, a.y, gs * 2.2, gs * 2.2, 0, 1 - gl * (0.05 + 0.05 * S.en + 0.05 * wkn))
				place(a.g2, a.x, a.y, gs, gs, 0, 1 - gl * (0.09 + 0.12 * S.en + 0.12 * wkn))
				local ro = a.role
				if ro == "sc" then
					place(a.sh, a.x, a.y, 10 * us, 10 * us, a.hd + 45, 1)
					a.shs.Transparency = 1 - gl * 0.95
					place(a.core, a.x, a.y, 3.6 * us, 3.6 * us, a.hd + 45, 1 - gl)
					local nl = (9 + 12 * (0.4 + 0.6 * spd) + 10 * wkn) * us
					seg(a.nose, a.x + dx * 7 * us, a.y + dy * 7 * us, a.x + dx * (7 * us + nl), a.y + dy * (7 * us + nl), 1.2, 1 - gl * (0.25 + 0.55 * spd + 0.2 * wkn))
				elseif ro == "bd" then
					place(a.sh, a.x, a.y, 15 * us, 8 * us, a.hd + 90, 1)
					a.shs.Transparency = 1 - gl * 0.95
					place(a.core, a.x, a.y, 4.4 * us, 4.4 * us, a.hd + 90, 1 - gl)
					local nl = (6 + 16 * spd + 8 * wkn) * us
					seg(a.nose, a.x - dx * 8 * us, a.y - dy * 8 * us, a.x - dx * (8 * us + nl), a.y - dy * (8 * us + nl), 2, 1 - gl * (0.15 + 0.7 * spd + 0.4 * wkn))
				elseif ro == "an" then
					local rr = t * 38 * a.dir
					place(a.sh, a.x, a.y, 14 * us, 14 * us, rr, 1)
					place(a.sh2, a.x, a.y, 14 * us, 14 * us, rr + 45, 1)
					a.shs.Transparency = 1 - gl * 0.9
					a.sh2s.Transparency = 1 - gl * 0.7
					place(a.core, a.x, a.y, 5 * us, 5 * us, 0, 1 - gl)
				else
					place(a.sh, a.x, a.y, 13 * us, 13 * us, 0, 1)
					a.shs.Transparency = 1 - gl * 0.9
					local so = t * 3.2 + a.ph
					place(a.sat, a.x + cos(so) * 11 * us, a.y + sin(so) * 11 * us, 3.6 * us, 3.6 * us, 0, 1 - gl * (0.5 + 0.5 * wkn))
					place(a.core, a.x, a.y, 4.6 * us, 4.6 * us, 0, 1 - gl)
				end
				local want = (tg ~= nil and tg ~= "") and (CODE[ro] .. string.format("%02d", a.ri) .. " " .. tg) or ""
				if want ~= a.tagS then a.tagS = want a.tagl.Text = want end
				a.tagl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(a.x + 16, a.y + 12)
				a.tagl.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 12)
				a.tagl.TextTransparency = 1 - gl * wkn * 0.75
				local tl = (0.25 + 0.5 * S.en) * (0.25 + 0.75 * spd)
				local px0, py0 = a.x, a.y
				for j = 1, 5 do
					local hp = a.hist[j]
					local fall = (1 - (j - 1) / 5) ^ 1.5
					seg(a.trail[j], px0, py0, hp[1], hp[2], (2.4 * fall + 0.6) * us, 1 - gl * tl * fall)
					px0, py0 = hp[1], hp[2]
				end
				if ro == "sc" and a.ri <= 4 then
					local c4 = E.ch[a.ri]
					local on = (task and wkn > 0.05 and (task.kind == "bp" or task.kind == "tr" or task.kind == "guide" or task.kind == "dim")) and 1 or 0
					a.cha = lerp(a.cha, on, 1 - exp(-6 * dt))
					local al = 1 - a.cha * 0.5
					place(c4.h, S.sx / 2, a.y, S.sx, 1, 0, al)
					place(c4.v, a.x, S.sy / 2, 1, S.sy, 0, al)
				end
			end
		end
		return cnt
	end

	-- ---------- scene systems ----------
	local function updScene(t, dt)
		local sx, sy, U = S.sx, S.sy, S.U
		local cx, cy = S.cx, S.cy
		local pxo, pyo = S.px, S.py
		local sk = max(S.sk, 0.1 * ss(60, 100, t))
		-- atmosphere
		E.hz1.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - (0.05 + 0.07 * ss(10, 40, t) + 0.07 * S.en) * 0.9
		E.hz2.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - (0.03 + 0.1 * ss(85, 105, t)) * 0.9
		-- perspective deck
		S.fph = (S.fph + dt * (0.05 + 0.22 * S.en + 0.25 * sk)) % 1
		local fa = ss(10, 22, t) * (1 - ss(112, 117, t) * 0.7)
		local hx, hy = cx + pxo * -0.2, cy + pyo * -0.2
		for n = 1, 7 do
			local z = (S.fph + (n - 1) / 7) % 1
			local zz = z ^ 2.2
			local al = 1 - fa * z * 0.14 * (0.6 + 0.4 * S.en)
			place(E.fh[n], hx, hy + (sy - hy) * zz, sx * 1.3, 1, 0, al)
			place(E.fh[n + 7], hx, hy - hy * zz, sx * 1.3, 1, 0, al)
		end
		for k = 1, 9 do
			local xk = cx + (k - 5) * sx * 0.16 + pxo * -0.2
			seg(E.fr[k], hx, hy, xk, sy * 1.05, 1, 1 - fa * 0.07)
			seg(E.fr[k + 9], hx, hy, xk, -sy * 0.05, 1, 1 - fa * 0.07)
		end
		-- far dust
		local da = ss(1, 8, t)
		for _, d in ipairs(E.dust) do
			d.y = (d.y - d.v * dt * (1 + S.en)) % 1
			local tw = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(t * 1.3 + d.ph)
			place(d.f, (d.x * sx + pxo * (d.k - 1)) % sx, (d.y * sy + pyo * (d.k - 1)) % sy, d.s, d.s, 0, 1 - da * tw * (0.25 + 0.3 * S.en))
		end
		-- near motes that stretch into streaks under motion
		for _, d in ipairs(E.nd) do
			d.d = d.d + dt * (0.012 * d.v + 0.5 * sk * d.v)
			if d.d > 1 then d.d = d.d - 0.97 end
			local r0 = d.d * U * 0.95
			local x, y = cx + cos(d.th) * r0 + pxo * 0.6, cy + sin(d.th) * r0 + pyo * 0.6
			local len = 2 + sk * U * 0.07 * d.d
			seg(d.f, x - cos(d.th) * len, y - sin(d.th) * len, x, y, 1 + d.d, 1 - da * (0.08 + 0.5 * sk) * c01(d.d * 3) * (1 - d.d * 0.4))
		end
		-- dormant fragments, later gathered into the blueprint
		local wC = ss(31, 44, t)
		local fOut = 1 - ss(40, 46, t)
		for i, f in ipairs(E.fg) do
			local on = ss(f.on, f.on + 3, t) * fOut
			if on > 0.002 or f.vis then
				f.vis = on > 0.002
				local bx = sx * f.hx + sin(t * 0.12 + i) * U * 0.02 + pxo * (f.k - 1)
				local by = sy * f.hy + cos(t * 0.1 + i * 1.3) * U * 0.02 + pyo * (f.k - 1)
				local rt = RC[f.tg]
				local x, y = lerp(bx, PX(rt.x + rt.w / 2), wC), lerp(by, PY(rt.y + rt.h / 2), wC)
				local sc = 1 - 0.7 * wC
				local w, h = f.w * U * f.k * sc, f.h * U * f.k * sc
				local rot = f.rot + f.spin * t
				local fl = 0.6 + 0.4 * sin(t * 3 + i * 5)
				place(f.o, x, y, w, h, rot, 1)
				f.st.Transparency = 1 - on * (0.2 + 0.25 * S.en) * fl
				seg(f.d, x - w * 0.3, y + h * 0.7, x + w * 0.3, y + h * 0.7, 1, 1 - on * 0.3 * fl)
			end
		end
		-- signal traces
		local trA = (1 - ss(32, 40, t))
		for i, tr in ipairs(E.tr) do
			local on = ss(2 + i * 1.1, 5 + i * 1.1, t) * trA
			if on > 0.002 or tr.vis then
				tr.vis = on > 0.002
				local h1, h2, h3, h4 = hash(i + 20, 1), hash(i + 20, 2), hash(i + 20, 3), hash(i + 20, 4)
				local sd = tr.side
				local p0x, p0y = (sd > 0) and sx or 0, sy * (0.14 + 0.72 * h1)
				local p1x, p1y = cx + sd * U * (0.55 + 0.25 * h2), p0y
				local p2x, p2y = p1x, cy + (h3 - 0.5) * U * 0.5
				local p3x, p3y = cx + sd * U * (0.1 + 0.07 * h4), p2y
				local en = 0.12 + 0.12 * ss(12, 20, t) + 0.1 * S.lv
				seg(tr.s[1], p0x, p0y, p1x, p1y, 1, 1 - on * en)
				seg(tr.s[2], p1x, p1y, p2x, p2y, 1, 1 - on * en)
				seg(tr.s[3], p2x, p2y, p3x, p3y, 1, 1 - on * en)
				local l1, l2, l3 = abs(p1x - p0x), abs(p2y - p1y), abs(p3x - p2x)
				local L = l1 + l2 + l3
				local d = ((t * tr.sp * (1 + 2 * ss(12, 20, t)) + i * 0.37) % 1) * L
				local px, py
				if d < l1 then px, py = lerp(p0x, p1x, d / l1), p0y
				elseif d < l1 + l2 then px, py = p1x, lerp(p1y, p2y, (d - l1) / l2)
				else px, py = lerp(p2x, p3x, (d - l1 - l2) / l3), p2y end
				place(tr.p, px, py, 3, 3, 0, 1 - on * (0.4 + 0.4 * S.lv))
				place(tr.n, p3x, p3y, 5, 5, 45, 1 - on * en * 2)
			end
		end
		-- the presence / beacon
		local ig = ss(12, 13.4, t)
		local d0 = ss(1.2, 8, t) * (0.22 + 0.08 * sin(t * 1.7))
		local bz = (d0 * (1 - ig) + ig * (0.85 + 0.15 * S.lv)) * (1 - ss(104, 108, t))
		local pulse = 1 + 0.5 * S.kick + 0.05 * sin(t * 1.6)
		for i = 1, 3 do
			local sz = U * (0.05 + 0.035 * i) * pulse * lerp(0.82, 1, ig)
			place(E.sg.sq[i], cx, cy, sz, sz, t * (6 + 5 * i) * ((i % 2 == 0) and -1 or 1) + i * 20 + 40 * S.kick, 1)
			E.sg.st[i].Transparency = 1 - bz * (0.3 + 0.15 * i)
		end
		local ov = ss(13, 18, t) * (1 - ss(22, 26, t)) + 0.35 * d0
		for i = 1, 4 do
			local r = U * (0.1 + 0.05 * (i - 1))
			place(E.sg.orb[i].f, cx, cy, r * 2, r * 2, 0, 1)
			E.sg.orb[i].st.Transparency = 1 - bz * ov * 0.5
		end
		for i = 1, 16 do
			local th = (i - 1) / 16 * TAU + t * 0.3 * ((i % 2 == 0) and 1 or -1)
			local r0 = U * 0.075 * pulse
			local r1 = r0 + U * (0.012 + 0.02 * (i % 3))
			seg(E.sg.tk[i], cx + cos(th) * r0, cy + sin(th) * r0, cx + cos(th) * r1, cy + sin(th) * r1, 1, 1 - bz * 0.6)
		end
		local gold = ss(104, 113, t)
		for i = 1, 3 do
			local sz = U * (0.06 + (0.26 * ig) * (1 + S.en) * i * 0.6 + 0.1 * S.lv) * (0.8 + 0.2 * i)
			E.sg.hl[i].BackgroundColor3 = mix((i == 1) and ICE or ((i == 2) and CYAN or GOLD), GOLD, gold * 0.5)
			place(E.sg.hl[i], cx, cy, sz, sz, 0, 1 - bz * (0.04 + 0.1 * ig + 0.12 * S.lv) / i)
		end
		place(E.core, cx, cy, U * (0.006 + 0.012 * ig + 0.01 * S.kick), U * (0.006 + 0.012 * ig + 0.01 * S.kick), 0, 1 - bz)
		place(E.vb, cx, cy, 2 + U * 0.02 * ig * (1 + S.kick), sy * 1.3, 0, 1 - bz * 0.5 * ig)
		place(E.hb, cx, cy, sx * (0.15 + 0.7 * ig), 2 + 2 * S.kick, 0, 1 - bz * 0.55 * ig * (0.5 + 0.5 * S.kick + 0.3))
		-- shafts of volumetric light, re-centred on the title for the finale
		local tcx, tcy = S.sx / 2, S.sy * 0.45
		local mv = ss(104, 108, t)
		local pkd = (t > PEAK) and exp(-(t - PEAK) * 1.2) or 0
		local sa = bz * (0.05 + 0.1 * ig * (0.6 + 0.4 * S.lv)) * (1 - 0.55 * ss(40, 50, t)) + mv * (1 - ss(117.5, 119.5, t)) * (0.07 + 0.12 * pkd) + ss(95, 105, t) * (1 - mv) * 0.08
		for i = 1, 5 do
			E.sh[i].BackgroundColor3 = mix(ICE, GOLD, S.tint)
			place(E.sh[i], lerp(cx, tcx, mv), lerp(cy, tcy, mv), U * (1.4 + 0.3 * (i % 3)), U * (0.025 + 0.018 * i), i * 36 + t * (2.5 + i * 0.8) * ((i % 2 == 0) and 1 or -1), 1 - sa)
		end
		-- holographic survey: spatial map revealed by the scouts
		E.reg.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(G.rx, G.ry)
		E.reg.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(G.W, G.H)
		E.reg2.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(G.rx, G.ry)
		E.reg2.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(G.W, G.H)
		local fS = ss(28.6, 40.5, t)
		local hA = ss(27.5, 29, t) * (1 - ss(46, 54, t))
		for i = 1, 13 do
			local r = (i - 1) / 12
			local d = fS - r
			local on = c01(d * 14)
			local fresh = (d > 0) and exp(-d * 10) or 0
			place(E.hv[i], G.W * r, G.H / 2, 1, G.H, sin((t + i) * 0.6) * 0.4 * S.kick, 1 - hA * (0.1 + 0.5 * fresh) * on)
		end
		for j = 1, 8 do
			place(E.hh[j], G.W * fS / 2, G.H * (j - 1) / 7, max(G.W * fS, 1), 1, 0, 1 - hA * 0.13)
		end
		local scA = hA * ((fS > 0.001 and fS < 0.999) and 1 or 0)
		place(E.scan, G.W * fS, G.H / 2, 3, G.H, 0, 1 - scA * 0.85)
		place(E.scanG, G.W * fS - 30, G.H / 2, 60, G.H, 0, 1 - scA * 0.6)
		E.scl.Text = string.format("SPATIAL MAP  %03d%%", floor(fS * 100))
		E.scl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(G.rx + 74, max(G.ry - 62, 10))
		E.scl.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 14)
		E.scl.TextTransparency = 1 - scA * 0.8
		local sh = ss(85, 90, t) * (1 - ss(113.5, 115, t))
		E.sheen.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(G.W * 0.22, G.H * 1.9)
		E.sheen.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(G.W * (-0.2 + 1.4 * ((t * 0.2) % 1)), G.H / 2)
		E.sheen.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - sh * (0.45 + 0.4 * ss(95, 112, t))
		-- guides
		local gA = 1 - ss(99, 106, t)
		for _, g in ipairs(GD) do
			g.hit = g.hit * exp(-5 * dt)
			if g.prog > 0 then
				local al = (0.4 + 0.5 * g.hit) * gA
				if g.o == "v" then
					local x = PX(g.f)
					local len = sy * g.prog
					place(g.line, x, len / 2, 1, len, 0, 1 - al)
					g.lab.Text = string.format("x:%d", floor(g.f * G.W))
					g.lab.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x + 28, min(len, sy) - 8)
				else
					local y = PY(g.f)
					local len = sx * g.prog
					place(g.line, len / 2, y, len, 1, 0, 1 - al)
					g.lab.Text = string.format("y:%d", floor(g.f * G.H))
					g.lab.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(min(len, sx) - 30, y - 8)
				end
				g.lab.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 12)
				g.lab.TextTransparency = 1 - al * 0.9
			end
		end
		-- dimension lines
		for id, d in ipairs(DM) do
			if d.prog > 0 then
				local x0, y0, x1, y1, txt = dimGeo(id)
				local ex, ey = lerp(x0, x1, d.prog), lerp(y0, y1, d.prog)
				local nx, ny = -(y1 - y0), (x1 - x0)
				local nl = max(sqrt(nx * nx + ny * ny), 0.001)
				nx, ny = nx / nl, ny / nl
				seg(d.line, x0, y0, ex, ey, 1, 1 - 0.7 * gA)
				seg(d.t1, x0 - nx * 7, y0 - ny * 7, x0 + nx * 7, y0 + ny * 7, 1, 1 - 0.8 * gA)
				seg(d.t2, ex - nx * 7, ey - ny * 7, ex + nx * 7, ey + ny * 7, 1, 1 - 0.8 * gA * ss(0.05, 0.2, d.prog))
				d.lab.Text = txt
				d.lab.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((x0 + x1) / 2 + nx * 14, (y0 + y1) / 2 + ny * 14)
				d.lab.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 12)
				d.lab.TextTransparency = 1 - 0.9 * gA * ss(0.5, 0.9, d.prog)
			end
		end
		-- rulers
		for id, ru in pairs(RU) do
			if ru.prog > 0 then
				if not ru.t then
					ru.t = {}
					for k = 0, ru.n do ru.t[k] = {box(E.world, 28, STEEL, 1), (k % 4 == 0) and lab(E.world, 28, 8, STEEL) or nil} end
					ru.base = box(E.world, 28, STEEL, 1)
				end
				if id == "h" then
					place(ru.base, G.rx + G.W * ru.prog / 2, G.ry - 12, G.W * ru.prog, 1, 0, 1 - 0.5 * gA)
				else
					place(ru.base, G.rx - 12, G.ry + G.H * ru.prog / 2, 1, G.H * ru.prog, 0, 1 - 0.5 * gA)
				end
				for k = 0, ru.n do
					local tk = ru.t[k]
					local on = (k / ru.n <= ru.prog) and 1 or 0
					local len = (k % 4 == 0) and 9 or 4
					if id == "h" then
						place(tk[1], G.rx + G.W * k / ru.n, G.ry - 12 - len / 2, 1, len, 0, 1 - on * 0.5 * gA)
					else
						place(tk[1], G.rx - 12 - len / 2, G.ry + G.H * k / ru.n, len, 1, 0, 1 - on * 0.5 * gA)
					end
					if tk[2] then
						tk[2].Text = tostring(floor(((id == "h") and G.W or G.H) * k / ru.n))
						if id == "h" then tk[2].Position = UDim2.fromOffset(G.rx + G.W * k / ru.n, G.ry - 28) else tk[2].Position = UDim2.fromOffset(G.rx - 30, G.ry + G.H * k / ru.n) end
						tk[2].Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 10)
						tk[2].TextTransparency = 1 - on * 0.55 * gA
					end
				end
			end
		end
		-- act transition wipe
		local wu = (t - S.wipeT) / 1.1
		if wu >= 0 and wu <= 1 then
			local y = sy * eio(wu)
			place(E.wp, cx, y, sx, 2, 0, 1 - 0.6 * sin(pi * wu))
			place(E.wpG, cx, y - 40, sx, 80, 0, 1 - 0.25 * sin(pi * wu))
			E.wp.BackgroundColor3 = mix(CYAN, GOLD, S.tint)
			E.wpG.BackgroundColor3 = E.wp.BackgroundColor3
		else
			E.wp.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			E.wpG.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		end
	end

	local function updBeams(t)
		local win = ss(63, 66, t) * (1 - ss(106, 109, t))
		for n, b in ipairs(BM) do
			local A, B = AG[b.a], AG[b.b]
			local v = min(A.vis, B.vis) * win
			if v < 0.01 then
				b.line.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				b.pk.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			else
				local act = b.feed and (0.25 + 0.75 * B.work) or (0.45 + 0.2 * S.en)
				seg(b.line, A.x, A.y, B.x, B.y, 1, 1 - v * 0.5 * act)
				local f = (t * 0.8 + n * 0.37) % 1
				place(b.pk, lerp(A.x, B.x, f), lerp(A.y, B.y, f), 5, 5, 45, 1 - v * act)
			end
		end
	end
	local function epos(e, which, t)
		local id, o
		if which == "a" then id, o = e.ia, e.oa else id, o = e.ib, e.ob end
		if id then
			local r = RC[id]
			return PX(r.x + r.w / 2), PY(r.y + r.h / 2)
		end
		return outerPos(o, t)
	end
	local function updNet(t, dt)
		local nA = ss(85, 88, t) * (1 - 0.6 * ss(108, 113, t)) * (1 - ss(117, 119, t))
		local wr = (t - S.pulseT) * S.U * 1.5
		local wd = exp(-(t - S.pulseT) * 0.6)
		for idx, e in ipairs(NE) do
			local prog = e.inner and LKS[e.inner].prog or eio((t - e.t0) / 2.2)
			if prog > 0.001 and nA > 0.001 then
				local ax, ay = epos(e, "a", t)
				local bx, by = epos(e, "b", t)
				local ex, ey = lerp(ax, bx, prog), lerp(ay, by, prog)
				local mx, my = (ax + bx) / 2 - S.cx, (ay + by) / 2 - S.cy
				local dd = (sqrt(mx * mx + my * my) - wr) / (S.U * 0.14)
				local w = exp(-dd * dd) * wd
				e.line.BackgroundColor3 = mix(mix(CYAN, ICE, w), GOLD, S.tint * 0.8)
				seg(e.line, ax, ay, ex, ey, 1.2 + 1.6 * w, 1 - c01((0.45 + 0.25 * S.en + w * 0.5) * nA))
				if prog >= 0.99 then
					local f = (t * 0.4 + idx * 0.173) % 1
					place(e.pk, lerp(ax, bx, f), lerp(ay, by, f), 7 + 7 * S.lv, 7 + 7 * S.lv, 0, 1 - nA * 0.7)
				else
					e.pk.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				end
			else
				e.line.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				e.pk.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			end
		end
		for k = 1, 12 do
			local x, y = outerPos(k, t)
			local pr = eio((t - (86 + (k - 1) * 0.6)) / 2.2)
			place(E.on[k], x, y, 8, 8, 45, 1 - pr * nA * 0.9)
		end
		for k, id in ipairs(NODEIDS) do
			local r = RC[id]
			local pr = c01(r.p) * ss(86, 90, t)
			place(E.rn[k], PX(r.x + r.w / 2), PY(r.y + r.h / 2), 6, 6, 45, 1 - pr * nA * 0.9)
		end
	end

	local function updTitle(t, dt)
		local Ls, adv, tx0, ty = titleGeo()
		local on = t >= 104.5
		E.tl.Visible = on
		if not on then return end
		local gf = 1 - ss(117.7, 119.9, t)
		local dep = ss(112.6, 114.6, t)
		local pk = (t > PEAK) and exp(-(t - PEAK) * 2.2) or 0
		local fk = (t > FIN) and exp(-(t - FIN) * 2.6) or 0
		local cs = Ls * 0.055 * (pk + fk * 1.4) + Ls * 0.006
		local M = max(6, Ls * 0.16)
		local cellH = Ls * 1.12
		local cw, chh = adv + 2 * M, cellH + 2 * M
		local d = Ls * 0.026 * dep
		for n, L in ipairs(LET) do
			local u = c01((t - L.tA) / 1.15)
			local wire = ss(0, 0.3, u)
			local fa = ss(0.42, 1, u)
			local clipK = eo3(c01(u / 0.6))
			local x = tx0 + (L.cell - 0.5) * adv
			local sinceDone = t - (L.tA + 1.15)
			local by = (sinceDone > 0) and Ls * 0.05 * exp(-sinceDone * 10) * cos(sinceDone * 30) or 0
			place(L.slot, x, ty, adv * 0.92, cellH, 0)
			L.slot.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			L.slst.Transparency = 1 - ss(L.tA - 0.8, L.tA - 0.4, t) * (1 - ss(L.tA + 0.2, L.tA + 0.5, t)) * 0.8
			L.clip.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x - adv / 2 - M, ty - cellH / 2 - M - by)
			L.clip.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cw, max(chh * clipK, 0.5))
			local function setL(f, ox, oy)
				f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(ox, oy)
				f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(cw, chh)
				f.TextSize = max(10, floor(Ls))
			end
			setL(L.e2, 2 * d, 2.6 * d) setL(L.e1, d, 1.3 * d) setL(L.gc, -cs, 0) setL(L.gv, cs, cs * 0.3) setL(L.lab, 0, 0)
			local ea = fa * gf * dep * 0.95
			L.e2.TextTransparency = 1 - ea
			L.e1.TextTransparency = 1 - ea
			local ga = fa * gf * (0.14 + 0.5 * c01(pk + fk))
			L.gc.TextTransparency = 1 - ga
			L.gv.TextTransparency = 1 - ga
			L.lab.TextTransparency = 1 - fa * gf
			L.lab.TextColor3 = mix(WHITE, GOLD, 0.8 * fk + 0.12 * (1 - dep))
			L.gr.Offset = Vector2.new(lerp(-1.2, 1.2, ((t * 0.33 + n * 0.05) % 1.6) / 1.6), 0)
			L.str.Color = mix(CYAN, GOLD, fa)
			L.str.Thickness = 1.5 + 4 * pk + 3 * fk
			L.str.Transparency = 1 - cl((wire * (0.9 - 0.5 * fa) + 0.6 * c01(pk + fk)) * gf, 0, 1)
			local scA = (u > 0 and u < 0.62) and 0.9 or 0
			place(L.sf, x, ty - cellH / 2 + cellH * clipK, adv + M, 2, 0, 1 - scA * gf)
			if u >= 1 and not L.done then
				L.done = true
				ring(x, ty, GOLD, 0.8, Ls * 1.2, 2)
				sfx("glass", 0.05, 2.0 + ((L.cell * 3) % 5) * 0.08)
				S.flashK = max(S.flashK, 0.1)
			end
		end
		local gs = Ls * (NAME:len() * 0.72)
		for i = 1, 3 do
			place(E.gt[i], S.sx / 2, ty, gs * (0.9 + 0.5 * i) * (1 + 0.3 * pk), Ls * (1.2 + 1.2 * i), 0, 1 - gf * (0.03 + 0.07 * dep + 0.2 * pk + 0.25 * fk) / i)
		end
		local tl = eio(ss(107, 112.8, t))
		local lw = adv * #NAME * 1.02 * tl
		place(E.tline, S.sx / 2, ty + cellH * 0.62, max(lw, 1), 2, 0, 1 - gf * 0.8 * c01(tl * 3))
		place(E.tdL, S.sx / 2 - lw / 2, ty + cellH * 0.62, 6, 6, 45, 1 - gf * c01(tl * 3))
		place(E.tdR, S.sx / 2 + lw / 2, ty + cellH * 0.62, 6, 6, 45, 1 - gf * c01(tl * 3))
		place(E.ana, S.sx / 2, ty, 2 + Ls * 0.1 * (pk + fk), S.sy * 1.2, 0, 1 - gf * 0.6 * c01(pk + fk))
		place(E.ana2, S.sx / 2, ty, S.sx * (0.25 + 0.85 * c01(pk + fk)), 2 + Ls * 0.05 * (pk + fk), 0, 1 - gf * 0.9 * c01(pk + fk * 1.2))
		SUBTXT.ax, SUBTXT.ay, SUBTXT.asz = S.sx / 2, ty + cellH * 0.62 + Ls * 0.2, max(9, Ls * 0.2)
		SUBTXT.sz = 0.01
	end

	local function updRings(t)
		for _, r in ipairs(E.rg) do
			local u = (t - r.t0) / r.life
			if u >= 0 and u <= 1 then
				local s = r.mr * 2 * eo3(u)
				place(r.f, r.x, r.y, s, s, 0, 1)
				r.st.Transparency = 1 - (1 - u) * 0.85
			else
				r.st.Transparency = 1
			end
		end
	end
	local function updBurst(t)
		local u = (t - S.bt) / 1.1
		if u >= 0 and u <= 1 then
			S.bvis = true
			local U = S.U
			for _, s in ipairs(E.bs) do
				local e = eo3(u)
				local a0 = U * (0.05 + 0.9 * e * s.v)
				local len = U * (0.05 + 0.3 * s.v) * (1 - u) * S.bmag
				local ox, oy = S.bx + cos(s.th) * a0, S.by + sin(s.th) * a0
				seg(s.f, ox - cos(s.th) * len, oy - sin(s.th) * len, ox, oy, 2 * (1 - u) + 0.6, 1 - (1 - u) * 0.9 * min(S.bmag, 1))
				s.f.BackgroundColor3 = S.bcol
			end
		elseif S.bvis then
			S.bvis = false
			for _, s in ipairs(E.bs) do s.f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 end
		end
		-- final-lock blades: close in on the title line, then slam
		local Ls, _, _, ty = titleGeo()
		local bu = (t - 115.8) / 1.0
		if bu >= 0 and bu <= 1 then
			local g = eio(bu)
			local off = Ls * 1.5 * (1 - g)
			place(E.bl[1], S.sx / 2, ty - off, S.sx * 0.9, 2 + 3 * g, 0, 1 - 0.85 * g)
			place(E.bl[2], S.sx / 2, ty + off, S.sx * 0.9, 2 + 3 * g, 0, 1 - 0.85 * g)
		elseif t > FIN then
			local fk = exp(-(t - FIN) * 5)
			place(E.bl[1], S.sx / 2, ty, S.sx * (0.9 + 0.4 * (1 - fk)), 2 + 8 * fk, 0, 1 - fk)
			E.bl[2].BackgroundTransparency = 1
		else
			E.bl[1].BackgroundTransparency = 1
			E.bl[2].BackgroundTransparency = 1
		end
	end

	-- ---------- key moments ----------
	local function onPeak(t)
		S.peak = true
		S.flashK = 0.8
		S.shake = 0.7
		S.punch = 0.1
		S.sk = 1
		ring(S.sx / 2, S.sy * 0.45, GOLD, 1.6, S.U * 0.95, 3)
		ring(S.sx / 2, S.sy * 0.45, ICE, 1.15, S.U * 0.58, 2)
		ring(S.sx / 2, S.sy * 0.45, WHITE, 0.8, S.U * 0.3, 2)
		burst(t, 0.8, GOLD, S.sx / 2, S.sy * 0.45)
		sfx("glass", 0.09, 1.7)
		sfx("snap", 0.09, 0.8)
		for _, r in ipairs(RL) do r.hit = 1 end
	end
	local function onFinal(t)
		S.fin = true
		S.flashK = 1
		S.shake = 0.9
		S.punch = 0.12
		S.sk = 1
		ring(S.sx / 2, S.sy * 0.45, GOLD, 1.6, S.U * 1.1, 4)
		ring(S.sx / 2, S.sy * 0.45, WHITE, 1.1, S.U * 0.7, 3)
		ring(S.sx / 2, S.sy * 0.45, ICE, 0.8, S.U * 0.4, 2)
		burst(t, 1, GOLD, S.sx / 2, S.sy * 0.45)
		sfx("glass", 0.1, 1.5)
		sfx("snap", 0.1, 0.7)
	end
	local EV = {
		{12, function(t)
			S.flashK, S.shake, S.punch, S.sk = 0.6, 0.5, 0.07, 1
			ring(S.cx, S.cy, ICE, 1.4, S.U * 0.7, 3) ring(S.cx, S.cy, CYAN, 1.0, S.U * 0.45, 2) ring(S.cx, S.cy, WHITE, 0.7, S.U * 0.25, 2)
			burst(t, 0.7, CYAN, S.cx, S.cy)
			sfx("glass", 0.08, 1.2) sfx("snap", 0.08, 0.7)
		end},
		{27, function(t) S.sk = max(S.sk, 0.5) ring(S.cx, S.cy, ICE, 1.2, S.U * 0.8, 2) end},
		{45, function(t) S.flashK = max(S.flashK, 0.2) S.sk = max(S.sk, 0.5) ring(S.cx, S.cy, GOLD, 1.2, S.U * 0.6, 2) end},
		{65, function(t) S.flashK = max(S.flashK, 0.25) S.punch = 0.03 S.sk = 0.8 ring(S.cx, S.cy, CYAN, 1.2, S.U * 0.7, 2) ring(S.cx, S.cy, ICE, 0.9, S.U * 0.4, 2) end},
		{85, function(t) S.flashK = max(S.flashK, 0.25) S.sk = 1 ring(S.cx, S.cy, CYAN, 1.5, S.U * 0.9, 3) ring(S.cx, S.cy, ICE, 1.1, S.U * 0.6, 2) ring(S.cx, S.cy, WHITE, 0.8, S.U * 0.3, 2) end},
		{105, function(t) S.flashK = max(S.flashK, 0.2) ring(S.sx / 2, S.sy * 0.45, GOLD, 1.3, S.U * 0.7, 2) end},
		{PEAK, onPeak},
		{FIN, onFinal},
	}

	local function audioGain(t)
		local g = ss(0, 6, t) * (1 - 0.8 * ss(116.5, 120, t))
		if S.skipT then g = g * (1 - c01((t - S.skipT) / 0.35)) end
		return g
	end

	local function loop()
		do
			local w0, lim = os.clock(), opts.ReadyWait or 8
			E.term.Text = ""
			while opts.Ready and not opts.Ready() and os.clock() - w0 < lim and not S.skipped do
				if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then break end
				local prog = SONG.Progress
				E.term.Text = "> LOADING SOUNDTRACK" .. string.rep(".", floor(os.clock() * 3) % 4) .. ((type(prog) == "number" and prog > 0 and prog < 1) and string.format("  %d%%", floor(prog * 100)) or "")
				E.term.TextTransparency = 0.3
				RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
			end
			if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then
				S.fallback = true
				return
			end
			E.term.Text = ""
			E.world.Visible = true
			E.mst = FX.AttachMaster(stage, E, 14, nil, {OFF = 0, BEAT = 0.5, BAR = 2, INT = math.clamp(tonumber(CFG.IntroIntensity) or 1, 0, 1.5), DUR = DUR}, 0)
			S.began = os.clock()
			S.wall0 = S.began
		end
		local okV, vv = pcall(function() return Music.Volume end)
		S.v0 = (okV and type(vv) == "number" and vv > 0.01) and vv or 1
		while true do
			local dt = math.min(RunService.Heartbeat:Wait(), 0.1)
			local t = os.clock() - S.began
			do
				local okP, pos, playing = pcall(function() return Music.TimePosition, Music.IsPlaying end)
				if okP and playing and type(pos) == "number" and pos > 0.05 then
					local now = os.clock()
					if pos ~= S.lastPos then S.lastPos, S.lastPosAt = pos, now end
					local est = pos + math.min(now - (S.lastPosAt or now), 0.1)
					local d = est - t
					if abs(d) > 0.25 then S.began = now - est else S.began = S.began - d * 0.35 end
					t = now - S.began
				end
			end
			if S.skipped and S.tEnd == DUR then
				S.tEnd = t + 0.35
				S.skipT = t
			end
			if t >= S.tEnd or t > DUR + 8 or os.clock() - S.wall0 > DUR + 10 then break end
			S.t = t
			local sz = stage.AbsoluteSize
			local sx, sy = max(sz.X, 160), max(sz.Y, 120)
			S.sx, S.sy, S.U = sx, sy, min(sx, sy)
			S.cx, S.cy = sx / 2, sy / 2
			geom()
			-- live loudness (music reactive, normalised); the choreography never depends on it
			local okL, raw = pcall(function() return Music.PlaybackLoudness end)
			raw = (okL and type(raw) == "number") and raw or 0
			S.pk = max(S.pk * exp(-0.04 * dt), raw, 60)
			S.lv = lerp(S.lv, c01(raw / S.pk), 1 - exp(-9 * dt))
			local et = 0.1 * ss(0, 12, t) + 0.2 * ss(12, 45, t) + 0.22 * ss(45, 85, t) + 0.3 * ss(85, 105, t) + 0.18 * ss(105, 113, t)
			S.en = lerp(S.en, et + 0.12 * S.lv * ss(10, 40, t), 1 - exp(-3 * dt))
			S.kick = S.kick * exp(-8 * dt)
			local beat = false
			if S.lv - (S.lastLv or 0) > 0.12 and t > 20 then S.kick = max(S.kick, 0.5 * S.lv) beat = true end
			S.lastLv = S.lv
			if t > 14 and t < 114 and not beat and t - S.lastBeat > 2.6 then beat = true S.kick = max(S.kick, 0.4) end
			if beat and t - S.lastBeat > 0.35 then
				S.lastBeat = t
				if t >= 85 then S.pulseT = t end
				if t > 14 and t < 105 then ring(S.cx, S.cy, (t >= 85) and ICE or CYAN, 1.1, S.U * (0.3 + 0.25 * ss(40, 100, t)), 1.5) end
			end
			S.shake = S.shake * exp(-9 * dt)
			S.flashK = S.flashK * exp(-6 * dt)
			S.punch = S.punch * exp(-5 * dt)
			S.sk = S.sk * exp(-1.6 * dt)
			S.wa = 1 - 0.6 * ss(105, 107.5, t) + 0.25 * (t > PEAK and exp(-(t - PEAK) * 1.4) or 0)
			S.tint = ss(104, 113, t) * 0.9
			-- camera: keyframed path, smoothed so every move eases in and settles
			do
				local tz, tx, ty, tr = camTarget(t)
				local cam = S.cam
				if not cam then cam = {z = tz, x = tx, y = ty, r = tr} S.cam = cam end
				local kc = 1 - exp(-2.6 * dt)
				cam.z, cam.x, cam.y, cam.r = lerp(cam.z, tz, kc), lerp(cam.x, tx, kc), lerp(cam.y, ty, kc), lerp(cam.r, tr, kc)
				S.px, S.py = cam.x * S.U, cam.y * S.U
			end
			for _, e in ipairs(EV) do
				if not e[3] and t >= e[1] then e[3] = true guard("event", e[2], t) end
			end
			for _, r in ipairs(RL) do
				if r.hit > 0.002 then r.hit = r.hit * exp(-5 * dt) else r.hit = 0 end
				if r.lockT then
					local s = t - r.lockT
					if r.jdx and s < 0.9 then
						local e = exp(-7 * s) * cos(s * 24)
						r.jx, r.jy = r.jdx * e, r.jdy * e
					else
						r.jx, r.jy = 0, 0
					end
					if s >= 0.9 then r.lockT = nil end
				end
				if r.lkT then r.lk = eob(c01((t - r.lkT) / 0.45)) end
				if r.gl >= 0 then
					r.gl = r.gl + dt / 0.75
					if r.gl > 1 then r.gl = -1 end
				end
			end
			for _, k in ipairs(ALL) do
				if not k.done and t >= k.t0 then guard("task", applyTask, k, t) end
			end
			if t >= 113.4 then
				SUBTXT.tp = c01((t - 113.4) / 1.9)
				SUBTXT.act = SUBTXT.tp < 1
			end
			guard("scene", updScene, t, dt)
			for _, r in ipairs(RL) do
				if r.p > 0 or r.fp > 0 or r.sl > 0 or r.key ~= -1 then guard("rect", drawRect, r) end
			end
			guard("title", updTitle, t, dt)
			for _, o in ipairs(TL) do guard("text", drawText, o, t) end
			local cnt = {sc = 0, bd = 0, an = 0, rl = 0}
			guard("agents", function() cnt = updAgents(t, dt) end)
			guard("beams", updBeams, t)
			guard("net", updNet, t, dt)
			guard("rings", updRings, t)
			guard("burst", updBurst, t)
			-- apply the camera
			do
				local cam = S.cam
				E.ws.Scale = max(cam.z * (1 + S.punch) + 0.012 * S.kick, 0.2)
				local roll = (1.2 * sin(t * 0.3) * ss(30, 50, t) + 2 * sin(t * 0.5) * ss(85, 100, t)) * (1 - ss(106, 112, t))
				E.world.Rotation = cam.r + roll
				local shk = S.shake * S.U * 0.012
				E.world.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, S.px + (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * shk, 0.5, S.py + (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * shk)
			end
			if E.mst then E.mst(t, dt, S) end
			-- overlays
			local ho = ss(117.6, 120, t)
			local gf = 1 - ho
			local lb = sy * (0.11 - 0.07 * ss(3, 30, t) + 0.03 * ss(104, 108, t) - 0.03 * ss(108, PEAK, t)) * (1 - ss(116, 119, t))
			E.lbT.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, floor(max(lb, 0)))
			E.lbB.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, floor(max(lb, 0)))
			local fl = S.flashK
			if S.skipT then fl = max(fl, c01((t - S.skipT) / 0.35)) end
			E.flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - c01(fl) * 0.9 * (S.skipT and 1 or gf)
			for i = 1, 4 do E.vg[i].BackgroundTransparency = 1 - (0.55 + 0.25 * S.en + 0.08 * S.kick) * gf end
			local ci = 1
			for i = 1, #CAPS do if t >= CAPS[i][1] then ci = i end end
			if ci ~= S.ci then S.ci = ci S.wipeT = t end
			local c0 = CAPS[ci][1]
			E.cap.Text = CAPS[ci][2]
			E.cap.TextTransparency = 1 - ss(c0 + 0.1, c0 + 0.9, t) * (1 - ss(c0 + 3.4, c0 + 4.4, t)) * 0.85 * gf
			E.cap.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24 + 130, sy - lb - 20)
			E.cap.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(280, 16)
			E.tc.Text = string.format("SWARM REBUILD  //  %02d:%02d  //  S%02d  B%02d  A%02d  R%02d", floor(t / 60), floor(t) % 60, cnt.sc, cnt.bd, cnt.an, cnt.rl)
			E.tc.TextTransparency = 1 - 0.55 * ss(1, 4, t) * gf
			E.tc.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(24 + 190, lb + 20)
			E.tc.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(380, 16)
			E.skip.Visible = t < 116
			-- hand-off: the whole cinematic dissolves into the real interface
			stage.BackgroundTransparency = ho
			E.bg.BackgroundTransparency = ho
			if E.cgOK then E.world.GroupTransparency = ho end
			E.world.Visible = ho < 0.995
			pcall(function() Music.Volume = S.v0 * audioGain(t) end)
		end
	end

	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		build()
		loop()
	end)
	if not ok then warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro 14 error (continuing): " .. tostring(err)) end
	for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
	pcall(function() stage:Destroy() end)
	FX.IntroCamBusy = false
	-- gentle return of the soundtrack to full level after the closing fade
	if S.v0 then
		task.spawn(function()
			local from = 0
			pcall(function() from = Music.Volume end)
			local t0 = os.clock()
			local dur = S.skipped and 0.6 or 3
			while os.clock() - t0 < dur do
				pcall(function() Music.Volume = lerp(from, S.v0, ss(0, dur, os.clock() - t0)) end)
				RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
			end
			pcall(function() Music.Volume = S.v0 end)
		end)
	end
	if S.fallback then return "fallback" end
	FX.IntroActive = false
	return true
end
]==]
function FX.Intro14(MainFrame, Music, _, opts)
	if FX.Intro14Fn == nil then
		FX.Intro14Fn = false
		local ls = loadstring or load
		if ls then
			local okC, fn, cerr = pcall(ls, FX.Intro14Src, "=Intro14")
			if okC and type(fn) == "function" then
				local okR, f2 = pcall(fn, Util, FX)
				if okR and type(f2) == "function" then FX.Intro14Fn = f2 end
			else
				warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro 14 unavailable: " .. tostring(cerr or fn))
			end
		end
	end
	if not FX.Intro14Fn then return "fallback" end
	return FX.Intro14Fn(MainFrame, Music, _, opts)
end
FX.Intro15Src = [==[
local Util, FX = ...
return function(MainFrame, Music, _, opts)
	if FX.IntroCamBusy then return end
	FX.IntroCamBusy = true
	FX.IntroActive = true
	opts = opts or {}
	local CFG, SONG = FX.Cfg, opts.Song or {}
	local RunService, UIS = game:GetService("RunService"), game:GetService("UserInputService")
	local floor, sin, cos, sqrt, max, min, abs, exp, pi, atan2 = math.floor, math.sin, math.cos, math.sqrt, math.max, math.min, math.abs, math.exp, math.pi, math.atan2
	local DEG, RAD = 180 / pi, pi / 180
	local DUR = 60
	local function C(r, g, b) return Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b) end
	local WHITE, BLACK = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	local CHAR, CON = C(24, 20, 25), C(72, 76, 84)
	local CRIM, CRIM2, PURP, VIO, ORNG, AMB = C(140, 18, 36), C(224, 52, 46), C(146, 64, 255), C(222, 204, 255), C(255, 126, 38), C(255, 176, 70)
	local function cl(x, a, b) return x < a and a or (x > b and b or x) end
	local function c01(x) return cl(x, 0, 1) end
	local function lerp(a, b, k) return a + (b - a) * k end
	local function ss(a, b, x) local k = c01((x - a) / (b - a)) return k * k * (3 - 2 * k) end
	local function eo3(x) return 1 - (1 - c01(x)) ^ 3 end
	local function mix(a, b, k) k = c01(k) return Color3.new(a.R + (b.R - a.R) * k, a.G + (b.G - a.G) * k, a.B + (b.B - a.B) * k) end
	local function hash(i, k) return (sin(i * 12.9898 + k * 78.233) * 43758.5453) % 1 end
	local function kf(tb, t)
		local n = #tb
		if t <= tb[1][1] then return tb[1][2] end
		for i = 2, n do
			if t <= tb[i][1] then
				local a, b = tb[i - 1], tb[i]
				return lerp(a[2], b[2], (t - a[1]) / (b[1] - a[1]))
			end
		end
		return tb[n][2]
	end
	local function mk(class, parent, props)
		local o = Util.Instance(class, parent)
		if props then for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end end
		return o
	end
	-- performance: respects the script's intro intensity and low-end mode
	local inten = math.clamp(tonumber(CFG.IntroIntensity) or 1, 0.3, 1.2)
	local low = false
	pcall(function() low = FX.IsLowEnd ~= nil and FX.IsLowEnd() == true end)
	local dens = (low and 0.45 or 1) * min(inten, 1)
	local function N(n) return max(1, floor(n * dens + 0.5)) end

	local conns = {}
	local S = {began = os.clock(), wall0 = os.clock(), skipped = false, skipT = nil, tEnd = DUR, fallback = false, t = 0, sx = 800, sy = 450, fit = 1,
		warned = {}, shake = 0, flashK = 0, lv = 0, pk = 50, lastPos = 0, lastPosAt = 0, v0 = 1, red = 0, P = 0, B = 0, charge = 0, fb = 0, burn = 0, white = 0, punch = 0}
	local function guard(name, fn, ...)
		local ok, err = pcall(fn, ...)
		if not ok and not S.warned[name] then
			S.warned[name] = true
			warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro 15 " .. name .. " (continuing): " .. tostring(err))
		end
	end
	local stage = mk("Frame", MainFrame, {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = BLACK, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 1000000, ClipsDescendants = true, Active = true})
	conns[#conns + 1] = UIS.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if os.clock() - S.began < 0.4 then return end
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
			local k = input.KeyCode
			if k == Enum.KeyCode.Space or k == Enum.KeyCode.Return or k == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then S.skipped = true end
		end
	end)

	-- ---------- small construction helpers ----------
	local function rect(par, x, y, w, h, col, z, tr)
		return mk("Frame", par, {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h), BackgroundColor3 = col or WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = tr or 0, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z or 1, Interactable = false})
	end
	local function cbox(par, x, y, w, h, col, z, tr, rnd)
		local f = mk("Frame", par, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, h), BackgroundColor3 = col or WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = tr or 0, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z or 1, Interactable = false})
		if rnd then mk("UICorner", f, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(rnd, 0)}) end
		return f
	end
	local function vgrad(f, c0, c1, t0, t1, rot)
		return mk("UIGradient", f, {Rotation = rot or 90, Color = ColorSequence.new(c0, c1 or c0), Transparency = NumberSequence.new(t0 or 0, t1 or t0 or 0)})
	end
	local function line(par, x0, y0, x1, y1, th, col, z, tr)
		local dx, dy = x1 - x0, y1 - y0
		local f = cbox(par, (x0 + x1) / 2, (y0 + y1) / 2, sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) + 1, th, col, z, tr)
		f.Rotation = atan2(dy, dx) * DEG
		return f
	end
	local function text(par, z, size, col, xa, font, txt)
		return mk("TextLabel", par, {BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = font or Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = size, TextColor3 = col, TextXAlignment = xa or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false, Text = txt or "", TextTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(420, 16)})
	end
	local GW = {0.14, 0.18, 0.24, 0.32, 0.46}
	local function glow(par, x, y, d, col, z)
		local g = {r = {}, d = d}
		for i = 1, 5 do
			local s = d * (1.04 - i * 0.17)
			g.r[i] = cbox(par, x, y, s, s, col, z, 1, 0.5)
		end
		return g
	end
	local function setGlow(g, a)
		a = c01(a)
		for i = 1, 5 do g.r[i].BackgroundTransparency = 1 - a * GW[i] end
	end
	local function glowPos(g, x, y, k)
		for i = 1, 5 do
			local s = g.d * k * (1.04 - i * 0.17)
			g.r[i].Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y)
			g.r[i].Size = UDim2.fromOffset(s, s)
		end
	end

	-- ---------- world: parallax layers (design space 3000 x 900, camera looks at the centre) ----------
	local LW, DH = 3000, 900
	local E = {}
	local world = mk("Frame", stage, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1.3, 1.3), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 2, Interactable = false})
	local LAY = {}
	local function newLayer(d, zf, z)
		local f = mk("Frame", world, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(LW, DH), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z, Interactable = false})
		local us = mk("UIScale", f, {Scale = 1})
		local L = {f = f, us = us, d = d, zf = zf}
		LAY[#LAY + 1] = L
		return L
	end
	local Lsky, Lfar, Lgz, Lhaze, Lmid, Lwat, Lfg = newLayer(0.2, 0.25, 1), newLayer(0.55, 0.6, 2), newLayer(1.0, 1.0, 3), newLayer(1.08, 1.04, 4), newLayer(1.15, 1.1, 5), newLayer(1.5, 1.3, 6), newLayer(1.65, 1.4, 8)
	local function applyCam(cx, cy, cz, roll, shx, shy)
		local fit = S.fit
		for _, L in ipairs(LAY) do
			local sc = fit * (1 + (cz - 1) * L.zf)
			L.us.Scale = sc
			L.f.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, (-cx * L.d + shx) * sc, 0.5, (-cy * L.d + shy) * sc)
		end
		world.Rotation = roll
	end
	local function project(L, x, y)
		local sc = L.us.Scale
		local px = L.f.Position
		local lx = (x - LW / 2) * sc + px.X.Offset
		local ly = (y - DH / 2) * sc + px.Y.Offset
		local r = world.Rotation * RAD
		local cr, sr = cos(r), sin(r)
		return S.sx / 2 + lx * cr - ly * sr, S.sy / 2 + lx * sr + ly * cr
	end
	local function mapX(Ls, x, Ld)
		local a, b = Ls.us.Scale, Ld.us.Scale
		return LW / 2 + ((x - LW / 2) * a + Ls.f.Position.X.Offset - Ld.f.Position.X.Offset) / b
	end

	local FIRES, WINS, BEAC, PLATES, LIMBS, VEINS, BLD = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
	local SMK, PLM, BOOM, DEB, RIPS, ASHP, RAINP, GRAIN, SHOCK, MIST = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
	local GZ, FGS = {}, {}
	local function addWin(par, x, y, w, h, off, z, bl)
		local warm = hash(x, y) > 0.35
		local f = rect(par, x, y, w, h, warm and C(255, 214, 150) or C(190, 222, 255), z or 2, 1)
		WINS[#WINS + 1] = {f = f, off = off, ph = floor(hash(x, 3) * 9), vis = false, bl = bl}
		return f
	end

	-- ---------- sky ----------
	local function buildSky()
		local sky = rect(Lsky.f, -1000, -2000, 5000, 3000, WHITE, 1)
		mk("UIGradient", sky, {Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence.new({ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0, C(5, 7, 11)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.6, C(13, 17, 25)),
			ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.8, C(36, 43, 58)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(0.88, C(84, 62, 70)), ColorSequenceKeypoint.new(1, C(30, 24, 30))})})
		E.skyRed = glow(Lsky.f, 1500, 560, 2800, CRIM, 2)
		E.skyPur = glow(Lsky.f, 1900, 220, 2100, PURP, 2)
		E.skyAft = glow(Lsky.f, 1500, 650, 3200, ORNG, 2)
		E.skyVeil = rect(Lsky.f, -1000, -2000, 5000, 3000, C(60, 66, 78), 3, 0.82)
	end

	-- ---------- far skyline: towers, highway, industrial zone, distant fires ----------
	local function buildFar()
		local L = Lfar.f
		rect(L, -1000, 640, 5000, 1500, C(13, 16, 22), 1)
		for i = 1, 36 do
			local x = -240 + i * 96 + hash(i, 1) * 50
			local h = 90 + hash(i, 2) * 150 + ((i % 7 == 0) and 120 or 0)
			local w = 48 + hash(i, 3) * 70
			local sh = 26 + hash(i, 4) * 12
			local b = rect(L, x, 640 - h, w, h + 4, C(sh, sh + 6, sh + 16), 2)
			vgrad(b, C(255, 255, 255), C(150, 150, 165))
			for k = 1, 3 do
				if hash(i, 10 + k) > 0.45 then
					addWin(L, x + 6 + hash(i, 20 + k) * (w - 14), 640 - h + 14 + hash(i, 30 + k) * (h - 40), 3, 4, 4 + hash(i, 33 + k) * 30, 2)
				end
			end
			if i % 6 == 3 then
				rect(L, x + w / 2 - 1, 640 - h - 46, 2, 46, C(20, 22, 28), 2)
				BEAC[#BEAC + 1] = {g = glow(L, x + w / 2, 640 - h - 46, 26, CRIM2, 3), ph = i, a0 = 0.9, slow = true}
			end
		end
		-- elevated highway
		rect(L, -400, 604, 3800, 11, C(20, 22, 28), 3)
		for i = 0, 26 do rect(L, -300 + i * 140, 615, 9, 28, C(16, 18, 24), 3) end
		for i = 1, 14 do addWin(L, -250 + i * 230 + hash(i, 5) * 60, 598, 4, 3, 5 + hash(i, 9) * 14, 3) end
		-- industrial zone: tanks and chimneys with flare stacks
		for i = 1, 5 do
			local tb = cbox(L, -120 + i * 118, 622, 96, 40, C(30, 34, 42), 3, 0, 0.18)
			vgrad(tb, C(200, 200, 210), C(90, 92, 104))
		end
		for i = 1, 3 do
			local x = 120 + (i - 1) * 160
			rect(L, x, 450, 12, 192, C(24, 26, 34), 3)
			rect(L, x - 1, 470, 14, 10, CRIM2, 3, 0.35)
		end
		local FP = {{200, 440, 4.0}, {620, 596, 6.0}, {1030, 575, 12.5}, {1700, 590, 15.0}, {2300, 585, 8.5}, {2650, 570, 18.0}, {2950, 590, 21.0}, {132, 444, 2.5}, {900, 588, 16.0}, {1450, 580, 22.0}, {1980, 590, 26.0}}
		for i, f in ipairs(FP) do
			local g = glow(L, f[1], f[2], 150 + hash(i, 5) * 110, ORNG, 3)
			FIRES[#FIRES + 1] = {g = g, x = f[1], y = f[2], t0 = f[3], ph = i * 1.7, base = 0.5 + hash(i, 6) * 0.4, far = true, a = 0}
		end
		E.farHaze = rect(L, -1000, 430, 5000, 280, C(62, 76, 98), 4, 0.5)
		vgrad(E.farHaze, C(62, 76, 98), C(62, 76, 98), 1, 0.3)
	end

	-- ---------- Godzilla: procedural, jointed, heavy (Shin Godzilla fourth form) ----------
	local TAILN = {{110, 205}, {110, 190}, {110, 172}, {110, 154}, {105, 136}, {105, 118}, {100, 100}, {100, 84}, {95, 68}, {95, 54}, {90, 42}, {90, 32}, {85, 22}}
	local function buildGZ()
		local root = mk("Frame", Lgz.f, {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(1500, 560), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 3, Interactable = false})
		GZ.root = root
		local function joint(par, x, y)
			return mk("Frame", par, {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x, y), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Interactable = false})
		end
		local function limb(j, len, th, z, shade, grot)
			local f = mk("Frame", j, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-th * 0.3, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(len + th * 0.6, th), BackgroundColor3 = CHAR, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = z or 3, Interactable = false})
			mk("UICorner", f, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)})
			vgrad(f, C(255, 255, 255), C(105, 98, 112), 0, 0, grot or 90)
			LIMBS[#LIMBS + 1] = {f = f, sh = shade or 1}
			return f
		end
		-- extra anatomical mass that follows the lighting system (registered in LIMBS)
		local function mass(par, x, y, w, h, z, shade, rot)
			local f = cbox(par, x, y, w, h, CHAR, z, 0, 0.5)
			if rot then f.Rotation = rot end
			vgrad(f, C(255, 255, 255), C(112, 104, 118), 0, 0, 90)
			LIMBS[#LIMBS + 1] = {f = f, sh = shade}
			return f
		end
		-- horizontal belly / flank folds: dark crease with a lit lip below it
		local function fold(par, x, y, len, th, rot)
			local a = cbox(par, x, y, th, len, C(2, 2, 4), 4, 0.1, 0.5)
			a.Rotation = rot
			local b = cbox(par, x + th * 1.4, y + 1, 2, len * 0.8, C(118, 96, 104), 4, 0.84, 0.5)
			b.Rotation = rot
		end
		-- charred skin: layered patches, lit raised tissue, deep wrinkles, raised scars, branching radiation fissures under crust
		local function skin(f, w, h, seed, rich)
			for k = 1, N(rich and 16 or 8) do
				local bw, bh = 22 + hash(seed, k) * 66, 12 + hash(seed, k + 9) * 42
				local m = k % 4
				local pc = (m == 0) and C(3, 3, 5) or ((m == 1) and C(56, 32, 38) or ((m == 2) and C(18, 13, 17) or C(36, 26, 32)))
				local b = cbox(f, hash(seed, k + 3) * w, h * (0.12 + 0.76 * hash(seed, k + 5)), bw, bh, pc, 2, 0.45 + 0.25 * hash(seed, k + 11), 0.5)
				b.Rotation = (hash(seed, k + 7) - 0.5) * 90
			end
			for k = 1, N(rich and 8 or 3) do
				local hl = cbox(f, hash(seed, k + 100) * w, h * (0.08 + 0.5 * hash(seed, k + 102)), 28 + hash(seed, k + 104) * 56, 6 + hash(seed, k + 106) * 8, C(118, 96, 104), 2, 0.85, 0.5)
				hl.Rotation = (hash(seed, k + 108) - 0.5) * 90
			end
			for k = 1, N(rich and 14 or 6) do
				local wx, wy, wl = hash(seed, k + 40) * w, h * (0.08 + 0.84 * hash(seed, k + 42)), 34 + hash(seed, k + 44) * 80
				local rot = (hash(seed, k + 48) - 0.5) * 110
				local wr = cbox(f, wx, wy, wl, 2.5 + hash(seed, k + 46) * 3, C(2, 2, 4), 2, 0.15)
				wr.Rotation = rot
				local lip = cbox(f, wx + 2, wy + 4, wl * 0.8, 1.6, C(104, 84, 92), 2, 0.86)
				lip.Rotation = rot
			end
			for k = 1, N(rich and 8 or 3) do
				local sx, sy = hash(seed, k + 60) * w, h * (0.15 + 0.7 * hash(seed, k + 62))
				local rot = (hash(seed, k + 68) - 0.5) * 120
				local sl = 28 + hash(seed, k + 64) * 58
				local sc = cbox(f, sx, sy, sl, 6 + hash(seed, k + 66) * 5, C(104, 38, 44), 2, 0.35, 0.5)
				sc.Rotation = rot
				local sc2 = cbox(f, sx, sy + 3, sl * 0.8, 2, C(18, 8, 12), 2, 0.2, 0.5)
				sc2.Rotation = rot
			end
			for k = 1, N(rich and 13 or 6) do
				local px, py = hash(seed, k + 20) * w, h * (0.12 + 0.76 * hash(seed, k + 22))
				local a = (hash(seed, k + 26) - 0.5) * 100
				local vl = 24 + hash(seed, k + 24) * 62
				local v = cbox(f, px, py, vl, 2.6, CRIM2, 3, 1)
				v.Rotation = a
				VEINS[#VEINS + 1] = {f = v, ph = hash(seed, k) * 6}
				if k % 2 == 0 then
					local v2 = cbox(f, px + 12, py + 9, 14 + hash(seed, k + 80) * 28, 1.9, CRIM2, 3, 1)
					v2.Rotation = a + 38 + hash(seed, k + 82) * 30
					VEINS[#VEINS + 1] = {f = v2, ph = hash(seed, k) * 6 + 1.3}
					if k % 4 == 0 then
						local v3 = cbox(f, px - 14, py - 8, 10 + hash(seed, k + 90) * 20, 1.5, CRIM2, 3, 1)
						v3.Rotation = a - 42 - hash(seed, k + 92) * 26
						VEINS[#VEINS + 1] = {f = v3, ph = hash(seed, k) * 6 + 2.4}
					end
				end
				if k % 3 == 0 then
					local crust = cbox(f, px, py, vl * 0.42, 6, C(6, 4, 8), 4, 0.15, 0.5)
					crust.Rotation = a
				end
			end
		end
		-- light skin detail for small parts (arms, claws' roots)
		local function fine(f, w, h, seed)
			for k = 1, 3 do
				local wr = cbox(f, w * (0.2 + 0.25 * k), h * (0.3 + 0.4 * hash(seed, k)), h * 0.9, 2, C(2, 2, 4), 2, 0.15)
				wr.Rotation = 80 + (hash(seed, k + 3) - 0.5) * 30
			end
			local hl = cbox(f, w * 0.5, h * 0.22, w * 0.6, 3, C(118, 96, 104), 2, 0.8, 0.5)
			local v = cbox(f, w * 0.45, h * 0.6, w * 0.5, 1.8, CRIM2, 3, 1)
			v.Rotation = (hash(seed, 9) - 0.5) * 40
			VEINS[#VEINS + 1] = {f = v, ph = hash(seed, 5) * 6}
		end
		-- dorsal plate: fleshy buttress, four stacked layers, broken/chipped pointed tips, jagged side spurs, individual radiation core
		local function plate(j, px, py, side, w, h, lean)
			local pj = joint(j, px, py)
			pj.Rotation = (side > 0 and 180 or 0) + lean + (hash(px * 3 + 1, h) - 0.5) * 18
			local P = {st = {}, tips = {}, tipOf = {}, ratio = 0, jit = (hash(px, h) - 0.5) * 0.18}
			P.halo = cbox(pj, 0, -h * 0.5, h * 1.9, h * 1.9, PURP, 1, 1, 0.5)
			local bt = cbox(pj, 0, 2, w * 1.25, w * 0.55, CHAR, 1, 0, 0.5)
			LIMBS[#LIMBS + 1] = {f = bt, sh = 0.78}
			local specs = {{1.12, 0.46}, {0.8, 0.7}, {0.52, 0.9}, {0.26, 1.04}}
			for i, s in ipairs(specs) do
				local f = mk("Frame", pj, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.fromOffset((hash(px, i) - 0.5) * w * 0.26, 5), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w * s[1], h * s[2]), BackgroundColor3 = CHAR, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 1 + i, Interactable = false})
				f.Rotation = (hash(h, i + 3) - 0.5) * 11
				P.st[i] = f
				local tw = w * s[1] * 0.64
				local broken = hash(px + i, h) > 0.62
				local tp = cbox(pj, (hash(px, i + 5) - 0.5) * w * 0.3, -h * s[2] + (broken and 8 or 2), tw * (broken and 0.7 or 1), tw, CHAR, 1 + i, 0)
				tp.Rotation = 45 + (hash(h, i + 7) - 0.5) * 38
				P.tips[#P.tips + 1] = tp
				P.tipOf[#P.tips] = i
				if i <= 3 then
					for sd = -1, 1, 2 do
						local sp = cbox(pj, sd * w * s[1] * 0.46, -h * s[2] * (0.5 + 0.18 * hash(px + sd, i)), w * 0.2, w * 0.2, CHAR, 1 + i, 0)
						sp.Rotation = 45 + sd * 10 + (hash(h, i + sd) - 0.5) * 30
						P.tips[#P.tips + 1] = sp
						P.tipOf[#P.tips] = i
					end
				end
			end
			local chip = cbox(pj, w * 0.34 * ((hash(px, 9) > 0.5) and 1 or -1), -h * 0.42, w * 0.16, h * 0.34, C(4, 3, 6), 7, 0.1)
			chip.Rotation = (hash(px, 11) - 0.5) * 40
			local crack = cbox(pj, w * 0.12, -h * 0.55, 2.5, h * 0.5, C(3, 3, 5), 7, 0.1)
			crack.Rotation = (hash(px, 13) - 0.5) * 30
			P.core = mk("Frame", pj, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, -2), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(max(w * 0.2, 4), h * 0.9), BackgroundColor3 = VIO, BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 6, Interactable = false})
			PLATES[#PLATES + 1] = P
			return P
		end
		-- pelvis: wide heavy hips, layered belly folds
		local pel = joint(root, 0, 0)
		GZ.pel = pel
		do
			local f = mk("Frame", pel, {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-10, 30), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(390, 330), BackgroundColor3 = CHAR, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 3, Interactable = false})
			mk("UICorner", f, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0.5, 0)})
			LIMBS[#LIMBS + 1] = {f = f, sh = 0.95}
			mass(f, 70, 205, 190, 190, 3, 0.9)
			mass(f, 320, 205, 190, 190, 3, 1.0)
			skin(f, 390, 330, 91, true)
			local ab = cbox(f, 195, 262, 290, 120, C(70, 22, 30), 2, 0.3, 0.5)
			vgrad(ab, C(255, 255, 255), C(120, 90, 100), 0.15, 0.85)
			for k = 1, 5 do
				fold(f, 80 + k * 46, 232 + (k % 2) * 26, 60 + hash(k, 3) * 50, 5, (hash(k, 4) - 0.5) * 30 + 90)
			end
		end
		-- thick hind legs: swollen thigh with quad mass, heavy scar-ridged knee, broad three-claw foot
		local function leg(x, a1, sh)
			local j1 = joint(pel, x, 55)
			j1.Rotation = a1
			local th = limb(j1, 205, 250, 3, sh)
			skin(th, 205, 250, 140 + x, true)
			mass(th, 125, 190, 190, 120, 3, sh * 0.97)
			local j2 = joint(j1, 205, 0)
			j2.Rotation = -28
			local shn = limb(j2, 192, 160, 3, sh * 0.9)
			skin(shn, 192, 160, 150 + x, false)
			local kn = cbox(j2, 0, 0, 196, 196, CHAR, 3, 0, 0.5)
			LIMBS[#LIMBS + 1] = {f = kn, sh = sh * 0.92}
			skin(kn, 196, 196, 160 + x, false)
			local kc = cbox(kn, 98, 60, 96, 14, C(3, 3, 5), 4, 0.15, 0.5)
			kc.Rotation = 20
			local j3 = joint(j2, 192, 0)
			j3.Rotation = -62
			limb(j3, 124, 84, 3, sh * 0.8)
			mass(j3, 100, 0, 70, 100, 3, sh * 0.78)
			for c = 0, 2 do
				local cw = cbox(j3, 134 + c * 3, -28 + c * 28, 50, 15, C(30, 24, 26), 4, 0, 0.5)
				cw.Rotation = -16 + c * 16
				LIMBS[#LIMBS + 1] = {f = cw, sh = 0.5}
			end
		end
		leg(-85, 98, 0.85)
		leg(85, 82, 1.0)
		-- spine, shoulders, thick neck (barrel torso, massive shoulders, heavy neck root)
		local chain = {{250, 300, -82}, {205, 228, 10}, {160, 128, 22}, {135, 92, 28}}
		GZ.ch = {}
		local par, px = pel, 0
		for i, c in ipairs(chain) do
			local j = joint(par, px, 0)
			j.Rotation = c[3]
			local f = limb(j, c[1], c[2], 4, 1)
			if i <= 2 then skin(f, c[1], c[2], 11 + i, true) elseif i == 3 then skin(f, c[1], c[2], 17, false) else skin(f, c[1], c[2], 19, false) end
			if i == 1 then
				-- barrel torso: flank swell, back hump, belly folds
				mass(f, c[1] * 0.5, c[2] * 0.5, c[1] * 0.95, c[2] * 1.1, 4, 0.97)
				mass(f, c[1] * 0.62, c[2] * 0.08, c[1] * 0.8, c[2] * 0.3, 4, 1.0)
				for k = 1, 5 do
					fold(f, c[1] * (0.1 + k * 0.16), c[2] * 0.86, 44 + hash(k, 21) * 50, 5, (hash(k, 22) - 0.5) * 24)
				end
			elseif i == 2 then
				-- rib cage: dark ridges with radiation fissures between them, heavy asymmetric shoulder mass
				for r = 1, 6 do
					local rb = cbox(f, c[1] * (0.12 + r * 0.13), c[2] * 0.58, 11, c[2] * (0.52 - r * 0.02), C(4, 3, 6), 3, 0.25, 0.5)
					rb.Rotation = -14 + r * 3
					local rv = cbox(f, c[1] * (0.18 + r * 0.13), c[2] * 0.58, 3, c[2] * 0.4, CRIM2, 3, 1)
					rv.Rotation = -14 + r * 3
					VEINS[#VEINS + 1] = {f = rv, ph = r * 0.9}
				end
				mass(f, c[1] * 0.2, c[2] * 0.2, 200, 160, 3, 0.98)
				mass(f, c[1] * 0.55, c[2] * 0.1, 170, 120, 3, 1.0)
				for k = 1, 3 do
					fold(f, c[1] * (0.3 + k * 0.17), c[2] * 0.84, 40 + hash(k, 25) * 36, 4, (hash(k, 26) - 0.5) * 24)
				end
			elseif i == 3 then
				mass(f, 28, c[2] * 0.4, 190, 170, 3, 0.98)
				for k = 1, 3 do
					fold(f, c[1] * (0.25 + k * 0.2), c[2] * 0.8, 34 + hash(k, 27) * 24, 4, (hash(k, 28) - 0.5) * 20)
				end
			else
				mass(f, 24, c[2] * 0.4, 130, 120, 3, 1.0)
			end
			GZ.ch[i] = {j = j, len = c[1], th = c[2], base = c[3]}
			par, px = j, c[1]
		end
		local backP = {}
		local function backPlates(i, xs, hs)
			for k, xf in ipairs(xs) do
				local c = GZ.ch[i]
				backP[#backP + 1] = plate(c.j, c.len * xf, -c.th / 2 + 8, -1, 60 + hs[k] * 0.5, hs[k] * 1.15, -12)
			end
		end
		-- very long segmented tail: massive at the hip, gradual taper to a thin whip; round knuckles smooth each joint transition
		local tailJ, tailP = {}, {}
		do
			local tp, tx = pel, -50
			for i, c in ipairs(TAILN) do
				local j = joint(tp, (i == 1) and -50 or tx, (i == 1) and 70 or 0)
				local bs = (i == 1) and 172 or (-2 + 1.2 * sin(i * 1.3))
				j.Rotation = bs
				local tf = limb(j, c[1], c[2], 3, 0.92 - i * 0.014, 270)
				if i <= 6 then skin(tf, c[1], c[2], 200 + i, i <= 3) end
				if i <= 8 then
					local kk = cbox(j, c[1], 0, c[2] * 0.92, c[2] * 0.92, CHAR, 3, 0, 0.5)
					LIMBS[#LIMBS + 1] = {f = kk, sh = 0.92 - i * 0.014}
				end
				tailJ[i] = {j = j, base = bs, len = c[1], a = bs}
				if i <= 10 then tailP[i] = plate(j, c[1] * 0.5, c[2] / 2 - 6, 1, 48 - i * 1.5, (104 - i * 7) * (0.8 + 0.4 * hash(i, 9)), 14) end
				tp, tx = j, c[1]
			end
		end
		GZ.tail = tailJ
		backPlates(1, {0.12, 0.3, 0.55, 0.82}, {70, 86, 104, 116})
		backPlates(2, {0.18, 0.45, 0.72, 0.95}, {112, 128, 120, 104})
		backPlates(3, {0.3, 0.72}, {90, 78})
		backPlates(4, {0.45}, {60})
		do
			local order = {}
			for i = #tailP, 1, -1 do order[#order + 1] = tailP[i] end
			for _, p in ipairs(backP) do order[#order + 1] = p end
			for i, p in ipairs(order) do p.ratio = (i - 1) / max(#order - 1, 1) end
		end
		-- small forearms kept small, but with a deltoid root, skin detail and longer pale claws
		do
			local aj = joint(GZ.ch[2].j, 52, 90)
			aj.Rotation = 95
			mass(aj, 6, 0, 64, 58, 6, 0.96)
			local ua = limb(aj, 70, 30, 6, 0.95)
			fine(ua, 70, 30, 301)
			local fj = joint(aj, 70, 0)
			fj.Rotation = -22
			local fa = limb(fj, 62, 22, 6, 0.9)
			fine(fa, 62, 22, 303)
			for c = -1, 1 do
				local cw = cbox(fj, 70, c * 7, 28, 6, C(190, 176, 160), 7, 0.1, 0.5)
				cw.Rotation = c * 20
			end
		end
		-- head: fuller skull, heavy brow, swollen eye tissue, long snout kept, strong jaw, irregular teeth
		local hj = joint(par, px, 0)
		hj.Rotation = 20
		GZ.head = {j = hj, base = 20}
		local sk = limb(hj, 150, 86, 4, 1.0)
		skin(sk, 150, 86, 31, false)
		local cr = cbox(hj, 34, -12, 100, 90, CHAR, 4, 0, 0.5)
		LIMBS[#LIMBS + 1] = {f = cr, sh = 1.0}
		mass(hj, 44, 30, 76, 54, 4, 0.92)
		cbox(hj, 82, -16, 54, 34, C(2, 2, 4), 5, 0.12, 0.5)
		cbox(hj, 118, 4, 56, 14, C(6, 4, 8), 5, 0.4, 0.5)
		local brow = cbox(hj, 82, -35, 64, 14, C(3, 3, 5), 6, 0.1, 0.5)
		brow.Rotation = 14
		local brow2 = cbox(hj, 80, -43, 58, 6, C(118, 96, 104), 6, 0.86, 0.5)
		brow2.Rotation = 14
		cbox(hj, 78, -20, 36, 24, C(26, 14, 18), 6, 0.3, 0.5)
		for k = 1, 3 do
			local ew = cbox(hj, 66 + k * 9, -4 + k * 3, 26, 2.4, C(2, 2, 4), 6, 0.15)
			ew.Rotation = -18 + k * 9
		end
		local hsc = cbox(hj, 52, 10, 34, 8, C(96, 34, 40), 5, 0.3, 0.5)
		hsc.Rotation = 20
		local hsc2 = cbox(hj, 100, -4, 40, 5, C(96, 34, 40), 5, 0.4, 0.5)
		hsc2.Rotation = -8
		local jj = joint(hj, 10, 26)
		GZ.jaw = jj
		limb(jj, 150, 42, 3, 0.7)
		rect(hj, 24, 32, 142, 5, C(70, 16, 26), 5, 0.1)
		for i = 0, 10 do
			if hash(i, 13) > 0.14 then
				local tt = rect(hj, 26 + i * 13 + hash(i, 6) * 5, 33, 4 + hash(i, 7) * 4, 10 + hash(i, 3) * 14, C(200, 188, 170), 6, 0.1)
				tt.Rotation = (hash(i, 8) - 0.5) * 36
			end
		end

		cbox(hj, 78, -20, 24, 15, BLACK, 6, 0.2, 0.5)

		end
	end

	-- ---------- haze layer: drifting smoke in front of the creature ----------
	local function buildHaze()
		local L = Lhaze.f
