		end
	end

	-- ---------- mid city: dense Tokyo blocks, viaduct, stalled train ----------
	local function buildMid()
		local L = Lmid.f
		rect(L, -1000, 720, 5000, 1600, C(10, 12, 16), 1)
		local x, i = 60, 0
		while x < 2960 do
			i = i + 1
			local w = 74 + hash(i, 1) * 110
			local h = 210 + hash(i, 2) * 300 + ((i % 5 == 0) and 90 or 0)
			local top = 720 - h
			local g = 30 + hash(i, 3) * 22
			local body = rect(L, x, top, w, h + 6, C(g, g + 4, g + 12), 2)
			vgrad(body, C(150, 156, 170), C(60, 64, 76))
			local B = {f = body, x = x, w = w, top = top, h = h, dead = false}
			BLD[#BLD + 1] = B
			rect(L, x + w * 0.2, top - 16, w * 0.6, 18, C(g - 4, g, g + 8), 2)
			if hash(i, 4) > 0.5 then
				local ah = 40 + hash(i, 5) * 60
				rect(L, x + w * 0.5 - 1, top - 16 - ah, 2, ah, C(20, 22, 28), 2)
				BEAC[#BEAC + 1] = {g = glow(L, x + w * 0.5, top - 16 - ah, 30, CRIM2, 3), ph = i * 1.3, a0 = 0.9, slow = true}
			end
			for k = 1, 7 do
				if hash(i, 40 + k) > 0.35 then
					addWin(L, x + 8 + hash(i, 50 + k) * (w - 20), top + 20 + hash(i, 60 + k) * (h - 50), 5, 7, 6 + hash(i, 70 + k) * 28, 3, B)
				end
			end
			if i % 4 == 1 then
				body.Rotation = (hash(i, 7) - 0.5) * 3
				local g2 = glow(L, x + w * 0.5, top + 30 + hash(i, 8) * 60, 150 + hash(i, 9) * 80, ORNG, 6)
				FIRES[#FIRES + 1] = {g = g2, t0 = 13 + i * 0.5, ph = i * 2.1, base = 0.55, a = 0}
			end
			x = x + w + 10 + hash(i, 8) * 48
		end
		-- railway viaduct with catenary and a stalled commuter train
		rect(L, -200, 690, 3400, 14, C(20, 22, 28), 4)
		for k = 0, 22 do rect(L, -150 + k * 150, 704, 12, 18, C(16, 18, 24), 4) end
		for k = 0, 14 do rect(L, -100 + k * 220, 600, 4, 92, C(24, 26, 32), 4) end
		rect(L, -200, 612, 3400, 2, C(24, 26, 32), 4)
		for k = 0, 3 do
			local cx = 420 + k * 118
			local car = cbox(L, cx + 56, 670, 112, 36, C(58, 62, 72), 4, 0, 0.12)
			vgrad(car, C(210, 214, 222), C(110, 112, 124))
			addWin(L, cx + 8, 660, 96, 9, 8 + k * 0.7, 5)
		end
		-- beam targets: five towers to the right of the creature
		local tg = {}
		for _, B in ipairs(BLD) do if B.x > 1900 and B.x < 2800 then tg[#tg + 1] = B end end
		local pick = {}
		local n = #tg
		for k = 1, 5 do pick[#pick + 1] = tg[min(n, max(1, floor((k - 0.5) / 5 * n + 1.5)))] end
		E.targets = pick
		-- debris and plumes (pooled)
		for k = 1, N(24) do
			DEB[k] = {f = cbox(L, 0, 0, 8, 8, C(30, 26, 28), 7, 1), t0 = -9, x = 0, y = 0, vx = 0, vy = 0, rot = 0}
		end
		for k = 1, 10 do
			PLM[k] = {f = cbox(L, 0, 0, 100, 80, C(36, 30, 34), 6, 1, 0.5), t0 = -9, x = 0, y = 0, sz = 100}
		end
		for k = 1, 8 do
			local o = cbox(L, 0, 0, 10, 10, ORNG, 8, 1, 0.5)
			local m = cbox(L, 0, 0, 10, 10, AMB, 8, 1, 0.5)
			local c = cbox(L, 0, 0, 10, 10, VIO, 8, 1, 0.5)
			BOOM[k] = {o = o, m = m, c = c, t0 = -9, x = 0, y = 0, s = 200}
		end
	end

		end

	-- ---------- foreground: utility poles, cables, Japanese road signs, traffic signal ----------
	local function buildFg()
		local L = Lfg.f
		local px = {220, 1030, 1800, 2700}
		for _, x in ipairs(px) do
			rect(L, x - 9, -1500, 18, 2600, C(14, 14, 16), 2)
			rect(L, x - 120, -230, 240, 10, C(14, 14, 16), 2)
			rect(L, x - 90, -150, 180, 8, C(14, 14, 16), 2)
			for k = -1, 1, 2 do rect(L, x + k * 104 - 3, -246, 6, 16, C(60, 66, 74), 3) end
		end
		local function cable(x0, y0, x1, y1, sag, n)
			local px0, py0 = x0, y0
			for k = 1, n do
				local u = k / n
				local nx, ny = lerp(x0, x1, u), lerp(y0, y1, u) + sag * 4 * u * (1 - u)
				line(L, px0, py0, nx, ny, 2.2, C(10, 10, 12), 2)
				px0, py0 = nx, ny
			end
		end
		for i = 1, 3 do
			local a, b = px[i], px[i + 1]
			cable(a - 104, -240, b - 104, -240, 70, 8)
			cable(a + 104, -240, b + 104, -240, 80, 8)
			cable(a - 80, -142, b - 80, -142, 60, 8)
		end
		-- no-entry sign
		rect(L, 616, 380, 8, 520, C(36, 38, 44), 2)
		cbox(L, 620, 380, 74, 74, C(190, 24, 34), 3, 0, 0.5)
		cbox(L, 620, 380, 50, 14, WHITE, 4, 0.05)
		-- parking sign
		rect(L, 1396, 330, 8, 570, C(36, 38, 44), 2)
		local bs = rect(L, 1346, 300, 108, 82, C(20, 64, 150), 3)
		mk("UIStroke", bs, {Thickness = 3, Color = WHITE})
		local pt = mk("TextLabel", bs, {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBlack, Text = "P", TextSize = 62, TextColor3 = WHITE, ZIndex = 4, Interactable = false})
		-- highway gantry sign
		rect(L, 2110, 270, 8, 640, C(36, 38, 44), 2)
		rect(L, 2480, 270, 8, 640, C(36, 38, 44), 2)
		local gs = rect(L, 2100, 240, 396, 96, C(18, 100, 64), 3)
		mk("UIStroke", gs, {Thickness = 3, Color = WHITE})
		mk("TextLabel", gs, {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.5), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Text = "SHINAGAWA  3 km", TextSize = 26, TextColor3 = WHITE, ZIndex = 4, Interactable = false})
		mk("TextLabel", gs, {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.5), Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Text = "HANEDA  12 km", TextSize = 26, TextColor3 = WHITE, ZIndex = 4, Interactable = false})
		-- dead traffic signal that stutters
		rect(L, 896, 420, 8, 480, C(30, 32, 38), 2)
		rect(L, 876, 380, 48, 22, C(22, 24, 28), 3)
		rect(L, 872, 372, 56, 14, C(22, 24, 28), 3)
		BEAC[#BEAC + 1] = {g = glow(L, 900, 391, 46, CRIM2, 4), ph = 2.4, a0 = 0.8}
		-- smoke drifting across the foreground
		for i = 1, N(5) do
			local s = 900 + hash(i, 3) * 700
			FGS[#FGS + 1] = {f = cbox(L, 0, 0, s, s * 0.5, C(26, 28, 36), 9, 1, 0.5), x = hash(i, 4) * 3000, y = 120 + hash(i, 5) * 600, v = 36 + hash(i, 6) * 46, s = s, idx = i}
		end
	end

	end

		E.skip = mk("TextButton", stage, {BackgroundTransparency = 1, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 1), Position = UDim2.new(1, -18, 1, -14), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 22), Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 12, TextColor3 = C(200, 206, 216), TextTransparency = 1, Text = "SKIP  [SPACE]", ZIndex = 15})
		conns[#conns + 1] = E.skip.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function() S.skipped = true end)
		E.load = text(stage, 16, 13, C(170, 176, 190), Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
		E.load.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		E.load.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
	end

	-- ---------- timeline data (60 s: desolation / approach / reveal / awakening / buildup / breath / aftermath / title) ----------
	local SHOT = {
		{0, 12, {{0, -80, 95, 1.0, 0}, {6, -48, 86, 1.07, -0.25}, {12, 40, 96, 1.15, -0.9}}},
		{12, 18, {{12, 150, -345, 1.10, 2.0}, {15, 45, -320, 1.18, 1.2}, {18, -60, -300, 1.27, 0.4}}},

		{32, 38, {{32, -125, -215, 1.38, -1.0}, {35, -60, -262, 1.5, -0.3}, {37.5, 0, -308, 1.58, 0.8}, {38, 350, -345, 1.6, 3.0}}},

	local DARK = {{0, 0.95}, {2, 0.9}, {8, 0.62}, {11.8, 0.5}, {12.2, 0.48}, {15, 0.42}, {17.8, 0.36}, {18.2, 0.38}, {22, 0.3}, {25, 0.32}, {28, 0.34}, {32, 0.38}, {38, 0.36}, {41.4, 0.42}, {42.05, 0.1}, {43.5, 0.14}, {47, 0.2}, {49.5, 0.32}, {52, 0.42}, {56, 0.55}, {58, 0.62}, {61, 0.66}}
	-- how much foreground smoke obstructs the frame
	local OBS = {{0, 0.15}, {8, 0.3}, {11.5, 0.45}, {12.4, 0.9}, {16, 0.85}, {17.8, 0.3}, {21, 0.2}, {24.6, 0.55}, {26, 0.25}, {36, 0.3}, {37.6, 0.8}, {38.4, 0.35}, {41, 0.25}, {42.3, 0.05}, {47, 0.1}, {50, 0.45}, {54, 0.55}, {58, 0.3}, {61, 0.2}}
	local function hermite(p0, p1, m0, m1, u)
		local u2 = u * u
		local u3 = u2 * u
		return (2 * u3 - 3 * u2 + 1) * p0 + (u3 - 2 * u2 + u) * m0 + (3 * u2 - 2 * u3) * p1 + (u3 - u2) * m1
	end
	local cam = nil
	-- smooth Catmull-Rom style camera path inside every shot (eases in at the start, no robotic linear motion)
	local function camTarget(t)
		local si = #SHOT
		for i = 1, #SHOT do if t < SHOT[i][2] then si = i break end end
		local k = SHOT[si][3]
		local out = {k[#k][2], k[#k][3], k[#k][4], k[#k][5]}
		if t <= k[1][1] then
			out = {k[1][2], k[1][3], k[1][4], k[1][5]}
		else
			for i = 2, #k do
				if t <= k[i][1] then
					local a, b, pr, nx = k[i - 1], k[i], k[i - 2], k[i + 1]
					local d = b[1] - a[1]
					local u = (t - a[1]) / d
					for c = 2, 5 do
						local m0 = pr and (b[c] - pr[c]) / (b[1] - pr[1]) * d or (b[c] - a[c]) * 0.4
						local m1 = nx and (nx[c] - a[c]) / (nx[1] - a[1]) * d or (b[c] - a[c]) * 0.6
						out[c - 1] = hermite(a[c], b[c], m0, m1, u)
					end
					break
				end
			end
		end
		return out[1], out[2], out[3], out[4], si
	end

	-- ---------- effects spawned by the timeline ----------
	local function ripple(x, y, w, dur)
		local best = E.rings[1]
		for _, r in ipairs(E.rings) do if S.t - r.t0 > r.dur then best = r break end end
		best.t0, best.x, best.y, best.w, best.dur = S.t, x, y, w, dur
	end
	local function shock(x, y, w, dur, col)
		local best = SHOCK[1]
		for _, r in ipairs(SHOCK) do if S.t - r.t0 > r.dur then best = r break end end
		best.t0, best.x, best.y, best.w, best.dur = S.t, x, y, w, dur
		best.st.Color = col or VIO
	end
	local function boom(B, kk)
		if B.dead then return end
		B.dead = true
		kk = kk or 1
		local t = S.t
		local cx, cy = B.x + B.w / 2, B.top + 40
		local bm = BOOM[1]
		for _, b in ipairs(BOOM) do if t - b.t0 > 1.3 then bm = b break end end
		bm.t0, bm.x, bm.y, bm.s = t, cx, cy, 160 + B.w * 1.5
		local pl = PLM[1]
		for _, p in ipairs(PLM) do if t - p.t0 > 6 then pl = p break end end
		pl.t0, pl.x, pl.y, pl.sz = t, cx, B.top, 90 + B.w
		for k = 1, #DEB do
			local d = DEB[k]
			if t - d.t0 > 1.8 then
				d.t0, d.x, d.y = t, cx + (hash(k, t) - 0.5) * B.w, B.top + hash(k, 2) * 60
				d.vx, d.vy, d.rot = (hash(k, 3) - 0.5) * 420, -260 - hash(k, 4) * 320, (hash(k, 5) - 0.5) * 540
				if k > 10 then break end
			end
		end
		B.f.BackgroundColor3 = C(8, 7, 9)
		B.f.Rotation = B.f.Rotation + (hash(cx, 1) - 0.5) * 6
		local g2 = glow(Lmid.f, cx, B.top + 70, 260, ORNG, 6)
		FIRES[#FIRES + 1] = {g = g2, t0 = t, ph = cx, base = 0.95, a = 0, bl = B}
		local sx, sy = project(Lmid, cx, cy)
		shock(sx, sy, 380, 0.9, ORNG)
		S.shake = max(S.shake, 0.35 * kk)
		S.flashK = max(S.flashK, 0.1 * kk)
	end
	local function dboom(i, kk)
		local B = BLD[i]
		if B and not B.dead then boom(B, kk) end
	end
	local EV = {

	for _, e in ipairs(EV) do e[3] = false end

	-- ---------- per-frame updates ----------
	local function updLight(t)
		S.red = c01((ss(18, 30, t) * 0.65 + ss(30, 42, t) * 0.35) * (1 - 0.3 * ss(51, 58, t)))
		S.charge = ss(33, 42, t) * (1 - ss(47.8, 51, t))
		S.B = ss(42, 42.3, t) * (1 - ss(47.5, 49.5, t))
		S.P = c01((ss(26, 42, t) * 0.45 + S.charge * 0.2 + S.B * 0.9) * (1 - ss(48.5, 52, t) * (1 - S.B)))
		S.fb = (ss(42, 45, t) * (1 - ss(49, 54, t))) * 0.6
		S.burn = ss(40, 50, t) * (1 - 0.35 * ss(53, 59, t))
	end
	-- handheld amplitude per scene: almost still -> distant tremor -> light -> moderate -> rising -> impact -> back to stability
	local HAND = {{0, 0.1}, {8, 0.22}, {12, 0.45}, {18, 0.62}, {25, 0.9}, {32, 1.5}, {38, 2.1}, {42, 1.6}, {42.3, 3.0}, {46, 2.4}, {50, 1.2}, {54, 0.6}, {60, 0.25}}
	local function updCam(t, dt)
		local tx, ty, tz, tr, si = camTarget(t)
		if not cam or cam.si ~= si then cam = {x = tx, y = ty, z = tz, r = tr, si = si} end
		local kc = 1 - exp(-3.2 * dt)
		cam.x, cam.y, cam.z, cam.r = lerp(cam.x, tx, kc), lerp(cam.y, ty, kc), lerp(cam.z, tz, kc), lerp(cam.r, tr, kc)
		S.punch = S.punch * exp(-5 * dt)
		local hh = kf(HAND, t) * (0.85 + 0.3 * S.lv) + 5 * S.shake + 2.2 * S.B
		local shx = hh * (sin(t * 2.1) * 0.55 + sin(t * 4.7 + 1.3) * 0.45)
		local shy = hh * (sin(t * 1.7 + 0.6) * 0.55 + sin(t * 5.3) * 0.45)
		if S.shake > 0.02 then
			shx = shx + (math.random() - 0.5) * 7 * S.shake
			shy = shy + (math.random() - 0.5) * 7 * S.shake
		end
		applyCam(cam.x, cam.y, cam.z * (1 + 0.07 * S.punch), cam.r + 1.2 * S.shake * sin(t * 31), shx, shy)
	end
	local function updSky(t)
		setGlow(E.skyRed, 0.03 + 0.5 * S.red + 0.2 * S.fb + 0.1 * S.lv * S.red)
		setGlow(E.skyAft, 0.55 * S.burn * (0.8 + 0.2 * sin(t * 1.3)))
		setGlow(E.skyPur, 0.6 * S.P)
		E.skyVeil.BackgroundTransparency = 0.8 - 0.22 * ss(10, 24, t)
		E.farHaze.BackgroundColor3 = mix(mix(C(62, 76, 98), C(120, 56, 70), S.red), C(120, 90, 170), S.P * 0.5)
		for i = 1, 3 do
			local b = E["band" .. i]
			b.BackgroundColor3 = mix(mix(C(48, 56, 72), C(110, 46, 58), S.red * 0.8), C(120, 90, 170), S.P * 0.5)
			b.BackgroundTransparency = 0.9 - 0.3 * ss(3, 14, t) - 0.08 * ss(36, 50, t)
		end
	end
	-- point on the upper (dorsal) edge of spine segment ci, in root-local space
	local function spinePt(ci, f)
		local a, x, y = GZ.pel.Rotation, 0, 0
		for i = 1, ci - 1 do
			a = a + GZ.ch[i].j.Rotation
			x = x + GZ.ch[i].len * cos(a * RAD)
			y = y + GZ.ch[i].len * sin(a * RAD)
		end
		local c = GZ.ch[ci]
		a = a + c.j.Rotation
		local d, off = c.len * f, c.th * 0.5
		return x + d * cos(a * RAD) + off * sin(a * RAD), y + d * sin(a * RAD) - off * cos(a * RAD)
	end
	-- point along tail segment ci, in root-local space
	local function tailPt(ci, f)
		local a = GZ.pel.Rotation + GZ.tail[1].j.Rotation
		local x, y = -50, 70
		for i = 2, ci do
			x = x + GZ.tail[i - 1].len * cos(a * RAD)
			y = y + GZ.tail[i - 1].len * sin(a * RAD)
			a = a + GZ.tail[i].j.Rotation
		end
		local d = GZ.tail[ci].len * f
		return x + d * cos(a * RAD), y + d * sin(a * RAD)
	end
	local function muzzleLocal()
		local a = GZ.pel.Rotation
		local x, y = 0, 0
		for i = 1, 4 do
			a = a + GZ.ch[i].j.Rotation
			x = x + GZ.ch[i].len * cos(a * RAD)
			y = y + GZ.ch[i].len * sin(a * RAD)
		end
		a = a + GZ.head.j.Rotation
		local mx, my = 172, 28
		return x + mx * cos(a * RAD) - my * sin(a * RAD), y + mx * sin(a * RAD) + my * cos(a * RAD)
	end
	local function updGZ(t, dt)
		local R = kf(RISE, t)
		GZ.root.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(1500 + 10 * sin(t * 0.33), 560 + R + 4 * sin(t * 0.61))
		GZ.pel.Rotation = 1.1 * sin(t * 0.27) + 0.8 * S.shake * sin(t * 23)
		local br = 1.4 * ss(24, 30, t) * sin(t * 0.95)
		for i, c in ipairs(GZ.ch) do c.j.Rotation = c.base + 1.6 * sin(t * 0.38 + i * 0.8) + br * ((i == 2) and 1 or 0.5) end
		-- head: rises at the reveal, stirs at the awakening, tilts back while charging, drops during the sweep and slumps afterwards
		local lift = -8 * ss(17, 24, t) - 5 * ss(26, 33, t) - 9 * S.charge + 10 * ss(42.4, 47, t) + 8 * ss(49, 56, t)
		GZ.head.j.Rotation = GZ.head.base + 3.5 * sin(t * 0.23) + 4 * ss(24, 28, t) * (1 - ss(32, 36, t)) * sin(t * 0.8) + lift
		local jaw = (3 + 4 * ss(20, 26, t) + 2.5 * ss(27, 33, t) * sin(t * 1.3) ^ 2 + 4 * ss(34, 38, t) + 18 * ss(38.6, 41.8, t) + 4 * ss(41.8, 42.2, t) + 1.5 * sin(t * 0.4)) * (1 - 0.78 * ss(48.5, 51, t))
		GZ.jaw.Rotation = jaw
		-- tail: heavy inertia, every joint trails the one before it
		local nT = #GZ.tail
		local grow = 0.7 + 0.5 * ss(20, 34, t)
		for i, tj in ipairs(GZ.tail) do
			local amp = ((i == 1) and 2.2 or (2.2 + i * 0.5)) * grow
			local target = tj.base + amp * sin(t * 0.46 - i * 0.58) + 1.2 * sin(t * 0.21 + i * 0.9) - 4 * S.B * (i / nT)
			tj.a = lerp(tj.a, target, 1 - exp(-(3.2 - i * 0.12) * dt))
			tj.j.Rotation = tj.a
		end
		-- colour cost is only paid once the creature is actually on screen
		local base0 = mix(C(7, 7, 11), CHAR, ss(16, 26, t))
		local base = mix(mix(base0, C(92, 18, 34), S.red * 0.45), C(120, 88, 160), S.P * 0.45)
		base = mix(base, C(5, 5, 8), ss(49, 53, t) * 0.78)
		if R < 880 then
			for _, L in ipairs(LIMBS) do L.f.BackgroundColor3 = mix(BLACK, base, L.sh) end
			local faint = 0.12 * ss(18, 26, t)
			local fr = c01((t - 28) / 14)
			local fade = 1 - 0.85 * ss(49, 55, t)
			for _, P in ipairs(PLATES) do
				-- individual activation: tail tip first, then along the spine toward the head
				local g = max(faint, c01((fr * 1.35 - P.ratio * 0.9 + P.jit) / 0.4))
				if S.B > 0.05 then g = max(g, S.B * (0.75 + 0.25 * sin(t * 9 + P.ratio * 12))) end
				g = g * (0.88 + 0.12 * S.lv) * fade
				local b2 = mix(base0, CRIM, g * 0.55)
				P.st[1].BackgroundColor3 = b2
				P.st[2].BackgroundColor3 = mix(b2, CRIM2, g * 0.5)
				P.st[3].BackgroundColor3 = mix(b2, PURP, g * 0.7)
				if P.st[4] then P.st[4].BackgroundColor3 = mix(b2, PURP, g * 0.85) end
				for i = 1, #P.tips do P.tips[i].BackgroundColor3 = P.st[P.tipOf[i]].BackgroundColor3 end
				P.core.BackgroundColor3 = mix(CRIM2, VIO, g)
				P.core.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - c01(g * 1.1 - 0.05)
				P.halo.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - 0.22 * g * g
			end
			-- fissures spread progressively over the body
			local ven = (0.08 + 0.5 * S.red + 0.3 * S.P) * ss(20, 28, t) * (1 - 0.75 * ss(49, 56, t))
			local spread = c01((t - 24) / 14)
			local nV = max(#VEINS, 1)
			for vi, v in ipairs(VEINS) do
				local on = 0.25 + 0.75 * c01(spread * 1.6 - (vi / nV) * 0.6)
				v.f.BackgroundColor3 = mix(CRIM2, VIO, S.P)
				v.f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - c01(ven * on * (0.6 + 0.4 * sin(t * 1.7 + v.ph)))
			end
			-- the eye never glows continuously: it only flares at three moments
			local eyeA = 0.8 * (ss(25.0, 25.5, t) * (1 - ss(26.4, 27.0, t)) + ss(31.6, 32.0, t) * (1 - ss(32.5, 33.1, t)) + ss(39.4, 40.4, t) * (1 - ss(41.6, 42.1, t)))
			GZ.eye.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - c01(eyeA)
			glowPos(GZ.mouth, 168, 30, 0.2 + S.charge * 1.7 + S.B * 0.6)
			setGlow(GZ.mouth, S.charge * S.charge * S.charge * 0.9 + 0.9 * S.B)
			GZ.mouthIn.BackgroundColor3 = mix(CRIM2, VIO, S.charge)
			GZ.mouthIn.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - c01(S.charge * 1.1 + S.B) * 0.85
			-- smoke rising from the body and jaw
			local rate = 0.45 * ss(20, 28, t) + 1.6 * ss(30, 42, t) + 1.0 * S.B + 0.6 * ss(49, 55, t)
			for _, p in ipairs(GZ.vent) do
				local age = t - p.t0
				if age > p.life then
					p.f.BackgroundTransparency = 1
					if t > 20 and math.random() < rate * dt then
						local lx, ly
						if t > 34 and math.random() < 0.3 then
							lx, ly = muzzleLocal()
						else
							lx, ly = spinePt(1 + floor(math.random() * 3), 0.15 + math.random() * 0.75)
						end
						p.t0, p.x, p.y, p.life, p.sz = t, lx, ly, 3.6 + math.random() * 2.2, 50 + math.random() * 60
					end
				else
					local a = age / p.life
					p.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(p.x + 26 * a + 8 * sin(t + p.sz), p.y - 190 * eo3(a))
					local s = p.sz * (1 + 2.2 * a)
					p.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(s, s * 0.8)
					p.f.BackgroundColor3 = mix(mix(C(34, 32, 40), C(120, 36, 40), S.red * 0.7), C(130, 90, 170), S.P * 0.6)
					p.f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - 0.38 * sin(a * pi)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local function muzzle()
		local x, y = muzzleLocal()
		return GZ.root.Position.X.Offset + x, GZ.root.Position.Y.Offset + y
	end
	local function updWater(t, dt)
		local amp = 0.3 + 0.7 * ss(5, 14, t)
		local vis = 1 - ss(12, 12.4, t) * 0.55
		for _, r in ipairs(RIPS) do
			r.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(r.x + 12 * sin(t * 0.2 + r.ph), r.y)
			r.f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - (0.04 + 0.26 * amp) * (0.5 + 0.5 * sin(t * 0.9 + r.ph)) * vis
		end
		for _, m in ipairs(MIST) do
			m.x = m.x + m.v * dt
			if m.x > 3700 then m.x = -700 end
			m.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(m.x, m.y + 8 * sin(t * 0.3 + m.v))
			m.f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - (0.2 * (1 - 0.3 * ss(10, 18, t)) + 0.05 + 0.06 * S.burn) * (0.4 + 0.6 * ss(0.5, 4, t))
			m.f.BackgroundColor3 = mix(C(86, 100, 120), C(140, 60, 66), S.red * 0.6)
		end
		-- a vast shape moves beneath the surface
		local sh = ss(4.5, 11.2, t) * (1 - ss(12, 12.3, t))
		E.shadow.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(lerp(700, 1260, ss(4.5, 12, t)), 772)
		E.shadow.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(lerp(420, 1500, ss(4.5, 12, t)), lerp(60, 230, ss(4.5, 12, t)))
		E.shadow.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - 0.78 * sh
		E.pRefl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(mapX(Lgz, 1750, Lwat), 760)
		E.pRefl.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - c01(0.5 * S.B + 0.22 * S.charge * S.charge + 0.1 * S.P)
		for _, r in ipairs(E.rings) do
			local a = (t - r.t0) / r.dur
			if a >= 0 and a <= 1 then
				local w = r.w * (0.15 + a)
				r.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(r.x, r.y)
				r.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, w * 0.2)
				r.st.Transparency = 0.2 + 0.8 * a
			else
				r.st.Transparency = 1
			end
		end
		for _, rf in ipairs(E.refl) do
			rf.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(mapX(Lfar, rf.fr.x, Lwat), 700 + 20 * sin(t * 2 + rf.fr.ph))
			rf.f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - c01(rf.fr.a * 0.5)
		end
		for _, b in ipairs(BEAC) do
			local on
			if b.slow then on = (floor(t * 1.0 + b.ph) % 2 == 0) and 0.9 or 0.1 else on = (sin(t * 7 + b.ph) > 0.2) and b.a0 or 0.05 end
			if t > 8.5 and t < 9.2 and not b.slow and b.ph > 2.4 then on = 0 end
			setGlow(b.g, on * ss(1, 4, t))
		end
	end
	local function updFires(t)
		for _, fr in ipairs(FIRES) do
			local t0 = fr.bl and fr.t0 or fr.t0 * 1.5
			local a = ss(t0, t0 + 3.2, t) * fr.base * (0.72 + 0.28 * sin(t * 11 + fr.ph) * sin(t * 6.3 + fr.ph * 2)) * (0.65 + 0.35 * ss(20, 48, t))
			a = c01(a * (1 + S.fb + 0.3 * S.lv * S.burn))
			fr.a = a
			setGlow(fr.g, a)
		end
	end
	local function updWins(t)
		for _, w in ipairs(WINS) do
			local woff = w.off * 1.55 + 2
			local on = t < woff
			if abs(t - woff) < 0.6 then on = (floor(t * 18 + w.ph) % 2 == 0) end
			if w.bl and w.bl.dead then on = false end
			if on ~= w.vis then
				w.vis = on
				w.f.BackgroundTransparency = on and 0.12 or 1
			end
		end
	end
	local function updSmoke(t, dt)
		local amtT = 0.16 + 0.3 * ss(6, 16, t) + 0.22 * ss(16, 30, t) + 0.12 * ss(36, 50, t)
		local col = mix(mix(C(30, 32, 42), C(110, 36, 42), S.red * 0.7), C(110, 80, 150), S.P * 0.5)
		local obs = kf(OBS, t)
		for _, s in ipairs(FGS) do
			s.x = s.x + s.v * dt
			if s.x > 3500 then s.x = -700 end
			s.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(s.x, s.y + 14 * sin(t * 0.25 + s.idx))
			s.f.BackgroundColor3 = mix(mix(C(22, 24, 32), C(90, 30, 36), S.red * 0.6), C(100, 70, 140), S.P * 0.5)
			s.f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - (0.1 + 0.42 * obs) * (0.6 + 0.4 * sin(t * 0.3 + s.idx * 2) ^ 2)
		end
		for _, s in ipairs(SMK) do
			s.y = s.y - s.vy * dt
			s.x = s.x + s.vx * dt
			s.sz = s.sz + s.gr * dt
			if s.y < 120 or s.x > 3200 then s.y, s.x, s.sz = 700 + hash(s.idx, t) * 40, -200 + hash(s.idx, 1) * 800, s.sz0 end
			s.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(s.x, s.y)
			s.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(s.sz, s.sz * 0.72)
			s.f.BackgroundColor3 = col
			s.f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - amtT * 0.45
		end
		for _, p in ipairs(PLM) do
			local a = (t - p.t0) / 5
			if a >= 0 and a < 1 then
				local sz = p.sz * (1 + 2.4 * eo3(a))
				p.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(p.x + 40 * a, p.y - 260 * eo3(a))
				p.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sz, sz * 0.8)
				p.f.BackgroundColor3 = mix(C(90, 34, 30), C(26, 24, 30), a * 1.6)
				p.f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.3 + 0.7 * a * a
			else
				p.f.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			end
		end
		for _, b in ipairs(BOOM) do
			local a = (t - b.t0) / 1.1
			if a >= 0 and a < 1 then
				local s = b.s * (0.2 + 0.8 * eo3(a * 1.3))
				for _, f in ipairs({b.o, b.m, b.c}) do f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(b.x, b.y) end
				b.o.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(s, s)
				b.m.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(s * 0.62, s * 0.62)
				b.c.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(s * 0.3, s * 0.3)
				b.o.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45 + 0.55 * a
				b.m.BackgroundTransparency = 0.2 + 0.8 * a
				b.c.BackgroundTransparency = max(0, a * 2 - 0.2)
			else
				b.o.BackgroundTransparency, b.m.BackgroundTransparency, b.c.BackgroundTransparency = 1, 1, 1
			end
		end
		for _, d in ipairs(DEB) do
			local a = t - d.t0
			if a >= 0 and a < 1.8 then
				d.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(d.x + d.vx * a, d.y + d.vy * a + 620 * a * a)
				d.f.Rotation = d.rot * a
				d.f.BackgroundTransparency = max(0, (a - 1.2) / 0.6)
			else
				d.f.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			end
		end
	end
	local function updBeam(t, dt)
		local mx, my = project(Lgz, muzzle())
		E.mx, E.my = mx, my
		local act = S.charge > 0.02 or S.B > 0.01
		local ch, B = S.charge, S.B
		-- aim: strikes the nearest tower, then sweeps right along the skyline and lifts into the sky
		local ax, ay = mx + S.sx * 0.5, my + S.sy * 0.3
		local tg = E.targets
		if tg and tg[1] then
			local pts = {}
			for i, b in ipairs(tg) do
				local px, py = project(Lmid, b.x + b.w / 2, b.top + b.h * 0.2)
				pts[i] = {px, py}
			end
			local tt = {42.0, 42.6, 44.0, 45.4, 46.6, 47.7, 49.4}
			local p0 = {pts[1][1] - 40, pts[1][2] - 190}
			local list = {p0, pts[1], pts[2], pts[3], pts[4], pts[5], {pts[5][1] + S.sx * 0.35, pts[5][2] - S.sy * 0.9}}
			if t <= tt[1] then ax, ay = p0[1], p0[2]
			elseif t >= tt[7] then ax, ay = list[7][1], list[7][2]
			else
				for i = 2, 7 do
					if t <= tt[i] then
						local u = ss(0, 1, (t - tt[i - 1]) / (tt[i] - tt[i - 1]))
						ax, ay = lerp(list[i - 1][1], list[i][1], u), lerp(list[i - 1][2], list[i][2], u)
						break
					end
				end
			end
		end
		local dx, dy = ax - mx, ay - my
		local ang = atan2(dy, dx)
		local dist = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy)
		local len = dist + S.sx * 0.7
		local pulse = 1 + 0.06 * sin(t * 38) + 0.04 * sin(t * 71) + 0.1 * S.lv
		local fn = S.sy / 900
		local function setB(f, h, tr)
			f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(mx + cos(ang) * len / 2, my + sin(ang) * len / 2)
			f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(len, max(h, 1))
			f.Rotation = ang * DEG
			f.BackgroundTransparency = tr
		end
		if B > 0.01 then
			setB(E.bm.fringe, 300 * fn * B * pulse, 1 - 0.14 * B)
			setB(E.bm.outer, 200 * fn * B * pulse, 1 - 0.3 * B)
			setB(E.bm.mid, 96 * fn * B * pulse, 1 - 0.62 * B)
			setB(E.bm.core, 30 * fn * B * pulse, 1 - 0.98 * B)
			setB(E.bm.hot, 12 * fn * B * pulse, 1 - 0.95 * B)
		else
			for _, f in pairs(E.bm) do f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 end
		end
		glowPos(E.muzG, mx, my, 0.5 + ch * 0.8 + B * 0.8)
		setGlow(E.muzG, 0.5 * ch * ch + 0.8 * B)
		glowPos(E.impG, ax, ay, 0.6 + B * 0.6)
		setGlow(E.impG, 0.75 * B * ss(42.2, 42.5, t))
		local sl = S.sx * (0.12 + 1.1 * ch * ch + 0.6 * B)
		E.streak.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(mx, my)
		E.streak.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sl, 2 + 6 * B + 2 * ch)
		E.streak.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - c01(0.65 * ch * ch + 0.9 * B)
		if not act then E.streak.BackgroundTransparency = 1 end
		-- thermal flame at the jaw: smoke -> orange fire -> concentrated beam
		local fk = ss(38.6, 41.9, t) * (1 - 0.55 * ss(42, 42.6, t)) * (1 - ss(48, 50, t))
		if fk > 0.01 then
			local fl0 = S.sx * 0.2 * fk * (0.85 + 0.15 * sin(t * 33) * sin(t * 21))
			local function setF(f, len, h, tr)
				f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(mx + cos(ang) * len / 2, my + sin(ang) * len / 2)
				f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(max(len, 1), max(h, 1))
				f.Rotation = ang * DEG
				f.BackgroundTransparency = tr
			end
			setF(E.flm.o, fl0, 70 * fn * fk, 1 - 0.34 * fk)
			setF(E.flm.m, fl0 * 0.7, 42 * fn * fk, 1 - 0.55 * fk)
			setF(E.flm.c, fl0 * 0.4, 20 * fn * fk, 1 - 0.8 * fk)
		else
			for _, f in pairs(E.flm) do f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 end
		end
		-- secondary radiation: dorsal plates and tail discharge while the main beam fires
		local rx, ry = GZ.root.Position.X.Offset, GZ.root.Position.Y.Offset
		for i, s in ipairs(E.sb) do
			local kk = ss(42.9 + i * 0.2, 43.6 + i * 0.2, t) * (1 - ss(46.6 + i * 0.1, 48.4 + i * 0.1, t))
			if kk > 0.01 then
				local lx, ly
				if i == 1 then lx, ly = spinePt(1, 0.55)
				elseif i == 2 then lx, ly = spinePt(2, 0.35)
				elseif i == 3 then lx, ly = spinePt(2, 0.85)
				elseif i == 4 then lx, ly = spinePt(3, 0.5)
				elseif i == 5 then lx, ly = tailPt(6, 0.5)
				else lx, ly = tailPt(#GZ.tail, 1) end
				local px2, py2 = project(Lgz, rx + lx, ry + ly)
				local ba = ((i <= 4) and (-1.75 - 0.12 * i) or ((i == 5) and -2.1 or -2.7)) + 0.12 * sin(t * 3.1 + i * 1.7)
				local lenS = S.sy * ((i <= 4) and (0.7 + 0.12 * i) or 0.5) * kk
				local wS = ((i <= 4) and 14 or 10) * fn * kk * (0.85 + 0.3 * S.lv)
				local pos, rot = UDim2.fromOffset(px2 + cos(ba) * lenS / 2, py2 + sin(ba) * lenS / 2), ba * DEG
				s.f.Position, s.f.Rotation = pos, rot
				s.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(max(lenS, 1), max(wS, 1))
				s.f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - 0.95 * kk
				s.g.Position, s.g.Rotation = pos, rot
				s.g.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(max(lenS, 1), max(wS * 4, 1))
				s.g.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - 0.28 * kk
			else
				s.f.BackgroundTransparency, s.g.BackgroundTransparency = 1, 1
			end
		end

	end
	local function updFx(t, dt)
		local sx, sy = S.sx, S.sy
		local rainAmt = ss(0.4, 4, t) * (1 - 0.6 * ss(26, 40, t)) * (1 - 0.25 * ss(50, 58, t))
		for _, r in ipairs(RAINP) do
			r.y = r.y + r.v * dt * 0.9
			if r.y > 1.05 then r.y = -0.05 r.x = hash(r.idx, t) end
			r.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(r.x * sx - r.y * sy * 0.2, r.y * sy)
			r.f.BackgroundTransparency = (r.idx / #RAINP < rainAmt) and 0.76 or 1
		end
		local ashAmt = 0.18 + 0.4 * ss(3, 14, t) + 0.42 * ss(20, 34, t)
		local fz = 0.2 + 0.8 * S.B
		for _, a in ipairs(ASHP) do
			a.y = a.y + a.vy * dt / sy
			a.x = a.x + (a.vx + 14 * sin(t * 0.7 + a.ph)) * dt / sx
			if a.y > 1.03 then a.y = -0.03 end
			if a.x > 1.03 then a.x = -0.03 elseif a.x < -0.03 then a.x = 1.03 end
			a.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(a.x * sx, a.y * sy)
			local vis = (a.idx / #ASHP) < ashAmt
			if (a.ember or a.h > (0.8 - 0.45 * S.burn)) and S.red > 0.2 then
				a.f.BackgroundColor3 = mix(C(255, 110, 40), C(255, 190, 110), 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(t * 6 + a.ph))
				a.f.BackgroundTransparency = vis and 0.1 or 1
			else
				a.f.BackgroundColor3 = mix(C(120, 122, 132), C(200, 160, 180), S.P * 0.6)
				a.f.BackgroundTransparency = vis and (0.45 - 0.2 * fz) or 1
			end
		end
		for _, s in ipairs(SHOCK) do
			local a = (t - s.t0) / s.dur
			if a >= 0 and a <= 1 then
				local w = s.w * eo3(a)
				s.f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(s.x, s.y)
				s.f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, w)
				s.st.Transparency = 0.1 + 0.9 * a
				s.st.Thickness = 1 + 5 * (1 - a)
			else
				s.st.Transparency = 1
			end
		end
		if floor(t * 30) % 2 == 0 then
			for _, g in ipairs(GRAIN) do
				g.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.random() * sx, math.random() * sy)
				g.BackgroundTransparency = 0.86 + math.random() * 0.1
			end
		end
	end
	local function updPost(t, dt)
		local sx, sy = S.sx, S.sy
		S.shake = S.shake * exp(-4.5 * dt)
		S.flashK = S.flashK * exp(-7 * dt)
		S.white = S.white * exp(-9 * dt)
		local dk = kf(DARK, t)
		-- the beam briefly lifts exposure, the dying skyline sinks it
		E.dark.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - dk
		local gc = mix(mix(C(10, 18, 32), C(70, 8, 18), ss(18, 30, t)), C(44, 16, 74), ss(33, 42, t))
		gc = mix(gc, C(120, 90, 190), S.B * 0.5)
		gc = mix(gc, C(14, 8, 12), ss(50, 57, t) * 0.8)
		E.grade.BackgroundColor3 = gc
		E.grade.BackgroundTransparency = 0.86 - 0.1 * ss(22, 30, t) - 0.1 * S.B
		local fl = S.flashK
		if S.skipT then fl = max(fl, c01((t - S.skipT) / 0.3)) end
		E.flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - c01(fl) * 0.7
		E.white.BackgroundTransparency = S.skipT and 1 or (1 - c01(S.white))
		E.flash.BackgroundColor3 = S.skipT and BLACK or mix(VIO, WHITE, S.B)
		local vgS = 0.55 + 0.2 * ss(18, 40, t) + 0.08 * ss(50, 58, t)
		for i = 1, 4 do E.vg[i].BackgroundTransparency = 1 - vgS end
		local ca = 0.22 * (S.charge * S.charge + S.B * 1.2) + 0.3 * S.shake
		E.caL.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - c01(ca) * 0.6
		E.caR.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - c01(ca) * 0.6
		-- scope bars (2.39:1 where the screen allows it)
		local bar = max((sy - sx / 2.39) / 2, sy * 0.045)
		bar = min(bar, sy * 0.14) * ss(0, 3, t) * (1 - ss(59.4, 59.9, t))
		E.barT.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, floor(bar))
		E.barB.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, floor(bar))
		E.bar = bar
		-- cuts hide behind a very short dip
		local d = 0
		if not S.skipT then
			for _, c in ipairs(CUTS) do d = max(d, c01(1 - abs(t - c) / 0.2)) end
		end
		E.dip.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - 0.95 * d * d
		-- hand-off
		local va = ss(58.7, 59.3, t)
		local fade = ss(59.55, 60, t)
		local vv = (S.skipT and c01((t - S.skipT) / 0.3)) or va
		E.veil.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - vv * (1 - fade)
		stage.BackgroundTransparency = fade
		world.Visible = t < 59.35 and not (S.skipT and vv >= 1)
		E.skip.TextTransparency = 1 - 0.55 * ss(1, 2.5, t) * (1 - ss(57, 58, t))
	end
	local function updHud(t, dt)
		local bar = E.bar or 0
		local a = ss(0.8, 2.5, t) * (1 - ss(11.2, 12, t))
		local x0, y0 = 26, bar + 18
		if floor(t * 8) ~= S.hudTick then
			S.hudTick = floor(t * 8)
			E.hud[1].Text = "TOKYO BAY  35.60N 139.77E  //  SURFACE MONITOR"
			E.hud[2].Text = string.format("SEISMIC  %.2f   DISPLACEMENT  %04.1f m", 0.2 + 0.2 * t + 0.1 * hash(S.hudTick, 1), 0.3 * t * t / 8)
			E.hud[3].Text = string.format("UNIDENTIFIED OBJECT  DEPTH %03d m", max(18, floor(92 - t * 4.2)))
		end
		for i = 1, 3 do
			E.hud[i].Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x0, y0 + (i - 1) * 16)
			E.hud[i].TextTransparency = 1 - a * (i == 1 and 0.45 or 0.6)
		end
		local sa = ss(2, 4, t) * (1 - ss(11.2, 12, t))
		local ampH = 3 + 22 * ss(3, 12, t)
		for i, b in ipairs(E.seis) do
			local h = 3 + ampH * hash(i + floor(t * 9), 3) * (0.4 + 0.6 * sin(i * 0.6 + t * 2) ^ 2)
			b.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(x0 + i * 6, S.sy - bar - 24 - h)
			b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(3, h)
			b.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - sa * 0.45
		end
		local ba = ss(6.5, 7.4, t) * (1 - ss(11.2, 11.8, t)) * 0.5
		local cx, cy = S.sx * 0.58 + 6 * sin(t * 1.1), S.sy * 0.7 + 4 * sin(t * 0.8)
		local bw, bh = 110 + 30 * ss(6.5, 11.5, t), 46
		local corners = {{-1, -1}, {1, -1}, {-1, 1}, {1, 1}}
		for i, c in ipairs(corners) do
			E.brk[i * 2 - 1].Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx + c[1] * bw / 2 - (c[1] > 0 and 14 or 0), cy + c[2] * bh / 2)
			E.brk[i * 2].Position = UDim2.fromOffset(cx + c[1] * bw / 2 - (c[1] > 0 and 2 or 0), cy + c[2] * bh / 2 - (c[2] > 0 and 14 or 0))
			E.brk[i * 2].Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2, 14)
			E.brk[i * 2 - 1].BackgroundTransparency = 1 - ba
			E.brk[i * 2].BackgroundTransparency = 1 - ba
		end
	end
	local function updTitle(t)
		if t < 56 then return end
		local sx, sy = S.sx, S.sy
		local sz = min(sx * 0.074, sy * 0.17)
		E.tcs.Scale = sz / 100
		local cy = sy * 0.47
		E.tc.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sx / 2, cy)
		local out = 1 - ss(59.3, 59.75, t)
		local sh = 0.5 + 0.5 * sin(t * 2.2)
		local rad = ss(57, 58.4, t) * out
		local ctr = (E.tcw or 0) / 2
		for i, L in ipairs(TL) do
			local p = ss(L.t0, L.t0 + 0.6, t)
			local pc = ss(L.t0, L.t0 + 0.25, t) * (1 - ss(L.t0 + 0.25, L.t0 + 0.7, t))
			local spread = (L.x - ctr) * 0.06 * (1 - p)
			L.lb.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(L.x + spread, 10 + (1 - p) * 26)
			L.gl.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(L.x + spread + 3 * pc, 14 + (1 - p) * 26)
			L.lb.TextTransparency = 1 - p * out
			L.gl.TextTransparency = 1 - p * out * (0.3 + 0.15 * sh + 0.4 * pc + 0.2 * rad)
			L.sk.Color = mix(C(8, 4, 6), PURP, 0.55 * rad * (0.6 + 0.4 * sin(t * 3 + i * 0.7)))
			L.gr.Offset = Vector2.new(0, 0.05 * sin(t * 1.3 + i * 0.5))
		end
		local rp = ss(56.4, 57.7, t)
		E.rule.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sx / 2, cy + sz * 0.78)
		E.rule.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sx * 0.46 * rp, 3)
		E.rule.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - out * (0.9 * rp)
		local sp = ss(57.7, 58.7, t)
		E.sub.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sx / 2, cy + sz * 0.78 + 28)
		E.sub.TextTransparency = 1 - sp * 0.85 * out
		glowPos(E.tGlow, sx / 2, cy, 1)
		setGlow(E.tGlow, (0.2 * ss(56.8, 58.5, t) * (0.8 + 0.2 * sh) + 0.12 * S.lv * rad) * out)
		-- smoke drifting through the lettering
		for i, f in ipairs(E.tSm) do
			local k = (t * 0.035 + i * 0.37) % 1
			f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sx * (0.15 + 0.7 * k), cy + (i - 2) * sz * 0.38)
			f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(sx * 0.46, sz * 1.1)
			f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - 0.2 * ss(56.2, 58.2, t) * out * (0.6 + 0.4 * sin(t * 0.7 + i * 2) ^ 2)
		end
	end
	local function audioGain(t)
		local g = 1 - ss(57.8, 60, t)
		if S.skipT then g = g * (1 - c01((t - S.skipT) / 0.35)) end
		return g
	end

	local function loop()
		do
			local w0, lim = os.clock(), opts.ReadyWait or 8
			E.load.TextTransparency = 0.3
			while opts.Ready and not opts.Ready() and os.clock() - w0 < lim and not S.skipped do
				if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then break end
				local prog = SONG.Progress
				E.load.Text = "LOADING SOUNDTRACK" .. string.rep(".", floor(os.clock() * 3) % 4) .. ((type(prog) == "number" and prog > 0 and prog < 1) and string.format("  %d%%", floor(prog * 100)) or "")
				RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
			end
			if opts.Failed and opts.Failed() then
				S.fallback = true
				return
			end
			E.load.Text = ""
			E.load.TextTransparency = 1
			S.began = os.clock()
			S.wall0 = S.began
		end
		local okV, vv = pcall(function() return Music.Volume end)
		S.v0 = (okV and type(vv) == "number" and vv > 0.01) and vv or 1
		while true do
			local dt = min(RunService.Heartbeat:Wait(), 0.1)
			local t = os.clock() - S.began
			do
				local okP, pos, playing = pcall(function() return Music.TimePosition, Music.IsPlaying end)
				if okP and playing and type(pos) == "number" and pos > 0.05 then
					local now = os.clock()
					if pos ~= S.lastPos then S.lastPos, S.lastPosAt = pos, now end
					local est = pos + min(now - (S.lastPosAt or now), 0.1)
					local d = est - t
					if abs(d) > 0.25 then S.began = now - est else S.began = S.began - d * 0.35 end
					t = now - S.began
				end
			end
			if S.skipped and S.tEnd == DUR then
				S.tEnd = t + 0.35
				S.skipT = t
			end
			if t >= S.tEnd or t > DUR + 4 or os.clock() - S.wall0 > DUR + 8 then break end
			S.t = t
			local sz = stage.AbsoluteSize
			S.sx, S.sy = max(sz.X, 160), max(sz.Y, 120)
			S.fit = max(S.sx / 1600, S.sy / 900)
			local okL, raw = pcall(function() return Music.PlaybackLoudness end)
			raw = (okL and type(raw) == "number") and raw or 0
			S.pk = max(S.pk * exp(-0.04 * dt), raw, 60)
			S.lv = lerp(S.lv, c01(raw / S.pk), 1 - exp(-9 * dt))
			updLight(t)
			for _, e in ipairs(EV) do
				if not e[3] and t >= e[1] then e[3] = true guard("event", e[2]) end
			end
			guard("cam", updCam, t, dt)
			guard("sky", updSky, t)
			guard("gz", updGZ, t, dt)
			guard("water", updWater, t, dt)
			guard("fires", updFires, t)
			guard("windows", updWins, t)
			guard("smoke", updSmoke, t, dt)
			guard("beam", updBeam, t, dt)
			guard("fx", updFx, t, dt)
			guard("post", updPost, t, dt)
			guard("hud", updHud, t, dt)
			guard("title", updTitle, t)
			pcall(function() Music.Volume = S.v0 * audioGain(t) end)
		end
	end

	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		guard("buildSky", buildSky)
		guard("buildFar", buildFar)
		guard("buildGZ", buildGZ)
		guard("buildHaze", buildHaze)
		guard("buildMid", buildMid)
		guard("buildWater", buildWater)
		guard("buildFg", buildFg)
		buildScreen()
		loop()
	end)
	if not ok then warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro 15 error (continuing): " .. tostring(err)) end
	for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
	pcall(function() stage:Destroy() end)
	FX.IntroCamBusy = false
	if S.skipped then
		-- skipped: hand the soundtrack back gently and let it keep playing
		if S.v0 then
			task.spawn(function()
				local from = 0
				pcall(function() from = Music.Volume end)
				local t0 = os.clock()
				while os.clock() - t0 < 0.6 do
					pcall(function() Music.Volume = lerp(from, S.v0, ss(0, 0.6, os.clock() - t0)) end)
					RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
				end
				pcall(function() Music.Volume = S.v0 end)
			end)
		end
	else
		-- exactly 60 s: the faded soundtrack is parked cleanly and the player is ready for the next track
		pcall(function()
			Music:Pause()
			Music.TimePosition = 0
			Music.Volume = S.v0
		end)
	end
	if S.fallback then return "fallback" end
	FX.IntroActive = false
	return true
end
]==]
function FX.Intro15(MainFrame, Music, _, opts)
	if FX.Intro15Fn == nil then
		FX.Intro15Fn = false
		local ls = loadstring or load
		if ls then
			local okC, fn, cerr = pcall(ls, FX.Intro15Src, "=Intro15")
			if okC and type(fn) == "function" then
				local okR, f2 = pcall(fn, Util, FX)
				if okR and type(f2) == "function" then FX.Intro15Fn = f2 end
			else
				warn("[UhhhhhhFX] intro 15 unavailable: " .. tostring(cerr or fn))
			end
		end
	end
	if not FX.Intro15Fn then return "fallback" end
	return FX.Intro15Fn(MainFrame, Music, _, opts)
end
function FX.BuildLoader(host, env)
local L = {Visible = false, p = 0, target = 0}
local showToken = 0
local capT = 0
local root = Util.Instance("Frame", host)
root.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
root.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
root.BackgroundTransparency = 1
root.BorderSizePixel = 0
root.Visible = false
root.ZIndex = 40
root.ClipsDescendants = true
local function label(size, ax, ay, pos, sz)
local l = Util.Instance("TextLabel", root)
l.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay)
l.Position = pos
l.Size = sz
l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
l.Font = Enum.Font.Code
l.TextSize = size
l.TextColor3 = env.UITextColor and env.UITextColor.Value or WHITE
l.ZIndex = 5
l.Text = ""
return l
end
local hint = label(12, 0.5, 0, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 8), UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 14))
hint.Text = "tap anywhere to open the UI now  ·  triangle: drag / tap / hold 5s"
hint.TextTransparency = 0.55
local cap = label(14, 0.5, 1, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -104), UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 16))
local status = label(13, 0.5, 1, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -30), UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 16))
status.Text = "Loading modules..."
local pctLabel = label(26, 0.5, 1, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -66), UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 30))
pctLabel.Text = "0%"
local detail = label(12, 0.5, 1, UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -48), UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 14))
detail.TextTransparency = 0.25
detail.Text = ""
if env.UITextColor then
env.UITextColor.Changed:Connect(function(v)
hint.TextColor3, cap.TextColor3, status.TextColor3, pctLabel.TextColor3, detail.TextColor3 = v, v, v, v, v
end)
end
local chargeTrack = Util.Instance("Frame", root)
chargeTrack.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
chargeTrack.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -98)
chargeTrack.Size = UDim2.new(0, 160, 0, 2)
chargeTrack.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
chargeTrack.BackgroundTransparency = 1
chargeTrack.BorderSizePixel = 0
chargeTrack.ZIndex = 5
local chargeFill = Util.Instance("Frame", chargeTrack)
chargeFill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
chargeFill.BorderSizePixel = 0
chargeFill.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
chargeFill.BackgroundTransparency = 1
chargeFill.ZIndex = 6
local track = Util.Instance("Frame", root)
track.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
track.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -14)
track.Size = UDim2.new(1, -40, 0, 10)
track.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
track.BackgroundTransparency = 0.88
track.BorderSizePixel = 0
track.ZIndex = 5
local fill = Util.Instance("Frame", track)
fill.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, 0)
fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
fill.ZIndex = 6
Util.Instance("UICorner", track).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
Util.Instance("UICorner", fill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
fill.ClipsDescendants = true
local shimmer = Util.Instance("Frame", fill)
shimmer.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.35, 1)
shimmer.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
shimmer.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45
shimmer.BorderSizePixel = 0
shimmer.ZIndex = 7
local shimmerGrad = Util.Instance("UIGradient", shimmer)
shimmerGrad.Transparency = NumberSequence.new({
NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 1),
NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.5, 0),
NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1),
})
local knob = Util.Instance("Frame", track)
knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(14, 14)
knob.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0.5, 0)
knob.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
knob.ZIndex = 8
Util.Instance("UICorner", knob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
local tri = FX.NewTriangle3D(root, {
Interactive = true, ZIndex = 2, Ring = true, Track = true, RingSize = 176,
HitSize = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 150),
IsVisible = function() return root.Visible end,
OnAction = function(name, n)
cap.Text = (n > 0 and (n .. "/5  ") or "") .. name
capT = 1.4
cap.TextTransparency = 0
end,
})
tri:SetActive(false)
L.Triangle = tri
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
if not L.Visible and root.BackgroundTransparency >= 0.999 then return end
local t = env.Time and env.Time() or os.clock()
if env.GetUIBGColor then root.BackgroundColor3 = env.GetUIBGColor(t) end
local c = env.GetUIColor and env.GetUIColor(t) or WHITE
fill.BackgroundColor3 = c
chargeFill.BackgroundColor3 = c
local MP = Util.ModuleProgress
local real = (type(MP) == "table" and (MP.Total or 0) > 0) and math.clamp((MP.Done or 0) / MP.Total, 0, 1) or 0
local goal = math.max(L.target, math.min(real, 0.98))
L.p = L.p + (goal - L.p) * (1 - math.exp(-8 * dt))
local sdt = math.min(dt, 1 / 30)
L.bv = (L.bv or 0) + ((L.p - (L.bp or 0)) * 140 - (L.bv or 0) * 13) * sdt
L.bp = math.clamp((L.bp or 0) + L.bv * sdt, 0, 1)
fill.Size = UDim2.new(L.bp, 0, 1, 0)
shimmer.Position = UDim2.new(((t * 0.9) % 1.5) - 0.4, 0, 0, 0)
local kn = 14 + 3 * math.sin(t * 7) + math.clamp(math.abs(L.bv) * 14, 0, 9)
knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(kn, kn)
knob.Position = UDim2.new(L.bp, 0, 0.5, 0)
knob.BackgroundColor3 = c
local pct = math.floor(L.p * 100 + 0.5)
if pct ~= L.lastPct then
L.lastPct = pct
L.pulse = 1
pctLabel.Text = pct .. "%"
end
L.pulse = math.max(0, (L.pulse or 0) - dt * 3.2)
pctLabel.TextSize = math.floor(26 + 8 * L.pulse * L.pulse + 1.5 * math.sin(t * 5))
L.detT = (L.detT or 0) - dt
if L.detT <= 0 then
L.detT = 0.1
local okD, st = pcall(Util.GetModuleStatus)
if okD and type(st) == "string" then detail.Text = st end
end
local ch = tri.charge
chargeFill.Size = UDim2.new(ch, 0, 1, 0)
chargeFill.BackgroundTransparency = ch > 0.02 and 0 or 1
chargeTrack.BackgroundTransparency = ch > 0.02 and 0.8 or 1
if ch > 0.03 and tri.phase == "idle" then
cap.Text = string.format("HOLD  %d%%", math.floor(ch * 100))
capT = 0.4
end
capT = math.max(0, capT - dt)
cap.TextTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(capT / 0.4, 0, 1)
end)
function L.Show()
if L.Visible then return end
L.Visible = true
showToken = showToken + 1
L.p, L.target = 0, 0
L.bp, L.bv, L.lastPct, L.pulse = 0, 0, nil, 1
root.Visible = true
tri:SetActive(true)
tri.scaleBase = 1
tri:PopIn()
tween(root, 0.35, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 0.08})
FX.BlurPulse(6, 0.12, 0.4)
FX.Play("open", 1, 0.8)
end
function L.Hide()
if not L.Visible then return end
L.Visible = false
showToken = showToken + 1
local my = showToken
L.target = 1
tri:Finale()
FX.BlurPulse(5, 0.1, 0.5)
task.delay(0.45, function()
if my ~= showToken then return end
tween(root, 0.45, Quad, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
task.delay(0.5, function()
if my ~= showToken then return end
root.Visible = false
tri:SetActive(false)
end)
end)
end
function L.SetStatus(text, prog)
if typeof(text) == "string" then status.Text = text end
if type(prog) == "number" then
L.target = math.clamp(prog, 0, 1)
end
end
return L
end
function FX.LoaderStatus(text, prog)
if FX.Loader and FX.Loader.Visible then
FX.Loader.SetStatus(text, prog)
end
end
function FX.MountHero(frame, textColor, music)
local cap = Util.Instance("TextLabel", frame)
cap.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
cap.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 7)
cap.Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 16)
cap.BackgroundTransparency = 1
cap.Font = Enum.Font.Code
cap.TextSize = 14
cap.TextColor3 = textColor and textColor.Value or WHITE
cap.TextTransparency = 1
cap.Text = ""
cap.ZIndex = 6
cap.Interactable = false
if textColor then
textColor.Changed:Connect(function(v)
cap.TextColor3 = v
end)
end
local brackets = {}
for _, c in ipairs({{0, 0}, {1, 0}, {0, 1}, {1, 1}}) do
local ax, ay = c[1], c[2]
for k = 1, 2 do
local f = Util.Instance("Frame", frame)
f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay)
f.Position = UDim2.new(ax, ax == 0 and 6 or -6, ay, ay == 0 and 6 or -6)
f.Size = (k == 1) and UDim2.fromOffset(14, 1) or UDim2.fromOffset(1, 14)
f.BorderSizePixel = 0
f.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE
f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
f.ZIndex = 6
f.Interactable = false
brackets[#brackets + 1] = f
end
end
local stat = Util.Instance("TextLabel", frame)
stat.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
stat.Position = UDim2.new(1, -12, 0, 8)
stat.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(60, 12)
stat.BackgroundTransparency = 1
stat.Font = Enum.Font.Code
stat.TextSize = 11
stat.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
stat.TextColor3 = textColor and textColor.Value or WHITE
stat.TextTransparency = 0.5
stat.Text = ""
stat.ZIndex = 6
stat.Interactable = false
if textColor then
textColor.Changed:Connect(function(v)
stat.TextColor3 = v
end)
end
local fps, fpsT = 60, 0
local capT, used = 0, false
local hero
hero = FX.NewTriangle3D(frame, {
Interactive = true, ZIndex = 2, Ring = true, Track = true, Music = music,
RingSize = 176,
HitSize = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 150),
IsVisible = function()
return Util.IsGuiVisible(frame)
end,
OnAction = function(name, n)
used = true
cap.Text = (n > 0 and (n .. "/5  ") or "") .. name
capT = 1.6
end,
})
local stuck = 0
local lastBracketAcc
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
if not frame.Parent then return end
if frame.Visible and not frame.Interactable and frame.Position == UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0) then
stuck = stuck + dt
if stuck > 0.9 then
frame.Interactable = true
stuck = 0
end
else
stuck = 0
end
if not Util.IsGuiVisible(frame) then return end
fps = fps + (1 / math.max(dt, 1e-3) - fps) * 0.08
fpsT = fpsT + dt
if fpsT > 0.25 then
fpsT = 0
stat.Text = string.format("%d FPS", math.floor(fps + 0.5))
end
local accent = FX.GetColor and FX.GetColor() or WHITE
if accent ~= lastBracketAcc then
lastBracketAcc = accent
for _, f in ipairs(brackets) do
f.BackgroundColor3 = accent
end
end
if hero.charge > 0.03 and hero.phase == "idle" then
cap.Text = string.format("HOLD  %d%%", math.floor(hero.charge * 100))
capT = 0.4
end
capT = math.max(0, capT - dt)
if capT > 0 then
cap.TextTransparency = 1 - math.clamp(capT / 0.4, 0, 1)
elseif not used then
cap.Text = "tap  ·  drag  ·  hold 5s"
cap.TextTransparency = 0.55 + math.sin(os.clock() * 2) * 0.12
else
cap.TextTransparency = 1
end
end)
hero:PopIn()
FX.Hero = hero
return hero
end

if win.Parent and win.Size.X.Offset == 44 and win.Size.Y.Offset == 30 then
win.Size = FX.BootFull
end
end)
end

function FX.WindowFold(win, content, closing, pos, full)
if not FX.Settings.Transitions or not win.Parent then return nil end
local Expo = FX.Expo
local k = 1 / math.max(0.2, FX.Cfg.UIAnimSpeed or 1)
local lite = FX.Lite()
local col = FX.GetColor and FX.GetColor() or WHITE
local pill = UDim2.fromOffset(112, 30)
local dest = pos or win.Position
local fx, fy = full.X.Offset, full.Y.Offset
local function after(t, fn) task.delay(t * k, fn) end
local function glass(size, tr)
local p, st = FX.Plate(win, WHITE, 1.5, tr, size, dest)
p.BackgroundColor3, p.BackgroundTransparency = col:Lerp(WHITE, 0.55), 0.9
return p, st
end
local function melt(p, st, t)
tween(st, t, Quint, EOut, {Transparency = 1, Thickness = 0.5})
tween(p, t, Quint, EOut, {BackgroundTransparency = 1})
Debris:AddItem(p, t * k + 0.25)
end
if closing then
local from = win.Size
local g, gs = glass(from, 0.4)
FX.Play("close", 0.9)
FX.BlurPulse(lite and 3 or 6, 0.12, 0.88)
tween(win, 1, Quint, EInOut, {Position = dest})
tween(win, 0.45, Quint, EInOut, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(from.X.Offset, 30)})
after(0.2, function() tween(win, 0.8, Quint, EInOut, {Size = pill}) end)
after(0.05, function() tween(g, 0.95, Quint, EInOut, {Size = pill, Position = dest}) end)
after(0.6, function() melt(g, gs, 0.4) end)
return 1 * k
end
local g, gs = glass(pill, 0.3)
FX.Play("open", 0.85)
FX.BlurPulse(lite and 5 or 10, 0.1, 0.9)
tween(win, 0.6, Quint, EOut, {Position = dest})
tween(g, 0.4, Expo, EOut, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(fx + 24, 34)})
after(0.08, function() tween(win, 0.4, Expo, EOut, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(fx, 30)}) end)
after(0.3, function()
tween(win, 0.7, Quint, EOut, {Size = full})
tween(g, 0.65, Quint, EOut, {Size = full})
FX.Play("hit", 0.85)
pcall(FX.Cascade, content, true)
end)
after(0.55, function()
if not lite then FX.Ring(win.Parent, col, math.max(fx, fy) * 1.1, 0.5, 1.5, dest) end
melt(g, gs, 0.45)
end)
return 1 * k
end
function FX.RegisterLock(win, full, content)
local Expo, parent = FX.Expo, win.Parent
local col = FX.GetColor and FX.GetColor() or WHITE
local fx, fy = full.X.Offset, full.Y.Offset
local lite = FX.Lite()
local k = 1 / math.max(0.2, FX.Cfg.UIAnimSpeed or 1)
local g, gs = FX.Plate(win, WHITE, 1.5, 0.25, UDim2.fromOffset(44, 30))
g.BackgroundColor3, g.BackgroundTransparency = col:Lerp(WHITE, 0.55), 0.88
FX.BlurPulse(lite and 5 or 10, 0.1, 0.9)
task.wait(0.08 * k)
FX.Play("open", 0.8)
tween(g, 0.4, Expo, EOut, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(fx + 40, 34)})
task.wait(0.08 * k)
tween(win, 0.36, Expo, EOut, {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(fx, 30)})
task.wait(0.2 * k)
FX.Cascade(content, true)
tween(win, 0.64, Quint, EOut, {Size = full})
tween(g, 0.58, Quint, EOut, {Size = full})
FX.Play("hit", 0.85)
task.wait(0.3 * k)

-- ===== JARVIS shared core: ONE module set + ONE conversation state, mounted into the main UI or the Delta tab =====
Util.Jarvis = (function()
local REPO = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Elliot12-wq/Offline-Ai-system/main/"

	round(win, 14)]====]},

	closeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(]====]},

		if i.UserInputType]====], [====[	conn(topbar.InputBegan, function(i)
		if host then return end

local Core = {M = nil, H = nil, building = false, built = false, waiters = {}, pendingHost = nil, closeFn = nil, reval = {}}
local function genv()
local ok, g = pcall(function() return getgenv and getgenv() end)
return (ok and type(g) == "table") and g or _G
end
local function fnv(name)
local v = rawget(genv(), name)
if type(v) ~= "function" then v = rawget(_G, name) end
return type(v) == "function" and v or nil
end
local function fsOk()
return fnv("readfile") and fnv("writefile") and fnv("isfile") and true or false
end
local function ensureDirs()
local mf, isf = fnv("makefolder"), fnv("isfolder")
if not (mf and isf) then return end
pcall(function()
if not isf(DIR) then mf(DIR) end
if not isf(DIR .. "/cache") then mf(DIR .. "/cache") end
end)
end
local function download(name)
local url = REPO .. name .. ".lua"
local body
local ok, r = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(url) end)
if ok and type(r) == "string" and #r > 40 and not r:find("^404: Not Found") then body = r end
if not body then
local rq = fnv("request") or fnv("http_request") or (syn and syn.request)
if rq then
local ok2, res = pcall(rq, {Url = url, Method = "GET"})
if ok2 and type(res) == "table" and (res.StatusCode or res.Status) == 200 and type(res.Body) == "string" and #res.Body > 40 then body = res.Body end
end
end
if not body then
local ok3, r3 = pcall(function() return game:GetService("HttpService"):GetAsync(url) end)
if ok3 and type(r3) == "string" and #r3 > 40 then body = r3 end
end
if body and fsOk() then
ensureDirs()
local cpath = DIR .. "/cache/" .. name .. ".lua"
local okOld, old = pcall(function() if fnv("isfile")(cpath) then return fnv("readfile")(cpath) end end)
if not (okOld and old == body) then pcall(fnv("writefile"), cpath, body) end
end
return body
end
local function source(name)
if fsOk() then
local path = DIR .. "/cache/" .. name .. ".lua"
local okc, c = pcall(function() if fnv("isfile")(path) then return fnv("readfile")(path) end end)
if okc and type(c) == "string" and #c > 40 then
if not Core.reval[name] then Core.reval[name] = true task.spawn(download, name) end
return c
end
end
return download(name)
end
local function compile(name, text)
local ld = fnv("loadstring") or (type(loadstring) == "function" and loadstring) or (type(load) == "function" and load) or nil
if not ld then return nil, "this executor has no loadstring" end
local fn, err = ld(text, "=" .. name)
if not fn then return nil, tostring(err) end
local ok, mod = pcall(fn)
if not ok then return nil, tostring(mod) end
return mod
end
local function loadModules()
local M = {}
for _, name in ipairs(FILES) do
local text = source(name)
if not text then return nil, "Could not download " .. name .. ".lua from Elliot12-wq/Offline-Ai-system and no cached copy exists." end
if name == "AI_UI" and not text:find("UI.relayout", 1, true) then
if text:find("UI.setHost", 1, true) then
return nil, "AI_UI.lua in the repo is an older embed build - replace it with the updated AI_UI.lua."
end
for _, p in ipairs(UI_PATCH) do
local i, j = text:find(p[1], 1, true)
if i then text = text:sub(1, i - 1) .. p[2] .. text:sub(j + 1) end
end
end
for _, p in ipairs({{"Nooby Neural AI", "JARVIS"}, {"NOOBY NEURAL AI", "JARVIS"}, {"Nooby AI", "JARVIS"}}) do
text = text:gsub(p[1]:gsub("%p", "%%%0"), (p[2]:gsub("%%", "%%%%")))
end
local mod, err = compile(name, text)
if type(mod) ~= "table" then return nil, name .. ": " .. tostring(err) end
M[name:sub(4)] = mod
end
local extra = {}
for _, name in ipairs(OPTIONAL) do
local text = source(name)
local mod
if text then
for _, p in ipairs({{"Nooby Neural AI", "JARVIS"}, {"NOOBY NEURAL AI", "JARVIS"}, {"Nooby AI", "JARVIS"}}) do
text = text:gsub(p[1]:gsub("%p", "%%%0"), (p[2]:gsub("%%", "%%%%")))
end
mod = compile(name, text)
end
if type(mod) ~= "table" then extra = nil break end
extra[name:sub(4)] = mod
end
if extra then for k, v in pairs(extra) do M[k] = v end end
local ctx = {}
for k, v in pairs(M) do ctx[k] = v end
ctx.Load = function(name)
local text = source(name)
if type(text) ~= "string" then return nil end
return (compile(name, text))
end
M.Config.init()
M.Memory.init(ctx)
M.Knowledge.init(ctx)
M.Retrieval.init(ctx)
M.Personality.init(ctx)
M.Neural.init(ctx)
M.Generator.init(ctx)
M.UI.init(ctx)
if M.Script and M.Mind then
local okI = pcall(function() M.Script.init(ctx) M.Mind.init(ctx) end)
if not okI then M.Script, M.Mind, ctx.Script, ctx.Mind = nil, nil, nil, nil end
end
return M
end
local function respond(M, raw)
local Mem, K, NLP, Gen, Ret, Neu, Cfg = M.Memory, M.Knowledge, M.NLP, M.Generator, M.Retrieval, M.Neural, M.Config
local Mind = M.Mind
Cfg.adapt()
if Mind and not Mem.temp.awaitFix then
local okP, pre = pcall(Mind.pre, raw)
if okP and type(pre) == "table" and type(pre.text) == "string" then
if pre.turn or not raw:find("^/") then
Mem.addTurn("u", raw)
Mem.addTurn("a", pre.text)
end
return {text = pre.text}
end
end
local cmd, arg = raw:match("^/(%a+)%s*(.-)%s*$")
if cmd then
cmd = cmd:lower()
if cmd == "new" then
Mem.newConvo()
return {render = {}}
elseif cmd == "status" then
local ms, ks, ns = Mem.stats(), K.stats(), Neu.status()
return {text = string.format("**Status**\n- Chats: %d\n- Memories: %d facts, %d learned\n- Verified entries: %d\n- Neural: %s\n- Storage: %s\n- Memory pressure: %d", ms.convos, ms.facts, ks.learned, ks.verified, ns.state, ms.persist and "saved on this device" or "session only", Cfg.pressure)}
elseif cmd == "neural" then
local on = arg:lower() == "on"
local _, msg = Neu.setEnabled(on)
return {text = msg or (on and "Neural on." or "Neural off.")}
elseif cmd == "forget" then
return {text = M.Personality.ack({kind = "forgot", key = arg, n = Mem.forget(arg) + K.forget(arg)})}
elseif cmd == "reset" then
if arg:lower() == "confirm" then
Mem.clearAll()
K.clearLearned()
Ret.invalidate()
return {render = {}, text = "Everything I stored has been cleared."}
end
return {text = "This wipes all chats, facts and learned notes. Send `/reset confirm` to continue."}
end
end
local prev = Mem.temp.prev
local ev
if Mem.temp.awaitFix then
local aw = Mem.temp.awaitFix
Mem.temp.awaitFix = nil
if raw:lower():find("^never ?mind") or raw:lower():find("^cancel") then
Mem.addTurn("u", raw)
Mem.addTurn("a", "Okay, no problem.")
return {text = "Okay, no problem."}
end
ev = {kind = "corrected", status = (K.learn("correction", raw, {q = aw.q}))}
Ret.invalidate()
end
local a = Neu.apply(NLP.analyze(raw, {prev = prev}))
local i = a.intent
if not ev then
if i == "teach" and a.slots.teach then
local t = a.slots.teach
if t.personal then
ev = {kind = "taught", status = Mem.remember(t.key, t.value, not t.temp), personal = true, temp = t.temp}
else
ev = {kind = "taught", status = (K.learn("note", t.value, {key = t.key, temp = t.temp})), temp = t.temp}
Ret.invalidate()
end
elseif i == "forget" then
local q = a.slots.forget or ""
ev = {kind = "forgot", key = q, n = Mem.forget(q) + K.forget(q)}
Ret.invalidate()
elseif i == "correction" then
if a.slots.fix and a.slots.fix ~= "" then
ev = {kind = "corrected", status = (K.learn("correction", a.slots.fix, {q = prev and prev.q}))}
if prev and prev.ids then
for _, id in ipairs(prev.ids) do pcall(K.reinforce, prev.terms, id, -1) end
end
Ret.invalidate()
elseif prev then
Mem.temp.awaitFix = {q = prev.q}
ev = {kind = "needfix"}
else
ev = {kind = "nothing"}
end
elseif i == "setting" then
if a.slots.level then
Mem.setPref("level", a.slots.level)
ev = {kind = "level", level = a.slots.level}
elseif a.slots.verbosity then
Mem.setPref("verbosity", a.slots.verbosity)
ev = {kind = "verbosity", v = a.slots.verbosity}
end
end
end
local r
local simple = {greeting = 1, thanks = 1, bye = 1, identity = 1, capabilities = 1, smalltalk = 1, memory_query = 1, teach = 1, setting = 1, forget = 1, correction = 1}
if not ev and not simple[i] then r = Ret.search(a, prev) end
if Mind then local okA, r2 = pcall(Mind.arbitrate, a, r, prev) if okA then r = r2 end end
local res = Gen.reply(a, r, ev)
local meta = res.meta or {}
if not ev then Mem.temp.prev = {topic = meta.topic or a.topic, terms = a.terms, ids = meta.ids or {}, q = raw} end
if Mind then
local okO, t2 = pcall(Mind.observe, raw, a, res, ev, prev)
if okO and type(t2) == "string" then res.text = t2 end
end
Mem.addTurn("u", raw, a.topic)
Mem.addTurn("a", res.text, meta.topic or a.topic)
return {text = res.text}
end
local function makeHandlers(M)
local Mem, K = M.Memory, M.Knowledge
return {
status = function()
local ms, ks = Mem.stats(), K.stats()
return {persist = ms.persist, convos = ms.convos, facts = ms.facts, learned = ks.learned, pressure = M.Config.pressure, neural = M.Neural.state == "loaded" and "loaded" or "off"}
end,
list = function() return Mem.list() end,
new = function() Mem.newConvo() return {} end,
open = function(id) return Mem.open(id) end,
delete = function(id) return Mem.delete(id) end,
ask = function(text, cb)
task.delay(0.2, function()
local ok, res = pcall(respond, M, text)
if not ok then res = {text = "Something went wrong: " .. tostring(res):match("^[^\n]*")} end
cb(res)
end)
end,
close = function() if Core.closeFn then pcall(Core.closeFn) end end,
toggle = function() end,
}
end
function Core.IsReady() return Core.built end
function Core.Flush()
if Core.M then pcall(Core.M.Memory.flush) end
end
-- Mount(host, {onClose = fn}, cb(ok, err)): moves the single AI window into `host`
function Core.Mount(host, opts, cb)
Core.closeFn = opts and opts.onClose or nil
Core.pendingHost = host
if Core.built then
local ok, e = pcall(function()
Core.M.UI.setHost(host)
if Core.M.Script then Core.M.Script.setHost(host) end
Core.M.UI.show(Core.H)
end)
if cb then cb(ok, not ok and tostring(e) or nil) end
return
end
if cb then Core.waiters[#Core.waiters + 1] = cb end
if Core.building then return end
Core.building = true
task.spawn(function()
local M, err = loadModules()
local ok = M ~= nil
if ok then
task.wait()
Core.H = makeHandlers(M)
ok, err = pcall(function()
M.UI.setHost(Core.pendingHost)
if M.Script then M.Script.setHost(Core.pendingHost) task.spawn(function() pcall(M.Script.ready) end) end
M.UI.show(Core.H)
local msgs = M.Memory.current()
if msgs and #msgs > 0 then M.UI.render(msgs) end
end)
if ok then Core.M, Core.built = M, true else pcall(M.UI.destroyWindow) end
end
Core.building = false
local w = Core.waiters
Core.waiters = {}
for _, f in ipairs(w) do pcall(f, ok, not ok and tostring(err) or nil) end
end)
end
-- ===== JARVIS butler: greeting + alerts (AI_Butler.lua), with a plain greeting fallback if the module cannot load =====
Core.Repo, Core.Dir, Core.butler = REPO, DIR, nil
function Core.StartButler(api)
api.repo, api.dir = REPO, DIR
task.spawn(function()
local okT, text = pcall(source, "AI_Butler")
if okT and type(text) == "string" then
local mod = compile("AI_Butler", text)
if type(mod) == "table" and type(mod.start) == "function" then
local ok, inst = pcall(mod.start, api)
if ok and type(inst) == "table" then Core.butler = inst return end
end
end
local t0 = os.clock()
while os.clock() - t0 < 150 and api.introRunning() do task.wait(0.25) end
t0 = os.clock()
while os.clock() - t0 < 60 and not api.uiReady() do task.wait(0.25) end
local lp = game:GetService("Players").LocalPlayer
local name = lp and ((lp.DisplayName ~= "" and lp.DisplayName) or lp.Name) or "friend"
local h = tonumber(os.date("%H")) or 12
local per = (h >= 5 and h < 12) and "morning" or (h >= 12 and h < 17) and "afternoon" or "evening"
pcall(api.notify, "JARVIS", ("Good %s, %s. All systems are standing by."):format(per, name))
end)
end
pcall(function() local g = genv(); g.JarvisAI = Core; g.NoobyNeuralAI = Core end)
return Core
end)()

FX.Delta = (function()
local D = {Detected = false, Active = false, Executor = "", Status = "idle"}
local CG = cloneref(game:GetService("CoreGui"))
local logoConns, motionConns, sweepTok = {}, {}, setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local hooked = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local PAGES = {Executor = true, Home = true, Scripthub = true, Settings = true, Console = true, Music = true}
local SOURCES = {
"UhhhhhhReanim/Plugins/DeltaCustomization.lua",
"UhhhhhhReanim/DeltaCustomization.lua",
"DeltaCustom/DeltaCustomization.lua",
}
local function cfg(k) return FX.Cfg[k] end
local function disc(list)
for i = #list, 1, -1 do
pcall(function() list[i]:Disconnect() end)
list[i] = nil
end
end
local function accent()
local ok, c = pcall(FX.TriColor, os.clock())
return (ok and typeof(c) == "Color3") and c or WHITE
end
local function speed() return math.clamp(tonumber(cfg("DeltaSpeed")) or 1, 0.4, 2.5) end
local function motionOn()
return D.Active and cfg("DeltaMotion") == true and FX.Settings.Transitions ~= false and not FX.IsLowEnd()
end
local function tw(obj, t, style, dir, props)
return tween(obj, t / speed(), style, dir, props)
end
function D.Detect()
local ok, n = pcall(function() return identifyexecutor() end)
if not (ok and type(n) == "string" and n ~= "") then
ok, n = pcall(function() return getexecutorname() end)
end
local name = ""
if ok and type(n) == "string" then
name = (n:lower():gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", ""))
end
D.Executor = name
D.Detected = name == "delta" or name:find("^delta") ~= nil
return D.Detected
end
function D.Env()
local reg
if type(getreg) == "function" then pcall(function() reg = getreg() end) end
if type(reg) ~= "table" and type(debug) == "table" and type(debug.getregistry) == "function" then
pcall(function() reg = debug.getregistry() end)
end
local root = type(reg) == "table" and rawget(reg, "__nameless_admin_private") or nil
local env = type(root) == "table" and rawget(root, "delta_customization") or nil
if type(env) ~= "table" then
local okG, g = pcall(function() return rawget((getgenv and getgenv()) or _G, "__UhDeltaCustomEnv") end)
env = okG and type(g) == "table" and g or nil
end
return type(env) == "table" and env or nil
end
function D.ReadSource()
local function try(path)
if type(path) ~= "string" or path == "" then return nil end
if path:match("^https?://") then
local ok, body = pcall(function() return game:HttpGet(path) end)
if ok and type(body) == "string" and body ~= "" then return body, path end
elseif type(isfile) == "function" and type(readfile) == "function" then
local okE, ex = pcall(isfile, path)
if okE and ex then
local ok, body = pcall(readfile, path)
if ok and type(body) == "string" and body ~= "" then return body, path end
end
end
end
local body, from = try(cfg("DeltaSource"))
if body then return body, from end
if type(D.Embedded) == "string" and D.Embedded ~= "" then return D.Embedded, "built-in Delta customizer" end
for _, p in ipairs(SOURCES) do
body, from = try(p)
if body then return body, from end
end
end
function D.Boot()
local e = D.Env()
if e and (rawget(e, "DeltaIcon") ~= nil or rawget(e, "__DeltaCustomizationMasterRuntime") ~= nil) then
return true
end
local src = D.ReadSource()
if not src then
D.Status = "Delta customization source not found (put it at " .. SOURCES[1] .. " or set a path / URL in the Customization page)"
return false
end
if type(loadstring) ~= "function" then
D.Status = "loadstring unavailable"
return false
end
local fn, err = D.Exec.Compile(src, "@DeltaCustomization", {nocache = true})
if type(fn) ~= "function" then
D.Status = "Delta customization compile failed: " .. tostring(err)
return false
end
task.spawn(function()
local ok, er = xpcall(fn, function(e)
local okT, tb = pcall(debug.traceback, tostring(e), 2)
return okT and tb or tostring(e)
end)
if not ok then
D.Status = "Delta customization error: " .. (tostring(er):match("^[^\n]*") or "")
warn("[UhhhhhhFX] Delta customization error (continuing): " .. tostring(er))
end
end)
return true
end
function D.WaitIcon(timeout)
local t0 = os.clock()
while os.clock() - t0 < timeout do
local e = D.Env()
local api = e and rawget(e, "DeltaIcon")
if type(api) == "table" and type(api.getButton) == "function" then
local ok, btn = pcall(api.getButton)
if ok and typeof(btn) == "Instance" and btn.Parent then return btn, api end
end
task.wait(0.25)
end
end
local iconRot0 = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
FX.Audio.Add("DeltaIcon", function(A, dt, off)
local btn = D.Button
if not (D.Active and btn and btn.Parent) then return end
local r0 = iconRot0[btn]
if r0 == nil then r0 = btn.Rotation iconRot0[btn] = r0 end
local r = off and r0 or (r0 + A.sway * (1.5 + 7 * A.energy))
if btn.Rotation ~= r then btn.Rotation = r end
local ps = D.PressScale
if ps and ps.Parent and os.clock() > (D.PressHold or 0) and motionOn() then
local sc = off and 1 or (1 + 0.07 * A.kick + 0.035 * A.beat + 0.02 * A.energy)
if ps.Scale ~= sc then ps.Scale = sc end
end
end)
function D.SyncLogo()
local host, btn = D.LogoHost, D.Button
if host and host.Parent and btn and btn.Parent then
host.Visible = btn.Visible and btn.BackgroundTransparency < 0.5 and not D.IntroHold
end
end
function D.ApplyLogo()
disc(logoConns)
if D.Logo then pcall(function() D.Logo:Destroy() end) D.Logo = nil end
if D.LogoHost then pcall(function() D.LogoHost:Destroy() end) D.LogoHost = nil end
local btn = D.Button
if not (btn and btn.Parent) and D.Api then
local ok, b = pcall(D.Api.getButton)
btn = ok and b or nil
D.Button = btn
end
if not (btn and btn.Parent and btn:IsA("ImageButton")) then return end
local pressScale = btn:FindFirstChild("LT_NoobyPress")
if not (D.Active and cfg("DeltaLogo") == true) then
if pressScale then pressScale:Destroy() end
D.PressScale = nil
pcall(function() btn.ImageTransparency = btn.BackgroundTransparency end)
return
end
local busy = false

if busy then return end
busy = true
pcall(function() btn.ImageTransparency = 1 end)
busy = false
end

if btn.ImageTransparency < 1 then hideImg() end
end)

host.BackgroundTransparency = 1
host.BorderSizePixel = 0

LayerAnchor = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), LayerPos = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), LayerSize = UDim2.fromScale(0.9, 0.9),
IsVisible = function() return host.Parent ~= nil and host.Visible end,
})

host:Destroy()
D.LogoHost = nil
pcall(function() btn.ImageTransparency = btn.BackgroundTransparency end)
return
end
T.baseSpin = 1.3
T.scaleBase = 1.15

host.Destroying:Connect(function() pcall(function() T:Destroy() end) end)
for _, p in ipairs({"Visible", "BackgroundTransparency"}) do
logoConns[#logoConns + 1] = btn:GetPropertyChangedSignal(p):Connect(D.SyncLogo)
end

pressScale.Name = "LT_NoobyPress"
pressScale.Parent = btn
end

end)

D.PressHold = os.clock() + 0.8
if not motionOn() then pressScale.Scale = 1 return end
tween(pressScale, 0.7, Enum.EasingStyle.Elastic, EOut, {Scale = 1})
pcall(T.Bloom, T)
pcall(FX.Play, "release", 1.2)

end
local M = {Run = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}), Press = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})}
local function lite() local ok, v = pcall(FX.Lite) return ok and v == true end
local function touchOnly() return UserInputService.TouchEnabled and not UserInputService.MouseEnabled end
local function managed(o)
for _, k in ipairs(o:GetChildren()) do
if k:IsA("UIListLayout") or k:IsA("UIGridLayout") or k:IsA("UITableLayout") or k:IsA("UIPageLayout") then return true end
end
return false
end
local function restore(st)
for _, t in ipairs(st.tw) do pcall(function() t:Cancel() end) end
if st.sc and st.sc.Parent then st.sc.Scale = 1 end
for obj, p in pairs(st.pos) do if obj.Parent then obj.Position = p end end
end
local function clearRun(owner)
local run = M.Run[owner]
if not run then return end
M.Run[owner] = nil
for i = 1, #run do pcall(restore, run[i]) end
end
local function targets(page)
local best, bestN, seen = nil, 0, 0
local function scan(o, depth)
if seen > 220 then return end
local n, kids = 0, o:GetChildren()
for _, k in ipairs(kids) do
seen = seen + 1
if k:IsA("GuiObject") and k.Visible and not k.Name:find("^LT_") then n = n + 1 end
end
if n > bestN and (o == page or o:IsA("ScrollingFrame") or managed(o)) then best, bestN = o, n end
if depth < 3 then
for _, k in ipairs(kids) do
if k:IsA("GuiObject") and k.Visible and not k:IsA("GuiButton") and not k:IsA("TextBox") then scan(k, depth + 1) end
end
end
end
scan(page, 0)
return best
end
local function cascade(list, owner, tok)
if not (list and list.Parent) then return end
local light = lite()
local cap, gap = light and 4 or 10, light and 0.03 or 0.045
local rows, lay = {}, managed(list)
for _, r in ipairs(list:GetChildren()) do
if r:IsA("GuiObject") and r.Visible and not r.Name:find("^LT_") then rows[#rows + 1] = r end
end
table.sort(rows, function(a, c)
local ay, cy = a.AbsolutePosition.Y, c.AbsolutePosition.Y
if math.abs(ay - cy) > 4 then return ay < cy end
return a.AbsolutePosition.X < c.AbsolutePosition.X
end)
local run = {}
M.Run[owner] = run
for i = 1, math.min(#rows, cap) do
local row = rows[i]
local st = {pos = {}, tw = {}}
local dist = math.clamp(row.AbsoluteSize.X * 0.2, 26, 84)
local movers = {}
if lay then
for _, c in ipairs(row:GetChildren()) do
if c:IsA("GuiObject") and #movers < 4 and not c.Name:find("^LT_") then movers[#movers + 1] = c end
end
else
movers[1] = row
end
for _, m in ipairs(movers) do
st.pos[m] = m.Position
m.Position = m.Position + UDim2.fromOffset(dist, 0)
end
if lay and not light then
local ex = row:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIScale")
if not ex then ex = Instance.new("UIScale") ex.Name = "LT_NoobyRow" ex.Parent = row end
if ex.Name == "LT_NoobyRow" then st.sc = ex ex.Scale = 0.95 end
end
run[#run + 1] = st
task.delay((i - 1) * gap / speed(), function()
if sweepTok[owner] ~= tok or M.Run[owner] ~= run then return end
for m, p in pairs(st.pos) do
if m.Parent then st.tw[#st.tw + 1] = tw(m, 0.55, FX.Expo, EOut, {Position = p}) end
end
if st.sc and st.sc.Parent then st.tw[#st.tw + 1] = tw(st.sc, 0.5, Quint, EOut, {Scale = 1}) end
end)
end
end
local function spring(o)
local s = M.Press[o]
if s ~= nil then return s or nil end
local ex = o:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("UIScale")
if ex and ex.Name ~= "LT_NoobyPress" then M.Press[o] = false return nil end
if not ex then ex = Instance.new("UIScale") ex.Name = "LT_NoobyPress" ex.Parent = o end
M.Press[o] = ex
return ex
end
local function feel(o, kind)
if not motionOn() then return end
local s = spring(o)
if not s then return end
if kind == "down" then tw(s, 0.08, Quad, EOut, {Scale = 0.95})
elseif kind == "hover" then tw(s, 0.16, Quad, EOut, {Scale = 1.025})
else tw(s, 0.32, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, EOut, {Scale = 1}) end
end
function D.PageIn(fr)
if not (motionOn() and fr and fr.Parent) then return end
local tok = (sweepTok[fr] or 0) + 1
sweepTok[fr] = tok
clearRun(fr)
local c, light = accent(), lite()
local settle = fr:FindFirstChild("LT_NoobySettle")
if not settle then
settle = Instance.new("UIScale")
settle.Name = "LT_NoobySettle"
settle.Parent = fr
end
settle.Scale = light and 0.99 or 0.97
tw(settle, 0.6, FX.Expo, EOut, {Scale = 1})
for _, n in ipairs({"LT_NoobySweep", "LT_NoobyEdge"}) do
local old = fr:FindFirstChild(n)
if old then old:Destroy() end
end
local ln = Instance.new("Frame")
ln.Name = "LT_NoobyEdge"
ln.Size = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, 2)
ln.BackgroundColor3 = c
ln.BorderSizePixel = 0
ln.Active = false
ln.ZIndex = 101
ln.Parent = fr
tw(ln, 0.6, FX.Expo, EOut, {Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 2)})
task.delay(0.55 / speed(), function()
if ln.Parent and sweepTok[fr] == tok then tw(ln, 0.45, Quad, EIn, {BackgroundTransparency = 1}) end
end)
task.delay(1.1 / speed(), function()
if sweepTok[fr] == tok then pcall(function() ln:Destroy() end) end
end)
pcall(cascade, targets(fr), fr, tok)
if not light and cfg("DeltaBlur") == true then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 4, 0.08, 0.45 / speed()) end
pcall(FX.Play, "tick", 1.4)
end
function D.BindMotion()
disc(motionConns)
local main = D.Main
if not (main and main.Parent) then return end
local function hook(fr)
if hooked[fr] or not (fr:IsA("GuiObject") and PAGES[fr.Name]) then return end
hooked[fr] = true
motionConns[#motionConns + 1] = fr:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Visible"):Connect(function()
if fr.Visible then
D.LastPage = fr
if D.Closing and D.Closing ~= fr then D.Closing = nil D.CloseTok = (D.CloseTok or 0) + 1 D.Busy = false end
if not (D.Holding and os.clock() < D.Holding) then
if D.Closing == fr then D.Closing = nil D.CloseTok = (D.CloseTok or 0) + 1 D.Busy = false end
pcall(D.PageIn, fr)
end
elseif D.Closing == fr then
fr.Visible = true
end
end)
end
for _, c in ipairs(main:GetChildren()) do hook(c) if c.Name and PAGES[c.Name] and c:IsA("GuiObject") and c.Visible then D.LastPage = c end end
motionConns[#motionConns + 1] = main.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c) task.defer(hook, c) end)
local snd = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local function hookBtn(o)
if snd[o] or o == D.Button or not o:IsA("GuiButton") then return end
snd[o] = true
motionConns[#motionConns + 1] = o.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() pcall(FX.Click, "click", 1, 0.9) pcall(feel, o, "down") end)
motionConns[#motionConns + 1] = o.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() pcall(FX.Click, "release", 1, 1) pcall(feel, o, touchOnly() and "up" or "hover") end)
if not touchOnly() then
motionConns[#motionConns + 1] = o.MouseEnter:Connect(function() pcall(feel, o, "hover") end)
motionConns[#motionConns + 1] = o.MouseLeave:Connect(function() pcall(feel, o, "up") end)
end
end
for _, o in ipairs(main:GetDescendants()) do pcall(hookBtn, o) end
motionConns[#motionConns + 1] = main.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(o) task.defer(pcall, hookBtn, o) end)
local sidebar = main:FindFirstChild("Sidebar", true)
if sidebar and sidebar:IsA("GuiObject") then
local CLOSED, OPEN = UDim2.new(1.08, 0, 0.5, 0), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0.5, 0)
local prevX = sidebar.Position.X.Scale
local function settleOf(fr)
local sc = fr:FindFirstChild("LT_NoobySettle")
if not sc then
sc = Instance.new("UIScale")
sc.Name = "LT_NoobySettle"
sc.Parent = fr
end
return sc
end
local function animateClose()
D.Busy = true
D.CloseTok = (D.CloseTok or 0) + 1
local tok, pg = D.CloseTok, D.LastPage
D.Holding = os.clock() + 0.6
sidebar.Position = OPEN
prevX = OPEN.X.Scale
local sc
if pg then
D.Closing = pg
pg.Visible = true
sc = settleOf(pg)
sc.Scale = 1
tw(sc, 0.3, Quad, EIn, {Scale = 0.92})
end
tw(sidebar, 0.34, Quint, EIn, {Position = CLOSED})
pcall(FX.Click, "close", 1, 1)
if cfg("DeltaBlur") == true then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 5, 0.1, 0.4 / speed()) end
task.delay(0.36 / speed(), function()
if tok ~= D.CloseTok then return end
D.Closing = nil
if pg then pg.Visible = false end
if sc then sc.Scale = 1 end
sidebar.Position = CLOSED
prevX = CLOSED.X.Scale
D.Busy = false
end)
end
local function animateOpen()
D.Busy = true
D.CloseTok = (D.CloseTok or 0) + 1
local tok = D.CloseTok
sidebar.Position = CLOSED
prevX = CLOSED.X.Scale
tw(sidebar, 0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, EOut, {Position = OPEN})
local stok = (sweepTok[sidebar] or 0) + 1
sweepTok[sidebar] = stok
clearRun(sidebar)
pcall(cascade, sidebar:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ScrollingFrame") or sidebar, sidebar, stok)
pcall(FX.Click, "open", 1.05, 1)
task.delay(0.52 / speed(), function()
if tok ~= D.CloseTok then return end
prevX = sidebar.Position.X.Scale
D.Busy = false
end)
end
motionConns[#motionConns + 1] = sidebar:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Position"):Connect(function()
local x = sidebar.Position.X.Scale
local px = prevX
prevX = x
if D.Busy or not motionOn() then return end
if px <= 1.001 and x >= 1.079 then
animateClose()
elseif px >= 1.079 and x < 1.079 and D.LastPage and D.LastPage.Visible then
animateOpen()
end
end)
end
end
