function D.RunIntro()
local DUR = D.IntroLength
local TH = DUR - 0.75
local PERIOD = 60 / 126.02
local inten = math.clamp(tonumber(cfg("IntroIntensity")) or 1, 0.2, 3)
local sg = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
sg.Name = Util.RandomString and Util.RandomString(14) or "LT_NoobyDeltaIntro"
sg.IgnoreGuiInset = true
sg.ResetOnSpawn = false
sg.DisplayOrder = 2147483646
sg.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
pcall(function() sg.ScreenInsets = Enum.ScreenInsets.None end)
local okP = pcall(function() sg.Parent = gethiddengui and gethiddengui() or CG end)
if not okP then sg.Parent = CG end
D.IntroHold = true
D.SyncLogo()
local conns, T, tx, ty, tsz = {}, nil, 0, 0, 40
local ok, err = pcall(function()
local GL = "01#%&$@?/\\<>"
local function clamp01(x) return math.max(0, math.min(1, x)) end
local function lerp(a, b, k) return a + (b - a) * k end
local function eOut(x) return 1 - (1 - x) ^ 3 end
local function eIn(x) return x * x * x end
local function eInOut(x)
if x < 0.5 then return 4 * x * x * x end
return 1 - ((-2 * x + 2) ^ 3) / 2
end
local function eBack(x)
local c1 = 1.70158
local c3 = c1 + 1
return 1 + c3 * (x - 1) ^ 3 + c1 * (x - 1) ^ 2
end
local function scr(s, frac)
local n = math.floor(#s * clamp01(frac))
if n >= #s then return s end
local out = s:sub(1, n)
for i = n + 1, #s do
local ch = s:sub(i, i)
if ch == " " then
out = out .. " "
else
local k = math.random(1, #GL)
out = out .. GL:sub(k, k)
end
end
return out
end
local function iaccent()
local m, c = cfg("IntroColorMode"), nil
if m == 2 then
c = Util.ParseHex and Util.ParseHex(cfg("IntroColor"))
elseif m == 3 then
c = WHITE
elseif m == 4 and Util.Color then
c = Util.Color.Cur
elseif Util.DiscoColor then
c = Util.DiscoColor(os.clock() * 0.48)
end
return typeof(c) == "Color3" and c or WHITE
end

local o = Instance.new(class)
o.Name = Util.RandomString and Util.RandomString(10) or class
for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
o.Parent = parent
return o
end

{1, 0, UDim2.fromScale(1, 0), UDim2.new(0, 140, 1, 0), 180},
}) do
local f = mk("Frame", stage, {
AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(v[1], v[2]), Position = v[3], Size = v[4], BackgroundColor3 = BLACK,
BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 10, Interactable = false,
})
mk("UIGradient", f, {Rotation = v[5], Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0.55), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 1)})})
vign[#vign + 1] = f
end
local hud = {}
for _, c in ipairs({{0, 0}, {1, 0}, {0, 1}, {1, 1}}) do
local ax, ay = c[1], c[2]
local host = mk("Frame", stage, {
AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(30, 30), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
BorderSizePixel = 0, ZIndex = 14, Interactable = false,
})
local h = mk("Frame", host, {
AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = UDim2.fromScale(ax, ay), Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 2),
BorderSizePixel = 0, BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 14,
})
local v = mk("Frame", host, {
AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = UDim2.fromScale(ax, ay), Size = UDim2.new(0, 2, 1, 0),
BorderSizePixel = 0, BackgroundColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundTransparency = 1, ZIndex = 14,
})
hud[#hud + 1] = {host = host, h = h, v = v, ax = ax, ay = ay}
end
local function hudText(ax, ay, pos, w)
return mk("TextLabel", stage, {
AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(ax, ay), Position = pos, Size = UDim2.fromOffset(w, 16), BackgroundTransparency = 1,
BorderSizePixel = 0, Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 13, TextColor3 = WHITE, TextTransparency = 1,
ZIndex = 15, Text = "", Interactable = false,
TextXAlignment = ax == 0 and Enum.TextXAlignment.Left or Enum.TextXAlignment.Right,

end
local tcL = hudText(0, 0, UDim2.new(0, 46, 0, 12), 420)
local nowL = hudText(0, 1, UDim2.new(0, 46, 1, -52), 420)
local modL = hudText(1, 1, UDim2.new(1, -46, 1, -34), 420)
local ctrL = hudText(0, 1, UDim2.new(0, 46, 1, -34), 420)
nowL.Text = "LOADING: DELTA CUSTOMIZER"
local progBg = mk("Frame", stage, {

mk("UICorner", progDot, {CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)})
local skipBtn = mk("TextButton", stage, {

ZIndex = 40, Interactable = false,
})
local pulse, flashK, punch, glitch, shake, lastBeat = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, -1
local lsx, lsy, U, CY = 0, 0, 1, 0
local titleDone, subDone, bootDone, lastN, ev = false, false, false, 0, 1
local t0
local function layout(sx, sy)
U = math.clamp(sy / 720, 0.55, 1.2)
CY = sy * 0.36
local th = 56 * U
local ty0 = CY + 158 * U
box.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sx * 0.5, ty0)
box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.min(sx * 0.86, 820), th)
local subY = ty0 + th * 0.5 + 16
sub.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sx * 0.5, subY)
sub.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.min(sx * 0.9, 640), 20)
boot.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sx * 0.5, subY + 20)
boot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(300, 54)
end
local function impact(k, c)
punch = math.max(punch, 0.03 + 0.03 * k)
shake = math.max(shake, 5 + 6 * k)
flashK = math.max(flashK, 0.12 + 0.2 * k)
glitch = math.max(glitch, 0.4 + 0.3 * k)
pulse = 1
if T then T.pulse = 1 end
pcall(FX.Ring, mark, c, 300 + 200 * k, 0.6, 2 + k)
pcall(FX.Sparks, mark, c, math.floor(6 + 5 * k), 130 + 80 * k, 0.6)
end
local function bootTick() pcall(FX.Play, "tick", 1.5) end
local EV = {
{0.04, function()
flashK = 0.5
pcall(FX.Play, "open", 1.1)
if cfg("DeltaBlur") == true then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 12 * inten, 0.12, 1.8) end
end},
{0.35, function()
local c = iaccent()
pcall(FX.Ring, mark, c, 420, 0.7, 3)
pcall(FX.Sparks, mark, c, 10, 200, 0.7)
pcall(FX.Play, "release", 1)
end},
{1.05, function() glitch = 0.8 pcall(FX.Play, "tick", 1.7) end},
{1.45, function() glitch = 0.6 pcall(FX.Play, "tick", 1.9) end},
{1.95, function()
impact(1, iaccent())
pcall(function() T.yawVel = T.yawVel + 10 end)
pcall(FX.Play, "hit", 1)
end},
{bootAt[1], bootTick}, {bootAt[2], bootTick}, {bootAt[3], bootTick},
{3.95, function() impact(0.6, iaccent()) pcall(FX.Play, "reform", 1) end},
{TH, function()
local s = sg.AbsoluteSize
tx, ty, tsz = s.X * 0.5, math.min(46, s.Y * 0.1), 40
local b = D.Button
if b and b.Parent then
local p, bs = b.AbsolutePosition, b.AbsoluteSize
tx, ty, tsz = p.X + bs.X / 2, p.Y + bs.Y / 2, math.max(bs.X, bs.Y)
end
pcall(FX.Play, "release", 0.9)
if cfg("DeltaBlur") == true then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 6, 0.1, 0.6) end
end},
}
local function step(t, dt, sx, sy)
while ev <= #EV and t >= EV[ev][1] do
if t - EV[ev][1] < 0.4 then pcall(EV[ev][2]) end
ev = ev + 1
end
if sx ~= lsx or sy ~= lsy then
lsx, lsy = sx, sy
layout(sx, sy)
end
local u, col = U, iaccent()
local outK = clamp01((t - TH) / (DUR - TH))
local inK = clamp01(t / 0.35)
local vis = inK * (1 - eIn(outK))
local fo = 1 - clamp01(outK * 3)
pulse = pulse * math.exp(-7 * dt)
punch = punch * math.exp(-8 * dt)
shake = shake * math.exp(-9 * dt)
flashK = math.max(0, flashK - dt * 3.2)
glitch = math.max(0, glitch - dt * 2.4)
local beat = math.floor(t / PERIOD)
if beat ~= lastBeat then
lastBeat = beat
pulse = 1
if T then T.pulse = math.max(T.pulse or 0, 0.55) end
end
stage.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - 0.94 * vis
if inK < 1 or outK > 0 then
for i = 1, #vign do vign[i].BackgroundTransparency = 1 - vis end
end
local R = math.sqrt(sx * sx + sy * sy) * 0.5
local sp = (0.35 + 3.2 * math.exp(-((t - 0.9) / 0.55) ^ 2)) * (1 - outK * 0.8)
local ex = 0.8 * vis
for i = 1, #stars do
local s = stars[i]
s.r = s.r + s.v * sp * dt * 0.6
if s.r > 1 then
s.r = math.random() * 0.08
s.a = math.random() * math.pi * 2
end
local rr = s.r * s.r
local f = s.f
f.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sx * 0.5 + math.cos(s.a) * rr * R, sy * 0.5 + math.sin(s.a) * rr * R)
f.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(2 + sp * rr * 46, 2)
f.Rotation = math.deg(s.a)
f.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.min(1, rr * 2.5) * ex
if s.hot then f.BackgroundColor3 = col end
end
local k = eInOut(outK)
mark.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(lerp(sx * 0.5, tx, k), lerp(CY + math.sin(t * 2.2) * 4 * u * (1 - outK), ty, k))
ms.Scale = math.max(0.01, eBack(clamp01((t - 0.12) / 0.8)) * lerp(u, tsz / 240 * 1.1, k) * (1 + pulse * 0.035 * (1 - outK)))
local tIn = clamp01((t - 1.05) / 0.75)
local lockK = eOut(clamp01((t - 1.05) / 0.9))
if not titleDone and t >= 1.0 then
local n = math.floor(#name * tIn)
if n ~= lastN then
lastN = n
if n > 0 and n % 2 == 0 then pcall(FX.Play, "tick", 1.7) end
end
local s = scr(name, tIn)
lblM.Text, lblR.Text, lblB.Text = s, s, s
titleDone = tIn >= 1
end
local c = (1 - lockK) * 22 * u + pulse * 3
lblR.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -c, 0.5, 0)
lblB.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, c, 0.5, 0)
local ta = clamp01((t - 1.0) / 0.12) * fo
lblM.TextTransparency = 1 - ta
lblR.TextTransparency = 1 - ta * (0.12 + 0.43 * (1 - lockK))
lblB.TextTransparency = lblR.TextTransparency
if not subDone and t >= 2.0 then
sub.Text = scr(subText, (t - 2.05) / 0.6)
subDone = t >= 2.65
end
local blink = (t > 3.95 and t < TH) and (math.floor(t * 4) % 2 == 0 and 1 or 0.55) or 1
sub.TextColor3 = col
sub.TextTransparency = 1 - clamp01((t - 2.05) / 0.2) * fo * blink
if not bootDone and t >= bootAt[1] then
local parts = {}
for i = 1, #bootLines do
local f = clamp01((t - bootAt[i]) / 0.3)
if f > 0 then parts[#parts + 1] = scr(bootLines[i], f) end
end
boot.Text = table.concat(parts, "\n")
bootDone = t >= bootAt[#bootAt] + 0.3
end
boot.TextColor3 = col
boot.TextTransparency = 1 - clamp01((t - bootAt[1]) / 0.15) * fo * 0.9
if t >= 1.0 and t < 1.95 then
scan.Visible = true
scan.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(sx * 0.5, sy * ((t - 1.0) / 0.95) - 60)
scan.BackgroundColor3, scanLine.BackgroundColor3 = col, col
elseif scan.Visible then
scan.Visible = false
end
for i = 1, #tears do
local f = tears[i]
if glitch > 0.05 and math.random() < glitch * 0.8 then
f.Visible = true
f.Position = UDim2.new(0, (math.random() - 0.5) * 40 * glitch, 0, math.random() * sy)
f.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, math.random(2, 10))
f.BackgroundColor3 = math.random() < 0.5 and col or WHITE
f.BackgroundTransparency = 0.45 + math.random() * 0.45
elseif f.Visible then
f.Visible = false
end
end
local bh = sy * 0.085 * eOut(clamp01(t / 0.6)) * (1 - eIn(outK))
barTop.Size, barBot.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, bh), UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, bh)
local hin = eOut(clamp01((t - 0.1) / 0.7))
local inset = (22 + (1 - hin) * 80) * u
for i = 1, #hud do
local b = hud[i]
b.host.Position = UDim2.new(b.ax, b.ax == 0 and inset or -inset, b.ay, b.ay == 0 and inset or -inset)
local tr = 1 - hin * (1 - outK)
if math.random() < 0.04 then tr = math.min(1, tr + 0.5) end
b.h.BackgroundTransparency, b.v.BackgroundTransparency = tr, tr
b.h.BackgroundColor3, b.v.BackgroundColor3 = col, col
end
tcL.Text = string.format("DELTA // BOOT  %04.2f / %04.2f", math.min(t, DUR), DUR)
modL.Text = D.Api and "CUSTOMIZER LINKED" or "CUSTOMIZER WAITING"
ctrL.Text = string.format("SYS.INIT  %03d%%", math.floor(clamp01(t / TH) * 100))
local hudA = math.min(1, 1 - hin * 0.85 * fo + (1 - fo))
for _, l in ipairs({tcL, nowL, modL, ctrL}) do
l.TextColor3 = col
l.TextTransparency = hudA
end
progFill.Size = UDim2.new(clamp01(t / TH), 0, 1, 0)
progFill.BackgroundColor3, progDot.BackgroundColor3 = col, col
local pf = clamp01(outK * 1.5)
progFill.BackgroundTransparency = pf
progDot.BackgroundTransparency = math.max(pf, math.clamp(0.15 - pulse * 0.3, 0, 1))
progDot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6 + pulse * 5, 6 + pulse * 5)
progBg.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - 0.1 * vis
local sv = fo * vis
skipBtn.TextColor3, skipStroke.Color = col, col
skipBtn.TextTransparency = 1 - sv
skipBtn.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - 0.7 * sv
skipStroke.Transparency = math.min(1, 0.2 + 0.22 * math.sin(t * 3) + (1 - sv))
local endF = clamp01((t - (DUR - 0.3)) / 0.3) * 0.25
flash.BackgroundColor3 = WHITE:Lerp(col, 0.35)
flash.BackgroundTransparency = 1 - math.max(math.min(0.8, flashK * math.clamp(inten, 0, 1.2)), endF * math.clamp(inten, 0.4, 1))
worldZoom.Scale = 1 + punch * inten
if shake > 0.1 then
world.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, (math.random() - 0.5) * shake * inten, 0.5, (math.random() - 0.5) * shake * inten)
elseif shake ~= 0 then
shake = 0
world.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
end
end
local function doSkip()
if t0 and os.clock() - t0 < TH then t0 = os.clock() - TH end
end
conns[#conns + 1] = UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
if not t0 or os.clock() - t0 < 0.4 then return end
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
local kc = input.KeyCode
if kc == Enum.KeyCode.Space or kc == Enum.KeyCode.Return or kc == Enum.KeyCode.Escape then doSkip() end
end
end)
conns[#conns + 1] = skipBtn.Activated:Connect(doSkip)
conns[#conns + 1] = skipBtn.MouseEnter:Connect(function() tween(skipScale, 0.2, Back, EOut, {Scale = 1.12}) end)
conns[#conns + 1] = skipBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(function() tween(skipScale, 0.3, Back, EOut, {Scale = 1}) end)
t0 = os.clock()
local last = t0
while sg.Parent do
local now = os.clock()
local t = now - t0
if t >= DUR then break end
local dt = math.min(0.1, now - last)
last = now
local sz = sg.AbsoluteSize
if sz.X >= 2 and sz.Y >= 2 then step(t, dt, sz.X, sz.Y) end
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
end
D.IntroHold = false
pcall(D.SyncLogo)
if D.Logo then pcall(D.Logo.Bloom, D.Logo) end
if D.LogoHost then pcall(FX.Ring, D.LogoHost, iaccent(), math.max(tsz * 1.8, 90), 0.7, 2) end
if cfg("DeltaBlur") == true then pcall(FX.BlurPulse, 5, 0.06, 0.5) end
end)
for _, c in ipairs(conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
D.IntroHold = false
pcall(D.SyncLogo)
if T then pcall(function() T:Destroy() end) end
pcall(function() sg:Destroy() end)
if not ok then error(err, 0) end
end
function D.PlayIntro(force)
if D.IntroBusy or not (D.Detected and D.Active) then return end
if not force and (D.IntroPlayed or cfg("DeltaIntro") ~= true or FX.IsLowEnd()) then return end
D.IntroBusy, D.IntroPlayed = true, true
task.spawn(function()
local t0 = os.clock()
while FX.IntroActive and not force and os.clock() - t0 < 120 do task.wait(0.1) end
local ok, err = pcall(D.RunIntro)
if not ok then
D.IntroHold = false
pcall(D.SyncLogo)
warn("[UhhhhhhFX] Delta intro error (continuing): " .. tostring(err))
end
D.IntroBusy = false
end)
end
function D.Apply()
pcall(D.Exec.Sync)
if D.Detected and D.Active then pcall(D.ApplyLogo) return end
if D.Detected and not D.Starting and cfg("DeltaEnabled") ~= false then
D.Started = false
task.spawn(D.Start)
end
end
function D.Start()
if D.Started or D.Starting then return end
D.Started, D.Starting = true, true
pcall(D.Exec.Sync)
if not D.Detected then
D.Status = "skipped (executor: " .. (D.Executor ~= "" and D.Executor or "unknown") .. ")"
D.Starting = false
return
end
if cfg("DeltaEnabled") == false then
D.Status = "turned off on the Customization page (applies on the next start)"
D.Starting = false
return
end
local ok, err = pcall(function()
if not D.Boot() then error(D.Status, 0) end
local btn, api = D.WaitIcon(75)
if not btn then error("Delta icon not found", 0) end
D.Button, D.Api = btn, api
D.Main = btn:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("ScreenGui")
D.Active = true
D.Status = "active"
D.ApplyLogo()
D.BindMotion()
D.PlayIntro(false)
end)
if not ok then
D.Active = false
D.Status = tostring(err)
warn("[UhhhhhhFX] Delta bridge off (script unaffected): " .. tostring(err))
end
D.Starting = false
end
D.Exec = (function()
local X = {Version = "1.0"}
local RS = cloneref(game:GetService("RunService"))
local stats = {hits = 0, misses = 0, compiled = 0, failed = 0, runs = 0, errors = 0, jobs = 0, compileMs = 0, savedMs = 0, netHits = 0}
local net, netCount, netBytes = {}, 0, 0
local NET_TTL = 90
local cache, entries, bytes, stamp = {}, {}, 0, 0
local jobs, head, tail, conn = {}, 1, 0, nil
local once = {}
local function tier()
local prof = type(_G) == "table" and _G.UHDevProfile
return type(prof) == "table" and tonumber(prof.Tier) or 3
end
local function limits()
local t = tier()
if t <= 1 then return 8, 1048576 end
if t == 2 then return 16, 2097152 end
return 32, 4194304
end
local function frameBudget()
local t = tier()
if t <= 1 or FX.IsLowEnd() then return 0.002 end
return t == 2 and 0.003 or 0.005
end
local function evict()
local maxN, maxB = limits()
while #entries > maxN or bytes > maxB do
local oi, ot = 1, math.huge
for i, e in ipairs(entries) do
if e.t < ot then oi, ot = i, e.t end
end
local e = table.remove(entries, oi)
if not e then break end
local bc = cache[e.chunk]
if bc then
bc[e.src] = nil
if next(bc) == nil then cache[e.chunk] = nil end
end
bytes -= e.size
end
end
local function tb(e)
local ok, t = pcall(debug.traceback, tostring(e), 2)
return ok and t or tostring(e)
end
function X.Compile(src, chunk, opts)
if type(src) ~= "string" or src == "" then return nil, "empty source" end
chunk = chunk or "=UhDelta"
local ls = loadstring or load
if type(ls) ~= "function" then return nil, "loadstring unavailable" end
local bc = cache[chunk]
local e = bc and bc[src]
if e then
stats.hits += 1
stats.savedMs += e.ms
stamp += 1
e.t = stamp
return e.fn
end
local t0 = os.clock()
local fn, err = ls(src, chunk)
local ms = (os.clock() - t0) * 1000
stats.misses += 1
if type(fn) ~= "function" then
stats.failed += 1
return nil, err
end
stats.compiled += 1
stats.compileMs += ms
local _, maxB = limits()
if not (type(opts) == "table" and opts.nocache) and #src <= maxB // 2 then
stamp += 1
local ent = {chunk = chunk, src = src, fn = fn, size = #src, ms = ms, t = stamp}
if not bc then bc = {} cache[chunk] = bc end
bc[src] = ent
entries[#entries + 1] = ent
bytes += ent.size
evict()
end
return fn
end
function X.Run(src, chunk, ...)
local fn, err = X.Compile(src, chunk)
if not fn then
stats.errors += 1
return false, err
end
stats.runs += 1
local res = table.pack(xpcall(fn, tb, ...))
if not res[1] then stats.errors += 1 end
return table.unpack(res, 1, res.n)
end
function X.RunAsync(src, chunk, ...)
return task.spawn(function(...)
local ok, err = X.Run(src, chunk, ...)
if not ok then warn("[UhDelta] " .. tostring(err)) end
end, ...)
end
function X.ReadFile(path)
if type(readfile) ~= "function" then return nil, "readfile unavailable" end
local ok, body = pcall(readfile, path)
if ok and type(body) == "string" and body ~= "" then return body end
if ok then return nil, "unreadable or empty file: " .. tostring(path) end
return nil, "file not found: " .. tostring(path)
end
function X.RunFile(path, ...)
local body, err = X.ReadFile(path)
if not body then return false, err end
return X.Run(body, "@" .. tostring(path), ...)
end
local function stop()
if conn then conn:Disconnect() conn = nil end
end
local function runJob(j)
local ok, err = pcall(j.fn, table.unpack(j.args, 1, j.n))
if not ok then
stats.errors += 1
warn("[UhDelta] queued job failed: " .. tostring(err))
end
end
local function pump()
local t0, budget = os.clock(), frameBudget()
while head <= tail do
local j = jobs[head]
jobs[head] = nil
head += 1
if j and not j.cancelled then
stats.jobs += 1
task.spawn(runJob, j)
end
if os.clock() - t0 >= budget then break end
end
if head > tail then
head, tail = 1, 0
stop()
end
end
local function cancelJob(j) j.cancelled = true end
function X.Queue(fn, ...)
if type(fn) ~= "function" then return nil end
local j = {fn = fn, args = {...}, n = select("#", ...), Cancel = cancelJob}
tail += 1
jobs[tail] = j
if not conn then conn = RS.Heartbeat:Connect(pump) end
return j
end
function X.Batch(list, onDone)
if type(list) ~= "table" then return 0 end
local total = #list
local left = total
for i = 1, total do
local item = list[i]
X.Queue(function()
local ok, err = pcall(function()
if type(item) == "function" then
item()
elseif type(item) == "table" then
local okR, errR
if item.File then okR, errR = X.RunFile(item.File) else okR, errR = X.Run(item.Source, item.Name) end
if not okR then error(errR, 0) end
end
end)
if not ok then warn("[UhDelta] batch item " .. i .. " failed: " .. tostring(err)) end
left -= 1
if left == 0 and type(onDone) == "function" then onDone() end
end)
end
return total
end
function X.Preload(list)
if type(list) ~= "table" then return 0 end
for _, item in ipairs(list) do
if type(item) == "table" then X.Queue(X.Compile, item.Source, item.Name) end
end
return #list
end
function X.Once(key, fn, ...)
if once[key] then return false end
once[key] = true
return true, fn(...)
end
function X.Debounce(fn, wait)
local token = 0
return function(...)
token += 1
local my, n, args = token, select("#", ...), {...}
task.delay(wait or 0.25, function()
if my == token then fn(table.unpack(args, 1, n)) end
end)
end
end
function X.Throttle(fn, interval)
local last = -math.huge
return function(...)
local now = os.clock()
if now - last >= (interval or 0.25) then
last = now
return fn(...)
end
end
end
function X.Memo(fn, max)
local store, count = {}, 0
max = max or 256
return function(k)
if k == nil then return fn(k) end
local v = store[k]
if v == nil then
v = fn(k)
if v ~= nil then
if count >= max then table.clear(store) count = 0 end
store[k] = v
count += 1
end
end
return v
end
end
local function netDrop(k)
local e = net[k]
if e then
net[k] = nil
netCount -= 1
netBytes -= e.size
end
end
local function netClear()
table.clear(net)
netCount, netBytes = 0, 0
end
function X.NetGet(key)
local e = type(key) == "string" and net[key] or nil
if not e then return nil end
if os.time() - e.t > NET_TTL then
netDrop(key)
return nil
end
stats.netHits += 1
return e.body
end
function X.NetSet(key, body)
if type(key) ~= "string" or type(body) ~= "string" or body == "" then return end
local maxN, maxB = limits()
local size = #body
if size > maxB // 2 then return end
netDrop(key)
while netCount > 0 and (netCount >= maxN or netBytes + size > maxB) do
local oldK, oldT = nil, math.huge
for k, e in pairs(net) do
if e.t < oldT then oldK, oldT = k, e.t end
end
if not oldK then break end
netDrop(oldK)
end
net[key] = {body = body, size = size, t = os.time()}
netCount += 1
netBytes += size
end
X.Fast = {
Compile = function(src, chunk) return X.Compile(src, chunk) end,
NetGet = X.NetGet,
NetSet = X.NetSet,
}
function X.Stats()
return {
Hits = stats.hits, Misses = stats.misses, Compiled = stats.compiled, Failed = stats.failed,
Runs = stats.runs, Errors = stats.errors, JobsRun = stats.jobs,
Cached = #entries, CachedBytes = bytes, Queued = math.max(0, tail - head + 1),
CompileMs = math.floor(stats.compileMs + 0.5),
NetHits = stats.netHits, NetCached = netCount,
EstimatedSavedMs = math.floor(stats.savedMs + 0.5),
}
end
function X.Clear()
table.clear(cache)
table.clear(entries)
bytes = 0
netClear()
for i = head, tail do
local j = jobs[i]
if j then j.cancelled = true end
jobs[i] = nil
end
head, tail = 1, 0
stop()
end
function X.Sync()
local on = D.Detected and FX.Cfg.DeltaExecHelpers ~= false
local fastOn = D.Detected and FX.Cfg.DeltaFastExec ~= false
local genv = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G
pcall(function()
local cur = rawget(genv, "UhDeltaAPI")
if on then
if cur ~= X then
if type(cur) == "table" and type(cur.Clear) == "function" then pcall(cur.Clear) end
rawset(genv, "UhDeltaAPI", X)
end
elseif cur == X then
rawset(genv, "UhDeltaAPI", nil)
end
local curF = rawget(genv, "UhDeltaFast")
if fastOn then
if curF ~= X.Fast then rawset(genv, "UhDeltaFast", X.Fast) end
elseif curF == X.Fast then
rawset(genv, "UhDeltaFast", nil)
end
end)
if not fastOn then netClear() end
if not on and not fastOn then X.Clear() end
end
return X
end)()
pcall(D.Detect)
FX.OnLowEnd(function() pcall(D.Apply) end)
return D
end)()
return FX
end)()

Util.QueryPlayerSelector = function(query, excludespeaker)

end

local FS = {}
Util.FS = FS
local function norm(p) return (tostring(p):gsub("\\", "/")) end
-- true / false / nil (unknown): uses isfile when present, otherwise falls back to readfile
function FS.IsFile(p)
p = norm(p)
if type(isfile) == "function" then
local ok, r = pcall(isfile, p)
if ok then return r == true end
end
if type(readfile) == "function" then
local ok, r = pcall(readfile, p)
if ok and type(r) == "string" then return true end
if not ok then
local m = tostring(r):lower()
if m:find("not exist", 1, true) or m:find("no such", 1, true) or m:find("not found", 1, true) or m:find("cannot open", 1, true) or m:find("doesn't exist", 1, true) then return false end
end
end
return nil
end
function FS.IsFolder(p)
p = (norm(p):gsub("/+$", ""))
if type(isfolder) == "function" then
local ok, r = pcall(isfolder, p)
if ok then return r == true end
end
if type(listfiles) == "function" and pcall(listfiles, p) then return true end
return nil
end
-- creates every missing folder of the path (parents first); existing folders are never touched
function FS.Folder(path)
path = (norm(path):gsub("/+$", ""))
local cur
for seg in path:gmatch("[^/]+") do
cur = cur and (cur .. "/" .. seg) or seg
if FS.IsFolder(cur) ~= true then
if type(makefolder) ~= "function" then return false, "this executor has no makefolder function (needed for '" .. cur .. "')" end
local ok, err = pcall(makefolder, cur)
if not ok and FS.IsFolder(cur) == false then return false, "makefolder failed for '" .. cur .. "': " .. tostring(err) end
end
end
return true
end
-- opt.IfMissing: only create it (an existing file is never rewritten). Identical existing content is never rewritten either (opt.IfChanged is therefore the default). Returns ok, info-or-error (error names operation + path)
-- opt.Scope: name of a UH Security internal-write scope (Util.ExtGuard.WriteScope): the write then runs as an authorised UH Admin operation for exactly this path
function FS.Write(path, data, opt)
path = norm(path)
opt = opt or {}
if type(writefile) ~= "function" then return false, "this executor has no writefile function" end
if type(data) ~= "string" then return false, "no data to write to '" .. path .. "'" end
local existed = FS.IsFile(path)
if opt.IfMissing then
if existed ~= false then return true, "exists" end
elseif existed == true and type(readfile) == "function" then
local okR, old = pcall(readfile, path)
if okR and old == data then return true, "unchanged" end
end
local dir = path:match("^(.*)/[^/]+$")
if dir then
local okF, errF = FS.Folder(dir)
if not okF then return false, errF end
end
local function perform()
local ok, err = pcall(writefile, path, data)
if not ok and existed == false and type(appendfile) == "function" and #data > 0 then
-- some executors reject one big writefile: build a NEW file piece by piece (never done over an existing file)
local okP = pcall(function()
writefile(path, "")
for i = 1, #data, 65536 do appendfile(path, data:sub(i, i + 65535)) end
end)
if okP then ok = true elseif type(delfile) == "function" then pcall(delfile, path) end
end
if not ok then return false, "writefile failed for '" .. path .. "': " .. tostring(err) end
if FS.IsFile(path) == false then return false, "writefile reported success but '" .. path .. "' does not exist" end
return true, "written"
end
local scope = opt.Scope and Util.ExtGuard and Util.ExtGuard.WriteScope
if scope then return scope(opt.Scope, path, perform) end
return perform()
end
-- JSON-safe copy (drops NaN / inf / functions / instances / cycles); only used when a plain JSONEncode fails
local function clean(v, depth, seen)
local t = type(v)
if t == "string" or t == "boolean" then return v end
if t == "number" then
if v ~= v or v == math.huge or v == -math.huge then return nil end
return v
end
if t ~= "table" or depth > 30 or seen[v] then return nil end
seen[v] = true
local out, n, arr = {}, 0, true
for k in pairs(v) do
n += 1
if type(k) ~= "number" or k < 1 or k ~= math.floor(k) then arr = false end
end
if arr and n > 0 and #v ~= n then arr = false end
if arr then
for i = 1, n do
local c = clean(v[i], depth + 1, seen)
if c ~= nil then out[#out + 1] = c end
end
else
for k, x in pairs(v) do
local key = type(k) == "string" and k or (type(k) == "number" and tostring(k)) or nil
if key then
local c = clean(x, depth + 1, seen)
if c ~= nil then out[key] = c end
end
end
end
seen[v] = nil
return out
end
function FS.Clean(v) return clean(v, 0, {}) end
end

local FS = Util.FS

if FS.IsFile("UhhhhhhReanim/.nomedia") == false then FS.Write("UhhhhhhReanim/.nomedia", "") end
do
local SaveDataFilename = "UhhhhhhReanim/tree.ehehetilde"
local told = {}
local function note(key, msg)
if told[key] then return end
told[key] = true
warn("[UhAdmin] " .. msg)
task.spawn(function() task.wait(2) pcall(Util.Notify, msg) end)
end
-- "ok", table, raw | "missing" | "empty" | "corrupt", raw, why | "unreadable", why
local function readSave()
if FS.IsFile(SaveDataFilename) == false then return "missing" end
if type(readfile) ~= "function" then return "unreadable", "this executor has no readfile function" end
local okR, raw = pcall(readfile, SaveDataFilename)
if not okR then
if FS.IsFile(SaveDataFilename) == false then return "missing" end
return "unreadable", tostring(raw)
end
if type(raw) ~= "string" or not raw:find("%S") then return "empty" end
local okD, dec = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, raw)
if okD and type(dec) == "table" and #dec == 0 then return "ok", dec, raw end
return "corrupt", raw, okD and "it is not a settings table" or tostring(dec)
end
local saveLock, emptyReads = false, 0
-- an EXISTING save that could not be loaded is never overwritten. true = it is now safe to write again
local function judge(st, a, b)
if st == "corrupt" then
local bak = SaveDataFilename .. ".corrupt-" .. tostring(os.time())
local okB, errB = FS.Write(bak, a)
if okB then
note("corrupt", "Your save file could not be decoded (" .. tostring(b) .. "). A copy was kept as " .. bak .. " and settings start fresh.")
return true
end
note("nobak", "Your save file could not be decoded and no backup copy could be written (" .. tostring(errB) .. "). It was left untouched, so changes are not saved yet.")
return false
elseif st == "empty" then
emptyReads += 1
if emptyReads >= 8 then
note("empty", "Your save file stayed empty, so it is being initialised again.")
return true
end
return false
end
note("unreadable", "Your save file could not be read (" .. tostring(a) .. "). It was left untouched; changes stay in memory and are not written over it.")
return false
end
local st, a, b
for attempt = 1, 3 do
st, a, b = readSave()
if st == "ok" or st == "missing" then break end
if attempt < 3 then task.wait(0.25) end
end
if st == "ok" then
SaveData = a
else
SaveData = {}
if st == "missing" then
local okW, errW = FS.Write(SaveDataFilename, "{}", {IfMissing = true})
if not okW then warn("[UhAdmin] could not create tree.ehehetilde: " .. tostring(errW)) end
else
saveLock = not judge(st, a, b)
end
end
local cleanWarned = false
local function encodeSave()
local ok, enc = pcall(HttpService.JSONEncode, HttpService, SaveData)
if ok then return enc end
local ok2, enc2 = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONEncode(FS.Clean(SaveData)) end)
if ok2 then
if not cleanWarned then
cleanWarned = true
warn("[UhAdmin] some setting values cannot be stored as JSON and were skipped when saving: " .. tostring(enc))
end
return enc2
end
return nil, tostring(enc)
end
local odata = encodeSave() -- baseline = the state right after loading, so early changes are still written
local savefailwarn, writing = false, false
-- returns ok, wrote
local function saveNow()
if saveLock or writing then return true, false end
local enc, err = encodeSave()
if not enc then
if not savefailwarn then
savefailwarn = true
pcall(Util.Notify, "Could not save your settings: " .. tostring(err))
end
return false, false
end
if enc == odata then return true, false end
writing = true
local ok, werr = FS.Write(SaveDataFilename, enc)
writing = false
if ok then
odata = enc
savefailwarn = false
return true, true
end
if not savefailwarn then
savefailwarn = true
pcall(Util.Notify, "Failed to write tree.ehehetilde (your save file): " .. tostring(werr))
end
return false, false
end
Util.SaveFlush = function()
local ok, good = pcall(saveNow)
return ok and good
end
local function fill(dst, src)
for k, v in pairs(src) do
if dst[k] == nil then
dst[k] = v
elseif type(dst[k]) == "table" and type(v) == "table" then
fill(dst[k], v)
end
end
end
local function tryRecover()
local rst, ra, rb = readSave()
if rst == "ok" then
fill(SaveData, ra) -- in place: the UI already holds references to these tables
saveLock = false
note("recovered", "Your saved settings were found again and merged in. Re-execute the script to apply them everywhere.")
elseif rst == "missing" then
saveLock = false
else
saveLock = not judge(rst, ra, rb)
end
end
task.spawn(function()
local interval, lastTry = 0.5, os.clock()
while true do
task.wait(interval)
if saveLock then
if os.clock() - lastTry >= 8 then
lastTry = os.clock()
pcall(tryRecover)
end
else
local t0 = os.clock()
local okC, good, wrote = pcall(saveNow)
interval = (os.clock() - t0 > 0.004) and 1.5 or 0.5
if wrote then task.wait(1.5) elseif okC and good == false then task.wait(5) end
end
end
end)
pcall(function()
game:GetService("UserInputService").WindowFocusReleased:Connect(function() pcall(saveNow) end)

-- Custom Limb Reanimation: mobile-tuned RootPart placement + 10 FPS replication on weak devices (uses the Limb Reanimator).

	Kind = "Limb",

	TickRate = 1,

		local part = ctx.Torso or ctx.RootPart
		local p = part.Position
		local now = ctx.Time
		if lastCF and lastT and now - lastT < (CRM.LowEnd() and 0.05 or 0.033) and (p - lastPos).Magnitude < 4 then
			return lastCF
		end

		if type(fp) ~= "number" or fp ~= fp or fp < -1e6 or fp > 1e6 then fp = floor0 end

	end,

Util.CDNMemo = {}
Util.GetCDNAsset = function(filename)
local FXc = Util.FX
local on = FXc and FXc.Cache and FXc.Cfg.UICache ~= false
if on then
local m = Util.CDNMemo[filename]
if m then return m end
local okG, gid = pcall(FXc.Cache.Graphic, filename)
if okG and gid then
Util.CDNMemo[filename] = gid
return gid
end
end
local path = "UhhhhhhReanim/Assets/" .. filename
local s, id = pcall(isfile, path)
if s and id then
s, id = pcall(getcustomasset, path)
if s then
if on and type(id) == "string" and id ~= "" then Util.CDNMemo[filename] = id end
return id
end
end
return ""
end
-- Per-frame write cache: Util.Dirty(slot, key, value) is true only when value differs from what was last written for slot[key]
-- (colours: summed RGB tolerance 0.004 = under 1/255, numbers: 0.002), so unchanged theme colours / transparencies are not pushed
-- to the engine every frame. Every 90th call per key writes anyway so a property touched by another script never stays stale.
-- With "UI Cache" off it is always true (the old write-every-frame behaviour).
Util.Dirty = function(slot, key, v)
local FXc = Util.FX
if not (FXc and FXc.Cfg.UICache ~= false) then return true end
local cnt = slot.__n
if not cnt then cnt = {} slot.__n = cnt end
local k = (cnt[key] or 0) + 1
cnt[key] = k
local old = slot[key]
if old ~= nil and k % 90 ~= 0 then
local tv = typeof(v)
if tv == "Color3" then
if typeof(old) == "Color3" and math.abs(old.R - v.R) + math.abs(old.G - v.G) + math.abs(old.B - v.B) <= 0.004 then return false end
elseif tv == "number" then
if type(old) == "number" and math.abs(old - v) <= 0.002 then return false end
elseif old == v then
return false
end
end
slot[key] = v
return true
end
-- UI text measurement cache: same (text, size, font, bounds) -> same size, so layout rebuilds skip the engine call
Util.TextSize = function(text, size, font, bounds)
local FXc = Util.FX
local C = FXc and FXc.Cache
if not (C and FXc.Cfg.UICache ~= false and type(text) == "string" and typeof(font) == "EnumItem" and typeof(bounds) == "Vector2") then
return TextService:GetTextSize(text, size, font, bounds)
end
local key = text .. "\0" .. tostring(size) .. "\0" .. font.Name .. "\0" .. tostring(bounds.X) .. "\0" .. tostring(bounds.Y)
local memo = C.Text
local v = memo[key]
if v then return v end
v = TextService:GetTextSize(text, size, font, bounds)
if C.TextN >= 3000 then memo = {} C.Text = memo C.TextN = 0 end
memo[key] = v
C.TextN += 1
return v
end
Util.MakeTriforce = function(tris, color, dur)
dur = dur or 8
local function CreateTriangle(parent, radius, width, rotation, color)
local height = (math.sqrt(3) / 2) * width
local pivot = Util.Instance("Frame", parent)
pivot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
pivot.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
pivot.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0)
pivot.BackgroundTransparency = 1
pivot.BorderSizePixel = 0
pivot.Rotation = rotation
local tri = Util.Instance("ImageLabel", pivot)
tri.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1)
tri.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5 - radius, 0)
tri.Size = UDim2.new(width, 0, height, 0)
tri.BackgroundTransparency = 1
tri.BorderSizePixel = 0
tri.Image = Util.GetCDNAsset("letriangul.graphic.png")
local grey = math.max(color.R, color.G, color.B) * 0.5
tri.ImageColor3 = Color3.new(grey, grey, grey)
TweenService:Create(tri, TweenInfo.new(dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {
ImageColor3 = color
}):Play()
end
local radius = 0.1
local pivot = Util.Instance("Frame")
pivot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
pivot.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
pivot.BackgroundTransparency = 1
pivot.BorderSizePixel = 0
local width = 2 * radius * math.sin(math.pi / tris) * 2
for i=1, tris do
CreateTriangle(pivot, radius, width, (i / tris) * 360, color)
end
return pivot
end
Util.MakeText = function(text)
text = text:upper()
local ls = "BCDEIKOPQRSTUVYZ\\_`N^MJ"
local lt = ""
lt ..= "DDDDD@DFF@@@@@FSFSFSF@@@@@@@@@@@@@@EMMUKKTDD@@@@@DEEEEEDDBBBBBD@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@@DE@@@G@@@@@@@@@DABBDEEI"
lt ..= "GJJJJJGDVDDDDSGJAGIISRAAGAARWJJSAAASIIRAARGIIRJJGSAABBDDGJJGJJGGJJHAAG"
lt ..= "@DD@DD@@DD@DE@@BDEDB@@@G@G@@@EDBDE@GJABD@D@@@@@@@"
lt ..= "DFJSJJJRJJRJJRGJIIIJGRJJJJJRSIIRIISSIIRIIIHIILJJHJJJSJJJGDDDDDGAAAAAJHJKMOMKJIIIIIISJQNJJJJJJPNLJJGJJJJJGRJJRIIIGJJJNGCRJJRMKJGJIGAJGSDDDDDDJJJJJJGJJJJJFDJJJNQJJJJFDFJJJJFDDDDSABDEIS"
local pixs = {}
local totalsize = 0
for i=0, 6 do
local row = {}
for j=1, text:len() do
local c = text:byte(j, j)
local w = 0
if c ~= 0x20 then
local k = (c - 33) * 7 + i
w = lt:byte(k + 1, k + 1)
if w ~= nil and w > 64 then
w = ls:byte(w - 64, w - 64) - 65
else
w = 0
end
end
for k=0, 5 do
local h = (j - 1) * 6 + (4 - k)
totalsize = math.max(totalsize, h + 1)
local p = (w // math.pow(2, k)) % 2
if p > 0 then
row[h] = true
end
end
end
pixs[i] = row
end
local pivot = Util.Instance("Frame")
pivot.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
pivot.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
pivot.Size = UDim2.new(0, totalsize, 0, 7)
pivot.BackgroundTransparency = 1
pivot.BorderSizePixel = 0
for i=0, 6 do
local row = pixs[i]
local olde = nil
local olds = 0
for j=0, totalsize - 1 do
local pix = row[j]
if pix == true then
if olde ~= nil then
olds += 1
olde.Size = UDim2.new(olds / totalsize, 0, 1 / 7, 0)
else
olde = Util.Instance("Frame", pivot)
olde.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0)
olde.Position = UDim2.new(j / totalsize, 0, i / 7, 0)
olde.Size = UDim2.new(1 / totalsize, 0, 1 / 7, 0)
olde.BackgroundTransparency = 1
olde.BorderSizePixel = 0
olds = 1
end
else
olde = nil
olds = 0
end
end
end
return pivot
end

v.BackgroundTransparency = tran
end

Util.SongRepo = {User = "Elliot12-wq", Repo = "Intro-theme-songs.-", Branch = "main", Listing = nil, Busy = false}
Util.SongRepo.Raw = function(name)
local R = Util.SongRepo
local enc = tostring(name):gsub("[^%w%-%._~]", function(c) return string.format("%%%02X", c:byte()) end)
return "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/" .. R.User .. "/" .. R.Repo .. "/" .. R.Branch .. "/" .. enc
end
Util.SongRepo.List = function(fetchFn)
local R = Util.SongRepo
local t0 = os.clock()
while R.Busy and os.clock() - t0 < 15 do task.wait(0.1) end
if R.Listing ~= nil then return R.Listing or nil end
R.Busy = true
local names = false
pcall(function()
local body = fetchFn("https://api.github.com/repos/" .. R.User .. "/" .. R.Repo .. "/contents?ref=" .. R.Branch)
local data = body and game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONDecode(body)
if type(data) == "table" then
local list = {}
for _, e in ipairs(data) do
if type(e) == "table" and e.type == "file" and type(e.name) == "string" then list[#list + 1] = e.name end
end
names = list
end
end)
R.Listing = names
R.Busy = false
return names or nil
end
Util.SongRepo.Find = function(names, match)
if type(names) ~= "table" or type(match) ~= "table" then return nil end
for _, n in ipairs(names) do
local low = n:lower()
if low:sub(-4) == ".mp3" then
local all = true
for _, key in ipairs(match) do
if not low:find(key, 1, true) then all = false break end
end
if all then return n end
end
end
return nil
end
Util.SongLoader = function(X)
local TS = {
Title = "Modjo - Lady (Hear Me Tonight)",
File = "modjo_lady_theme.mp3",
Bpm = 126.02, Offset = 0.18,
MinBytes = 100000,
Remote = {Name = "modjo_lady_theme.mp3", Match = {"modjo"}},
}
if X then TS = X end
local function THEME_SONG_DATA()
return {
}
end
TS.Samples = TS.Samples or {
{1, "49443303000000000023545353450000"},
{442671, "cc51c2d7d88da30c7b2196cd3bd05929"},
{885342, "2484f49152a9422f203594b14832391a"},
{1327998, "55555555555555555555555555555555"},
}
TS.Progress = 0
TS.Why = nil
local B64, La, Lb, Lc, Ld = {}, {}, {}, {}, {}
do
local alphabet = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
for i = 1, 64 do
local v, ch = i - 1, alphabet:byte(i)
B64[ch] = v
La[ch] = v * 4
Lb[ch] = v // 16 + (v % 16) * 4096
Lc[ch] = (v // 4) * 256 + (v % 4) * 4194304
Ld[ch] = v * 65536
end
B64[61], La[61], Lb[61], Lc[61], Ld[61] = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
end
local function hex(s)
return (s:gsub(".", function(ch) return string.format("%02x", ch:byte()) end))
end
local function verify(body)
if type(body) ~= "string" or #body ~= TS.Bytes or body:sub(1, 3) ~= "ID3" then return false end
for _, sm in ipairs(TS.Samples) do
if hex(body:sub(sm[1], sm[1] + 15)) ~= sm[2] then return false end
end
return true
end
local function decodeNative(chunks)
local joined = table.concat(chunks)
local getters = {
function() return crypt.base64decode end,
function() return crypt.base64_decode end,
function() return crypt.base64.decode end,
function() return syn.crypt.base64.decode end,
function() return base64_decode end,
function() return base64decode end,
function() return base64.decode end,
}
for _, get in ipairs(getters) do
local okG, fn = pcall(get)
if okG and type(fn) == "function" then
local okD, res = pcall(fn, joined)
if okD and verify(res) then return res end
end
end
return nil
end
local function decodeLua(chunks)
local sbyte, schar, concat = string.byte, string.char, table.concat
local nchars = 0
for _, s in ipairs(chunks) do nchars = nchars + #s end
local lastChunk = chunks[#chunks]
local pad = (lastChunk:sub(-2) == "==") and 2 or ((lastChunk:sub(-1) == "=") and 1 or 0)
local size = nchars // 4 * 3 - pad
local t0 = os.clock()
local total = #chunks
if type(buffer) == "table" and buffer.create and buffer.writeu32 and buffer.readstring then
local buf = buffer.create(size + 8)
local writeu32 = buffer.writeu32
local pos = 0
for ci, s in ipairs(chunks) do
for i = 1, #s, 4 do
local a, b, c, d = sbyte(s, i, i + 3)
writeu32(buf, pos, La[a] + Lb[b] + Lc[c] + Ld[d])
pos = pos + 3
end
TS.Progress = ci / total
if os.clock() - t0 > 0.02 then
task.wait()
t0 = os.clock()
end
end
return buffer.readstring(buf, 0, size)
end
local out = {}
for ci, s in ipairs(chunks) do
local parts, pn = {}, 0
for i = 1, #s, 4 do
local a, b, c, d = sbyte(s, i, i + 3)
local v = (B64[a] or 0) * 262144 + (B64[b] or 0) * 4096 + (B64[c] or 0) * 64 + (B64[d] or 0)
pn = pn + 1
parts[pn] = schar(v // 65536, (v // 256) % 256, v % 256)
end
out[ci] = concat(parts)
TS.Progress = ci / total
if os.clock() - t0 > 0.02 then
task.wait()
t0 = os.clock()
end
end
local body = concat(out)
if pad > 0 then body = body:sub(1, #body - pad) end
return body
end
local function unpack64(chunks)
local okN, res = pcall(decodeNative, chunks)
if okN and res then return res end
local okL, body = pcall(decodeLua, chunks)
if okL and verify(body) then return body end
TS.Why = okL and "bundled data failed verification (script text damaged?)" or ("decode error: " .. tostring(body))
return nil
end
TS.Path = "UhhhhhhReanim/Assets/" .. TS.File
TS.Period = 60 / TS.Bpm
local busy, failed = false, false
local function url()
if X then return nil end
local u = _G.UhhhhhhThemeSongUrl
if type(u) ~= "string" or u == "" then u = THEME_SONG_URL end
u = tostring(u):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")
if u:match("^https?://%S+$") then return u end
return nil
end
local verified = false
function TS.Cached()
if verified then return true end
local ok, v = pcall(isfile, TS.Path)
if not (ok and v == true) then return false end
local FE = Util.FastExec
local fast = FE and FE.On()
if fast and FE.FileOk(TS.Path, TS.Bytes) then
verified = true
return true
end
if type(readfile) == "function" then
local okR, data = pcall(readfile, TS.Path)
if okR and type(data) == "string" and (#data < TS.MinBytes or (TS.Bytes ~= nil and #data ~= TS.Bytes)) then
pcall(function() if type(delfile) == "function" then delfile(TS.Path) end end)
if fast then FE.FileDrop(TS.Path) end
return false
end
if fast and okR and type(data) == "string" then FE.FileSet(TS.Path, #data) end
end
verified = true
return true
end
local function fetch(u)
local ok, body = pcall(game.HttpGet, game, u)
if ok and type(body) == "string" and #body > 0 then return body end
if type(request) == "function" then
local ok2, res = pcall(request, {Url = u, Method = "GET"})
if ok2 and type(res) == "table" and (res.StatusCode == 200 or res.Success == true) and type(res.Body) == "string" then
return res.Body
end
end
return nil
end
local function looksLikeMp3(b)
if #b < TS.MinBytes then return false end
if b:sub(1, 3) == "ID3" then return true end
local b1, b2 = b:byte(1, 2)
return b1 == 0xFF and b2 ~= nil and b2 >= 0xE0
end
function TS.Ensure(wait)
if TS.Cached() then return true end
local u = url()
local chunks = (X and X.Data or THEME_SONG_DATA)()
local bundled = type(chunks) == "table" and #chunks > 0
if failed or not (u or bundled or TS.Remote) then return false end
if not busy then
busy = true
task.spawn(function()
local function sizeOk()
if type(readfile) ~= "function" then return true end
local okR, data = pcall(readfile, TS.Path)
return okR and type(data) == "string" and ((TS.Bytes ~= nil and #data == TS.Bytes) or (TS.Bytes == nil and #data >= TS.MinBytes))
end
local function save(body)
pcall(function()
if not isfolder("UhhhhhhReanim/Assets") then makefolder("UhhhhhhReanim/Assets") end
end)
local okW, errW = pcall(writefile, TS.Path, body)
if okW and sizeOk() then return true end
if type(appendfile) == "function" then
local okP = pcall(function()
for i = 1, #body, 262144 do
local piece = body:sub(i, i + 262143)
if i == 1 then writefile(TS.Path, piece) else appendfile(TS.Path, piece) end
end
end)
if okP and sizeOk() then return true end
end
TS.Why = "could not write " .. TS.Path .. (okW and " (file came out the wrong size)" or (": " .. tostring(errW)))
return false
end
local ok = pcall(function()
if bundled then
local body = unpack64(chunks)
if body and save(body) then return end
end
if u then
for attempt = 1, 2 do
local body = fetch(u)
if body and looksLikeMp3(body) and save(body) then return end
if attempt == 1 then task.wait(1.5) end
end
end
if TS.Remote then
local R = Util.SongRepo
local tried = {}
local function try(name)
if not name or tried[name] then return false end
tried[name] = true
for attempt = 1, 2 do
local body = fetch(R.Raw(name))
if body and looksLikeMp3(body) and save(body) then return true end
if body and not looksLikeMp3(body) then break end
if attempt == 1 then task.wait(1.5) end
end
return false
end
if try(TS.Remote.Name) then return end
if try(R.Find(R.List(fetch), TS.Remote.Match)) then return end
TS.Why = TS.Why or ("could not download " .. tostring(TS.Remote.Name or TS.Title) .. " from the GitHub song repo")
end
end)
if not (ok and TS.Cached()) then
failed = true
local why = TS.Why or "no bundled data and no valid THEME_SONG_URL"
warn("[Uhhhhhh] " .. (X and "Intro 2 song" or "theme song") .. " unavailable - " .. why .. (X and ". Using the original intro." or ". Using the old default track."))
pcall(function() Util.UINotify((X and "Intro 2 song" or "Theme song") .. " unavailable: " .. why) end)
end
busy = false
end)
end
local t0 = os.clock()
while busy and os.clock() - t0 < (wait or 0) do task.wait(0.1) end
return TS.Cached()
end
function TS.IsPlaying(snd)
local ok, r = pcall(function() return snd.Name == TS.Title and snd.IsPlaying end)
return ok and r == true
end
function TS.Beat(pos)
local n = (pos - TS.Offset) / TS.Period
local i = math.floor(n)
return i, n - i
end
return TS
end

local UISound = {}
UISound.Music = Util.Instance("Sound", UIMainFrame)
UISound.Music.Looped = false
UISound.Music.PlaybackRegionsEnabled = false
UISound.Music.Volume = 1
UISound.Music.PlaybackSpeed = 1
local MusicPlayer = {}
MusicPlayer.Database = {
}
pcall(function()
local future = table.clone(MusicPlayer.Database)
if isfile("UhhhhhhReanim/Muzik/nobuiltin") then
table.clear(future)
end
for _,file in listfiles("UhhhhhhReanim/Muzik") do
if isfile(file) and file:sub(-4, -1) == ".mp3" then
table.insert(future, {file, file:sub(21, -5)})
end
end
if #future > 0 then
MusicPlayer.Database = future
end
end)
table.insert(MusicPlayer.Database, 1, {Util.ThemeSong.Path, Util.ThemeSong.Title, Theme = true})
MusicPlayer.Switching = false
MusicPlayer.UserPicked = false
MusicPlayer.Last = 1
MusicPlayer.PlayMusic = function(i)
if MusicPlayer.Switching then return end
MusicPlayer.Switching = true
local last = MusicPlayer.LastMusic
if not i and MusicPlayer.Sequential and last then i = last % #MusicPlayer.Database + 1 end
if not i then
i = last
while #MusicPlayer.Database > 1 and (i == last or (MusicPlayer.Database[i].Theme and not Util.ThemeSong.Cached())) do
i = math.random(1, #MusicPlayer.Database)
task.wait()
end
i = i or 1
end
MusicPlayer.LastMusic = i
local hi = MusicPlayer.Database[i]
local soundid, soundname = hi[1], hi[2]
if hi.Theme then pcall(Util.ThemeSong.Ensure, 40) end
local s, id = pcall(isfile, soundid)
if s and id then
s, id = pcall(getcustomasset, soundid)
if s then
soundid = id
else
soundid = ""
end
else
soundid = ""
end
if #soundid == 0 then
MusicPlayer.Switching = false
if #MusicPlayer.Database <= 1 then return end
return MusicPlayer.PlayMusic()
end
UISound.Music:Stop()
UISound.Music.SoundId = soundid
UISound.Music.Name = soundname
UISound.Music.Looped = hi.Loop == true
local lw = os.clock()
repeat game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Wait() until UISound.Music.IsLoaded or os.clock() - lw > 8
UISound.Music.TimePosition = 0
UISound.Music:Play()
task.wait()
MusicPlayer.Switching = false
end
MusicPlayer.PlayDefault = function()
if MusicPlayer.UserPicked then return end
local ok = Util.ThemeSong.Ensure(40)
if MusicPlayer.UserPicked then return end
local IS = (SaveData.IntroStyle == 15 and Util.Intro15Song) or (SaveData.IntroStyle == 14 and Util.Intro14Song) or (SaveData.IntroStyle == 13 and Util.Intro13Song) or (SaveData.IntroStyle == 12 and Util.Intro12Song) or (SaveData.IntroStyle == 11 and Util.Intro11Song) or (SaveData.IntroStyle == 10 and Util.Intro10Song) or (SaveData.IntroStyle == 9 and Util.Intro9Song) or (SaveData.IntroStyle == 8 and Util.Intro8Song) or nil
if IS then
local okS, idxS = pcall(function()
if not IS.Ensure(60) then return nil end
for i, entry in ipairs(MusicPlayer.Database) do
if entry[1] == IS.Path then return i end
end
table.insert(MusicPlayer.Database, {IS.Path, IS.Title, Intro2 = true})
return #MusicPlayer.Database
end)
if okS and idxS and not MusicPlayer.UserPicked then
MusicPlayer.Database[idxS].Loop = true
MusicPlayer.PlayMusic(idxS)
return
end
end
MusicPlayer.PlayMusic(ok and 1 or nil)
end

end)
Util.Color = (function()
local C = {}
local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
C.Modes = {"Theme (follow UI theme)", "Picked color", "Rainbow", "Harmony cycle", "Aurora", "Music reactive", "Day / Night"}
C.Harmonies = {"Analogous", "Complementary", "Triadic", "Split complementary", "Monochrome"}
C.Cur = WHITE
C.ThemeCol = WHITE
local function cfg() return (Util.FX and Util.FX.Cfg) or {} end
local function clamp(x, a, b) if x < a then return a elseif x > b then return b end return x end
local function hueLerp(a, b, k)
local d = ((b - a + 0.5) % 1) - 0.5
return (a + d * k) % 1
end
function C.Init()
local st = Util.FX and Util.FX.Store
if st and st.AccentMode == nil and type(st.UIAccent) == "string" and st.UIAccent ~= "" then
Util.FX.SetCfg("AccentMode", 2)
end
end
function C.Base()
local c = cfg()
local hx = c.UIAccent or ""
if c.UICache == false then return Util.ParseHex(hx) or C.ThemeCol end
if hx ~= C._hx then C._hx = hx C._hxc = Util.ParseHex(hx) or false end
return C._hxc or C.ThemeCol
end
function C.HarmonyHues(h)
local m = cfg().HarmonyMode or 1
if m == 2 then return {h, (h + 0.5) % 1}
elseif m == 3 then return {h, (h + 1 / 3) % 1, (h + 2 / 3) % 1}
elseif m == 4 then return {h, (h + 0.42) % 1, (h + 0.58) % 1}
elseif m == 5 then return {h}
end
return {h, (h + 0.08) % 1, (h - 0.08) % 1}
end
local function music()
local ok, v = pcall(function()
local s = Util.FX and Util.FX.UISound and Util.FX.UISound.Music
if s and s.IsPlaying ~= false then return s.PlaybackLoudness end
return 0
end)
return ok and v or 0
end
function C.Resolve(t, theme)
C.ThemeCol = theme or C.ThemeCol
C.Cur = C.ThemeCol
return C.ThemeCol
end
function C.Palette(t)
local a = C.Cur
local on = cfg().UICache ~= false
if on and C._pc and C._pa == a and C._pm == (cfg().HarmonyMode or 1) then return C._pc end
local h, s, v = a:ToHSV()
local hues = C.HarmonyHues(h)
local m = cfg().HarmonyMode or 1
local sec, ter
if m == 5 then
sec = Color3.fromHSV(h, s * 0.6, math.max(0.35, v * 0.7))
ter = Color3.fromHSV(h, s * 0.4, 1)
else
sec = Color3.fromHSV(hues[2] or h, s, v)
ter = Color3.fromHSV(hues[3] or ((h + 0.25) % 1), s * 0.85, v)
end
local res = {Accent = a, Secondary = sec, Tertiary = ter, Bg = Color3.fromHSV(h, clamp(s * 0.55, 0, 0.6), 0.07), Text = Color3.new(1, 1, 1):Lerp(a, 0.12)}
if on then C._pc, C._pa, C._pm = res, a, (cfg().HarmonyMode or 1) end
return res
end
return C
end)()

local FX = Util.FX
local genv = (type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv()) or _G
if genv.NA_AUTO_PERF == false or _G.NA_AUTO_PERF == false then return end
local function try(f, ...)
local ok, r = pcall(f, ...)
if ok then return r end
end
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local pn = tostring(try(function() return UIS:GetPlatform() end) or "")
local mobile
if pn:find("IOS") or pn:find("Android") then
mobile = true
elseif pn:find("Windows") or pn:find("OSX") or pn:find("Linux") or pn:find("SteamOS") then
mobile = false
else
mobile = try(function() return UIS.TouchEnabled and not (UIS.KeyboardEnabled or UIS.MouseEnabled) end) == true
end
local function unitOf(ks)
if ks:find("byte", 1, true) then return "b" end
if ks:find("kb$") or ks:find("[^a-z]kb") or ks:find("kib", 1, true) then return "kb" end
if ks:find("mb$") or ks:find("[^a-z]mb") or ks:find("mib", 1, true) then return "mb" end
if ks:find("gb$") or ks:find("[^a-z]gb") or ks:find("gib", 1, true) then return "gb" end
end
-- RAM value -> GB. Honors explicit unit hints (key names / "8 GB" strings), otherwise infers GB / MB / KB / bytes from magnitude
local function toGB(v, hint)
if type(v) == "string" then
local low = v:lower()
local num = tonumber(low:match("%d+%.?%d*"))
if not num then return nil end
hint = (low:find("tb", 1, true) and "tb") or (low:find("gb", 1, true) and "gb") or (low:find("mb", 1, true) and "mb") or (low:find("kb", 1, true) and "kb") or (low:find("byte", 1, true) and "b") or hint
v = num
end
v = tonumber(v)
if not v or v ~= v or v <= 0 then return nil end
local g
if hint == "tb" then g = v * 1024
elseif hint == "gb" then g = v
elseif hint == "mb" then g = v / 1024
elseif hint == "kb" then g = v / 1048576
elseif hint == "b" then g = v / 2 ^ 30
elseif v < 256 then g = v
elseif v < 131072 then g = v / 1024
elseif v < 2e8 then g = v / 1048576
else g = v / 2 ^ 30 end
if g < 0.5 or g > 256 then return nil end
return g
end
local BAD = {"avail", "free", "used", "usage", "limit", "process", "heap", "swap", "virtual", "cache", "vram", "video", "gpu", "graphic", "texture", "dedicated"}
local function badKey(k)
for _, w in ipairs(BAD) do if k:find(w, 1, true) then return true end end
return false
end
local GPU_SOFT = {"llvmpipe", "swiftshader", "softpipe", "basic render", "software"}
local GPU_STRONG = {"rtx", "gtx 16", "gtx 10[6-9]", "rx [5-9]%d%d%d", "arc a", "apple m%d", "apple a1%d", "apple a2%d", "adreno%D*[78]%d%d", "adreno%D*6[4-9]%d", "mali%-g7", "mali%-g9", "immortalis", "xclipse", "radeon pro", "vega 1"}
local GPU_WEAK = {"intel%(r%) hd", "intel hd", "uhd graphics", "gma", "radeon hd", "radeon%(tm%) r[2-5]", "adreno%D*[2345]%d%d", "mali%-4", "mali%-t", "mali%-g3", "mali%-g5[12]", "powervr", "vivante", "geforce [89]", "gt 7", "gt 6"}
local function gpuClass(name)
if type(name) ~= "string" then return nil end
local n = name:lower()
for _, p in ipairs(GPU_SOFT) do if n:find(p, 1, true) then return "soft" end end
for _, p in ipairs(GPU_STRONG) do if n:find(p) then return "strong" end end
for _, p in ipairs(GPU_WEAK) do if n:find(p) then return "weak" end end
return "mid"
end
-- walks an executor info table (depth <= 2) collecting total RAM (ranked), cores/threads and GPU/CPU names
local function scan(t, depth, o)
if type(t) ~= "table" or depth > 2 then return end
for k, v in pairs(t) do
local ks = type(k) == "string" and k:lower() or ""
local tv = type(v)
if tv == "table" then
scan(v, depth + 1, o)
elseif ks ~= "" and (tv == "number" or tv == "string") then
if not badKey(ks) then
local mem = ks:find("memory", 1, true) or ks:find("^ram") or ks:find("[^a-z]ram") or ks:find("ram$")
local rank = 0
if mem and (ks:find("total", 1, true) or ks:find("physical", 1, true) or ks:find("install", 1, true)) then
rank = 2
elseif ks == "ram" or ks == "memory" or ks == "ramgb" or ks == "ram_gb" or ks == "memorygb" then
rank = 1
end
if rank > (o.rr or 0) then
local g = toGB(v, unitOf(ks))
if g then o.ram, o.rr = g, rank end
end
end
if tv == "number" then
if v >= 1 and v <= 256 and v % 1 == 0 and not (ks:find("clock", 1, true) or ks:find("speed", 1, true) or ks:find("freq", 1, true) or ks:find("temp", 1, true) or ks:find("mhz", 1, true) or ks:find("ghz", 1, true)) then
if ks:find("thread", 1, true) or ks:find("logical", 1, true) or ks:find("processorcount", 1, true) or ks:find("cpucount", 1, true) or ks:find("numcpu", 1, true) then
o.th = math.max(o.th or 0, v)
elseif ks:find("core", 1, true) then
o.cores = math.max(o.cores or 0, v)
end
end
elseif #v > 2 and #v < 120 then
if ks:find("gpu", 1, true) or ks:find("graphic", 1, true) or ks:find("video", 1, true) or ks:find("renderer", 1, true) or ks:find("adapter", 1, true) then
o.gpu = o.gpu or v
elseif ks:find("cpu", 1, true) or ks:find("processor", 1, true) then
o.cpu = o.cpu or v
end
end
end
end
end
local function procMB() return tonumber(try(function() return game:GetService("Stats"):GetTotalMemoryUsageMb() end)) end
-- gather every executor-exposed hardware source; each call is independent, nothing unavailable is treated as known
local hw, cands, srcs = {}, {}, {}
local function consume(n, r)
local o = {}
local tr = type(r)
if tr == "table" then
scan(r, 0, o)
elseif tr == "number" then
if n:find("ram", 1, true) or n:find("memory", 1, true) then
local g = toGB(r)
if g then o.ram, o.rr = g, 2 end
elseif r >= 1 and r <= 256 and r % 1 == 0 then
if n:find("logical", 1, true) or n:find("count", 1, true) or n:find("processor", 1, true) then o.th = r
elseif n:find("core", 1, true) or n:find("cpu", 1, true) then o.cores = r end
end
elseif tr == "string" and #r > 2 and #r < 120 then
if n:find("gpu", 1, true) or n:find("graphic", 1, true) or n:find("video", 1, true) or n:find("render", 1, true) then
o.gpu = r
elseif n:find("cpu", 1, true) or n:find("processor", 1, true) then
o.cpu = r
elseif n:find("ram", 1, true) or n:find("memory", 1, true) then
local g = toGB(r)
if g then o.ram, o.rr = g, 2 end
end
end
if o.ram then cands[#cands + 1] = {o.ram, o.rr or 1, n} end
hw.cores = hw.cores or o.cores
hw.th = hw.th or o.th
hw.gpu = hw.gpu or o.gpu
hw.cpu = hw.cpu or o.cpu
if o.ram or o.cores or o.th or o.gpu or o.cpu then srcs[#srcs + 1] = n end
end
pcall(function()
for _, n in ipairs({"getdeviceram", "getdevicememory", "gettotalram", "getsystemram", "getsystemmemory", "getramsize", "getphysicalmemory", "gettotalmemory", "getram", "getdeviceinfo", "getsysteminfo", "gethardwareinfo", "gethwinfo", "getdevicespecs", "getsystemspecs", "getspecs", "getcomputerinfo", "getcpuinfo", "getprocessorinfo", "getgpuinfo", "getgraphicsinfo", "getcpucores", "getcorecount", "getcpucount", "getprocessorcount", "getnumcores", "getlogicalcores", "getgpuname", "getgpu", "getvideocard", "getgraphicscard", "getrenderer"}) do
local fn = genv[n] or _G[n]
if type(fn) == "function" then
local r = try(fn)
if r ~= nil then consume(n, r) end
end
end
end)
local exName = try(function() return (identifyexecutor or getexecutorname)() end)
exName = type(exName) == "string" and exName or nil
local gb, src, conf
local mg = toGB(genv.NA_RAM_GB or _G.NA_RAM_GB)
if mg then
gb, src, conf = mg, "manual", "exact"
else
local bestRank = 0
for _, c in ipairs(cands) do
if c[2] > bestRank then bestRank, gb, src = c[2], c[1], c[3] end
end
if gb then
conf = bestRank >= 2 and "high" or "medium"
local agree = 0
for _, c in ipairs(cands) do
if math.abs(c[1] - gb) <= gb * 0.15 then agree = agree + 1 end
end
if agree >= 2 and conf == "medium" then conf = "high" end
local pm = procMB()
if pm and pm / 1024 > gb * 0.95 then conf = "low" end -- Roblox's own process memory can't exceed physical RAM: reading is suspect
end
end
local manualTier = tonumber(genv.NA_PERF_TIER or _G.NA_PERF_TIER)
local th = hw.th or hw.cores
local gcls = gpuClass(hw.gpu)
-- hardware evidence: threads (weak signal on phones, where 8 cores is normal) and GPU class nudge the RAM-based tier by at most one step
local delta = 0
if th then
if mobile then
if th <= 4 then delta = delta - 1 end
elseif th <= 2 then delta = delta - 1
elseif th >= 8 then delta = delta + 1 end
end
if gcls == "soft" or gcls == "weak" then delta = delta - 1 elseif gcls == "strong" then delta = delta + 1 end
if delta > 1 then delta = 1 elseif delta < -1 then delta = -1 end
local tier = manualTier
if tier then
src, conf = src or "manual-tier", conf or "exact"
elseif gb or th or gcls then
local base
if gb then
base = (gb < 2.5 and 1) or (gb < 5 and 2) or (gb < 9 and 3) or 4
if mobile and conf == "medium" then
for _, bd in ipairs({2.5, 5, 9}) do
if gb >= bd and gb < bd + 0.4 then base = math.max(1, base - 1) break end
end
end
else
base = mobile and 2 or 4
conf = "low"
src = srcs[1] or "hardware"
end
tier = base + delta
if delta > 0 and mobile and base < 4 and tier > 3 then tier = 3 end
else
tier = mobile and 2 or 4
src, conf = "fallback", "none"
end
tier = math.clamp(math.floor(tier), 1, 4)
-- static capability score 0-100 (hardware estimate only; live FPS lives in Perf.Status)
local num, den = 0, 0
if gb then
num = num + ((gb < 2 and 8) or (gb < 3 and 15) or (gb < 4 and 22) or (gb < 6 and 32) or (gb < 8 and 42) or (gb < 12 and 52) or 60)
den = den + 60
end
if th then
if mobile then
num = num + (th <= 4 and 3 or (th <= 6 and 9 or 12))
den = den + 12
else
num = num + ((th >= 12 and 20) or (th >= 8 and 16) or (th >= 6 and 12) or (th >= 4 and 7) or 3)
den = den + 20
end
end
if gcls then
num = num + ((gcls == "strong" and 30) or (gcls == "mid" and 18) or (gcls == "weak" and 8) or 0)
den = den + 30
end
local score = den > 0 and math.floor(num / den * 100 + 0.5) or nil
if score and mobile then score = math.max(0, score - 8) end
if manualTier then score = ({15, 40, 62, 85})[tier] end
local prof = {Mobile = mobile, RAM = gb, PhysicalGB = gb, RAMSource = src, Confidence = conf, ProcessMB = procMB(), Pressure = false, Cores = hw.cores or hw.th, Threads = hw.th or hw.cores, CPU = hw.cpu, GPU = hw.gpu, GPUClass = gcls, Score = score, Sources = srcs, Platform = pn, Executor = exName}
FX.Device = prof
_G.UHDevProfile = prof
pcall(function() genv.UHDevProfile = prof end)
local function apply(t)
prof.Tier, prof.Class = t, ({"low", "low", "mid", "high"})[t]
prof.LowEnd, prof.AntiLag, prof.AssetMode = t == 1, t == 1, ({"Batch", "Medium", "Medium"})[t]
if FX.Perf then FX.Perf.Seed(t, mobile, score, conf) end
end
apply(tier)
-- runtime memory pressure (Roblox process memory vs physical RAM): elevated blocks quality upgrades, sustained critical on phones lowers the tier once
if FX.Perf and FX.Perf.SetProbe then
local lastMB, crit, dropped = nil, 0, false
FX.Perf.SetProbe(function()
local used = procMB()
if not used then return 0 end
prof.ProcessMB = used
local ratio = used / (gb and gb * 1024 or (mobile and 4096 or 16384))
local grow = lastMB and (used - lastMB) or 0
lastMB = used
local lv = 0
if ratio >= 0.6 then lv = 2 elseif ratio >= 0.42 or (mobile and grow > 350) then lv = 1 end
prof.Pressure = lv > 0
if lv >= 2 and mobile and gb and not manualTier and not dropped then
crit = crit + 1
if crit >= 2 and prof.Tier > 1 then
dropped = true
apply(prof.Tier - 1)
end
else
crit = 0
end
return lv
end)
end
if SaveData.ModuleLoadMode == nil and tier <= 2 then
SaveData.ModuleLoadMode = tier == 1 and 4 or 2
end
end)
end

local function loadPos()
local sx, sy = tostring(FX.Cfg.AdminTriPos or ""):match("^([%d%.]+),([%d%.]+)$")
sx, sy = tonumber(sx), tonumber(sy)

local v = vpSize()
placeAt(math.clamp(sx, 0, 1) * v.X, math.clamp(sy, 0, 1) * v.Y) -- clamped to the visible screen
else
root.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
end
end

end
end)

local commitAt, commitPending = 0, false
local function scheduleCommit()
commitAt = os.clock() + 0.6
if commitPending then return end
commitPending = true
task.spawn(function()
while os.clock() < commitAt do task.wait(0.2) end
commitPending = false
pcall(commitPos)
end)
end

S.shake = math.max(0, S.shake - dt * 3)
local want = 0.9 + (S.hover and 1.1 or 0) + (S.open and 1.6 or 0) + S.boost * 2.5 + S.flash * 3
for _, e in ipairs(U.Tris) do
local T = e.tri
if T and T.active then
T.baseSpin = T.baseSpin + (want * e.mult - T.baseSpin) * (1 - math.exp(-6 * dt))
T.scaleBase = e.scale * (1 + 0.05 * math.sin(t * 2.3) + 0.12 * S.flash)
end
end
if S.shown then
local speed = 1.4 + (S.open and 1.6 or 0) + S.boost * 3 + S.flash * 5 + (Util.FX.Audio.running and Util.FX.Audio.kick * 4 or 0)
U.orbitA = (U.orbitA or 0) + dt * speed
local R = (SIZE + 8) / 2
for i, d in ipairs(dots) do
local a = U.orbitA + (i - 1) * (math.pi * 2 / 3)
d.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, math.cos(a) * R, 0.5, math.sin(a) * R)
end
U.btnGrad = ((U.btnGrad or 0) + dt * (90 + S.boost * 220 + (S.open and 120 or 0))) % 360
grad.Rotation = U.btnGrad
local pulse = SIZE + 14 + math.sin(t * 2) * 4 + S.flash * 18 + (Util.FX.Audio.running and Util.FX.Audio.kick * 10 or 0)
aura.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(pulse, pulse)
aura.BackgroundTransparency = 0.9 - S.flash * 0.35 - (S.open and 0.07 or 0)
btn.Rotation = S.shake > 0 and math.sin(t * 55) * 7 * S.shake or 0
if glyph.Visible then glyph.Rotation = (t * 80 * want) % 360 end
end
local g, bs = U.BarGrad, U.BarStroke
if g and g.Parent then
U.barGradA = ((U.barGradA or 0) + dt * (70 + (S.open and 90 or 0) + S.boost * 260)) % 360
g.Rotation = U.barGradA
bs.Thickness = 1.4 + S.boost * 1.2 + S.flash * 1.4
end
local sc = U.BarScan
if sc and sc.Parent and S.open then
U.scanT = ((U.scanT or 0) + dt / 1.5) % 1
sc.Position = UDim2.new(0, -70 + U.scanT * 320, 1, 0)
end
end)
if not ok and not U.tickWarned then
U.tickWarned = true
warn("[UhAdmin] driver error: " .. tostring(err))
end
end)
applyHidden(FX.Cfg.AdminTriHidden == true)
end)
if not okL then
warn("[UhAdmin] triangle launcher failed: " .. tostring(errL))
end
end

task.spawn(function()
local okCore, errCore = xpcall(function()
local Notification = {}
Notification.Notify = function(t)
t = t or {}
local desc = tostring(t.Description or "")
local title = tostring(t.Title or "")
local msg = desc
if title ~= "" and title ~= "Nameless Admin" then
msg = title .. ": " .. desc
end
pcall(Util.Notify, msg)
end
local Notify = Notification.Notify
Util.UhAdmin = Util.UhAdmin or {
Tris = {},
State = {open = false, hover = false, boost = 0, flash = 0, shake = 0, shown = false},
}
Util.UhAdmin.BlockedCmds = {punch = true}
Util.UhAdmin.Theme = function(t)
local th = Util.UhAdmin.GetTheme
if th then
local ok, a, b, c = pcall(th, t)
if ok and a then return a, b or Color3.new(0, 0, 0), c or Color3.new(1, 1, 1) end
end
return Util.LoopedHSV(t / 10, 0.8, 1), Color3.new(0, 0, 0), Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
end
Util.UhAdmin.IsBlocked = function(aliases)
local allowed = {walkfling = true, wfling = true, unwalkfling = true, unwfling = true}
for _, n in ipairs(aliases) do
local l = tostring(n):lower()
if Util.UhAdmin.BlockedCmds[l] then return true end
if l:find("fling", 1, true) and not allowed[l] then return true end
end
return false
end
Util.UhAdmin.RegisterTri = function(tri, mult, scale)
if tri then
table.insert(Util.UhAdmin.Tris, {tri = tri, mult = mult or 1, scale = scale or 1})
end
end
Util.UhAdmin.Fire = function(ev)
local U = Util.UhAdmin
local S = U.State
local function each(f)
for _, e in ipairs(U.Tris) do
if e.tri and e.tri.active then pcall(f, e.tri) end
end
end
if ev == "open" then
S.open = true
each(function(t) t.yawVel = t.yawVel + 8 t.pulse = math.max(t.pulse, 0.7) end)
pcall(Util.FX.Play, "open", 1.2)
elseif ev == "close" then
S.open = false
elseif ev == "type" then
S.boost = math.min(1, S.boost + 0.3)
each(function(t) t.yawVel = t.yawVel + 2.2 end)
elseif ev == "run" then
S.flash = 1
each(function(t) t.yawVel = t.yawVel + 16 t.pulse = 1 t.prism = 1 end)
pcall(Util.FX.Play, "hit", 1.3)
elseif ev == "unknown" then
S.shake = 1
each(function(t)
t.yawVel = t.yawVel - 12
if not t.flipT then t.flipT = 0 end
end)
pcall(Util.FX.Play, "release", 0.8)
end
end
local UhCollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local UH_TAG_ACCENT = "UhAdmin_Accent"
local UH_TAG_BG = "UhAdmin_BG"
local UH_TAG_TEXT = "UhAdmin_Text"
local function uhTag(obj, kind)
local tagName = (kind == "accent" and UH_TAG_ACCENT) or (kind == "bg" and UH_TAG_BG) or UH_TAG_TEXT
UhCollectionService:AddTag(obj, tagName)
end
do
local uhThemeLast, uhLastA, uhLastB, uhLastT, uhLastN, uhFullAt = 0, nil, nil, nil, -1, 0
local uhTagLists, uhIsStroke = {}, setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local function uhQualAccent(o)
if o:IsA("UIStroke") then uhIsStroke[o] = true return true end
return o:IsA("GuiObject")
end
local function uhQualGui(o) return o:IsA("GuiObject") end
local function uhQualText(o) return o:IsA("TextLabel") or o:IsA("TextButton") or o:IsA("TextBox") end
local function uhTagList(tag, qualifies)
local c = uhTagLists[tag]
if c then return c end
c = {n = 0, arr = {}, idx = {}}
uhTagLists[tag] = c
local function add(o)
if c.idx[o] or not qualifies(o) then return end
local n = c.n + 1
c.n, c.arr[n], c.idx[o] = n, o, n
end
UhCollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal(tag):Connect(add)
UhCollectionService:GetInstanceRemovedSignal(tag):Connect(function(o)
local at = c.idx[o]
if not at then return end
local n = c.n
local last = c.arr[n]
c.arr[at], c.idx[last] = last, at
c.arr[n], c.idx[o], c.n = nil, nil, n - 1
end)
for _, o in ipairs(UhCollectionService:GetTagged(tag)) do add(o) end
return c
end
game:GetService("RunService").Heartbeat:Connect(function()
local now = os.clock()
if now - uhThemeLast < 0.1 then return end
uhThemeLast = now
local cfg = Util.FX and Util.FX.Cfg
local accent, bg, textCol = Util.UhAdmin.Theme(now)
if cfg and cfg.UIAccent and cfg.UIAccent ~= "" then
accent = Util.ParseHex(cfg.UIAccent) or accent
end
local uhSig = uhTagList(UH_TAG_ACCENT, uhQualAccent).n + uhTagList(UH_TAG_BG, uhQualGui).n + uhTagList(UH_TAG_TEXT, uhQualText).n
if accent == uhLastA and bg == uhLastB and textCol == uhLastT and uhSig == uhLastN and now - uhFullAt < 0.4 then return end
uhLastA, uhLastB, uhLastT, uhLastN, uhFullAt = accent, bg, textCol, uhSig, now
do
local c = uhTagList(UH_TAG_ACCENT, uhQualAccent)
local arr = c.arr
for n = 1, c.n do
local o = arr[n]
if uhIsStroke[o] then o.Color = accent else o.BackgroundColor3 = accent end
end
end
do
local c = uhTagList(UH_TAG_BG, uhQualGui)
local arr = c.arr
for n = 1, c.n do arr[n].BackgroundColor3 = bg end
end
do
local c = uhTagList(UH_TAG_TEXT, uhQualText)
local arr = c.arr
for n = 1, c.n do arr[n].TextColor3 = textCol end
end
end)
end
local function uhNew(class, props, parent)
local o = Instance.new(class)
for k, v in pairs(props) do
o[k] = v
end
o.Parent = parent
return o
end

local function fade(show, t)
local info = ti(t or 0.3)
for k, it in ipairs(items) do
local function go() if dc.Parent then TS:Create(it[1], info, show and it[2] or it[3]):Play() end end
if show then task.delay((k - 1) * 0.05, go) else go() end
end
end
local function slideFade(i, show, base, t)
local info = ti(t or 0.35)
for k, it in ipairs(slides[i]) do
local function go()
if closed and show then return end
if not dc.Parent then return end
if show and it[4] then
it[1].Position = it[4] + UDim2.fromOffset(18, 0)
TS:Create(it[1], ti(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint), {Position = it[4]}):Play()
end
TS:Create(it[1], info, show and it[2] or it[3]):Play()
end
if show then task.delay(base + (k - 1) * 0.07, go) else go() end
end
end
local function fillRun(i, dur)
local tw = TS:Create(pills[i][2], TweenInfo.new(dur, Enum.EasingStyle.Linear), {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)})
tweens[#tweens + 1] = tw
tw:Play()
end
local function goTo(i)
if closed or i == cur then return end
local prev = cur
cur = i
slideFade(prev, false, 0, 0.25)
TS:Create(track, ti(0.6, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {Position = UDim2.fromOffset(-(i - 1) * VW, 0)}):Play()
slideFade(i, true, 0.3)
for k, p in ipairs(pills) do
TS:Create(p[1], ti(0.4, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint), {Size = UDim2.fromOffset(k == i and 34 or 14, 6)}):Play()
end
fillRun(i, 20)
end
local function dcHide()
if closed or not dc.Parent then return end
closed = true
local me = coroutine.running()
if mainT and mainT ~= me then pcall(task.cancel, mainT) end
if slideT and slideT ~= me then pcall(task.cancel, slideT) end
if artT and artT ~= me then pcall(task.cancel, artT) end
for _, tw in ipairs(tweens) do pcall(function() tw:Cancel() end) end
fade(false, 0.15)
slideFade(cur, false, 0, 0.15)
task.wait(0.12)
TS:Create(dc, TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {Size = UDim2.new(0, 126, 0, 34)}):Play()
TS:Create(corner, TweenInfo.new(0.45, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.InOut), {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 17)}):Play()
task.wait(0.5)
TS:Create(dc, TweenInfo.new(0.35, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, -60), Size = UDim2.new(0, 30, 0, 30)}):Play()
task.wait(0.4)
dc:Destroy()
end

local bringc = {}
commandcount = 0
cmd = {}
cmd._lastError = nil
cmd._conflicts = {}
cmd._rejected = {}
cmd._lastAdd = 0
cmd._pending = false
cmd._refresh = function()
cmd._lastAdd = os.clock()
if cmd._pending then return end
local okG, G = pcall(function() return gui end)
if not okG or type(G) ~= "table" or type(G.loadCommands) ~= "function" then return end
cmd._pending = true
task.spawn(function()
while os.clock() - cmd._lastAdd < 0.5 do task.wait(0.25) end
cmd._pending = false
local okH, H = pcall(function() return gui end)
if okH and type(H) == "table" and type(H.loadCommands) == "function" then pcall(H.loadCommands) end
end)
end
cmd.add = function(...)
local vars = {...}
local aliases, info, func = vars[1], vars[2], vars[3]
if type(aliases) ~= "table" or type(func) ~= "function" then
cmd._rejected[#cmd._rejected + 1] = tostring(type(aliases) == "table" and aliases[1] or aliases)
return false
end
local primary = aliases[1]
if type(primary) ~= "string" or primary == "" then return false end
if Util.UhAdmin.IsBlocked(aliases) then
cmd._blocked = cmd._blocked or {}
for _, n in ipairs(aliases) do cmd._blocked[tostring(n):lower()] = true end
return false
end
local meta = {}
if type(info) == "table" then for k, v in pairs(info) do meta[k] = v end end
meta[1] = tostring(meta[1] or primary)
meta[2] = tostring(meta[2] or "")
primary = primary:lower()
local old = Commands[primary]
local registration = {func, meta, aliases = {}}
local claim = {}
for i = 2, #aliases do
local a = aliases[i]
if type(a) == "string" and a ~= "" then claim[a:lower()] = true end
end
local carry = {}
if old then
for _, a in ipairs(old.aliases or {}) do
if Aliases[a] == old then
if claim[a] then Aliases[a] = nil
elseif old.proxy then carry[#carry + 1] = a
else Aliases[a] = nil end
end
end
else
commandcount = commandcount + 1
end
Commands[primary] = registration
local shadowed = Aliases[primary]
if shadowed and shadowed ~= registration then
Aliases[primary] = nil
if shadowed.aliases then
for i = #shadowed.aliases, 1, -1 do
if shadowed.aliases[i] == primary then table.remove(shadowed.aliases, i) end
end
end
end
local function take(alias)
if alias == primary then return false end
if Commands[alias] and Commands[alias] ~= registration then
cmd._conflicts[alias] = primary
return false
end
local holder = Aliases[alias]
if holder and holder ~= registration then
if not holder.proxy and holder ~= old then
cmd._conflicts[alias] = primary
return false
end
if holder.aliases then
for i = #holder.aliases, 1, -1 do
if holder.aliases[i] == alias then table.remove(holder.aliases, i) end
end
end
end
Aliases[alias] = registration
registration.aliases[#registration.aliases + 1] = alias
return true
end
for i = 2, #aliases do
local alias = aliases[i]
if type(alias) == "string" and alias ~= "" then take(alias:lower()) end
end
for _, a in ipairs(carry) do take(a) end
cmd._refresh()
return true
end
cmd.has = function(name)
name = tostring(name or ""):lower()
return Commands[name] ~= nil or Aliases[name] ~= nil
end
cmd.list = function()
local names = {}
for name in pairs(Commands) do names[#names + 1] = name end
table.sort(names)
local out = {}
for _, name in ipairs(names) do
local reg = Commands[name]
out[#out + 1] = {name = name, usage = reg[2][1], description = reg[2][2], aliases = reg.aliases or {}, proxy = reg.proxy == true}
end
return out
end
cmd.run = function(args)
cmd._lastError = nil
if type(args) ~= "table" then cmd._lastError = "Invalid command arguments"; return false, cmd._lastError end
local caller = type(args[1]) == "string" and args[1]:lower() or nil
if not caller or caller == "" then cmd._lastError = "No command specified"; return false, cmd._lastError end
local registration = Commands[caller] or Aliases[caller]
if not registration then
local na = Util.UhAdmin and Util.UhAdmin.NA
local blocked = cmd._blocked and cmd._blocked[caller]
if na and not blocked and type(na.Has) == "function" and type(na.Run) == "function" and not Util.UhAdmin.IsBlocked({caller}) and na.Has(caller) then
local rest = {}
for i = 2, #args do rest[#rest + 1] = args[i] end
na.Run((type(na.Resolve) == "function" and na.Resolve(caller)) or caller, rest)
return true
end
cmd._lastError = blocked and ("Command is disabled: " .. tostring(args[1])) or ("Unknown command: " .. tostring(args[1]))
return false, cmd._lastError
end
if type(registration[1]) ~= "function" then cmd._lastError = "Command has no handler: " .. tostring(args[1]); return false, cmd._lastError end
local arguments = {}
for i = 2, #args do arguments[#arguments + 1] = args[i] end
local success, err = _native_pcall(function() registration[1](table.unpack(arguments)) end)
if not success then cmd._lastError = tostring(err); return false, cmd._lastError end
return true
end
Util.UhCmd = {cmds = Commands, aliases = Aliases, run = cmd.run, list = cmd.list, has = cmd.has}
lib = {}
lib.wrap = function(f)
return coroutine.wrap(f)()
end
wrap = lib.wrap
local wait = function(int)
if not int then int = 0 end
local t = tick()
repeat
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait(0)
until (tick() - t) >= int
return (tick() - t), t
end

local getPlr = function(Name)
if type(Name) ~= "string" then return nil end
local query = Name:lower():gsub("%s", "")
local players = Players:GetPlayers()
if query == "random" then if #players == 0 then return nil end; return players[math.random(1, #players)] end
if query == "" then return nil end
local prefixMatch, containsMatch
for _, x in ipairs(players) do
local user = x.Name:lower()
local display = x.DisplayName:lower():gsub("%s", "")
if user == query or display == query then return x end
if not prefixMatch and (user:sub(1, #query) == query or display:sub(1, #query) == query) then prefixMatch = x end
if not containsMatch and user:find(query, 1, true) then containsMatch = x end
end
return prefixMatch or containsMatch
