local status
if criticalFailures > 0 then
status = STATUS_INCOMPATIBLE
elseif counts.FAIL > 0 or counts.REVIEW > 0 then
status = STATUS_PARTIAL
else
status = STATUS_COMPATIBLE
end
local summary = formatReport(status, flags, counts, criticalFailures)
if cfg.Print then
print(summary)
end
return {
Status = status,
Flags = flags,
Counts = counts,
CriticalFailures = criticalFailures,
Summary = summary,
}
end
function LimbReanimator.FormatCompatRich(report)
local COLORS = { PASS = "#55ff7f", FAIL = "#ff5555", REVIEW = "#ffd24d" }
local WEIGHT = { FAIL = 1, REVIEW = 2, PASS = 3 }
local function esc(s)
return (string.gsub(string.gsub(string.gsub(tostring(s), "&", "&amp;"), "<", "&lt;"), ">", "&gt;"))
end
local statusColor = COLORS.REVIEW
if report.Status == "Compatible!" then
statusColor = COLORS.PASS
elseif report.Status == "Not compatible: *NOT ACCURATE PLEASE CHECK IF SO.*" then
statusColor = COLORS.FAIL
end
local sorted = table.clone(report.Flags)
table.sort(sorted, function(a, b)
local wa, wb = WEIGHT[a.Severity], WEIGHT[b.Severity]
if wa ~= wb then return wa < wb end
if a.Critical ~= b.Critical then return a.Critical end
return a.Index < b.Index
end)
local lines = {
string.format('<font color="%s"><b>%s</b></font>', statusColor, esc(report.Status)),
string.format("Passed: %d | Failed: %d (critical: %d) | Review: %d",
report.Counts.PASS, report.Counts.FAIL, report.CriticalFailures, report.Counts.REVIEW),
"",
}
for _, flag in sorted do
lines[#lines + 1] = string.format('<font color="%s">[%s]</font> %s/%s%s - %s',
COLORS[flag.Severity], flag.Severity, esc(flag.Category), esc(flag.Id),
flag.Critical and " (critical)" or "", esc(flag.Message))
if flag.Detail then
lines[#lines + 1] = '    <font color="#aaaaaa">' .. esc(flag.Detail) .. "</font>"
end
end
return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end
function LimbReanimator.DumpState()
local out = {}
local function add(fmt, ...)
local ok, line = pcall(string.format, fmt, ...)
out[#out + 1] = ok and line or tostring(fmt)
end
local function safe(f, ...)
local ok, a = pcall(f, ...)
if ok then return a end
return "?"
end
add("== Limb Reanimator state (t=%.1f) ==", os.clock())
add("Mode=%s Velocity=%s Streaming=%s Gravity=%s SeatSit=%s Noclip=%s", tostring(LimbReanimator.Mode), tostring(LimbReanimator.Velocity), tostring(workspace.StreamingEnabled), tostring(workspace.Gravity), tostring(Reanimate.SeatSit), tostring(Reanimate.Noclip))
add("Stopping=%s Starting=%s", tostring(Reanimate.Stopping), tostring(Reanimate.Starting))
local rc = Reanimate.Character
if not rc then
add("FAKE character: none")
else
local hum = rc:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
local root = rc:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
add("FAKE character: inWorkspace=%s parent=%s", tostring(rc:IsDescendantOf(workspace)), tostring(rc.Parent))
if hum then
add("FAKE Humanoid: state=%s Sit=%s PlatformStand=%s WalkSpeed=%s JumpPower=%s UseJumpPower=%s Health=%s EvalStateMachine=%s MoveDirection=%s Floor=%s",
hum:GetState().Name, tostring(hum.Sit), tostring(hum.PlatformStand), tostring(hum.WalkSpeed), tostring(hum.JumpPower), tostring(hum.UseJumpPower), tostring(hum.Health), tostring(hum.EvaluateStateMachine), tostring(hum.MoveDirection), tostring(hum.FloorMaterial))
else
add("FAKE Humanoid: MISSING")
end
if root then
add("FAKE root: Anchored=%s IsGrounded=%s CanCollide=%s Pos=%s Vel=%s AssemblyMass=%s",
tostring(root.Anchored), tostring(safe(root.IsGrounded, root)), tostring(root.CanCollide), tostring(root.Position), tostring(root.AssemblyLinearVelocity), tostring(root.AssemblyMass))
add("FAKE seat weld present=%s", tostring(root:FindFirstChild("hell yeah!! :3") ~= nil))
local joints = safe(root.GetJoints, root)
if type(joints) == "table" then
for _, j in joints do
local p0, p1 = j:IsA("JointInstance") and j.Part0 or (j:IsA("WeldConstraint") and j.Part0) or nil, j:IsA("JointInstance") and j.Part1 or (j:IsA("WeldConstraint") and j.Part1) or nil
local outside = (p0 and not p0:IsDescendantOf(rc) and p0) or (p1 and not p1:IsDescendantOf(rc) and p1) or nil
if outside then
add("  EXTERNAL joint on fake root: %s (%s) -> %s Anchored=%s", j.Name, j.ClassName, outside:GetFullName(), tostring(outside.Anchored))
end
end
end
local connected = safe(root.GetConnectedParts, root, true)
if type(connected) == "table" then
for _, p in connected do
if p.Anchored then add("  ANCHORED part in fake assembly: %s", p:GetFullName()) end
end
end
else
add("FAKE root: MISSING")
end
for _, p in rc:GetDescendants() do
if p:IsA("BasePart") and p.Anchored then add("  fake part anchored: %s", p:GetFullName()) end
end
end
local ch = Player.Character
local rh = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if rh then
add("REAL Humanoid: state=%s WalkSpeed=%s JumpPower=%s Health=%s root=%s anchored=%s grounded=%s", rh:GetState().Name, tostring(rh.WalkSpeed), tostring(rh.JumpPower), tostring(rh.Health), tostring(rh.RootPart), tostring(rh.RootPart and rh.RootPart.Anchored), tostring(rh.RootPart and safe(rh.RootPart.IsGrounded, rh.RootPart)))
else
add("REAL character: %s", ch and "no Humanoid" or "none")
end
add("Input: Move=%s Jump=%s focusedTextBox=%s MenuIsOpen=%s", tostring(Reanimate.Control.Move), tostring(Reanimate.Control.Jump), tostring(UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox()), tostring(GuiService.MenuIsOpen))
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
local fakeHum = rc and rc:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
add("Camera: type=%s subjectIsFake=%s subject=%s", tostring(cam and cam.CameraType), tostring(cam and fakeHum ~= nil and cam.CameraSubject == fakeHum), tostring(cam and cam.CameraSubject))
return table.concat(out, "\n")
end
function LimbReanimator.Config(parent, hiderKey)
UI.CreateText(parent, "as mentioned in the README, this only works for SOME games,\nbecause 'modern' games create the Animator automatically which breaks limb reanimation", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
local modenames = LimbReanimator.GetModeNames()
local dmode = UI.CreateDropdown(parent, "RootPart Mode", modenames, LimbReanimator.Mode + 1)
local dvel = UI.CreateDropdown(parent, "RootPart Velocity", {"No Velocity", "Follow Character", "Fling-like"}, LimbReanimator.Velocity + 1)
local dinit = UI.CreateDropdown(parent, "Init Mode", {"Reset Character", "CDSB + Reset", "CDSB + SSE + Kill"}, LimbReanimator.InitMode + 1)
dmode.Changed:Connect(function(val)
LimbReanimator.Mode = val - 1
SaveData.Reanimator.LimbMode = val - 1
SaveData.Reanimator.LimbModeName = modenames[val]
end)
dvel.Changed:Connect(function(val)
LimbReanimator.Velocity = val - 1
SaveData.Reanimator.LimbVelocity = val - 1
end)
dinit.Changed:Connect(function(val)
LimbReanimator.InitMode = val - 1
SaveData.Reanimator.LimbInitMode = val - 1
end)
UI.CreateSwitch(parent, "Show me how I look!", LimbReanimator.ReplicateFPS10).Changed:Connect(function(val)
LimbReanimator.ReplicateFPS10 = val
SaveData.Reanimator.LimbReplicateFPS10 = val
end)
Reanimate.LimbHider.Switches(parent, hiderKey or "Limbs")
UI.CreateSwitch(parent, "Target Fling Enabled", LimbReanimator.FlingEnabled).Changed:Connect(function(val)
LimbReanimator.FlingEnabled = val
SaveData.Reanimator.LimbRoleplay = not val
end)
UI.CreateText(parent, "vvv touch player = they lose ownership vvv", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
UI.CreateText(parent, "fling style is chosen with the 'Fling Method' dropdown on the main page\n(Default / Weak / Nooby's / NaN State / Fling 1 / Fling 2 / Fling 3)", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
UI.CreateSeparator(parent)
do
local UX = Reanimate.UnanchoredReanimator
if UX and UX.ConfigExtra then UX.ConfigExtra(parent) end
end
UI.CreateSeparator(parent)
UI.CreateText(parent, "-=+ Compatibility Checker +=-", 12, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
local checkBtn, checkBtnText = UI.CreateButton(parent, "Check Limb Compatibility", 16)
local checkResult = UI.CreateText(parent, "Spawn a character, then press the button to check game animations, voice chat players, dynamic faces, the game environment and R6/R15.", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Left)
local checking = false
checkBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
if checking then return end
checking = true
checkBtnText.Text = "Checking..."
local ok, result = pcall(function()
return LimbReanimator.FormatCompatRich(LimbReanimator.RunCompatCheck())
end)
pcall(function()
checkResult.Text = ok and result or ("Checker failed: " .. tostring(result):gsub("<", "&lt;"):gsub(">", "&gt;"))
checkBtnText.Text = "Check Limb Compatibility"
end)
checking = false
end)
local dumpBtn = UI.CreateButton(parent, "Dump Fake Character State (console + clipboard)", 12)
dumpBtn.Activated:Connect(function()
local ok, report = pcall(LimbReanimator.DumpState)
report = ok and report or ("DumpState failed: " .. tostring(report))
print(report)
pcall(setclipboard, report)
pcall(Util.Notify, "Limb state dumped to the console (and clipboard if supported).")
end)
Util.LinkDestroyI2C(dmode, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
dmode.Value = math.min(LimbReanimator.Mode + 1, #modenames)
dvel.Value = LimbReanimator.Velocity + 1
dinit.Value = LimbReanimator.InitMode + 1
end))
end
function LimbReanimator.Start()
table.clear(LimbReanimator.FlingTargets)
table.clear(LimbReanimator._TempNotFling)
local LimbNames = {"Head", "Torso", "Left Arm", "Right Arm", "Left Leg", "Right Leg"}
local rootposition = Vector3.new(
math.random(-65536, 65536),
math.random(-70000, -60000),
math.random(-65536, 65536)
)
local rootposition2 = Vector3.new(
math.random(-2048, 2048),
math.random(-500, -100) + FallenPartsDestroyHeight,
math.random(-2048, 2048)
)
local skyposition = Vector3.new(
math.random(-2048, 2048),
math.random(1000, 2000),
math.random(-2048, 2048)
)
local veryskyposition = Vector3.new(
math.random(-65536, 65536),
math.random(60000, 70000),
math.random(-65536, 65536)
)
local InitCFrame = nil
if Player.Character then
local h = Player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if h and h.RootPart then
local r = h.RootPart
InitCFrame = r.CFrame
if h:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then
h:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, true)
h:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead)
end
end
end

local FakeTools = {}

local FakeTool = Instance.new("Tool")
FakeTool.Name = "faketool"
local FakeToolHandle = Instance.new("Part")
FakeToolHandle.Name = "Handle"
FakeToolHandle.Transparency = 1
FakeToolHandle.Color = Color3.new(0, 0, 1)
FakeToolHandle.CanCollide = false
FakeToolHandle.Massless = true
FakeToolHandle.Parent = FakeTool
FakeTool.Parent = Reanimate.Character

RightGrip.Name = "RightGrip"
RightGrip.Parent = FakeToolHandle

RightGrip.Part1 = FakeToolHandle

RightGrip.C1 = FakeTool.Grip
end))
RightGrip.C1 = FakeTool.Grip
return FakeTool
end
local BaseParts = {}
local UnknownMotor6Ds = {}
local Ragdoll = LimbReanimator.RagdollMode and true or false
local VelInterp = LimbReanimator.VelInterpMode and LimbReanimator.VelInterpCore or false
local RagdollParts, RagdollByPart, RGWC, RagdollWarned = {}, {}, {}, {}
local RagdollZero = Vector3.zero
local function RagdollFinite(p)
return p.X == p.X and p.Y == p.Y and p.Z == p.Z and math.abs(p.X) < 1e7 and math.abs(p.Y) < 1e7 and math.abs(p.Z) < 1e7
end
local function RagdollFiniteCF(cf)
local x, y, z, a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i = cf:GetComponents()
return math.abs(x) < 1e7 and math.abs(y) < 1e7 and math.abs(z) < 1e7 and math.abs(a) <= 1.01 and math.abs(b) <= 1.01 and math.abs(c) <= 1.01 and math.abs(d) <= 1.01 and math.abs(e) <= 1.01 and math.abs(f) <= 1.01 and math.abs(g) <= 1.01 and math.abs(h) <= 1.01 and math.abs(i) <= 1.01
end
local function RagdollJointPose(mv, rel)
local c0, c1 = mv.C0, mv.C1
return c0 * (c0:Inverse() * rel * c1).Rotation * c1:Inverse()
end
local function RagdollRelease(map, restore)
local rg = map.RG
if not rg then return end
map.RG, map.RT = nil, nil
if rg.Conn then
rg.Conn:Disconnect()
rg.Conn = nil
end
for _,o in {rg.AP, rg.AO, rg.DA, rg.BS, rg.A0, rg.A1, rg.PX} do
pcall(o.Destroy, o)
end
if RagdollByPart[rg.P1] == map then
RagdollByPart[rg.P1] = nil
RagdollParts[rg.P1] = nil
end
if restore and rg.Motor then
pcall(function() rg.Motor.Enabled = true end)
end
end
local function GameHasSocket(p0, p1)
local model = p1.Parent
if not model then return false end
for _,d in model:GetDescendants() do
if d:IsA("BallSocketConstraint") and d.Name ~= "RagdollSocket" then
local a, b = d.Attachment0, d.Attachment1
local x, y = a and a.Parent, b and b.Parent
if (x == p0 and y == p1) or (x == p1 and y == p0) then return true end
end
end
return false
end
local RagdollRoot
local function RagdollFolder()
if not (RagdollRoot and RagdollRoot.Parent) then
RagdollRoot = Instance.new("Folder")
RagdollRoot.Name = "RGP" .. math.random(100000, 999999)
RagdollRoot.Parent = workspace
end
return RagdollRoot
end
local function RagdollClean()
if RagdollRoot then
pcall(RagdollRoot.Destroy, RagdollRoot)
RagdollRoot = nil
end
end
local function Ragdollize(map, v, kp0, kp1)
local p0, p1 = kp0 or v.Part0, kp1 or v.Part1
if not (p0 and p1) then return end
local hum = p1.Parent and p1.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if hum then
hum.RequiresNeck = false
hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, false)
end
local rg = map.RG
if rg and rg.P1 == p1 and rg.PX and rg.PX.Parent and rg.AP.Parent and rg.AO.Parent then
rg.Motor, rg.P0 = v, p0
else
if rg then RagdollRelease(map) end
rg = {P0 = p0, P1 = p1, Motor = v, Fresh = true}
local px = Instance.new("Part")
px.Name = "RagdollProxy"
px.Size = p1.Size
px.Transparency = 1
px.CanCollide, px.CanTouch, px.CanQuery = false, false, false
px.CFrame = p1.CFrame
px.Parent = RagdollFolder()
local da = Instance.new("Attachment")
da.Name = "RagdollDrive"
da.Parent = px
local stiff = LimbReanimator.RagdollStiffness or 100
local ap = Instance.new("AlignPosition")
ap.Name = "RagdollAP"
ap.Mode = Enum.PositionAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
ap.Attachment0 = da
ap.ApplyAtCenterOfMass = true
ap.RigidityEnabled = false
ap.MaxForce, ap.MaxVelocity = math.huge, math.huge
ap.Responsiveness = stiff
ap.Position = px.Position
ap.Parent = px
local ao = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
ao.Name = "RagdollAO"
ao.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
ao.Attachment0 = da
ao.RigidityEnabled = false
ao.MaxTorque, ao.MaxAngularVelocity = math.huge, math.huge
ao.Responsiveness = stiff
ao.CFrame = px.CFrame
ao.Parent = px
rg.PX, rg.DA, rg.AP, rg.AO = px, da, ap, ao
map.RG = rg
end
RagdollByPart[p1] = map
end
local function RagdollWorld(part)
local c = RGWC[part]
if c then return c end
local m = RagdollByPart[part]
if m and m.RT and m.RG then
c = RagdollWorld(m.RG.P0) * m.RT
else
c = part.CFrame
end
RGWC[part] = c
return c
end
local function RagdollSample(RootPart)
local rc = RootPart.CFrame
for _,map in LimbMapping do
local rg = map.RG
if rg then
rg.Act = nil
local px = rg.PX
if px and px.Parent and map.Reference and not rg.Fresh then
local pw
if rg.P0 == RootPart then
pw = rc
else
local pm = RagdollByPart[rg.P0]
local ppx = pm and pm.RG and pm.RG.PX
if ppx and ppx.Parent then pw = ppx.CFrame end
end
if pw then
local rel = pw:ToObjectSpace(px.CFrame)
if RagdollFiniteCF(rel) then
local mv = rg.Motor
if rg.P0 ~= RootPart and mv and mv.Parent then rel = RagdollJointPose(mv, rel) end
if RagdollFiniteCF(rel) then rg.Act = rel end
end
end
end
end
end
end
local function RagdollDrive(RootPart)
table.clear(RGWC)
RGWC[RootPart] = RootPart.CFrame
local now = os.clock()
for _,map in LimbMapping do
local rg = map.RG
if rg and map.Reference then
local p1 = rg.P1
if not (rg.PX.Parent and rg.AP.Parent and rg.AO.Parent) and p1.Parent and rg.Motor and now - (rg.Rebuilt or 0) > 0.25 then
local rp0, motor = rg.P0, rg.Motor
RagdollRelease(map)
pcall(Ragdollize, map, motor, rp0, p1)
rg = map.RG
if rg then rg.Rebuilt = now end
end
if rg and rg.PX.Parent and rg.AP.Parent and rg.AO.Parent then
local px = rg.PX
local w = RagdollWorld(p1)
local pos = w.Position
if RagdollFiniteCF(w) then
if rg.Fresh then
rg.Fresh = nil
px.CFrame = w
px.AssemblyLinearVelocity = RagdollZero
px.AssemblyAngularVelocity = RagdollZero
end
if map.RPart0 ~= "ROOT" and not (rg.BS and rg.BS.Parent and rg.A0.Parent) then
local pm = RagdollByPart[rg.P0]
local ppx = pm and pm.RG and pm.RG.PX
local mv = rg.Motor
if ppx and ppx.Parent and mv and mv.Parent then
for _,o in {rg.A0, rg.A1, rg.BS} do
pcall(o.Destroy, o)
end
local a0, a1 = Instance.new("Attachment"), Instance.new("Attachment")
a0.Name, a1.Name = "RagdollA0", "RagdollA1"
a0.CFrame, a1.CFrame = mv.C0, mv.C1
a0.Parent, a1.Parent = ppx, px
local bs = Instance.new("BallSocketConstraint")
bs.Name = "RagdollSocket"
bs.LimitsEnabled = false
bs.TwistLimitsEnabled = false
bs.Attachment0, bs.Attachment1 = a0, a1
bs.Parent = px
rg.A0, rg.A1, rg.BS = a0, a1, bs
end
end
local pcf = px.CFrame
if not RagdollFiniteCF(pcf) or (pcf.Position - pos).Magnitude > 8 then
px.CFrame = w
px.AssemblyLinearVelocity = RagdollZero
px.AssemblyAngularVelocity = RagdollZero
end
rg.AP.Position = pos
rg.AO.CFrame = w
end
end
end
end
end
local Servo = LimbReanimator.ServoMode and true or false
local ServoByPart, ServoRoot, ServoBase, ServoConn, ServoDrive = {}, nil, nil, nil, nil
local ServoAnchor = CFrame.new(math.random(-512, 512), math.random(2500, 3000), math.random(-512, 512))
local SERVO_AX = {
CFrame.identity,
CFrame.fromMatrix(Vector3.zero, Vector3.yAxis, Vector3.zAxis),
CFrame.fromMatrix(Vector3.zero, Vector3.zAxis, Vector3.xAxis),
}
local SERVO_TAU, SERVO_RAD, SERVO_DEG = math.pi * 2, math.rad, math.deg
-- Servo calibration. Kinds hold anatomical ranges (deg) about the character's right (P), up (T) and forward/back (R) axes for a limb hanging down; R is the right-side range and is mirrored for the left side.
-- Hinge stage order stays X > Y > Z (CFrame.Angles order); the middle stage (Y) is the gimbal axis and is always kept inside +/-MID.
local SJ = {
TQ = 20, -- max torque per unit of driven mass at Strength 1 (stud^2/s^2)
RESP = 100, -- hinge servo responsiveness: high so the physical joint tracks the animated target without a smoothing lag
DEV = 0.06, -- max radians the replicated angle may stray from the commanded animation target: the animation target is authoritative, the physical servo only adds a small bounded residual
DEAD = 0.012, -- physical residuals below this (radians) are ignored, so servo jitter, solver noise and settling never reach the animation
GIM = SERVO_RAD(80), -- middle-stage angle (rad) from which the outer X / Z stages count as gimbal-coupled
Seq = 0, -- physics-step counter: a joint is only driven by an animation snapshot stamped with the current step
Snap = {}, SnapHj = {}, Live = {}, -- scratch tables for the one-pass animation snapshot / the one synchronized drive pass
MID = 88, -- middle-axis limit (deg), keeps the Euler decomposition away from gimbal lock
CAP = 178, -- hinge angle safety range (deg), avoids the +/-180 wrap
CARRIER = 4, -- carrier density, keeps carrier / limb mass ratios solver friendly
HEAD = 1.5, -- hinge speed headroom over the per-joint target rate, so the physical hinge never trails the target (the target rate is the only speed limit)
SPIN = SERVO_TAU * 8, -- unwrapped hinge angle range (rad) used for continuous rotation when anatomical limits are off
Kinds = {
root = {P = {-180, 180}, T = {-180, 180}, R = {-180, 180}, Spd = 1},
neck = {P = {-90, 90}, T = {-88, 88}, R = {-70, 70}, Spd = 1},
shoulder = {P = {-180, 180}, T = {-88, 88}, R = {-120, 180}, Spd = 1},
elbow = {P = {-20, 175}, T = {-60, 60}, R = {-30, 30}, Spd = 1},
wrist = {P = {-90, 90}, T = {-70, 70}, R = {-70, 70}, Spd = 1},
hip = {P = {-120, 160}, T = {-88, 88}, R = {-80, 100}, Spd = 1},
knee = {P = {-175, 15}, T = {-30, 30}, R = {-20, 20}, Spd = 1},
ankle = {P = {-70, 70}, T = {-40, 40}, R = {-45, 45}, Spd = 1},
waist = {P = {-90, 70}, T = {-88, 88}, R = {-70, 70}, Spd = 1},
generic = {P = {-178, 178}, T = {-178, 178}, R = {-178, 178}, Spd = 1},
},
Keys = {
{"neck", "neck"}, {"head", "neck"}, {"shoulder", "shoulder"}, {"elbow", "elbow"}, {"wrist", "wrist"}, {"hand", "wrist"},
{"hip", "hip"}, {"knee", "knee"}, {"ankle", "ankle"}, {"foot", "ankle"}, {"waist", "waist"}, {"spine", "waist"},
},
}
local function ServoPart(name, size, anchored, density)
local p = Instance.new("Part")
p.Name = name
p.Size = size
p.Transparency = 1
p.Anchored = anchored
p.CanCollide, p.CanTouch, p.CanQuery = false, false, false
p.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(density or 0.5, 0, 0, 0, 0)
p.CFrame = ServoAnchor
if not (ServoRoot and ServoRoot.Parent) then
ServoRoot = Instance.new("Folder")
ServoRoot.Name = "SJR" .. math.random(100000, 999999)
ServoRoot.Parent = workspace
end
p.Parent = ServoRoot
return p
end
local function ServoGetBase()
if not (ServoBase and ServoBase.Parent) then
ServoBase = ServoPart("ServoBase", Vector3.one, true)
end
return ServoBase
end
local function ServoHinge(name, host, p0, cf0, p1, cf1)
local a0, a1 = Instance.new("Attachment"), Instance.new("Attachment")
a0.Name, a1.Name = name .. "A0", name .. "A1"
a0.CFrame, a1.CFrame = cf0, cf1
a0.Parent, a1.Parent = p0, p1
local h = Instance.new("HingeConstraint")
h.Name = name
h.ActuatorType = Enum.ActuatorType.Servo
h.Attachment0, h.Attachment1 = a0, a1
h.Parent = host
return h
end
local function ServoSetProp(o, k, v)
o[k] = v
end
-- mass of the limb ghost, its carriers and everything hanging off it: servo torque is scaled to this instead of a blind constant
function SJ.Mass(sv)
local m = sv.PX.Mass + sv.CR1.Mass + sv.CR2.Mass
for _,map in LimbMapping do
local c = map.SV
if c and c ~= sv and c.Linked and c.P0 == sv.P1 then m += SJ.Mass(c) end
end
return m
end
-- classifies the joint (root / neck / shoulder / hip / elbow / knee ...) and maps its anatomical ranges onto the three local hinge axes of the original Motor6D C0 frame (sign aware)
function SJ.Profile(sv, map, psv)
local c0 = sv.C0
local r0 = psv and psv.R1 or CFrame.identity
sv.R1 = r0 * c0.Rotation * sv.C1.Rotation:Inverse()
local kind = SJ.Kinds.generic
if map.RPart0 == "ROOT" then
kind = SJ.Kinds.root
else
local nm = string.lower(sv.Motor.Name .. " " .. sv.P1.Name)
for _,key in SJ.Keys do
if string.find(nm, key[1], 1, true) then
kind = SJ.Kinds[key[2]]
break
end
end
end
local side = r0:VectorToWorldSpace(c0.Position).X
local fr = r0 * c0.Rotation
local axes = {fr.XVector, fr.YVector, fr.ZVector}
for i = 1, 3 do
local v = axes[i]
local ax, ay, az = math.abs(v.X), math.abs(v.Y), math.abs(v.Z)
local L, s
if ay >= ax and ay >= az then
L, s = kind.T, v.Y
elseif ax >= az then
L, s = kind.P, v.X
else
L, s = kind.R, v.Z
if side < 0 then L = {-L[2], -L[1]} end
end
s = s >= 0 and 1 or -1
local lo, hi = L[1] * s, L[2] * s
if lo > hi then lo, hi = hi, lo end
sv.LoD[i], sv.HiD[i] = lo, hi
end
sv.Spd = kind.Spd
end
-- joint limits (user cap + anatomical ranges + gimbal-safe middle axis) -> clamp radians, and torque / speed / limits pushed to the hinges
local function ServoApply(sv, cfg)
sv.Ver = cfg.Ver
local on = cfg.Limits
local cap = on and math.min(cfg.LimitDeg, SJ.CAP) or SJ.CAP
local mid = SJ.MID
local S = sv.S
for i = 1, 3 do
local l, u = sv.LoD[i], sv.HiD[i]
if not on then l, u = -SJ.CAP, SJ.CAP end
if l < -cap then l = -cap end
if u > cap then u = cap end
if i == 2 then
if l < -mid then l = -mid end
if u > mid then u = mid end
end
sv.LD[i], sv.HD[i] = l, u
if on or i == 2 then
sv.Lo[i], sv.Hi[i] = SERVO_RAD(l), SERVO_RAD(u)
else
sv.Lo[i], sv.Hi[i] = -SJ.SPIN, SJ.SPIN
end
end
sv.Rate = cfg.Speed * sv.Spd
local H = sv.H
if H then
local tq = cfg.Torque * SJ.TQ * SJ.Mass(sv)
local sp = sv.Rate * SJ.HEAD
for i = 1, 3 do
local h = H[i]
local l, u = sv.LD[i], sv.HD[i]
if S[i] < 0 then l, u = -u, -l end
h.ServoMaxTorque = tq
h.AngularSpeed = sp
pcall(ServoSetProp, h, "AngularResponsiveness", SJ.RESP)
h.LowerAngle = l
h.UpperAngle = u
h.LimitsEnabled = on or i == 2
end
end
end
-- joint limits applied as one coordinated rotation instead of three independent axis clamps. When the middle (Y) stage is pushed against a limit next to gimbal lock, only the sum (y > 0) or difference (y < 0) of the outer X / Z stages still defines the rotation: that combined angle is kept and its redundant split is taken from the current target, so the two outer axes never flip against each other.
local function ServoClamp(sv, x, y, z)
local lo, hi = sv.Lo, sv.Hi
local cy = math.clamp(y, lo[2], hi[2])
if cy ~= y and math.abs(cy) >= SJ.GIM then
local T = sv.T
local d
if y > 0 then d = (x + z - T[1] - T[3]) * 0.5 else d = (x - z - T[1] + T[3]) * 0.5 end
d -= math.pi * math.round(d / math.pi)
x, z = T[1] + d, T[3] + (y > 0 and d or -d)
end
return math.clamp(x, lo[1], hi[1]), cy, math.clamp(z, lo[3], hi[3])
end
-- desired joint rotation (Motor6D transform) -> XYZ euler angles = one angle per hinge stage, unwrapped against the previous target; translation is kept separately
local function ServoDesired(sv, mcf)
local t = sv.C0i * mcf * sv.C1
sv.PT = t.Position
local hj = sv.Hj
if hj then t = hj:Inverse() * t.Rotation end
local x, y, z = t:ToEulerAnglesXYZ()
local T = sv.T
x += SERVO_TAU * math.round((T[1] - x) / SERVO_TAU)
z += SERVO_TAU * math.round((T[3] - z) / SERVO_TAU)
return x, y, z
end
local function ServoRelease(map, restore)
local sv = map.SV
if not sv then return end
map.SV = nil
-- the animation snapshot never outlives the rig it drove: a rebuilt servo waits for a fresh one
map.CFrame, map.PS = nil, nil
if ServoByPart[sv.P1] == map then ServoByPart[sv.P1] = nil end
for _,o in {sv.PX, sv.CR1, sv.CR2, sv.PA} do
pcall(o.Destroy, o)
end
if restore and sv.Motor then
pcall(function() sv.Motor.Enabled = true end)
pcall(Util.SetMotor6DTransform, sv.Motor, CFrame.identity)
end
end
local function ServoBuild(map, v)
local p0, p1 = v.Part0, v.Part1
if not (p0 and p1) then return end
local old = map.SV
if old and old.P1 == p1 and old.PX.Parent then
old.Motor, old.P0 = v, p0
return
end
if old then ServoRelease(map) end
local cs = Vector3.new(0.4, 0.4, 0.4)
map.SV = {
P0 = p0, P1 = p1, Motor = v,
C0 = v.C0, C1 = v.C1, C0i = v.C0:Inverse(), C1i = v.C1:Inverse(),
T = {0, 0, 0}, W = {0, 0, 0}, S = {1, 1, 1}, E = {0, 0, 0},
LoD = {-178, -86, -178}, HiD = {178, 86, 178}, LD = {-178, -86, -178}, HD = {178, 86, 178},
Lo = {-3.1, -1.5, -3.1}, Hi = {3.1, 1.5, 3.1},
Pos = Vector3.zero, PT = Vector3.zero, Spd = 1, Ver = -1, Built = os.clock(),
PX = ServoPart("ServoLimb", p1.Size, true, 0.5),
CR1 = ServoPart("ServoCarrierX", cs, true, SJ.CARRIER),
CR2 = ServoPart("ServoCarrierY", cs, true, SJ.CARRIER),
}
ServoByPart[p1] = map
-- one central physics-step connection drives every servo target: the step counter advances first, SJ.Pose stamps every joint with it, and ServoDrive / ServoSample only trust poses carrying the current stamp
if not ServoConn then
ServoConn = RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function(dt)
SJ.Seq += 1
local rp = SJ.Root
if rp then pcall(SJ.Pose, Reanimate.Character, rp) end
pcall(ServoDrive, dt)
end)
end
end
-- X stage: parent -> carrier X, Y stage: carrier X -> carrier Y, Z stage: carrier Y -> limb. Pivot = C0 / C1 of the original Motor6D.
-- Every stage starts exactly at its clamped target pose (CurrentAngle == TargetAngle) so the first physics step has nothing to correct.
local function ServoLink(map, sv, pp, psv)
local cfg = LimbReanimator.ServoCfg
local c0 = sv.C0
SJ.Profile(sv, map, psv)
ServoApply(sv, cfg)
local x, y, z = ServoDesired(sv, map.CFrame)
x, y, z = ServoClamp(sv, x, y, z)
sv.T[1], sv.T[2], sv.T[3] = x, y, z
sv.Pos = sv.PT
local px, cr1, cr2 = sv.PX, sv.CR1, sv.CR2
local piv = pp.CFrame * c0
local r1 = CFrame.Angles(x, 0, 0)
local r12 = r1 * CFrame.Angles(0, y, 0)
cr1.CFrame = piv * r1
cr2.CFrame = piv * r12
px.CFrame = piv * r12 * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, z) * sv.C1i
local ax = SERVO_AX
local h1 = ServoHinge("ServoX", cr1, pp, c0 * ax[1], cr1, ax[1])
local h2 = ServoHinge("ServoY", cr2, cr1, ax[2], cr2, ax[2])
local h3 = ServoHinge("ServoZ", px, cr2, ax[3], px, sv.C1 * ax[3])
sv.H = {h1, h2, h3}
sv.PA = h1.Attachment0
ServoApply(sv, cfg)
local d1, d2, d3 = SERVO_DEG(x), SERVO_DEG(y), SERVO_DEG(z)
sv.W[1], sv.W[2], sv.W[3] = d1, d2, d3
sv.E[1], sv.E[2], sv.E[3] = d1, d2, d3
h1.TargetAngle, h2.TargetAngle, h3.TargetAngle = d1, d2, d3
sv.Cal = false
cr1.Anchored, cr2.Anchored, px.Anchored = false, false, false
sv.Linked = true
-- the driven mass of every ancestor changed: refresh their torque on the next step
local a = psv
while a do
a.Ver = -1
local pm = ServoByPart[a.P0]
a = pm and pm.SV
end
end
local function ServoAlive(sv, map)
local H = sv.H
local h1 = H[1]
if not (sv.PX.Parent and sv.CR1.Parent and sv.CR2.Parent and h1.Parent and H[2].Parent and H[3].Parent) then return false end
local a0 = h1.Attachment0
local host = a0 and a0.Parent
if not (host and host.Parent and sv.Motor.C0 == sv.C0 and sv.Motor.C1 == sv.C1) then return false end
-- one skeleton: this joint's first hinge stage must hang off its ACTUAL parent servo limb (the base for the root). A parent that was rebuilt leaves its children on a destroyed limb, so they are rebuilt onto the new parent instead of simulating as detached assemblies
if map.RPart0 == "ROOT" then return host == ServoBase end
local pm = ServoByPart[sv.P0]
local psv = pm and pm.SV
return psv ~= nil and psv.Linked == true and host == psv.PX
end
-- physical residual (measured - commanded): deadbanded and limited so the physical hinges can never pull a joint away from the animation
function SJ.Resid(r, dead, dev)
if r > dead then return math.min(r - dead, dev) end
if r < -dead then return math.max(r + dead, -dev) end
return 0
end
-- joint pose that gets replicated through the original Motor6D. The commanded animation target (sv.T) is the authority; the measured hinge angles only add a small bounded residual, and only while the joint's snapshot is current. Non-finite readings and a stale snapshot fall back to the pure target.
local function ServoSample()
local dead, dev, seq = SJ.DEAD, SJ.DEV, SJ.Seq
for _,map in LimbMapping do
local sv = map.SV
if sv then
sv.Act = nil
if sv.Linked then
local T, H = sv.T, sv.H
local a1, a2, a3 = T[1], T[2], T[3]
local h1, h2, h3 = H[1], H[2], H[3]
-- the replicated pose is the commanded animation target ONLY: measured hinge angles (solver drift, settling, residuals) are never added, so no limb can move on its own or keep moving after the animation stopped
local act = sv.C0 * (CFrame.new(sv.Pos) * (sv.Hj or CFrame.identity) * CFrame.Angles(a1, a2, a3)) * sv.C1i
if RagdollFiniteCF(act) then sv.Act = act end
end
end
end
end
-- animation -> servo snapshot: the pose the active moveset + dance just produced becomes every servo limb's authoritative target pose. The whole snapshot is built first and committed in one pass, stamped with the current physics step; if building it fails nothing is committed and every joint holds its last good target. LimbPoseCFrame also returns identity for a joint whose parts cannot be found: only that case is an invalid pose, a real neutral pose is accepted
function SJ.PoseValid(map, RC, RootPart)
if not RC then return false end
local p0 = map.RPart0 == "ROOT" and RootPart or RC:FindFirstChild(map.RPart0)
return p0 ~= nil and RC:FindFirstChild(map.RPart1) ~= nil
end
function SJ.Pose(RC, RootPart)
if not (RC and RC.Parent and RootPart and RootPart.Parent) then return false end
local pose, idcf = Reanimate.SafeLimbPose, CFrame.identity
-- heading (yaw) of the animated character relative to the real RootPart: the root joint carries it kinematically so a turning character never runs the root hinges through gimbal / +-180 wrap
local H, Fr
local hrp = RC:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if hrp then
local rcf = RootPart.CFrame
local _, a0 = rcf:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
local _, a1 = hrp.CFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
if a0 == a0 and a1 == a1 then H, Fr = CFrame.Angles(0, a1 - a0, 0), rcf.Rotation end
end
local snap, hjs = SJ.Snap, SJ.SnapHj
table.clear(snap)
table.clear(hjs)
for _,map in LimbMapping do
local sv, ref = map.SV, map.Reference
if sv and ref then
local cf = pose(map, ref, RC, RootPart)
if RagdollFiniteCF(cf) and (cf ~= idcf or SJ.PoseValid(map, RC, RootPart)) then
snap[map] = cf
if map.RPart0 == "ROOT" then
if H then
local F = Fr * sv.C0.Rotation
hjs[map] = F:Inverse() * H * F
else
hjs[map] = false
end
end
end
end
end
local seq = SJ.Seq
for map, cf in snap do
map.CFrame, map.PS = cf, seq
local hj = hjs[map]
if hj ~= nil then map.SV.Hj = hj or nil end
end
return true
end
-- Coordinated rig update. Every joint's goal comes from the one animation snapshot SJ.Pose just committed (a joint without a current snapshot holds its last commanded target). Each joint tracks its own goal directly (all three axes of a joint move together at one shared fraction, so the joint is never distorted) and is limited only by its own angular speed. The measured physical angles are never read here, so they cannot become a target.
ServoDrive = function(dt)
local cfg = LimbReanimator.ServoCfg
if dt > 0.1 then dt = 0.1 elseif dt < 0.002 then dt = 0.002 end
local now, seq = os.clock(), SJ.Seq
local live, worst = SJ.Live, 0
table.clear(live)
for _,map in LimbMapping do
local sv = map.SV
if sv then
local fresh = map.PS == seq
if not sv.Linked then
local pp, psv
if map.RPart0 == "ROOT" then
pp = ServoGetBase()
else
local pm = ServoByPart[sv.P0]
psv = pm and pm.SV
if psv and psv.Linked and psv.PX.Parent then pp = psv.PX end
end
-- a servo is only ever built at the current animation pose, never at a cached one
local mcf = fresh and map.CFrame
if pp and mcf and RagdollFiniteCF(mcf) and now - (sv.Try or 0) > 0.25 then
if not pcall(ServoLink, map, sv, pp, psv) then
local m = sv.Motor
ServoRelease(map)
pcall(ServoBuild, map, m)
local ns = map.SV
if ns then ns.Try = now end
end
end
elseif not ServoAlive(sv, map) then
if now - sv.Built > 0.25 then
local m = sv.Motor
ServoRelease(map)
pcall(ServoBuild, map, m)
end
else
if sv.Ver ~= cfg.Ver then ServoApply(sv, cfg) end
local mcf = fresh and map.CFrame
if mcf and RagdollFiniteCF(mcf) then
local H, T, W, S = sv.H, sv.T, sv.W, sv.S
-- one-time check of the hinge angle direction against the pose the limb was placed in
if sv.Cal == false then
sv.Cal = true
local E, flip = sv.E, false
for i = 1, 3 do
local e = E[i]
if math.abs(e) > 4 then
local c = H[i].CurrentAngle
if c == c and math.abs(c + e) < math.abs(c - e) then
S[i], W[i], flip = -1, math.huge, true
end
end
end
if flip then ServoApply(sv, cfg) end
end
local x, y, z = ServoDesired(sv, mcf)
x, y, z = ServoClamp(sv, x, y, z)
sv.Pos = sv.PT
sv.GX, sv.GY, sv.GZ = x, y, z
live[#live + 1] = sv
local need = math.max(math.abs(x - T[1]), math.abs(y - T[2]), math.abs(z - T[3])) / (sv.Rate * dt)
if need > worst then worst = need end
end
end
end
end
-- apply pass: every joint of the skeleton advances toward the ONE current animation snapshot by the SAME fraction (set by the slowest joint), so the whole rig arrives together and no limb lags, overshoots or keeps moving on its own
local f = worst > 1 and 1 / worst or 1
for i = 1, #live do
local sv = live[i]
local T, W, S, H = sv.T, sv.W, sv.S, sv.H
if f >= 1 then
T[1], T[2], T[3] = sv.GX, sv.GY, sv.GZ
else
T[1] += (sv.GX - T[1]) * f
T[2] += (sv.GY - T[2]) * f
T[3] += (sv.GZ - T[3]) * f
end
for a = 1, 3 do
local d = SERVO_DEG(T[a]) * S[a]
if math.abs(d - W[a]) > 0.004 then
W[a] = d
H[a].TargetAngle = d
end
end
end
end
local function ServoCleanAll(restore)
if ServoConn then
ServoConn:Disconnect()
ServoConn = nil
end
for _,map in LimbMapping do ServoRelease(map, restore) end
if ServoRoot then
pcall(ServoRoot.Destroy, ServoRoot)
ServoRoot = nil
end
ServoBase = nil
SJ.Root = nil
table.clear(ServoByPart)
end
local ServoCleaner = function() ServoCleanAll(true) end
if Servo then
local stale = LimbReanimator.ServoCleanup
if stale then pcall(stale) end
LimbReanimator.ServoCleanup = ServoCleaner
end
local Hybrid = LimbReanimator.HybridMode and true or false
-- Hybrid-Joint: every R6 joint becomes a physical chain built from its own constraint type. Native joints (RootJoint = waist, Neck, shoulders, hips) get BallSocketConstraints; R6 has no elbow / wrist / knee / ankle Motor6Ds, so each limb gets an internal three-segment proxy chain (upper / lower / end) joined by virtual elbow-wrist / knee-ankle joints. The chain is simulated in an isolated anchored rig; its weighted pose is written back through the ORIGINAL Motor6D (replicated path), never relying on client constraints replicating.
local HJ = {
ByPart = {}, Folder = nil, Base = nil, Conn = nil, Root = nil,
Anchor = CFrame.new(math.random(-512, 512), math.random(3200, 3600), math.random(-512, 512)),
TQ = 20, -- max torque per unit of driven mass at Strength 1
HEAD = 1.5, -- speed headroom over the commanded rate so a joint never trails its target
DEV = 0.35, -- max radians the replicated limb rotation may stray from the commanded target
SEG = {0.45, 0.35, 0.2}, -- length fractions of the upper / lower / end proxy segments of a limb
Spec = {
neck = {"neck"},
waist = {"waist"},
shoulder = {"shoulder", "elbow", "wrist"},
hip = {"hip", "knee", "ankle"},
},
-- Ball = {swing cone, twist} deg, Hinge = {lower, upper} flexion deg, Sign = flexion direction about the character's right axis
Lim = {
neck = {Ball = {80, 70}, Hinge = {-60, 60}, Sign = 1},
shoulder = {Ball = {180, 120}, Hinge = {-175, 175}, Sign = 1},
elbow = {Ball = {150, 60}, Hinge = {-10, 150}, Sign = 1},
wrist = {Ball = {80, 80}, Hinge = {-70, 70}, Sign = 1},
waist = {Ball = {85, 100}, Hinge = {-90, 70}, Sign = 1},
hip = {Ball = {130, 80}, Hinge = {-120, 150}, Sign = 1},
knee = {Ball = {150, 40}, Hinge = {-10, 150}, Sign = -1},
ankle = {Ball = {60, 40}, Hinge = {-35, 35}, Sign = 1},
},
}
function HJ.Set(o, k, v)
o[k] = v
end
function HJ.Kind(map, v, p1)
if map.RPart0 == "ROOT" then return "waist" end
local nm = string.lower(v.Name .. " " .. p1.Name)
if string.find(nm, "neck", 1, true) or string.find(nm, "head", 1, true) then return "neck" end
if string.find(nm, "shoulder", 1, true) or string.find(nm, "arm", 1, true) then return "shoulder" end
if string.find(nm, "hip", 1, true) or string.find(nm, "leg", 1, true) then return "hip" end
return "waist"
end
function HJ.Part(name, size, density)
local p = Instance.new("Part")
p.Name = name
p.Size = Vector3.new(math.max(size.X, 0.2), math.max(size.Y, 0.2), math.max(size.Z, 0.2))
p.Transparency = 1
p.Anchored = true
p.CanCollide, p.CanTouch, p.CanQuery = false, false, false
p.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(math.clamp(density, 0.05, 100), 0, 0, 0, 0)
p.CFrame = HJ.Anchor
if not (HJ.Folder and HJ.Folder.Parent) then
HJ.Folder = Instance.new("Folder")
HJ.Folder.Name = "HJR" .. math.random(100000, 999999)
HJ.Folder.Parent = workspace
end
p.Parent = HJ.Folder
return p
end
function HJ.GetBase()
if not (HJ.Base and HJ.Base.Parent) then
HJ.Base = HJ.Part("HybridBase", Vector3.one, 1)
end
return HJ.Base
end
function HJ.Attach(hy, part, cf, name)
local a = Instance.new("Attachment")
a.Name = name
a.CFrame = cf
a.Parent = part
hy.Objs[#hy.Objs + 1] = a
return a
end
-- rotation whose X axis is the unit vector a (attachment primary axis for hinge / cylinder / ball twist)
function HJ.Axis(a)
local p = math.abs(a.Y) < 0.9 and Vector3.yAxis or Vector3.xAxis
local z = a:Cross(p).Unit
return CFrame.fromMatrix(Vector3.zero, a, z:Cross(a), z)
end
-- twist angle of rotation q about unit axis a (swing-twist: q = swing * twist)
function HJ.Twist(q, a)
local ax, an = q:ToAxisAngle()
local th = 2 * math.atan2(ax:Dot(a) * math.sin(an / 2), math.cos(an / 2))
if th ~= th then return 0 end
if th > math.pi then th -= math.pi * 2 elseif th < -math.pi then th += math.pi * 2 end
return th
end
-- measured hinge angle (rad) about the shared attachment X axis, read from the real part orientations
function HJ.HingeAngle(j)
local rel = (j.Par.CFrame * j.A0.CFrame):ToObjectSpace(j.Child.CFrame * j.A1.CFrame)
local _, _, _, _, _, _, _, e, _, _, h = rel:GetComponents()
return math.atan2(h, e)
end
-- mass of segments from joint index `from` outward, the extension carrier and every limb hanging off this one
function HJ.Mass(hy, from)
local m = 0
for i = from, hy.N do m += hy.Seg[i].Mass end
if hy.Ext then m += hy.Ext.Mass end
for _,map in LimbMapping do
local c = map.HY
if c and c ~= hy and c.Linked and c.P0 == hy.P1 then m += HJ.Mass(c, 1) end
end
return m
end
-- limits / torque / speed / spring / extension configuration pushed to the physical joints
function HJ.Apply(hy, cfg)
hy.Ver = cfg.Ver
local on = cfg.Limits
local cap = on and cfg.LimitDeg or 180
local tqk, sp = cfg.Torque * HJ.TQ, cfg.Speed
for i = 1, hy.N do
local j = hy.J[i]
local lim = HJ.Lim[j.Section]
local m = HJ.Mass(hy, i)
if j.Type == 1 then
local bs, ao = j.Con, j.AO
local cone, twist = math.min(lim.Ball[1], cap), math.min(lim.Ball[2], cap)
bs.LimitsEnabled = on
bs.UpperAngle = cone
bs.TwistLimitsEnabled = on
bs.TwistLowerAngle = -twist
bs.TwistUpperAngle = twist
pcall(HJ.Set, bs, "MaxFrictionTorque", cfg.Friction * HJ.TQ * m)
ao.Responsiveness = cfg.Stiffness
ao.MaxTorque = tqk * m
ao.MaxAngularVelocity = sp * HJ.HEAD
else
local h = j.Con
local lo, hi = math.max(lim.Hinge[1], -cap), math.min(lim.Hinge[2], cap)
if j.S < 0 then lo, hi = -hi, -lo end
if lo > h.UpperAngle then
h.UpperAngle = hi
h.LowerAngle = lo
else
h.LowerAngle = lo
h.UpperAngle = hi
end
h.LimitsEnabled = on
h.ServoMaxTorque = tqk * m
h.AngularSpeed = sp * HJ.HEAD
pcall(HJ.Set, h, "AngularResponsiveness", cfg.Responsiveness)
pcall(HJ.Set, h, "MaxFrictionTorque", cfg.Friction * HJ.TQ * m)
end
end
local c = hy.Cyl
if c then
local me = hy.Ext.Mass
c.LimitsEnabled = true
c.LowerLimit = -cfg.ExtRange
c.UpperLimit = cfg.ExtRange
pcall(HJ.Set, c, "ActuatorType", Enum.ActuatorType.Servo)
pcall(HJ.Set, c, "TargetPosition", 0)
pcall(HJ.Set, c, "ServoMaxForce", tqk * me)
pcall(HJ.Set, c, "LinearResponsiveness", cfg.Responsiveness)
pcall(HJ.Set, c, "Speed", sp)
pcall(HJ.Set, c, "AngularActuatorType", Enum.ActuatorType.Servo)
pcall(HJ.Set, c, "TargetAngle", 0)
pcall(HJ.Set, c, "ServoMaxTorque", tqk * me)
pcall(HJ.Set, c, "AngularResponsiveness", cfg.Responsiveness)
pcall(HJ.Set, c, "AngularSpeed", sp)
end
local s = hy.Spring
if s then
local ms = HJ.Mass(hy, 2)
s.Stiffness = cfg.SpringStiff * ms
s.Damping = cfg.SpringDamp * ms
end
end
function HJ.Release(map, restore)
local hy = map.HY
if not hy then return end
map.HY = nil
if HJ.ByPart[hy.P1] == map then HJ.ByPart[hy.P1] = nil end
for _,o in hy.Objs do pcall(o.Destroy, o) end
if restore and hy.Motor then
pcall(function() hy.Motor.Enabled = true end)
pcall(Util.SetMotor6DTransform, hy.Motor, CFrame.identity)
if hy.MV then pcall(function() hy.Motor.MaxVelocity = hy.MV end) end
end
end
-- proxy segments only; the physical joints are created once the parent chain exists (HJ.Link)
function HJ.Build(map, v)
local p0, p1 = v.Part0, v.Part1
if not (p0 and p1) then return end
local old = map.HY
if old and old.P1 == p1 and old.Seg[1].Parent then
old.Motor, old.P0 = v, p0
return
end
if old then HJ.Release(map) end
local cfg = LimbReanimator.HybridCfg
local kind = HJ.Kind(map, v, p1)
local names = HJ.Spec[kind]
local n, sz, dens = #names, p1.Size, cfg.Density
local hy = {
P0 = p0, P1 = p1, Motor = v, Kind = kind, Names = names, N = n,
C0 = v.C0, C1 = v.C1, C0i = v.C0:Inverse(), C1i = v.C1:Inverse(),
Q = CFrame.identity, PT = Vector3.zero, Pos = Vector3.zero, Ay = Vector3.yAxis, R1 = CFrame.identity,
Ver = -1, TV = cfg.TV, Built = os.clock(), MV = v.MaxVelocity,
Seg = {}, SO = {}, YC = {}, YB = {}, J = {}, Objs = {},
}
if n == 1 then
hy.SO[1], hy.YC[1] = CFrame.identity, 0
hy.Seg[1] = HJ.Part("HybridSeg1", sz, dens)
else
local y = sz.Y / 2
for i = 1, n do
local h = sz.Y * HJ.SEG[i]
hy.YC[i] = y - h / 2
hy.SO[i] = CFrame.new(0, hy.YC[i], 0)
hy.YB[i + 1] = y - h
hy.Seg[i] = HJ.Part("HybridSeg" .. i, Vector3.new(sz.X, h, sz.Z), dens)
y -= h
end
if cfg.ExtOn then hy.Ext = HJ.Part("HybridExt", Vector3.new(0.4, 0.4, 0.4), math.max(dens, 1)) end
end
for _,s in hy.Seg do hy.Objs[#hy.Objs + 1] = s end
if hy.Ext then hy.Objs[#hy.Objs + 1] = hy.Ext end
map.HY = hy
HJ.ByPart[p1] = map
-- one central physics-step connection drives every hybrid joint
if not HJ.Conn then
HJ.Conn = RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function(dt)
local rp = HJ.Root
if rp then pcall(HJ.Pose, Reanimate.Character, rp) end
pcall(HJ.Drive, dt)
end)
end
end
-- joint 1 = parent -> upper segment (the original Motor6D pivot C0 / C1), joint 2 / 3 = virtual elbow-wrist / knee-ankle between the proxy segments. Every segment starts exactly at its commanded pose so the first physics step has nothing to correct.
function HJ.Link(map, hy, pp, psv)
local cfg = LimbReanimator.HybridCfg
local c0, c1 = hy.C0, hy.C1
local r0 = psv and psv.R1 or CFrame.identity
hy.R1 = r0 * c0.Rotation * c1.Rotation:Inverse()
local fw = r0 * c0.Rotation
local ay = fw:VectorToObjectSpace(Vector3.yAxis)
local ax = fw:VectorToObjectSpace(Vector3.xAxis)
hy.Ay = ay
local t = hy.C0i * map.CFrame * c1
local q = t.Rotation
if hy.Hj then q = hy.Hj:Inverse() * q end
if not RagdollFiniteCF(q) then q = CFrame.identity end
hy.Q, hy.PT, hy.Pos = q, t.Position, t.Position
local n, segs, names = hy.N, hy.Seg, hy.Names
local pa1 = (psv and psv.SO[1]:Inverse() or CFrame.identity) * c0
local qplace, th0 = q, 0
if cfg.Types[names[1]] == 2 then
local a1 = ax * HJ.Lim[names[1]].Sign
th0 = HJ.Twist(q, a1)
qplace = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(a1, th0)
end
local limb = pp.CFrame * pa1 * qplace * hy.C1i
for i = 1, n do segs[i].CFrame = limb * hy.SO[i] end
for i = 1, n do
local sec = names[i]
local lim = HJ.Lim[sec]
local jt = cfg.Types[sec]
local par, pcf0, ccf0
if i == 1 then
par, pcf0, ccf0 = pp, pa1, hy.SO[1]:Inverse() * c1
else
par = segs[i - 1]
pcf0 = CFrame.new(0, hy.YB[i] - hy.YC[i - 1], 0) * c1.Rotation
ccf0 = CFrame.new(0, hy.YB[i] - hy.YC[i], 0) * c1.Rotation
end
local axis = ax * lim.Sign
local H = jt == 1 and HJ.Axis(ay) or HJ.Axis(axis)
local a0 = HJ.Attach(hy, par, pcf0 * H, "HybA0_" .. i)
local a1 = HJ.Attach(hy, segs[i], ccf0 * H, "HybA1_" .. i)
local j = {Section = sec, Type = jt, PA0 = pcf0, H = H, Axis = axis, Par = par, Child = segs[i], A0 = a0, A1 = a1, S = 1, Cal = false, W = 0, Rem = CFrame.identity}
if jt == 1 then
local bs = Instance.new("BallSocketConstraint")
bs.Name = "HybBall" .. i
bs.Attachment0, bs.Attachment1 = a0, a1
bs.Parent = segs[i]
-- BallSocketConstraint has no servo: a separate AlignOrientation drives the child's attachment toward the animation target
local ao = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
ao.Name = "HybAO" .. i
ao.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
ao.Attachment0 = a1
ao.RigidityEnabled = false
ao.CFrame = par.CFrame * pcf0 * (i == 1 and q or CFrame.identity) * H
ao.Parent = segs[i]
j.Con, j.AO = bs, ao
hy.Objs[#hy.Objs + 1] = bs
hy.Objs[#hy.Objs + 1] = ao
else
local h = Instance.new("HingeConstraint")
h.Name = "HybHinge" .. i
h.ActuatorType = Enum.ActuatorType.Servo
h.Attachment0, h.Attachment1 = a0, a1
h.Parent = segs[i]
local d0 = i == 1 and math.deg(th0) or 0
h.TargetAngle = d0
j.W, j.Con = d0, h
hy.Objs[#hy.Objs + 1] = h
end
hy.J[i] = j
end
-- mechanical extension: a carrier sliding along the limb axis at the tip (CylindricalConstraint)
if hy.Ext then
local last = segs[n]
local ly = last.Size.Y
local ecf = CFrame.new(0, -ly / 2, 0)
local H = HJ.Axis(ay)
hy.Ext.CFrame = last.CFrame * ecf
hy.E0 = HJ.Attach(hy, last, ecf * c1.Rotation * H, "HybE0")
hy.E1 = HJ.Attach(hy, hy.Ext, c1.Rotation * H, "HybE1")
local c = Instance.new("CylindricalConstraint")
c.Name = "HybCyl"
c.Attachment0, c.Attachment1 = hy.E0, hy.E1
c.Parent = hy.Ext
hy.Cyl = c
hy.Objs[#hy.Objs + 1] = c
end
-- secondary flexible joint: an elastic span across the virtual elbow / knee (never the only structural link)
if cfg.SpringOn and n >= 2 then
local off = segs[1].Size.X * 0.4
local s0 = HJ.Attach(hy, segs[1], CFrame.new(off, 0, 0), "HybS0")
local s1 = HJ.Attach(hy, segs[n], CFrame.new(off, 0, 0), "HybS1")
local sp = Instance.new("SpringConstraint")
sp.Name = "HybSpring"
sp.Attachment0, sp.Attachment1 = s0, s1
sp.FreeLength = hy.YC[1] - hy.YC[n]
sp.LimitsEnabled = false
sp.Visible = false
sp.Parent = segs[n]
hy.Spring = sp
hy.Objs[#hy.Objs + 1] = sp
end
hy.Linked = true
HJ.Apply(hy, cfg)
for _,s in segs do s.Anchored = false end
if hy.Ext then hy.Ext.Anchored = false end
-- the driven mass of every ancestor changed: refresh their torque on the next step
local a = psv
while a do
a.Ver = -1
local pm = HJ.ByPart[a.P0]
a = pm and pm.HY
end
end
function HJ.Alive(hy)
for i = 1, hy.N do
local s, j = hy.Seg[i], hy.J[i]
if not (s.Parent and j.Con.Parent and j.A0.Parent and j.A1.Parent and (not j.AO or j.AO.Parent)) then return false end
local p = s.Position
if p.X ~= p.X or p.Y ~= p.Y or p.Z ~= p.Z or (p - HJ.Anchor.Position).Magnitude > 200 then return false end
end
if hy.Ext and not (hy.Ext.Parent and hy.Cyl and hy.Cyl.Parent) then return false end
if hy.Spring and not hy.Spring.Parent then return false end
return hy.Motor.C0 == hy.C0 and hy.Motor.C1 == hy.C1
end
-- animation -> hybrid snapshot: the pose the active moveset + dance just produced becomes every chain's authoritative target pose, sampled each physics step (never behind the dorep / ReplicateFPS10 throttle). A missing or non-finite pose holds the last good one so a limb is never left uncontrolled.
-- LimbPoseCFrame also returns identity for a joint whose parts cannot be found: only that case is an invalid pose, a real neutral pose is accepted
function HJ.PoseValid(map, RC, RootPart)
if not RC then return false end
local p0 = map.RPart0 == "ROOT" and RootPart or RC:FindFirstChild(map.RPart0)
return p0 ~= nil and RC:FindFirstChild(map.RPart1) ~= nil
end
function HJ.Pose(RC, RootPart)
local pose, idcf = Reanimate.SafeLimbPose, CFrame.identity
-- heading (yaw) of the animated character relative to the real RootPart: the waist carries it kinematically so a turning character never pushes the ball socket through its limits
local H, Fr
if RC and RootPart and RootPart.Parent then
local hrp = RC:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if hrp then
local rcf = RootPart.CFrame
local _, a0 = rcf:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
local _, a1 = hrp.CFrame:ToEulerAnglesYXZ()
if a0 == a0 and a1 == a1 then H, Fr = CFrame.Angles(0, a1 - a0, 0), rcf.Rotation end
end
end
for _,map in LimbMapping do
local hy = map.HY
if hy and map.Reference then
local cf = pose(map, map.Reference, RC, RootPart)
if RagdollFiniteCF(cf) and (cf ~= idcf or HJ.PoseValid(map, RC, RootPart)) then map.CFrame = cf end
if map.RPart0 == "ROOT" then
if H then
local F = Fr * hy.C0.Rotation
hy.Hj = F:Inverse() * H * F
else
hy.Hj = nil
end
end
end
end
end
-- physical chain -> one R6 limb pose: the joint rotations are composed down the chain and blended by segment length (so a virtual elbow / wrist / knee / ankle flex moves the single-piece limb by its share, never visibly bending the mesh); the extension slide adds a bounded offset along the limb axis. The result is what gets replicated through the original Motor6D.
function HJ.Sample()
local cfg = LimbReanimator.HybridCfg
local dev = HJ.DEV
local w2 = HJ.SEG[2] / (HJ.SEG[1] + HJ.SEG[2])
local w3 = HJ.SEG[3]
for _,map in LimbMapping do
local hy = map.HY
if hy then
hy.Act = nil
if hy.Linked then
local ok, acc, rots = true, CFrame.identity, {}
for i = 1, hy.N do
local j = hy.J[i]
if not (j.Par.Parent and j.Child.Parent) then ok = false break end
local r
if j.Type == 1 then
local rel = (j.Par.CFrame * j.A0.CFrame):ToObjectSpace(j.Child.CFrame * j.A1.CFrame)
r = j.H * rel.Rotation * j.H:Inverse()
else
r = j.Rem * CFrame.fromAxisAngle(j.Axis, HJ.HingeAngle(j))
end
if not RagdollFiniteCF(r) then ok = false break end
acc = acc * r
rots[i] = acc
end
if ok then
local M = rots[1]
if hy.N >= 3 then
local s = cfg.Secondary
M = M:Lerp(rots[2], math.clamp(w2 * s, 0, 1))
M = M:Lerp(rots[3], math.clamp(w3 * s, 0, 1))
end
local ax, an = hy.Q:ToObjectSpace(M):ToAxisAngle()
if an > dev then M = hy.Q * CFrame.fromAxisAngle(ax, dev) end
local hj = hy.Hj or CFrame.identity
local pos = hy.Pos
local cyl = hy.Cyl
if cyl and cyl.Parent and hy.E0.Parent and hy.E1.Parent then
local sl = (hy.Seg[hy.N].CFrame * hy.E0.CFrame):PointToObjectSpace((hy.Ext.CFrame * hy.E1.CFrame).Position).X
if sl == sl then
sl = math.clamp(sl, -cfg.LinearLimit, cfg.LinearLimit)
pos = pos + (hj * M):VectorToWorldSpace(hy.Ay) * sl
end
end
local act = hy.C0 * (CFrame.new(pos) * hj * M) * hy.C1i
if RagdollFiniteCF(act) then hy.Act = act end
end
end
end
end
end
-- one coordinated step for a linked chain: rate-limited commanded target (no snapping when the animation changes), then ball sockets get their world orientation target, hinges their servo angle
function HJ.Step(hy, mcf, dt, cfg)
local t = hy.C0i * mcf * hy.C1
local rot = t.Rotation
if hy.Hj then rot = hy.Hj:Inverse() * rot end
if RagdollFiniteCF(rot) and RagdollFinite(t.Position) then
local ax, an = hy.Q:ToObjectSpace(rot):ToAxisAngle()
local mx = cfg.Speed * dt
if an > mx then rot = hy.Q * CFrame.fromAxisAngle(ax, mx) end
hy.Q = rot
hy.PT = t.Position
end
hy.Pos = hy.PT
for i = 1, hy.N do
local j = hy.J[i]
local qi = i == 1 and hy.Q or CFrame.identity
if j.Type == 1 then
local w = j.Par.CFrame * j.PA0 * qi * j.H
if RagdollFiniteCF(w) then j.AO.CFrame = w end
else
local th, rem = 0, CFrame.identity
if i == 1 then
th = HJ.Twist(qi, j.Axis)
rem = qi * CFrame.fromAxisAngle(j.Axis, -th)
end
j.Rem = rem
-- one-time check of the hinge angle direction against the measured pose
if not j.Cal and math.abs(th) > 0.07 then
local c, m = j.Con.CurrentAngle, math.deg(HJ.HingeAngle(j))
if c == c and m == m and math.abs(c) > 4 and math.abs(m) > 4 then
j.Cal = true
local sg = (c * m < 0) and -1 or 1
if sg ~= j.S then
j.S = sg
j.W = math.huge
hy.Ver = -1
end
end
end
local deg = math.deg(th) * j.S
if math.abs(deg - j.W) > 0.004 then
j.W = deg
j.Con.TargetAngle = deg
end
end
end
end
function HJ.Drive(dt)
local cfg = LimbReanimator.HybridCfg
if dt > 0.1 then dt = 0.1 elseif dt < 0.002 then dt = 0.002 end
local now = os.clock()
for _,map in LimbMapping do
local hy = map.HY
if hy then
if hy.TV ~= cfg.TV then
-- joint assignment / density / extension / spring layout changed: rebuild this chain
local m = hy.Motor
HJ.Release(map)
pcall(HJ.Build, map, m)
elseif not hy.Linked then
local pp, psv
if map.RPart0 == "ROOT" then
pp = HJ.GetBase()
else
local pm = HJ.ByPart[hy.P0]
psv = pm and pm.HY
if psv and psv.Linked and psv.Seg[1].Parent then pp = psv.Seg[1] end
end
local mcf = map.CFrame
if pp and mcf and RagdollFiniteCF(mcf) and now - (hy.Try or 0) > 0.25 then
if not pcall(HJ.Link, map, hy, pp, psv) then
local m = hy.Motor
HJ.Release(map)
pcall(HJ.Build, map, m)
local nh = map.HY
if nh then nh.Try = now end
end
end
elseif not HJ.Alive(hy) then
if now - hy.Built > 0.25 then
local m = hy.Motor
HJ.Release(map)
pcall(HJ.Build, map, m)
end
else
local mcf = map.CFrame
if mcf and RagdollFiniteCF(mcf) then
if hy.Ver ~= cfg.Ver then HJ.Apply(hy, cfg) end
HJ.Step(hy, mcf, dt, cfg)
end
end
end
end
end
function HJ.CleanAll(restore)
if HJ.Conn then
HJ.Conn:Disconnect()
HJ.Conn = nil
end
for _,map in LimbMapping do HJ.Release(map, restore) end
if HJ.Folder then
pcall(HJ.Folder.Destroy, HJ.Folder)
HJ.Folder = nil
end
HJ.Base, HJ.Root = nil, nil
table.clear(HJ.ByPart)
end
local HybridCleaner = function() HJ.CleanAll(true) end
if Hybrid then
local stale = LimbReanimator.HybridCleanup
if stale then pcall(stale) end
LimbReanimator.HybridCleanup = HybridCleaner
end
local CharOnDesc = function(v)
if v:IsA("BasePart") then
if not table.find(BaseParts, v) then
table.insert(BaseParts, v)
v.CanCollide = false
v:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanCollide"):Connect(function()
if v.CanCollide then v.CanCollide = false end
end)
end
elseif v:IsA("Motor6D") then
repeat task.wait() until (not v:IsDescendantOf(workspace)) or (v.Part0 and v.Part1)
if not v:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return end
local p0, p1 = v.Part0, v.Part1
if p0 and p1 then
p0, p1 = p0.Name, p1.Name
for _,map in LimbMapping do
if map.Part0 == p0 and map.Part1 == p1 then
map.Reference = v
if VelInterp then VelInterp.Reset(map) end
if Ragdoll then pcall(Ragdollize, map, v) end
if Servo then pcall(ServoBuild, map, v) end
if Hybrid then pcall(HJ.Build, map, v) end
return
end
end
end
table.insert(UnknownMotor6Ds, v)
elseif v:IsA("Animator") then
task.defer(v.Destroy, v)
elseif v:IsA("LocalScript") and v.Parent == Player.Character then
v.Enabled = false
v:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function()
if v.Enabled then v.Enabled = false end
end)
v:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Disabled"):Connect(function()
if not v.Disabled then v.Disabled = true end
end)
elseif v:IsA("Tool") and v.Parent == Player.Character then
if not FakeTools[v] then
FakeTools[v] = true
local fake = CreateFakeTool()
fake.Grip = v.Grip
local h = v:FindFirstChild("Handle")
if h ~= nil then
fake.Handle.Size = h.Size
end
Util.LinkDestroyI2C(fake, RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function()
if v.Parent == Player.Character then
fake.Grip = v.Grip
local h = v:FindFirstChild("Handle")
if h ~= nil then
fake.Handle.Size = h.Size
end
else
fake:Destroy()
FakeTools[v] = nil
end
end))
Util.LinkDestroyI2C(fake, v.ChildAdded:Connect(function(v)
if v.ClassName == "StringValue" and v.Name == "toolanim" then
local w = Instance.new("StringValue")
w.Name = "toolanim"
w.Value = v.Value
w.Parent = fake
Debris:AddItem(v, 1)
Debris:AddItem(w, 1)
end
end))
fake.Handle.Touched:Connect(function(t)
local h = v:FindFirstChild("Handle")
if h and t and h:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and t:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
h.CanTouch = true
pcall(firetouchinterest, h, t, 0)
end
end)
fake.Handle.TouchEnded:Connect(function(t)
local h = v:FindFirstChild("Handle")
if h and t and h:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and t:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
h.CanTouch = true
pcall(firetouchinterest, h, t, 1)
end
end)
end
end
end
local lastspawn = 0
local OnLimbCharacter = function(character)
local camcfr = Camera.CFrame
RunService.PreRender:Once(function()
RunService.PreAnimation:Wait()
Camera.CFrame = camcfr
end)
lastspawn = os.clock()
table.clear(BaseParts)
table.clear(UnknownMotor6Ds)
table.clear(RagdollParts)
table.clear(RagdollByPart)
for _,map in LimbMapping do
map.Reference = nil
if map.RG then RagdollRelease(map) end
if map.SV then ServoRelease(map) end
if map.HY then HJ.Release(map) end
map.RG, map.RT = nil, nil
if VelInterp then VelInterp.Reset(map) end
end
character.DescendantAdded:Connect(CharOnDesc)
for _,v in character:GetDescendants() do
task.spawn(CharOnDesc, v)
end
local humanoid = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
local stupid = humanoid:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Animator")
if stupid then
stupid:Destroy()
end
if not Reanimate.UseLoadAnimationHook then
stupid = character:FindFirstChild("Animate")
while not stupid do
character.ChildAdded:Wait()
stupid = character:FindFirstChild("Animate")
end
stupid:Destroy()
end
end
local CharConn = Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(OnLimbCharacter)
local gotRespawn = false
local respawnConn = Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() gotRespawn = true end)
local respawnTimeout = 15
pcall(function() respawnTimeout = math.clamp((tonumber(Players.RespawnTime) or 5) + 10, 15, 40) end)
local respawnWaitStart = os.clock()
while not gotRespawn and os.clock() - respawnWaitStart < respawnTimeout do
task.wait()
end
respawnConn:Disconnect()
if not gotRespawn then
pcall(Util.Notify, "Limb Reanimator: the game did not respawn your character after the reset (waited " .. math.floor(os.clock() - respawnWaitStart) .. "s). Continuing in placeholder mode so you can still move and jump.")
local current = Player.Character
if current then
task.spawn(OnLimbCharacter, current)
end
end
Reanimate.CreateCharacter(InitCFrame)
local lastrep = 0
local LOPT = {
info = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}),
lk = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}),
limbs = {Head = true, Torso = true, ["Left Arm"] = true, ["Right Arm"] = true, ["Left Leg"] = true, ["Right Leg"] = true},
vz = Vector3.zero,
refDirty = true,
refAt = 0,
}
local function lookup(parent, key, isClass)
local c = LOPT.lk[parent]
if not c then c = {} LOPT.lk[parent] = c end
local o = c[key]
if not o or o.Parent ~= parent then
if isClass then o = parent:FindFirstChildOfClass(key) else o = parent:FindFirstChild(key) end
c[key] = o
end
return o
end
local function UpdateTransforms(ReanimCharacter, RootPart, rootcf, rootvel, flingtarget, flingcf, tcf, held)
if not RootPart:IsGrounded() then
if flingtarget then
Util.Fling.ApplyRoot(RootPart, flingtarget, flingcf)
pcall(sethiddenproperty, RootPart, "PhysicsRepRootRef", Util.Fling.UseGlue() and Util.PredictionFlingPart(flingtarget.Target) or nil)
LOPT.refDirty = true
else
RootPart.CFrame = rootcf + Vector3.new(0, 0, math.random(0, 1) * 0.005)
RootPart.Velocity, RootPart.RotVelocity = rootvel, Vector3.zero
local _rn = os.clock()
if LOPT.refDirty or _rn - LOPT.refAt > 0.5 then
LOPT.refDirty, LOPT.refAt = false, _rn
pcall(sethiddenproperty, RootPart, "PhysicsRepRootRef", nil)
end
end
end
local dorep = true
if LimbReanimator.ReplicateFPS10 then
dorep = false
local b = os.clock()
local a = b - lastrep
if a >= 1 / 10 then
dorep = true
a %= 1 / 10
lastrep = b - a
end
end
for _,v in UnknownMotor6Ds do
Util.SetMotor6DTransform(v, CFrame.identity)
end
if Ragdoll then RagdollSample(RootPart) end
if Servo then
SJ.Root = RootPart
pcall(ServoSample)
end
if Hybrid then
HJ.Root = RootPart
HJ.Sample()
end
local LimbPose, idcf = Reanimate.SafeLimbPose, CFrame.identity
local vnow = VelInterp and os.clock() or 0
for _,map in LimbMapping do
local v = map.Reference
if v then
if map.RG then
if flingtarget then
map.RT = v.C0 * v.C1:Inverse()
pcall(Util.SetMotor6DTransform, v, CFrame.identity)
else
local mcf = map.CFrame
if not mcf or (dorep and not (held and map.RPart0 ~= "ROOT")) then
local cf = LimbPose(map, v, ReanimCharacter, RootPart, tcf)
if cf ~= idcf then
map.CFrame = cf
mcf = cf
end
end
map.RT = Reanimate.LimbHider.Void(map, mcf)
local rg = map.RG
if dorep or not rg.Out then rg.Out = rg.Act or map.RT end
if rg.Out and not RagdollFiniteCF(rg.Out) then rg.Out = map.RT end
if rg.Out then pcall(Util.SetMotor6DOffset, v, rg.Out) end
end
elseif map.SV then
if flingtarget then
pcall(Util.SetMotor6DTransform, v, CFrame.identity)
else
local mcf = map.CFrame
if not mcf then
local cf = LimbPose(map, v, ReanimCharacter, RootPart)
mcf = cf
end
local sv = map.SV
sv.Out = sv.Act or mcf
if sv.Out then pcall(Util.SetMotor6DOffset, v, Reanimate.LimbHider.Void(map, sv.Out)) end
end
elseif map.HY then
if flingtarget then
pcall(Util.SetMotor6DTransform, v, CFrame.identity)
else
local mcf = map.CFrame
if not mcf then
mcf = LimbPose(map, v, ReanimCharacter, RootPart)
end
local hy = map.HY
hy.Out = hy.Act or mcf
if hy.Out then pcall(Util.SetMotor6DOffset, v, Reanimate.LimbHider.Void(map, hy.Out)) end
end
elseif flingtarget then
if VelInterp then VelInterp.Reset(map) end
Util.SetMotor6DTransform(v, CFrame.identity)
else
local mcf = map.CFrame
local fresh = false
if not mcf or (dorep and not (held and map.RPart0 ~= "ROOT")) then
mcf = LimbPose(map, v, ReanimCharacter, RootPart, tcf)
map.CFrame = mcf
fresh = true
end
if VelInterp then mcf = Reanimate.SanitizeLimbPose(map, v, VelInterp.Step(map, mcf, fresh, vnow)) end
Util.SetMotor6DOffset(v, Reanimate.LimbHider.Void(map, mcf))
end
end
end
if Ragdoll then RagdollDrive(RootPart) end
end
do
local UX = Reanimate.UnanchoredReanimator
if UX and UX.StartExtra then pcall(UX.StartExtra) end
end
Reanimate.Starting = false
local rebuildWindowStart, rebuildCount, lastRebuild, rebuildGaveUp = 0, 0, 0, false
local function FrameStep()
RunService.PreSimulation:Wait()
workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = 0/0
do
local rc = Reanimate.Character
if rc and not rc:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
local now = os.clock()
if now - rebuildWindowStart > 20 then
rebuildWindowStart, rebuildCount = now, 0
end
if rebuildCount < 3 and now - lastRebuild > 0.5 then
rebuildCount += 1
lastRebuild = now
pcall(Util.Notify, "Limb Reanimator: the fake character was removed from the workspace by something else, rebuilding it (" .. rebuildCount .. "/3).")
Reanimate.CreateCharacter()
elseif not rebuildGaveUp and rebuildCount >= 3 then
rebuildGaveUp = true
pcall(Util.Notify, "Limb Reanimator: the game keeps removing the fake character; not rebuilding it any more.")
end
end
end
local ReanimOkay = false
local Character, Humanoid, RootPart = Player.Character, nil, nil
if Character then
Humanoid = lookup(Character, "Humanoid", true)
if Humanoid then
if Humanoid.AutoRotate then Humanoid.AutoRotate = false end
if Humanoid.WalkSpeed < 1 then
Humanoid.WalkSpeed = 16
end
if Humanoid.JumpPower < 1 then
Humanoid.JumpPower = 50
end
RootPart = Reanimate.ResolveRealRoot(Character, Humanoid)
if RootPart and Humanoid:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then
Humanoid:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)
ReanimOkay = LimbReanimator.FlingTargets[1] == nil
end
end
end
local rootcf = CFrame.new(LimbReanimator.Mode == 5 and skyposition or LimbReanimator.Mode == 6 and veryskyposition or rootposition)
local rootvel = Vector3.zero
local tcf, held = nil, false
local ltm = Reanimate.LocalTransparencyModifier
local ReanimCharacter = Reanimate.Character
if ReanimCharacter then
local RCHumanoid = lookup(ReanimCharacter, "Humanoid", true)
local RCRootPart = lookup(ReanimCharacter, "HumanoidRootPart")
local RCTorso = lookup(ReanimCharacter, "Torso")
if Camera and Camera.CameraSubject ~= RCHumanoid then
Camera.CameraSubject = RCHumanoid
end
local nowc, fpb, vz, infoT = os.clock(), Reanimate.FirstPersonBody and true or false, LOPT.vz, LOPT.info
for _,v in BaseParts do
if v.CanCollide then v.CanCollide = false end
if not RagdollParts[v] then
if v.Velocity ~= vz then v.Velocity = vz end
if v.RotVelocity ~= vz then v.RotVelocity = vz end
end
local info = infoT[v]
if not info or nowc - info.at > 1 or info.fpb ~= fpb then
info = {at = nowc, fpb = fpb, tool = v:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Tool") ~= nil, head = false}
if fpb and v.Name ~= "Head" then
local lol = v:FindFirstChild("AccessoryWeld")
info.head = (lol and lol:IsA("Weld") and lol.Part1 and lol.Part1.Name == "Head") and true or false
end
infoT[v] = info
end
if not info.tool then
local lltm = ltm
if fpb and v.Name ~= "Head" and not info.head then
lltm = 0
end
if v.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= lltm then v.LocalTransparencyModifier = lltm end
end
end
local wantT = ReanimOkay and 1 or Reanimate.PlaceholderTransparency
local limbSet = LOPT.limbs
for _,v in ReanimCharacter:GetChildren() do
if limbSet[v.Name] and v:IsA("BasePart") and v.Transparency ~= wantT then
v.Transparency = wantT
end
end
if Character and Humanoid and RootPart then
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
local t = os.clock()
if RCRootPart and RCTorso then
if LimbReanimator.Mode == 1 then
rootcf = CFrame.new(rootposition2)
end
if LimbReanimator.Mode == 5 then
rootcf = CFrame.new(skyposition)
end
if LimbReanimator.Mode == 6 then
rootcf = CFrame.new(veryskyposition)
end
if LimbReanimator.Mode == 2 or workspace.StreamingEnabled then
rootcf = CFrame.new(RCRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, -16, 0))
end
if LimbReanimator.Mode == 3 then
rootcf = RCRootPart.CFrame
end
if LimbReanimator.Mode == 4 then
local trel = Reanimate.StableTorsoRel(RCRootPart, RCTorso)
LOPT.torsoRel = trel
rootcf = Reanimate.StableTorsoCFrame(RCRootPart, RCTorso, trel)
end
if LimbReanimator.Velocity == 1 then
rootvel = Reanimate.ClampRootVelocity(RCRootPart.Velocity)
elseif LimbReanimator.Velocity == 2 then
rootvel = Vector3.new(0, 16384, 0)
end
if LimbReanimator.Mode >= 7 then
local pm = LimbReanimator.PluginModes[LimbReanimator.Mode - 6]
local usedplugin = false
if pm and not pm.Failed then
local ok, pcf, pvel = pcall(pm.GetRootCFrame, {
RootPart = RCRootPart,
Torso = RCTorso,
Character = ReanimCharacter,
Time = t,
FallenPartsDestroyHeight = FallenPartsDestroyHeight,
Streaming = workspace.StreamingEnabled,
})
if ok and typeof(pcf) == "CFrame" then
rootcf = pcf
if typeof(pvel) == "Vector3" then rootvel = pvel end
usedplugin = true
else
pm.Failed = true
Util.Notify("Plugin '" .. pm.Name .. "' failed and was disabled: " .. tostring(ok and "GetRootCFrame must return a CFrame" or pcf))
end
end
if not usedplugin then
rootcf = CFrame.new(RCRootPart.Position + Vector3.new(0, -16, 0))
end
end
local ovr = LimbReanimator.RootOverride
if ovr then
local okO, ocf = pcall(ovr, RCRootPart, RCTorso)
if okO and typeof(ocf) == "CFrame" then rootcf = ocf end
end
if Reanimate.FiniteCF(rootcf) then LOPT.lastRoot = rootcf elseif LOPT.lastRoot then rootcf = LOPT.lastRoot end
if LimbReanimator.Mode == 4 and not ovr then tcf = rootcf end
end
do
local q = LimbReanimator.FlingTargets
for qi = #q, 2, -1 do
local qt = q[qi] and q[qi].Target
if typeof(qt) == "Instance" then
local qp = Util.Fling.GetPart(qt)
local gone = (not qp) or (not qp:IsDescendantOf(workspace))
if not gone then
local pp = qp.Position
gone = pp.X ~= pp.X or pp.Y ~= pp.Y or pp.Z ~= pp.Z
end
if gone then table.remove(q, qi) end
end
end
end
local flingtarget, flingcf = Util.Fling.Step(LimbReanimator.FlingTargets, t, Util.Fling.UseGlue() and 0.5 or 2)
if flingtarget then
local fpos, frv = flingcf.Position, flingcf.RightVector
if fpos.X ~= fpos.X or fpos.Y ~= fpos.Y or fpos.Z ~= fpos.Z or fpos.Magnitude > 1e7 or frv.X ~= frv.X then
table.remove(LimbReanimator.FlingTargets, 1)
flingtarget, flingcf = nil, CFrame.identity
end
end
UpdateTransforms(ReanimCharacter, RootPart, rootcf, rootvel, flingtarget, flingcf, tcf)
held = tcf ~= nil and flingtarget == nil and not VelInterp
if flingtarget then
Util.Fling.ApplyHumanoid(Humanoid, flingtarget, lastspawn)
else
if Util.Fling.Method == 4 then
pcall(sethiddenproperty, Humanoid, "MoveDirectionInternal", Vector3.zero)
end
pcall(sethiddenproperty, Humanoid, "NetworkHumanoidState", Enum.HumanoidStateType.Flying.Value)
end
end
RunService.PreRender:Wait()
if Reanimate:ShouldRotationType() then
Reanimate:CameraLockCharacter()
end
if Character and Humanoid and RootPart then
if LimbReanimator.Mode == 4 and RCRootPart and RCTorso and not LimbReanimator.RootOverride then
-- the camera lock above re-yawed the fake character after rootcf was taken at Heartbeat: re-derive the torso target from the fake RootJoint so the real RootPart and the RootJoint pose are never split across two different torso states. The limb / neck joint poses are not sampled again (held): they stay the Heartbeat sample of the same simulation frame, only the root -> torso relation follows the new yaw
local ncf = Reanimate.StableTorsoCFrame(RCRootPart, RCTorso, LOPT.torsoRel)
if Reanimate.FiniteCF(ncf) then
rootcf = ncf
tcf = ncf
LOPT.lastRoot = ncf
end
end
UpdateTransforms(ReanimCharacter, RootPart, rootcf, rootvel, nil, CFrame.identity, tcf, held)
end
end
end
local stepFails, lastStepErr, lastStepErrTime = 0, nil, 0
while not Reanimate.Stopping do
local stepOk, stepErr = pcall(FrameStep)
if stepOk then
stepFails = 0
else
stepFails += 1
stepErr = tostring(stepErr)
if stepErr ~= lastStepErr or os.clock() - lastStepErrTime > 10 then
lastStepErr, lastStepErrTime = stepErr, os.clock()
warn("[Limb Reanimator] frame step failed (x" .. stepFails .. "): " .. stepErr)
pcall(Util.Notify, "Limb Reanimator frame error (see console): " .. stepErr)
end
end
end
do
local UX = Reanimate.UnanchoredReanimator
if UX and UX.StopExtra then pcall(UX.StopExtra) end
end
table.clear(LimbReanimator.FlingTargets)
table.clear(LimbReanimator._TempNotFling)
CharConn:Disconnect()
if Ragdoll then
for _,map in LimbMapping do RagdollRelease(map) end
RagdollClean()
end
if Servo then
ServoCleanAll(true)
if LimbReanimator.ServoCleanup == ServoCleaner then LimbReanimator.ServoCleanup = nil end
end
if Hybrid then
HJ.CleanAll(true)
if LimbReanimator.HybridCleanup == HybridCleaner then LimbReanimator.HybridCleanup = nil end
end
if VelInterp then
for _,map in LimbMapping do VelInterp.Clear(map) end
end
if Player.Character then
local h = Player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
if h then
h:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, true)
h:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead)
end
end
Reanimate.Stopping = false
Reanimate.DestroyCharacter()
end
do
SaveData.Reanimator.RagdollStiffness = SaveData.Reanimator.RagdollStiffness or 100
LimbReanimator.RagdollStiffness = SaveData.Reanimator.RagdollStiffness
local RagdollReanimator = setmetatable({Name = "Ragdoll", HiderKey = "Ragdoll"}, {__index = LimbReanimator})
Reanimate.RagdollReanimator = RagdollReanimator
function RagdollReanimator.Config(parent)
UI.CreateText(parent, "Ragdoll Reanimation: your real limbs are detached into BallSocket ragdoll limbs and physically driven to the reanimated pose.\nUses the Limb Reanimator settings below.", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
LimbReanimator.Config(parent, "Ragdoll")
local sl = UI.CreateSlider(parent, "Ragdoll Stiffness", LimbReanimator.RagdollStiffness, 10, 200, 1)
sl.Changed:Connect(function(val)
val = math.clamp(val, 10, 200)
LimbReanimator.RagdollStiffness = val
SaveData.Reanimator.RagdollStiffness = val
end)

end
