-- ===== Skeletal Retargeting Reanimation (R6 only) =====
-- source animation -> source skeleton reader -> anatomical mapping -> reference-pose relative joint motion -> target R6 joint frames -> proportion compensation -> smoothing -> target R6 pose.
-- The target pose is returned through Reanimate.LimbPoseCFrame, so it flows through the existing Limb pipeline (replicated Motor6D offsets, optional Servo-Joint actuation) and also drives the internal skeleton rig.
do
local RS = SaveData.Reanimator
RS.SkelShow = RS.SkelShow ~= false
RS.SkelProportion = RS.SkelProportion ~= false
RS.SkelServo = RS.SkelServo == true
RS.SkelSmooth = math.clamp(tonumber(RS.SkelSmooth) or 25, 0, 100)
if not RS.SkelVisV2 then RS.SkelVisV2, RS.SkelThickness, RS.SkelTransparency = true, 18, 0 end
RS.SkelOnTop = RS.SkelOnTop ~= false
RS.SkelThickness = math.clamp(tonumber(RS.SkelThickness) or 18, 5, 40)
RS.SkelTransparency = math.clamp(tonumber(RS.SkelTransparency) or 15, 0, 90)
local CFG = {Show = RS.SkelShow, Proportion = RS.SkelProportion, Servo = RS.SkelServo, Smooth = RS.SkelSmooth, Thick = RS.SkelThickness / 100, Trans = RS.SkelTransparency / 100, OnTop = RS.SkelOnTop}
local SKR = setmetatable({Name = "Skeletal Retargeting", HiderKey = "Skeletal"}, {__index = LimbReanimator})
Reanimate.SkeletalRetargetReanimator = SKR
local K = {Active = false, T = 0, TM = {}, G = {}, S = {}, L = {}, Role = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})}
SKR.Core = K
local V3, CFnew, IDCF = Vector3.new, CFrame.new, CFrame.identity
local ROLES = {"Root", "Neck", "LS", "RS", "LH", "RH"}
-- native R6 Motor6Ds of the target character: name -> {role, Part0 name, Part1 name}
local TGT = {
RootJoint = {"Root", "HumanoidRootPart", "Torso"},
Neck = {"Neck", "Torso", "Head"},
["Left Shoulder"] = {"LS", "Torso", "Left Arm"},
["Right Shoulder"] = {"RS", "Torso", "Right Arm"},
["Left Hip"] = {"LH", "Torso", "Left Leg"},
["Right Hip"] = {"RH", "Torso", "Right Leg"},
}
local function roleOf(v)
local e = TGT[v.Name]
if not e then return nil end
local p0, p1 = v.Part0, v.Part1
if p0 and p1 and p0.Name == e[2] and p1.Name == e[3] then return e[1] end
return nil
end
local function fin(cf)
local x, y, z = cf.X, cf.Y, cf.Z
if x ~= x or y ~= y or z ~= z or x > 1e7 or x < -1e7 or y > 1e7 or y < -1e7 or z > 1e7 or z < -1e7 then return false end
local l = cf.LookVector
return l.X == l.X and l.Y == l.Y and l.Z == l.Z
end
local function fromTo(a, b)
local d = a:Dot(b)
if d > 0.99999 then return IDCF end
if d < -0.99999 then
local ax = a:Cross(V3(1, 0, 0))
if ax.Magnitude < 1e-3 then ax = a:Cross(V3(0, 0, 1)) end
return CFrame.fromAxisAngle(ax.Unit, math.pi)
end
return CFrame.fromAxisAngle(a:Cross(b).Unit, math.acos(d))
end
local function scaleCF(cf, s)
if s == 1 then return cf end
return CFnew(cf.Position * s) * cf.Rotation
end
-- anatomical role of a source Motor6D, independent of the exact joint names (R6 / R15 / custom rigs)
local PARTW = {
{"shoulder", "S"}, {"upperarm", "S"}, {"elbow", "E"}, {"forearm", "E"}, {"lowerarm", "E"},
{"wrist", "W"}, {"hand", "W"}, {"hip", "H"}, {"thigh", "H"}, {"upperleg", "H"},
{"knee", "K"}, {"shin", "K"}, {"calf", "K"}, {"lowerleg", "K"}, {"ankle", "A"}, {"foot", "A"},
}
local function classify(name)
local n = string.lower(name):gsub("[%s_%-%.]", "")
if n:find("neck", 1, true) then return "Neck" end
if n:find("waist", 1, true) or n:find("spine", 1, true) or n:find("abdomen", 1, true) then return "Waist" end
if n:find("root", 1, true) then return "Root" end
for _, pw in PARTW do
local i = n:find(pw[1], 1, true)
if i then
local pre, suf = n:sub(1, i - 1), n:sub(i + #pw[1])
if n:find("left", 1, true) or pre == "l" or suf == "l" then return "L" .. pw[2] end
if n:find("right", 1, true) or pre == "r" or suf == "r" then return "R" .. pw[2] end
return nil
end
end
return nil
end
-- source record: parent part -> child part over one joint (or a joint chain such as RootJoint + Waist), with its reference (rest) pose
local function newRec(chain, lenMotors)
local m1, mN = chain[1], chain[#chain]
local rest = IDCF
for _, m in chain do rest = rest * (m.C0 * m.C1:Inverse()) end
local len = 0
for _, m in lenMotors do len += m.Part1.Size.Y end
return {P0 = m1.Part0, P1 = mN.Part1, C0 = m1.C0, C1 = mN.C1, Rest = rest, Len0 = len}
end
local function buildLimb(sh, el, wr)
if not sh then return nil end
local lm = {sh}
local restEnd = sh.C0 * sh.C1:Inverse()
local endPart
if el and el.Part0 == sh.Part1 then
lm[2] = el
restEnd = restEnd * (el.C0 * el.C1:Inverse())
endPart = el.Part1
if wr and wr.Part0 == el.Part1 then
lm[3] = wr
restEnd = restEnd * (wr.C0 * wr.C1:Inverse())
endPart = wr.Part1
end
end
local rec = newRec({sh}, lm)
if endPart then rec.Aim = {End = endPart, RestEnd = restEnd} end
return rec
end
-- source skeleton reader: finds the animated joints once and caches them (name-independent anatomical mapping)
local function buildSource(RC)
local by = {}
for _, m in RC:GetDescendants() do
if m:IsA("Motor6D") and m.Part0 and m.Part1 then
local r = classify(m.Name)
if r and not by[r] then by[r] = m end
end
end
local src = {RC = RC, S0 = math.max(RC:GetScale(), 1e-3), Rec = {}}
local R = src.Rec
if by.Root then
local ch, lm = {by.Root}, {by.Root}
if by.Waist and by.Waist.Part0 == by.Root.Part1 then ch[2], lm[2] = by.Waist, by.Waist end
R.Root = newRec(ch, lm)
end
if by.Neck then R.Neck = newRec({by.Neck}, {by.Neck}) end
R.LS = buildLimb(by.LS, by.LE, by.LW)
R.RS = buildLimb(by.RS, by.RE, by.RW)
R.LH = buildLimb(by.LH, by.LK, by.LA)
R.RH = buildLimb(by.RH, by.RK, by.RA)
return src
end
local function refreshRec(rec, rs)
rec.rs = rs
rec.C0s, rec.C1s = scaleCF(rec.C0, rs), scaleCF(rec.C1, rs)
rec.C0i = rec.C0s:Inverse()
rec.TrI = (rec.C0i * scaleCF(rec.Rest, rs) * rec.C1s):Inverse()
rec.C0R = rec.C0s.Rotation
rec.C0RI = rec.C0R:Inverse()
rec.Len = rec.Len0 * rs
local aim = rec.Aim
if aim then
aim.Far = V3(0, -aim.End.Size.Y * 0.5, 0)
local u = (scaleCF(aim.RestEnd, rs) * aim.Far) - rec.C0s.Position
aim.U0 = u.Magnitude > 1e-4 and u.Unit or V3(0, -1, 0)
end
end
-- target R6 geometry: the real Motor6D's own C0 / C1 / limb size, plus virtual elbow / wrist / knee / ankle points derived from the limb geometry
local function buildGeo(role, v)
local c0, c1, p1 = v.C0, v.C1, v.Part1
local sz = p1.Size
local g = {V = v, P1 = p1, Size = sz, C0 = c0, C1 = c1, C1I = c1:Inverse(), C0R = c0.Rotation, C0RI = c0.Rotation:Inverse(), Len = sz.Y}
if role == "Root" then
g.Sy = sz.Y
elseif role == "Neck" then
g.Pos = c0.Position
else
local piv = c1.Position
local bot = -sz.Y * 0.5
g.Piv = piv
g.Mid = V3(0, piv.Y + (bot - piv.Y) * 0.5, 0)
g.End = V3(0, piv.Y + (bot - piv.Y) * 0.92, 0)
end
return g
end
-- relative transform: joint motion relative to its parent and reference pose (Part1 = Part0 * C0 * Transform * C1^-1), converted into the target joint frame, proportion compensated
local function retarget(rec, g, k)
local p0cf = rec.P0.CFrame
local T = rec.TrI * (rec.C0i * p0cf:ToObjectSpace(rec.P1.CFrame) * rec.C1s)
local R = T.Rotation
local aim = rec.Aim
if aim and aim.End.Parent then
-- multi-segment source limb: the R6 limb aims along the source chain (shoulder -> end), keeping the shoulder's twist
local piv = rec.C0s.Position
local far = p0cf:PointToObjectSpace(aim.End.CFrame * aim.Far) - piv
if far.Magnitude > 1e-3 then
local rp = rec.C0R * R * rec.C0RI
local u0 = aim.U0
local twist = fromTo(u0, rp * u0):Inverse() * rp
R = rec.C0RI * (fromTo(u0, far.Unit) * twist) * rec.C0R
end
end
local fm = g.C0RI * rec.C0R
local d = fm * (T.Position * k)
return CFnew(d) * (fm * R * (rec.C0RI * g.C0R))
end
-- internal skeleton visualization (local only, parented to the camera); joints / bones are placed from K.L, the same retargeted transforms that drive the Motor6Ds.
-- Two layers sit on those transforms: neon parts (depth tested) and always-on-top handle adornments, so the rig is drawn overlapping the body and stays visible through it.
local BA = {3, 1, 2, 4, 2, 2, 3, 3, 6, 8, 7, 9, 12, 14, 13, 15}
local BB = {1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 12, 13, 8, 10, 9, 11, 14, 16, 15, 17}
local CORE, LEFT, RIGHT = Color3.fromRGB(255, 225, 60), Color3.fromRGB(60, 225, 255), Color3.fromRGB(255, 90, 200)
local JLEFT = {[6] = true, [8] = true, [10] = true, [12] = true, [14] = true, [16] = true}
local JRIGHT = {[7] = true, [9] = true, [11] = true, [13] = true, [15] = true, [17] = true}
local FCC = Enum.BulkMoveMode.FireCFrameChanged
function K.VizOff()
local VZ = K.VZ
K.VZ = nil
if VZ and VZ.M then pcall(VZ.M.Destroy, VZ.M) end
end
function K.VizStyle(VZ)
VZ.Th, VZ.Tr, VZ.Top = CFG.Thick, CFG.Trans, CFG.OnTop
local th, tr, top = CFG.Thick, CFG.Trans, CFG.OnTop
for i = 1, 17 do
local s = i == 5 and th * 6 or th * 3
VZ.P[i].Size = V3(s, s, s)
VZ.P[i].Transparency = tr
local ad = VZ.AJ[i]
ad.Radius = s * 0.5
ad.Transparency = tr * 0.7
ad.AlwaysOnTop = top
end
for i = 1, 16 do
VZ.P[17 + i].Transparency = tr
local ad = VZ.AB[i]
ad.Transparency = tr * 0.7
ad.AlwaysOnTop = top
VZ.L[i] = -1
end
if VZ.H then VZ.H.DepthMode = top and Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop or Enum.HighlightDepthMode.Occluded end
end
function K.VizBuild()
K.VizOff()
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera or Camera
local old = cam:FindFirstChild("UH_SkeletalRig")
while old do
old:Destroy()
old = cam:FindFirstChild("UH_SkeletalRig")
end
local m = Instance.new("Model")
m.Name = "UH_SkeletalRig"
local VZ = {M = m, Cam = cam, P = {}, C = {}, J = {}, L = {}, AJ = {}, AB = {}}
local function mk(shape, color)
local p = Instance.new("Part")
p.Anchored, p.CanCollide, p.CanTouch, p.CanQuery, p.CastShadow, p.Massless = true, false, false, false, false, true
p.Material = Enum.Material.Neon
p.Color = color
p.Shape = shape
p.Size = V3(0.2, 0.2, 0.2)
p.Parent = m
return p
end
-- invisible anchor part: it is moved onto the retargeted torso every frame and every adornment is placed in torso space
local anchor = mk(Enum.PartType.Block, CORE)
anchor.Name = "Anchor"
anchor.Transparency = 1
local function ad(cls, color)
local a = Instance.new(cls)
a.Adornee = anchor
a.Color3 = color
a.ZIndex = 5
a.Parent = anchor
return a
end
for i = 1, 17 do
local col = JLEFT[i] and LEFT or JRIGHT[i] and RIGHT or CORE
VZ.P[i] = mk(Enum.PartType.Ball, col)
VZ.C[i] = IDCF
VZ.J[i] = Vector3.zero
VZ.AJ[i] = ad("SphereHandleAdornment", col)
end
for i = 1, 16 do
local jb = BB[i]
local col = JLEFT[jb] and LEFT or JRIGHT[jb] and RIGHT or CORE
VZ.P[17 + i] = mk(Enum.PartType.Block, col)
VZ.C[17 + i] = IDCF
VZ.L[i] = -1
local b = ad("BoxHandleAdornment", col)
b.Size = V3(0.1, 0.1, 0.1)
VZ.AB[i] = b
end
VZ.P[34], VZ.C[34] = anchor, IDCF
pcall(function()
local h = Instance.new("Highlight")
h.Adornee = m
h.FillColor = Color3.fromRGB(80, 220, 255)
h.OutlineColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
h.FillTransparency = 0.5
h.OutlineTransparency = 0.2
h.Parent = m
VZ.H = h
end)
K.VizStyle(VZ)
m.Parent = cam
K.VZ = VZ
return VZ
end
function K.Viz()
local L, tw, G = K.L, K.TW, K.G
local gR, gN, gLS, gRS, gLH, gRH = G.Root, G.Neck, G.LS, G.RS, G.LH, G.RH
if not (tw and L.Neck and L.LS and L.RS and L.LH and L.RH and gR and gN and gLS and gRS and gLH and gRH) then return end
local VZ = K.VZ
if not VZ or VZ.Cam ~= (workspace.CurrentCamera or Camera) or not VZ.M.Parent then VZ = K.VizBuild() end
if VZ.Th ~= CFG.Thick or VZ.Tr ~= CFG.Trans or VZ.Top ~= CFG.OnTop then K.VizStyle(VZ) end
local J, P, C, BL, AJ, AB = VZ.J, VZ.P, VZ.C, VZ.L, VZ.AJ, VZ.AB
local sy = gR.Sy
-- joint points in torso space: limb frames in K.L are relative to the torso, so no world conversion is needed for the adornments
local la, ra, ll, rl = L.LS, L.RS, L.LH, L.RH
J[1] = V3(0, 0, 0)
J[2] = V3(0, sy * 0.3, 0)
J[3] = V3(0, -sy * 0.5, 0)
J[4] = gN.Pos
J[5] = L.Neck.Position
J[6], J[8], J[10] = la * gLS.Piv, la * gLS.Mid, la * gLS.End
J[7], J[9], J[11] = ra * gRS.Piv, ra * gRS.Mid, ra * gRS.End
J[12], J[14], J[16] = ll * gLH.Piv, ll * gLH.Mid, ll * gLH.End
J[13], J[15], J[17] = rl * gRH.Piv, rl * gRH.Mid, rl * gRH.End
for i = 1, 17 do
local lc = CFnew(J[i])
C[i] = tw * lc
AJ[i].CFrame = lc
end
local th = VZ.Th
for i = 1, 16 do
local a, b = J[BA[i]], J[BB[i]]
local dv = b - a
local len = dv.Magnitude
local bl
if len < 1e-3 then
bl = CFnew(a)
else
local up = math.abs(dv.Y) > len * 0.99 and V3(1, 0, 0) or V3(0, 1, 0)
bl = CFrame.lookAt(a, b, up) * CFnew(0, 0, -len * 0.5)
end
C[17 + i] = tw * bl
local ad = AB[i]
ad.CFrame = bl
if math.abs(len - BL[i]) > 0.002 then
BL[i] = len
local z = math.max(len, 0.05)
P[17 + i].Size = V3(th, th, z)
ad.Size = V3(th, th, z)
end
end
C[34] = tw
if not pcall(workspace.BulkMoveTo, workspace, P, C, FCC) then
for i = 1, 34 do P[i].CFrame = C[i] end
end
K.Drawn = true
end
-- one full retargeting pass over the six R6 joints; lazily triggered by the first pose request of every update stage
function K.Refresh(RC, now)
local dt = now - K.T
K.T = now
if dt < 1 / 240 then dt = 1 / 240 elseif dt > 1 / 15 then dt = 1 / 15 end
local src = K.Src
if K.RC ~= RC or not src then
src = buildSource(RC)
K.Src, K.RC = src, RC
table.clear(K.S)
end
local rs = RC:GetScale() / src.S0
local sm = CFG.Smooth
local a = sm <= 0 and 1 or 1 - math.exp(-(3 + 80 * (1 - sm / 100)) * dt)
local L, G, S = K.L, K.G, K.S
for i = 1, 6 do
local role = ROLES[i]
local v, rec = K.TM[role], src.Rec[role]
local out
if v and rec and v.Parent and v.Part1 and rec.P0.Parent and rec.P1.Parent then
local g = G[role]
if not g or g.V ~= v or g.P1 ~= v.Part1 or g.C0 ~= v.C0 or g.C1 ~= v.C1 or g.Size ~= v.Part1.Size then
g = buildGeo(role, v)
G[role] = g
end
if not rec.rs or math.abs(rec.rs - rs) > 1e-4 then refreshRec(rec, rs) end
local k = 1
if CFG.Proportion and rec.Len > 1e-3 and g.Len > 1e-3 then k = math.clamp(g.Len / rec.Len, 0.05, 20) end
local T = retarget(rec, g, k)
if fin(T) then
local prev = S[role]
if prev and a < 1 then T = prev:Lerp(T, a) end
S[role] = T
out = g.C0 * T * g.C1I
end
end
L[role] = out
end
local rr = src.Rec.Root
if L.Root and rr then K.TW = rr.P0.CFrame * L.Root else K.TW = nil end
if CFG.Show then
K.Viz()
if not K.Drawn then
K.Since = K.Since or now
if now - K.Since > 4 and not K.Warned then
K.Warned = true
local miss = {}
for i = 1, 6 do
local role = ROLES[i]
if not K.TM[role] then miss[#miss + 1] = role .. " (real joint)"
elseif not src.Rec[role] then miss[#miss + 1] = role .. " (source joint)"
elseif not L[role] then miss[#miss + 1] = role .. " (pose)" end
end
pcall(Util.Notify, "Skeletal Retargeting: the internal skeleton has not been drawn yet. Missing: " .. (#miss > 0 and table.concat(miss, ", ") or "none (see console)"))
end
end
elseif K.VZ then
K.VizOff()
end
end
-- drop-in replacement for Reanimate.LimbPoseCFrame while the method runs (same signature / meaning: the Motor6D offset Part0 -> Part1 for the real joint)
function K.Pose(map, v, RC, RootPart, tcf)
local orig = K.Orig
local hl = Reanimate.HiddenLimbs
if hl and hl[map.RPart1] and (map.RPart0 == "ROOT" or not hl[map.RPart0]) then return CFnew(0, -250, 0) end
if K.Active and RC and v then
local role = K.Role[v]
if role == nil then
role = roleOf(v) or false
K.Role[v] = role
end
if role then
if K.TM[role] ~= v then
K.TM[role], K.G[role], K.S[role], K.L[role] = v, nil, nil, nil
K.T = 0
end
local now = os.clock()
if K.RC ~= RC or now - K.T > 0.001 then
local ok, err = pcall(K.Refresh, RC, now)
if not ok then
table.clear(K.L)
K.TW = nil
if K.LastErr ~= tostring(err) then
K.LastErr = tostring(err)
warn("[Skeletal Retargeting] retarget pass failed, using the plain limb pose: " .. K.LastErr)
pcall(Util.Notify, "Skeletal Retargeting error (see console): " .. K.LastErr)
end
end
end
local l = K.L[role]
if l then
if role ~= "Root" then return l end
local tw = K.TW
if tw and RootPart then return RootPart.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(tw) end
end
end
end
if orig then return orig(map, v, RC, RootPart, tcf) end
return IDCF
end
function K.End()
K.Active = false
if K.Orig and Reanimate.LimbPoseCFrame == K.Pose then Reanimate.LimbPoseCFrame = K.Orig end
K.Orig = nil
K.VizOff()
table.clear(K.TM)
table.clear(K.G)
table.clear(K.S)
table.clear(K.L)
K.Src, K.RC, K.TW, K.T, K.LastErr = nil, nil, nil, 0, nil
K.Drawn, K.Since, K.Warned = nil, nil, nil
end
function K.Begin()
K.End()
K.Orig = Reanimate.LimbPoseCFrame
Reanimate.LimbPoseCFrame = K.Pose
K.Active = true
end
-- R6-only gate: nothing is initialised, built or modified unless the current character is R6
function SKR.CanStart()
local ch = Player.Character
local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if not hum then
return false, "Skeletal Retargeting Reanimation is R6-only and needs a loaded character: none was found, so nothing was started."
end
if hum.RigType ~= Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 then
return false, "Skeletal Retargeting Reanimation is R6-only. Your character is R15, so it was not started and your character was not modified."
end
if not (ch:FindFirstChild("Torso") and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")) then
return false, "Skeletal Retargeting Reanimation needs a complete R6 body (Torso / HumanoidRootPart missing), so it was not started."
end
return true
end
function SKR.Config(parent)
UI.CreateText(parent, "-=+ R6 ONLY +=-", 13, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
UI.CreateText(parent, "Skeletal Retargeting Reanimation translates source animation through an internal R6 skeletal rig and reconstructs the resulting pose on the target R6 character. It refuses to start on R15 characters; every other reanimator keeps its R15 support. The retargeted pose is applied through the Limb Reanimator's replicated joint pipeline, so other players see the movement.", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
UI.CreateText(parent, "-=+ Skeletal Retargeting Settings +=-", 12, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
UI.CreateSwitch(parent, "Show Internal Skeleton", CFG.Show).Changed:Connect(function(val)
CFG.Show = val and true or false
RS.SkelShow = CFG.Show
end)
UI.CreateSwitch(parent, "Proportion Compensation", CFG.Proportion).Changed:Connect(function(val)
CFG.Proportion = val and true or false
RS.SkelProportion = CFG.Proportion
end)
UI.CreateSlider(parent, "Motion Smoothing (0 = raw)", CFG.Smooth, 0, 100, 1).Changed:Connect(function(val)
val = math.clamp(val, 0, 100)
CFG.Smooth = val
RS.SkelSmooth = val
end)
UI.CreateSlider(parent, "Skeleton Bone Thickness (1/100 stud)", RS.SkelThickness, 5, 40, 1).Changed:Connect(function(val)
val = math.clamp(val, 5, 40)
RS.SkelThickness = val
CFG.Thick = val / 100
end)
UI.CreateSlider(parent, "Skeleton Transparency (%)", RS.SkelTransparency, 0, 90, 1).Changed:Connect(function(val)
val = math.clamp(val, 0, 90)
RS.SkelTransparency = val
CFG.Trans = val / 100
end)
UI.CreateSwitch(parent, "Overlay On Top Of Body (see through)", CFG.OnTop).Changed:Connect(function(val)
CFG.OnTop = val and true or false
RS.SkelOnTop = CFG.OnTop
end)
UI.CreateText(parent, "^^^ the internal skeleton (joints, spine / pelvis, virtual elbows, wrists, knees and ankles) is drawn inside your R6 body from the same retargeted pose that moves the real joints. It is a local visual only.", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
UI.CreateSwitch(parent, "Physical Servo Actuation (applies on next Reanimate)", CFG.Servo).Changed:Connect(function(val)
CFG.Servo = val and true or false
RS.SkelServo = CFG.Servo
end)
UI.CreateText(parent, "^^^ ON: the retargeted joint angles drive the Servo-Joint hinge controller (strength / speed / limits come from the Servo-Joint Reanimator page). OFF: the retargeted pose is applied directly through the replicated joint offsets.", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
UI.CreateSeparator(parent)
UI.CreateText(parent, "RootPart / init / fling options below are shared with the Limb Reanimator.", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
LimbReanimator.Config(parent, "Skeletal")
end
function SKR.Start()
local okR6, why = SKR.CanStart()
if not okR6 then
pcall(Util.UINotify, why)
Reanimate.Starting = false
repeat task.wait() until Reanimate.Stopping
Reanimate.Stopping = false
return
end
K.Begin()
LimbReanimator.ServoMode = CFG.Servo and true or nil
local ok, err = pcall(LimbReanimator.Start)
LimbReanimator.ServoMode = nil
K.End()
if not ok then
warn("[Skeletal Retargeting] failed to start: " .. tostring(err))
pcall(Util.Notify, "Skeletal Retargeting Reanimation failed to start (see console): " .. tostring(err))
local cl = LimbReanimator.ServoCleanup
LimbReanimator.ServoCleanup = nil
if cl then pcall(cl) end
pcall(Reanimate.DestroyCharacter)
Reanimate.Starting = false
repeat task.wait() until Reanimate.Stopping
Reanimate.Stopping = false
end
end
end
-- ===== Kinematic Reanimation (R6 only, IK reanimator) =====
-- procedural R6 targets (gait / idle / air / seated / custom) -> two-bone IK (law of cosines, virtual elbow / knee, pole vectors) -> R6 Motor6D offsets.
-- The pose is returned through Reanimate.LimbPoseCFrame, so it flows through the existing Limb pipeline (replicated Motor6D offsets). No Instances and no RunService connections are created.
do
local RS = SaveData.Reanimator
RS.KinArms = RS.KinArms ~= false
RS.KinLegs = RS.KinLegs ~= false
RS.KinTerrain = RS.KinTerrain ~= false
RS.KinHandTargets = RS.KinHandTargets == true
RS.KinFootTargets = RS.KinFootTargets == true
RS.KinSmooth = math.clamp(tonumber(RS.KinSmooth) or 25, 0, 100)
RS.KinGait = math.clamp(tonumber(RS.KinGait) or 100, 0, 200)
RS.KinReach = math.clamp(tonumber(RS.KinReach) or 100, 50, 100)
local CFG = {Arms = RS.KinArms, Legs = RS.KinLegs, Terrain = RS.KinTerrain, Hands = RS.KinHandTargets, Feet = RS.KinFootTargets, Smooth = RS.KinSmooth, Gait = RS.KinGait / 100, Reach = RS.KinReach / 100}
local KR = setmetatable({Name = "Kinematic Reanimation", HiderKey = "Kinematic"}, {__index = LimbReanimator})
Reanimate.KinematicReanimator = KR
local K = {Active = false, T = 0, Au = 0, Tr = 0, MP = {}, A = {}, Seen = {}, TM = {}, G = {}, L = {}, S = {}, Bnd = {}, GY = {}, GN = {}, GT = {}, GNT = {}, W = {}, WP = {}, WL = {}, FT = {}, SWG = {}, Tgt = {}, Role = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})}
KR.Core = K
local V3, CFnew, IDCF = Vector3.new, CFrame.new, CFrame.identity
local ZERO, UPV, DOWNV, RIGHTV = Vector3.zero, Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), Vector3.new(0, -1, 0), Vector3.new(1, 0, 0)
local PI, PI2 = math.pi, math.pi * 2
local sqrt, sin, cos, exp, clamp = math.sqrt, math.sin, math.cos, math.exp, math.clamp
local ROLES = {"Root", "Neck", "LS", "RS", "LH", "RH"}
-- the six native R6 Motor6Ds: name -> {role, Part0 name, Part1 name}
local TGT = {
RootJoint = {"Root", "HumanoidRootPart", "Torso"},
Neck = {"Neck", "Torso", "Head"},
["Left Shoulder"] = {"LS", "Torso", "Left Arm"},
["Right Shoulder"] = {"RS", "Torso", "Right Arm"},
["Left Hip"] = {"LH", "Torso", "Left Leg"},
["Right Hip"] = {"RH", "Torso", "Right Leg"},
}
local TN = {LeftHand = 1, RightHand = 2, LeftFoot = 3, RightFoot = 4}
local function roleOf(v)
local e = TGT[v.Name]
if not e then return nil end
local p0, p1 = v.Part0, v.Part1
if p0 and p1 and p0.Name == e[2] and p1.Name == e[3] then return e[1] end
return nil
end
local function okcf(cf)
local x, y, z = cf.X, cf.Y, cf.Z
if x ~= x or y ~= y or z ~= z or x > 1e6 or x < -1e6 or y > 1e6 or y < -1e6 or z > 1e6 or z < -1e6 then return false end
local l = cf.LookVector
return l.X == l.X and l.Y == l.Y and l.Z == l.Z
end
local function perp(d)
local p = d:Cross(UPV)
if p.Magnitude < 1e-3 then p = d:Cross(RIGHTV) end
return p.Unit
end
-- cached R6 joint geometry: the real Motor6D's own C0 / C1 / limb size. Len = pivot -> limb end, Half = virtual elbow / knee distance from the pivot
local function buildGeo(role, v)
local c0, c1, sz = v.C0, v.C1, v.Part1.Size
local g = {V = v, P1 = v.Part1, Size = sz, C0 = c0, C1 = c1, Piv = c0.Position, CP = c1.Position, Q0 = c0.Rotation * c1.Rotation:Inverse(), Q0I = c1.Rotation * c0.Rotation:Inverse(), Rest = c0 * c1:Inverse()}
if role ~= "Root" and role ~= "Neck" then
g.Len = math.max(g.CP.Y + sz.Y * 0.5, 0.2)
g.Half = g.Len * 0.5
g.Off = g.Q0 * V3(-g.CP.X, 0, -g.CP.Z)
end
return g
end
-- two-bone IK. S = shoulder / hip pivot, virtual elbow / knee at Half, end effector T (all torso-local).
-- R6 limbs are rigid (no elbow / knee Motor6D), so the solved virtual joint is mapped onto the real shoulder / hip: the limb aims between the chord S->T and the upper bone S->joint (kb), and rolls so its bend plane stays stable.
local function ik(role, g, T, hint, sign, kb, reach, nrm, nw, look, a, S0, az, aw)
local S, Ln = S0 or g.Piv, g.Len
local l1 = g.Half
local l2 = Ln - l1
local ch = T - S
local d0 = ch.Magnitude
local cd = d0 > 1e-3 and ch / d0 or DOWNV
local d = clamp(d0, Ln * 0.12, Ln * reach)
local ca = clamp((l1 * l1 + d * d - l2 * l2) / (2 * l1 * d), -1, 1)
local sa = sqrt(1 - ca * ca)
-- bend plane: the stored plane is carried onto the new chord (parallel transport) and only nudged towards the pole hint; the hint fades out as it becomes parallel to the chord and a flipped hint is ignored, so the virtual elbow / knee never snaps across
local prev = K.Bnd[role]
local pb = hint - cd * hint:Dot(cd)
local pm = pb.Magnitude
local hv = pm > 1e-3 and pb / pm or nil
local pp = prev and (prev - cd * prev:Dot(cd)) or nil
local ppm = pp and pp.Magnitude or 0
local bd
if ppm > 1e-3 then
pp = pp / ppm
if hv and hv:Dot(pp) > -0.5 then
local m = pp:Lerp(hv, a * clamp(pm / 0.3, 0, 1))
local mm = m.Magnitude
bd = mm > 1e-3 and m / mm or pp
else
bd = pp
end
else
bd = hv or perp(cd)
end
K.Bnd[role] = bd
local ud = cd * ca + bd * sa
local u = cd * (1 - kb) + ud * kb
if nw > 0 and nrm then u = u * (1 - nw) - nrm * nw end
local um = u.Magnitude
u = um > 1e-3 and u / um or cd
-- roll: explicit orientation (custom target) > authored roll (az, weighted by aw) > bend plane
local zr = look and -look or bd * sign
if az and aw and aw > 0.001 then
local dz = zr:Dot(az)
if aw >= 0.999 or (dz < -0.85 and aw > 0.5) then
zr = az
elseif dz >= -0.85 then
zr = zr:Lerp(az, aw)
end
end
zr -= u * zr:Dot(u)
if zr.Magnitude < 1e-3 then zr = bd - u * bd:Dot(u) end
if zr.Magnitude < 1e-3 then zr = perp(u) end
zr = zr.Unit
local Y = -u
local Q = CFrame.fromMatrix(ZERO, Y:Cross(zr), Y, zr) * g.Q0
return CFnew(S) * Q * CFnew(-g.CP)
end
-- authored joint pose (the real Motor6D's Part0 -> Part1 offset, torso space) -> solver inputs: pivot, end-effector target (pivot + limb axis * limb length) and roll direction. It is the inverse of what ik() returns, so feeding these back with kb = 0 rebuilds the authored limb pose exactly
local function authPose(g, cf)
local R = cf.Rotation * g.Q0I
local Sa = cf:PointToWorldSpace(g.CP)
return Sa, Sa - R.YVector * g.Len, R.ZVector
end
local CNAME = {"LeftHand", "RightHand", "LeftFoot", "RightFoot"}
-- custom target state for slot wi (1-2 hands, 3-4 feet): root-space position / orientation, blended in and out smoothly. Runs for every update so explicit targets override authored and procedural motion alike
local function custom(rcf, kc, wi, on)
local ct = K.Tgt[CNAME[wi]]
local live = on and ct
if live then
K.WP[wi] = ct.World and rcf:PointToObjectSpace(ct.Pos) or ct.Pos
K.WL[wi] = ct.Ori and (ct.World and rcf:VectorToObjectSpace(ct.Ori.LookVector) or ct.Ori.LookVector) or nil
end
local cw = K.W[wi] or 0
cw += ((live and 1 or 0) - cw) * kc
K.W[wi] = cw
if cw <= 0.001 or not K.WP[wi] then K.WP[wi], K.WL[wi] = nil, nil end
end
local function put(role, cf, ka)
if okcf(cf) then
local pv = K.S[role]
if pv and ka < 1 then cf = pv:Lerp(cf, ka) end
K.S[role] = cf
K.L[role] = cf
else
K.L[role] = nil
end
end
local function resetRun()
for _, t in {K.S, K.Bnd, K.GY, K.GN, K.GT, K.GNT, K.W, K.WP, K.WL, K.FT, K.SWG, K.A, K.Seen} do table.clear(t) end
K.Ph, K.Mv, K.Sp, K.Air, K.Seat, K.Drop, K.Dir, K.RayAt = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, V3(0, 0, -1), 0
K.RR, K.Hum, K.RP, K.RPch, K.TW = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
K.Au, K.Tr, K.Key, K.New = 0, 0, nil, true
end
resetRun()
-- internal target interface. limb: "LeftHand" | "RightHand" | "LeftFoot" | "RightFoot". pos: Vector3 (or a CFrame, whose rotation is then the orientation). ori: optional CFrame, the limb's front face is turned along its LookVector. world ~= false: world space, world == false: relative to the reanimator root.
-- Used only while the matching Custom Hand / Foot Targets switch is on; targets blend in and out smoothly and are cleared when the method stops.
function KR.SetTarget(limb, pos, ori, world)
if not TN[limb] then return false end
if typeof(pos) == "CFrame" then
if ori == nil then ori = pos end
pos = pos.Position
end
if typeof(pos) ~= "Vector3" or pos.X ~= pos.X or pos.Y ~= pos.Y or pos.Z ~= pos.Z then return false end
K.Tgt[limb] = {Pos = pos, Ori = typeof(ori) == "CFrame" and ori or nil, World = world ~= false}
return true
end
function KR.ClearTarget(limb) K.Tgt[limb] = nil end
function KR.ClearTargets() table.clear(K.Tgt) end
-- one full IK pass over the six R6 joints; lazily triggered by the first pose request of every update stage
function K.Refresh(RC, now)
local dt = now - K.T
K.T = now
if dt < 1 / 240 then dt = 1 / 240 elseif dt > 1 / 15 then dt = 1 / 15 end
if K.RC ~= RC then
resetRun()
K.RC = RC
end
if not K.RR or K.RR.Parent ~= RC then
K.RR = RC:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
K.Hum = RC:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end
local L, G, TM, AU = K.L, K.G, K.TM, K.A
local rr, hum = K.RR, K.Hum
local ready = rr ~= nil and hum ~= nil
for i = 1, 6 do
local role = ROLES[i]
local v = TM[role]
if v and v.Parent and v.Part1 then
local g = G[role]
if not g or g.V ~= v or g.P1 ~= v.Part1 or g.C0 ~= v.C0 or g.C1 ~= v.C1 or g.Size ~= v.Part1.Size then
G[role] = buildGeo(role, v)
end
else
ready = false
end
end
if not ready then
table.clear(L)
table.clear(AU)
K.TW = nil
return
end
local gR, gN, gLS, gRS, gLH, gRH = G.Root, G.Neck, G.LS, G.RS, G.LH, G.RH
local sm = CFG.Smooth
local ka = sm <= 0 and 1 or 1 - exp(-(3 + 80 * (1 - sm / 100)) * dt)
local kw = 1 - exp(-(3 + 22 * (1 - sm / 100)) * dt)
local kc = 1 - exp(-(2 + 18 * (1 - sm / 100)) * dt)
local gi, reach = CFG.Gait, CFG.Reach
local armsOn, legsOn = CFG.Arms, CFG.Legs
local rcf = rr.CFrame
-- ===== authored animation (Moveset / Dance) =====
-- priority: explicit custom targets > authored animation pose > procedural gait / idle. au = how much the authored pose owns the limbs (snaps on a fresh animated character, eases in / out otherwise); K.Tr is a short window after a dance / moveset change in which the authored pose is eased from the previous output instead of snapping
local auOn = (RC:GetAttribute("MovementInit") or RC:GetAttribute("IsDancing")) and true or false
local akey = tostring(RC:GetAttribute("MovesetInternalName")) .. "|" .. tostring(RC:GetAttribute("DanceInternalName"))
local fresh = K.New
K.New = false
if fresh then
K.Au = auOn and 1 or 0
elseif akey ~= K.Key then
K.Tr = 0.4
end
K.Key = akey
if K.Tr > 0 then K.Tr = math.max(K.Tr - dt, 0) end
K.Au += ((auOn and 1 or 0) - K.Au) * (1 - exp(-(auOn and 20 or 8) * dt))
if K.Au > 0.995 then K.Au = 1 elseif K.Au < 0.005 then K.Au = 0 end
local au = K.Au
-- one coherent sample of all six authored joint poses per update (the pose the existing animation system produced on the animated character)
if auOn or au > 0 then
local orig, rt, hl = K.Orig, K.Root, Reanimate.HiddenLimbs
for i = 1, 6 do
local role = ROLES[i]
local m = K.MP[role]
local cf
if orig and m and not (hl and hl[m.RPart1] and (m.RPart0 == "ROOT" or not hl[m.RPart0])) then
cf = orig(m, TM[role], RC, rt)
if not okcf(cf) then cf = nil end
end
AU[role] = cf
end
else
table.clear(AU)
end
local ROa = AU.Root and K.Root and rcf:ToObjectSpace(K.Root.CFrame * AU.Root) or nil
local proc = au < 1 or not (ROa and AU.Neck and AU.LS and AU.RS and AU.LH and AU.RH)
local aR = ROa and au or 0
ka += ((K.Tr > 0 and 1 - exp(-16 * dt) or 1) - ka) * au
-- motion inputs from the control character (root space: forward = -Z)
local vel = rr.AssemblyLinearVelocity
local sc = math.max(RC:GetScale(), 0.05)
local hv = rcf:VectorToObjectSpace(V3(vel.X, 0, vel.Z))
local lvx, lvz = hv.X, hv.Z
local sp = sqrt(lvx * lvx + lvz * lvz) / sc
K.Sp += (sp - K.Sp) * (1 - exp(-12 * dt))
local spS = K.Sp
if sp > 0.3 then
local nd = V3(lvx, 0, lvz).Unit
local md = K.Dir:Lerp(nd, 1 - exp(-10 * dt))
K.Dir = md.Magnitude > 1e-3 and md.Unit or nd
end
K.Mv += (clamp((spS - 0.6) / 1.4, 0, 1) - K.Mv) * (1 - exp(-8 * dt))
local mv = K.Mv
local sit = hum.Sit
local air = (not sit) and hum.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air
K.Air += ((air and 1 or 0) - K.Air) * (1 - exp(-10 * dt))
K.Seat += ((sit and 1 or 0) - K.Seat) * (1 - exp(-10 * dt))
local wA, wS = K.Air, K.Seat
local legL = gLH.Len
local lu = legL * 0.5
local A = math.min(clamp(0.5 + 0.045 * spS, 0.45, 1.15) * gi * lu, legL * 0.85)
local H = math.min((0.2 + 0.03 * spS) * gi * lu, legL * 0.45)
if mv > 0.02 then K.Ph = (K.Ph + dt * clamp(spS * sc / (4 * math.max(A, 0.05)), 0.4, 3.2)) % 1 end
local ph = K.Ph
local rest = gR.Rest
local dir = K.Dir
local dx, dz = dir.X, dir.Z
-- explicit custom hand / foot targets (slots 1-2 hands, 3-4 feet)
custom(rcf, kc, 1, CFG.Hands)
custom(rcf, kc, 2, CFG.Hands)
custom(rcf, kc, 3, CFG.Feet)
custom(rcf, kc, 4, CFG.Feet)
local FT, SWG = K.FT, K.SWG
local RO
local rayOn = false
if proc then
-- terrain probing: at most two rays per tick, rate follows the active performance profile (off while an authored animation owns the legs)
rayOn = legsOn and CFG.Terrain and wA < 0.5 and wS < 0.5 and au < 0.5
local doRay = false
if rayOn and now >= K.RayAt then
doRay = true
local pf = Util.FX and Util.FX.Perf
local rs = pf and tonumber(pf.RayStride) or 1
if rs < 1 then rs = 1 end
K.RayAt = now + (mv > 0.05 and 0.033 or 0.25) * rs
local pc = Player.Character
if not K.RP or K.RPch ~= pc then
K.RPch = pc
local rp = RaycastParams.new()
rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
rp.RespectCanCollide = true
rp.IgnoreWater = true
rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = pc and {RC, pc} or {RC}
K.RP = rp
end
end
-- foot targets (root space) + pelvis height needed to keep both rigid legs on their targets
local drop = 0
for i = 1, 2 do
local g = i == 1 and gLH or gRH
local hip = rest * g.Piv
local p = (ph + (i == 2 and 0.5 or 0)) % 1
local z, lift, swg
if p < 0.5 then
z, lift, swg = A * (1 - 4 * p), 0, 0
else
local t = (p - 0.5) * 2
z = A * (2 * (0.5 - 0.5 * cos(PI * t)) - 1)
swg = sin(PI * t)
lift = H * swg
end
local fx, fz = hip.X + dx * z * mv, hip.Z + dz * z * mv
local ty, nrm = hip.Y - g.Len, UPV
if rayOn then
if doRay then
local hit = workspace:Raycast(rcf:PointToWorldSpace(V3(fx, hip.Y + 1, fz)), V3(0, -(g.Len + 4.5), 0), K.RP)
local gy, gn = hip.Y - g.Len, UPV
if hit then
gy = rcf:PointToObjectSpace(hit.Position).Y
local n = rcf:VectorToObjectSpace(hit.Normal)
if n.Y > 0.5 then gn = n end
end
K.GT[i], K.GNT[i] = gy, gn
if not K.GY[i] then K.GY[i], K.GN[i] = gy, gn end
end
local cy = K.GY[i]
if cy then
local ag = 1 - exp(-22 * dt)
cy += (K.GT[i] - cy) * ag
K.GY[i] = cy
local nn = K.GN[i]:Lerp(K.GNT[i], ag)
K.GN[i] = nn.Magnitude > 1e-3 and nn.Unit or UPV
ty, nrm = cy, K.GN[i]
end
end
local clr = 0.04 + 0.35 * sqrt(math.max(0, 1 - nrm.Y * nrm.Y))
local F = V3(fx, ty + clr + lift * mv, fz)
if wA > 0.001 then
local fall = clamp(-vel.Y / 40, 0, 1)
F = F:Lerp(V3(hip.X, hip.Y - legL * (0.8 + 0.1 * fall), hip.Z + (i == 1 and -0.32 or 0.3) * legL), wA)
end
if wS > 0.001 then F = F:Lerp(V3(hip.X, hip.Y - 0.12 * legL, hip.Z - 0.97 * legL), wS) end
local wi = 2 + i
local cw = K.WP[wi] and K.W[wi] or 0
if cw > 0.001 then F = F:Lerp(K.WP[wi], cw) end
FT[i], SWG[i] = F, swg * mv
if legsOn then
local hx, hz = F.X - hip.X, F.Z - hip.Z
local mx = g.Len * g.Len - hx * hx - hz * hz
local need = (hip.Y - F.Y) - (mx > 0.04 and sqrt(mx) or 0.2)
if need > drop then drop = need end
end
end
drop = clamp(drop, -0.06 * lu, legL * 0.55)
K.Drop += (drop - K.Drop) * (1 - exp(-(6 + 60 * (1 - sm / 100)) * dt))
-- pelvis (RootJoint): height, forward lean along the movement direction, small counter twist
local lean = clamp(spS * 0.008, 0, 0.16) * gi * mv * (1 - wA * 0.6)
local O = CFnew(0, -K.Drop, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, sin(PI2 * ph) * 0.1 * gi * mv, 0)
if lean > 1e-4 then O = O * CFrame.fromAxisAngle(UPV:Cross(dir), lean) end
RO = O * rest
if aR > 0 then RO = RO:Lerp(ROa, aR) end
else
-- authored animation owns the pelvis: no procedural lean / height / twist
K.Drop += (0 - K.Drop) * (1 - exp(-8 * dt))
RO = ROa
end
if armsOn or legsOn then
local pr = K.S.Root
if pr and aR > 0 and K.Tr > 0 then RO = pr:Lerp(RO, 1 - exp(-16 * dt)) end
K.S.Root = RO
if aR >= 1 and K.Tr <= 0 then
-- exact authored RootJoint (the original pose callback supplies it)
L.Root, K.TW = nil, nil
elseif okcf(RO) then
L.Root = RO
K.TW = rcf * RO
else
L.Root, K.TW = nil, nil
end
else
L.Root, K.TW, K.S.Root = nil, nil, nil
end
-- neck: authored neck pose when an authored animation is active, otherwise it keeps the head mostly upright against the pelvis lean / twist
if armsOn or legsOn then
local an = AU.Neck
local nk = proc and CFnew(gN.Piv) * (IDCF:Lerp(RO.Rotation:Inverse(), 0.8) * gN.Q0) * CFnew(-gN.CP) or nil
if an and au > 0 then nk = nk and nk:Lerp(an, au) or an end
put("Neck", nk, ka)
else
L.Neck, K.S.Neck = nil, nil
end
-- legs: authored foot pose and / or procedural foot target -> torso space -> two-bone IK (virtual knee, pole = forward); a custom foot target overrides both
if legsOn then
for i = 1, 2 do
local role = i == 1 and "LH" or "RH"
local g = i == 1 and gLH or gRH
local wi = 2 + i
local cw = K.WP[wi] and K.W[wi] or 0
local ac = AU[role]
local aw = ac and au or 0
local T, S0, az, nrm
local kb, nw = 0, 0
if aw < 1 then
T = RO:PointToObjectSpace(FT[i])
if cw > 0.001 then T -= g.Off * cw end
kb = math.max(SWG[i], clamp((1 - (T - g.Piv).Magnitude / g.Len) * 1.5, 0, 0.5), wA * 0.5)
if rayOn and K.GN[i] then
nrm = RO:VectorToObjectSpace(K.GN[i])
nw = (1 - SWG[i]) * 0.3 * (1 - wA) * (1 - wS)
end
end
if aw > 0 then
local Sa, Ta, za = authPose(g, ac)
local kba = 0
if cw > 0.001 then
Ta = Ta:Lerp(RO:PointToObjectSpace(K.WP[wi]), cw) - g.Off * cw
kba = cw * clamp((1 - (Ta - Sa).Magnitude / g.Len) * 1.5, 0, 0.5)
end
if T then
T, S0 = T:Lerp(Ta, aw), g.Piv:Lerp(Sa, aw)
else
T, S0 = Ta, Sa
end
kb, nw, az = kb * (1 - aw) + kba * aw, nw * (1 - aw), za
end
local look = (cw > 0.5 and K.WL[wi]) and RO:VectorToObjectSpace(K.WL[wi]) or nil
if look then az = nil end
put(role, ik(role, g, T, V3((i == 1 and -1 or 1) * 0.12, 0, -1), -1, kb, reach, nrm, nw, look, kw, S0, az, aw), ka)
end
else
L.LH, L.RH, K.S.LH, K.S.RH = nil, nil, nil, nil
end
-- arms: authored arm pose and / or procedural swing (opposite to the same-side leg) / idle sway / air / seated -> torso space -> two-bone IK (virtual elbow, pole = back + out); a custom hand target overrides both
if armsOn then
for i = 1, 2 do
local role = i == 1 and "LS" or "RS"
local g = i == 1 and gLS or gRS
local s = i == 1 and -1 or 1
local cw = K.WP[i] and K.W[i] or 0
local ac = AU[role]
local aw = ac and au or 0
local T, S0, az
local kb = 0.4
if aw < 1 then
local Sp, La = g.Piv, g.Len
local swing = cos(PI2 * ((ph + (i == 1 and 0.5 or 0)) % 1))
local ang = clamp((0.22 + 0.04 * spS) * gi, 0, 1.3) * swing * mv
local flex = (0.05 + 0.18 * math.max(0, swing)) * mv * math.min(spS / 16, 1)
local rl = La * (0.985 - flex)
local sway = (1 - mv) * (1 - wA) * 0.012 * La
local Hd = V3(Sp.X + s * 0.08 * La + s * sin(now * 1.3 + i) * sway, Sp.Y - rl * cos(ang) + cos(now * 1.7 + i) * sway, Sp.Z - 0.03 * La) + V3(dx, 0, dz) * (rl * sin(ang))
if wA > 0.001 then Hd = Hd:Lerp(V3(Sp.X + s * 0.75 * La, Sp.Y + 0.55 * La, Sp.Z - 0.15 * La), wA) end
if wS > 0.001 then Hd = Hd:Lerp(V3(Sp.X - s * 0.2 * La, Sp.Y - 0.78 * La, Sp.Z - 0.5 * La), wS) end
if cw > 0.001 then Hd = Hd:Lerp(RO:PointToObjectSpace(K.WP[i]), cw) - g.Off * cw end
T = Hd
end
if aw > 0 then
local Sa, Ta, za = authPose(g, ac)
local kba = 0
if cw > 0.001 then
Ta = Ta:Lerp(RO:PointToObjectSpace(K.WP[i]), cw) - g.Off * cw
kba = cw * 0.4
end
if T then
T, S0 = T:Lerp(Ta, aw), g.Piv:Lerp(Sa, aw)
else
T, S0 = Ta, Sa
end
kb, az = kb * (1 - aw) + kba * aw, za
end
local look = (cw > 0.5 and K.WL[i]) and RO:VectorToObjectSpace(K.WL[i]) or nil
if look then az = nil end
put(role, ik(role, g, T, V3(s * 0.35, -0.1, 0.9), 1, kb, reach, nil, 0, look, kw, S0, az, aw), ka)
end
else
L.LS, L.RS, K.S.LS, K.S.RS = nil, nil, nil, nil
end
end
-- drop-in replacement for Reanimate.LimbPoseCFrame while the method runs (same signature / meaning: the Motor6D offset Part0 -> Part1 for the real joint)
function K.Pose(map, v, RC, RootPart, tcf)
local orig = K.Orig
local hl = Reanimate.HiddenLimbs
if hl and hl[map.RPart1] and (map.RPart0 == "ROOT" or not hl[map.RPart0]) then return CFnew(0, -250, 0) end
if K.Active and RC and v then
local role = K.Role[v]
if role == nil then
role = roleOf(v) or false
K.Role[v] = role
end
if role then
if K.TM[role] ~= v then
K.TM[role], K.G[role], K.S[role], K.L[role] = v, nil, nil, nil
K.T = 0
end
K.MP[role] = map
if RootPart and Reanimate.IsRealRoot(RootPart, RC) then K.Root = RootPart end
local now = os.clock()
local since = now - K.T
-- a new update stage starts when a joint is requested a second time (or after a stall): the whole stage then shares one pose sample / IK pass
if K.RC ~= RC or K.T == 0 or since > 0.05 or (since > 0.001 and K.Seen[role]) then
table.clear(K.Seen)
local ok, err = pcall(K.Refresh, RC, now)
if not ok then
table.clear(K.L)
K.TW = nil
if K.LastErr ~= tostring(err) then
K.LastErr = tostring(err)
warn("[Kinematic Reanimation] IK pass failed, using the plain limb pose: " .. K.LastErr)
pcall(Util.Notify, "Kinematic Reanimation error (see console): " .. K.LastErr)
end
end
end
K.Seen[role] = true
-- the solved pose already consumed the authored Dance / Moveset pose (see K.Refresh); only joints it did not solve fall back to the original pose callback
local l = K.L[role]
if l then
if role ~= "Root" then return l end
local tw = K.TW
if tw and RootPart then return RootPart.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(tw) end
end
end
end
if orig then return orig(map, v, RC, RootPart, tcf) end
return IDCF
end
-- restores the previous pose callback and drops every cached reference / temporary state
function K.Reset()
K.Active = false
if K.Orig and Reanimate.LimbPoseCFrame == K.Pose then Reanimate.LimbPoseCFrame = K.Orig end
K.Orig = nil
table.clear(K.TM)
table.clear(K.G)
table.clear(K.L)
table.clear(K.MP)
K.Root = nil
resetRun()
K.RC, K.T, K.LastErr = nil, 0, nil
end
function K.End()
K.Reset()
table.clear(K.Tgt)
end
function K.Begin()
K.Reset()
K.Orig = Reanimate.LimbPoseCFrame
Reanimate.LimbPoseCFrame = K.Pose
K.Active = true
end
-- R6-only gate: nothing is initialised, built or modified unless the current character is a complete R6 rig
function KR.CanStart()
local ch = Player.Character
local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if not (hum and hum.RigType == Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6 and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and ch:FindFirstChild("Torso") and ch:FindFirstChild("Head") and ch:FindFirstChild("Left Arm") and ch:FindFirstChild("Right Arm") and ch:FindFirstChild("Left Leg") and ch:FindFirstChild("Right Leg")) then
return false, "Kinematic Reanimation only supports R6 characters."
end
return true
end
function KR.Config(parent)
UI.CreateText(parent, "-=+ R6 ONLY +=-", 13, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
UI.CreateText(parent, "Kinematic Reanimation generates its own hand and foot targets (walk / run gait, idle, air, seated) and solves them with a two-bone IK solver: virtual elbows and knees (law of cosines, pole vectors, reach clamping) are mapped onto the six native R6 Motor6D joints. Active Dances and Movesets are read from the animated character and rebuilt through the solver (priority: custom targets > authored Dance / Moveset pose > procedural gait). It refuses to start on R15 characters; every other reanimator is unchanged.", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
UI.CreateText(parent, "-=+ Kinematic IK Settings +=-", 12, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
UI.CreateSwitch(parent, "Procedural Arms", CFG.Arms).Changed:Connect(function(val)
CFG.Arms = val and true or false
RS.KinArms = CFG.Arms
end)
UI.CreateSwitch(parent, "Procedural Legs", CFG.Legs).Changed:Connect(function(val)
CFG.Legs = val and true or false
RS.KinLegs = CFG.Legs
end)
UI.CreateSwitch(parent, "Terrain-Adaptive Feet", CFG.Terrain).Changed:Connect(function(val)
CFG.Terrain = val and true or false
RS.KinTerrain = CFG.Terrain
end)
UI.CreateText(parent, "^^^ OFF arms / legs: that limb pair keeps the plain animated pose. Terrain-Adaptive Feet raycasts the ground under each foot (two rays per tick, rate follows the performance profile) to place feet, tilt them to the slope and lower the pelvis.", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
UI.CreateSlider(parent, "Motion Smoothing (0 = raw)", CFG.Smooth, 0, 100, 1).Changed:Connect(function(val)
val = clamp(val, 0, 100)
CFG.Smooth = val
RS.KinSmooth = val
end)
UI.CreateSlider(parent, "Gait Intensity (%)", RS.KinGait, 0, 200, 1).Changed:Connect(function(val)
val = clamp(val, 0, 200)
RS.KinGait = val
CFG.Gait = val / 100
end)
UI.CreateSlider(parent, "IK Reach Limiting (% of limb length)", RS.KinReach, 50, 100, 1).Changed:Connect(function(val)
val = clamp(val, 50, 100)
RS.KinReach = val
CFG.Reach = val / 100
end)
UI.CreateText(parent, "^^^ gait intensity scales stride, foot lift, arm swing and lean. Reach limiting caps how far the solver extends a limb, lower values keep the virtual elbows / knees more bent.", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
UI.CreateSwitch(parent, "Custom Hand Targets", CFG.Hands).Changed:Connect(function(val)
CFG.Hands = val and true or false
RS.KinHandTargets = CFG.Hands
end)
UI.CreateSwitch(parent, "Custom Foot Targets", CFG.Feet).Changed:Connect(function(val)
CFG.Feet = val and true or false
RS.KinFootTargets = CFG.Feet
end)
UI.CreateText(parent, "^^^ with these ON, targets supplied through Reanimate.KinematicReanimator.SetTarget(\"LeftHand\" | \"RightHand\" | \"LeftFoot\" | \"RightFoot\", position, optionalOrientationCFrame, worldSpace) replace the procedural ones (blended in and out smoothly). Limbs without a supplied target keep their procedural default. ClearTarget(name) / ClearTargets() release them.", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
UI.CreateSeparator(parent)
UI.CreateText(parent, "RootPart / init / fling options below are shared with the Limb Reanimator.", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
LimbReanimator.Config(parent, "Kinematic")
end
function KR.Start()
local okR6, why = KR.CanStart()
if not okR6 then
pcall(Util.UINotify, why)
Reanimate.Starting = false
repeat task.wait() until Reanimate.Stopping
Reanimate.Stopping = false
return
end
K.Begin()
local ok, err = pcall(LimbReanimator.Start)
K.End()
if not ok then
warn("[Kinematic Reanimation] failed to start: " .. tostring(err))
pcall(Util.Notify, "Kinematic Reanimation failed to start (see console): " .. tostring(err))
pcall(Reanimate.DestroyCharacter)
Reanimate.Starting = false
repeat task.wait() until Reanimate.Stopping
Reanimate.Stopping = false
end
end
end
-- ===== Velocity-Interpolated Reanimation =====
-- Every mapped limb owns a continuous movement state (position, rotation, linear and angular velocity AND acceleration). The ORIGINAL animation target (map.CFrame, Motor6D transform space, never modified) is the only authoritative destination. The limb follows it with a critically damped THIRD-order tracker integrated in closed form from real elapsed time (frame-rate independent): position, velocity and acceleration all stay continuous (no acceleration steps when the goal changes, S-shaped catch-up, no overshoot for a consistent state, a lower peak acceleration for the same lag). Speed and acceleration are bounded as vectors (direction changes are limited too); a braking guard works on the ACCELERATION wherever the limb can still stop in time (a velocity is only cut when it can no longer be stopped inside the remaining distance), the limb never crosses its goal and settles without vibrating. Linear and angular motion are independent channels whose responsiveness is kept in step (a joint that mostly rotates also tightens its translation) and tightened a little while the whole body is active, so every joint lags the animation by a consistent time. Target velocity is only MEASURED (successive original targets, same local space) to adapt responsiveness, relax the limits and extrapolate the goal between samples; it is never a velocity the limb must follow. Responsiveness follows the measured speed (slow motion smoothed harder, fast motion followed tighter), rises fast and falls slowly so it never softens mid-motion; a sudden reversal adds temporary damping and a lower acceleration limit, and while the target motion is not consistent (reversal, stop, pose jump) the velocity that is sideways to the goal or leads away from it is damped extra, while the momentum of consistent motion is kept. Because every new sample is held over the whole step, the goal is shifted back by half a step of measured motion, so the lag is the same at 30, 60, 120 and higher frame rates. Between samples (ReplicateFPS10) the goal is extrapolated along the measured motion for at most one sample interval; stale samples are never treated as fresh. One shared, adaptively capped frame step drives every limb: irregular frame times are integrated exactly, a dropped frame never causes a burst or a snap, and only teleports and real stalls restart the state. Pose jumps and animation switches only clear the measured target motion, the limb eases from where it is with its own velocity and acceleration intact. Prediction (small default lead, 0 = off) is confidence weighted, faded out on reversals and deceleration, scaled per joint and tightly bounded. Rotation errors keep one representation across the half turn, so the limb never flips direction at the far side. Each joint type (root, torso, head, arm, leg, hand / foot) has its own responsiveness, limits and damping. map.CFrame keeps the raw target; the interpolated pose only replaces it at the final (pre-LimbHider) Motor6D write; should the controller ever raise an error the limb falls back to the raw pose.
do
local RS = SaveData.Reanimator
local function num(k, d, lo, hi)
local v = math.clamp(tonumber(RS[k]) or d, lo, hi)
RS[k] = v
return v
end
-- tuning revision 4 (adaptive smoothing, confidence weighted prediction, reversal damping): the movement controller was reworked, values saved by older builds (tuned for the old momentum based controller) are reset to the new defaults once
if RS.VelInterpTune ~= 4 then
RS.VelInterpTune = 4
RS.VelInterpResp, RS.VelInterpPredictMs, RS.VelInterpMaxAcc, RS.VelInterpMaxSpeed, RS.VelInterpAngResp, RS.VelInterpMaxAngAcc = nil, nil, nil, nil, nil, nil
end
local VC = {
Resp = num("VelInterpResp", 24, 1, 60),
Predict = num("VelInterpPredictMs", 4, 0, 10) / 1000,
MaxAcc = num("VelInterpMaxAcc", 250, 10, 1000),
MaxSpeed = num("VelInterpMaxSpeed", 14, 1, 60),
AngResp = num("VelInterpAngResp", 24, 1, 60),
MaxAngAcc = num("VelInterpMaxAngAcc", 220, 10, 800),
}
LimbReanimator.VelInterpCfg = VC
local exp, sqrt, abs, PI = math.exp, math.sqrt, math.abs, math.pi
local ZERO, IDCF = Vector3.zero, CFrame.identity
-- HITCH: frame time above which the state restarts on the current target (a real stall, not a frame drop); MAX_DT / MIN_CAP / CAP_K / DT_T: adaptive step cap shared by all limbs (cap = CAP_K x the running average frame time, between MIN_CAP and MAX_DT, averaged over DT_T seconds) so one long frame never produces a burst of movement; MIN_SAMPLE: shortest interval used for a target speed measurement; GAP: longest interval a measurement is trusted over; STALE / STALE10: time without a fresh sample after which the measured target motion fades out (normal / ReplicateFPS10) at rate DECAY; BRAKE: share of the acceleration limit the limb may rely on to stop inside the remaining distance; GAIN / X0 / W0: how far (x GAIN) and how quickly (half-speed X0 studs/s, W0 rad/s) responsiveness rises with the measured target speed; OM_MAX: responsiveness ceiling; OM10: responsiveness floor while the animation is only sampled 10 times per second; SPR_K: tracker rate per unit of responsiveness (a critically damped third-order tracker of rate SPR_K x responsiveness lags steady motion by 3 / rate of real time, at every frame rate); OM_UP / OM_DOWN: time constants with which responsiveness rises (fast, no trailing) / falls (slow, no sudden softening); JUMP_LIN / TELEPORT: linear speed / distance of a target step that is a pose jump, not motion; LEAD_CAP / ANG_LEAD_CAP / LEAD_STEP: prediction limits (studs, rad, share of the last real target step); EXT_STEP: share of the last real target step the goal may be extrapolated by between samples; EPS_POS / EPS_ANG / EPS_VL / EPS_VA: settle distance / angle / speed / angular speed; HYST / HYST_V: near-half-turn error angle and counter-rotation speed above which the current rotation direction is kept
local HITCH, MIN_SAMPLE, GAP, STALE, STALE10, DECAY = 1, 0.006, 0.2, 0.05, 0.14, 20
local MAX_DT, MIN_CAP, CAP_K, DT_T = 0.1, 1 / 30, 2.5, 0.25
local BRAKE, GAIN, X0, W0, OM_MAX, OM10 = 0.8, 1.6, 3, 3, 90, 28
local SPR_K, OM_UP, OM_DOWN = 4.2, 0.02, 0.08
local JUMP_LIN, TELEPORT = 45, 12
local LEAD_CAP, ANG_LEAD_CAP, LEAD_STEP, EXT_STEP = 0.03, 0.03, 0.5, 1
local EPS_POS, EPS_ANG, EPS_VL, EPS_VA = 5e-4, 2.5e-4, 0.05, 0.05
local HYST, HYST_V = 2.8, 0.5
-- adaptive smoothing: FILT_SLOW / FILT_FAST = velocity measurement filter time constants for slow / fast target motion; CONF_RISE = time of consistent motion until prediction reaches full confidence; SLOW_OM = share of the base responsiveness used for (almost) still / slow motion (SLOW_X / SLOW_WX = linear / angular speed at which it is half way back to 1)
local FILT_SLOW, FILT_FAST, CONF_RISE, SLOW_OM, SLOW_X, SLOW_WX = 0.08, 0.025, 0.06, 0.65, 1.5, 0.8
-- sudden direction change: REV_L / REV_A = minimum linear / angular speed on both sides of a reversal, TURN_TIME = duration of the extra damping, TURN_OM / TURN_ACC = responsiveness / acceleration reduction at its start
local REV_L, REV_A, TURN_TIME, TURN_OM, TURN_ACC = 2, 1.5, 0.15, 0.35, 0.25
-- per joint type: rm / am / sm scale the linear responsiveness / acceleration / speed settings, wr / wa scale the angular responsiveness / acceleration settings, wmax = angular speed limit for catching up (rad/s), jw = angular speed (rad/s) above which a target step is a pose jump, pm = prediction scale, sc = how strongly the body-wide activity tightens the joint, sd = scale of the extra damping of unwanted (sideways / opposing) velocity
local PROFILE = {
-- Root / Torso trackers use sc = 0: the activity of the limbs never tightens them, so the torso follows the body / root animation and not the limb motion
Root = {rm = 0.85, am = 0.8, sm = 0.9, wr = 0.85, wa = 0.8, wmax = 9, jw = 30, pm = 0.5, sc = 0, sd = 1},
Torso = {rm = 0.9, am = 0.9, sm = 0.95, wr = 0.9, wa = 0.85, wmax = 10, jw = 32, pm = 0.7, sc = 0, sd = 1},
Head = {rm = 1, am = 0.9, sm = 1, wr = 1, wa = 0.9, wmax = 12, jw = 38, pm = 0.8, sc = 0.6, sd = 1.1},
Arm = {rm = 1, am = 1, sm = 1.15, wr = 1.1, wa = 1, wmax = 16, jw = 45, pm = 1, sc = 1, sd = 0.9},
Leg = {rm = 1, am = 1.05, sm = 1.1, wr = 1.05, wa = 1, wmax = 15, jw = 42, pm = 1, sc = 1, sd = 0.9},
Distal = {rm = 1.15, am = 1.1, sm = 1.3, wr = 1.2, wa = 1.2, wmax = 20, jw = 55, pm = 1.25, sc = 1.2, sd = 0.7},
}
local function classify(map)
if map.RPart0 == "ROOT" or map.Part0 == "HumanoidRootPart" then return PROFILE.Root end
local n = string.lower(tostring(map.Part1 or map.RPart1 or ""))
if n:find("head", 1, true) then return PROFILE.Head end
if n:find("hand", 1, true) or n:find("foot", 1, true) then return PROFILE.Distal end
if n:find("arm", 1, true) then return PROFILE.Arm end
if n:find("leg", 1, true) then return PROFILE.Leg end
return PROFILE.Torso
end
local function finite(v)
local m = v.Magnitude
return m == m and m < 1e9
end
local function finiteCF(cf)
return finite(cf.Position) and finite(cf.XVector) and finite(cf.YVector)
end
local function clampMag(v, m)
local l = v.Magnitude
if l > m then return v * (m / l) end
return v
end
local function rotVec(r)
local axis, ang = r:ToAxisAngle()
if ang > PI then ang -= 2 * PI end
if abs(ang) < 1e-7 then return ZERO end
return axis * ang
end
local function rotFromVec(w)
local a = w.Magnitude
if a < 1e-9 then return IDCF end
return CFrame.fromAxisAngle(w / a, a)
end
-- Core.K: HALF = share of a step the sampled goal is shifted back along the measured motion (a new sample is held over the whole step, which would make the limb lead by about half a step at low frame rates; the shift keeps the lag the same at every frame rate); SIDE / OPP = extra damping rate (x the tracker rate) of the velocity that is sideways to the goal / leads away from it, faded out by the motion confidence; SYNC_G / SYNC_T / SYNC_X = how much (share), how slowly (s) and from which activity the body-wide animation activity tightens every joint; LINK = share of one channel's measured activity that also tightens the other channel of the same joint. Core.G: body-wide activity (A = smoothed mean activity, S / N = sum / count collected during the current frame, F = number of reported errors)
local Core = {
	K = {HALF = 0.6, SIDE = 0.45, OPP = 0.6, SYNC_G = 0.3, SYNC_T = 0.08, SYNC_X = 1, LINK = 0.5},
	G = {A = 0, S = 0, N = 0, F = 0},
}
LimbReanimator.VelInterpCore = Core
-- one critically damped THIRD-order step in closed form (frame-rate independent). State per channel: e = limb - goal (remaining distance / angle as a vector), v = limb velocity, a = limb acceleration, w = tracker rate. The response is (c0 + c1 t + c2 t^2) e^(-w t) (a triple pole at -w): position, velocity AND acceleration stay continuous (no acceleration step when the goal moves, S shaped catch-up, no overshoot for a consistent state), and for the same lag it needs a rate only 1.5x higher than a second-order tracker with a lower peak acceleration. conf (0..1) = confidence that the target keeps moving consistently, gv = measured goal velocity (confidence weighted). While the target motion is not consistent, the velocity (relative to the goal motion) that is sideways to the goal or leads away from it is damped extra (straight, unhurried approach; momentum of consistent motion is kept). Before the step a braking guard works on the ACCELERATION: if the response would cross the goal (c2 < 0, or the quadratic c0 + c1 t + c2 t^2 reaches zero) the braking acceleration along the goal direction is raised to the smallest value that avoids it (limited by BRAKE x amax), so the velocity stays continuous; only a closing speed from which the limited braking can no longer stop inside the distance is cut. After the step the speed is limited to smax and the velocity CHANGE (a vector, so direction changes too) to amax * dt, the acceleration to amax; when a limit acts the step is integrated with the limited velocity. The limb never crosses its goal. Returns the new error, velocity and acceleration.
local function spring3(e, v, a, w, amax, smax, dt, conf, gv, sd)
	local d = e.Magnitude
	local u = ZERO
	if d > 1e-9 then
		u = e / d
		local k = 1 - conf
		if k > 0.02 then
			local kc = Core.K
			local vr = v - gv
			local al = vr:Dot(u)
			v -= (vr - u * al) * (1 - exp(-kc.SIDE * sd * k * w * dt))
			if al > 0 then v -= u * (al * (1 - exp(-kc.OPP * k * w * dt))) end
		end
		local c = -v:Dot(u)
		if c > 0 then
			local br = BRAKE * amax
			local cb = sqrt(2 * br * d)
			if c > cb then
				v += u * (c - cb)
				c = cb
			end
			local wd = w * d
			local need = 2 * w * c - wd * w
			if c > wd then
				local q = wd - c
				need += q * q / (2 * d)
			end
			local au = a:Dot(u)
			if au < need then
				if need > br then need = br end
				if au < need then a += u * (need - au) end
			end
		end
	end
	local ex = exp(-w * dt)
	local c1 = v + e * w
	local c2 = (a + v * (2 * w) + e * (w * w)) * 0.5
	local p0 = e + (c1 + c2 * dt) * dt
	local p1 = c1 + c2 * (2 * dt)
	local en = p0 * ex
	local vn = (p1 - p0 * w) * ex
	local an = (c2 * 2 - p1 * (2 * w) + p0 * (w * w)) * ex
	local exact = true
	local sp = vn.Magnitude
	if sp > smax then
		vn *= smax / sp
		local ad = an:Dot(vn)
		if ad > 0 then an -= vn * (ad / (smax * smax)) end
		exact = false
	end
	local dv = vn - v
	local m, lim = dv.Magnitude, amax * dt
	if m > lim then
		vn = v + dv * (lim / m)
		exact = false
	end
	local am = an.Magnitude
	if am > amax then an *= amax / am end
	if not exact then en = e + (v + vn) * (0.5 * dt) end
	if d > 1e-9 then
		local kk = en:Dot(u)
		if kk < 0 then
			en -= u * kk
			local cv = vn:Dot(u)
			if cv < 0 then vn -= u * cv end
			local ca = an:Dot(u)
			if ca < 0 then an -= u * ca end
		end
	end
	return en, vn, an
end
-- shared frame clock: one adaptively capped time step for every limb
local GN, GDA, GCAP = 0, 1 / 60, 0.05
function Core.Reset(map)
	local st = map.VI
	if st then st.Ready = false end
end
function Core.Clear(map)
	map.VI = nil
end
-- tgt = original animation target (never modified), fresh = tgt was just sampled this call (a cached target is never a new sample), now = os.clock(); returns the interpolated pose
function Core.Impl(map, tgt, fresh, now)
	local K, G = Core.K, Core.G
	local st = map.VI
	if not st then
		st = {Ready = false, P = classify(map), Cur = tgt, Tgt = tgt, PrevT = tgt, LV = ZERO, AV = ZERO, LA = ZERO, AA = ZERO, ER = ZERO, TV = ZERO, TA = ZERO, SS = 0, SW = 0, SL = 0, SA = 0, CL = 0, CA = 0, TN = 0, TT = now, IT = now, ST = now, SI = 0, OM = 0, OMR = 0}
		map.VI = st
	end
	if now ~= GN then
		local fd = now - GN
		GN = now
		if fd > 0 and fd <= HITCH then
			local s = fd < GCAP and fd or GCAP
			GDA += (s - GDA) * (1 - exp(-s / DT_T))
			local c = CAP_K * GDA
			GCAP = c < MIN_CAP and MIN_CAP or (c > MAX_DT and MAX_DT or c)
			-- body-wide activity: the mean normalized target speed of every joint stepped during the previous frame, smoothed over time (all joints of a frame see the same value)
			if G.N > 0 then G.A += (G.S / G.N - G.A) * (1 - exp(-s / K.SYNC_T)) end
		else
			G.A = 0
		end
		G.S, G.N = 0, 0
	end
	local hl = Reanimate.HiddenLimbs
	if hl and hl[map.RPart1] and (map.RPart0 == "ROOT" or not hl[map.RPart0]) then
		st.Ready = false
		return tgt
	end
	if not finiteCF(tgt) then
		if not st.Ready then return tgt end
		tgt, fresh = st.Tgt, false
	end
	if not st.Ready then
		st.Ready = true
		st.Cur, st.Tgt, st.PrevT = tgt, tgt, tgt
		st.LV, st.AV, st.LA, st.AA, st.ER, st.TV, st.TA = ZERO, ZERO, ZERO, ZERO, ZERO, ZERO, ZERO
		st.SS, st.SW, st.SL, st.SA = 0, 0, 0, 0
		st.CL, st.CA, st.TN = 0, 0, 0
		st.TT, st.IT, st.ST, st.SI, st.OM, st.OMR = now, now, now, 0, 0, 0
		return tgt
	end
	local P = st.P
	if fresh then
		st.Tgt, st.ST = tgt, now
		local ds = now - st.TT
		if ds >= MIN_SAMPLE then
			local pp = st.PrevT
			local dp = tgt.Position - pp.Position
			local dr = rotVec(tgt * pp:Inverse())
			if finite(dp) and finite(dr) then
				local ml, ma = dp.Magnitude, dr.Magnitude
				if ds > GAP or ml > TELEPORT or ml > JUMP_LIN * ds or ma > P.jw * ds then
					-- discontinuity (animation switch, pose jump, teleport, sampling gap): no speed is measured from it and the measured target motion is cleared, but the limb keeps its own velocity and acceleration and eases from where it is; only a teleport lands directly on the target
					if ml > TELEPORT then
						st.Cur, st.LV, st.AV, st.LA, st.AA, st.SS, st.SW = tgt, ZERO, ZERO, ZERO, ZERO, 0, 0
					end
					st.TV, st.TA, st.CL, st.CA, st.TN, st.ER = ZERO, ZERO, 0, 0, 0, ZERO
				else
					local rl, ra = dp / ds, dr / ds
					local il, ia = ml / ds, ma / ds
					local tv, ta = st.TV, st.TA
					local tl, tal = tv.Magnitude, ta.Magnitude
					local sl0, sw0 = st.SS, st.SW
					-- adaptive measurement filter: slow target motion is averaged over a longer window (smoother, less noise), fast motion is followed closely
					local fl = il > sl0 and il or sl0
					local fa = ia > sw0 and ia or sw0
					local kl = 1 - exp(-ds / (FILT_FAST + (FILT_SLOW - FILT_FAST) * X0 / (fl + X0)))
					local ka = 1 - exp(-ds / (FILT_FAST + (FILT_SLOW - FILT_FAST) * W0 / (fa + W0)))
					local dl, da = tv:Dot(rl), ta:Dot(ra)
					-- a reversal (or a first sample after rest) replaces the old estimate outright instead of blending through it, and is never predicted from
					local cl = dl > 0.5 * tl * il
					local ca = da > 0.5 * tal * ia
					-- prediction confidence: builds up while the measured motion keeps its direction AND speed, collapses on a direction change and drops quickly while the target speeds up or slows down
					local cf = st.CL
					if not cl then cf = 0
					elseif il < 0.7 * tl or il > 1.5 * tl then cf *= 0.35
					else cf = math.min(1, cf + ds / CONF_RISE) end
					st.CL = cf
					cf = st.CA
					if not ca then cf = 0
					elseif ia < 0.7 * tal or ia > 1.5 * tal then cf *= 0.35
					else cf = math.min(1, cf + ds / CONF_RISE) end
					st.CA = cf
					-- sudden direction change (fast on both sides, not the smooth speed-zero crossing of an ordinary swing): temporary extra damping and a lower acceleration limit; the limb's velocity itself is never cut, it decelerates and re-accelerates continuously
					if (tl > REV_L and il > REV_L and dl < 0.1 * tl * il) or (tal > REV_A and ia > REV_A and da < 0.1 * tal * ia) then
						st.TN = 1
					end
					st.TV = cl and tv:Lerp(rl, kl) or rl
					st.TA = ca and ta:Lerp(ra, ka) or ra
					st.SS += (il - sl0) * kl
					st.SW += (ia - sw0) * ka
					local si = st.SI
					st.SI = si > 0 and si + (ds - si) * 0.3 or ds
				end
				st.SL, st.SA = ml, ma
				st.PrevT, st.TT = tgt, now
			end
		end
	end
	local dt = now - st.IT
	st.IT = now
	if not (dt > 0) then return st.Cur end
	if dt > HITCH then
		st.Ready = false
		return st.Tgt
	end
	if dt > GCAP then dt = GCAP end
	local ten = LimbReanimator.ReplicateFPS10
	if now - st.TT >= (ten and STALE10 or STALE) then
		-- the animation stopped changing: the measured target motion fades out smoothly and relaxes every limit back to its base value
		local k = exp(-DECAY * dt)
		local s0, w0 = st.SS * k, st.SW * k
		st.SS, st.SW = s0 < 1e-3 and 0 or s0, w0 < 1e-3 and 0 or w0
		st.TV, st.TA = st.TV * k, st.TA * k
		st.CL, st.CA = 0, 0
	end
	local ss, sw = st.SS, st.SW
	local tn = st.TN
	if tn > 0 then
		tn -= dt / TURN_TIME
		if tn < 0 then tn = 0 end
		st.TN = tn
	end
	-- synchronisation: this joint's normalized target speed feeds the body-wide activity (capped, so one very fast limb cannot dominate the mean); a channel that is (almost) still is tightened by a share of the other channel's activity, so position and rotation of a joint lag the animation by the same time
	local nl, na = ss / X0, sw / W0
	local act = nl > na and nl or na
	G.S += act < 4 and act or 4
	G.N += 1
	local sync = 1 + K.SYNC_G * P.sc * (G.A / (G.A + K.SYNC_X))
	local ssn, swn = ss, sw
	if na * K.LINK > nl then ssn = na * K.LINK * X0 end
	if nl * K.LINK > na then swn = nl * K.LINK * W0 end
	local cfg = VC
	-- responsiveness rises with the measured target speed (slow motion: softer, rising to the full base value and beyond as the measured speed grows); a recent reversal adds temporary damping
	local dmp = 1 - TURN_OM * tn
	local om = cfg.Resp * P.rm * dmp * sync * (SLOW_OM + (1 - SLOW_OM) * ssn / (ssn + SLOW_X)) * (1 + GAIN * ssn / (ssn + X0))
	local omr = cfg.AngResp * P.wr * dmp * sync * (SLOW_OM + (1 - SLOW_OM) * swn / (swn + SLOW_WX)) * (1 + GAIN * swn / (swn + W0))
	if ten then
		if om < OM10 then om = OM10 end
		if omr < OM10 then omr = OM10 end
	end
	if om > OM_MAX then om = OM_MAX end
	if omr > OM_MAX then omr = OM_MAX end
	-- the responsiveness actually used is smoothed (rises fast so fast motion is not trailed, falls slowly so the limb never gets suddenly softer in the middle of a movement)
	local o0, r0 = st.OM, st.OMR
	if o0 <= 0 or r0 <= 0 then
		o0, r0 = om, omr
	else
		o0 += (om - o0) * (1 - exp(-dt / (om > o0 and OM_UP or OM_DOWN)))
		r0 += (omr - r0) * (1 - exp(-dt / (omr > r0 and OM_UP or OM_DOWN)))
	end
	st.OM, st.OMR = o0, r0
	local smax = cfg.MaxSpeed * P.sm + 1.5 * ss
	local amax = (cfg.MaxAcc * P.am + o0 * ss) * (1 - TURN_ACC * tn)
	local wmax = P.wmax + 1.5 * sw
	local wamax = (cfg.MaxAngAcc * P.wa + r0 * sw) * (1 - TURN_ACC * tn)
	local base = st.Tgt
	local gp, gr = base.Position, base.Rotation
	local cl, ca = st.CL * (1 - tn), st.CA * (1 - tn)
	local tv, ta = st.TV, st.TA
	local ext = now - st.ST
	if ext > 0 then
		-- no fresh sample this call (sparse sampling): the goal keeps moving along the measured motion for at most one expected sample interval and never by more than the last real target step, so the limb moves continuously instead of in separate bursts
		local cap = st.SI * 1.25
		if ext > cap then ext = cap end
	else
		ext = 0
	end
	local pr = cfg.Predict
	-- the sample is held over the whole step: the goal is shifted back along the measured motion by HALF of the step (confidence weighted, never more than 3/4 of the last real target step) so the lag does not depend on the frame rate; the optional prediction and the between-sample extrapolation are added on top, each bounded
	local hs = K.HALF * dt
	if cl > 0 then
		local sl = st.SL
		local off = ext > 0 and clampMag(tv * (ext * cl), sl * EXT_STEP) or ZERO
		-- optional prediction: only along a consistent, steady (not decelerating) measured direction, weighted by its confidence, faded out after a reversal, scaled per joint and never more than a share of the last real target step (the absolute cap grows a little with the measured speed)
		if pr > 0 then
			off += clampMag(tv * (pr * P.pm * cl), math.min(sl * LEAD_STEP, LEAD_CAP * (1 + ss / (ss + X0))))
		end
		gp += off - clampMag(tv * (hs * cl), sl * 0.75)
	end
	if ca > 0 then
		local sa = st.SA
		local off = ext > 0 and clampMag(ta * (ext * ca), sa * EXT_STEP) or ZERO
		if pr > 0 then
			off += clampMag(ta * (pr * P.pm * ca), math.min(sa * LEAD_STEP, ANG_LEAD_CAP * (1 + sw / (sw + W0))))
		end
		off -= clampMag(ta * (hs * ca), sa * 0.75)
		local m = off.Magnitude
		if m > 1e-9 then gr = CFrame.fromAxisAngle(off / m, m) * gr end
	end
	local cur = st.Cur
	local en, nv, nac = spring3(cur.Position - gp, st.LV, st.LA, o0 * SPR_K, amax, smax, dt, cl, cl > 0 and tv * cl or ZERO, P.sd)
	local np
	if en.Magnitude < EPS_POS and nv.Magnitude < EPS_VL then
		np, nv, nac = gp, ZERO, ZERO
	else
		np = gp + en
	end
	local er = rotVec(cur * gr:Inverse())
	local av = st.AV
	local th = er.Magnitude
	if th > HYST then
		local ax = er / th
		local alt = -ax * (2 * PI - th)
		-- almost a half turn away: keep rotating the way the limb already turns, or (when it is nearly still) keep the error representation of the previous frame, so the error never flips to the other side of the half turn
		if av:Dot(ax) > HYST_V or (av.Magnitude < HYST_V and st.ER:Dot(alt) > st.ER:Dot(er)) then er = alt end
	end
	st.ER = er
	local ev, nav, naa = spring3(er, av, st.AA, r0 * SPR_K, wamax, wmax, dt, ca, ca > 0 and ta * ca or ZERO, P.sd)
	local nr
	if ev.Magnitude < EPS_ANG and nav.Magnitude < EPS_VA then
		nr, nav, naa = gr, ZERO, ZERO
	else
		nr = rotFromVec(ev) * gr
	end
	if not (finite(np) and finite(nv) and finite(nac) and finite(nav) and finite(naa) and finite(nr.XVector) and finite(nr.YVector)) then
		st.Ready = false
		return st.Tgt
	end
	local out = nr + np
	st.Cur, st.LV, st.AV, st.LA, st.AA = out, nv, nav, nac, naa
	return out
end
-- safety net: should the controller ever raise an error the limb falls back to the raw animation pose (state restarts on the next call) instead of breaking the reanimation loop
function Core.Step(map, tgt, fresh, now)
	local ok, out = pcall(Core.Impl, map, tgt, fresh, now)
	if ok and out then return out end
	local st = map.VI
	if st then st.Ready = false end
	local G = Core.G
	if not ok and G.F < 3 then
		G.F += 1
		warn("[Velocity-Interpolated Reanimator] step error, the limb uses the raw animation pose: " .. tostring(out))
	end
	return tgt
end
local VelInterpReanimator = setmetatable({Name = "Velocity-Interpolated", HiderKey = "VelInterp"}, {__index = LimbReanimator})
Reanimate.VelocityInterpolatedReanimator = VelInterpReanimator
function VelInterpReanimator.Config(parent)
UI.CreateText(parent, "Velocity-Interpolated Reanimation: every limb keeps its own continuous movement state (position, rotation, velocity and acceleration) and is moved toward the animation's current pose by a bounded, critically damped third-order (jerk-continuous) tracker integrated from real frame time, so motion stays continuous across frame drops, frame rates and consecutive animation samples, without overshoot or vibration. Responsiveness follows how fast the animation really moves, is kept consistent between the joints and differs per joint (root, torso, head, arms, legs, hands / feet); pose jumps and animation switches only clear the measured animation motion while the limb's own velocity and acceleration carry on smoothly. The animation's own pose is never overwritten, and it works with the Limb Reanimator's RootPart, init, fling and limb hider options.", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
UI.CreateText(parent, "-=+ Velocity-Interpolated Settings +=-", 12, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
local function slider(label, key, lo, hi, field, scale)
UI.CreateSlider(parent, label, RS[key], lo, hi, 1).Changed:Connect(function(val)
val = math.clamp(val, lo, hi)
RS[key] = val
VC[field] = scale and val / scale or val
end)
end
slider("Interpolation Responsiveness (1/s)", "VelInterpResp", 1, 60, "Resp")
slider("Prediction Time (ms)", "VelInterpPredictMs", 0, 10, "Predict", 1000)
slider("Maximum Linear Acceleration (studs/s^2)", "VelInterpMaxAcc", 10, 1000, "MaxAcc")
slider("Maximum Linear Speed (studs/s)", "VelInterpMaxSpeed", 1, 60, "MaxSpeed")
slider("Angular Responsiveness (1/s)", "VelInterpAngResp", 1, 60, "AngResp")
slider("Maximum Angular Acceleration (rad/s^2)", "VelInterpMaxAngAcc", 10, 800, "MaxAngAcc")
UI.CreateText(parent, "^^^ all settings apply live. Responsiveness is the base smoothing speed (limbs automatically follow faster animation motion more tightly); prediction (0 = off) only adds a small lead that is bounded by the measured motion and fades out on reversals and deceleration; the acceleration / speed limits only shape catch-up after pose jumps and never restrict the animation's own motion. Lower values = softer, heavier transitions.", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
UI.CreateSeparator(parent)
UI.CreateText(parent, "RootPart / init / fling options below are shared with the Limb Reanimator.", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
LimbReanimator.Config(parent, "VelInterp")
end
function VelInterpReanimator.Start()
LimbReanimator.VelInterpMode = true
local ok, err = pcall(LimbReanimator.Start)
LimbReanimator.VelInterpMode = nil
if not ok then
warn("[Velocity-Interpolated Reanimator] failed to start: " .. tostring(err))
pcall(Util.Notify, "Velocity-Interpolated Reanimator failed to start (see console): " .. tostring(err))
pcall(Reanimate.DestroyCharacter)
Reanimate.Starting = false
repeat task.wait() until Reanimate.Stopping
Reanimate.Stopping = false
end
end
end

HatReanimator.FlingTargets = {}
HatReanimator._TempNotFling = {}
HatReanimator.BuiltinFlingNames = {"Disabled (RP)", "Classic Respawn", "Biggest Hat", "All Hats", "Use Tool Handle"}
HatReanimator.PluginFlingMethods = {}
function HatReanimator.GetFlingNames()
local names = table.clone(HatReanimator.BuiltinFlingNames)
for _,fm in HatReanimator.PluginFlingMethods do
table.insert(names, fm.Name)
end
return names
end
function HatReanimator.RegisterFlingMethod(def, file)
if type(def) ~= "table" then error("fling method must return a table") end
if def.Name == nil and #def > 0 then
for _,d in ipairs(def) do HatReanimator.RegisterFlingMethod(d, file) end
return
end
if type(def.Name) ~= "string" or type(def.Run) ~= "function" then
error("fling method needs Name (string) and Run (function)")
end
table.insert(HatReanimator.PluginFlingMethods, {Name = def.Name, Run = def.Run, File = file})
end
function HatReanimator.ResolveSavedFling()
local saved = SaveData.Reanimator.HatsFlingMethodName
if type(saved) ~= "string" then return end
for i,fm in HatReanimator.PluginFlingMethods do
if fm.Name == saved then
HatReanimator.FlingMethod = 3 + i
SaveData.Reanimator.HatsFlingMethod = HatReanimator.FlingMethod
return
end
end
end
function HatReanimator.Fling(target, duration)
if HatReanimator.FlingMethod == -1 then return end
if not target then return false end
for _,v in HatReanimator.FlingTargets do
if v.Target == target then
return false
end
end
if target == Reanimate.Character then return false end
if target == Player.Character then return false end
if typeof(target) == "Instance" then
if HatReanimator._TempNotFling[target] then return end
HatReanimator._TempNotFling[target] = true
task.delay(1, function()
HatReanimator._TempNotFling[target] = nil
end)
end
table.insert(HatReanimator.FlingTargets, {
Target = target,
Duration = duration
})
if typeof(target) == "Instance" then
if target:IsA("Model") then
local h = Util.Instance("Highlight")
h.Adornee = target
h.FillColor = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
h.OutlineColor = Color3.new(1, 0, 0)
h.FillTransparency = 0.5
h.OutlineTransparency = 0
h.Parent = target
TweenService:Create(h, TweenInfo.new(5), {
FillTransparency = 1,
OutlineTransparency = 1
}):Play()
game.Debris:AddItem(h, 5)
end
end
return true
end

HatReanimator.LastForceRespawn = 0
function HatReanimator.ForceRespawn(reason, force)
local char = Player.Character
local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
HatReanimator.LastForceRespawn = os.clock()
HatReanimator.Status.Permadeath = reason or "Force respawn!"
if not hum then return false end
pcall(function()
hum.EvaluateStateMachine = true
hum.BreakJointsOnDeath = true
hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing, true)
hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, true)
hum.Health = 0
hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead)
end)
pcall(replicatesignal, hum.ServerBreakJoints)
pcall(function() char:BreakJoints() end)
return true
end
