function ToolReanimator.Fling(target, duration)
if not ToolReanimator.FlingEnabled then return end
return Util.Fling.Queue(ToolReanimator, target, duration)
end
local function ReceiveOwns(h) return h.ReceiveAge == 0 end
function ToolReanimator.FlingStep(claimed, owns, t)
owns = owns or ReceiveOwns
local q, ft, flingcf, pick = ToolReanimator.FlingTargets
if q[1] then
if ToolReanimator.FlingEnabled then
local area = 0
for _, c in claimed do
local h = c.Handle
local a = h.Size.X * h.Size.Y * h.Size.Z
if a > area and h:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and owns(h) then pick, area = c, a end
end
end
if pick then
ft, flingcf = Util.Fling.Step(q, t, Util.Fling.UseGlue() and Reanimate.PhysicsRepRootPartFling or 2)
else
table.clear(q)
end
end
local last = ToolReanimator.FlingPick
if last and not (ft and last == pick) then
pcall(sethiddenproperty, last.Handle, "PhysicsRepRootRef", nil)
last.Handle.CanCollide = ToolReanimator.Collide
end
if not ft then
ToolReanimator.FlingPick = nil
return nil
end
local h = pick.Handle
h.CanCollide, h.Massless = true, true
Util.Fling.ApplyRoot(h, ft, flingcf)
pcall(sethiddenproperty, h, "PhysicsRepRootRef", Util.Fling.UseGlue() and Util.PredictionFlingPart(ft.Target) or nil)
ToolReanimator.FlingPick = pick
return pick
end
function ToolReanimator.FlingReset()
table.clear(ToolReanimator.FlingTargets)
local p = ToolReanimator.FlingPick
ToolReanimator.FlingPick = nil
if p then pcall(sethiddenproperty, p.Handle, "PhysicsRepRootRef", nil) end
end
function ToolReanimator.ForceRespawn(reason, force)
ToolReanimator.Status.Permadeath = reason or "Force respawn!"
return HatReanimator.ForceRespawn(reason, force)
end
function ToolReanimator.StartAlt()
local Status = ToolReanimator.Status
local claimed, pending, Registry = {}, {}, {}
local Stopped, Busy = false, false
local HandledChar, ParkConn, BringConn = nil, nil, nil
local Handling = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local CharConns = {}
local nextretry, nextredrop, nextcommit = 0, {}, 0
local MAX_TRIES, MAX_CYCLES = 6, 3
local OWN_GRACE, OWN_TIMEOUT = 3, 8
-- OWN_CONFIRM: ownership must hold this long before a tool counts as claimed | REGRIP_GRACE: how long a re-attached grip is tolerated before demoting | REVIVE_AFTER/MAX_REVIVES: slow bounded second chances for tools marked failed | WAKE_GAP: min gap between ownership wake-ups
local OWN_CONFIRM, REGRIP_GRACE, REVIVE_AFTER, MAX_REVIVES, WAKE_GAP = 0.15, 0.3, 6, 3, 0.25
local PassError = nil
ToolReanimator.HasPermadeath = false
Status.Permadeath = "Not used by Corpse Claim"
-- Replication contract: tools are never reparented client-side to workspace (that left a local-only ghost copy while the server
--   destroyed its copy with the corpse, so only this client saw it). Tools stay inside the character, which is kept alive on the
--   server (pd, same as Original) when replicatesignal exists; handle joints are broken locally and on the server, so the
--   server-side handle is the same instance this client simulates and other players see it.
local Corpses = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local ClaimHum = nil
local function Detach(handle)
for _, j in handle:GetJoints() do
pcall(j.Destroy, j)
end
for _, v in handle:GetChildren() do
if v:IsA("JointInstance") then v:Destroy() end
if v:IsA("Constraint") then v.Enabled = false end
end
return #handle:GetJoints() == 0
end
local function GetTools()
local tools = {}
local char = Player.Character
local backpack = Player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
for _, container in {char or false, backpack or false} do
if container then
for _, v in container:GetChildren() do
local handle = v:IsA("Tool") and v:FindFirstChild("Handle")
if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") then
table.insert(tools, v)
end
end
end
end
return tools
end
-- "Free" = the handle is connected to nothing outside its own tool. Cached for 0.1s unless fresh is requested.
local function IsFree(c, fresh)
local now = os.clock()
if not fresh and c.FreeAt and now - c.FreeAt < 0.1 then return c.FreeVal end
local okp, parts = pcall(c.Handle.GetConnectedParts, c.Handle, true)
local free = okp
if okp then
for _, p in parts do
if p ~= c.Handle and not p:IsDescendantOf(c.Tool) then
free = false
break
end
end
end
c.FreeAt, c.FreeVal = now, free
return free
end
-- Local ownership only: the engine reports this client as the handle's simulator. Not server-authoritative.
local function Owns(handle)
if not handle.Parent then return false end
return handle.ReceiveAge == 0 and not handle:IsGrounded()
end
local function Valid(c)
return c.Tool:IsDescendantOf(game) and c.Handle:IsDescendantOf(game)
end
-- Server break bookkeeping. A local Detach / BreakJoints makes IsFree true at once while the server's grip weld may still exist (it is only really gone when its removal replicates back), so every break request is timestamped per tool and a tool only counts as detached after one network round trip since its last request.
local gapAt, gapVal = 0, 0.5
local function BreakGap()
local now = os.clock()
if now - gapAt > 1 then
gapAt = now
local ok, ping = pcall(Player.GetNetworkPing, Player)
gapVal = math.clamp((ok and tonumber(ping) or 0.1) * 2 + 0.2, 0.3, 1.2)
end
return gapVal
end
local function SendBreak(hum)
hum = hum or ClaimHum
if replicatesignal and hum and hum.Parent then
pcall(replicatesignal, hum.ServerBreakJoints)
return true
end
return false
end
local function Settled(c, now)
return not replicatesignal or not c.BreakAt or now - c.BreakAt >= BreakGap()
end
-- ask the engine to (re)assign this handle to us: throttled, never on a grounded assembly
local function Wake(c, now)
if now - (c.WakeAt or 0) < WAKE_GAP then return end
c.WakeAt = now
local h = c.Handle
if h.Parent and not h:IsGrounded() then pcall(sethiddenproperty, h, "NetworkIsSleeping", false) end
end
-- Detach is confirmed separately from ownership: the handle must be in the workspace and free of every outside joint.
local function Detached(c, fresh)
return c.Handle:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and IsFree(c, fresh)
end
-- Corpse detection/tracking: when a watched character dies, every registered tool still inside that body is dropped out of it
-- right away (before the body is removed on respawn) so the freed handles can be confirmed and tracked. Event driven, no polling.
local function WatchCorpse(character, hum)
if Corpses[character] then return end
Corpses[character] = true
table.insert(CharConns, hum.Died:Connect(function()
for _, list in {claimed, pending} do
for _, c in list do
if c.Tool.Parent == character then pcall(Detach, c.Handle) end
end
end
end))
end
local Holding, ParkRoot = false, nil
local function HasLivePending()
for _, c in pending do
if not c.Failed then return true end
end
return false
end
local function UpdateSummary()
local head = "[Corpse Claim, client-side] "
if #claimed + #pending == 0 then
ToolReanimator.Summary = head .. "No usable Tools found (a Tool needs a Handle part). Waiting..."
return
end
local lines = {head .. "Tools claimed: " .. #claimed .. "/" .. #LimbOrder .. (#pending > 0 and (", pending: " .. #pending) or "")}
for _, c in claimed do
table.insert(lines, c.Limb .. " <- " .. c.Tool.Name)
end
for _, c in pending do
local note
if c.Failed then
note = " (unconfirmed: " .. (c.FailReason or "no confirmation") .. ")"
elseif not c.Detached then
note = " (pending: waiting to detach)"
else
note = " (pending: waiting for local ownership)"
end
table.insert(lines, c.Limb .. " <- " .. c.Tool.Name .. note)
end
table.insert(lines, "Tools stay in the server-side body; others see them while this client owns them.")
ToolReanimator.Summary = table.concat(lines, "\n")
end
local function ResolveState()
if Busy or PassError then return end
if #claimed + #pending == 0 then return end
if #pending == 0 then
Status.ReanimState = "Done."
elseif #claimed > 0 then
Status.ReanimState = "Done (" .. #claimed .. " claimed, " .. #pending .. " still pending confirmation)."
elseif HasLivePending() then
Status.ReanimState = "Waiting for tool ownership (character stays at the claim spot)"
else
Status.ReanimState = "Unconfirmed: tools did not detach / this client never got ownership. Nothing is claimed (see the summary)."
end
end
local function NextLimb()
for _, limb in LimbOrder do
local used = false
for _, c in claimed do
if c.Limb == limb then used = true break end
end
if not used then
for _, c in pending do
if c.Limb == limb then used = true break end
end
end
if not used then return limb end
end
end
local function Forget(c)
Registry[c.Tool] = nil
nextredrop[c] = nil
end
local function PruneList(list)
for i = #list, 1, -1 do
local c = list[i]
local tool = c.Tool
local gone = not tool:IsDescendantOf(game)
if not gone and c.Handle.Parent ~= tool then
local h = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
if h and h:IsA("BasePart") then
c.Handle = h
c.Detached, c.Owned, c.FreeAt, c.DetachedAt = false, false, nil, nil
else
gone = true
end
end
if gone then
Forget(c)
table.remove(list, i)
end
end
end
local function Prune()
PruneList(claimed)
PruneList(pending)
end
-- Clears the hat-style drive state of a handle (claim timer, last position, glue, physical properties) so the next
-- claim starts clean and nothing stale is left on a handle we stop driving.
local function ResetDrive(c)
local h = c.Handle
pcall(function()
h:SetAttribute("_Uhhhhhh_ClaimTime", nil)
h:SetAttribute("_Uhhhhhh_LastPosition", nil)
h.CustomPhysicalProperties = c.OrigProps
h.Massless = c.OrigMassless == true
end)
c.RepRef, c.Aligned = nil, false
pcall(sethiddenproperty, h, "PhysicsRepRootRef", nil)
end
-- Promotion is the ONLY way a tool becomes claimed: detach AND local (engine-reported) ownership, both checked fresh.
local function Promote(c, i, now)
table.remove(pending, i)
table.insert(claimed, c)
c.Detached, c.Owned, c.Failed, c.FailReason = true, true, false, nil
c.Tries, c.OwnLostAt, c.DetachedAt, c.ClaimedAt, c.OwnSince, c.AttachedAt = 0, nil, nil, now, nil, nil
nextredrop[c] = nil
c.Handle.CanCollide = false
ResetDrive(c)
end
local function Demote(c, i, why)
table.remove(claimed, i)
table.insert(pending, c)
ResetDrive(c)
c.Detached, c.Owned, c.OwnLostAt, c.DetachedAt, c.Tries, c.OwnSince, c.AttachedAt = false, false, nil, nil, 0, nil, nil
c.Cycles += 1
nextredrop[c] = nil
if c.Cycles > MAX_CYCLES then
c.Failed, c.FailReason, c.FailedAt = true, why or "ownership keeps changing", os.clock()
end
end
local function Commit()
local now = os.clock()
for i = #pending, 1, -1 do
local c = pending[i]
if Valid(c) then
c.Detached = Detached(c, true) and Settled(c, now)
c.Owned = c.Detached and Owns(c.Handle)
c.OwnSince = c.Owned and (c.OwnSince or now) or nil
if c.Owned and now - c.OwnSince >= OWN_CONFIRM then
Promote(c, i, now)
else
if c.Detached then
c.DetachedAt = c.DetachedAt or now
if not c.Owned then Wake(c, now) end
if not c.Failed and now - c.DetachedAt > OWN_TIMEOUT then
c.Failed, c.FailReason, c.FailedAt = true, "detached but the engine never gave this client ownership", now
end
else
c.DetachedAt = nil
end
end
-- slow, bounded second chance for tools marked failed (a late server break or ownership hand-off can still make them usable)
if c.Failed and c.FailedAt and now - c.FailedAt > REVIVE_AFTER and (c.Revives or 0) < MAX_REVIVES then
c.Revives = (c.Revives or 0) + 1
c.Failed, c.FailReason, c.FailedAt, c.Tries, c.Cycles, c.DetachedAt = false, nil, nil, 0, 0, nil
nextredrop[c] = nil
end
else
Forget(c)
table.remove(pending, i)
end
end
end
-- Bounded retries with backoff: after MAX_TRIES the tool is marked failed (it stays pending and can still be promoted
-- later if ownership arrives, but it is no longer re-dropped).
-- the server may have moved the tool out of the body (unequip / respawn race): put it back so its grip can be broken again instead of re-dropping a tool that is not even in the character
local function EquipBack(c)
local char = Player.Character
local tool = c.Tool
if not (char and char:IsDescendantOf(workspace)) or tool.Parent == char or not tool:IsDescendantOf(game) then return end
pcall(function()
tool.Enabled = true
tool.RequiresHandle = false
tool.Parent = char
end)
end
local function DropTool(c, now, bounce)
if c.Failed or now < (nextredrop[c] or 0) then return end
if c.Tries >= MAX_TRIES then
c.Failed, c.FailReason, c.FailedAt = true, "still attached after " .. c.Tries .. " drops", now
return
end
c.Tries += 1
nextredrop[c] = now + math.max(math.min(0.5 * 2 ^ (c.Tries - 1), 4), BreakGap() + 0.2)
EquipBack(c)
-- the first try only asks the server (its removal replicating back is the real confirmation); retries, or no replicatesignal, also clear the grip locally
if c.Tries > 1 or not replicatesignal then pcall(Detach, c.Handle) end
c.BreakAt = now
SendBreak()
end
local function ClaimTools(char, list)
for _, tool in GetTools() do
local limb = NextLimb()
if not limb then break end
if not Registry[tool] then
local origRH, origEn = tool.RequiresHandle, tool.Enabled
pcall(function()
tool.Enabled = true
tool.RequiresHandle = false
tool.Parent = char
end)
local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
if tool.Parent == char and handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") then
local c = {
Tool = tool, Handle = handle, Limb = limb,
Detached = false, Owned = false, Failed = false,
Tries = 0, Cycles = 0,
OrigRH = origRH, OrigEnabled = origEn,
OrigCollide = handle.CanCollide, OrigTouch = handle.CanTouch, OrigMassless = handle.Massless,
OrigProps = handle.CustomPhysicalProperties,
}
Registry[tool] = c
table.insert(pending, c)
table.insert(list, c)
else
pcall(function()
tool.RequiresHandle = origRH
tool.Enabled = origEn
end)
end
end
end
return list
end
local function ParkPosition(RootPart)
local rp = ToolReanimator.RespawnPosition
local root = Reanimate.Character and Reanimate.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local pos = RootPart.Position
if rp == 0 then
local base = root and root.Position or pos
pos = Vector3.new(base.X, FallenPartsDestroyHeight + 12, base.Z)
elseif root and rp == 1 then
pos = root.CFrame * Vector3.new(0, 0, 6)
elseif root and rp == 4 then
pos = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, -16, 0)
end
return pos
end
local function ClaimPosition(RootPart)
local root = Reanimate.Character and Reanimate.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
return (root and root.Position or RootPart.Position) + Vector3.new(0, 25, 0)
end
local function Park(RootPart, claiming)
if ParkConn then ParkConn:Disconnect() end
local rp = ToolReanimator.RespawnPosition
local fixed = ParkPosition(RootPart)
if rp == 2 and Reanimate.Character and Reanimate.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
local dir = Vector3.new(math.random() * 2 - 1, math.random() * 2 - 1, math.random() * 2 - 1).Unit
if dir ~= dir or dir.Magnitude == 0 then dir = Vector3.yAxis end
fixed = Reanimate.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position + dir * math.random(8, 12)
end
local follow = rp == 0 or rp == 1 or rp == 4
ParkConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
if not RootPart:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return end
local p = claiming and ClaimPosition(RootPart) or (follow and ParkPosition(RootPart) or fixed)
RootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(p) * CFrame.Angles(math.pi / 2, 0, 0)
RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity, RootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
end)
end
-- Pending tools that are already free are pulled to the claim spot (only while we are the simulator).
BringConn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
if #pending == 0 then return end
local root = ParkRoot
if not (root and root:IsDescendantOf(workspace)) then return end
local p, now = ClaimPosition(root), os.clock()
for _, c in pending do
local h = c.Handle
if not c.Failed and (not c.Driven or now - c.Driven > 0.1) and h:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and h.ReceiveAge == 0 and IsFree(c) and Settled(c, now) then
h.CanCollide = false
h.CFrame = CFrame.new(p)
h.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, 67, 0)
h.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
end
end
end)
-- Hat-style handle driving: the same alignment routine HatReanimator uses for its handles (SetUACFrameNetless: claim-time
-- settle phase, netless velocity, speed limit, aligned flag, same _Uhhhhhh_* handle attributes), a per-handle mapping that
-- honours HatReanimator.HatCFrameOverride entries by tool Name, and the per-handle PhysicsRepRootRef from that mapping.
local function AlignHandle(handle, dt, newcf, tvel, fling, spin)
if dt <= 0 then return false end
if not (handle:IsA("BasePart") and handle:IsDescendantOf(workspace)) then return false end
local timing = os.clock()
local idlerv = Vector3.new(
math.sin(timing * 14), math.sin(timing * 15 + 1.0472), math.sin(timing * 16 + 2.0944)
)
local idleoff = idlerv * 0.001
local ylimit = FallenPartsDestroyHeight + 5
if newcf.Y < ylimit then
newcf += Vector3.new(0, ylimit - newcf.Y, 0)
end
local speedlimit = 16384
if fling then
speedlimit = math.huge
end
local netless = Reanimate.NetlessVelocity + (math.sin(timing * 0.5) + 1) / 2
local aligned = true
local lastcf = handle:GetAttribute("_Uhhhhhh_LastPosition")
local claimtime = handle:GetAttribute("_Uhhhhhh_ClaimTime")
if typeof(lastcf) ~= "CFrame" then lastcf = handle.CFrame end
if not handle:IsGrounded() and handle.ReceiveAge == 0 then
local newpos = newcf.Position
local lastpos = lastcf.Position
local vel = (newpos - lastpos) / dt
if vel.Magnitude < 0.12 then
newcf += idleoff
elseif vel.Magnitude > speedlimit then
vel = vel.Unit * speedlimit
newpos = lastpos + vel * dt
newcf = newcf.Rotation + newpos
aligned = false
end
local rvel = lastcf:ToObjectSpace(newcf)
local a, b = rvel:ToAxisAngle()
rvel = (a * b) / dt
lastcf = newcf
if claimtime then
if timing - claimtime < 5.67 then
handle.Massless = false
handle.CustomPhysicalProperties = nil
else
handle.Massless = true
handle.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(0.01, 0, 0, 0, 0)
end
if timing - claimtime < 0.51 then
handle.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, netless, 0)
else
if fling then
handle.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(16384, 16384, 16384)
else
if Reanimate.UsePatchmaLikeNetless then
vel = tvel
vel *= Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
if vel.Magnitude > netless then
vel = vel.Unit * netless
end
handle.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(vel.X * 10, netless, vel.Z * 10)
else
vel += tvel
vel *= Vector3.new(1, 0, 1)
if vel.Magnitude > netless then
vel = vel.Unit * netless
end
handle.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(vel.X, math.max(vel.Y, netless), vel.Z)
end
end
end
else
claimtime = timing
handle.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.new(0, netless * 2, 0)
end
handle.CFrame = newcf
if spin then
handle.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.new(16384, 16384, 16384)
else
if Reanimate.UseAngularVelocity then
handle.AssemblyAngularVelocity = rvel + idleoff
else
handle.AssemblyAngularVelocity = idleoff
end
end
else
claimtime = nil
lastcf = handle.CFrame
aligned = false
end
handle:SetAttribute("_Uhhhhhh_LastPosition", lastcf)
handle:SetAttribute("_Uhhhhhh_ClaimTime", claimtime)
return aligned
end
local function ResolveMap(c, now)
if c.Map and now - c.MapAt < 1 then return c.Map end
local map = {Limb = c.Limb}
for _, data in HatReanimator.HatCFrameOverride do
if not data.Disable and data.Name and not data.MeshId and not data.TextureId and not data.Group and not data.Index and data.Name == c.Tool.Name then
map = {
Limb = data.Limb or c.Limb,
C0 = data.C0, C1 = data.C1,
Offset = data.Offset or data.CFrame,
RepRootPart = data.RepRootPart,
}
break
end
end
c.Map, c.MapAt = map, now
return map
end
local function MappedCFrame(map, limb, scale)
if map.C0 and map.C1 then
return limb.CFrame * Util.ApplyAxis(Util.ScaleCFrame(map.C0, scale)) * Util.ScaleCFrame(map.C1, 1):Inverse(), limb.Velocity
end
if map.Offset then
return limb.CFrame * map.Offset, limb.Velocity
end
return limb.CFrame, limb.Velocity
end
local function SetRepRoot(c, part, now)
local want = nil
-- only a part that exists for everyone is a valid physics root: never the client-only reanimated rig, never our own handle, never something outside the workspace
if typeof(part) == "Instance" and part:IsA("BasePart") and part ~= c.Handle and part:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and not (Reanimate.Character and part:IsDescendantOf(Reanimate.Character)) and Util.Fling.UseGlue() then want = part end
if c.RepRef ~= want or c.RepRefAt == nil or (want ~= nil and now - c.RepRefAt > 0.5) or now - c.RepRefAt > 2 then
c.RepRef, c.RepRefAt = want, now
pcall(sethiddenproperty, c.Handle, "PhysicsRepRootRef", want)
end
end
local function ClaimPass(character, hum, RootPart, initial)
if Busy then return end
Busy, Holding, PassError = true, false, nil
local function alive()
return character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and not Stopped and not Reanimate.Stopping
end
Park(RootPart, true)
local list = {}
local ok, err = pcall(function()
repeat
if not alive() then return end
ClaimTools(character, list)
if #list == 0 then
if not initial then return end
task.wait(0.25)
end
until #list > 0
task.wait(0.25)
if not alive() then return end
ClaimTools(character, list)
do
Status.ReanimState = "Corpse Claim: arming " .. #list .. " tool(s)"
local armDeadline = os.clock() + 3
repeat
ClaimTools(character, list)
local ready = 0
for _, c in list do
if not Valid(c) then
ready += 1
else
if c.Tool.Parent ~= character then
pcall(function() c.Tool.Parent = character end)
end
c.Handle.CanTouch = false
if c.Tool.Parent == character and not IsFree(c, true) then ready += 1 end
end
end
if ready < #list then task.wait(0.1) end
until ready >= #list or os.clock() > armDeadline or not alive()
if not alive() then return end
Status.ReanimState = "Corpse Claim: detaching tools (client death + server joint break)"
do
local sent = os.clock()
SendBreak(hum)
-- the first server break is the real detach: the first retry waits a round trip, and tool grips are left alone locally until then
for _, c in list do
c.BreakAt, c.Tries = sent, math.max(c.Tries, 1)
nextredrop[c] = sent + BreakGap() + 0.2
end
end
pcall(function()
hum.EvaluateStateMachine = true
hum.BreakJointsOnDeath = true
if replicatesignal then
-- break the body locally but leave tool grips for the server break to remove (destroying them locally would make a handle look free while the server still welds it)
for _, j in character:GetDescendants() do
if j:IsA("JointInstance") then
local p0, p1 = j.Part0, j.Part1
if not ((p0 and p0:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Tool")) or (p1 and p1:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Tool"))) then pcall(j.Destroy, j) end
end
end
hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing, true)
hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, false)
hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Climbing)
Status.Permadeath = "Body kept alive on the server (tools stay replicated)."
else
hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, true)
hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead)
end
end)
Status.ReanimState = "Corpse Claim: waiting for the tools to detach"
local deadline = os.clock() + 6
local left
repeat
left = 0
local now = os.clock()
for _, c in list do
if Valid(c) then
c.Handle.CanTouch = false
if not Detached(c, true) then
DropTool(c, now, c.Tool.Parent == workspace)
if not c.Failed then left += 1 end
elseif not Settled(c, now) then
left += 1
end
end
end
if left > 0 then RunService.Heartbeat:Wait() end
until left == 0 or os.clock() > deadline or not alive()
end
Commit()
Status.ReanimState = "Waiting for local ownership confirmation"
local ownDeadline = os.clock() + 4
local waiting
repeat
task.wait(0.1)
Commit()
waiting = 0
for _, c in list do
if not c.Owned and not c.Failed and Valid(c) then waiting += 1 end
end
until waiting == 0 or os.clock() > ownDeadline or not alive()
end)
Commit()
Busy = false
Holding = HasLivePending()
if alive() then
Park(RootPart, Holding)
end
if ok then
ResolveState()
else
PassError = tostring(err)
Status.ReanimState = "Error: " .. PassError
end
end
local function ClearAll()
for _, c in claimed do Forget(c) end
for _, c in pending do Forget(c) end
table.clear(claimed)
table.clear(pending)
Holding = false
end
local function OnCharacter(character)
if Stopped or HandledChar == character or Handling[character] then return end
Handling[character] = true
Status.ReanimState = "Respawned."
local hum = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
if not hum then Handling[character] = nil return end
ClaimHum = hum
WatchCorpse(character, hum)
if not Reanimate.UseLoadAnimationHook then
local stupid = character:FindFirstChild("Animate")
if stupid then stupid:Destroy() end
table.insert(CharConns, character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(v)
if v:IsA("LocalScript") then
v.Disabled = true
task.defer(function() v:Destroy() end)
end
end))
end
local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
if animator then animator:Destroy() end
local RootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
if not RootPart then Handling[character] = nil return end
ParkRoot = RootPart
for _, v in character:GetDescendants() do
if v:IsA("BasePart") then v.CanTouch = false end
end
pcall(function() hum.EvaluateStateMachine = false end)
pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics) end)
while Busy and not Stopped and character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) do task.wait(0.1) end
if Stopped or not character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then Handling[character] = nil return end
HandledChar = character
Prune()
if #claimed > 0 or HasLivePending() then
-- previously claimed / still-pending tool state survives the respawn
Holding = HasLivePending()
Park(RootPart, Holding)
ResolveState()
Status.ReanimState = "Respawned. " .. Status.ReanimState
return
end
-- nothing claimed and nothing still worth waiting for: forget the failed leftovers and run a fresh claim pass
for _, c in pending do Forget(c) end
table.clear(pending)
ClaimPass(character, hum, RootPart, true)
end
table.insert(CharConns, Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c) task.spawn(OnCharacter, c) end))
local InitCFrame = nil
local startChar = Player.Character
do
local h = startChar and startChar:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if h and h.RootPart then InitCFrame = h.RootPart.CFrame end
end
Reanimate.CreateCharacter(InitCFrame)
Reanimate.Starting = false
if startChar and startChar:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
task.spawn(OnCharacter, startChar)
end
local nextsummary, stuckSince = 0, nil
while not Reanimate.Stopping do
RunService.PreSimulation:Wait()
if workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight == workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight then
workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = 0/0
end
if Util.FX.SimDue() then
pcall(function() Player.SimulationRadius = #Players:GetPlayers() * 1000 end)
pcall(sethiddenproperty, Player, "SimulationRadius", #Players:GetPlayers() * 1000)
end
local Character = Player.Character
local ReanimCharacter = Reanimate.Character
local ltm = Reanimate.LocalTransparencyModifier
if Character and Character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
if Character ~= HandledChar and os.clock() > nextretry then
nextretry = os.clock() + 2
task.spawn(OnCharacter, Character)
end
local hum = Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
local rchum = ReanimCharacter and ReanimCharacter:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
local subject = rchum or hum
if Camera and subject and Camera.CameraSubject ~= subject then
Camera.CameraSubject = subject
end
for _, v in Character:GetChildren() do
if v:IsA("BasePart") then
if v.CanCollide then v.CanCollide = false end
if v.CanTouch then v.CanTouch = false end
if v.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= ltm then v.LocalTransparencyModifier = ltm end
end
end
end
Prune()
local usable = 0
for _, c in claimed do
if Owns(c.Handle) then usable += 1 end
end
if ToolReanimator.AutoForceRespawn and not Busy and #claimed + #pending > 0 and usable == 0 then
local now = os.clock()
stuckSince = stuckSince or now
if now - stuckSince > ToolReanimator.StuckTimeout and now - HatReanimator.LastForceRespawn > 5 then
stuckSince = nil
ClearAll()
ToolReanimator.ForceRespawn("No usable tool for " .. ToolReanimator.StuckTimeout .. "s. Force respawning!")
end
else
stuckSince = nil
end
local dt = RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
local t = os.clock()
if ReanimCharacter and dt > 0 then
local scale = ReanimCharacter:GetScale()
local flung = ToolReanimator.FlingStep(claimed, Owns, t)
for i = #claimed, 1, -1 do
local c = claimed[i]
local handle = c.Handle
if c == flung then
c.RepRef = false
elseif not Valid(c) then
-- removed by Prune next frame
elseif not Detached(c) then
-- grip came back / tool left the workspace: never driven while attached, back to pending (bounded) only if it stays attached past REGRIP_GRACE
c.AttachedAt = c.AttachedAt or t
if t - c.AttachedAt > REGRIP_GRACE then Demote(c, i, "tool keeps getting re-attached") end
elseif not Owns(handle) then
-- delayed replication / ownership change: stop driving, wake the handle (throttled), give it a grace period, then re-confirm from pending
c.AttachedAt = nil
c.OwnLostAt = c.OwnLostAt or t
Wake(c, t)
if t - c.OwnLostAt > OWN_GRACE then Demote(c, i, "ownership lost") end
else
c.OwnLostAt, c.AttachedAt = nil, nil
if c.ClaimedAt and c.Cycles > 0 and t - c.ClaimedAt > 30 then c.Cycles = 0 end
local map = ResolveMap(c, t)
local limb = c.LimbPart
if not limb or limb.Parent ~= ReanimCharacter or limb.Name ~= map.Limb then
limb = ReanimCharacter:FindFirstChild(map.Limb)
c.LimbPart = limb
end
local lltm = ltm
if Reanimate.FirstPersonBody and map.Limb ~= "Head" then lltm = 0 end
if handle.CanCollide ~= ToolReanimator.Collide then handle.CanCollide = ToolReanimator.Collide end
if handle.CanTouch then handle.CanTouch = false end
if handle.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= lltm then handle.LocalTransparencyModifier = lltm end
if limb and limb:IsA("BasePart") then
local tcf, tvel = MappedCFrame(map, limb, scale)
c.Aligned = AlignHandle(handle, dt, tcf, tvel, false, false)
c.Driven = t
SetRepRoot(c, map.RepRootPart, t)
end
end
end
if not Busy and #pending > 0 and t > nextcommit then
nextcommit = t + 0.1
Commit()
for _, c in pending do
if not c.Failed and not c.Detached and Valid(c) then
DropTool(c, t, c.Tool.Parent == workspace)
end
end
end
if t > nextsummary then
nextsummary = t + 0.5
local live = HasLivePending()
if not Busy and ParkRoot and live ~= Holding then
Holding = live
Park(ParkRoot, Holding)
end
UpdateSummary()
ResolveState()
end
end
RunService.PreRender:Wait()
if Reanimate.Character and Reanimate:ShouldRotationType() then
Reanimate:CameraLockCharacter()
end
end
Stopped = true
if BringConn then BringConn:Disconnect() BringConn = nil end
if ParkConn then ParkConn:Disconnect() ParkConn = nil end
for _, conn in CharConns do conn:Disconnect() end
table.clear(CharConns)
local Character = Player.Character
local hum = Character and Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
local rroot = Reanimate.Character and Reanimate.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local ReturnCFrame = rroot and rroot.CFrame
for _, v in (Character and Character:GetDescendants() or {}) do
if v:IsA("BasePart") then
v.CanTouch = true
v.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
end
end
local backpack = Player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
local function RestoreTool(c)
if c.Tool.Parent and c.Handle.Parent then
local h = c.Handle
ResetDrive(c)
pcall(function()
h.CanTouch = c.OrigTouch ~= false
h.CanCollide = c.OrigCollide ~= false
h.Massless = c.OrigMassless == true
h.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
h.AssemblyLinearVelocity, h.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
c.Tool.RequiresHandle = c.OrigRH ~= false
c.Tool.Enabled = c.OrigEnabled ~= false
end)
if ReturnCFrame then pcall(function() h.CFrame = ReturnCFrame end) end
pcall(function() c.Tool.Parent = backpack or Character end)
end
end
ToolReanimator.FlingReset()
for _, c in claimed do RestoreTool(c) end
for _, c in pending do RestoreTool(c) end
if hum and hum.Parent then
pcall(function() hum.EvaluateStateMachine = true end)
pcall(function() hum:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, true) end)
if hum.Health > 0 then
local hrp = hum.RootPart
if hrp and ReturnCFrame then
hrp.CFrame = ReturnCFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)
hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity, hrp.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
end
pcall(function() hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.GettingUp) end)
end
pcall(function() if Camera then Camera.CameraSubject = hum end end)
end
ClearAll()
table.clear(nextredrop)
ToolReanimator.HasPermadeath = false
ToolReanimator.Summary = "(no tools claimed yet...)"
Status.Permadeath = "(no status)"
Status.ReanimState = "(no status)"
Reanimate.Stopping = false
Reanimate.DestroyCharacter()
end
function ToolReanimator.Start()
if ToolReanimator.Method ~= 1 then return ToolReanimator.StartAlt() end
local Status = ToolReanimator.Status
local claimed = {}
local CurrentCharacter, HandledChar, Humanoid = nil, nil, nil
local Stopped = false
local nextretry = 0
local function GetTools()
local tools = {}
local char = Player.Character
local backpack = Player:FindFirstChildOfClass("Backpack")
for _, container in {char or false, backpack or false} do
if container then
for _, v in container:GetChildren() do
local handle = v:IsA("Tool") and v:FindFirstChild("Handle")
if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") then
table.insert(tools, v)
end
end
end
end
return tools
end
local function UpdateSummary()
if #claimed == 0 then
ToolReanimator.Summary = "No usable Tools found (a Tool needs a Handle part). Waiting..."
return
end
local lines = {"Tools claimed: " .. #claimed .. "/" .. #LimbOrder}
for _, c in claimed do
local owned = c.Handle.Parent and c.Handle.ReceiveAge == 0
table.insert(lines, c.Limb .. " <- " .. c.Tool.Name .. (owned and "" or " (not owned)"))
end
ToolReanimator.Summary = table.concat(lines, "\n")
end
local function ClaimTools(char)
local list = {}
for _, tool in GetTools() do
if #list >= #LimbOrder then break end
pcall(function()
tool.Enabled = true
tool.RequiresHandle = false
tool.Parent = char
end)
local handle = tool:FindFirstChild("Handle")
if tool.Parent == char and handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") then
table.insert(list, {Tool = tool, Handle = handle, Limb = LimbOrder[#list + 1]})
end
end
return list
end
local function Detach(handle)
for _, j in handle:GetJoints() do
pcall(j.Destroy, j)
end
for _, v in handle:GetChildren() do
if v:IsA("JointInstance") then v:Destroy() end
if v:IsA("Constraint") then v.Enabled = false end
end
return #handle:GetJoints() == 0
end
local function OnCharacter(character)
if Stopped or HandledChar == character then return end
HandledChar = character
table.clear(claimed)
CurrentCharacter = nil
Status.ReanimState = "Respawned."
Status.Permadeath = "Respawn detected."
local perma = ToolReanimator.Permadeath
if not replicatesignal then perma = false end
ToolReanimator.HasPermadeath = perma
local hum = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 10)
if not hum then return end
Humanoid = hum
if not Reanimate.UseLoadAnimationHook then
local stupid = character:FindFirstChild("Animate")
if stupid then
stupid:Destroy()
end
character.ChildAdded:Connect(function(v)
if v:IsA("LocalScript") then
v.Disabled = true
task.defer(function()
v:Destroy()
end)
end
end)
end
local animator = hum:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator")
if animator then
animator:Destroy()
end
local RootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", 10)
if not RootPart then return end
local RootPosition = Vector3.new(RootPart.Position.X, FallenPartsDestroyHeight, RootPart.Position.Z)
local ReanimCharacter = Reanimate.Character
local root = ReanimCharacter and ReanimCharacter:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if root then
RootPosition = Vector3.new(root.Position.X, FallenPartsDestroyHeight, root.Position.Z)
end
if not perma then
RootPosition += Vector3.new(0, 12, 0)
if root then
if ToolReanimator.RespawnPosition == 1 then
RootPosition = root.CFrame * Vector3.new(0, 0, 6)
end
if ToolReanimator.RespawnPosition == 2 then
local dir = Vector3.new(math.random() * 2 - 1, math.random() * 2 - 1, math.random() * 2 - 1).Unit
if dir ~= dir or dir.Magnitude == 0 then
dir = Vector3.yAxis
end
RootPosition = root.Position + dir * math.random(8, 12)
end
if ToolReanimator.RespawnPosition == 4 then
RootPosition = root.Position + Vector3.new(0, -16, 0)
end
end
if ToolReanimator.RespawnPosition == 3 then
RootPosition = RootPart.Position
end
if ToolReanimator.RespawnPosition == 4 and not root then
RootPosition = RootPart.Position
end
end
local function alive()
return character:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and not Stopped and not Reanimate.Stopping
end
Status.Permadeath = perma and "Waiting for tools." or "Disabled, nothing to do."
local bringconns = {}
local lgloop = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
RootPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(RootPosition) * CFrame.Angles(math.pi / 2, 0, 0)
RootPart.AssemblyLinearVelocity, RootPart.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero, Vector3.zero
end)
local ok, err = pcall(function()
if perma then task.wait(1) end
local list = {}
repeat
if not alive() then return end
list = ClaimTools(character)
if #list == 0 then task.wait(0.25) end
until #list > 0

if not alive() then return end
if not detached then
ToolReanimator.ForceRespawn("Tools stayed attached to the body. Force respawning!")
return
end
for _, b in bringconns do b:Disconnect() end
table.clear(bringconns)
for _, c in list do table.insert(claimed, c) end
CurrentCharacter = character
Status.ReanimState = "Done."
if perma then task.wait(1) end
end)
lgloop:Disconnect()
for _, b in bringconns do b:Disconnect() end
if not ok then
Status.ReanimState = "Error: " .. tostring(err)
end
end

Util.AltDirectFling = function(target)
local ch = Player.Character
local root = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local hum = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if not (root and hum and hum.Health > 0 and root:IsDescendantOf(workspace)) then
return false, "no character to fling with"
end
if not Util.Fling.Queue(Direct, target) then
return false, "fling engine rejected the target (dead / already flinging / invalid)"
end
if Direct.Busy then return true end
Direct.Busy = true
task.spawn(function()
local q, home = Direct.FlingTargets, nil
pcall(function()
while q[1] do
RunService.PreSimulation:Wait()
local c = Player.Character
local r = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local h = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

table.clear(q)
break
end
local ft, flingcf = Util.Fling.Step(q, os.clock(), Util.Fling.UseGlue() and Reanimate.PhysicsRepRootPartFling or 2)
if ft then
home = home or r.CFrame
r.CanCollide = true
Util.Fling.ApplyRoot(r, ft, flingcf)
pcall(sethiddenproperty, r, "PhysicsRepRootRef", Util.Fling.UseGlue() and Util.PredictionFlingPart(ft.Target) or nil)
Util.Fling.ApplyHumanoid(h, ft, 0)
end
end
end)
table.clear(q)
pcall(directStop, home)
Direct.Busy = false
end)
return true
end
end

do
local RS = SaveData.Reanimator
do
local poseCache = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
-- ===== shared root identity / limb pose guard (every limb reanimation method goes through it) =====
-- The REAL character's root is its HumanoidRootPart: never a Torso / UpperTorso / LowerTorso and never a part of the fake (reanimator) character.
function Reanimate.IsRealRoot(p, fake)
if typeof(p) ~= "Instance" or not p:IsA("BasePart") then return false end
local n = p.Name
if n == "Torso" or n == "UpperTorso" or n == "LowerTorso" then return false end
if fake and p:IsDescendantOf(fake) then return false end
return true
end
function Reanimate.ResolveRealRoot(character, humanoid, fake)
fake = fake or Reanimate.Character
local hrp = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
if hrp and Reanimate.IsRealRoot(hrp, fake) then return hrp end
local rp = humanoid and humanoid.RootPart
if rp and Reanimate.IsRealRoot(rp, fake) then return rp end
return nil
end
function Reanimate.FiniteCF(cf)
if typeof(cf) ~= "CFrame" then return false end
local x, y, z, a, b, c, d, e, f, g, h, i = cf:GetComponents()
return math.abs(x) < 1e9 and math.abs(y) < 1e9 and math.abs(z) < 1e9 and math.abs(a) <= 1.01 and math.abs(b) <= 1.01 and math.abs(c) <= 1.01 and math.abs(d) <= 1.01 and math.abs(e) <= 1.01 and math.abs(f) <= 1.01 and math.abs(g) <= 1.01 and math.abs(h) <= 1.01 and math.abs(i) <= 1.01
end
-- RootPart Velocity "Follow Character": a collision / teleport spike of the fake character's root must never be replicated as an extreme velocity (remote clients would extrapolate the whole body with it)
function Reanimate.ClampRootVelocity(vel)
local m = vel.Magnitude
if m ~= m then return Vector3.zero end
if m > 1500 then return vel * (1500 / m) end
return vel
end
-- world pose of the fake Torso rebuilt from the fake HumanoidRootPart and its own RootJoint (HumanoidRootPart * C0 * Transform * C1^-1), never read back from the Torso part: nothing that displaces the Torso (limb joints, welds, physics) can feed into a root target derived from it
Reanimate._RootJointCache = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
function Reanimate.StableTorsoRel(rcRoot, rcTorso)
local j = Reanimate._RootJointCache[rcRoot]
if not (j and j.Parent and j.Part0 == rcRoot and j.Part1 == rcTorso) then
j = nil
for _, holder in {rcRoot, rcTorso} do
for _, c in holder:GetChildren() do
if c:IsA("Motor6D") and c.Part0 == rcRoot and c.Part1 == rcTorso then
j = c
break
end
end
if j then break end
end
Reanimate._RootJointCache[rcRoot] = j
end
if j and j.Enabled then
local rel = j.C0 * j.Transform * j.C1:Inverse()
if Reanimate.FiniteCF(rel) then return rel end
end
return rcRoot.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(rcTorso.CFrame)
end
-- rel = the root -> torso relation of the SAME simulation frame as the limb / neck joint samples (StableTorsoRel at Heartbeat). Passing it keeps the torso on that frame's RootJoint pose when only the fake root yaw changed afterwards (camera lock), instead of re-reading a RootJoint that may already belong to a newer animation frame than the held limb poses
function Reanimate.StableTorsoCFrame(rcRoot, rcTorso, rel)
local cf = rcRoot.CFrame * (rel or Reanimate.StableTorsoRel(rcRoot, rcTorso))
if Reanimate.FiniteCF(cf) then return cf end
return rcTorso.CFrame
end
-- limb pose guard: a non-finite pose never reaches a Motor6D (the last valid one is held), and a limb joint (neck / shoulder / hip) stays anchored to its parent, so a glitched pose can no longer throw a limb away from its pivot. Stateless (no extra smoothing), so it never fights an interpolating method. The root joint (HumanoidRootPart -> Torso) and hidden limbs are never modified here.
function Reanimate.SanitizeLimbPose(map, v, cf, exact)
if cf == CFrame.identity then return cf end
local hl = Reanimate.HiddenLimbs
if hl and hl[map.RPart1] and (map.RPart0 == "ROOT" or not hl[map.RPart0]) then return cf end
if not Reanimate.FiniteCF(cf) then
return map.SaneCF or (v and v.C0 * v.C1:Inverse()) or CFrame.identity
end
-- exact: the pose was sampled straight from the animated joint (RootPart is Torso), it is the animation's own transform and is not corrected
if not exact and map.RPart0 ~= "ROOT" and v then
local c0, c1 = v.C0, v.C1
local tr = c0:Inverse() * cf * c1
local p = tr.Position
local m = p.Magnitude
local lim = (c0.Position.Magnitude + c1.Position.Magnitude) * 1.25 + 0.5
if m > lim then
cf = c0 * (CFrame.new(p * (lim / m)) * tr.Rotation) * c1:Inverse()
end
end
map.SaneCF = cf
return cf
end
function Reanimate.SafeLimbPose(map, v, RC, RootPart, tcf)
local cf, exact = Reanimate.LimbPoseCFrame(map, v, RC, RootPart, tcf)
cf = Reanimate.SanitizeLimbPose(map, v, cf, exact)
local LB = Util.LimbBlocks -- Building Limb Blocks: offsets are layered on the finished pose (Limb Reanimator only, only while Building Mode is on)
if LB then
local okLB, ncf = pcall(LB.LimbPose, map, v, RC, RootPart, tcf, cf)
if okLB and typeof(ncf) == "CFrame" then return ncf end
end
return cf
end
-- tcf (RootPart is Torso only) = the fake torso world CFrame rebuilt from the fake HumanoidRootPart * RootJoint. With it the pose is read from the animated joints: the torso joint is the real root -> tcf relation and every limb / neck joint is its own Motor6D (C0 * Transform * C1^-1) relative to its anatomical parent, so no torso, root or limb movement is inherited twice and no physics-displaced part CFrame feeds back. Returns (pose, true) when sampled this way
function Reanimate.LimbPoseCFrame(map, v, RC, RootPart, tcf)
local hl = Reanimate.HiddenLimbs
if hl and hl[map.RPart1] and (map.RPart0 == "ROOT" or not hl[map.RPart0]) then return CFrame.new(0, -250, 0) end
local e = poseCache[map]
if not e or e.RC ~= RC then
e = {RC = RC}
poseCache[map] = e
end
local n0, n1 = map.RPart0, map.RPart1
local p0
if n0 == "ROOT" then
p0 = RootPart
if not Reanimate.IsRealRoot(p0, RC) then p0 = Reanimate.ResolveRealRoot(Player.Character, nil, RC) end
else
p0 = e.p0
if not p0 or p0.Parent ~= RC or p0.Name ~= n0 then
p0 = RC:FindFirstChild(n0)
e.p0 = p0
end
end
local p1 = e.p1
if not p1 or p1.Parent ~= RC or p1.Name ~= n1 then
p1 = RC:FindFirstChild(n1)
e.p1 = p1
end
if not (p0 and p1) then return CFrame.identity end
local rel, auth
if tcf then
if n0 == "ROOT" then
if n1 == "Torso" then rel, auth = p0.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(tcf), true end
else
local j = e.j
if not (j and j.Parent and j.Part0 == p0 and j.Part1 == p1) and (j or e.jp0 ~= p0 or e.jp1 ~= p1) then
e.jp0, e.jp1, j = p0, p1, nil
for _, c in p0:GetChildren() do
if c:IsA("Motor6D") and c.Part0 == p0 and c.Part1 == p1 then
j = c
break
end
end
e.j = j
end
if j and j.Enabled then rel, auth = j.C0 * j.Transform * j.C1:Inverse(), true end
end
end
local t = map.Type
if t == 1 then
if rel then return rel, auth end
return p0.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(p1.CFrame)
elseif t == 2 then
local mc0, mc1 = map.C0, map.C1
if e.c0Src ~= mc0 then
e.c0Src, e.c0 = mc0, CFrame.new(mc0)
e.c0i = e.c0:Inverse()
end
if e.c1Src ~= mc1 then
e.c1Src, e.c1 = mc1, CFrame.new(mc1)
end
local transform
if rel then
transform = e.c0i * rel * e.c1
else
transform = (p0.CFrame * e.c0):ToObjectSpace(p1.CFrame * e.c1)
end
local offset = map.Offset
if offset then
if e.offSrc ~= offset then
e.offSrc, e.offInv = offset, offset:Inverse()
end
transform = offset * transform * e.offInv
end
local vc1 = v.C1
if e.vc1Src ~= vc1 then
e.vc1Src, e.vc1Inv = vc1, vc1:Inverse()
end
return v.C0 * transform * e.vc1Inv, auth
end
return CFrame.identity
end
end
end
-- ===== Unanchored Reanimation (separate method: no tools, hats, reset or respawn) =====
do
local U = {Name = "Unanchored", HiderKey = "Unanchored"}
Reanimate.UnanchoredReanimator = U
local C
do
local SD = SaveData.Reanimator
if type(SD.Unanchored) ~= "table" then SD.Unanchored = {} end
C = SD.Unanchored
end
if C.Wings == nil then C.Wings = true end
if C.Tail == nil then C.Tail = true end
if C.Halo == nil then C.Halo = true end
if C.AutoSearch == nil then C.AutoSearch = true end
if C.Confirm == nil then C.Confirm = true end
if C.Extra == nil then C.Extra = false end
if C.Tools == nil then C.Tools = true end
if C.Limbs == nil then C.Limbs = false end
C.TorsoOffset = (C.TorsoOffset == 2 or C.TorsoOffset == 3) and C.TorsoOffset or 1
C.WingAnim = C.WingAnim == 2 and 2 or 1
C.TailAnim = C.TailAnim == 2 and 2 or 1
C.Radius = math.clamp(tonumber(C.Radius) or 150, 20, 500)
U.Want = {Wings = 20, Tail = 6, Halo = 8, Limbs = 6}
U.Label = {Wings = "Wings", Tail = "Tail", Halo = "Halo Aura", Limbs = "Limb"}
U.Feats = {"Wings", "Tail", "Halo", "Limbs"}
-- Limbs only exist during an unanchored limb run; Wings / Tail / Halo go through the existing tool-style handling, which "Use unanchored parts as tools" switches (plain Extra mode inside the Limb / Ragdoll reanimator is not affected by it)
function U.On(S, f)
if f == "Limbs" then return S.LimbRun == true and C.Limbs == true end
if (S.LimbRun or not S.Extra) and C.Tools == false then return false end
return C[f] and true or false
end
-- limb slots on the fake character, filled in this order (the Torso slot is last so the real torso keeps carrying the real limbs until every other limb is replaced)
U.Slots = {"Left Arm", "Right Arm", "Left Leg", "Right Leg", "Head", "Torso"}
function U.NextSlot(S)
local used = {}
for _, r in S.G.Limbs do
if r.Slot then used[r.Slot] = true end
end
for _, sl in U.Slots do
if not used[sl] then return sl end
end
return nil
end
-- real limbs are only hidden while the unanchored part that replaces them is owned, attached AND settled in its slot (rec.Ready); after a real ownership loss the real limb is shown again once U.HideHold has passed
function U.Hidden(S)
local h = {}
local hnow = os.clock()
for _, rec in S.G.Limbs do
if rec.Slot and rec.Ready and rec.Held and not rec.Dead and (rec.Owned or (rec.LostAt and hnow - rec.LostAt < U.HideHold)) then h[rec.Slot] = true end
end
-- an equipped real Tool is welded to the real Right Arm: that arm stays where it is so the Tool and its Handle are never moved away
local hch = Player.Character
if hch and hch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool") then h["Right Arm"] = nil end
if h.Torso and not (h["Left Arm"] and h["Right Arm"] and h["Left Leg"] and h["Right Leg"] and h.Head) then h.Torso = nil end
Reanimate.HiddenLimbs = h
end
U.Near, U.Hot, U.OwnWait = 45, 0.7, 10
-- U.OwnConfirm = ReceiveAge 0 must hold this long before a part is touched, U.RecoverWait = how long a previously live part may stay without ownership before it is released, U.Drift = studs of unexpected displacement that re-bases the smoothing
U.OwnConfirm, U.RecoverWait, U.Drift = 0.35, 25, 10
-- OwnGrace = how long ReceiveAge may flicker away from 0 before an owned part counts as lost (the controller stays enabled through blips so nothing drops), MaxPend = parts that may wait for their first ownership confirmation at once
U.OwnGrace, U.MaxPend = 1.5, 5
-- ConfirmBlip = longest ReceiveAge flicker that does not restart the OwnConfirm run of a part that is not confirmed yet, RecoverConfirm = ReceiveAge 0 run needed to re-accept a part that was live before, Prove = how long a part must hold ownership after (re)acceptance before it counts as controllable,
-- Settle = studs from its slot target at which a part counts as in place, HideHold = how long the real limb stays hidden after ownership of its replacement was lost, ProbeWait = how long a limb part that never settled may wait for ownership before its slot is given to another candidate
U.ConfirmBlip, U.RecoverConfirm, U.Prove, U.Settle, U.HideHold, U.ProbeWait = 0.12, 0.1, 0.6, 5, 1.2, 8
-- Top = candidates examined per selection pass, ReserveTTL = longest a reservation may wait for the character to come within reach (the ownership clock then takes over), PromptMin = closest distance still worth a teleport prompt
U.Top, U.ReserveTTL, U.PromptMin = 8, 20, 12
-- attachment tuning: PosResp / RotResp = AlignPosition / AlignOrientation responsiveness, MaxVel / MaxAng = speed caps (studs/s, rad/s), ForceK / TorqueK = finite force / torque caps per unit of assembly mass (x gravity, x length^2)
U.PosResp, U.RotResp, U.MaxVel, U.MaxAng, U.ForceK, U.TorqueK = 120, 90, 300, 40, 40, 1200

-- same convention as the Hats/Tools reanimators: only a part that exists for everyone, never the client-only rig
function U.RepRef(p)
if typeof(p) ~= "Instance" or not p:IsA("BasePart") or not p:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return nil end
local rc = Reanimate.Character
if rc and p:IsDescendantOf(rc) then return nil end
return p
end
function U.Note(text)
pcall(Util.UINotify, text)
end
function U.Sm(x) return x * x * (3 - 2 * x) end
function U.Fit(x, lo, hi, ideal)
if x < lo or x > hi then return 0 end
return 1 - 0.8 * math.abs(x - ideal) / math.max(ideal - lo, hi - ideal)
end
function U.Score(s, f)
local mx = math.max(s.X, s.Y, s.Z)
local mn = math.max(math.min(s.X, s.Y, s.Z), 0.05)
if f == "Wings" then
return U.Fit(mx, 1.2, 16, 5) * 0.6 + math.clamp(mx / mn / 4, 0, 1) * 0.4
elseif f == "Tail" then
return U.Fit(mx, 0.8, 12, 3) * 0.7 + math.clamp(mx / mn / 3, 0, 1) * 0.3
elseif f == "Limbs" then
return U.Fit(mx, 0.8, 8, 3) * 0.7 + math.clamp(mx / mn / 2, 0, 1) * 0.3
end
return U.Fit(mx, 0.4, 6, 1.5) * 0.7 + math.clamp(mn / mx, 0, 1) * 0.3
end
-- detector tuning: U.Min = minimum fit to count as suitable, U.Slack = discovery reach beyond Search Radius (existing candidates get 25% more before they drop),
-- U.NearQ = radius of the frequent near pass, U.MinLen / U.MaxLen = part size window, U.MaxAsm = max parts in a free assembly, U.Stale = candidate re-rate interval
U.Min, U.Slack, U.NearQ, U.MinLen, U.MaxLen, U.MaxAsm, U.Stale = 0.45, 1.2, 70, 0.05, 150, 64, 1.5
U.PS = game:GetService("PhysicsService")
function U.Why(p, f, sc)
local s = p.Size
return ("%.1f x %.1f x %.1f studs, %d%% fit for %s, unanchored and free to simulate"):format(s.X, s.Y, s.Z, math.floor(sc * 100), U.Label[f])
end
-- Stage 1/2 filter: rejects only genuinely unusable parts (characters / NPCs / the rig, anchored or grounded assemblies, seats, terrain, destroyed, oversized).
-- Name, class (MeshPart / Union / any shape), CanQuery, CanCollide, transparency and network ownership are NOT reasons to reject here.
-- Returns the number of parts in the part's assembly (1 = fully independent), or nil when the part cannot be used.
function U.Grounded(p)
local ok, g = pcall(p.IsGrounded, p)
return ok and g == true
end
-- Tool protection: a part inside a Tool (Handle or any other part), or welded into an assembly with a Tool part or a player character, is never claimed, collided with, driven or velocity-reset.
function U.Foreign(q)
if q:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Tool") then return true end
local m = q:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model")
while m do
if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(m) then return true end
m = m:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Model")
end
return false
end
function U.Tainted(p)
if U.Foreign(p) then return true end
if p.AssemblyMass > p.Mass * 1.001 + 0.0001 then
local ok, cp = pcall(p.GetConnectedParts, p, true)
if ok then
for i = 1, #cp do
if cp[i] ~= p and U.Foreign(cp[i]) then return true end
end
end
end
return false
end
-- re-rates a record only when its assembly mass changed (parts joined / left); returns true when it became tainted
function U.Taint(rec)
rec.AM = rec.P.AssemblyMass
return U.Tainted(rec.P)
end
-- event-driven: a claimed part that is destroyed, removed, or picked up as a Tool is released the same frame (coalesced, so a remove + re-add in one frame keeps its attachment)
function U.Watch(S, rec)
local p = rec.P
rec.Conns = {p.AncestryChanged:Connect(function()
if rec.Dead or not S.Alive or rec.Chk then return end
rec.Chk = true
task.defer(function()
rec.Chk = nil
if rec.Dead or not S.Alive then return end
if not p:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
U.Release(S, rec, 20)
elseif U.Foreign(p) then
U.Release(S, rec, 30)
end
end)
end)}
end
function U.Filter(S, p)
if p.Anchored or not p.Parent or not p:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return nil, "anchored or destroyed" end
if p:IsA("Terrain") then return nil, "terrain" end
if (p:IsA("Seat") or p:IsA("VehicleSeat")) and p.Occupant ~= nil then return nil, "seat in use" end
local s = p.Size
local mx = math.max(s.X, s.Y, s.Z)
if mx < U.MinLen or mx > U.MaxLen then return nil, ("size %.1f studs is outside %.2f-%d"):format(mx, U.MinLen, U.MaxLen) end
local rc = Reanimate.Character
if rc and p:IsDescendantOf(rc) then return nil, "own rig" end
if p.Name == "RagdollProxy" then return nil, "own rig" end
local m = p.Parent
while m and m ~= workspace do
if m:IsA("Tool") then return nil, "Tool part (Tools and their Handles are never used)" end
if m:IsA("Model") then
if Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(m) then return nil, "player character" end
local hum = m:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if hum and hum.Health > 0 then return nil, "living character / NPC" end
end
m = m.Parent
end
if U.Grounded(p) then return nil, "grounded (attached to anchored geometry)" end
local n = 1
if p.AssemblyMass > p.Mass * 1.001 + 0.0001 then
local ok2, cp = pcall(p.GetConnectedParts, p, true)
if ok2 then n = math.max(#cp, 1) end
if n > U.MaxAsm then return nil, n .. " parts in one assembly" end
if ok2 then
for i = 1, #cp do
if cp[i] ~= p and U.Foreign(cp[i]) then return nil, "assembly contains a Tool or character part" end
end
end
end
return n
end
function U.Valid(S, p)
return U.Filter(S, p) ~= nil
end
function U.Free(S, p, now)
if S.Rec[p] then return false end
local ar = p.AssemblyRootPart
if ar and S.Asm[ar] then return false end
if (S.Cool[p] or 0) > now then return false end
if (S.Declined[p] or 0) > now then return false end
return true
end
-- engine-reported simulator only (same rule as the Tools reanimator); used when rating candidates
function U.Owns(p)
return p.Parent ~= nil and not p.Anchored and p.ReceiveAge == 0 and not U.Grounded(p)
end
-- per-record ownership read for the Heartbeat drive: ReceiveAge / Anchored every frame, the pcall'd grounded check only a few times per second
function U.RecOwns(rec, now)
local p = rec.P
if p.Parent == nil or p.Anchored or p.ReceiveAge ~= 0 then
-- OwnRun = start of the current ReceiveAge 0 run: a flicker shorter than ConfirmBlip does not break it, a longer one restarts it
rec.OffAt = rec.OffAt or now
if now - rec.OffAt > U.ConfirmBlip then rec.OwnRun = nil end
return false
end
rec.OffAt = nil
rec.OwnRun = rec.OwnRun or now
if now >= rec.GrAt then
rec.GrAt = now + 0.25
rec.Gr = U.Grounded(p)
if rec.Gr then rec.GrSince = rec.GrSince or now else rec.GrSince = nil end
end
return not rec.Gr
end
function U.Wake(rec, now)
if now - rec.WakeAt < 0.5 then return end
rec.WakeAt = now
pcall(sethiddenproperty, rec.P, "NetworkIsSleeping", false)
end
-- orient a part so its longest side runs along t1, its middle side along t2 and its shortest side along t3 of the target frame
function U.Align(s, t1, t2, t3)
local sz = {s.X, s.Y, s.Z}
local idx = {1, 2, 3}
table.sort(idx, function(i, j) return sz[i] > sz[j] or (sz[i] == sz[j] and i < j) end)
local rank = {}
for r = 1, 3 do rank[idx[r]] = r end
local T = {t1, t2, t3}
return CFrame.fromMatrix(Vector3.zero, T[rank[1]], T[rank[2]])
end
-- the used parts (and every part joined into their assembly) stop colliding with your character and the world; originals are remembered once and restored on release
function U.NoCollide(rec)
local p = rec.P
local cc = rec.CCs
if not cc then
cc = {}
rec.CCs = cc
end
local list = {p}
if p.AssemblyMass > p.Mass * 1.001 + 0.0001 then
local ok, cp = pcall(p.GetConnectedParts, p, true)
if ok and #cp <= U.MaxAsm then list = cp end
end
for i = 1, #list do
local q = list[i]
if not U.Foreign(q) then
if cc[q] == nil then cc[q] = q.CanCollide end
if q.CanCollide then pcall(function() q.CanCollide = false end) end
end
end
end
-- reservation only; physics properties are touched once ownership is confirmed (U.Apply). One record per part and one writer per assembly.
function U.Claim(S, p, f, now, rsv)
local ex = S.Rec[p]
if ex then return ex end
if U.Tainted(p) then return nil end
local ar = p.AssemblyRootPart
if ar and S.Asm[ar] then return nil end
local s = p.Size
local slot
if f == "Limbs" then
slot = U.NextSlot(S)
if not slot then return nil end
end
local rec = {P = p, F = f, Born = now, Rsv = rsv == true, LastOwned = now, WakeAt = 0, Owned = false, WasLive = false, GrAt = 0, RefAt = 0, LiveAt = now, AR = ar, CF = p.CFrame, Len = math.max(s.X, s.Y, s.Z)}
if s.X >= s.Y and s.X >= s.Z then
rec.AX, rec.AZ = CFrame.identity, CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0)
elseif s.Y >= s.Z then
rec.AX, rec.AZ = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)), CFrame.Angles(math.rad(90), 0, 0)
else
rec.AX, rec.AZ = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(90), 0), CFrame.identity
end
local d = {s.X, s.Y, s.Z}
table.sort(d, function(x, y) return x > y end)
rec.Wid, rec.Thk, rec.Thick = d[2], d[3], math.min(d[3], 6)
rec.AX = U.Align(s, Vector3.xAxis, Vector3.yAxis, Vector3.zAxis)
rec.AH = U.Align(s, Vector3.zAxis, Vector3.xAxis, Vector3.yAxis)
rec.AL = U.Align(s, Vector3.yAxis, Vector3.xAxis, Vector3.zAxis)
rec.Slot = slot
S.Rec[p] = rec
if ar then S.Asm[ar] = rec end
rec.AM = p.AssemblyMass
U.Watch(S, rec)
local g = S.G[f]
g[#g + 1] = rec
return rec
end
-- PhysicsRepRootRef is only ever pointed at a valid replicated root (U.RepRef) and only written when it differs; a nil / stale root never overwrites a working reference
function U.SetRef(rec, rr)
if not rr or rec.Ref == rr then return end
local p = rec.P
if not p.Parent then return end
if pcall(sethiddenproperty, p, "PhysicsRepRootRef", rr) then rec.Ref = rr end
end
function U.VerifyRef(S, rec)
local want = S.RepRoot
if not (want and want.Parent) then return end
local ok, cur = pcall(gethiddenproperty, rec.P, "PhysicsRepRootRef")
if ok and cur ~= want then
rec.Ref = nil
U.SetRef(rec, want)
end
end
-- genuine attachment: one Attachment on the part (A), one target Attachment on the character part that hosts the feature (T), one AlignPosition + one AlignOrientation between them
-- (reaction force / torque off, so the character is never pushed) and one VectorForce that only cancels the assembly's weight. Animation only moves T's CFrame; the controller is built once per part.
function U.Host(S, f, rec)
if f == "Limbs" then
local ch = Reanimate.Character
local lp = ch and rec and rec.Slot and ch:FindFirstChild(rec.Slot)
if lp and lp:IsA("BasePart") and lp.Parent then return lp end
return nil
end
local h = f == "Tail" and S.LowT or S.Tor
if h and h.Parent then return h end
return S.Root
end
function U.Tune(rec)
local m = math.max(rec.P.AssemblyMass, 0.001)
local g = workspace.Gravity
if rec.M == m and rec.Gv == g then return end
rec.M, rec.Gv = m, g
rec.AP.MaxForce = m * math.max(g, 50) * U.ForceK
rec.AO.MaxTorque = m * (rec.Len * rec.Len + 1) * U.TorqueK
rec.VF.Force = Vector3.new(0, m * g, 0)
end
function U.Hold(rec, on)
rec.On = on
if rec.AP then rec.AP.Enabled, rec.AO.Enabled, rec.VF.Enabled = on, on, on end
end
function U.Detach(rec)
for _, k in {"AP", "AO", "VF", "A", "T"} do
local o = rec[k]
if o then pcall(o.Destroy, o) end
rec[k] = nil
end
rec.M = nil
end
-- returns the host part while the controller is intact. Every piece (part attachment, target attachment, AlignPosition, AlignOrientation, VectorForce) is checked on its own: valid pieces are kept untouched (no duplicates, no needless rebuilds),
-- only missing / destroyed / foreign-parented pieces are recreated, and the target attachment is re-hosted after a respawn. Only UhUA_* instances created by this system are ever touched; Tool welds and other constraints are never modified.
function U.Attach(S, rec)
local p, host = rec.P, U.Host(S, rec.F, rec)
if not (host and host.Parent) then return nil end
local a0, a1, ap, ao, vf = rec.A, rec.T, rec.AP, rec.AO, rec.VF
if a0 and a0.Parent == p and a1 and a1.Parent == host and ap and ap.Parent == p and ao and ao.Parent == p and vf and vf.Parent == p
and ap.Attachment0 == a0 and ap.Attachment1 == a1 and ao.Attachment0 == a0 and ao.Attachment1 == a1 and vf.Attachment0 == a0 then
return host
end
if not (a0 or a1 or ap or ao or vf) then
-- first build: remove leftovers of an earlier run that was never cleaned up
for _, c in p:GetChildren() do
if string.sub(c.Name, 1, 5) == "UhUA_" then pcall(c.Destroy, c) end
end
end
if not (a0 and a0.Parent == p) then
if a0 then pcall(a0.Destroy, a0) end
a0 = Instance.new("Attachment")
a0.Name = "UhUA_Part"
a0.Parent = p
end
if a1 and a1.Parent ~= host and not pcall(function() a1.Parent = host end) then
pcall(a1.Destroy, a1)
a1 = nil
end
if not a1 then
a1 = Instance.new("Attachment")
a1.Name = "UhUA_Target"
a1.CFrame = host.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(p.CFrame)
a1.Parent = host
end
local on = rec.On ~= false
if not (ap and ap.Parent == p) then
if ap then pcall(ap.Destroy, ap) end
ap = Instance.new("AlignPosition")
ap.Name = "UhUA_Pos"
ap.Mode = Enum.PositionAlignmentMode.TwoAttachment
ap.ApplyAtCenterOfMass = true
ap.RigidityEnabled, ap.ReactionForceEnabled = false, false
ap.Responsiveness, ap.MaxVelocity = U.PosResp, U.MaxVel
ap.Attachment0, ap.Attachment1 = a0, a1
ap.Enabled = on
ap.Parent = p
rec.M = nil
elseif ap.Attachment0 ~= a0 or ap.Attachment1 ~= a1 then
ap.Attachment0, ap.Attachment1 = a0, a1
end
if not (ao and ao.Parent == p) then
if ao then pcall(ao.Destroy, ao) end
ao = Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
ao.Name = "UhUA_Rot"
ao.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.TwoAttachment
ao.RigidityEnabled, ao.ReactionTorqueEnabled = false, false
ao.Responsiveness, ao.MaxAngularVelocity = U.RotResp, U.MaxAng
ao.Attachment0, ao.Attachment1 = a0, a1
ao.Enabled = on
ao.Parent = p
rec.M = nil
elseif ao.Attachment0 ~= a0 or ao.Attachment1 ~= a1 then
ao.Attachment0, ao.Attachment1 = a0, a1
end
if not (vf and vf.Parent == p) then
if vf then pcall(vf.Destroy, vf) end
vf = Instance.new("VectorForce")
vf.Name = "UhUA_Weight"
vf.ApplyAtCenterOfMass = true
vf.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
vf.Attachment0 = a0
vf.Enabled = on
vf.Parent = p
rec.M = nil
elseif vf.Attachment0 ~= a0 then
vf.Attachment0 = a0
end
rec.A, rec.T, rec.AP, rec.AO, rec.VF = a0, a1, ap, ao, vf
U.Tune(rec)
return host
end
-- first confirmed ownership saves the original physics state once; every later confirmation (recovery) only re-asserts it and re-enables the existing controller. Returns true once the controller exists and is enabled.
function U.Apply(S, rec)
local p = rec.P
-- nothing is built or written before ownership is genuinely confirmed (U.DriveRec only gets here once rec.Owned is set)
if rec.Dead or not rec.Owned then return false end
if not rec.Applied then
rec.Applied = true
local ok, prev = pcall(gethiddenproperty, p, "PhysicsRepRootRef")
rec.PrevRef = ok and U.RepRef(prev) or nil
end
U.NoCollide(rec)
U.SetRef(rec, S.RepRoot or U.RepRef(U.RepSource(S, S.Root)))
if U.Attach(S, rec) then
-- control starts from rest once (leftover free-fall velocity never fights the constraints); later re-assertions never touch the velocity again
if not rec.Rested and p.ReceiveAge == 0 then
rec.Rested = true
pcall(function()
rec.P.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
rec.P.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
end)
end
U.Hold(rec, true)
rec.Held = true
return true
end
return false
end
function U.Release(S, rec, cool)
local p = rec.P
if S.Rec[p] ~= rec then return end
rec.Dead = true
if rec.Conns then
for _, c in rec.Conns do pcall(c.Disconnect, c) end
rec.Conns = nil
end
S.Rec[p] = nil
S.NextChoose = 0
if rec.AR and S.Asm[rec.AR] == rec then S.Asm[rec.AR] = nil end
local g = S.G[rec.F]
local i = table.find(g, rec)
if i then table.remove(g, i) end
if cool and cool > 0 then S.Cool[p] = os.clock() + cool end
U.Detach(rec)
if rec.CCs then
for q, v in rec.CCs do
if q.Parent then pcall(function() q.CanCollide = v end) end
end
rec.CCs = nil
end
if rec.Applied and p.Parent then
pcall(sethiddenproperty, p, "PhysicsRepRootRef", U.RepRef(rec.PrevRef))
if rec.Owned and p.ReceiveAge == 0 and not U.Tainted(p) then
pcall(function()
p.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
p.AssemblyAngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
end)
end
end
end
-- ownership lifecycle per part: RESERVED (claimed, character not yet in reach) -> AWAITING OWNERSHIP (clock running) -> confirmed (engine reports ReceiveAge 0 for OwnConfirm, short flickers tolerated) -> ATTACHED (controllers built + enabled)
-- -> OWNERSHIP LOST (no writes, record + feature kept, recovery watched) -> live again after re-confirmation. The work runs protected so one broken record never stops the Heartbeat step for the other parts; a record that keeps failing is released by U.Validate.
function U.Drive(S, rec, tgt, a, now)
local ok, err = pcall(U.DriveRec, S, rec, tgt, a, now)
if ok then
rec.Errs = nil
else
rec.Errs = (rec.Errs or 0) + 1
if not S.Warned then
S.Warned = true
warn("[Unanchored Reanimation] part drive error: " .. tostring(err))
end
end
end
function U.DriveRec(S, rec, tgt, a, now)
local p = rec.P
if rec.Dead or not p.Parent then return end
-- the ownership clock only starts once the character is within reach of the part
if not rec.WasLive and not rec.WaitAt and (p.Position - S.Origin).Magnitude <= U.Near + 25 then rec.WaitAt = now end
if U.RecOwns(rec, now) then
rec.BlipAt = nil
elseif (rec.Owned or rec.OwnRun) and now - (rec.BlipAt or now) < U.OwnGrace then
-- ReceiveAge flickers on healthy parts: keep the controller on and keep driving through the blip so the part (and anything welded to it) never falls; a part that is not confirmed yet only waits (its OwnConfirm run restarts when the flicker outlasts U.ConfirmBlip)
rec.BlipAt = rec.BlipAt or now
U.Wake(rec, now)
if not rec.Owned then return end
else
rec.BlipAt = nil
rec.OwnRun = nil
if rec.Owned then
rec.Owned = false
rec.LostAt = now
-- no writes while the engine does not report us as simulator; the controllers stay built AND enabled (constraints made on this client do nothing without ownership), so the part resumes the moment ownership returns instead of being torn down and rebuilt
end
local cd = S.Cand[p]
if cd then cd.Own = false end
U.Wake(rec, now)
return
end
if not rec.Owned then
-- first acquisition needs an uninterrupted ReceiveAge 0 run of OwnConfirm; a part that was live before is re-accepted after a short RecoverConfirm run so one stray reading never flips it back
if now - (rec.OwnRun or now) < (rec.WasLive and U.RecoverConfirm or U.OwnConfirm) then return end
local lost = rec.LostAt and now - rec.LostAt or 0
rec.Owned = true
rec.OwnedAt = now
rec.LostAt = nil
if not rec.WasLive or lost > 1 then
rec.CF = p.CFrame
rec.LiveAt = now
end
-- after a real loss the part has to settle in its slot again before its real limb is hidden again
if lost > U.HideHold then rec.Ready, rec.NearAt = nil, nil end
rec.WasLive = true
rec.WaitAt = rec.WaitAt or now
rec.ApplyAt = now + 0.25
if rec.Held then U.Hold(rec, true) else U.Apply(S, rec) end
end
rec.LastOwned = now
-- the candidate only counts as owned once ownership is confirmed
local cd = S.Cand[p]
if cd then cd.Own, cd.Fails = true, 0 end
-- Apply is retried until the controller really exists (e.g. the host part was missing during a respawn)
if not rec.Held and now >= (rec.ApplyAt or 0) then
rec.ApplyAt = now + 0.25
U.Apply(S, rec)
end
if rec.Rsv and rec.Held and not rec.Noted then
rec.Noted = true
U.Note(("Ownership of \"%s\" confirmed - attached as %s."):format((p.Name:gsub("[<>&]", "?")), U.Label[rec.F]))
end
local tp = tgt.Position
if tp.X ~= tp.X or tp.Y ~= tp.Y or tp.Z ~= tp.Z then return end
local cur = p.CFrame
local rp = rec.CF.Position
if rp.X ~= rp.X or rp.Y ~= rp.Y or rp.Z ~= rp.Z or (cur.Position - rp).Magnitude > U.Drift then
-- displaced by something else (server correction, collision, teleport): glide back from where the part really is instead of snapping
rec.CF = cur
rec.LiveAt = now
end
local yl = S.YLim
if yl and tgt.Y < yl then tgt += Vector3.new(0, yl - tgt.Y, 0) end
-- the first second glides the target from where the part really is into the formation; after that the target is the exact formation frame, so the constraints track the character without smoothing lag
local lv = now - rec.LiveAt
local k = a * math.min(1, 0.25 + lv * 2.2)
if lv > 0.6 then k += (1 - k) * math.min(1, (lv - 0.6) * 2) end
local cf = rec.CF:Lerp(tgt, k)
rec.CF = cf
-- animation only moves the character-relative target attachment; the Align constraints do the moving
local host = U.Attach(S, rec)
if host then
rec.T.CFrame = host.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(cf)
U.Tune(rec)
end
-- Ready (limbs): owned, controller built and enabled, ownership held for U.Prove since (re)acceptance and the part is physically at its slot. Only then is the real limb hidden (U.Hidden); a part that drifts far off its slot stops being ready until it settles again
if host and rec.Held and rec.F == "Limbs" then
local dist = (p.Position - tgt.Position).Magnitude
local lim = math.max(U.Settle, rec.Len * 0.5 + 1)
if dist <= lim then
rec.NearAt = rec.NearAt or now
elseif dist > lim * 3 then
rec.NearAt, rec.Ready = nil, nil
elseif not rec.Ready then
rec.NearAt = nil
end
if not rec.Ready and rec.NearAt and now - rec.NearAt >= 0.25 and now - (rec.OwnedAt or now) >= U.Prove then
rec.Ready, rec.Proven = true, true
end
end
if now >= rec.RefAt then
rec.RefAt = now + 2
U.VerifyRef(S, rec)
U.NoCollide(rec)
if host then U.Tune(rec) end
end
end
function U.Slash(t)
local T = 2.6
local c = math.floor(t / T)
local u = t - c * T
local d = (c % 2 == 0) and 1 or -1
local rad = math.rad
if u < 0.25 then return -d * rad(55) * U.Sm(u / 0.25) end
if u < 0.6 then return -d * rad(55) + d * rad(125) * U.Sm((u - 0.25) / 0.35) end
if u < 1.3 then return d * rad(70) * (1 - U.Sm((u - 0.6) / 0.7)) end
return 0
end

-- ===== Wing formation (structured angel wing) =====
-- Each wing is a three-bone skeleton (arm / forearm / hand) carrying four feather sections:
--   1 primary    long outer fan on the hand bone, tips form the curved outer outline
--   2 secondary  two overlapping rows on the forearm bone (main row + shorter covert row)
--   3 inner      short feathers in two staggered layers along the arm, densest at the wing root, growing longer outward
--   4 lower      elongated feathers hanging down from the inner / middle arm
-- The layout is built once per feather set in RIGHT-WING LOCAL space (+X outward from the wing root, +Y up, +Z behind the character, units of Lp = primary feather length).
-- The left wing is the same local layout mirrored in local space (U.WingMir) - never a mirrored world CFrame - so both wings share identical slots, angles and spacing.
-- Every feather keeps a fixed pose relative to its bone (rec.WL), so animation only bends the bones and the internal arrangement is never disturbed.
U.WA = {math.rad(58), math.rad(30), math.rad(8)}
U.WB = {0.30, 0.50, 0.22}
function U.WingMir(cf)
local x, y = cf.XVector, cf.YVector
return CFrame.fromMatrix(Vector3.new(-cf.X, cf.Y, cf.Z), Vector3.new(-x.X, x.Y, x.Z), Vector3.new(-y.X, y.Y, y.Z))
end
-- feathers per section for the number of feathers one wing owns {primary, secondary, inner, lower}
function U.WingPlan(m)
if m <= 0 then return {0, 0, 0, 0} end
if m == 1 then return {1, 0, 0, 0} end
if m == 2 then return {1, 1, 0, 0} end
if m == 3 then return {1, 1, 0, 1} end
local fr = {0.30, 0.28, 0.24, 0.18}
local c, tot = {}, 0
for i = 1, 4 do
c[i] = math.max(1, math.floor(fr[i] * m))
tot += c[i]
end
while tot < m do
local bi, bv = 1, -math.huge
for i = 1, 4 do
local v = fr[i] * m - c[i]
if v > bv then bi, bv = i, v end
end
c[bi] += 1
tot += 1
end
while tot > m do
local bi, bv = nil, -math.huge
for i = 1, 4 do
local v = c[i] - fr[i] * m
if c[i] > 1 and v > bv then bi, bv = i, v end
end
if not bi then break end
c[bi] -= 1
tot -= 1
end
return c
end
-- Assigns every wing part to a slot and stores its bone-relative rest pose. The parts are ranked by length: the longest go to the outer primaries, then the lower / secondary / inner sections in turn, and each slot is filled with a matching pair (one part per wing) so both wings get feathers of the same size at the same place. An odd leftover (the shortest part) becomes a centre feather between the two wing roots.
function U.WingBuild(S, g)
local n = #g
local sc = S.Sc or 1
local rad, cos, sin = math.rad, math.cos, math.sin
local ord = {}
for i = 1, n do ord[i] = {g[i], i} end
table.sort(ord, function(a, b)
if a[1].Len ~= b[1].Len then return a[1].Len > b[1].Len end
return a[2] < b[2]
end)
local pc = n // 2
local pl = U.WingPlan(pc)
local np, ns, ni, nl = pl[1], pl[2], pl[3], pl[4]
local nB = ns // 2
local nA = ns - nB
local slots, k = {}, 0
local function add(sec, q, u, lf, row)
k += 1
slots[k] = {sec = sec, q = q, u = u, lf = lf, row = row, k = k}
end
for q = 1, np do
local u = np > 1 and (q - 1) / (np - 1) or 0
add(1, q, u, 1 - 0.2 * u)
end
for q = 1, nA do
local u = nA > 1 and (q - 1) / (nA - 1) or 0.5
add(2, q, u, 0.54 + 0.12 * u, 1)
end
for q = 1, nB do
local u = (q - 0.5) / nB
add(2, q, u, 0.36 + 0.12 * u, 2)
end
for q = 1, ni do
local u = ni > 1 and ((q - 1) / (ni - 1)) ^ 1.25 or 0.5
add(3, q, u, 0.16 + 0.18 * u)
end
for q = 1, nl do
local u = nl > 1 and (q - 1) / (nl - 1) or 0.5
add(4, q, u, 0.58 + 0.18 * u)
end
table.sort(slots, function(a, b)
if a.lf ~= b.lf then return a.lf > b.lf end
return a.k < b.k
end)
local mt = 0
for i = 1, n do
if g[i].Thick > mt then mt = g[i].Thick end
end
local prim, pls, pn = {}, 0, 0
for p = 1, pc do
local sl = slots[p]
local a, b = ord[2 * p - 1][1], ord[2 * p][1]
if p % 2 == 1 then sl.R, sl.L = a, b else sl.R, sl.L = b, a end
sl.Len, sl.Wid = (a.Len + b.Len) * 0.5, (a.Wid + b.Wid) * 0.5
if sl.sec == 1 then
prim[sl.q] = sl
pls += sl.Len
pn += 1
end
end
local Lp = math.clamp(pn > 0 and pls / pn or (n > 0 and ord[1][1].Len or 2), 1.2, 16)
-- skeleton rest pose (right-wing local)
local WA, WB = U.WA, U.WB
local R0 = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, WA[1])
local J1 = R0.XVector * (WB[1] * Lp)
local R1 = CFrame.new(J1) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, WA[2])
local J2 = J1 + R1.XVector * (WB[2] * Lp)
local R2 = CFrame.new(J2) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, WA[3])
local J3 = J2 + R2.XVector * (WB[3] * Lp)
local RI = {R0:Inverse(), R1:Inverse(), R2:Inverse()}
local function poly(pu)
local b0 = WB[1] * Lp
local s = pu * (WB[1] + WB[2]) * Lp
if s <= b0 then return R0.XVector * s, 1 end
return J1 + R1.XVector * (s - b0), 2
end
-- primary fan: angular step follows the feather width so neighbours keep an even, slightly overlapping spacing; total fan kept inside a natural range
local th = rad(16)
if prim[1] then
prim[1].th = th
for q = 2, np do
local a, b = prim[q - 1], prim[q]
local wd = (a.Wid + b.Wid) * 0.5
local ln = (a.Len + b.Len) * 0.5
th -= math.clamp(0.9 * wd / math.max(ln * 0.8, 0.1), rad(3.5), rad(9))
b.th = th
end
if np > 1 then
local tot = prim[1].th - prim[np].th
local sf = math.clamp(tot, rad(28), rad(66)) / tot
for q = 2, np do prim[q].th = prim[1].th - (prim[1].th - prim[q].th) * sf end
end
end
local tEnd = prim[np] and prim[np].th or rad(16)
local sW, sE = math.min(tEnd - rad(8), rad(-42)), rad(-80)
local gap = math.min(0.14 * sc + mt * 0.5, 1.2)
local z0 = 0.1 * sc
for p = 1, pc do
local sl = slots[p]
local sec, u = sl.sec, sl.u
local an, tha, bone, layer, beta
if sec == 1 then
an, tha, bone, layer, beta = J3:Lerp(J2, u), sl.th, 3, 1, rad(3 + 4 * (1 - u))
elseif sec == 2 then
an, tha, bone, beta = J1:Lerp(J2, u), sE + (sW - sE) * u, 2, rad(2)
if sl.row == 1 then
layer = 2
else
layer = 3
tha += rad(3)
end
elseif sec == 3 then
an, bone = poly(0.05 + 0.8 * u)
tha, layer, beta = rad(-78) + rad(22) * u, (sl.q % 2 == 1) and 4 or 3.5, rad(2)
else
an, bone = poly(0.08 + 0.55 * u)
an += Vector3.new(0, -0.03 * Lp, 0)
tha, layer, beta = rad(-88) + rad(20) * u, 0, rad(2)
end
local d = Vector3.new(cos(tha), sin(tha), 0)
local nv = Vector3.new(-sin(tha), cos(tha), 0)
local z = z0 + layer * gap + (sl.q % 2) * 0.3 * gap
for i = 1, 2 do
local rec = i == 1 and sl.R or sl.L
local cf = CFrame.fromMatrix(an + d * (rec.Len * 0.5) + Vector3.new(0, 0, z), d, nv) * CFrame.Angles(0, -beta, 0)
rec.WL, rec.WB, rec.WS = RI[bone] * cf, bone, i == 1 and 1 or -1
end
end
if n % 2 == 1 then
local rec = ord[n][1]
rec.WL = CFrame.fromMatrix(Vector3.new(0, 0.15 * sc - rec.Len * 0.5, z0 + 4.5 * gap), Vector3.new(0, -1, 0), Vector3.new(1, 0, 0))
rec.WB, rec.WS = 0, 0
end
local lay = {N = n, Sc = sc, Lp = Lp, List = {}, Bones = {}, Root = Vector3.new(0.45 * sc + math.min(0.04 * Lp, 0.6), 0, 0.06 * sc)}
for i = 1, n do lay.List[i] = g[i] end
return lay
end

-- Auto spreadness for unanchored limbs: every part is spaced by its own real size (re-read each frame, so size changes are followed). Only size beyond the standard limb (and, for the limbs around it, a bigger torso part) adds spacing:
-- normal-sized parts keep their usual position, bigger parts get proportionally more room, and the spacing stops at contact (K < 1) so limbs never drift apart. Parts are never resized, replaced or detached; hosts (and so Torso Offset) are untouched.
U.LimbSign = {["Left Arm"] = -1, ["Right Arm"] = 1, ["Left Leg"] = -1, ["Right Leg"] = 1}
function U.LimbDims(rec)
local s = rec.P.Size
if rec.LSz == s then return end
rec.LSz = s
local d = {s.X, s.Y, s.Z}
table.sort(d, function(x, y) return x > y end)
rec.Len, rec.Wid, rec.Thk, rec.Thick = d[1], d[2], d[3], math.min(d[3], 6)
rec.AL = U.Align(s, Vector3.yAxis, Vector3.xAxis, Vector3.zAxis)
end
function U.LimbRefs(sz)
local a, b = sz.X, sz.Y
local c = sz.Z
if a < b then a, b = b, a end
if b < c then b = c end
if a < b then a, b = b, a end
return a, b
end
function U.LimbTarget(S, rec, lp, tor, gw, gh)
U.LimbDims(rec)
local cf = lp.CFrame * rec.AL
local sl = rec.Slot
if sl == "Torso" then return cf end
local K = 0.92
local refLen, refWid = U.LimbRefs(lp.Size)
local el = math.max(0, rec.Len - refLen) * 0.5 * K
local ew = math.max(0, rec.Wid - refWid) * 0.5 * K
local sg = U.LimbSign[sl]
local lat, ly, ty = 0, 0, 0
