if sl == "Head" then
ly, ty = el, gh * 0.5 * K
elseif sg then
if sl == "Left Arm" or sl == "Right Arm" then
lat, ly, ty = sg * (ew + gw * 0.5 * K), -el, gh * 0.5 * K
else
lat, ly, ty = sg * (ew + gw * 0.25 * K), -el, -gh * 0.5 * K
end
end
if ly ~= 0 then cf = lp.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, ly, 0) * rec.AL end
if (lat ~= 0 or ty ~= 0) and tor and tor.Parent then
cf = cf + tor.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(lat, ty, 0))
elseif lat ~= 0 or ty ~= 0 then
cf = cf + lp.CFrame:VectorToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(lat, ty, 0))
end
return cf
end
function U.Step(S, dt)
if not S.Alive or S.Scout then return end
local root = S.Root
if not (root and root.Parent) then
local ch = U.HostChar(S)
root = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
S.Root = root
S.RefDirty = true
end
if not root and not S.LastCF then return end
local now = os.clock()
if now >= S.RefChkAt then
S.RefChkAt = now + 0.25
S.YLim = U.VoidY() + 5
local ch = root and root.Parent
local tor = ch and (ch:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or ch:FindFirstChild("Torso"))
local lt = ch and (ch:FindFirstChild("LowerTorso") or tor)
S.Tor, S.LowT = tor, lt
S.BackAtt = tor and tor:FindFirstChild("BodyBackAttachment")
S.WaistAtt = lt and lt:FindFirstChild("WaistBackAttachment")
S.Sc = tor and math.clamp(tor.Size.X / 2, 0.4, 4) or 1
local cr = S.RepRoot
local rs = U.RepSource(S, root)
if (cr and not cr:IsDescendantOf(workspace)) or (rs ~= cr and U.RepRef(rs)) then S.RefDirty = true end
end
if S.RefDirty then
S.RefDirty = nil
local rr = U.RepRef(U.RepSource(S, root))
if rr then
S.RepRoot = rr
for _, rec in S.Rec do
if rec.Applied then U.SetRef(rec, rr) end
end
end
end
local t = now - S.T0
local rcf = root and root.CFrame or S.LastCF
if root then S.LastCF = rcf end
local a = 1 - math.exp(-math.min(dt, 0.1) * 14)
local sin, cos, rad = math.sin, math.cos, math.rad
-- mounts: wings hang off the real BodyBackAttachment of the torso (follows the torso's own pose and the avatar scale); the tail off the waist-back attachment. +Z of both frames is behind the character.
local sc = S.Sc or 1
local aw = 1 - math.exp(-math.min(dt, 0.1) * 24)
local tor = S.Tor
local wm, tb
if tor and tor.Parent then
local ba = S.BackAtt
local bp = ba and ba.Parent == tor and ba.Position or Vector3.new(0, 0, tor.Size.Z * 0.5)
wm = tor.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, math.min(bp.Y + 0.55 * sc, tor.Size.Y * 0.42), bp.Z)
else
wm = rcf * CFrame.new(0, 0.55 * sc, 0.5 * sc)
end
local lt, wa = S.LowT, S.WaistAtt
if lt and lt.Parent and wa and wa.Parent == lt then
local wp = wa.Position
tb = lt.CFrame * CFrame.new(wp.X, wp.Y - 0.2 * sc, wp.Z + 0.2 * sc) * CFrame.Angles(rad(8), 0, 0)
else
tb = rcf * CFrame.new(0, -sc, 1.1 * sc) * CFrame.Angles(rad(8), 0, 0)
end
-- Wings: two mirrored articulated wings hinged behind the shoulder blades (roots offset in the BodyBackAttachment frame). The whole wing hinges at its root (sweep swings it back and away from the torso, lift raises / lowers it) and the forearm / hand bones trail with a small phase lag; every feather is rigid relative to its bone (U.WingBuild), so flapping and idling never change the formation. The left wing is the local-space mirror of the right wing's bone-relative poses.
local g = S.G.Wings
local n = #g
if n > 0 and C.Wings then
local lay = S.WingLay
local fresh = lay and lay.N == n and math.abs(lay.Sc - sc) < 0.05
if fresh then
local lst = lay.List
for k = 1, n do
if lst[k] ~= g[k] then
fresh = false
break
end
end
end
if not fresh then
lay = U.WingBuild(S, g)
S.WingLay = lay
end
local sweep, lift, eb, wb
if C.WingAnim == 2 then
local b = sin(t * 1.7)
sweep, lift = rad(22 + 2 * b), rad(7 + 3 * b)
eb, wb = rad(1.5 * sin(t * 1.7 - 0.6)), rad(2.5 * sin(t * 1.7 - 1.2))
else
local ph = t * 7
local w = sin(ph) + 0.2 * sin(2 * ph - 0.9)
sweep, lift = rad(26 - 11 * w), rad(8 + 26 * w)
eb, wb = rad(4 * sin(ph - 0.6)), rad(7 * sin(ph - 1.2))
end
local Lp, WA, WB = lay.Lp, U.WA, U.WB
local bn = lay.Bones
local B1 = CFrame.Angles(0, -sweep, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, lift) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, WA[1])
local B2 = B1 * CFrame.new(WB[1] * Lp, 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, WA[2] - WA[1] + eb)
local B3 = B2 * CFrame.new(WB[2] * Lp, 0, 0) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, WA[3] - WA[2] + wb)
bn[1], bn[2], bn[3] = B1, B2, B3
local rt = lay.Root
local rootR = wm * CFrame.new(rt)
local rootL = wm * CFrame.new(-rt.X, rt.Y, rt.Z)
for k = 1, n do
local rec = g[k]
local side = rec.WS
local tgt
if side == 0 then
tgt = wm * rec.WL * rec.AX
elseif side < 0 then
tgt = rootL * U.WingMir(bn[rec.WB] * rec.WL) * rec.AX
else
tgt = rootR * (bn[rec.WB] * rec.WL) * rec.AX
end
U.Drive(S, rec, tgt, aw, now)
end
end
-- Tail: chain behind the lower torso, each segment lagging the previous one
g = S.G.Tail
n = #g
if n > 0 and C.Tail then
local cf = tb
local slash = C.TailAnim == 2
for k = 1, n do
local rec = g[k]
local yaw
if slash then yaw = U.Slash(t - k * 0.03) * 1.5 / n else yaw = rad(11) * sin(t * 3.2 - k * 0.5) end
cf = cf * CFrame.Angles(rad(-4), yaw, 0)
U.Drive(S, rec, cf * CFrame.new(0, 0, rec.Len * 0.5) * rec.AZ, a, now)
cf = cf * CFrame.new(0, 0, rec.Len * 0.9)
end
end
-- Halo: level ring centred above the character, always rotating. Every part claims arc room in proportion to its own size, so big parts spread the ring wider (more radius, more gap, more headroom) instead of piling into a small circle.
g = S.G.Halo
n = #g
if n > 0 and C.Halo then
local tot, mw, mt = 0, 0, 0
for k = 1, n do
local rec = g[k]
rec.Span = rec.Len * 1.08 + 0.3 + rec.Wid * 0.12
tot = tot + rec.Span
if rec.Wid > mw then mw = rec.Wid end
if rec.Thk > mt then mt = rec.Thk end
end
local R = math.max(3.4 * sc, tot / 6.2832, mw * 0.5 + 2.2 * sc)
local c = rcf.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3.8 * sc + mt * 0.5, 0)
S.HaloA = (S.HaloA or 0) + math.min(dt, 0.1) * 1.6 * math.min(1, 10 / R)
local acc = 0
for k = 1, n do
local rec = g[k]
local arc = 6.2832 * rec.Span / tot
local th = S.HaloA + acc + arc * 0.5
acc = acc + arc
local pos = c + Vector3.new(cos(th) * R, sin(t * 2 + k) * 0.12, sin(th) * R)
U.Drive(S, rec, CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + Vector3.new(-sin(th), 0, cos(th))) * rec.AH, a, now)
end
end
-- Limbs: every part owns one slot of the fake character (Torso / Head / arms / legs) and follows that limb's CFrame; the real limb of the same slot is hidden while its part is attached
if S.LimbRun then
g = S.G.Limbs
n = #g
if C.Limbs then
local lch = Reanimate.Character
local ltor = lch and lch:FindFirstChild("Torso")
local gw, gh = 0, 0
for k = 1, n do
local tr = g[k]
if tr.Slot == "Torso" and tr.Held and not tr.Dead and ltor and ltor.Parent then
U.LimbDims(tr)
local rl, rw = U.LimbRefs(ltor.Size)
gw, gh = math.max(0, tr.Wid - rw), math.max(0, tr.Len - rl)
break
end
end
for k = 1, n do
local rec = g[k]
local lp = U.Host(S, "Limbs", rec)
if lp then U.Drive(S, rec, U.LimbTarget(S, rec, lp, ltor, gw, gh), a, now) end
end
end
U.Hidden(S)
end
end

function U.ClosePrompt(S)
local pr = S.Prompt
if not pr then return end
S.Prompt = nil
for _, c in pr.Conns do pcall(c.Disconnect, c) end
pcall(pr.Gui.Destroy, pr.Gui)
end
function U.PromptText(S, pr)
local d = S.Root and (pr.P.Position - S.Root.Position).Magnitude or pr.D
pr.Info.Text = ("Part: %s\nDistance: %d studs\nWhy: %s\nIntended use: %s"):format(pr.P.Name, math.floor(d), pr.Why, U.Label[pr.F])
end
-- one window at a time (S.Prompt guard + stale windows of an earlier run are removed); returns true only when the YES / NO window is really on screen
function U.ShowPrompt(S, e, f, opts)
if S.Prompt then return false end
local g = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
g.Name = "UhUnanchoredPrompt"
g.ResetOnSpawn = false
g.DisplayOrder = 965
g.IgnoreGuiInset = true
g.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
local mounted = false
for _, get in {function() return gethui and gethui() end, function() return game:GetService("CoreGui") end, function() return Player:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui") end} do
local ok, par = pcall(get)
if ok and typeof(par) == "Instance" then
pcall(function()
for _, o in par:GetChildren() do
if o.Name == "UhUnanchoredPrompt" then o:Destroy() end
end
end)
if pcall(function() g.Parent = par end) and g.Parent == par then
mounted = true
break
end
end
end
if not mounted then
pcall(g.Destroy, g)
return false
end
local ok, err = pcall(function()
local fr = Instance.new("Frame")
fr.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
fr.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.08, 0)
fr.Size = UDim2.new(0, 340, 0, 214)
fr.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 22, 30)
fr.BorderSizePixel = 0
fr.Active = true
fr.Parent = g
Instance.new("UICorner", fr).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
local st = Instance.new("UIStroke", fr)
st.Color = Color3.fromRGB(90, 140, 255)
st.Thickness = 1.5
local function lbl(text, y, h, size, bold)
local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
l.Position = UDim2.new(0, 12, 0, y)
l.Size = UDim2.new(1, -24, 0, h)
l.Text = text
l.TextWrapped = true
l.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
l.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
l.Font = bold and Enum.Font.GothamBold or Enum.Font.Gotham
l.TextSize = size
l.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
l.Parent = fr
return l
end
local function btn(text, x, ox, col)
local b = Instance.new("TextButton")
b.Position = UDim2.new(x, ox, 1, -48)
b.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, -18, 0, 36)
b.BackgroundColor3 = col
b.BorderSizePixel = 0
b.Text = text
b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
b.TextSize = 13
b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
b.AutoButtonColor = true
b.Parent = fr
Instance.new("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 6)
return b
end
lbl(opts and opts.Title or "A suitable unanchored part has been found! Would you like to teleport to it?", 10, 44, 14, true)
local p = e.P
local pr = {P = p, F = f, D = e.D, Gui = g, Conns = {}, Why = U.Why(p, f, e[f]), Fixed = opts ~= nil}
pr.Info = lbl("", 58, 102, 12, false)
local yes = btn("YES — TELEPORT", 0, 12, Color3.fromRGB(46, 160, 90))
local no = btn("NO — DECLINE", 0.5, 6, Color3.fromRGB(190, 64, 64))
U.PromptText(S, pr)
pr.Conns[1] = yes.Activated:Connect(function()
if S.Prompt ~= pr then return end
U.ClosePrompt(S)
local okA, errA = pcall(U.Accept, S, p, f)
if not okA then
S.NextChoose = 0
U.Note("Teleport failed (" .. tostring(errA) .. "). Searching for another part...")
end
if opts and opts.Cb then task.spawn(opts.Cb, true) end
end)
pr.Conns[2] = no.Activated:Connect(function()
if S.Prompt ~= pr then return end
U.ClosePrompt(S)
S.Declined[p] = os.clock() + 300
S.NextPrompt = os.clock() + 2
if opts and opts.Cb then task.spawn(opts.Cb, false) end
end)
S.Prompt = pr
end)
if not ok then
pcall(g.Destroy, g)
if not S.Warned then
S.Warned = true
warn("[Unanchored Reanimation] teleport prompt failed: " .. tostring(err))
end
return false
end
return true
end
-- safe spot beside/above the part: tries all four sides, ground-snapped, never inside the part, away from void and obvious kill bricks
function U.SafeSpot(S, p)
local root = S.Root
if not (root and root.Parent) then return nil end
local ch = root.Parent
local hum = ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
local half = (hum and hum.HipHeight or 2) + root.Size.Y * 0.5 + 0.5
local sz, pp = p.Size, p.Position
local flat = Vector3.new(root.Position.X - pp.X, 0, root.Position.Z - pp.Z)
flat = flat.Magnitude > 0.1 and flat.Unit or Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
local rc = Reanimate.Character
local ign = rc and {ch, p, rc} or {ch, p}
local rp = RaycastParams.new()
rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = ign
local op = OverlapParams.new()
op.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
op.FilterDescendantsInstances = ign
local dist = math.max(sz.X, sz.Z) * 0.5 + 4
local low = U.VoidY() + 50
local air
for _, ang in {0, 90, -90, 180} do
local dir = CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(ang), 0) * flat
local base = pp + dir * dist + Vector3.new(0, sz.Y * 0.5 + 6, 0)
local hit = workspace:Raycast(base, Vector3.new(0, -150, 0), rp)
local pos, ok = base, true
if hit then
local nm = string.lower(hit.Instance.Name .. " " .. (hit.Instance.Parent and hit.Instance.Parent.Name or ""))
for _, w in {"kill", "lava", "death", "damage", "acid"} do
if string.find(nm, w, 1, true) then ok = false end
end
pos = hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, half, 0)
end
if ok and pos.Y >= low then
for _ = 1, 3 do
local blocked = false
for _, q in workspace:GetPartBoundsInBox(CFrame.new(pos), Vector3.new(2.5, 4.5, 2.5), op) do
if q.CanCollide then blocked = true break end
end
if not blocked then
if hit then return pos end
air = air or pos
break
end
pos = pos + Vector3.new(0, 4, 0)
end
end
end
return air
end
-- only ever called from the YES button: revalidate -> safe spot -> teleport -> reserve this exact part + feature -> re-rate it first.
-- Success is NOT reported here: the part is only moved after the engine confirms ownership (U.Drive), and the confirmation / failure notices come from there.
function U.Accept(S, p, f)
local now = os.clock()
local name = (p.Name:gsub("[<>&]", "?"))
S.NextChoose = 0
if not U.Valid(S, p) then
U.Note(("\"%s\" is no longer usable (moved, anchored, removed or taken). Searching for another part..."):format(name))
return
end
local root = S.Root
if not (root and root.Parent) then
U.Note("Teleport cancelled: your character is not loaded. Searching for another part...")
return
end
local pos = U.SafeSpot(S, p)
if not pos then
S.Seen[p] = now + 120
U.Note(("No safe spot to stand near \"%s\". Searching for another part..."):format(name))
return
end
local pp = p.Position
S.Cool[p], S.Declined[p] = nil, nil
local cd = S.Cand[p]
if cd then cd.Chk, cd.Fails = 0, 0 end
local rec = S.Rec[p]
if rec and not rec.Owned and not rec.WasLive then rec.Born, rec.WaitAt, rec.Rsv = now, nil, true end
S.Reserve = {P = p, F = f, Until = now + 25}
S.NextNear = 0
S.ForceEval = p
S.NextPrompt = now + 8
root.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(pos, Vector3.new(pp.X, pos.Y, pp.Z))
root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
U.Note(("Teleported next to \"%s\". Waiting for the server to hand over ownership before anything moves..."):format(name))
task.delay(0.6, function()
local rt = S.Root
if not S.Alive or not (rt and rt.Parent) then return end
if (rt.Position - pos).Magnitude > 40 then
if S.Reserve and S.Reserve.P == p then S.Reserve = nil end
S.Seen[p] = os.clock() + 60
S.NextPrompt = 0
S.NextChoose = 0
U.Note(("The teleport to \"%s\" did not hold (the game moved you back). Searching for another part..."):format(name))
end
end)
end

-- ownership never arrived inside U.OwnWait: free the slot with a short escalating pause only (the part stays a discovered, suitable candidate and is reconsidered when the pause ends)
function U.Fail(S, rec)
local p = rec.P
local cd = S.Cand[p]
local fl = (cd and cd.Fails or 0) + 1
if cd then cd.Fails = fl end
if rec.Rsv then
if S.Reserve and S.Reserve.P == p then S.Reserve = nil end
U.Note(("Could not take ownership of \"%s\" even after teleporting (the server did not hand it over). Searching for another part..."):format((p.Name:gsub("[<>&]", "?"))))
end
U.Release(S, rec, math.min(5 * fl, 25))
end
function U.Validate(S)
local now = os.clock()
local pr = S.Prompt
if pr and pr.Fixed then
U.PromptText(S, pr)
elseif pr then
local cd = S.Cand[pr.P]
local rec = S.Rec[pr.P]
local root = S.Root
-- the window only closes when it can no longer be answered meaningfully; selecting other candidates never touches it
if not (root and root.Parent) or not C.Confirm or not C.AutoSearch or not U.On(S, pr.F) or not cd or cd.Own or (rec and rec.Owned) or cd.D <= U.PromptMin or #S.G[pr.F] >= U.Want[pr.F] or not U.Valid(S, pr.P) then
U.ClosePrompt(S)
S.NextPrompt = now + 1
else
U.PromptText(S, pr)
end
end
for p, rec in S.Rec do
if not p.Parent or not p:IsDescendantOf(workspace) or p.Anchored then
U.Release(S, rec, 20)
elseif rec.Errs and rec.Errs >= 30 then
U.Release(S, rec, 15)
elseif rec.AM ~= p.AssemblyMass and U.Taint(rec) then
-- a Tool part or a character got welded into this assembly: let go cleanly, nothing of theirs is touched
U.Release(S, rec, 30)
elseif not U.On(S, rec.F) then
U.Release(S, rec, 0)
elseif rec.Gr and rec.GrSince and now - rec.GrSince > 2 then
U.Release(S, rec, 30)
else
local ar = p.AssemblyRootPart
local dup = false
if ar ~= rec.AR then
if rec.AR and S.Asm[rec.AR] == rec then S.Asm[rec.AR] = nil end
local o = ar and S.Asm[ar]
if o and o ~= rec then
dup = true
else
rec.AR = ar
if ar then S.Asm[ar] = rec end
end
end
if dup then
-- the part joined an assembly another record already drives: one writer per assembly
U.Release(S, rec, 3)
elseif not rec.Owned then
if rec.WasLive then
-- ownership lost after it was confirmed: keep the record and its feature slot while the engine may hand ownership back, release only after RecoverWait
local lim = (rec.F == "Limbs" and not rec.Proven) and U.ProbeWait or U.RecoverWait
if now - (rec.LostAt or rec.LastOwned) > lim then U.Release(S, rec, 8) end
elseif rec.WaitAt then
if now - rec.WaitAt > U.OwnWait then U.Fail(S, rec) end
elseif now - rec.Born > U.ReserveTTL then
-- reserved but the character never came within reach: give the slot back
U.Release(S, rec, 4)
end
end
end
end
end

-- ===== multi-method part detector =====
-- Stage 1 Discovery: spatial radius + forward box queries (every collision group), incremental Workspace scan, DescendantAdded queue, periodic re-rating.
-- Stage 2 Suitability: per-feature fit + proximity / front / independence / ownership rank. Stage 3 Ownership: only read, never required to register a candidate.
-- Stage 4 Acquisition: U.Claim / U.Drive (unchanged) move parts only once the engine reports we simulate them.
function U.Drop(S, c)
local list = S.CL
local i = c.I
if i and list[i] == c then
local last = list[#list]
list[i] = last
last.I = i
list[#list] = nil
end
S.Cand[c.P] = nil
end
-- parts ahead of the character weigh most; beside / behind still count (never zero, never an exclusion)
function U.FrontW(dot)
if dot >= 0.5 then return 1 end
if dot >= -0.25 then return 0.55 + 0.45 * (dot + 0.25) / 0.75 end
return 0.3 + 0.25 * (dot + 1) / 0.75
end
-- register or refresh one candidate (no ownership needed); returns the record, or nil when the part is not / no longer a candidate
function U.Eval(S, p, now)
local c = S.Cand[p]
if p.Anchored then
if c then U.Drop(S, c) end
return nil
end
local o = S.Origin
local pos = p.Position
local dx, dy, dz = pos.X - o.X, pos.Y - o.Y, pos.Z - o.Z
local d = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz)
if d > C.Radius * U.Slack * (c and 1.25 or 1) then
if c then U.Drop(S, c) end
return nil
end
local n, why = U.Filter(S, p)
if n or (why ~= "player character" and why ~= "living character / NPC" and why ~= "own rig") then
local dg = S.Diag
if d < dg.D or dg.P == p or now - dg.T > 4 then dg.P, dg.D, dg.T, dg.Why = p, d, now, why end
end
if not n then
if c then U.Drop(S, c) end
return nil
end
if not c then
c = {P = p, Born = now, Wings = 0, Tail = 0, Halo = 0, Limbs = 0, Fails = 0}
S.Cand[p] = c
local list = S.CL
local i = #list + 1
list[i] = c
c.I = i
end
local s = p.Size
c.Seen, c.Chk, c.D, c.N, c.Size, c.DY = now, now, d, n, s, dy
c.Len = math.max(s.X, s.Y, s.Z)
local fl = math.sqrt(dx * dx + dz * dz)
c.Dot = fl > 3 and (dx * S.FX + dz * S.FZ) / fl or 1
c.Front = U.FrontW(c.Dot)
c.Ind = n == 1 and 1 or (n <= 4 and 0.75 or (n <= 12 and 0.5 or 0.3))
c.Own = p.ReceiveAge == 0
if c.Own then c.Fails = 0 end
local vis = p.Transparency >= 0.9 and 0.3 or 1
c.Wings = U.Score(s, "Wings") * vis
c.Tail = U.Score(s, "Tail") * vis
c.Halo = U.Score(s, "Halo") * vis
c.Limbs = U.Score(s, "Limbs") * vis
return c
end
function U.Take(S, list, now)
local pass, stamp = S.Pass, S.Stamp
for i = 1, #list do
local p = list[i]
if stamp[p] ~= pass then
stamp[p] = pass
if p.Anchored then
local c = S.Cand[p]
if c then U.Drop(S, c) end
else
U.Eval(S, p, now)
end
end
end
end
-- character origin + flat forward direction from the current root CFrame; a big move / teleport re-rates every cached candidate
function U.Context(S, now)
local root = S.Root
if not (root and root.Parent) then
S.Ready = false
return
end
local cf = root.CFrame
local o = cf.Position
local lv = cf.LookVector
local fx, fz = lv.X, lv.Z
local m = math.sqrt(fx * fx + fz * fz)
if m > 0.05 then S.FX, S.FZ = fx / m, fz / m end
S.Origin = o
S.Ready = true
local lo = S.LastO
if not lo or (o - lo).Magnitude > 20 then
S.LastO = o
if lo then
for _, c in S.CL do c.Chk = 0 end
S.NextNear = 0
end
end
end
-- spatial queries only return parts whose collision group collides with the query group, so also query once for every group that Default would miss
function U.Groups(S, now)
local gs = S.Groups
if gs and now < S.GroupsAt then return gs end
S.GroupsAt = now + 20
gs = {"Default"}
local PS = U.PS
local ok, all = pcall(PS.GetRegisteredCollisionGroups, PS)
if ok and type(all) == "table" then
local names = {}
for _, g in all do
if type(g) == "table" and type(g.name) == "string" then names[#names + 1] = g.name end
end
for _, h in names do
if h ~= "Default" then
local okc, hit = pcall(PS.CollisionGroupsAreCollidable, PS, h, "Default")
if okc and not hit then
local q
local okh, selfc = pcall(PS.CollisionGroupsAreCollidable, PS, h, h)
if okh and selfc then
q = h
else
for _, x in names do
local okx, cx = pcall(PS.CollisionGroupsAreCollidable, PS, h, x)
if okx and cx then
q = x
break
end
end
end
if q and not table.find(gs, q) then gs[#gs + 1] = q end
end
end
end
end
S.Groups = gs
return gs
end
-- spatial pass: radius sphere around the character + a forward box (wide for left / right, tall for ground-level and overhead parts)
function U.Query(S, now, far)
local root = S.Root
local o = S.Origin
local rc = Reanimate.Character
local op = S.OP
op.FilterDescendantsInstances = rc and {root.Parent, rc} or {root.Parent}
S.Pass += 1
local R = C.Radius * U.Slack
local rad, bx, by, bz
if far then
rad = R
bx, by, bz = math.clamp(R * 0.8, 80, 400), math.clamp(R * 0.5, 60, 250), R
else
rad = math.min(U.NearQ, R)
bx, by, bz = 60, 60, math.min(90, R)
end
local box = CFrame.lookAt(o, o + Vector3.new(S.FX, 0, S.FZ)) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -bz * 0.5)
local bs = Vector3.new(bx, by, bz)
local groups = U.Groups(S, now)
for i = 1, #groups do
op.CollisionGroup = groups[i]
local ok, list = pcall(workspace.GetPartBoundsInRadius, workspace, o, rad, op)
if ok then U.Take(S, list, now) end
ok, list = pcall(workspace.GetPartBoundsInBox, workspace, box, bs, op)
if ok then U.Take(S, list, now) end
end
end
-- parts reported by DescendantAdded (new spawns, streamed-in parts)
function U.Drain(S, now)
local q, h, t = S.Q, S.QH, S.QT
if h >= t then return end
local t0 = os.clock()
local k = 0
while h < t do
h += 1
local d = q[h]
q[h] = nil
if d then U.Eval(S, d, now) end
k += 1
if k % 32 == 0 and os.clock() - t0 > 0.002 then break end
end
S.QH = h
if h >= t then S.QH, S.QT = 0, 0 end
end
-- incremental Workspace descendant scan: catches parts the spatial queries cannot return (CanQuery off, odd collision groups, query limits)
function U.Scan(S, now)
local list = S.List
if not list then
if now < S.NextList then return end
list = workspace:GetDescendants()
S.List, S.ListI = list, 0
end
local i, n = S.ListI, #list
local t0 = os.clock()
while i < n do
i += 1
local d = list[i]
if d:IsA("BasePart") and not d.Anchored then U.Eval(S, d, now) end
if i % 64 == 0 and os.clock() - t0 > 0.002 then break end
end
S.ListI = i
if i >= n then
S.List = nil
S.Scans += 1
S.NextList = now + math.max(8, n / 5000)
end
end
-- round-robin re-rating of cached candidates: drops destroyed / anchored / grounded / out-of-range ones, refreshes distance, direction and ownership
function U.Revalidate(S, now)
local list = S.CL
local n = #list
if n == 0 then
S.VI = 1
return
end
local i = S.VI
local t0 = os.clock()
for k = 1, 120 do
if i > n then i = 1 end
local c = list[i]
if c and now - c.Chk >= U.Stale then
if U.Eval(S, c.P, now) then i += 1 else n = #list end
else
i += 1
end
if k % 16 == 0 and os.clock() - t0 > 0.002 then break end
end
S.VI = i
end
-- rank cached candidates, claim the best ones for open feature slots, and offer a teleport for suitable parts that are out of reach.
-- Reach = the engine can plausibly hand ownership over without moving (U.Near + front bonus) or already reports us as simulator (c.Own).
-- Parts already owned and the part just accepted through the prompt skip the pending cap, so unconfirmable parts can never starve them; failed parts sit out an escalating cooldown and then compete again.
function U.Choose(S, now)
local rv = S.Reserve
if rv and (rv.Until < now or not rv.P.Parent) then
S.Reserve = nil
rv = nil
end
local open, tc, tf, tv = S.Open, S.TC, S.TF, S.TV
local top = U.Top
for _, f in U.Feats do open[f] = (U.On(S, f) and #S.G[f] < U.Want[f]) and true or false end
for i = 1, top do
tc[i] = false
tv[i] = -math.huge
end
local nf, ns = 0, 0
local bc, bfe, bv
local pc, pf, pv
local rad = math.max(C.Radius, 1)
local conf = C.Confirm and not S.NoTp and not S.Prompt and now >= S.NextPrompt
for _, c in S.CL do
nf += 1
local p = c.P
local base = (1 - math.min(c.D / rad, 1)) * 0.22 + c.Front * 0.12 + c.Ind * 0.08 + (c.Own and 0.08 or 0) - math.min(c.Fails, 6) * 0.04
local f1, v1, f2, v2
for _, f in U.Feats do
if U.On(S, f) then
local fit = c[f]
if fit > U.Min then
local v = fit * 0.45 + base
if f == "Limbs" then v += 0.4 end
if rv and rv.P == p and rv.F == f then v += 10 end
if not v1 or v > v1 then f1, v1 = f, v end
if open[f] and (not v2 or v > v2) then f2, v2 = f, v end
end
end
end
if f1 then
ns += 1
if not S.Rec[p] then
if not bv or v1 > bv then bc, bfe, bv = c, f1, v1 end
if f2 and U.Free(S, p, now) then
local reach = U.Near + 25 * c.Front
if c.Own or c.D <= reach then
if v2 > tv[top] then
local j = top
while j > 1 and v2 > tv[j - 1] do
tc[j], tf[j], tv[j] = tc[j - 1], tf[j - 1], tv[j - 1]
j -= 1
end
tc[j], tf[j], tv[j] = c, f2, v2
end
end
-- teleport offer: suitable, usable by an enabled feature, not simulated by us, and either out of reach or already failed once; no failed attempt is needed first
if conf and not c.Own and c.D > U.PromptMin and (c.D > reach or c.Fails > 0) and (S.Seen[p] or 0) < now and not (rv and rv.P == p) then
local pw = v2 + (c[f2] >= U.Hot and 5 or 0)
if not pv or pw > pv then pc, pf, pv = c, f2, pw end
end
end
end
end
end
local k = S.Cnt
k.Found, k.Suit = nf, ns
S.Best, S.BestF = bc, bfe
-- claims are staggered: only a few parts wait for their first ownership confirmation at once, so a burst of new parts never destabilises the ones already attached
local pend = 0
for _, r in S.Rec do
if not r.WasLive then pend += 1 end
end
local hold = pc and pc.P or (S.Prompt and S.Prompt.P)
for i = 1, top do
local c = tc[i]
if not c then break end
local f = tf[i]
local p = c.P
if p ~= hold and open[f] and #S.G[f] < U.Want[f] and not S.Rec[p] and not p.Anchored then
local rsv = rv ~= nil and rv.P == p
if c.Own or rsv or pend < U.MaxPend then
local rec = U.Claim(S, p, f, now, rsv)
if rec then
if not c.Own then pend += 1 end
if rsv then
S.Reserve = nil
rv = nil
end
else
-- could not be reserved (assembly already driven / tainted): rest briefly so it cannot occupy a top slot every pass
S.Cool[p] = now + 3
end
end
end
end
if pc and not S.Prompt then
if not U.ShowPrompt(S, pc, pf) then S.NextPrompt = now + 3 end
end
end
function U.Sim(S)
local sr = math.max(1000, #Players:GetPlayers() * 1000)
pcall(function() Player.SimulationRadius = sr end)
pcall(function() Player.MaximumSimulationRadius = sr end)
pcall(sethiddenproperty, Player, "SimulationRadius", sr)
pcall(sethiddenproperty, Player, "MaximumSimulationRadius", sr)
end
-- ===== lifecycle states (reporting only; nothing here changes behaviour) =====
-- ATTACHED is reported only while the part attachment, target attachment, AlignPosition, AlignOrientation and VectorForce all exist and are enabled
function U.Attached(rec)
local p, ap, ao, vf, a0, a1 = rec.P, rec.AP, rec.AO, rec.VF, rec.A, rec.T
if not (rec.Owned and ap and ao and vf and a0 and a1) then return false end
return ap.Parent == p and ao.Parent == p and vf.Parent == p and a0.Parent == p and a1.Parent ~= nil and ap.Enabled and ao.Enabled and vf.Enabled
end
function U.Phase(rec)
if rec.Owned then return U.Attached(rec) and "ATTACHED" or "OWNERSHIP CONFIRMED" end
if rec.WasLive then return "OWNERSHIP LOST" end
if rec.WaitAt then return "AWAITING OWNERSHIP" end
return "RESERVED"
end
function U.PartState(S, p, now)
local rec = S.Rec[p]
if rec then return U.Phase(rec) end
if (S.Declined[p] or 0) > now then return "REJECTED (declined by you)" end
local rv = S.Reserve
if rv and rv.P == p then return "RESERVED (teleport accepted)" end
local cd = S.Cand[p]
if not cd then return "DISCOVERED" end
local suit = false
for _, f in U.Feats do
if U.On(S, f) and cd[f] > U.Min then
suit = true
break
end
end
if not suit then return "DISCOVERED (no enabled feature fits it)" end
local cl = (S.Cool[p] or 0) - now
if cl > 0 then return ("SUITABLE (retry in %ds)"):format(math.ceil(cl)) end
return "SUITABLE"
end
-- lightweight status line in the Part Finder config
function U.Status(S, now)
local lab = U.StatusLabel
if not lab or not lab.Parent then return end
local rsv, awt, acq, att, lost = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
for _, rec in S.Rec do
if rec.Owned then
acq += 1
if U.Attached(rec) then att += 1 end
elseif rec.WasLive then
lost += 1
elseif rec.WaitAt then
awt += 1
else
rsv += 1
end
end
local state
if not C.AutoSearch then
state = "OFF (Automatic Part Search is disabled)"
elseif S.List then
state = "SEARCHING - scanning Workspace " .. math.floor(S.ListI / math.max(#S.List, 1) * 100) .. "%"
else
state = "SEARCHING - nearby queries + new-part watch active"
end
local bt = "none yet"
local b = S.Best
if b and S.BestF then
bt = ("%s - %d studs - %s (%d%% fit) - %s"):format((b.P.Name:gsub("[<>&]", "?")), math.floor(b.D), U.Label[S.BestF], math.floor(b[S.BestF] * 100), U.PartState(S, b.P, now))
end
local dg = S.Diag
local dt = "none seen within the search radius yet"
if dg.P and now - dg.T <= 6 then
local p = dg.P
local pn = (p.Name:gsub("[<>&]", "?"))
if dg.Why then
dt = ("%s - %d studs - REJECTED: %s"):format(pn, math.floor(dg.D), dg.Why)
else
local cd = S.Cand[p]
local ft = cd and ("fit W%d T%d H%d"):format(math.floor(cd.Wings * 100), math.floor(cd.Tail * 100), math.floor(cd.Halo * 100)) or "fit ?"
dt = ("%s - %d studs - %s (%s, receive age %.1fs)"):format(pn, math.floor(dg.D), U.PartState(S, p, now), ft, p.ReceiveAge)
end
end
local k = S.Cnt
local txt = ("Detector: %s\nDiscovered: %d | Suitable: %d | Pending: %d (reserved %d, awaiting ownership %d) | Acquired: %d | Attached: %d | Ownership lost: %d\nBest candidate: %s\nNearest unanchored part: %s"):format(state, k.Found, k.Suit, rsv + awt, rsv, awt, acq, att, lost, bt, dt)
if txt ~= S.LastStatus then
S.LastStatus = txt
pcall(function() lab.Text = txt end)
end
end
function U.Guard(S, name, fn, ...)
local ok, err = pcall(fn, ...)
if not ok and not S.Warned then
S.Warned = true
warn("[Unanchored Reanimation] part finder error (" .. name .. "): " .. tostring(err))
end
end
function U.Tick(S)
local now = os.clock()
U.Guard(S, "validate", U.Validate, S)
if now >= S.NextSim then
S.NextSim = now + 1.5
U.Guard(S, "simulation radius", U.Sim, S)
end
U.Guard(S, "context", U.Context, S, now)
if S.Ready and C.AutoSearch then
local fp = S.ForceEval
if fp then
S.ForceEval = nil
U.Guard(S, "recheck target", U.Eval, S, fp, now)
end
U.Guard(S, "new parts", U.Drain, S, now)
U.Guard(S, "recheck", U.Revalidate, S, now)
U.Guard(S, "scan", U.Scan, S, now)
if now >= S.NextNear then
S.NextNear = now + 0.75
local far = now >= S.NextFar
if far then S.NextFar = now + 3 end
U.Guard(S, "query", U.Query, S, now, far)
end
if now >= S.NextChoose and not S.Scout then
S.NextChoose = now + 0.5
U.Guard(S, "choose", U.Choose, S, now)
end
end
if now >= S.NextStatus then
S.NextStatus = now + 0.5
U.Guard(S, "status", U.Status, S, now)
end
end
function U.Worker(S)
while S.Alive do
task.wait(0.2)
if not S.Alive then break end
U.Guard(S, "tick", U.Tick, S)
end
end

function U.Cleanup()
local S = U.Run
if not S then return end
U.Run = nil
Reanimate.HiddenLimbs = nil
S.Alive = false
for _, c in S.Conns do pcall(c.Disconnect, c) end
U.ClosePrompt(S)
for _, rec in S.Rec do U.Release(S, rec, 0) end
for _, grp in S.G do table.clear(grp) end
table.clear(S.Asm)
table.clear(S.Q)
table.clear(S.Cand)
table.clear(S.CL)
S.List = nil
pcall(function()
if U.StatusLabel then U.StatusLabel.Text = "Detector: idle (Unanchored Reanimation is not running)" end
end)
if S.PrevSleep ~= nil then pcall(function() settings().Physics.AllowSleep = S.PrevSleep end) end
if S.PrevSim then pcall(sethiddenproperty, Player, "SimulationRadius", S.PrevSim) end
if S.PrevMax then pcall(sethiddenproperty, Player, "MaximumSimulationRadius", S.PrevMax) end
end
function U.Init(extra, mode)
U.Cleanup()
local S = {Alive = true, Extra = extra == true, Scout = mode == "scout", LimbRun = mode == "limbs", NoTp = mode == "limbs" and U.NoTp == true, T0 = os.clock(), Rec = {}, G = {Wings = {}, Tail = {}, Halo = {}, Limbs = {}}, Conns = {}, NextPrompt = 0, RefDirty = true, Asm = {}, RefChkAt = 0}
S.Cand, S.CL, S.VI = {}, {}, 1
S.Q, S.QH, S.QT = {}, 0, 0
S.Pass, S.Scans, S.ListI, S.NextList = 0, 0, 0, 0
S.NextSim, S.NextNear, S.NextFar, S.NextChoose, S.NextStatus = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
S.FX, S.FZ, S.Origin = 0, -1, Vector3.zero
S.Cnt, S.Open, S.TC, S.TF, S.TV = {Found = 0, Suit = 0, Pend = 0}, {}, {}, {}, {}
S.Cool = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
S.Declined = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
S.Seen = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
S.Stamp = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
S.Diag = {D = math.huge, T = -1e9}
pcall(function()
local ph = settings().Physics
S.PrevSleep = ph.AllowSleep
ph.AllowSleep = false
end)
S.OP = OverlapParams.new()
S.OP.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
S.OP.MaxParts = 0
local ch = U.HostChar(S)
S.Root = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local ok1, r1 = pcall(gethiddenproperty, Player, "SimulationRadius")
local ok2, r2 = pcall(gethiddenproperty, Player, "MaximumSimulationRadius")
S.PrevSim = ok1 and r1 or nil
S.PrevMax = ok2 and r2 or nil
U.Run = S
S.Conns[1] = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt) U.Guard(S, "step", U.Step, S, dt) end)
S.Conns[2] = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(d)
if C.AutoSearch and d:IsA("BasePart") then
local t = S.QT + 1
S.QT = t
S.Q[t] = d
if t - S.QH > 20000 then
table.clear(S.Q)
S.QH, S.QT = 0, 0
end
end
end)
task.spawn(U.Worker, S)
end
function U.Start()
if C.Limbs then return U.StartLimbs() end
local ok, err = pcall(U.Init)
if not ok then
warn("[Unanchored Reanimation] failed to start: " .. tostring(err))
U.Note("Unanchored Reanimation failed to start (see console): " .. tostring(err))
end
Reanimate.Starting = false
repeat task.wait() until Reanimate.Stopping
pcall(U.Cleanup)
Reanimate.Stopping = false
end

-- ===== Unanchored Limb Reanimation: its own lifecycle (U.LimbLife); the used unanchored parts become the limbs of the fake character. LimbReanimator.Start is never called =====
-- Torso Offset: 1 Nooby's Method, 2 RootPart Streamed (Limb mode "Keep RootPart Streamed"), 3 RootPart in Sky/Void (Limb modes "RootPart in sky" / "RootPart in void")
function U.NoobyRoot(root)
return CFrame.new(root.Position + Vector3.new(8, -8, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(math.pi * 0.5, 0, 0)
end
function U.TorsoMode()
local t = C.TorsoOffset
if t == 2 then return 2 end
if t == 3 then return math.random(2) == 1 and 1 or 5 end
return nil
end
-- best suitable limb part: fit + closeness + how many other suitable parts sit around it (so the teleport lands in a spot with enough parts for all the limbs)
function U.ScoutPick(S)
local list, ok = S.CL, {}
for i = 1, #list do
local c = list[i]
if c.Limbs > U.Min and (S.Declined[c.P] or 0) < os.clock() and #ok < 400 then ok[#ok + 1] = c end
end
local best, bv
for i = 1, #ok do
local c = ok[i]
local near = 0
for j = 1, #ok do
if i ~= j and (ok[j].P.Position - c.P.Position).Magnitude < 40 then near += 1 end
end
local v = c.Limbs * 0.45 + math.min(near, 5) * 0.12 + (1 - math.min(c.D / math.max(C.Radius, 1), 1)) * 0.1
if not bv or v > bv then best, bv = c, v end
end
return best
end
-- before the reset: look for a suitable part, ask YES / NO, teleport only on YES. NO or nothing found: reanimation simply continues from the current position
function U.Scout()
U.NoTp = false
if not C.AutoSearch then
U.Note("Automatic Part Search is OFF - unanchored limbs can only use parts that are already in reach.")
return
end
if not pcall(U.Init, false, "scout") then return end
local S = U.Run
if not (S and S.Scout) then return end
local t0, pick = os.clock(), nil
while S.Alive and os.clock() - t0 < 7 do
task.wait(0.5)
if os.clock() - t0 >= 2.5 then
pick = U.ScoutPick(S)
if pick then break end
end
end
if not (S.Alive and pick) then
U.Note("No suitable unanchored part found within the search radius - reanimating from your current position.")
U.Cleanup()
return
end
if pick.D <= U.PromptMin then
U.Cleanup()
return
end
local done, yes = false, false
local shown = U.ShowPrompt(S, pick, "Limbs", {Title = "Teleport to a suitable unanchored part before reanimation?", Cb = function(v) yes, done = v, true end})
if not shown then
U.Note("Could not show the teleport question - reanimating from your current position.")
U.NoTp = true
U.Cleanup()
return
end
local tw = os.clock()
while not done and S.Alive and os.clock() - tw < 120 do task.wait(0.1) end
if not done then U.ClosePrompt(S) end
U.NoTp = not yes
if yes then task.wait(1.2) end
U.Cleanup()
end
function U.LimbLife()
U.Scout()
local torso = U.TorsoMode()
local LimbMapping = Util.LoadMap("d_limbmap.lua")
local LR = LimbReanimator
table.clear(LR.FlingTargets)
table.clear(LR._TempNotFling)
local voidPos = Vector3.new(math.random(-2048, 2048), math.random(-500, -100) + FallenPartsDestroyHeight, math.random(-2048, 2048))
local skyPos = Vector3.new(math.random(-2048, 2048), math.random(1000, 2000), math.random(-2048, 2048))
local initCF
do
local ch = Player.Character
local h = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
local r = h and h.RootPart
if r then
initCF = r.CFrame
if h:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then
h:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, true)
h:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead)
end
end
end
local parts, unknown, fakeTools, conns = {}, {}, {}, {}
local info = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local kids = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local vz, idcf, lastspawn = Vector3.zero, CFrame.identity, 0
local limbSet = {Head = true, Torso = true, ["Left Arm"] = true, ["Right Arm"] = true, ["Left Leg"] = true, ["Right Leg"] = true}
local function kid(parent, key, cls)
local c = kids[parent]
if not c then
c = {}
kids[parent] = c
end
local o = c[key]
if not o or o.Parent ~= parent then
if cls then o = parent:FindFirstChildOfClass(key) else o = parent:FindFirstChild(key) end
c[key] = o
end
return o
end
-- the real Tool stays untouched in the real character; the fake rig only gets a mirror of it
local function newFakeTool()
local ft = Instance.new("Tool")
ft.Name = "faketool"
local h = Instance.new("Part")
h.Name, h.Transparency, h.Color, h.CanCollide, h.Massless = "Handle", 1, Color3.new(0, 0, 1), false, true
h.Parent = ft
ft.Parent = Reanimate.Character
local g = Instance.new("Weld")
g.Name = "RightGrip"
g.Parent = h
g.Part0 = Reanimate.Character and Reanimate.Character:FindFirstChild("Right Arm")
g.Part1 = h
g.C0 = RIGHTGRIP_C0
Util.LinkDestroyI2C(ft, ft:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Grip"):Connect(function() g.C1 = ft.Grip end))
g.C1 = ft.Grip
return ft
end
local function onDesc(v)
if v:IsA("BasePart") then
if not table.find(parts, v) then
table.insert(parts, v)
v.CanCollide = false
v:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanCollide"):Connect(function()
if v.CanCollide then v.CanCollide = false end
end)
end
elseif v:IsA("Motor6D") then
repeat task.wait() until (not v:IsDescendantOf(workspace)) or (v.Part0 and v.Part1)
if not v:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then return end
local a, b = v.Part0.Name, v.Part1.Name
for _, map in LimbMapping do
if map.Part0 == a and map.Part1 == b then
map.Reference = v
return
end
end
table.insert(unknown, v)
elseif v:IsA("Animator") then
task.defer(v.Destroy, v)
elseif v:IsA("LocalScript") and v.Parent == Player.Character then
v.Enabled = false
v:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Enabled"):Connect(function() if v.Enabled then v.Enabled = false end end)
v:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Disabled"):Connect(function() if not v.Disabled then v.Disabled = true end end)
elseif v:IsA("Tool") and v.Parent == Player.Character then
if not fakeTools[v] then
fakeTools[v] = true
local fake = newFakeTool()
fake.Grip = v.Grip
local h0 = v:FindFirstChild("Handle")
if h0 then fake.Handle.Size = h0.Size end
Util.LinkDestroyI2C(fake, RunService.PreSimulation:Connect(function()
if v.Parent == Player.Character then
fake.Grip = v.Grip
local h1 = v:FindFirstChild("Handle")
if h1 then fake.Handle.Size = h1.Size end
else
fake:Destroy()
fakeTools[v] = nil
end
end))
Util.LinkDestroyI2C(fake, v.ChildAdded:Connect(function(c)
if c.ClassName == "StringValue" and c.Name == "toolanim" then
local w = Instance.new("StringValue")
w.Name = "toolanim"
w.Value = c.Value
w.Parent = fake
Debris:AddItem(c, 1)
Debris:AddItem(w, 1)
end
end))
fake.Handle.Touched:Connect(function(t)
local h1 = v:FindFirstChild("Handle")
if h1 and t and h1:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and t:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
h1.CanTouch = true
pcall(firetouchinterest, h1, t, 0)
end
end)
fake.Handle.TouchEnded:Connect(function(t)
local h1 = v:FindFirstChild("Handle")
if h1 and t and h1:IsDescendantOf(workspace) and t:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
h1.CanTouch = true
pcall(firetouchinterest, h1, t, 1)
end
end)
end
end
end
local function onChar(character)
local camcfr = Camera.CFrame
RunService.PreRender:Once(function()
RunService.PreAnimation:Wait()
Camera.CFrame = camcfr
end)
lastspawn = os.clock()
table.clear(parts)
table.clear(unknown)
for _, map in LimbMapping do
map.Reference = nil
map.RG, map.RT = nil, nil
end
character.DescendantAdded:Connect(onDesc)
for _, v in character:GetDescendants() do task.spawn(onDesc, v) end
local hum = character:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
local an = hum and hum:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("Animator")
if an then an:Destroy() end
if not Reanimate.UseLoadAnimationHook then
local t0, a = os.clock(), character:FindFirstChild("Animate")
while not a and os.clock() - t0 < 10 do
task.wait(0.1)
a = character:FindFirstChild("Animate")
end
if a then a:Destroy() end
end
end
local lastRoot = {}
local refDirty, refAt = true, 0
local function update(rig, root, rootcf, rootvel, ft, fcf)
if not root:IsGrounded() then
if ft then
Util.Fling.ApplyRoot(root, ft, fcf)
pcall(sethiddenproperty, root, "PhysicsRepRootRef", Util.Fling.UseGlue() and Util.PredictionFlingPart(ft.Target) or nil)
refDirty = true
else
root.CFrame = rootcf + Vector3.new(0, 0, math.random(0, 1) * 0.005)
root.Velocity, root.RotVelocity = rootvel, vz
local n = os.clock()
if refDirty or n - refAt > 0.5 then
refDirty, refAt = false, n
pcall(sethiddenproperty, root, "PhysicsRepRootRef", nil)
end
end
end
for _, v in unknown do Util.SetMotor6DTransform(v, idcf) end
local pose = Reanimate.SafeLimbPose
for _, map in LimbMapping do
local v = map.Reference
if v then
if ft then
Util.SetMotor6DTransform(v, idcf)
else
map.CFrame = pose(map, v, rig, root)
Util.SetMotor6DOffset(v, Reanimate.LimbHider.Void(map, map.CFrame))
end
end
end
end
local rbStart, rbCount, rbLast, rbGaveUp = 0, 0, 0, false
local function frame()
RunService.PreSimulation:Wait()
workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = 0 / 0
do
local rc = Reanimate.Character
if rc and not rc:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
local now = os.clock()
if now - rbStart > 20 then rbStart, rbCount = now, 0 end
if rbCount < 3 and now - rbLast > 0.5 then
rbCount += 1
rbLast = now
pcall(Util.Notify, "Unanchored Limb Reanimation: the fake character was removed from the workspace by something else, rebuilding it (" .. rbCount .. "/3).")
Reanimate.CreateCharacter()
elseif not rbGaveUp and rbCount >= 3 then
rbGaveUp = true
pcall(Util.Notify, "Unanchored Limb Reanimation: the game keeps removing the fake character; not rebuilding it any more.")
end
end
end
local character = Player.Character
local hum, root, okay = nil, nil, false
if character then
hum = kid(character, "Humanoid", true)
if hum then
if hum.AutoRotate then hum.AutoRotate = false end
if hum.WalkSpeed < 1 then hum.WalkSpeed = 16 end
if hum.JumpPower < 1 then hum.JumpPower = 50 end
root = Reanimate.ResolveRealRoot(character, hum)
if root and hum:GetState() ~= Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead then
hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Physics)
okay = LR.FlingTargets[1] == nil
end
end
end
local rig = Reanimate.Character
if not rig then return end
local rrh, rroot, rtor = kid(rig, "Humanoid", true), kid(rig, "HumanoidRootPart"), kid(rig, "Torso")
if Camera and rrh and Camera.CameraSubject ~= rrh then Camera.CameraSubject = rrh end
local nowc, fpb, ltm = os.clock(), Reanimate.FirstPersonBody and true or false, Reanimate.LocalTransparencyModifier
for _, v in parts do
if v.CanCollide then v.CanCollide = false end
local inf = info[v]
if not inf or nowc - inf.at > 1 or inf.fpb ~= fpb then
inf = {at = nowc, fpb = fpb, tool = v:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Tool") ~= nil, head = false}
if fpb and v.Name ~= "Head" then
local w = v:FindFirstChild("AccessoryWeld")
inf.head = (w and w:IsA("Weld") and w.Part1 and w.Part1.Name == "Head") and true or false
end
info[v] = inf
end
if not inf.tool then
if v.Velocity ~= vz then v.Velocity = vz end
if v.RotVelocity ~= vz then v.RotVelocity = vz end
local l = ltm
if fpb and v.Name ~= "Head" and not inf.head then l = 0 end
if v.LocalTransparencyModifier ~= l then v.LocalTransparencyModifier = l end
end
end
local wantT = okay and 1 or Reanimate.PlaceholderTransparency
for _, v in rig:GetChildren() do
if limbSet[v.Name] and v:IsA("BasePart") and v.Transparency ~= wantT then v.Transparency = wantT end
end
local rootcf, rootvel = CFrame.new(voidPos), vz
if character and hum and root then
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
local t = os.clock()
if rroot and rtor then
if torso == nil then
local okO, ocf = pcall(U.NoobyRoot, rroot, rtor)
rootcf = (okO and typeof(ocf) == "CFrame") and ocf or CFrame.new(rroot.Position + Vector3.new(0, -16, 0))
elseif torso == 1 then
rootcf = CFrame.new(voidPos)
elseif torso == 5 then
rootcf = CFrame.new(skyPos)
end
if torso == 2 or (torso ~= nil and workspace.StreamingEnabled) then
rootcf = CFrame.new(rroot.Position + Vector3.new(0, -16, 0))
end
local q = LR.FlingTargets
for qi = #q, 2, -1 do
local qt = q[qi] and q[qi].Target
if typeof(qt) == "Instance" then
local qp = Util.Fling.GetPart(qt)
local gone = (not qp) or (not qp:IsDescendantOf(workspace))
if not gone then
local pp = qp.Position
gone = pp.X ~= pp.X or pp.Y ~= pp.Y or pp.Z ~= pp.Z
end
if gone then table.remove(q, qi) end
end
end
local ft, fcf = Util.Fling.Step(q, t, Util.Fling.UseGlue() and 0.5 or 2)
if ft then
local fpos, frv = fcf.Position, fcf.RightVector
if fpos.X ~= fpos.X or fpos.Y ~= fpos.Y or fpos.Z ~= fpos.Z or fpos.Magnitude > 1e7 or frv.X ~= frv.X then
table.remove(q, 1)
ft, fcf = nil, idcf
end
end
update(rig, root, rootcf, rootvel, ft, fcf)
if ft then
Util.Fling.ApplyHumanoid(hum, ft, lastspawn)
else
if Util.Fling.Method == 4 then pcall(sethiddenproperty, hum, "MoveDirectionInternal", Vector3.zero) end
pcall(sethiddenproperty, hum, "NetworkHumanoidState", Enum.HumanoidStateType.Flying.Value)
end
end
end
RunService.PreRender:Wait()
if Reanimate:ShouldRotationType() then Reanimate:CameraLockCharacter() end
if character and hum and root then update(rig, root, rootcf, rootvel, nil, idcf) end
end
local function shutdown(failed)
pcall(U.Cleanup)
for _, c in conns do pcall(c.Disconnect, c) end
table.clear(LR.FlingTargets)
table.clear(LR._TempNotFling)
pcall(function()
if type(FallenPartsDestroyHeight) == "number" and FallenPartsDestroyHeight == FallenPartsDestroyHeight then workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight = FallenPartsDestroyHeight end
end)
local ch = Player.Character
local h = ch and ch:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if h then
pcall(function()
h:SetStateEnabled(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead, true)
h:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Dead)
end)
end
if not failed then Reanimate.Stopping = false end
pcall(Reanimate.DestroyCharacter)
end
local okRun, errRun = pcall(function()
conns[1] = Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(onChar)
local got = false
local rc = Player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function() got = true end)
local timeout = 15
pcall(function() timeout = math.clamp((tonumber(Players.RespawnTime) or 5) + 10, 15, 40) end)
local w0 = os.clock()
while not got and os.clock() - w0 < timeout do task.wait() end
rc:Disconnect()
if not got then
pcall(Util.Notify, "Unanchored Limb Reanimation: the game did not respawn your character after the reset (waited " .. math.floor(os.clock() - w0) .. "s). Continuing in placeholder mode so you can still move and jump.")
local cur = Player.Character
if cur then task.spawn(onChar, cur) end
end
Reanimate.CreateCharacter(initCF)
local okI, errI = pcall(U.Init, true, "limbs")
if not okI then
warn("[Unanchored Reanimation] limb system failed to start: " .. tostring(errI))
U.Note("Unanchored limb system failed to start (see console): " .. tostring(errI))
end
Reanimate.Starting = false
local fails, lastErr, lastErrT = 0, nil, 0
while not Reanimate.Stopping do
local ok, e = pcall(frame)
if ok then
fails = 0
else
fails += 1
e = tostring(e)
if e ~= lastErr or os.clock() - lastErrT > 10 then
lastErr, lastErrT = e, os.clock()
warn("[Unanchored Limb Reanimation] frame step failed (x" .. fails .. "): " .. e)
pcall(Util.Notify, "Unanchored Limb Reanimation frame error (see console): " .. e)
end
end
end
end)
shutdown(not okRun)
if not okRun then error(errRun, 0) end
end
function U.StartLimbs()
local ok, err = pcall(U.LimbLife)
if not ok then
warn("[Unanchored Reanimation] limb reanimation failed to start: " .. tostring(err))
U.Note("Unanchored limb reanimation failed to start (see console): " .. tostring(err))
pcall(Reanimate.DestroyCharacter)
Reanimate.Starting = false
repeat task.wait() until Reanimate.Stopping
Reanimate.Stopping = false
end
end

-- ===== Extra Unanchored Reanimation (runs inside the Limb / Ragdoll reanimator, hosted on the FAKE character) =====
-- host character of the formation: the real character (standalone method) or the fake rig (extra mode)
function U.HostChar(S)
if S.Extra then return Reanimate.Character end
return Player.Character
end
-- the Limb reanimator sets FallenPartsDestroyHeight to NaN every frame; fall back to the value saved at startup
function U.VoidY()
local y = workspace.FallenPartsDestroyHeight
if y ~= y then y = FallenPartsDestroyHeight end
if type(y) ~= "number" or y ~= y then y = -500 end
return y
end
-- PhysicsRepRootRef must point at a part that exists for everyone; the fake rig only exists on this client, so extra mode references a part of the REAL character instead
function U.RepSource(S, root)
if not S.Extra then return root end
local ch = Player.Character
return ch and (ch:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or ch:FindFirstChild("Torso") or ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")) or nil
end
function U.StartExtra()
local lim = U.LimbFlag == true
if not C.Extra and not lim then return end
local ok, err = pcall(U.Init, true, lim and "limbs" or nil)
if not ok then
warn("[Unanchored Reanimation] extra mode failed to start: " .. tostring(err))
U.Note("Extra Unanchored Reanimation failed to start (see console): " .. tostring(err))
end
end
function U.StopExtra()
if U.Run and U.Run.Extra then pcall(U.Cleanup) end
end
function U.LimbRunning()
local cur = Reanimate.Current
local n = cur and cur.Name
return cur ~= nil and cur.Running == true and (n == "Limbs" or n == "Ragdoll" or n == "Servo-Joint" or n == "Hybrid-Joint") and Reanimate.Character ~= nil and not Reanimate.Stopping
end
-- switch flipped while a Limb / Ragdoll run is active: start or stop the extra system immediately
function U.ExtraToggle()
if C.Extra then
if U.LimbRunning() and not (U.Run and U.Run.Extra) then U.StartExtra() end
elseif not (U.Run and U.Run.LimbRun) then
U.StopExtra()
end
end
function U.ConfigExtra(parent)
local function refresh() task.defer(function() pcall(Util.RefreshReanimatorConfig) end) end
UI.CreateText(parent, "-=+ Extra Unanchored Reanimation +=-", 12, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
UI.CreateSwitch(parent, "Extra Unanchored Reanimation", C.Extra).Changed:Connect(function(v)
C.Extra = v
U.ExtraToggle()
refresh()
end)
UI.CreateText(parent, "^^^ ON: while this reanimator runs, loose unanchored parts from the map become Wings, a Tail and a Halo Aura on your FAKE character (not the real one). Parts are only moved once the engine confirms you simulate them. Same options as Unanchored Reanimation.", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
if C.Extra then U.Options(parent) end
end
function U.HiderActive() return C.Limbs == true end
function U.Config(parent)
UI.CreateText(parent, "Unanchored Reanimation: no tools, hats, reset or respawn. Finds loose unanchored parts near you, only moves them once the engine confirms you simulate them, and turns them into Wings, a Tail and a Halo.", 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
local function refresh() task.defer(function() pcall(Util.RefreshReanimatorConfig) end) end
UI.CreateSwitch(parent, "Use unanchored parts as tools", C.Tools).Changed:Connect(function(v)
C.Tools = v
end)
UI.CreateSwitch(parent, "Use unanchored parts as limbs", C.Limbs).Changed:Connect(function(v)
C.Limbs = v

local function squeeze(w, keep)
	local out, prev, run = {}, nil, 0
	for c in w:gmatch(".") do
		if c == prev then run = run + 1 else prev, run = c, 1 end
		if run <= keep then out[#out + 1] = c end
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end
local function dd(w) return squeeze(w, 1) end
local function squeeze3(w)
	local out, i, n = {}, 1, #w
	while i <= n do
		local c, j = w:sub(i, i), i
		while j < n and w:sub(j + 1, j + 1) == c do j = j + 1 end
		local len = j - i + 1
		out[#out + 1] = c:rep(len >= 3 and 1 or len)
		i = j + 1
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end
local function clamp(v, a, b) return v < a and a or (v > b and b or v) end
