-- ---------- pure analyser: text -> category, confidence (0-0.99), flags ----------
function CM.Analyze(raw, ctx)
	ctx = ctx or {}
	local R = {conf = 0, hits = {}}
	local low = tostring(raw or ""):lower()
	local s, n = low:gsub("\226\128[\139-\143]", "")
	local evad = n > 0
	s, n = s:gsub("\226\129\160", "") evad = evad or n > 0
	s, n = s:gsub("\239\187\191", "") evad = evad or n > 0
	local joke = s:find("\240\159\152\130", 1, true) or s:find("\240\159\164\163", 1, true) or s:find("\240\159\152\134", 1, true) or s:find("/j%f[%A]") or s:find("/s%f[%A]")
	local _, nq = s:gsub('"', "")
	local quote = nq >= 2 or s:find("\226\128\156", 1, true) ~= nil
	s = s:gsub("\226\128\153", ""):gsub("'", ""):gsub("[\128-\255]", " ")
	s = s:gsub("%S+", function(ch)
		local core = ch:gsub("[%._%-%*]+$", "")
		if #core >= 5 and #core % 2 == 1 then
			for i = 1, #core do
				local c = core:sub(i, i)
				if i % 2 == 1 then if not c:find("%a") then return end elseif not c:find("[%._%-%*]") then return end
			end
			evad = true
			return (core:gsub("[%._%-%*]", ""))
		end
	end)
	s = s:gsub("[^%w%s@$!%+#]", " ")
	local _, hn = s:gsub("#", "")
	R.hash = hn >= 4 and hn / math.max(#s, 1) >= 0.3
	local toks, alts, leeted = {}, {}, {}
	for t in s:gmatch("%S+") do
		t = t:gsub("^[!%+@#]+", ""):gsub("[!%+#@]+$", "")
		if t ~= "" then
			local lt, alt = t, nil
			if t:find("%a") and t:find("[%d@$!%+]") then
				lt = t:gsub("[%d@$!%+]", LEET)
				if t:find("1", 1, true) then alt = t:gsub("[%d@$!%+]", function(c) return c == "1" and "l" or LEET[c] end) end
			end
			toks[#toks + 1], alts[#toks] = lt, alt
			leeted[#toks] = lt ~= t
		end
	end
	if #toks == 0 then return R end
	-- spaced-out letters ("i d i o t", "f.u.c.k") become one extra token
	local ex, exl, run = {}, {}, {}
	local function flush() if #run >= 3 then ex[#ex + 1] = table.concat(run) end run = {} end
	for i = 1, #toks do if #toks[i] == 1 and toks[i]:find("%w") then run[#run + 1] = toks[i] else flush() end end
	flush()
	local ct = {}
	for i, t in ipairs(toks) do ct[i] = PRON[t] or squeeze3(t) end
	local flat = " " .. table.concat(ct, " "):gsub(" you self ", " yourself ") .. " "
	local mention
	local function getMention() if mention == nil then mention = (ctx.names and ctx.names(low)) or false end return mention end
	local function directed(i)
		if getMention() then return true end
		for j = math.max(1, i - 3), math.min(#ct, i + 3) do if ct[j] == "you" or ct[j] == "yourself" then return true end end
		return false
	end
	local function before(i, st, k) for j = math.max(1, i - k), i - 1 do if st[ct[j]] then return true end end return false end
	local sc = {Harassment = 0, Threat = 0, ["Sexual content"] = 0, ["Hate speech"] = 0}
	local function bump(cat, v, why) if v > sc[cat] then sc[cat] = v end R.hits[#R.hits + 1] = why end
	local function look(db, i)
		local e = db[dd(toks[i])]
		if e and #toks[i] >= e.len then return e, leeted[i] end
		if alts[i] then e = db[dd(alts[i])] if e and #alts[i] >= e.len then return e, true end end
	end
	local function lookEx(db) for _, t in ipairs(ex) do local e = db[dd(t)] if e and #t >= e.len then return e end end end
	local insN, sexN = 0, 0
	local selfHarm = false
	for i = 1, #toks do
		local e, lv = look(INSDB, i)
		if e then
			local w = e.w
			if directed(i) then w = w + .4 elseif before(i, SELF, 2) then w = w * .3 else w = w * .8 end
			if before(i, NEG, 2) then w = w - .45 end
			insN = insN + 1
			if lv then evad = true end
			bump("Harassment", w + (insN > 1 and math.min(.2, .1 * (insN - 1)) or 0), "insult:" .. e.word)
		end
		e, lv = look(SEXDB, i)
		if e then
			sexN = sexN + 1
			if lv then evad = true end
			bump("Sexual content", e.w + math.min(.3, .15 * (sexN - 1)) + (directed(i) and .25 or 0), "sexual:" .. e.word)
		end
		e, lv = look(HATEDB, i)
		if e then
			if lv then evad = true end
			bump("Hate speech", e.w, "slur")
		end
		for _, st in ipairs(STEMS) do
			local t = squeeze(toks[i], 2)
			if t:sub(1, #st[1]) == st[1] and t:sub(1, 8) ~= "retardan" then bump("Hate speech", st[2] + (st[3] and directed(i) and .25 or 0), "slur") if leeted[i] then evad = true end break end
		end
		if GROUPS[ct[i]] then
			for j = math.max(1, i - 4), math.min(#ct, i + 4) do
				if HV1[ct[j]] and j ~= i then bump("Hate speech", before(j, NEG, 2) and .2 or .9, "group:" .. ct[j]) break end
				if HV2[ct[j]] and j ~= i then bump("Hate speech", before(j, NEG, 2) and .2 or .8, "group:" .. ct[j]) break end
			end
		end
		if VERBS[ct[i]] and before(i, SUBJ, 3) then
			local hit = false
			for j = i + 1, math.min(#ct, i + 4) do if TGT[ct[j]] then hit = true break end end
			if hit or getMention() then
				local v = .75
				for _, w in ipairs(ct) do if REALCTX[w] then v = v + .2 break end end
				for _, w in ipairs(ct) do if GAMECTX[w] then v = v - .25 break end end
				bump("Threat", v, "threat:" .. ct[i])
			end
		end
		if DOXV[ct[i]] and directed(i) then bump("Threat", .85, "dox") end
	end
	for _, t in ipairs(ex) do
		local q = SQ[t]
		if q then evad = true selfHarm = selfHarm or q[3] == true bump(q[1], q[2], "spaced-phrase") end
	end
	for _, t in ipairs(ex) do
		local w = exSub(INSW, t)
		if w then evad = true bump("Harassment", INS[w] + ((getMention() or flat:find(" you ", 1, true)) and .4 or .1), "insult-spaced") end
		w = exSub(SEXW, t)
		if w then evad = true bump("Sexual content", SEX[w], "sexual-spaced") end
	end
	local e = lookEx(HATEDB) if e then evad = true bump("Hate speech", e.w, "slur-spaced") end
	for _, t in ipairs(ex) do
		for _, st in ipairs(STEMS) do if t:sub(1, #st[1]) == st[1] then evad = true bump("Hate speech", st[2], "slur-spaced") break end end
	end
	for _, p in ipairs(HP) do if flat:find(p[1], 1, true) then bump("Harassment", p[2], "phrase") end end
	for _, p in ipairs(TP) do if flat:find(p, 1, true) then selfHarm = true bump("Threat", .9, "selfharm") break end end
	for _, p in ipairs(TP2) do if flat:find(p[1], 1, true) then bump("Threat", p[2], "threat-phrase") end end
	for _, p in ipairs(SP) do if flat:find(p[1], 1, true) then bump("Sexual content", p[2], "solicit") end end
	for _, p in ipairs(HP2) do if flat:find(p[1], 1, true) then bump("Hate speech", p[2], "hate-phrase") end end
	-- context: quotes / discussion, jokes, game talk, questions
	local hasQ, hasJ, hasG = quote, joke, false
	for _, t in ipairs(ct) do
		if QUOTE[t] then hasQ = true end
		if JOKE[t] then hasJ = true end
		if GAMECTX[t] then hasG = true end
	end
	local qmark = low:find("%?%s*$") and (ct[1] == "what" or ct[1] == "why" or ct[1] == "is" or ct[1] == "does" or ct[1] == "how" or ct[1] == "can" or ct[1] == "should" or ct[1] == "do")
	local best, bcat = 0, nil
	for cat, v in pairs(sc) do
		if v > 0 then
			if hasQ then v = v - ((cat == "Threat" and selfHarm) and .3 or .45) end
			if hasJ then v = v - (cat == "Harassment" and .2 or (cat == "Threat" and .15 or .1)) end
			if hasG and cat == "Harassment" and not directed(1) then v = v - .2 end
			if qmark and cat ~= "Threat" then v = v - .15 end
			if evad and v > .4 then v = v + .08 end
			if v > best then best, bcat = v, cat end
		end
	end
	R.cat, R.conf, R.evad = bcat, clamp(best, 0, .99), evad
	R.target = mention or nil
	return R
end

-- ---------- helpers ----------
local function clean(text)
	text = tostring(text or ""):gsub("&lt;", "<"):gsub("&gt;", ">"):gsub("&quot;", '"'):gsub("&apos;", "'"):gsub("&amp;", "&"):gsub("<[^>]+>", "")
	return (text:gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")):sub(1, 300)
end
local function say(text)
	local ok = false
	local TCS = game:GetService("TextChatService")
	if TCS.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService then
		local ch = TCS:FindFirstChild("TextChannels")
		ch = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")
		if ch then ok = pcall(function() ch:SendAsync(text) end) end
	else
		local ev = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("DefaultChatSystemChatEvents")
		local rq = ev and ev:FindFirstChild("SayMessageRequest")
		if rq then ok = pcall(function() rq:FireServer(text, "All") end) end
	end
	return ok
end
local function clip(t)
	local f = setclipboard or toclipboard
	if f then return pcall(f, t) end
	return false
end
local function names(speakerId)
	return function(lowerText)
		for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if pl.UserId ~= speakerId then
				local a, b = pl.Name:lower(), pl.DisplayName:lower()
				if (#a >= 4 and lowerText:find(a, 1, true)) or (#b >= 4 and lowerText:find(b, 1, true)) then return pl end
			end
		end
	end
end
function CM.List()
	local l = {}
	for _, f in pairs(CM.Flags) do l[#l + 1] = f end
	table.sort(l, function(a, b) return a.t > b.t end)
	return l
end
function CM.Pending()
	local c = 0
	for _, x in ipairs(CM.Queue) do if x.status == "queued" then c = c + 1 end end
	return c
end
function CM.Review()
	local c = 0
	for _, x in ipairs(CM.CaseList) do if x.status == "pending" then c = c + 1 end end
	return c
end
function CM.Cur()
	local f = CM.Sel and CM.Flags[CM.Sel]
	if f then return f end
	CM.Sel = nil
	if next(CM.Flags) then return nil, "no player is selected - tap Next Flagged Player" end
	return nil, "no players have been flagged yet"
end
function CM.Ordered()
	local l = {}
	for _, f in pairs(CM.Flags) do l[#l + 1] = f end
	table.sort(l, function(a, b) return (a.seq or 0) < (b.seq or 0) end)
	return l
end
function CM.Refresh()
	pcall(function()
		if CM.UI.AR then
			local on = cfg("AutoReport") == true
			CM.UI.AR.Text = on and ("Auto Report: <b>ON</b> - watching public chat. Violations at 85%+ become cases; nothing is sent until you confirm with Report With Jarvis." .. (CM.Review() > 0 and ("  <b>" .. CM.Review() .. " awaiting review.</b>") or "") .. (CM.Pending() > 0 and ("  <b>" .. CM.Pending() .. " queued.</b>") or ""))
				or "Auto Report: <b>OFF</b> - no automatic report assistance."
		end
		if CM.UI.Status then
			CM.UI.Status.Text = ("Monitoring: <b>%s</b> | Flagged: %d | Awaiting review: %d | Reports queued: %d"):format(CM.Active and "ON" or "OFF", #CM.List(), CM.Review(), CM.Pending())
		end
		if CM.UI.Show then CM.UI.Show() end
	end)
end

-- ---------- evidence / reporting: every submission needs the user's confirmation; states: pending -> queued -> submitting -> submitted | failed | manual | left | duplicate | dismissed | cancelled ----------
CM.Seq = CM.Seq or 0
local TERMINAL = {submitted = true, failed = true, dismissed = true, left = true, duplicate = true, cancelled = true}
CM.StatusText = {pending = "awaiting your confirmation", queued = "queued", submitting = "submitting", submitted = "submitted", failed = "failed (nothing sent)", manual = "finish it in the Roblox report menu", dismissed = "dismissed", left = "player left", duplicate = "already reported", cancelled = "cancelled"}
local function stamp() return os.date("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") end
local function pct(v) return type(v) == "number" and (tostring(math.floor(v * 100 + .5)) .. "%") or "n/a" end
CM.Pct = pct
local function snap(list, cat)
	local out = {}
	for _, e in ipairs(list or {}) do
		if cat == nil or e.cat == nil or e.cat == cat then out[#out + 1] = {ts = e.ts, text = e.text, cat = e.cat, conf = e.conf} end
	end
	return out
end
local function newId() CM.Seq = CM.Seq + 1 return ("JV-%04d"):format(CM.Seq) end
local function activeFor(uid)
	for i = #CM.CaseList, 1, -1 do
		local c = CM.CaseList[i]
		if c.uid == uid and not TERMINAL[c.status] then return c end
	end
end
CM.ActiveFor = activeFor
CM.LastSubmit = CM.LastSubmit or -1e9
CM.Reported = CM.Reported or {}
CM.NextOK, CM.RateGap, CM.MaxTries = 0, 20, 3
local REASON = {["Harassment"] = "Bullying", ["Threat"] = "Bullying", ["Sexual content"] = "Swearing", ["Hate speech"] = "Bullying"}
local function evText(f, n)
	local out = {}
	for i = #f.ev, 1, -1 do
		if f.ev[i].cat == nil or f.ev[i].cat == f.cat then out[#out + 1] = f.ev[i] end
		if #out >= n then break end
	end
	return out
end
function CM.Ident(f)
	local pl = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(f.uid)
	local name = f.name
	if name == nil or name == "" then name = pl and pl.Name end
	if name == nil or name == "" then name = "User" .. tostring(f.uid) end
	local disp = f.display
	if disp == nil or disp == "" then disp = pl and pl.DisplayName end
	if disp == nil or disp == "" then disp = name end
	return tostring(name), tostring(disp)
end
local function trim()
	local i = 1
	while #CM.CaseList > 20 and i <= #CM.CaseList do
		local d = CM.CaseList[i]
		if TERMINAL[d.status] then
			table.remove(CM.CaseList, i)
			if CM.Cases[d.key] == d then CM.Cases[d.key] = nil end
		else
			i = i + 1
		end
	end
end
local function caseFor(f)
	if f.key and f.id then return f end
	local cat = tostring(f.cat or "Other")
	local key = tostring(f.uid) .. ":" .. cat
	local c = (not f.manual and activeFor(f.uid)) or CM.Cases[key]
	if not c then
		c = {key = key, id = newId(), uid = f.uid, cat = cat, conf = f.conf, status = "pending", tries = 0, t = os.clock(), stamp = stamp(), ev = snap(f.ev, cat)}
		CM.Cases[key] = c
		CM.CaseList[#CM.CaseList + 1] = c
		trim()
	end
	c.name, c.display = CM.Ident(f)
	if f.manual then c.manual = true end
	if f.conf and (c.conf == nil or (c.status == "pending" and f.conf > c.conf)) then c.conf = f.conf end
	if #c.ev == 0 and f.ev then c.ev = snap(f.ev, c.cat) end
	return c
end
CM.CaseFor = caseFor
function CM.CaseOf(f)
	if f.key and f.id then return f end
	return activeFor(f.uid) or CM.Cases[tostring(f.uid) .. ":" .. tostring(f.cat or "Other")]
end
local function reopen(c, f)
	c.status, c.tries, c.user, c.confirmUntil, c.t = "pending", 0, nil, nil, os.clock()
	c.id, c.stamp = newId(), stamp()
	if f and not f.key and f.ev and #f.ev > 0 then c.ev = snap(f.ev, c.cat) end
end
local function dequeue(c)
	for i = #CM.Queue, 1, -1 do if CM.Queue[i] == c then table.remove(CM.Queue, i) end end
end
local function enqueue(c, front)
	for _, q in ipairs(CM.Queue) do
		if q == c then return true end
		if q.uid == c.uid and q.status == "queued" then return false, q end
	end
	if front then table.insert(CM.Queue, 1, c) else CM.Queue[#CM.Queue + 1] = c end
	return true
end
function CM.Evidence(f)
	local c = caseFor(f)
	local name, disp = CM.Ident(c)
	local out = {"Public chat evidence collected by Jarvis (visible chat only)",
		("Case: %s | Status: %s | Detected: %s"):format(tostring(c.id), tostring(c.status), tostring(c.stamp)),
		("Player: %s (@%s) UserId %s"):format(disp, name, tostring(c.uid)),
		("Category: %s | Confidence: %s"):format(tostring(c.cat), pct(c.conf))}
	for _, e in ipairs(c.ev) do out[#out + 1] = ("[%s] %s"):format(tostring(e.ts), tostring(e.text)) end
	if #c.ev == 0 then out[#out + 1] = "(no public chat lines were recorded for this case)" end
	return table.concat(out, "\n"), c
end
function CM.CopyEvidence(f)
	if not f then notify("Chat Moderation: select a flagged player first") return false end
	local text, c = CM.Evidence(f)
	CM.LastEvidence = text
	if clip(text) then
		notify(("Evidence for %s (@%s) copied, case %s"):format(c.display, c.name, c.id))
		return true
	end
	notify(("Chat Moderation: this executor cannot copy to the clipboard. Read the evidence for %s (@%s) in the flagged-player details above."):format(c.display, c.name))
	return false
end
-- The Roblox menu is a supported, documented thing to open; the player-report screen is not. Jarvis opens the menu, verifies it, and guides the rest.
function CM.OpenReport(f, prefix)
	if not f then notify("Chat Moderation: select a flagged player first") return false end
	local text, c = CM.Evidence(f)
	CM.LastEvidence = text
	CM.ReportTarget = {uid = c.uid, name = c.name, display = c.display, cat = c.cat, conf = c.conf, id = c.id}
	local copied = clip(text) and true or false
	local here = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(c.uid) ~= nil
	task.spawn(function()
		local okSet = pcall(function() GuiService:SetMenuIsOpen(true) end)
		local state = nil
		if okSet then
			state = false
			for _ = 1, 8 do
				local okR, v = pcall(function() return GuiService.MenuIsOpen end)
				if not okR then state = nil break end
				if v == true then state = true break end
				task.wait(0.1)
			end
		end
		local lead = state == true and "The Roblox menu is open (it is the system menu, not the report screen)." or "Jarvis could not confirm that the Roblox menu opened - open it yourself (Esc, or the Roblox icon on mobile)."
		notify((prefix and (prefix .. " ") or "") .. ("%s Then tap Report > choose %s (@%s) > pick the category (suggested: %s).%s%s Case %s."):format(lead, c.display, c.name, tostring(c.cat), copied and " Evidence copied." or " Evidence could not be copied - read it in the details above.", here and "" or " They already left, so Roblox may not list them.", c.id))
	end)
	return true
end
-- ---------- reporting queue: FIFO, one submission per rate-limit window ----------
function CM.Wait()
	return math.max(0, math.max(CM.LastSubmit + CM.RateGap, CM.NextOK) - os.clock())
end
local function attempt(c)
	local pl = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(c.uid)
	if not pl then return "left" end
	local parts = {}
	for _, e in ipairs(evText(c, 3)) do parts[#parts + 1] = "[" .. tostring(e.text) .. "]" end
	local msg = ("Reported by user via Jarvis after review: %s%s%s"):format(tostring(c.cat), c.manual and "" or (" (flagged " .. pct(c.conf) .. ")"), #parts > 0 and (". Recent public chat: " .. table.concat(parts, " ")) or "")
	msg = msg:sub(1, 280)
	local err
	for _, reason in ipairs({REASON[c.cat] or "Other", "Other"}) do
		local ok, e = pcall(function() Players:ReportAbuse(pl, reason, msg) end)
		if ok then return "sent" end
		err = tostring(e)
		local l = err:lower()
		if l:find("rate", 1, true) or l:find("too many", 1, true) or l:find("429", 1, true) or l:find("retry", 1, true) or l:find("cooldown", 1, true) or l:find("throttl", 1, true) then break end
	end
	local l = (err or ""):lower()
	local wait = tonumber(l:match("retry[^%d]*(%d+)") or l:match("wait[^%d]*(%d+)") or l:match("(%d+)%s*sec"))
	if l:find("rate", 1, true) or l:find("too many", 1, true) or l:find("429", 1, true) or l:find("retry", 1, true) or l:find("cooldown", 1, true) or l:find("throttl", 1, true) then return "retry", wait, err end
	if l:find("permission") or l:find("not allowed") or l:find("disabled") or l:find("cannot be called") or l:find("blocked") or l:find("capability") or l:find("security") or l:find("lacking") then return "blocked", nil, err end
	return "retry", wait, err
end
function CM.Process(c)
	local now = os.clock()
	if not c.user then
		CM.SetStatus(c, "pending")
		notify(("Chat Moderation: %s (@%s) needs your confirmation first - nothing was sent"):format(c.display, c.name))
		return false, "pending"
	end
	if CM.Reported[c.uid] and now - CM.Reported[c.uid] < 1800 then
		CM.SetStatus(c, "duplicate")
		notify(("Chat Moderation: %s (@%s) was already reported in the last 30 minutes, nothing was sent"):format(c.display, c.name))
		return false, "dup"
	end
	CM.SetStatus(c, "submitting")
	local okA, res, wait, err = pcall(attempt, c)
	if not okA then res, wait, err = "retry", nil, res end
	now = os.clock()
	if res == "sent" then
		CM.LastSubmit = now
		CM.Reported[c.uid] = now
		c.by = "jarvis"
		CM.SetStatus(c, "submitted")
		notify(("Report call for %s (@%s) completed without an error (case %s). Roblox gives scripts no confirmation, so Jarvis cannot verify it was accepted."):format(c.display, c.name, c.id))
		return true
	end
	c.tries = (c.tries or 0) + 1
	local short = (tostring(err or "unknown error"):gsub("%s+", " ")):sub(1, 90)
	if res == "retry" and c.tries < CM.MaxTries then
		local w = math.clamp(wait or 30 * c.tries, 1, 900)
		CM.NextOK = now + w
		CM.SetStatus(c, "queued")
		enqueue(c, true)
		notify(("Chat Moderation: report for %s (@%s) was not accepted (%s). It is queued and will retry in about %d seconds (attempt %d of %d)"):format(c.display, c.name, short, math.ceil(w), c.tries + 1, CM.MaxTries))
		CM.Pump()
		return false, "queued"
	end
	if res == "left" then
		CM.SetStatus(c, "left")
		notify(("Chat Moderation: %s (@%s) left before the report could be sent, nothing was sent"):format(c.display, c.name))
		return false, "left"
	end
	if res == "blocked" then
		CM.SetStatus(c, "manual")
		CM.OpenReport(c, ("Roblox does not let scripts submit this report on this client (%s). Nothing was sent."):format(short))
		return false, "manual"
	end
	CM.SetStatus(c, "failed")
	CM.OpenReport(c, ("Report for %s (@%s) failed after %d attempts (%s). Nothing was sent."):format(c.display, c.name, c.tries, short))
	return false, "failed"
end
local function nextCase()
	for i, q in ipairs(CM.Queue) do
		if q.status ~= "queued" or not q.user then table.remove(CM.Queue, i) return nextCase() end
		return q, i
	end
end
local function step()
	local c, i = nextCase()
	if not c then return false end
	local w = CM.Wait()
	if w > 0 then task.wait(math.min(w, 5) + 0.05) return true end
	table.remove(CM.Queue, i)
	local ok, err = pcall(CM.Process, c)
	if not ok then
		if c.status == "submitting" or c.status == "queued" then CM.SetStatus(c, "failed") end
		notify(("Chat Moderation: the report for %s (@%s) hit an internal error (%s). Use Report With Jarvis to retry."):format(tostring(c.display), tostring(c.name), tostring(err):sub(1, 60)))
	end
	return true
end
function CM.Pump()
	if CM.Pumping then return end
	CM.Pumping = true
	task.spawn(function()
		local errs = 0
		while true do
			local ok, more = pcall(step)
			if not ok then
				local c = CM.Queue[1]
				if not c then break end
				errs = errs + 1
				if errs >= 3 then
					table.remove(CM.Queue, 1)
					pcall(CM.SetStatus, c, "failed")
					notify(("Chat Moderation: the queued report for %s (@%s) failed internally (%s). Use Report With Jarvis to retry."):format(tostring(c.display), tostring(c.name), tostring(more):sub(1, 60)))
					errs = 0
				end
				task.wait(1)
			elseif not more then
				break
			end
		end
		CM.Pumping = false
		CM.Refresh()
	end)
end
function CM.Left(uid)
	for _, c in ipairs(CM.CaseList) do
		if c.uid == uid and (c.status == "queued" or c.status == "pending" or c.status == "manual") then
			CM.SetStatus(c, "left")
			notify(("Chat Moderation: %s (@%s) left the server, so case %s was closed. The evidence is still available under Copy Evidence."):format(tostring(c.display), tostring(c.name), tostring(c.id)))
		end
	end
end
function CM.Submit(f, confirmed)
	if not f then notify("Chat Moderation: select a flagged player first") return false, "none" end
	if type(f.uid) ~= "number" then notify("Chat Moderation: this entry has no valid UserId, nothing was sent") return false, "invalid" end
	local c = caseFor(f)
	local who = ("%s (@%s)"):format(c.display, c.name)
	if not Players:GetPlayerByUserId(c.uid) then
		if not TERMINAL[c.status] then CM.SetStatus(c, "left") end
		notify(("Chat Moderation: %s has left the server, nothing was sent. Copy Evidence still works."):format(who))
		return false, "left"
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	if c.status == "submitting" then notify(("Chat Moderation: the report for %s is already being submitted"):format(who)) return false, "queued" end
	if c.status == "queued" then
		c.user = true
		notify(("Chat Moderation: the report for %s is already queued and will be sent when the rate limit allows"):format(who))
		CM.Pump()
		return false, "queued"
	end
	if CM.Reported[c.uid] and now - CM.Reported[c.uid] < 1800 then notify(("Chat Moderation: you already reported %s in the last 30 minutes, nothing was sent"):format(who)) return false, "dup" end
	if TERMINAL[c.status] then reopen(c, f) end
	if not confirmed then
		if not (c.confirmUntil and now <= c.confirmUntil) then
			c.confirmUntil = now + 20
			notify(("Confirm report: %s | %s | %s confidence | %d chat line(s) | case %s. Press Report With Jarvis again within 20 seconds to submit, or Dismiss Case. Nothing has been sent yet."):format(who, tostring(c.cat), pct(c.conf), #c.ev, c.id))
			CM.Refresh()
			return false, "confirm"
		end
	end
	c.confirmUntil = nil
	c.user, c.tries = true, 0
	local ahead = false
	for _, q in ipairs(CM.Queue) do if q.status == "queued" and q.user then ahead = true break end end
	if ahead or CM.Wait() > 0 then
		local okq, other = enqueue(c)
		if not okq then notify(("Chat Moderation: a report for %s is already queued"):format(who)) return false, "queued" end
		CM.SetStatus(c, "queued")
		notify(("Chat Moderation: report for %s is queued and will be sent when the rate limit allows (about %d seconds)"):format(who, math.ceil(CM.Wait())))
		CM.Pump()
		return false, "queued"
	end
	return CM.Process(c)
end
function CM.SetStatus(f, st)
	if not f then notify("Chat Moderation: select a flagged player first") return end
	local c = caseFor(f)
	c.status, c.t = st, os.clock()
	if st ~= "queued" then dequeue(c) end
	CM.Refresh()
	return c
end
function CM.Dismiss(f)
	if not f then notify("Chat Moderation: select a flagged player first") return false end
	local c = caseFor(f)
	local who = ("%s (@%s)"):format(c.display, c.name)
	if c.status == "submitting" then notify(("Chat Moderation: the report for %s is being submitted right now, it cannot be dismissed"):format(who)) return false end
	if c.status == "submitted" then notify(("Chat Moderation: case %s is already marked submitted"):format(c.id)) return false end
	if c.status == "dismissed" then notify(("Chat Moderation: case %s is already dismissed"):format(c.id)) return false end
	c.confirmUntil = nil
	CM.SetStatus(c, "dismissed")
	notify(("Case %s dismissed: %s. Nothing was sent."):format(c.id, who))
	return true
end
function CM.MarkSubmitted(f)
	if not f then notify("Chat Moderation: select a flagged player first") return false end
	local c = caseFor(f)
	local who = ("%s (@%s)"):format(c.display, c.name)
	if c.status == "submitted" then notify(("Chat Moderation: case %s is already marked submitted"):format(c.id)) return false end
	if c.status == "submitting" then notify(("Chat Moderation: Jarvis is submitting the report for %s right now - wait for the result"):format(who)) return false end
	c.by, c.user, c.confirmUntil = "user", true, nil
	CM.Reported[c.uid] = os.clock()
	CM.SetStatus(c, "submitted")
	notify(("Case %s marked as submitted by you: %s. Roblox gives scripts no confirmation, so Jarvis cannot verify it."):format(c.id, who))
	return true
end
function CM.SendManual(f)
	local now = os.clock()
	local t = CM.PendingSay
	if not t and f then
		local _, disp = CM.Ident(f)
		t = "Jarvis: @" .. disp .. ", please keep the conversation respectful."
	end
	if not t then notify("Chat Moderation: no reminder is waiting and no player is selected") return false end
	if now - CM.LastSay < 10 then notify(("Chat Moderation: wait %d more seconds before sending another reminder"):format(math.ceil(10 - (now - CM.LastSay)))) return false end
	if say(t) then CM.PendingSay, CM.LastSay = nil, now notify("Reminder sent to public chat") return true end
	clip(t)
	notify("Chat is unavailable here; the reminder was copied instead")
	return false
end

-- ---------- per-message handling (also the unit-test entry point) ----------
local function remind(f)
	if cfg("CModOn") ~= true or cfg("CModSay") ~= true then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - CM.LastSay < 45 or (f.say and now - f.say < 300) then return end
	local log, kept = CM.SayLog, {}
	for _, t in ipairs(log) do if now - t < 600 then kept[#kept + 1] = t end end
	CM.SayLog = kept
	if #kept >= 5 then return end
	local recent = 0
	for _, t in ipairs(f.hist) do if now - t < 600 then recent = recent + 1 end end
	local text = recent >= 3 and "Jarvis: Reminder: Harassment and inappropriate language are not acceptable here."
		or (recent == 2 and ("Jarvis: @" .. f.display .. ", please keep the conversation respectful.") or "Jarvis: Please keep the chat respectful and appropriate for everyone.")
	f.say, CM.LastSay = now, now
	kept[#kept + 1] = now
	CM.LastReminder = text
	task.spawn(function()
		if not say(text) then CM.PendingSay = text notify("Jarvis could not send the chat reminder. Use Chat Moderation > Send Reminder Manually.") end
	end)
end
local function prompt(f, R)
	if cfg("AutoReport") ~= true or R.conf + 1e-6 < REPORT_MIN or not REPORTABLE[R.cat] then return end
	if not Players:GetPlayerByUserId(f.uid) then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	if CM.Reported[f.uid] and now - CM.Reported[f.uid] < 1800 then return end
	if activeFor(f.uid) then return end
	for _, q in ipairs(CM.Queue) do if q.uid == f.uid then return end end
	local key = tostring(f.uid) .. ":" .. R.cat
	local old = CM.Cases[key]
	if old and TERMINAL[old.status] and old.status ~= "left" and now - old.t < 1800 then return end
	if old then
		for i = #CM.CaseList, 1, -1 do if CM.CaseList[i] == old then table.remove(CM.CaseList, i) end end
		CM.Cases[key] = nil
	end
	local name, disp = CM.Ident(f)
	local c = caseFor({uid = f.uid, name = name, display = disp, cat = R.cat, conf = R.conf, ev = f.ev})
	if not CM.Cur() then CM.Sel = f.uid end
	notify(("Auto Report: %s (@%s) flagged for %s (%d%% confidence), case %s. Nothing has been sent - select them under Chat Moderation and press Report With Jarvis to confirm."):format(disp, name, R.cat, math.floor(R.conf * 100 + .5), c.id))
end
function CM.Handle(uid, name, display, text, mid)
	local key = mid or (uid .. ":" .. tostring(text))
	if CM.Seen[key] then return end
	CM.Seen[key] = true
	local q = CM.SeenQ
	q[#q + 1] = key
	if #q > SEEN_MAX then CM.Seen[table.remove(q, 1)] = nil end
	text = clean(text)
	if #text < 2 or text:lower():sub(1, 7) == "jarvis:" then return end
	local now = os.clock()
	local R = CM.Analyze(text, {names = names(uid)})
	local st = CM.Strikes[uid] or {}
	local kept = {}
	for _, x in ipairs(st) do if now - x.t < 180 then kept[#kept + 1] = x end end
	CM.Strikes[uid] = kept
	if R.hash and not R.cat then
		kept[#kept + 1] = {t = now, hash = true}
		local h = 0
		for _, x in ipairs(kept) do if x.hash and now - x.t < 90 then h = h + 1 end end
		if h >= 3 then R.cat, R.conf = "Filter bypass", .76 end
	end
	if not R.cat then return end
	if R.cat ~= "Filter bypass" then
		if R.conf >= .55 then
			local prior = 0
			for _, x in ipairs(kept) do if not x.hash then prior = prior + 1 end end
			R.conf = math.min(.99, R.conf + math.min(.2, .07 * prior))
			kept[#kept + 1] = {t = now, cat = R.cat}
		end
	end
	if R.conf + 1e-6 < LEVELS[clamp(math.floor(tonumber(cfg("CModConf")) or 2), 1, 3)] then return end
	local f = CM.Flags[uid]
	if not f then
		local c = 0
		for _ in pairs(CM.Flags) do c = c + 1 end
		if c >= FLAG_MAX then
			local l = CM.List()
			local drop
			for i = #l, 1, -1 do if not activeFor(l[i].uid) then drop = l[i] break end end
			drop = drop or l[#l]
			if drop then CM.Flags[drop.uid] = nil end
		end
		CM.FlagSeq = (CM.FlagSeq or 0) + 1
		f = {uid = uid, n = 0, ev = {}, hist = {}, seq = CM.FlagSeq}
		CM.Flags[uid] = f
	end
	f.name, f.display, f.t, f.n = name, display, now, f.n + 1
	if f.cat == nil or f.cat == R.cat then f.cat, f.conf = R.cat, math.max(f.conf or 0, R.conf)
	elseif R.conf > (f.conf or 0) then f.cat, f.conf = R.cat, R.conf end
	f.hist[#f.hist + 1] = now
	if #f.hist > 8 then table.remove(f.hist, 1) end
	local entry = {ts = os.date("%H:%M:%S"), text = text:sub(1, 160), cat = R.cat, conf = R.conf}
	f.ev[#f.ev + 1] = entry
	if #f.ev > EVID_MAX then table.remove(f.ev, 1) end
	local pc = activeFor(uid)
	if pc and pc.status == "pending" and pc.cat == R.cat then
		pc.ev[#pc.ev + 1] = {ts = entry.ts, text = entry.text, cat = entry.cat, conf = entry.conf}
		if #pc.ev > 8 then table.remove(pc.ev, 1) end
		pc.conf = math.max(pc.conf or 0, R.conf)
	end
	remind(f)
	prompt(f, R)
	CM.Refresh()
	return R
end

-- ---------- event wiring (single connection set, fully disconnected when both switches are off) ----------
local function onTextChat(m)
	local src = m.TextSource
	if not src or src.UserId == Player.UserId or m.Status == Enum.TextChatMessageStatus.Sending then return end
	local ch = m.TextChannel
	if not ch or ch.Name ~= "RBXGeneral" then return end
	local pl = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(src.UserId)
	if pl then pcall(CM.Handle, pl.UserId, pl.Name, pl.DisplayName, m.Text, m.MessageId) end
end
function CM.Enable()
	if CM.Active then return end
	CM.Active = true
	local cs = CM.Conns
	if TextChatService.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.LegacyChatService then
		local function hook(pl)
			if pl == Player then return end
			cs[#cs + 1] = pl.Chatted:Connect(function(msg, rcpt) if rcpt == nil then CM.LegacySeq = (CM.LegacySeq or 0) + 1 pcall(CM.Handle, pl.UserId, pl.Name, pl.DisplayName, msg, "L" .. CM.LegacySeq) end end)
		end
		for _, pl in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do hook(pl) end
		cs[#cs + 1] = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(hook)
	else
		cs[#cs + 1] = TextChatService.MessageReceived:Connect(onTextChat)
	end
	cs[#cs + 1] = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(pl) CM.Strikes[pl.UserId] = nil pcall(CM.Left, pl.UserId) end)
end
function CM.Disable()
	for _, c in ipairs(CM.Conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
	CM.Conns, CM.Seen, CM.SeenQ, CM.Strikes, CM.Active = {}, {}, {}, {}, false
end
function CM.Sync()
	local want = cfg("CModOn") == true or cfg("AutoReport") == true
	if want then CM.Enable() else CM.Disable() end
	if cfg("AutoReport") == true then CM.Pump() end
	CM.Refresh()
end
function CM.Announce()
	if not CM.Active then return end
	local on = function(k) return cfg(k) == true and "ON" or "OFF" end
	local text = ("JARVIS: Chat moderation is active. Auto Report %s | Chat Monitoring %s | Public Reminders %s. Change them in Main > Performance."):format(on("AutoReport"), on("CModOn"), on("CModSay"))
	notify(text)
	pcall(function()
		local TCS = game:GetService("TextChatService")
		local ch = TCS.ChatVersion == Enum.ChatVersion.TextChatService and TCS:FindFirstChild("TextChannels")
		ch = ch and ch:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral")
		if ch then ch:DisplaySystemMessage(text) else StarterGui:SetCore("ChatMakeSystemMessage", {Text = text}) end
	end)
end
function CM.Clear()
	local nf, nq, keep = 0, 0, {}
	for _ in pairs(CM.Flags) do nf = nf + 1 end
	for _, c in ipairs(CM.CaseList) do
		if c.status == "queued" then c.status, nq = "cancelled", nq + 1 end
		if c.status == "submitting" then keep[#keep + 1] = c end
	end
	CM.Queue, CM.Flags, CM.Cases, CM.CaseList, CM.Sel = {}, {}, {}, keep, nil
	for _, c in ipairs(keep) do CM.Cases[c.key] = c end
	CM.Refresh()
	return nf, nq
end
return CM
end)()

local AntiLag = {}
do
local TextureProps = {
Decal = {"Texture"},
Texture = {"Texture"},
SurfaceAppearance = {"ColorMap", "MetalnessMap", "NormalMap", "RoughnessMap"},
MeshPart = {"TextureID"},
SpecialMesh = {"TextureId"},
Shirt = {"ShirtTemplate"},
Pants = {"PantsTemplate"},
ShirtGraphic = {"Graphic"},
}
local Saved = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local enabled = false
local token = 0
local addedConn = nil
local CHUNK = 1500
local function isProtected(inst)
if inst:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Accoutrement") or inst:FindFirstAncestorWhichIsA("Tool") then
return true
end
local mine = Player.Character
if mine and inst:IsDescendantOf(mine) then return true end
local rc = Reanimate.Character
if rc and inst:IsDescendantOf(rc) then return true end
return false
end
local function strip(inst)
local props = TextureProps[inst.ClassName]
if not props or Saved[inst] then return end
if isProtected(inst) then return end
local rec = nil
for _, p in ipairs(props) do
local ok, v = pcall(function() return inst[p] end)
if ok and v ~= nil and v ~= "" then
rec = rec or {}
rec[p] = v
pcall(function() inst[p] = "" end)
end
end
if rec then Saved[inst] = rec end
end
function AntiLag.Set(on)
on = on and true or false
if on == enabled then return end
enabled = on
token += 1
local my = token
if addedConn then
addedConn:Disconnect()
addedConn = nil
end
if on then
addedConn = workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(strip)
task.spawn(function()
local list = workspace:GetDescendants()
for i = 1, #list do
if token ~= my then return end
strip(list[i])
if i % CHUNK == 0 then task.wait() end
end
end)
else
task.spawn(function()
local list = {}
for inst in pairs(Saved) do list[#list + 1] = inst end
for i = 1, #list do
if token ~= my then return end
local inst = list[i]
local rec = Saved[inst]
if rec then
for p, v in pairs(rec) do
pcall(function() inst[p] = v end)
end
Saved[inst] = nil
end
if i % CHUNK == 0 then task.wait() end
end
end)
end
end
end
local PlayerHider = {}
do
local enabled = false
local records = {}
local watchers = {}
local joinConn, leaveConn = nil, nil
local function hide(plr, char)
if not enabled or plr == Player then return end
local parent = char.Parent
if not parent then return end
records[plr] = {Char = char, Parent = parent}
pcall(function() char.Parent = nil end)
end
local function watchChar(plr, char)
local w = watchers[plr]
if not w then return end
if w.CharParent then w.CharParent:Disconnect() end
w.CharParent = char:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Parent"):Connect(function()
if enabled and char.Parent ~= nil then hide(plr, char) end
end)
hide(plr, char)
end
local function watchPlayer(plr)
if plr == Player or watchers[plr] then return end
local w = {}
watchers[plr] = w
w.CharAdded = plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
watchChar(plr, char)
end)
if plr.Character then watchChar(plr, plr.Character) end
end
local function unwatchPlayer(plr)
local w = watchers[plr]
if w then
if w.CharAdded then w.CharAdded:Disconnect() end
if w.CharParent then w.CharParent:Disconnect() end
watchers[plr] = nil
end
records[plr] = nil
end
function PlayerHider.Set(on)
on = on and true or false
if on == enabled then return end
enabled = on
if on then
for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do watchPlayer(plr) end
joinConn = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watchPlayer)
leaveConn = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(unwatchPlayer)
else
if joinConn then joinConn:Disconnect() joinConn = nil end
if leaveConn then leaveConn:Disconnect() leaveConn = nil end
for plr in pairs(watchers) do
local w = watchers[plr]
if w.CharAdded then w.CharAdded:Disconnect() end
if w.CharParent then w.CharParent:Disconnect() end
end
watchers = {}
for plr, rec in pairs(records) do
local char = rec.Char
if char and plr.Character == char and char.Parent == nil then
local parent = rec.Parent
if not (parent and parent:IsDescendantOf(game)) then parent = workspace end
pcall(function() char.Parent = parent end)
end
end
records = {}
end
end
end
local AntiLagSwitch = UI.CreateSwitch(MainPage, "Anti Lag (remove all textures)", false)
AntiLagSwitch.Changed:Connect(function(val)
AntiLag.Set(val)
Util.UINotify("Anti Lag " .. (val and "ON" or "OFF"))
end)
if type(_G.UHDevProfile) == "table" and _G.UHDevProfile.AntiLag == true then
pcall(function() AntiLagSwitch.Value = true end)
pcall(AntiLag.Set, true)
end

local NoobyKill = {
Enabled = false,
YaKids = SaveData.YaKidsToolKill == true,
Targets = {},
Queue = {},
Run = nil,
WorkerRunning = false,
FocusTimeout = 2,
MaxAttempts = 3,
ForceFieldWait = 10,
PendingWait = 10,
RunLimit = 90,
NotifyStamp = {},
LastActivate = 0,
Switch = nil,
}
local KILL_PRIMARY_PARTS = {"Head", "HumanoidRootPart", "UpperTorso", "Torso", "LowerTorso"}
local KILL_LIMB_PARTS = {
"Left Arm", "Right Arm", "Left Leg", "Right Leg",
"LeftUpperArm", "RightUpperArm", "LeftLowerArm", "RightLowerArm", "LeftHand", "RightHand",
"LeftUpperLeg", "RightUpperLeg", "LeftLowerLeg", "RightLowerLeg", "LeftFoot", "RightFoot",
}
local KILL_RED = Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
function NoobyKill.Notify(key, text)
local now = os.clock()
local last = NoobyKill.NotifyStamp[key]
if last and now - last < 2 then return end
NoobyKill.NotifyStamp[key] = now
pcall(Util.Notify, text)
end
function NoobyKill.TargetFlingEnabled()
local cur = Reanimate.Current
local sel = cur or ({[3] = Reanimate.ToolReanimator})[SaveData.SelectedReanimator]
if sel == Reanimate.ToolReanimator then
return sel.FlingEnabled and true or false
end
local hh = cur or ({[9] = Reanimate.HairReanimator, [10] = Reanimate.HatHairReanimator, [11] = Reanimate.AccessoriesReanimator})[SaveData.SelectedReanimator]
if hh and (hh == Reanimate.HairReanimator or hh == Reanimate.HatHairReanimator or hh == Reanimate.AccessoriesReanimator) then
return hh.FlingMethod ~= -1
end
local hats
if cur == HatReanimator then
hats = true
elseif cur == LimbReanimator or cur == Reanimate.RagdollReanimator or cur == Reanimate.ServoJointReanimator or cur == Reanimate.HybridJointReanimator or cur == Reanimate.SkeletalRetargetReanimator or cur == Reanimate.KinematicReanimator or cur == Reanimate.VelocityInterpolatedReanimator then
hats = false
else
hats = (SaveData.SelectedReanimator == 2)
end
if hats then
return HatReanimator.FlingMethod ~= -1
end
return LimbReanimator.FlingEnabled and true or false
end
function NoobyKill.EspParents()
local list = {}
if type(gethiddengui) == "function" then
local ok, g = pcall(gethiddengui)
if ok and typeof(g) == "Instance" then table.insert(list, g) end
end
table.insert(list, CoreGui)
table.insert(list, workspace)
return list
end
function NoobyKill.NewEspPiece(className, char, color, parents)
for _, parent in ipairs(parents) do
local ok, inst = pcall(function()
local i = Instance.new(className)
if className == "Highlight" then
i.FillColor = color
i.OutlineColor = color
i.FillTransparency = 0.6
i.OutlineTransparency = 0
i.DepthMode = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop
else
i.Color3 = color
i.LineThickness = 0.07
i.SurfaceTransparency = 0.7
i.SurfaceColor3 = color
end
i.Adornee = char
i.Parent = parent
return i
end)
if ok and inst then
if inst.Parent == parent then return inst end
pcall(function() inst:Destroy() end)
end
end
return nil
end
function NoobyKill.MakeEsp(char, color)
local parents = NoobyKill.EspParents()
local esp = {}
local hl = NoobyKill.NewEspPiece("Highlight", char, color, parents)
if hl then table.insert(esp, hl) end
local sb = NoobyKill.NewEspPiece("SelectionBox", char, color, parents)
if sb then table.insert(esp, sb) end
return esp
end
function NoobyKill.DestroyEsp(esp)
if not esp then return end
for _, inst in ipairs(esp) do
pcall(function() inst:Destroy() end)
end
end
function NoobyKill.FlashEsp(char, color, seconds)
local esp = NoobyKill.MakeEsp(char, color)
task.delay(seconds or 2, function() NoobyKill.DestroyEsp(esp) end)
end
function NoobyKill.GetDamageTool()
local char = Player.Character
if not char then return nil end
for _, child in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
if child:IsA("Tool") then
local handle = child:FindFirstChild("Handle")
if handle and handle:IsA("BasePart") then
return child, handle
end
end
end
return nil
end
function NoobyKill.RemoveTarget(char)
local info = NoobyKill.Targets[char]
if info then
NoobyKill.DestroyEsp(info.Esp)
NoobyKill.Targets[char] = nil
end
for i = #NoobyKill.Queue, 1, -1 do
if NoobyKill.Queue[i] == char then table.remove(NoobyKill.Queue, i) end
end
end
function NoobyKill.StopAll()
for char, info in pairs(NoobyKill.Targets) do
NoobyKill.DestroyEsp(info.Esp)
end
NoobyKill.Targets = {}
NoobyKill.Queue = {}
NoobyKill.Run = nil
end
function NoobyKill.Finish(char, status)
local run = NoobyKill.Run
local info = NoobyKill.Targets[char]
if run and info and info.InRun then
if status == "killed" then
run.Killed = run.Killed + 1
elseif status == "failed" then
table.insert(run.Failed, info.Name)
end
end
NoobyKill.RemoveTarget(char)
end
function NoobyKill.Rotate()
if #NoobyKill.Queue > 1 then
table.insert(NoobyKill.Queue, table.remove(NoobyKill.Queue, 1))
end
end
local function killFire(handle, part)
firetouchinterest(handle, part, 0)
firetouchinterest(handle, part, 1)
end
function NoobyKill.YaKidsBurst(handle, char)
local part = char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or char:FindFirstChild("Torso") or char:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart")
if not part then return end
local plr = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(char)
if plr then
local t = plr.Team
if t ~= nil and t == Player.Team and t.Name ~= "Neutral" then return end
end
local tool = handle.Parent
if tool and tool:IsA("Tool") then pcall(function() tool:Activate() end) end
firetouchinterest(part, handle, 0)
firetouchinterest(part, handle, 1)
firetouchinterest(handle, part, 0)
firetouchinterest(handle, part, 1)
end
function NoobyKill.Burst(handle, char)
if NoobyKill.YaKids then pcall(NoobyKill.YaKidsBurst, handle, char) end
for _, name in ipairs(KILL_PRIMARY_PARTS) do
local p = char:FindFirstChild(name)
if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then killFire(handle, p) end
end
for _, name in ipairs(KILL_LIMB_PARTS) do
local p = char:FindFirstChild(name)
if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then killFire(handle, p) end
end
end
function NoobyKill.CheckPending(now)
local run = NoobyKill.Run
if not run then return end
for plr in pairs(run.Pending) do
if plr.Parent == nil then
run.Pending[plr] = nil
elseif now > run.PendingUntil then
run.Pending[plr] = nil
table.insert(run.Failed, plr.Name)
else
local c = plr.Character
local h = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if h and h.Health > 0 then
run.Pending[plr] = nil
NoobyKill.AddTarget(c, true, plr.Name)
end
end
end
end
function NoobyKill.HasWork()
if #NoobyKill.Queue > 0 then return true end
local run = NoobyKill.Run
return run ~= nil and next(run.Pending) ~= nil
end
function NoobyKill.FinishRun()
local run = NoobyKill.Run
if not run then return end
NoobyKill.Run = nil
local total = run.Killed + #run.Failed
local msg = "Kill All: killed " .. run.Killed .. "/" .. total
if #run.Failed > 0 then
msg = msg .. " (couldn't kill: " .. table.concat(run.Failed, ", ") .. ")"
end
pcall(Util.Notify, msg)
end
function NoobyKill.Step()
if not NoobyKill.TargetFlingEnabled() then
NoobyKill.Notify("tf", "Toggle Kill stopped: Target Fling is disabled")
NoobyKill.StopAll()
return
end
local tool, handle = NoobyKill.GetDamageTool()
if not tool then
NoobyKill.Notify("nodmg", "No item that deals damage is equipped")
NoobyKill.StopAll()
return
end
pcall(function() handle.CanTouch = true end)
local now = os.clock()
local run = NoobyKill.Run
if run and now > run.Deadline then
for _, c in ipairs(table.clone(NoobyKill.Queue)) do NoobyKill.Finish(c, "failed") end
run.Pending = {}
return
end
NoobyKill.CheckPending(now)
local char = NoobyKill.Queue[1]
if char then
local info = NoobyKill.Targets[char]
local tHum = char.Parent and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if not tHum then
NoobyKill.Finish(char, "gone")
elseif tHum.Health <= 0 then
NoobyKill.Finish(char, "killed")
elseif char:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") then
info.FFStart = info.FFStart or now
if now - info.FFStart > NoobyKill.ForceFieldWait then
NoobyKill.Finish(char, "failed")
else
NoobyKill.Rotate()
end
else
info.FFStart = nil
info.FocusStart = info.FocusStart or now
if info.LastHealth and tHum.Health < info.LastHealth then
info.FocusStart = now
info.Attempts = 0
end
info.LastHealth = tHum.Health
if now - info.FocusStart > NoobyKill.FocusTimeout then
info.Attempts = info.Attempts + 1
info.FocusStart = nil
if info.Attempts >= NoobyKill.MaxAttempts then
NoobyKill.Notify("timeout", "Couldn't kill " .. info.Name .. " with '" .. tool.Name .. "'")
NoobyKill.Finish(char, "failed")
else
NoobyKill.Rotate()
end
else
pcall(NoobyKill.Burst, handle, char)
end
end
end
if now - NoobyKill.LastActivate > 0.25 then
NoobyKill.LastActivate = now
pcall(function() tool:Activate() end)
end
end
function NoobyKill.EnsureWorker()
if NoobyKill.WorkerRunning then return end
NoobyKill.WorkerRunning = true
task.spawn(function()
while NoobyKill.Enabled and NoobyKill.HasWork() do
local ok, err = pcall(NoobyKill.Step)
if not ok then warn("[Toggle Kill] " .. tostring(err)) end
RunService.Heartbeat:Wait()
end
NoobyKill.WorkerRunning = false
NoobyKill.FinishRun()
end)
end
function NoobyKill.Gate()
if not Util.Capabilities.firetouch then
NoobyKill.Notify("noexec", "Toggle Kill needs an executor with firetouchinterest")
return false
end
if not NoobyKill.Enabled then
NoobyKill.Notify("off", "Turn on Toggle Kill first")
return false
end
if not NoobyKill.TargetFlingEnabled() then
NoobyKill.Notify("tf", "Toggle Kill needs Target Fling enabled")
return false
end
if not NoobyKill.GetDamageTool() then
NoobyKill.Notify("nodmg", "No item that deals damage is equipped")
return false
end
return true
end
function NoobyKill.AddTarget(char, inRun, name)
if not char or NoobyKill.Targets[char] then return false end
if char == Player.Character or char == Reanimate.Character then return false end
local tHum = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if not tHum or tHum.Health <= 0 then return false end
NoobyKill.Targets[char] = {
Esp = NoobyKill.MakeEsp(char, KILL_RED),
Attempts = 0,
InRun = inRun and true or false,
Name = name or char.Name,
}
table.insert(NoobyKill.Queue, char)
NoobyKill.EnsureWorker()
return true
end
NoobyKill.Switch = UI.CreateSwitch(MainPage, "Toggle Kill", false)
NoobyKill.Switch.Changed:Connect(function(val)
if val then
if not Util.Capabilities.firetouch then
NoobyKill.Notify("noexec", "Toggle Kill needs an executor with firetouchinterest")
NoobyKill.Switch.Value = false
return
end
if not NoobyKill.TargetFlingEnabled() then
NoobyKill.Notify("tf", "Toggle Kill needs Target Fling enabled")
NoobyKill.Switch.Value = false
return
end
NoobyKill.Enabled = true
else
NoobyKill.Enabled = false
NoobyKill.StopAll()
end
end)

Turn on <b>Click Fling</b> to pick targets by clicking them. While Toggle Kill is on, clicks only kill (they never fling).</font>', 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)

With <b>RootPart is Torso</b> or <b>CurrentAngle Style</b> it will kill you too.</font>', 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
UI.CreateButton(MainPage, "Kill All", 20).Activated:Connect(function()
if not NoobyKill.Gate() then return end
if NoobyKill.Run then
NoobyKill.Notify("busy", "Kill All is already running")
return
end
local now = os.clock()
local run = {Killed = 0, Failed = {}, Pending = {}, PendingUntil = now + NoobyKill.PendingWait, Deadline = now + NoobyKill.RunLimit}
NoobyKill.Run = run
local queued = 0
for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
if plr ~= Player then
local c = plr.Character
if not c then
run.Pending[plr] = true
else
local h = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
if h and h.Health > 0 then
local existing = NoobyKill.Targets[c]
if existing then
existing.InRun = true
queued = queued + 1
elseif NoobyKill.AddTarget(c, true, plr.Name) then
queued = queued + 1
end
end
end
end
end
if queued == 0 and next(run.Pending) == nil then
NoobyKill.Run = nil
NoobyKill.Notify("none", "Kill All: no living players to target")
else
NoobyKill.EnsureWorker()
end
end)

if val == 3 then

end
if val == 4 then
selectedkey = Enum.KeyCode.Z
end
if val == 5 then
selectedkey = Enum.KeyCode.X
end
if val == 6 then
selectedkey = Enum.KeyCode.F
end
if val == 7 then
selectedkey = Enum.KeyCode.T
end
end

local Maus = Player:GetMouse()
local HoldingCtrl = UI.CreateSwitch(MainPage, "TP Key Held", false)
local _lastclick = nil
local _lastclickgpe = false
local _lastclicktick = 0
local _lastclickpos = Vector3.zero
UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gpe)
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
if input.KeyCode == selectedkey then
HoldingCtrl.Value = true
end
end
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
_lastclick = input
_lastclickgpe = gpe
_lastclicktick = os.clock()
_lastclickpos = input.Position
end
end)
UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input, gpe)
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Keyboard then
if input.KeyCode == selectedkey then
HoldingCtrl.Value = false
end
end
if _lastclick and (_lastclick == input or _lastclick.UserInputType == input.UserInputType) and not _lastclickgpe then
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or (os.clock() - _lastclicktick < 0.3 and (input.Position - _lastclickpos).Magnitude < 10) then
if Reanimate.CtrlClick and HoldingCtrl.Value then
if Maus.Target and Maus.Target.Parent then
ReanimCharacterTeleport(Maus.Hit.Position + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
return
end
end
local function _charFromPart(part)
local p = part
for _ = 1, 6 do
if not p or p == workspace or p == game then return nil end
if p:IsA("Model") and p:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then return p end
p = p.Parent
end
return nil
end
local function _resolveClickTarget()
local own1, own2 = Player.Character, Reanimate.Character
local c = _charFromPart(Maus.Target)
if c and c ~= own1 and c ~= own2 then return c end
local ok, part = pcall(function()
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
local ray
if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
ray = cam:ScreenPointToRay(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
else
local m = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
ray = cam:ViewportPointToRay(m.X, m.Y)
end
local params = RaycastParams.new()
params.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
params.FilterDescendantsInstances = {own1, own2}
local res = workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * 2000, params)
return res and res.Instance
end)
if ok and part then
c = _charFromPart(part)
if c and c ~= own1 and c ~= own2 then return c end
end
return nil
end

local function fetchServers(desc)
local list, cursor = {}, nil
for _ = 1, 2 do
local url = ("https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/%d/servers/Public?sortOrder=%s&excludeFullGames=true&limit=100"):format(game.PlaceId, desc and "Desc" or "Asc")
if cursor then url ..= "&cursor=" .. cursor end
local ok, res = pcall(request, {Url = url, Method = "GET"})
if not ok or type(res) ~= "table" then return list, "server list request failed" end
if res.StatusCode == 429 then return list, "rate limited by Roblox, wait a minute and try again" end
if res.StatusCode ~= 200 then return list, "server list error (HTTP " .. tostring(res.StatusCode) .. ")" end
local okj, data = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, res.Body)
if not okj or type(data) ~= "table" or type(data.data) ~= "table" then return list, "bad server list response" end
for _, s in data.data do table.insert(list, s) end
cursor = data.nextPageCursor
if type(cursor) ~= "string" then break end
end
return list
end
local function pickPool(servers)
local mode = SaveData.ServerHopMode
local visited = SaveData.ServerHopVisited
local skip = SaveData.ServerHopSkipVisited
local all, fresh = {}, {}
for _, s in servers do
if type(s) == "table" and type(s.id) == "string" and s.id ~= game.JobId
and (tonumber(s.playing) or 0) < (tonumber(s.maxPlayers) or math.huge) then
table.insert(all, s)
if not (skip and visited[s.id]) then table.insert(fresh, s) end
end
end
local pool = #fresh > 0 and fresh or all
if mode == 2 then
table.sort(pool, function(a, b) return (tonumber(a.playing) or 0) < (tonumber(b.playing) or 0) end)
elseif mode == 3 then
table.sort(pool, function(a, b) return (tonumber(a.playing) or 0) > (tonumber(b.playing) or 0) end)
else
for i = #pool, 2, -1 do
local j = math.random(1, i)
pool[i], pool[j] = pool[j], pool[i]
end
end
return pool
end
local function tryTeleport(jobid)

local conn = TeleportService.TeleportInitFailed:Connect(function(plr, result, msg)
if plr == LocalPlayer then
failedmsg = (type(msg) == "string" and msg ~= "") and msg or tostring(result)
end
end)

if not ok then failedmsg = tostring(err) end
local start = os.clock()
while not failedmsg and os.clock() - start < 8 do
task.wait(0.2)
end
conn:Disconnect()
if failedmsg then Util.TeleportAutoExec.Abort() end
return failedmsg == nil, failedmsg
end

local AnimLib = {}
do
local Track = {}
function Track.frombuffer(buf)
local needle = 0
local buflen = buffer.len(buf)
local function getleft()
return buflen - needle
end
local function readstring()
assert(getleft() >= 2)
local len = buffer.readu16(buf, needle)
needle += 2
assert(getleft() >= len)
local val = buffer.readstring(buf, needle, len)
needle += len
return val
end
local function readsizet()
assert(getleft() >= 4)
local val = buffer.readu32(buf, needle)
needle += 4
return val
end
local function readfloat()
assert(getleft() >= 4)
local val = buffer.readf32(buf, needle)
needle += 4
return val
end
local anim = {
Name = "<unknown>",
Time = 0,
Keyframes = {},
}
anim.Name = readstring()
local nkeyframes = readsizet()
for _=1, nkeyframes do
local t = readfloat()
anim.Time = math.max(anim.Time, t)
local nposes = readsizet()
local keyframe = {
Time = t,
Poses = {}
}
for _=1, nposes do
local pose = {}
pose.Name = readstring()
pose.Weight = readfloat()
pose.EasingStyle = readstring()
pose.EasingDirection = readstring()
pose.CFrame = CFrame.new(
readfloat(),
readfloat(),
readfloat(),
readfloat(),
readfloat(),
readfloat(),
readfloat(),
readfloat(),
readfloat(),
readfloat(),
readfloat(),
readfloat()
)
table.insert(keyframe.Poses, pose)
end
table.insert(anim.Keyframes, keyframe)
end
table.sort(anim.Keyframes, function(a, b)
return a.Time < b.Time
end)
return anim
end
function Track.fromfile(path)
local s, data = pcall(readfile, path)
if s and data then
local buf = buffer.fromstring(data)
return Track.frombuffer(buf)
end
end
function Track.frominstance(ks)
assert(ks and ks:IsA("KeyframeSequence"))
local anim = {
Name = "<unknown>",
Time = 0,
Keyframes = {},
}
anim.Name = ks.Name
for _,k in ks:GetKeyframes() do
local t = k.Time
anim.Time = math.max(anim.Time, t)
local keyframe = {
Time = t,
Poses = {}
}
for _,p in k:GetDescendants() do
if not p:IsA("Pose") then continue end
table.insert(keyframe.Poses, {
Name = p.Name,
Weight = p.Weight,
EasingStyle = p.EasingStyle.Name,
EasingDirection = p.EasingDirection.Name,
CFrame = p.CFrame
})
end
table.insert(anim.Keyframes, keyframe)
end
table.sort(anim.Keyframes, function(a, b)
return a.Time < b.Time
end)
return anim
end
function Track.paste(target, source, timeoffset)
for _,keyframe in source.Keyframes do
local newkeyframe = DeepcopyTable(keyframe)
newkeyframe.Time += timeoffset
table.insert(target.Keyframes, newkeyframe)
end
anim.Time = 0
table.sort(source.Keyframes, function(a, b)
anim.Time = math.max(anim.Time, a.Time, b.Time)
return a.Time < b.Time
end)
end
function Track.getPoses(track, t, looped)
local poses = {}
local keyframes = track.Keyframes
for _,keyframe in keyframes do
for _,pose in keyframe.Poses do
poses[pose.Name] = CFrame.identity
end
end
if looped then
t = t % track.Time
end
for name,_ in poses do
local k1, k2, t1, t2 = nil, nil, -math.huge, math.huge
for _,k in keyframes do
local po = nil
for _,p in k.Poses do
if p.Name == name and p.Weight > 0 then
po = p
end
end
if po ~= nil then
if t1 < k.Time and k.Time <= t then
k1 = po
t1 = k.Time
end
if t2 > k.Time and k.Time > t then
k2 = po
t2 = k.Time
end
end
end
local cf = CFrame.identity
if k1 ~= nil then
if k2 ~= nil then
local a = (t - t1) / (t2 - t1)
local es, ed = k1.EasingStyle, k1.EasingDirection
if es == "Constant" then
if ed == "In" then
a = 1
elseif ed == "Out" then
a = 0
else
if a < 0.5 then
a = 0
else
a = 1
end
end
else
if es == "CubicV2" then
es = "Cubic"
end
a = TweenService:GetValue(
a,
Enum.EasingStyle[es],
Enum.EasingDirection[ed]
)
end
cf = k1.CFrame:Lerp(k2.CFrame, a)
else
cf = k1.CFrame
end
else
if k2 ~= nil then
cf = k2.CFrame
end
end
poses[name] = cf
end
return poses
end
AnimLib.Track = Track
local Animator = {}
Animator.__index = Animator
function Animator.new()
local self = setmetatable({}, Animator)
self.rig = nil
self.track = nil
self.map = {{0, 1}, {0, 1}}
self.looped = false
self.speed = 1
self.weight = 1
self._optimiser = 1
self._jointmap = nil
self._skipsec = nil
self._rig = nil
self._track = nil
return self
end
function Animator:Step(t)
local rig, track, map, speed, weight, looped = self.rig, self.track, self.map, self.speed, self.weight, self.looped
local jointmap, skipsec = self._jointmap, self._skipsec
if rig and track then
local scale = rig:GetScale()
t *= speed
if map then
t = map[2][1] + (t - map[1][1]) * (map[2][2] - map[2][1]) / (map[1][2] - map[1][1])
end
if self._rig ~= rig then
jointmap = nil
self._rig = rig
end
if self._track ~= track then
skipsec = nil
self._track = track
end
if not jointmap then
jointmap = {}
for _,v in rig:GetDescendants() do
if v:IsA("Motor6D") and v.Part0 and v.Part1 then
jointmap[v.Part1.Name] = v
end
end
self._jointmap = jointmap
end
local keyframes = track.Keyframes
if not skipsec then
skipsec = {}
local i = 1
local oldsec = 0
while i < #keyframes do
local k = keyframes[i]
local sec = k.Time // self._optimiser
while oldsec < sec do
local j = math.max(1, i - 1)
local poses = {}
local scan = j
while scan > 0 do
local k2 = keyframes[scan]
local ok = true
for name,_ in jointmap do
if not poses[name] then
for _,p in k2.Poses do
if p.Name == name and p.Weight > 0 then
poses[name] = true
j = scan
break
end
end
end
ok = poses[name] and ok
end
if ok then break end
scan -= 1
end
table.insert(skipsec, {j, j})
oldsec += 1
end
i += 1
end
for i,v in skipsec do
while v[2] < #keyframes and keyframes[v[2]].Time <= (i + 1) * self._optimiser do
v[2] += 1
end
end
self._skipsec = skipsec
end
local poses = {}
for name,_ in jointmap do
poses[name] = CFrame.identity
end
if looped then
t = t % track.Time
end
local skip1, skip2 = 1, #keyframes
if #skipsec >= 2 then
local i = t // self._optimiser
if i < 1 then
skip1, skip2 = 1, skipsec[1][2]
elseif i < #skipsec then
skip1, skip2 = skipsec[i][1], skipsec[i][2]
else
skip1, skip2 = skipsec[#skipsec][1], #keyframes
end
end
for name,_ in poses do
local k1, k2, t1, t2 = nil, nil, -math.huge, math.huge
for i=skip1, skip2 do
local k = keyframes[i]
local po = nil
for _,p in k.Poses do
if p.Name == name and p.Weight > 0 then
po = p
end
end
if po ~= nil then
if t1 < k.Time and k.Time <= t then
k1 = po
t1 = k.Time
end
if t2 > k.Time and k.Time > t then
k2 = po
t2 = k.Time
end
end
end
local cf = CFrame.identity
if k1 ~= nil then
if k2 ~= nil then
local a = (t - t1) / (t2 - t1)
local es, ed = k1.EasingStyle, k1.EasingDirection
if es == "Constant" then
if ed == "In" then
a = 1
elseif ed == "Out" then
a = 0
else
if a < 0.5 then
a = 0
else
a = 1
end
end
else
if es == "CubicV2" then
es = "Cubic"
end
a = TweenService:GetValue(
a,
Enum.EasingStyle[es],
Enum.EasingDirection[ed]
)
end
cf = k1.CFrame:Lerp(k2.CFrame, a)
else
cf = k1.CFrame
end
else
if k2 ~= nil then
cf = k2.CFrame
end
end
poses[name] = cf
end
for name,joint in jointmap do
local cf = poses[name] or CFrame.identity
cf = cf.Rotation + (cf.Position * scale)
if weight == 1 then
joint.Transform = cf
elseif weight ~= 0 then
joint.Transform = joint.Transform:Lerp(cf, weight)
end
end
end
end
AnimLib.Animator = Animator
end
local function AssetGetPathFromFilename(filename)
local filetype = "Unknown/"
if filename:sub(-4, -1) == ".mp3" then
filetype = "Sounds/"
elseif filename:sub(-5, -1) == ".anim" or filename:sub(-6, -1) == ".anims" then
filetype = "Anims/"
elseif filename:sub(-4, -1) == ".png" then
filetype = "Images/"
elseif filename:sub(-4, -1) == ".rbxm" or filename:sub(-5, -1) == ".rbxms" then
filetype = "Models/"
end
return "UhhhhhhReanim/Content/" .. filetype .. filename
end
local _Assetdownloading = {}
local _Assetdownloadingcount, _Assetdownloadingfail = 0, 0
local function _UpdateDownloadStatus()
local prog = 1 / ((_Assetdownloadingcount + _Assetdownloadingfail) / 2 + 1)
if _Assetdownloadingcount > 0 then
Util.UINotify("Downloading " .. _Assetdownloadingcount .. " assets...", prog)
else
if _Assetdownloadingfail > 0 then
Util.UINotify(_Assetdownloadingfail .. " failed to download", prog)
else
Util.UINotify("Asset download done", 1)
end
end
end
local function EnsureUrlEncode(source)
return source:gsub("[^%w%-%._~/]", function(c)
return string.format("%%%02X", string.byte(c))
end)
end
local function AssetDownloadAgent(source, filename, path)
if isfile(path) then return true end
if _Assetdownloading[filename] then return false end
_Assetdownloading[filename] = true
task.spawn(function()
_Assetdownloadingcount += 1
_UpdateDownloadStatus()
local s, resp = pcall(request, {
Method = "GET",
Url = source,
})
if s and resp and resp.StatusCode == 200 then
_Assetdownloadingcount -= 1
_UpdateDownloadStatus()
pcall(writefile, path, resp.Body)
task.wait(10)
else
_Assetdownloadingcount -= 1
_Assetdownloadingfail += 1
_UpdateDownloadStatus()
task.wait(10)
_Assetdownloadingfail -= 1
_UpdateDownloadStatus()
end
_Assetdownloading[filename] = nil
end)
return false
end
local function AssetDownload(filename)
local source = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/STEVE-916-create/Uhhhhhh/main/content/" .. EnsureUrlEncode(filename)
local split = string.split(filename, "@")
if #split > 1 then
filename = table.remove(split, 1)
source = table.concat(split, "@")
end
if source:sub(1, 7) == "MARKET/" then
source = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/STEVE-916-create/Uhhhhhh-Store/main/" .. EnsureUrlEncode(source:sub(8))
end
local path = AssetGetPathFromFilename(filename)
return AssetDownloadAgent(source, filename, path)
end
local function AssetGetContentId(filename)
local path = AssetGetPathFromFilename(filename)
if not isfile(path) then return "" end
local pc = Util.PreloadIds
if pc and pc[filename] then return pc[filename] end
local s, id = pcall(getcustomasset, path)
if s and id then
if pc then pc[filename] = id end
return id
end
return ""
end
local function AssetEnsure(list)
local ok = true
for _,filename in list do
if not AssetDownload(filename) then
ok = false
end
end
return ok
end
local function ProtectedChat(content)
pcall(function()
TextChatService:FindFirstChildOfClass("ChatInputBarConfiguration").TargetTextChannel:SendAsync(content, Util.RandomString(64))
end)
end

if plr then
OnPlayerChatted:Fire(plr, msg)
if msg == "67" then
Util.UINotify("SON :sob::sob::sob::sob:")
end
if msg == "1.1.0" then
Util.UINotify("the overhaul update is real?")
end
end
end
end)

do
local AF = {Prefix = ";", Admins = {}, Notified = {}, Hide = {}, Conns = {}, Enabled = false, LastSend = 0}
Util.AltFling = AF
local function status(t)
local l = Util.AltFlingUI
if l then pcall(function() l.Text = t end) end
end
local function isWhisper(m)
return m.TextChannel ~= nil and string.find(m.TextChannel.Name, "^RBXWhisper") ~= nil
end
function AF.Refresh()
local adm = AF.Active and AF.Admins[AF.Active]
AF.Command = (adm and AF.Target) and (adm.Prefix .. "fling " .. AF.Target.Name) or nil
if not adm then status("Alt-fling: waiting for an admin whitelist whisper")
elseif AF.Command then status("Alt-fling via " .. adm.Player.Name .. ": " .. AF.Command)
else status("Alt-fling via " .. adm.Player.Name .. ": click a target") end
end
function AF.Send()
local adm = AF.Active and AF.Admins[AF.Active]
if not (adm and adm.Player.Parent and AF.Command) then return false end
if os.clock() - AF.LastSend < 1 then return false end
AF.LastSend = os.clock()
local msg = "/w @" .. adm.Player.Name .. " " .. AF.Command
AF.Hide[AF.Command] = true
AF.Hide[msg] = true
local ch = adm.Channel
if ch and ch.Parent and pcall(function() ch:SendAsync(AF.Command, Util.RandomString(64)) end) then
return true
end
ProtectedChat(msg)
return true
end
function AF.Request(target)
if not AF.Enabled then return false end
if typeof(target) == "Instance" and not target:IsA("Player") then target = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(target) end
if typeof(target) ~= "Instance" or not target:IsA("Player") or target == Player or AF.Admins[target.UserId] then return false end
local RM = Util.AltRemake
if RM and RM.HasFlinger() then return RM.SendFling(target) end
AF.Target = target
AF.Refresh()
return AF.Send()
end
local function onMessage(m)
local src = m.TextSource
if not src or src.UserId == Player.UserId or not isWhisper(m) then return end
local low = m.Text:lower()
if not (low:find("got admin", 1, true) and low:find("prefix", 1, true)) then return end
local plr = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(src.UserId)
if not plr then return end
local pfx = m.Text:match("[Pp]refix%s*is%s*(%p)")
if pfx == "'" or pfx == '"' then pfx = nil end
AF.Admins[plr.UserId] = {Player = plr, Prefix = pfx or AF.Prefix, Channel = m.TextChannel}
AF.Active = plr.UserId
if not AF.Notified[plr.UserId] then
AF.Notified[plr.UserId] = true
Util.UINotify("Nameless Admin whitelist from " .. plr.Name)
local reply = "/w @" .. plr.Name .. " uh mod connected."
AF.Hide["uh mod connected."] = true
AF.Hide[reply] = true
if not pcall(function() m.TextChannel:SendAsync("uh mod connected.", Util.RandomString(64)) end) then
ProtectedChat(reply)
end
end
AF.Refresh()
end
local function hideOwn(m)
local src = m.TextSource
if src and src.UserId == Player.UserId and AF.Hide[m.Text] then
local p = Instance.new("TextChatMessageProperties")
p.Text = ""
p.PrefixText = ""
return p
end
end
function AF.Enable()
if AF.Enabled then return end
AF.Enabled = true
if type(getcallbackvalue) == "function" then
local ok, prev = pcall(getcallbackvalue, TextChatService, "OnIncomingMessage")
AF.Prev = ok and prev or nil
end
pcall(function()
TextChatService.OnIncomingMessage = function(m)
local ok, res = pcall(hideOwn, m)
if ok and res then return res end
if AF.Prev then return AF.Prev(m) end
end
end)
if type(getcallbackvalue) == "function" then
local okb, prevb = pcall(getcallbackvalue, TextChatService, "OnBubbleAdded")
AF.PrevBubble = okb and prevb or nil
end
pcall(function()
TextChatService.OnBubbleAdded = function(m, adornee)
local src = m.TextSource
if src and src.UserId == Player.UserId and AF.Hide[m.Text] then
local p = Instance.new("BubbleChatMessageProperties")
for k, v in pairs({Transparency = 1, TextTransparency = 1, BackgroundTransparency = 1, TailVisible = false, TextSize = 1}) do
pcall(function() p[k] = v end)
end
return p
end
if AF.PrevBubble then return AF.PrevBubble(m, adornee) end
end
end)
table.insert(AF.Conns, TextChatService.MessageReceived:Connect(onMessage))
table.insert(AF.Conns, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p)
AF.Admins[p.UserId] = nil
AF.Notified[p.UserId] = nil
if AF.Active == p.UserId then AF.Active = nil end
if AF.Target == p then AF.Target = nil end
AF.Refresh()
end))
AF.Refresh()
end
function AF.Disable()
if not AF.Enabled then return end
AF.Enabled = false
for _, c in ipairs(AF.Conns) do pcall(function() c:Disconnect() end) end
table.clear(AF.Conns)
pcall(function() TextChatService.OnIncomingMessage = AF.Prev end)
pcall(function() TextChatService.OnBubbleAdded = AF.PrevBubble end)
AF.PrevBubble = nil
AF.Prev = nil
table.clear(AF.Admins)
table.clear(AF.Notified)
table.clear(AF.Hide)
AF.Active, AF.Target, AF.Command = nil, nil, nil
status("Alt-fling: disabled")
end
if Util.Fling.Method == 8 then AF.Enable() end
end
do
-- Lua Chat Mode: toggle beside the chat mic icon; ON = chat input runs as Lua on THIS client only.
local LC = {On = false, Commands = {}, Env = {}}
Util.LuaChat = LC
local genv = (type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv()) or _G
local ld = loadstring or load
local pill, knob, label, box, bar, host, native, mic
local hidden, lastScan, lastMic, conn = false, 0, 0, nil
local function esc(s)
return (tostring(s):gsub("&", "&amp;"):gsub("<", "&lt;"):gsub(">", "&gt;"))
end
local function out(t, col)
t = tostring(t)
if #t > 800 then t = t:sub(1, 800) .. "..." end
local ok = pcall(function()
local chans = TextChatService:FindFirstChild("TextChannels")
local ch = chans and (chans:FindFirstChild("RBXGeneral") or chans:FindFirstChild("RBXSystem"))
ch:DisplaySystemMessage('<font color="' .. col .. '">[Lua] ' .. esc(t) .. "</font>")
end)
if not ok then pcall(Util.UINotify, t) end
end
local function join(...)
local t = {}
for i = 1, select("#", ...) do t[i] = tostring((select(i, ...))) end
return table.concat(t, " ")
end
function LC.Register(name, fn, desc)
if type(name) ~= "string" or type(fn) ~= "function" then return false end
LC.Commands[name] = {fn = fn, desc = tostring(desc or "")}
return true
end
local env = setmetatable(LC.Env, {__index = function(_, k)
local c = LC.Commands[k]
if c then return c.fn end
return genv[k]
end})
env.print = function(...) out(join(...), "#9CDCFE") end
env.warn = function(...) out(join(...), "#FFB454") end
env.Player, env.LocalPlayer, env.Players, env.Util = Player, Player, Players, Util
LC.Register("help", function()
local n = {}
for k, c in pairs(LC.Commands) do n[#n + 1] = k .. (c.desc ~= "" and (" - " .. c.desc) or "") end
table.sort(n)
out(table.concat(n, "\n"), "#8AB4FF")
end, "list registered commands")
LC.Register("off", function() LC.Set(false) end, "turn Lua chat mode off")
function LC.Submit(code)
if type(code) ~= "string" or not code:match("%S") then return false end
if type(ld) ~= "function" then out("loadstring unavailable", "#FF6B6B") return false end
local fn, err = ld("return " .. code, "=LuaChat")
if not fn then fn, err = ld(code, "=LuaChat") end
if not fn then out(err, "#FF6B6B") return false end
pcall(setfenv, fn, env)
task.spawn(function()
local r = table.pack(pcall(fn))
if not r[1] then out(r[2], "#FF6B6B")
elseif r.n > 1 then out(join(table.unpack(r, 2, r.n)), "#7CE38B")
else out("ok", "#7CE38B") end
end)
return true
end
local function hasLayout(g)
for _, c in ipairs(g:GetChildren()) do
if c:IsA("UIListLayout") or c:IsA("UIGridLayout") or c:IsA("UITableLayout") or c:IsA("UIPageLayout") then return true end
end
return false
end
local function shown(g)
while g and g ~= game do
if g:IsA("LayerCollector") then return g.Enabled end
if g:IsA("GuiObject") and not g.Visible then return false end
g = g.Parent
end
return false
end
local function find()
local ec = CoreGui:FindFirstChild("ExperienceChat")
local b = ec and ec:FindFirstChild("chatInputBar", true)
if not b then return false end
local tb = b:FindFirstChild("TextBox", true)
if not (tb and tb:IsA("TextBox")) then
tb = nil
for _, d in ipairs(b:GetDescendants()) do
if d:IsA("TextBox") and d.Name ~= "LuaChatInput" then tb = d break end
end
end
if not tb then return false end
native, bar, host, mic, hidden = tb, b, b, nil, false
while hasLayout(host) and host.Parent and host.Parent ~= CoreGui do host = host.Parent end
return true
end
local function findMic()
local best, bx = nil, -1
for _, d in ipairs(bar:GetDescendants()) do
if (d:IsA("GuiButton") or d:IsA("ImageLabel")) and not (pill and d:IsDescendantOf(pill)) and d.Visible and d.AbsoluteSize.X > 8 and d.AbsoluteSize.X <= bar.AbsoluteSize.Y * 1.6 then
local n = d.Name:lower()
if n:find("voice") or n:find("mic") then return d end
if d.AbsolutePosition.X > bx then best, bx = d, d.AbsolutePosition.X end
end
end
return best
end
local function build()
if pill then pcall(pill.Destroy, pill) end
if box then pcall(box.Destroy, box) end
pill = Instance.new("TextButton")
pill.Name, pill.Text, pill.AutoButtonColor, pill.BorderSizePixel, pill.ZIndex = "LuaChatToggle", "", false, 0, 50
pill.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
Instance.new("UICorner", pill).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
knob = Instance.new("Frame", pill)
knob.Name, knob.BorderSizePixel, knob.ZIndex, knob.BackgroundColor3 = "Knob", 0, 51, Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
Instance.new("UICorner", knob).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
label = Instance.new("TextLabel", pill)
label.Name, label.Text, label.BackgroundTransparency, label.ZIndex = "Label", "Lua", 1, 51
label.Font, label.TextColor3 = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
box = Instance.new("TextBox")
box.Name, box.BackgroundTransparency, box.BorderSizePixel, box.ZIndex = "LuaChatInput", 1, 0, 50
box.ClearTextOnFocus, box.MultiLine, box.TextWrapped, box.ClipsDescendants = false, false, false, true
box.TextXAlignment, box.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
box.PlaceholderText, box.Text, box.Visible = "Lua code...", "", false
pill.Parent, box.Parent = host, host
pill.Activated:Connect(function() LC.Set(not LC.On) end)
box.FocusLost:Connect(function(enter)
if not LC.On then return end
local s = box.Text
if enter and s:match("%S") then
box.Text = ""
LC.Submit(s)
end
end)
end
local function step()
if not (native and native.Parent and bar and bar.Parent and host and host.Parent and pill and pill.Parent == host and box and box.Parent == host) then
if os.clock() - lastScan < 0.5 then return end
lastScan = os.clock()
if not find() then return end
build()
end
local vis = shown(bar)
pill.Visible = vis
if not vis then box.Visible = false return end
if not (mic and mic.Parent) and os.clock() - lastMic > 2 then lastMic = os.clock() mic = findMic() end
local on = LC.On
local hp, bp, np = host.AbsolutePosition, bar.AbsolutePosition, native.AbsolutePosition
local bs, ns = bar.AbsoluteSize, native.AbsoluteSize
local ph = math.clamp(math.floor(ns.Y * 0.62), 16, 28)
local pw = math.floor(ph * 2.1)
local re = (mic and mic.Parent and mic.Visible) and mic.AbsolutePosition.X or (bp.X + bs.X - 8)
local px = re - 6 - pw
pill.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(pw, ph)
pill.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(px - hp.X, np.Y + ns.Y / 2 - hp.Y)
pill.BackgroundColor3 = on and Color3.fromRGB(46, 160, 90) or Color3.fromRGB(72, 74, 80)
knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(ph - 6, ph - 6)
knob.Position = UDim2.new(on and 1 or 0, on and -(ph - 3) or 3, 0.5, 0)
label.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(pw - ph, ph)
label.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(on and 3 or ph - 3, 0)
label.TextSize = math.max(9, math.floor(ph * 0.5))
if on then
hidden = true
if native.Visible then native.Visible = false end
box.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(np.X - hp.X, np.Y - hp.Y)
box.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(40, px - 6 - np.X), ns.Y)
if not box.Visible then
pcall(function() box.FontFace = native.FontFace end)
pcall(function() box.TextSize, box.TextColor3, box.PlaceholderColor3 = native.TextSize, native.TextColor3, native.PlaceholderColor3 end)
box.Visible = true
end
else
if hidden then hidden = false native.Visible = true end
if box.Visible then box.Visible = false end
end
end
function LC.Set(on)
LC.On = on and true or false
if not LC.On and box then pcall(function() box.Text = "" box:ReleaseFocus() end) end
pcall(step)
out(LC.On and "Lua mode ON" or "Lua mode OFF", "#8AB4FF")
end
function LC.Destroy()
LC.On = false
pcall(step)
if conn then conn:Disconnect() conn = nil end
if pill then pcall(pill.Destroy, pill) end
if box then pcall(box.Destroy, box) end
end
conn = RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function() pcall(step) end)
end
