local function canEdit()
	if not S then return false end
	if not S.char then
		if os.clock() - lastWarn > 3 then
			lastWarn = os.clock()
			say("Start reanimation first - Animation Studio only edits your reanimated character.")
		end
		return false
	end
	return true
end
local function mark(b, on, text) b.Text = (on and "* " or "") .. text; b.TextTransparency = on and 0 or 0.45 end
local function cycle(list, v) return list[(table.find(list, v) or 1) % #list + 1] end
local function edited(A)
	if A.static or #A.kfs > 1 then return true end
	for _, n in PARTS do
		for i = 1, 6 do
			if A.kfs[1].pose[n][i] ~= 0 then return true end
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- ===== undo / redo (snapshots of one animation; every edit pushes one entry, a whole gizmo drag is one entry) =====
local MIRROR = {Torso = "Torso", Head = "Head", ["Left Arm"] = "Right Arm", ["Right Arm"] = "Left Arm", ["Left Leg"] = "Right Leg", ["Right Leg"] = "Left Leg"}
local function mirrorPose(src) -- mirror across the character's YZ plane (swap left/right, flip X position and Y / Z rotation)
	local out = {}
	for _, n in PARTS do
		local s = src[MIRROR[n]]
		out[n] = {-s[1], s[2], s[3], s[4], -s[5], -s[6]}
	end
	return out
end
local function cloneAnim(A)
	local c = {dur = A.dur, speed = A.speed, loop = A.loop, static = A.static, kfs = {}}
	for i, k in A.kfs do
		c.kfs[i] = {t = k.t, ease = k.ease, dir = k.dir, pose = copyPose(k.pose), w = k.w and table.clone(k.w) or nil}
	end
	return c
end
local function pushUndo()
	local h = Work.hist
	h[#h + 1] = {cat = Work.cat, anim = cloneAnim(Work.anims[Work.cat]), sel = Work.sel}
	if #h > 60 then table.remove(h, 1) end
	table.clear(Work.redo)
end
local function stepHist(src, dst)
	if not canEdit() then return end
	local e = table.remove(src)
	if not e then say(src == Work.hist and "Nothing to undo." or "Nothing to redo.") return end
	dst[#dst + 1] = {cat = e.cat, anim = cloneAnim(Work.anims[e.cat]), sel = e.cat == Work.cat and Work.sel or 1}
	if S.live then setLive(false) end
	local m = e.cat == "Dance" and "dance" or "moveset"
	if m ~= Work.mode then
		if U.nameBox then Work.names[Work.mode] = U.nameBox.Text end
		Work.mode = m
		if U.nameBox then U.nameBox.Text = Work.names[m] or "" end
	end
	Work.cat, Work.anims[e.cat] = e.cat, e.anim
	if e.cat ~= "Dance" then Work.lastCat = e.cat end
	Work.sel = math.clamp(e.sel, 1, #e.anim.kfs)
	local A = cur()
	S.t, S.playing = A.static and 0 or A.kfs[Work.sel].t, false
	touch()
	refreshAll()
end
local function undo() stepHist(Work.hist, Work.redo) end
local function redo() stepHist(Work.redo, Work.hist) end

-- ===== one drag manager for the whole editor (timeline + sliders); touch drags that start vertical are left to the page scroll =====
local function lockScroll(on) for _, sf in (U.scrolls or {}) do pcall(function() sf.ScrollingEnabled = not on end) end end
local function endDrag() Drag = nil; lockScroll(false) end
local function callDrag(d, x) local f = d.first; d.first = false; d.fn(x, f) end
local function beginDrag(input, fn)
	if not S then return end
	local ty = input.UserInputType
	if ty ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and ty ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
	local d = {ref = input, fn = fn, first = true, locked = ty == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1, start = ty == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input.Position or nil}
	Drag = d
	if d.locked then lockScroll(true); callDrag(d, input.Position.X) end
end
local function onChanged(input)
	if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel then
		if U.wheel then pcall(U.wheel, input.Position.Z) end
		return
	end
	local p = PD
	if p then -- window / gizmo pointer drag (follows the input that started it)
		local ty = input.UserInputType
		if (ty == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and p.ref.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) or (ty == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input == p.ref) then
			if ty == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and not UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then
				PD = nil
				if p.done then pcall(p.done) end
			else
				local ok, err = pcall(p.move, Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y))
				if not ok then warn("[AnimStudio] " .. tostring(err)) end
			end
			return
		end
	end
	local d = Drag
	if not d then return end
	local ty = input.UserInputType
	if ty == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
		if not d.locked then return end
		if not UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then endDrag() return end
		callDrag(d, input.Position.X)
	elseif ty == Enum.UserInputType.Touch and input == d.ref then
		if not d.locked then
			local delta = input.Position - d.start
			if delta.Magnitude <= 8 then return end
			if math.abs(delta.X) < math.abs(delta.Y) then Drag = nil return end
			d.locked = true
			lockScroll(true)
			callDrag(d, d.start.X)
		end
		callDrag(d, input.Position.X)
	end
end
local function onEnded(input)
	local p = PD
	if p and (p.ref == input or (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and p.ref.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)) then
		PD = nil
		if p.done then pcall(p.done) end
		return
	end
	local d = Drag
	if not d or d.ref ~= input then return end
	if not d.locked then callDrag(d, input.Position.X) end
	endDrag()
end
-- pointer drag that is not tied to the timeline (floating window, 3D gizmo handles): move(pos) gets the pointer position, done() runs on release
local function beginPtr(input, move, done)
	local ty = input.UserInputType
	if not S or PD or (ty ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and ty ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then return false end
	PD = {ref = input, move = move, done = done}
	return true
end

-- ===== Animation Editor: shared helpers + redraw functions (Free Animator style layout) =====
local FPS = 30
local ACC = Color3.fromRGB(0, 162, 255)
-- hierarchy / timeline rows: Camera (display only), Rig (all joints) and the six R6 limbs
local ROWS = {
	{id = "cam", name = "Camera", kind = "group", grp = true},
	{id = "fov", name = "FieldOfView", kind = "cam", up = "cam"},
	{id = "cf", name = "CFrame", kind = "cam", up = "cam"},
	{id = "rig", name = "Rig", kind = "all", grp = true},
	{id = "Torso", name = "Torso", kind = "part", part = "Torso", up = "rig"},
	{id = "Head", name = "Head", kind = "part", part = "Head", up = "rig"},
	{id = "Left Arm", name = "Left Arm", kind = "part", part = "Left Arm", up = "rig"},
	{id = "Right Arm", name = "Right Arm", kind = "part", part = "Right Arm", up = "rig"},
	{id = "Left Leg", name = "Left Leg", kind = "part", part = "Left Leg", up = "rig"},
	{id = "Right Leg", name = "Right Leg", kind = "part", part = "Right Leg", up = "rig"},
}
local HL = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local function sel(b, on) local d = HL[b]; if d then b.BackgroundColor3 = on and ACC or d end end
local function addHl(b) HL[b] = b.BackgroundColor3 end
local function wOf(k, n) local w = k.w and k.w[n]; if w == nil then return 1 end return w end
local function fmtNum(v)
	local s = string.format("%.3f", tonumber(v) or 0)
	s = s:gsub("0+$", "")
	s = s:gsub("%.$", "")
	if s == "" or s == "-0" then s = "0" end
	return s
end
local function viewRange()
	local d = math.max(cur().dur, 0.05)
	local span = math.clamp(U.span or d, math.min(0.1, d), d)
	local t0 = math.clamp(U.t0 or 0, 0, d - span)
	U.t0 = t0
	U.zoomed = span < d - 1e-3
	return t0, span
end
local function selectPart(n)
	if Work.part == n then return end
	Work.part = n
	refreshPose()
	drawTimeline()
end

-- ===== redraw helpers =====
function drawTimeline()
	if not U.trk or not U.rowsBuilt then return end
	local A = cur()
	local t0, span = viewRange()
	local W = U.trk.AbsoluteSize.X
	local fspan = span * FPS
	local fsteps = {1, 2, 5, 10, 25, 50, 100, 250, 500, 1000}
	local step = 1000
	for _, s in fsteps do
		if W <= 0 or fspan / s * 46 <= W then step = s break end
	end
	local first, last = math.ceil(t0 * FPS / step - 1e-6), math.floor((t0 + span) * FPS / step + 1e-6)
	local n = 0
	for i = first, last do
		n += 1
		if n > 60 then break end
		local lbl = U.ticks[n]
		if not lbl then
			lbl = Util.Instance("TextLabel", U.trk)
			lbl.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			lbl.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(40, 18)
			lbl.BackgroundTransparency = 1
			lbl.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
			lbl.TextSize = 14
			lbl.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(232, 232, 232)
			U.ticks[n] = lbl
			local g = Util.Instance("Frame", U.grid)
			g.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0)
			g.Size = UDim2.new(0, 1, 1, 0)
			g.BorderSizePixel = 0
			g.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100)
			U.gridLines[n] = g
		end
		local x = (i * step / FPS - t0) / span
		lbl.Text = tostring(i * step)
		lbl.Position = UDim2.new(x, 0, 0.5, 0)
		lbl.Visible = true
		U.gridLines[n].Position = UDim2.new(x, 0, 0, 0)
		U.gridLines[n].Visible = true
	end
	for i = n + 1, #U.ticks do U.ticks[i].Visible = false; U.gridLines[i].Visible = false end
	local k0 = curKf()
	for _, r in ROWS do
		if r.kind == "all" or r.kind == "part" then
			local part, marks = r.part, r.marks
			for i, k in A.kfs do
				local m = marks[i]
				if not m then
					m = Util.Instance("Frame", r.lane)
					m.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
					m.Rotation = 45
					m.BorderSizePixel = 0
					m.ZIndex = 3
					Util.Instance("UICorner", m).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 2)
					marks[i] = m
				end
				local x = (k.t - t0) / span
				local show = not (A.static and i > 1) and x >= -0.01 and x <= 1.01
				if show and part and wOf(k, part) <= 0 then show = false end
				m.Visible = show
				if show then
					local on = i == Work.sel and (part == nil or part == Work.part)
					m.BackgroundColor3 = on and ACC or Color3.fromRGB(242, 242, 242)
					m.BackgroundTransparency = on and 0 or 0.1
					m.Size = on and UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12) or UDim2.fromOffset(9, 9)
					m.Position = UDim2.new(x, 0, 0.5, 0)
				end
			end
			for i = #A.kfs + 1, #marks do marks[i].Visible = false end
		end
		if r.hl then r.hl.Visible = r.part ~= nil and r.part == Work.part end
		if r.chk then r.chk.Text = wOf(k0, r.part) > 0 and U.G.check or "" end
	end
	if U.hthumb then
		local d = math.max(A.dur, 0.05)
		U.hthumb.Size = UDim2.new(math.clamp(span / d, 0.02, 1), 0, 1, 0)
		U.hthumb.Position = UDim2.new(math.clamp(t0 / d, 0, math.max(0, 1 - span / d)), 0, 0, 0)
		U.hthumb.BackgroundTransparency = U.zoomed and 0 or 0.65
	end
	if U.refreshEvents then U.refreshEvents() end
end
function updateInfo()
	if not U.built then return end
	local A = cur()
	local t = S and S.t or 0
	if A.static then t = 0 end
	U.frameTxt.Text = tostring(math.floor(t * FPS + 0.5))
	local t0, span = viewRange()
	if U.zoomed and S and S.playing and (t < t0 or t > t0 + span) then
		U.t0 = math.clamp(t - span * 0.1, 0, math.max(0, A.dur - span))
		t0 = viewRange()
		drawTimeline()
	end
	local x = (t - t0) / span
	U.head.Visible = x >= -0.001 and x <= 1.001
	U.head.Position = UDim2.new(x, 0, 0, 0)
end
function refreshPose()
	if not U.built then return end
	local k, n = curKf(), Work.part
	local p = k.pose[n]
	for i = 1, 6 do U.pose[i].Text = fmtNum(p[i]) end
	U.weightBox.Text = fmtNum(wOf(k, n))
	U.jName.Text = n .. "  (parent: " .. (n == "Torso" and "HumanoidRootPart" or "Torso") .. ")"
	if U.updateSel then U.updateSel() end
end
function refreshKf()
	if not U.built then return end
	local k = curKf()
	U.easeBtn.Text = k.ease == "Constant" and "Stepped" or k.ease
	U.dirBtn.Text = k.dir
	if U.refreshEvents then U.refreshEvents() end
end
function refreshTransport()
	if not U.built then return end
	local G = U.G
	U.playBtn.Text = (S and S.playing) and G.pause or G.play
	sel(U.modeMove, U.mode3 == "move")
	sel(U.modeRot, U.mode3 == "rotate")
	U.loopBtn.Text = "Loop: " .. (cur().loop and "ON" or "OFF")
	U.staticBtn.Text = "Static: " .. (cur().static and "ON" or "OFF")
	U.liveBtn.Text = "Live Test: " .. ((S and S.live) and "ON" or "OFF")
	U.catBtn.Text = (Work.mode == "dance" and "Dance" or CAT_LABEL[Work.cat]) .. " " .. G.dd
end
function refreshStatus()
	if not U.status then return end
	if not S then U.status.Visible = false return end
	if not S.char then
		U.status.Text = '<font color="#FF8080">Reanimation is OFF</font> - start it in Feature Center &gt; Reanimation &amp; Character. Editing stays locked until your reanimated character exists.'
		U.status.Visible = true
	elseif not (U.msgUntil and os.clock() < U.msgUntil) then
		U.status.Visible = false
	end
	if U.updateSel then U.updateSel() end
end
function refreshAll()
	if not U.built then return end
	local A, ms = cur(), Work.mode == "moveset"
	U.busy = true
	sel(U.modeBtns[1], not ms)
	sel(U.modeBtns[2], ms)
	U.catRow.Visible = ms
	U.liveRow.Visible = ms
	U.hintRow.Visible = ms
	for i, c in CATS do
		sel(U.catBtns[i], Work.cat == c)
		U.catBtns[i].Text = CAT_LABEL[c] .. (edited(Work.anims[c]) and " +" or "")
	end
	U.durBox.Text = fmtNum(A.dur)
	U.speedBox.Text = fmtNum(A.speed)
	if U.refreshAssets then U.refreshAssets() end
	if U.refreshTitle then U.refreshTitle() end
	U.busy = false
	drawTimeline(); refreshKf(); refreshPose(); updateInfo(); refreshTransport(); refreshStatus()
end

-- ===== editing actions (every one re-checks that the reanimated rig exists) =====
function selectKf(i)
	local A = cur()
	i = A.static and 1 or math.clamp(i, 1, #A.kfs)
	Work.sel = i
	if S then S.t = A.kfs[i].t; S.playing = false; touch() end
	drawTimeline(); refreshKf(); refreshPose(); updateInfo(); refreshTransport()
end
local function afterEdit() touch(); drawTimeline(); refreshKf(); refreshPose(); updateInfo(); refreshTransport() end
local function setMode(m)
	if not canEdit() or Work.mode == m then return end
	if S.live then setLive(false) end
	Work.names[Work.mode] = U.nameBox.Text
	Work.mode = m
	Work.cat = m == "dance" and "Dance" or Work.lastCat
	Work.sel = 1
	S.t, S.playing = 0, false
	U.nameBox.Text = Work.names[m] or ""
	touch()
	refreshAll()
end
local function setCat(c)
	if not canEdit() then return end
	Work.cat, Work.lastCat, Work.sel = c, c, 1
	S.t, S.playing = 0, false
	touch()
	refreshAll()
end
local function addKf(nopush)
	if not canEdit() then return end
	local A = cur()
	if A.static then say("Static pose has a single frame. Turn Static off to add keyframes.") return end
	if #A.kfs >= MAXKF then say("Keyframe limit reached (" .. MAXKF .. ").") return end
	local t = round(math.clamp(S.t, 0, A.dur), 0.01)
	local function free(x)
		for _, k in A.kfs do
			if math.abs(k.t - x) < 0.02 then return false end
		end
		return true
	end
	if not free(t) then
		local found
		for s = 1, 40 do
			local c = round(t + s * 0.05, 0.01)
			if c > A.dur then break end
			if free(c) then found = c break end
		end
		if not found then say("No free spot there - lengthen the duration or move a keyframe.") return end
		t = found
	end
	local src = curKf()
	local k = {t = t, ease = src.ease, dir = src.dir, pose = evalPose(A, t), w = src.w and table.clone(src.w) or nil}
	if nopush ~= true then pushUndo() end
	table.insert(A.kfs, k)
	table.sort(A.kfs, function(a, b) return a.t < b.t end)
	Work.sel = table.find(A.kfs, k)
	S.t, S.playing = k.t, false
	afterEdit()
end
local function dupKf()
	if not canEdit() then return end
	local A = cur()
	if A.static then say("Static pose has a single frame.") return end
	if #A.kfs >= MAXKF then say("Keyframe limit reached (" .. MAXKF .. ").") return end
	local src = curKf()
	local nextT = A.kfs[Work.sel + 1] and A.kfs[Work.sel + 1].t or A.dur
	local gap = nextT - src.t
	if gap < 0.04 then say("No room after this keyframe - move the next one or lengthen the duration.") return end
	local k = {t = round(src.t + math.min(0.25, gap / 2), 0.01), ease = src.ease, dir = src.dir, pose = copyPose(src.pose), w = src.w and table.clone(src.w) or nil}
	pushUndo()
	table.insert(A.kfs, Work.sel + 1, k)
	Work.sel += 1
	S.t, S.playing = k.t, false
	afterEdit()
end
local function delKf()
	if not canEdit() then return end
	local A = cur()
	if A.static then say("Turn Static off first.") return end
	if #A.kfs <= 1 then say("An animation needs at least one keyframe. Use Reset frame instead.") return end
	pushUndo()
	table.remove(A.kfs, Work.sel)
	Work.sel = math.min(Work.sel, #A.kfs)
	S.t, S.playing = A.kfs[Work.sel].t, false
	afterEdit()
end
local function playPause()
	if not canEdit() then return end
	if S.live then say("Turn Live Test off to play the timeline.") return end
	local A = cur()
	if A.static then say("Static pose: the pose is already applied to your character.") return end
	if S.playing then
		S.playing = false
	else
		if S.t >= A.dur - 0.001 then S.t = 0 end
		S.playing = true
	end
	touch(); refreshTransport()
end
local function stopPlay()
	if not canEdit() then return end
	S.playing, S.t = false, 0
	touch(); updateInfo(); refreshTransport()
end
local function replay()
	if not canEdit() then return end
	if S.live then say("Turn Live Test off to play the timeline.") return end
	S.t, S.playing = 0, not cur().static
	touch(); updateInfo(); refreshTransport()
end
local function toggleLoop()
	if not canEdit() then return end
	pushUndo()
	local A = cur()
	A.loop = not A.loop
	touch(); refreshTransport()
end
local function resetPart()
	if not canEdit() then return end
	pushUndo()
	local p = curKf().pose[Work.part]
	for i = 1, 6 do p[i] = 0 end
	S.playing, S.t = false, cur().static and 0 or curKf().t
	afterEdit()
end
local function resetFrame()
	if not canEdit() then return end
	pushUndo()
	curKf().pose = newPose()
	S.playing, S.t = false, cur().static and 0 or curKf().t
	afterEdit()
end
local function onPose(i, v)
	if U.busy then return end
	if not canEdit() then refreshPose() return end
	local A, k = cur(), curKf()
	pushUndo()
	k.pose[Work.part][i] = v
	S.playing, S.t = false, A.static and 0 or k.t
	touch(); updateInfo(); refreshTransport()
end
timelineDrag = function(x, first, part)
	if not S then return end
	if not S.char then canEdit() return end
	local A = cur()
	local t0, span = viewRange()
	local w = U.trk.AbsoluteSize.X
	if w <= 0 then return end
	local t = t0 + math.clamp((x - U.trk.AbsolutePosition.X) / w, 0, 1) * span
	if first then
		S.dragKf, S.dragUndo = nil, nil
		if part ~= false then
			local best, bd = nil, 16
			for i, k in A.kfs do
				if not (A.static and i > 1) and (part == nil or wOf(k, part) > 0) then
					local d = math.abs(k.t - t) / span * w
					if d <= bd then best, bd = i, d end
				end
			end
			if part then selectPart(part) end
			if best then S.dragKf = best; selectKf(best) return end
		end
	end
	local i = S.dragKf
	if i then
		if A.static then return end
		local k = A.kfs[i]
		local lo = A.kfs[i - 1] and A.kfs[i - 1].t + 0.02 or 0
		local hi = A.kfs[i + 1] and A.kfs[i + 1].t - 0.02 or A.dur
		local nt = math.max(lo, math.min(hi, round(t, 0.01)))
		if nt ~= k.t then
			if not S.dragUndo then pushUndo(); S.dragUndo = true end
			k.t = nt
		end
		S.t, S.playing = k.t, false
		touch(); drawTimeline(); refreshKf(); updateInfo()
	else
		S.playing = false
		S.t = math.clamp(round(t, 1 / FPS), 0, A.dur)
		touch(); updateInfo(); refreshTransport()
	end
end

-- ===== Live Test (moveset): the exact runtime that generated modules use, fed with the unsaved animations =====
local function makeLive()
	local s = S
	local opt = {Blend = 0.2, RunSpeed = 22, Speed = {}, Loop = {}}
	for _, c in CATS do opt.Speed[c], opt.Loop[c] = Work.anims[c].speed, Work.anims[c].loop end
	local L = getRuntime().NewMoveset(function(n) return exportTrack(Work.anims[n], "live_" .. n) end, opt)
	L.Init(s.char)
	s.live, s.liveErr = L, 0
end
function setLive(on)
	local s = S
	if not s then return end
	if on then
		if Work.mode ~= "moveset" or not canEdit() then return end
		s.playing = false
		local ok, err = pcall(makeLive)
		if ok then
			say("Live Test ON - walk, run and jump to see Idle, Moves, Run and Jump.")
		else
			s.live = nil
			say("Live Test failed: " .. tostring(err))
		end
	else
		if s.live then pcall(s.live.Destroy, s.char); s.live = nil end
		touch()
	end
	refreshTransport()
end

-- ===== pose the rig shows at the moment the Studio takes it over (a vanilla moveset / dance may be driving it): editor-space values (parent-part space, studs / degrees) =====
function U.snapshot(char)
	local joints = {}
	pcall(function()
		for _, d in char:GetDescendants() do
			if d:IsA("Motor6D") and d.Part1 and C0R[d.Part1.Name] and not joints[d.Part1.Name] then joints[d.Part1.Name] = d end
		end
	end)
	local scale = 1
	pcall(function() scale = char:GetScale() end)
	if type(scale) ~= "number" or scale <= 0 then scale = 1 end
	local snap, any = {}, false
	for _, n in PARTS do
		local j = joints[n]
		if j then
			local c = C0R[n]
			local m = c * j.Transform * c:Inverse() -- inverse of poseCF
			local p = m.Position / scale
			local rx, ry, rz = m:ToEulerAnglesXYZ()
			local v = {p.X, p.Y, p.Z, math.deg(rx), math.deg(ry), math.deg(rz)}
			for i = 1, 6 do
				local x = v[i]
				if x ~= x then x = 0 end
				v[i] = math.round(math.clamp(x, i <= 3 and -POSLIM or -180, i <= 3 and POSLIM or 180) * 1000) / 1000
			end
			snap[n] = v
			any = true
		end
	end
	return any and snap or nil
end

-- ===== the ONE playback / apply loop (Heartbeat, only while the page is open) =====
local function step(dt)
	local s = S
	if not s then return end
	if os.clock() - s.authAt > 5 then
		s.authAt = os.clock()
		if not authorized(false) then stopSession("Animation Studio closed: verified access is required.") return end
	end
	local char = rigNow()
	if char ~= s.char then -- reanimation started, stopped or the character was replaced
		if s.live then pcall(s.live.Destroy, nil); s.live = nil end
		s.playing, s.char = false, char
		s.vanilla = char and U.snapshot(char) or nil -- the pose the rig showed before the Studio took it over
		s.animator.rig = char
		touch()
		pcall(refreshStatus); pcall(refreshTransport)
	end
	if not char then return end
	local A = cur()
	if s.live then
		if s.dirty then
			s.dirty = false
			pcall(s.live.Destroy, char)
			if not pcall(makeLive) then s.live = nil; pcall(refreshTransport) end
		end
		if s.live then
			s.liveErr = pcall(s.live.Update, dt, char) and 0 or (s.liveErr + 1)
			if s.liveErr > 30 then
				pcall(s.live.Destroy, char)
				s.live = nil
				say("Live Test stopped: an animation errored.")
				pcall(refreshTransport)
			end
		end
		return
	end
	if s.playing then
		s.t += dt * A.speed
		if s.t >= A.dur then
			if A.loop and not A.static then
				s.t = s.t % A.dur
			else
				s.t, s.playing = A.dur, false
				pcall(refreshTransport)
			end
		end
		s.dirty = true
		s.acc += dt
		if s.acc >= s.period then s.acc = 0; updateInfo() end
	end
	s.keep += dt
	if s.keep > s.guard then s.keep, s.dirty = 0, true end -- the Studio re-asserts its pose every frame (every 0.1 s on low-end): nothing left running from a moveset can hold a different pose
	if s.dirty then
		s.dirty = false
		if s.stale or not s.track then
			s.stale = false
			s.track = exportTrack(A, "editor")
			s.animator.track = s.track
		end
		s.animator.rig = char
		s.animator.looped = s.playing and A.loop and not A.static and s.track.Time > 0
		local ok, err = pcall(s.animator.Step, s.animator, A.static and 0 or s.t)
		if not ok then warn("[AnimStudio] " .. tostring(err)) end
	end
end
-- ===== Animation Studio Freecam + movement lock (camera only: the character is never anchored, moved or edited) =====
local FC = {on = false, conns = {}, held = {}, speed = 24, presets = {6, 24, 64, 160}, vel = Vector3.zero, pos = Vector3.zero, joyVec = Vector2.zero, dead = 0, ml = {on = false},
	sink = {Enum.KeyCode.W, Enum.KeyCode.A, Enum.KeyCode.S, Enum.KeyCode.D, Enum.KeyCode.Space},
	arrows = {Enum.KeyCode.Up, Enum.KeyCode.Down, Enum.KeyCode.Left, Enum.KeyCode.Right}}
FC.sinkFn = function() return Enum.ContextActionResult.Sink end

-- ----- movement lock: PlayerModule controls Disable (PC keys + mobile thumbstick/jump) + scoped CAS sink; everything is saved and restored -----
function FC.lock()
	local m = FC.ml
	if m.on then return end
	m.on = true
	local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
	local ps = lp and lp:FindFirstChild("PlayerScripts")
	local pm = ps and ps:FindFirstChild("PlayerModule")
	local ok, ctl = pcall(function() return require(pm):GetControls() end)
	if ok and type(ctl) == "table" then
		m.ctl, m.was = ctl, ctl.controlsEnabled ~= false
		pcall(ctl.Disable, ctl)
	end
	local pg = lp and lp:FindFirstChildOfClass("PlayerGui")
	local tg = pg and pg:FindFirstChild("TouchGui")
	local tf = tg and tg:FindFirstChild("TouchControlFrame")
	if tf then -- default mobile joystick + jump button: hidden, never destroyed
		m.tf, m.tfv = tf, tf.Visible
		pcall(function() tf.Visible = false end)
	end
	local keys = table.clone(FC.sink)
	if not m.ctl then table.move(FC.arrows, 1, #FC.arrows, #keys + 1, keys) end
	pcall(function() ContextActionService:BindActionAtPriority("AnimStudioMoveLock", FC.sinkFn, false, 3000, table.unpack(keys)) end)
end
function FC.enforce(dt) -- keeps the lock in place for the whole session (something else re-enabling the controls is undone)
	local m = FC.ml
	if not m.on then return end
	m.t = (m.t or 0) + dt
	if m.t < 0.5 then return end
	m.t = 0
	if m.ctl and m.ctl.controlsEnabled == true then pcall(m.ctl.Disable, m.ctl) end
	if m.tf and m.tf.Parent and m.tf.Visible then pcall(function() m.tf.Visible = false end) end
end
function FC.unlock()
	local m = FC.ml
	if not m.on then return end
	m.on = false
	pcall(function() ContextActionService:UnbindAction("AnimStudioMoveLock") end)
	if m.tf and m.tf.Parent then pcall(function() m.tf.Visible = m.tfv end) end
	if m.ctl and m.was then pcall(m.ctl.Enable, m.ctl) end
	m.ctl, m.tf, m.t = nil, nil, nil
end

-- ----- freecam helpers -----
function FC.key(c) return UserInputService:IsKeyDown(c) and 1 or 0 end
function FC.paint() -- toolbar camera button: highlighted while Freecam is on
	local b = U.camBtn
	if not b then return end
	b.BackgroundColor3 = ACC
	b.BackgroundTransparency = FC.on and 0 or 1
end
function FC.refreshSpeed()
	if FC.ui then FC.ui.spd.Text = tostring(math.floor(FC.speed + 0.5)) end
end
function FC.lockMouse()
	if FC.mlock then return end
	FC.mlock = UserInputService.MouseBehavior
	UserInputService.MouseBehavior = Enum.MouseBehavior.LockCurrentPosition
end
function FC.unlockMouse()
	if not FC.mlock then return end
	UserInputService.MouseBehavior = FC.mlock
	FC.mlock = nil
end
function FC.look(dx, dy, sens)
	if FC.dead > 0 then FC.dead -= math.abs(dx) + math.abs(dy) return end -- small movement = a tap (limb pick), not a rotation
	FC.tyaw -= math.rad(dx * sens)
	FC.tpitch = math.clamp(FC.tpitch - math.rad(dy * sens), -1.5, 1.5)
end
function FC.joyReset()
	FC.joy, FC.joyO, FC.joyVec = nil, nil, Vector2.zero
	if FC.ui then FC.ui.thumb.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5) end
end
function FC.joyMove(p)
	local u = FC.ui
	if not (u and FC.joyO) then return end
	local r = math.max(u.base.AbsoluteSize.X * 0.5, 1)
	local d = Vector2.new(p.X, p.Y) - FC.joyO
	if d.Magnitude > r then d = d.Unit * r end
	u.thumb.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, d.X, 0.5, d.Y)
	local m = d.Magnitude / r
	FC.joyVec = m < 0.12 and Vector2.zero or (d / r).Unit * ((m - 0.12) / 0.88)
end
function FC.layout()
	local u, root = FC.ui, U.root
	if not (u and root) then return end
	local W, H = root.AbsoluteSize.X, root.AbsoluteSize.Y
	if W <= 0 or H <= 0 then return end
	local B = math.clamp(math.floor(H * 0.094), 34, 66)
	local gap = math.max(4, math.floor(B * 0.12))
	local js = math.clamp(math.floor(H * 0.28), 84, 150)
	local mx, my = math.floor(W * 0.04), math.floor(H * 0.04)
	u.base.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(js, js)
	u.base.Position = UDim2.new(0, mx, 1, -my) -- lower-left
	u.thumb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(js * 0.42), math.floor(js * 0.42))
	for n, k in {"up", "down", "spd"} do -- lower-right row, clear of the side tool columns and the centre transport
		local b = u[k]
		b.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(B, B)
		b.TextSize = math.floor(B * 0.42)
		b.Position = UDim2.new(1, -mx - (n - 1) * (B + gap), 1, -my)
	end
end
function FC.buildUI() -- mobile controls: exist only while Freecam is on
	local root = U.root
	if not (root and UserInputService.TouchEnabled) then return end
	local I = Util.Instance
	local dark = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 24)
	local f = I("Frame", root)
	f.Name, f.BackgroundTransparency, f.BorderSizePixel, f.Size, f.ZIndex = "AnimStudioFreecamUI", 1, 0, UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), 6
	local base = I("Frame", f)
	base.AnchorPoint, base.BackgroundColor3, base.BackgroundTransparency, base.BorderSizePixel, base.Active, base.ZIndex = Vector2.new(0, 1), dark, 0.35, 0, true, 7
	I("UICorner", base).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	local st = I("UIStroke", base)
	st.Color, st.Transparency, st.Thickness = Color3.new(1, 1, 1), 0.75, 2
	local thumb = I("Frame", base)
	thumb.AnchorPoint, thumb.Position, thumb.BackgroundColor3, thumb.BackgroundTransparency, thumb.BorderSizePixel, thumb.ZIndex = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), ACC, 0.1, 0, 8
	I("UICorner", thumb).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	local u = {frame = f, base = base, thumb = thumb}
	for key, txt in {up = utf8.char(0x25B2), down = utf8.char(0x25BC), spd = tostring(math.floor(FC.speed + 0.5))} do
		local b = I("TextButton", f)
		b.AnchorPoint, b.BackgroundColor3, b.BackgroundTransparency, b.BorderSizePixel, b.AutoButtonColor, b.ZIndex = Vector2.new(1, 1), dark, 0.25, 0, false, 7
		b.Font, b.Text, b.TextColor3 = Enum.Font.GothamBold, txt, Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		I("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
		u[key] = b
		if key == "spd" then -- cycles the movement speed
			b.Activated:Connect(function()
				local nx = FC.presets[1]
				for _, v in FC.presets do if v > FC.speed + 0.5 then nx = v break end end
				FC.speed = nx
				FC.refreshSpeed()
			end)
		else -- hold = move the camera up / down
			b.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
				local ty = i.UserInputType
				if ty == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or ty == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then FC.held[key] = i; b.BackgroundColor3 = ACC end
			end)
		end
	end
	base.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
		local ty = i.UserInputType
		if FC.joy or not (ty == Enum.UserInputType.Touch or ty == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1) then return end
		FC.joy, FC.joyO = i, Vector2.new(i.Position.X, i.Position.Y)
	end)
	FC.ui = u
	table.insert(FC.conns, root:GetPropertyChangedSignal("AbsoluteSize"):Connect(FC.layout))
	FC.layout()
end

-- ----- per-frame camera: exponential smoothing = frame-rate independent, no jumps, no shake -----
function FC.step(dt)
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not (FC.on and cam) then return end
	dt = math.min(dt, 0.1)
	if cam.CameraType ~= Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable end
	local k = 1 - math.exp(-dt * 28)
	FC.yaw += (FC.tyaw - FC.yaw) * k
	FC.pitch += (FC.tpitch - FC.pitch) * k
	local rot = CFrame.fromOrientation(FC.pitch, FC.yaw, 0)
	local x, y, z = FC.joyVec.X, 0, -FC.joyVec.Y
	if not UserInputService:GetFocusedTextBox() then
		x += FC.key(Enum.KeyCode.D) - FC.key(Enum.KeyCode.A)
		z += FC.key(Enum.KeyCode.W) - FC.key(Enum.KeyCode.S)
		y += FC.key(Enum.KeyCode.E) - FC.key(Enum.KeyCode.Q)
	end
	if FC.held.up then y += 1 end
	if FC.held.down then y -= 1 end
	local dir = rot.RightVector * x + Vector3.yAxis * y + rot.LookVector * z
	local m = dir.Magnitude
	if m > 1 then dir /= m end
	local sp = FC.speed
	if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.RightShift) then sp *= 3 end
	FC.vel = FC.vel:Lerp(dir * sp, 1 - math.exp(-dt * 14))
	if m == 0 and FC.vel.Magnitude < 0.01 then FC.vel = Vector3.zero end
	FC.pos += FC.vel * dt
	cam.CFrame = CFrame.new(FC.pos) * rot
end

function FC.enable()
	if FC.on or not S then return end
	local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not cam then return end
	FC.on = true
	FC.saved = {cam = cam, type = cam.CameraType, subject = cam.CameraSubject, fov = cam.FieldOfView, cf = cam.CFrame}
	local pitch, yaw = cam.CFrame:ToOrientation() -- start exactly where the camera is looking
	pitch = math.clamp(pitch, -1.5, 1.5)
	FC.pitch, FC.yaw, FC.tpitch, FC.tyaw = pitch, yaw, pitch, yaw
	FC.pos, FC.vel, FC.joyVec, FC.rot, FC.joy, FC.held, FC.dead = cam.CFrame.Position, Vector3.zero, Vector2.zero, nil, nil, {}, 0
	cam.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable
	local c = FC.conns
	table.insert(c, UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(i, gp)
		local ty = i.UserInputType
		if gp or FC.rot then return end
		if ty == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2 then -- right-drag rotates immediately
			FC.rot, FC.dead = i, 0
			FC.lockMouse()
		elseif ty == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or ty == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then -- drag on the 3D view (not on any editor GUI) rotates
			FC.rot, FC.dead = i, 6
			if ty == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then FC.lockMouse() end
		end
	end))
	table.insert(c, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(i, gp)
		local ty, r = i.UserInputType, FC.rot
		if ty == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement then
			if r and r.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then FC.look(i.Delta.X, i.Delta.Y, 0.16) end
			if FC.joy and FC.joy.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then FC.joyMove(i.Position) end
		elseif ty == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			if r == i then FC.look(i.Delta.X, i.Delta.Y, 0.22) elseif FC.joy == i then FC.joyMove(i.Position) end
		elseif ty == Enum.UserInputType.MouseWheel and not gp then -- wheel = speed
			FC.speed = math.clamp(FC.speed * 1.15 ^ i.Position.Z, 2, 400)
			FC.refreshSpeed()
			if os.clock() - (FC.sayAt or 0) > 0.5 then FC.sayAt = os.clock(); say("Freecam speed: " .. math.floor(FC.speed + 0.5)) end
		end
	end))
	table.insert(c, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
		local r = FC.rot
		if r and (r == i or (i.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch and r.UserInputType == i.UserInputType)) then
			FC.rot = nil
			FC.unlockMouse()
		end
		if FC.joy == i or (FC.joy and i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and FC.joy.UserInputType == i.UserInputType) then FC.joyReset() end
		for k, h in FC.held do
			if h == i or (i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and h.UserInputType == i.UserInputType) then
				FC.held[k] = nil
				local b = FC.ui and FC.ui[k]
				if b then b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 24) end
			end
		end
	end))
	pcall(function() ContextActionService:BindActionAtPriority("AnimStudioFreecamKeys", FC.sinkFn, false, 3000, Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift, Enum.KeyCode.RightShift) end) -- Shift = boost, not shift-lock
	FC.buildUI()
	pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("AnimStudioFreecam") end)
	RunService:BindToRenderStep("AnimStudioFreecam", Enum.RenderPriority.Camera.Value + 1, FC.step) -- the gizmo overlay runs at Last, after this
	FC.paint()
end
function FC.disable()
	if not FC.on then return end
	FC.on = false
	pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("AnimStudioFreecam") end)
	pcall(function() ContextActionService:UnbindAction("AnimStudioFreecamKeys") end)
	for _, c in FC.conns do pcall(c.Disconnect, c) end
	table.clear(FC.conns)
	FC.unlockMouse()
	FC.rot, FC.joy, FC.joyO, FC.joyVec, FC.held = nil, nil, nil, Vector2.zero, {}
	if FC.ui then pcall(function() FC.ui.frame:Destroy() end) FC.ui = nil end
	local sv = FC.saved
	FC.saved = nil
	if sv then
		local cam = (sv.cam and sv.cam.Parent) and sv.cam or workspace.CurrentCamera
		if cam then
			pcall(function()
				cam.CFrame = sv.cf
				cam.FieldOfView = sv.fov
				cam.CameraSubject = sv.subject
				cam.CameraType = sv.type
			end)
		end
	end
	FC.paint()
end
function FC.toggle() -- toolbar camera button
	if FC.on then
		FC.disable()
		say("Freecam off - normal camera restored.")
	elseif S then
		FC.enable()
		if FC.on then say(UserInputService.TouchEnabled and "Freecam on: joystick moves, drag to look, arrow buttons go up/down, middle button = speed." or "Freecam on: WASD move, E/Q up/down, drag to look, Shift = fast, wheel = speed.") end
	end
end

function startSession()
	if S then return end
	S = {page = U.page, conns = {}, animator = AnimLib.Animator.new(), playing = false, stale = true, dirty = true, t = 0, acc = 0, keep = 0, authAt = os.clock(), liveErr = 0, period = lowEnd() and 1 / 12 or 1 / 30, guard = lowEnd() and 0.1 or 0}
	FC.lock() -- Studio open = normal character movement disabled (PC + mobile) until stopSession; Freecam stays off until the camera button is pressed
	table.insert(S.conns, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(FC.enforce))
	table.insert(S.conns, {Disconnect = function() FC.disable(); FC.unlock() end})
	table.insert(S.conns, RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(step))
	table.insert(S.conns, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(onChanged))
	table.insert(S.conns, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(onEnded))
	table.insert(S.conns, UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(i, gp) if U.tapBegin then pcall(U.tapBegin, i, gp) end end))
	table.insert(S.conns, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(i) if U.tapEnd then pcall(U.tapEnd, i) end end))
	pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("AnimStudioGizmo") end)
	RunService:BindToRenderStep("AnimStudioGizmo", Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value, function() if gzUpdate then pcall(gzUpdate) end end) -- after the camera has moved this frame
	table.insert(S.conns, {Disconnect = function() pcall(function() RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("AnimStudioGizmo") end) end})
	pcall(Studio.RefreshSaved)
	U.nameBox.Text = Work.names[Work.mode] or ""
	refreshAll()
end
function stopSession(reason)
	local s = S
	if not s then return end
	S, Drag, PD = nil, nil, nil -- first: the regular moveset / dance loop takes over again on the next frame
	FC.disable(); FC.unlock() -- Freecam off + camera restored + character controls restored (Back / close / page hidden all land here)
	for _, c in s.conns do pcall(c.Disconnect, c) end
	table.clear(s.conns)
	if s.live then pcall(s.live.Destroy, s.char); s.live = nil end
	pcall(function() s.page.ScrollingEnabled = true end)
	if typeof(s.char) == "Instance" and s.char.Parent then
		pcall(function()
			for _, d in s.char:GetDescendants() do
				if d:IsA("Motor6D") then d.Transform = CFrame.identity end
			end
		end)
	end
	s.track, s.animator, s.char = nil, nil, nil
	if U.nameBox then Work.names[Work.mode] = U.nameBox.Text end
	pcall(refreshStatus)
	pcall(refreshTransport)
	if U.onClose then pcall(U.onClose) end
	if reason then say(reason) end
end

-- ===== saving / loading =====
local function cleanName(s)
	s = tostring(s or ""):gsub("[%c<>&\"\\]", "")
	s = s:gsub("^%s+", "")
	s = s:gsub("%s+$", "")
	return s:sub(1, 32)
end
local function nameTaken(n)
	for _, l in {MovementStyles, DanceableDances} do
		for _, m in l do
			if m.Name == n then return true end
		end
	end
	return false
end
function Studio.RefreshSaved()
	local out = {}
	local ok, list = pcall(listfiles, FOLDER)
	if ok and type(list) == "table" then
		for _, path in list do
			if #out >= 60 then break end
			if tostring(path):lower():match("%.json$") then
				local okR, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(path)) end)
				if okR and type(data) == "table" and type(data.name) == "string" and (data.kind == "DANCE" or data.kind == "MOVESET") then
					out[#out + 1] = {path = path, name = cleanName(data.name), kind = data.kind}
				end
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(out, function(a, b) return a.name:lower() < b.name:lower() end)
	Work.saved = out
	Work.savedIdx = math.clamp(Work.savedIdx, 1, math.max(1, #out))
end
local function saveCreation()
	if not authorized(true) then
		stopSession("Animation Studio: verified access is required to save.")
		return
	end
	if not canEdit() then return end
	if type(writefile) ~= "function" then error("this executor has no writefile function, so nothing can be saved", 0) end
	local kind = Work.mode == "dance" and "DANCE" or "MOVESET"
	local name = cleanName(U.nameBox.Text)
	Work.names[Work.mode] = U.nameBox.Text
	if name == "" then say("Type a name for your creation first.") return end
	if S.live then setLive(false) end
	local base = name
	local n = 1
	while nameTaken(name) do
		n += 1
		name = cleanName(base):sub(1, 28) .. " (" .. n .. ")"
	end
	local slug = name:lower():gsub("[^%w]+", "_")
	slug = slug:gsub("^_+", ""):gsub("_+$", "")
	slug = slug:sub(1, 24)
	if slug == "" then slug = "creation" end
	ensureFolders()
	local id, internal, modFile
	repeat
		id = string.format("%x%02x", os.time(), math.random(0, 255))
		internal = "AnimStudio_" .. slug .. "_" .. id
		modFile = internal .. ".lua"
	until Util.FS.IsFile(MODDIR .. modFile) ~= true and Util.FS.IsFile(FOLDER .. "/" .. internal .. ".json") ~= true
		and Util.FS.IsFile(AssetGetPathFromFilename(internal .. ".anim")) ~= true and Util.FS.IsFile(AssetGetPathFromFilename(internal .. "_Idle.anim")) ~= true
	local files, tracks, anims = {}, {}, {}
	if kind == "DANCE" then
		files.Dance = internal .. ".anim"
		tracks.Dance = exportTrack(Work.anims.Dance, internal)
		anims.Dance = Work.anims.Dance
	else
		for _, c in CATS do
			files[c] = internal .. "_" .. c .. ".anim"
			tracks[c] = exportTrack(Work.anims[c], internal .. "_" .. c)
			anims[c] = Work.anims[c]
		end
	end
	local src = moduleSource(kind, name, internal, files, anims)
	local blocked = Util.Security and Util.Security.GateModule and Util.Security.GateModule(MODDIR .. modFile, src)
	if blocked then error("the security scan blocked the generated module: " .. tostring(blocked)) end
	local fn, cerr = loadstring(src, "=AnimStudio :: " .. modFile)
	if not fn then error("generated module did not compile: " .. tostring(cerr)) end
	local proj = {v = 1, kind = kind, name = name, internal = internal, module = modFile, files = files, anims = anims}
	local written, names = {}, nil
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		for key, f in files do
			putAnim(f, tracks[key])
			table.insert(written, AssetGetPathFromFilename(f))
		end
		local jpath = FOLDER .. "/" .. internal .. ".json"
		if Util.FS.IsFile(jpath) ~= true then table.insert(written, jpath) end -- only files created by THIS save are rolled back
		local okJ, errJ = Util.FS.Write(jpath, HttpService:JSONEncode(proj))
		if not okJ then error(tostring(errJ), 0) end
		local mpath = MODDIR .. modFile
		if Util.FS.IsFile(mpath) ~= true then table.insert(written, mpath) end
		local okM, errM = Util.FS.Write(mpath, src)
		if not okM then error(tostring(errM), 0) end
		local list = fn()
		local log
		names, log = AddModules(list) -- registers through the normal pipeline: lands in the Dances / Movesets page immediately
		if not names or #names == 0 then error("registration failed" .. tostring(log)) end
	end)
	if not ok then
		for _, p in written do pcall(delfile, p) end
		error(err, 0)
	end
	if Util.UserModulesListor then Util.UserModulesListor[modFile] = names end
	pcall(Studio.RefreshSaved)
	for i, e in Work.saved do
		if e.name == name then Work.savedIdx = i end
	end
	refreshAll()
	say((kind == "DANCE" and "Dance" or "Moveset") .. " saved: " .. name .. " - find it in " .. (kind == "DANCE" and "Dances" or "Movesets") .. ".")
end
local saving = false
local function doSave()
	if saving then return end
	saving = true
	local ok, err = pcall(saveCreation)
	saving = false
	if not ok then say("Save failed: " .. tostring(err)) end
end
local function loadSaved()
	if not canEdit() then return end
	local e = Work.saved[Work.savedIdx]
	if not e then say("No saved creations yet.") return end
	local ok, data = pcall(function() return HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(e.path)) end)
	if not ok or type(data) ~= "table" or type(data.anims) ~= "table" then say("That creation could not be read.") return end
	if S.live then setLive(false) end
	local kind = data.kind == "MOVESET" and "moveset" or "dance"
	if kind == "dance" then
		Work.anims.Dance = cleanAnim(data.anims.Dance, "Dance")
	else
		for _, c in CATS do Work.anims[c] = cleanAnim(data.anims[c], c) end
	end
	Work.mode, Work.cat, Work.sel = kind, kind == "dance" and "Dance" or "Idle", 1
	table.clear(Work.hist); table.clear(Work.redo)
	Work.names[kind] = cleanName(data.name)
	U.nameBox.Text = Work.names[kind]
	S.t, S.playing = 0, false
	touch()
	refreshAll()
	say("Loaded " .. Work.names[kind] .. " - saving creates a new copy.")
end
-- startup: re-creates missing .anim files of saved creations from their project data (e.g. after "clear downloaded content")
function Studio.Restore()
	if type(listfiles) ~= "function" or type(readfile) ~= "function" or type(writefile) ~= "function" then return end
	local ok, list = pcall(listfiles, FOLDER)
	if not ok or type(list) ~= "table" then return end
	if not pcall(ensureFolders) then return end
	for _, path in list do
		if tostring(path):lower():match("%.json$") then
			pcall(function()
				local data = HttpService:JSONDecode(readfile(path))
				if type(data) ~= "table" or type(data.files) ~= "table" or type(data.anims) ~= "table" then return end
				for key, f in data.files do
					if okAnimName(f) and (key == "Dance" or table.find(CATS, key)) and Util.FS.IsFile(AssetGetPathFromFilename(f)) == false then
						local base = f:gsub("%.anim$", "")
						putAnim(f, exportTrack(cleanAnim(data.anims[key], key), base))
					end
				end
			end)
		end
	end
end

-- ===== page: Animation Editor (Free Animator style: floating "Rig Shift Animator" window, hierarchy + timeline, 3D move / rotate gizmos) =====
local function buildEditor()
	U.scrolls, U.ticks, U.gridLines, U.asRows, U.rowsBuilt = {}, {}, {}, {}, false
	U.coll, U.mode3, U.gzOn = {cam = false, rig = false}, "move", true
	local ts, ord = 14, 0
	local function nxt() ord += 1 return ord end
	local TL = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	local TXT, DIM = Color3.fromRGB(236, 236, 236), Color3.fromRGB(165, 165, 165)
	local BG, BG2, BG3, LINE = Color3.fromRGB(51, 51, 51), Color3.fromRGB(41, 41, 41), Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 70), Color3.fromRGB(104, 104, 104)
	local TH, RHD, HB, RH = 34, 26, 14, 26
	local function ch(c) return utf8.char(c) end
	local GL = {
		play = ch(0x25B6), pause = "II", prev = "|" .. ch(0x25C0), next = ch(0x25B6) .. "|", key = ch(0x25C6), keyO = ch(0x25C7),
		down = ch(0x25BC), right = ch(0x25B6), check = ch(0x2713), gear = ch(0x2699), cam = ch(0x1F4F7), undo = ch(0x21B6), redo = ch(0x21B7),
		move = ch(0x2725), rot = ch(0x21BB), pick = ch(0x25CE), reset = ch(0x21BA), mirror = ch(0x21CB), copy = ch(0x1F4D1),
		edit = ch(0x270F), del = ch(0x1F5D1), cut = ch(0x2702), clip = ch(0x1F4CB), dd = ch(0x25BE),
	}
	U.G = GL
	local setPick, layout, openPopup, closePopups, placeWin, applyRows

	local root = Util.Instance("Frame", Util.TopGui)
	root.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	root.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	root.BorderSizePixel = 0
	root.ZIndex = 2147483647
	U.root = root

	-- ----- builders -----
	local function newFrame(parent, col, tr)
		local f = Util.Instance("Frame", parent)
		f.BorderSizePixel = 0
		if col then
			f.BackgroundColor3 = col
			f.BackgroundTransparency = tr or 0
		else
			f.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		end
		return f
	end
	local function newLabel(parent, text, size, xa, col)
		local l = Util.Instance("TextLabel", parent)
		l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		l.BorderSizePixel = 0
		l.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
		l.TextSize = size or ts
		l.Text = text
		l.TextColor3 = col or TXT
		l.TextXAlignment = xa or TL
		l.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center
		return l
	end
	local function newBtn(parent, text, cb)
		local b = Util.Instance("TextButton", parent)
		b.BorderSizePixel = 0
		b.AutoButtonColor = true
		b.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansSemibold
		b.TextSize = ts
		b.Text = text
		b.TextColor3 = TXT
		b.BackgroundColor3 = BG3
		b.BackgroundTransparency = 0
		Util.Instance("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 5)
		addHl(b)
		if cb then b.Activated:Connect(function() cb(b) end) end
		return b
	end
	local function newBox(parent, ph)
		local t = Util.Instance("TextBox", parent)
		t.BorderSizePixel = 0
		t.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
		t.TextSize = ts
		t.Text = ""
		t.PlaceholderText = ph or ""
		t.PlaceholderColor3 = DIM
		t.TextColor3 = TXT
		t.ClearTextOnFocus = false
		t.TextXAlignment = TL
		t.BackgroundColor3 = BG2
		Util.Instance("UICorner", t).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 4)
		local p = Util.Instance("UIPadding", t)
		p.PaddingLeft, p.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 6), UDim.new(0, 4)
		return t
	end
	local function circ(parent, glyph, cb)
		local b = Util.Instance("TextButton", parent)
		b.BorderSizePixel = 0
		b.AutoButtonColor = false
		b.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(26, 26, 28)
		b.BackgroundTransparency = 0.22
		b.Text = glyph
		b.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
		b.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
		b.TextSize = 24
		Util.Instance("UICorner", b).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
		HL[b] = b.BackgroundColor3
		if cb then b.Activated:Connect(function() cb(b) end) end
		return b
	end
	local function newScroll(parent)
		local sf = Util.Instance("ScrollingFrame", parent)
		sf.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		sf.BorderSizePixel = 0
		sf.ScrollBarThickness = 4
		sf.ScrollBarImageColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 150)
		sf.VerticalScrollBarInset = Enum.ScrollBarInset.None
		sf.ScrollingDirection = Enum.ScrollingDirection.Y
		sf.AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
		sf.CanvasSize = UDim2.new()
		local l = Util.Instance("UIListLayout", sf)
		l.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
		l.Padding = UDim.new(0, 5)
		table.insert(U.scrolls, sf)
		return sf, l
	end
	local function rowFrame(parent, h)
		local f = newFrame(parent)
		f.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, h)
		f.LayoutOrder = nxt()
		return f
	end
	local function fill(o) o.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1) return o end
	local function btnRow(parent, items, h)
		local row = rowFrame(parent, h or 28)
		local n, btns = #items, {}
		for i, it in items do
			local b = newBtn(row, it[1], it[2])
			b.Position = UDim2.new((i - 1) / n, 0, 0, 0)
			b.Size = UDim2.new(1 / n, i < n and -3 or 0, 1, 0)
			btns[i] = b
		end
		return btns, row
	end
	local function field(parent, text)
		local r = rowFrame(parent, 28)
		local l = newLabel(r, text, ts)
		l.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
		local b = newBox(r)
		b.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0)
		b.Size = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, 0)
		return b
	end

	-- ----- actions that only exist in the new layout -----
	local function toggleStatic()
		if not canEdit() then return end
		pushUndo()
		local A = cur()
		A.static = not A.static
		Work.sel = 1
		S.t, S.playing = 0, false
		touch()
		refreshAll()
	end
	local function setDuration(v)
		if not canEdit() then refreshAll() return end
		pushUndo()
		local A = cur()
		A.dur = tonumber(string.format("%.2f", math.clamp(v, 0.2, 60)))
		for i = #A.kfs, 1, -1 do
			local hi = i == #A.kfs and A.dur or (A.kfs[i + 1].t - 0.02)
			if A.kfs[i].t > hi then A.kfs[i].t = math.max(0, hi) end
		end
		S.t = math.min(S.t, A.dur)
		afterEdit()
		U.durBox.Text = fmtNum(A.dur)
	end
	local function setSpeed(v)
		if not canEdit() then refreshAll() return end
		pushUndo()
		cur().speed = tonumber(string.format("%.2f", math.clamp(v, 0.1, 3)))
		U.speedBox.Text = fmtNum(cur().speed)
	end
	local function setKfTime(v)
		if not canEdit() then return end
		local A = cur()
		if A.static then return end
		pushUndo()
		local i, k = Work.sel, curKf()
		local lo = A.kfs[i - 1] and A.kfs[i - 1].t + 0.02 or 0
		local hi = A.kfs[i + 1] and A.kfs[i + 1].t - 0.02 or A.dur
		k.t = math.max(lo, math.min(hi, round(v, 0.01)))
		S.t, S.playing = k.t, false
		touch(); drawTimeline(); updateInfo(); refreshTransport()
	end
	local function onWeight(v)
		if not canEdit() then refreshPose() return end
		pushUndo()
		local A, k = cur(), curKf()
		v = math.clamp(v, 0, 1)
		k.w = k.w or {}
		k.w[Work.part] = v ~= 1 and v or nil
		if next(k.w) == nil then k.w = nil end
		S.playing, S.t = false, A.static and 0 or k.t
		afterEdit()
	end
	local function toggleJoint(n) -- hierarchy checkbox: joint enabled (weight > 0) in the selected keyframe
		if not canEdit() then return end
		pushUndo()
		local k = curKf()
		k.w = k.w or {}
		k.w[n] = wOf(k, n) > 0 and 0 or nil
		if next(k.w) == nil then k.w = nil end
		S.playing, S.t = false, cur().static and 0 or k.t
		afterEdit()
	end
	local function keyJoint() -- insert / select the keyframe at the playhead and enable the selected joint in it
		if not canEdit() then return end
		local A = cur()
		if A.static then say("Static pose has a single frame - edit its values directly.") return end
		local found
		for i, k in A.kfs do
			if math.abs(k.t - S.t) < 0.02 then found = i break end
		end
		if found then
			pushUndo()
			local k = A.kfs[found]
			Work.sel = found
			if k.w and k.w[Work.part] ~= nil then
				k.w[Work.part] = nil
				if next(k.w) == nil then k.w = nil end
			end
			S.t, S.playing = k.t, false
			afterEdit()
			say(Work.part .. " keyed at frame " .. math.floor(k.t * FPS + 0.5))
		else
			local n0 = #A.kfs
			addKf()
			if #A.kfs > n0 then say(Work.part .. " keyed at frame " .. math.floor(curKf().t * FPS + 0.5)) end
		end
	end
	local function selectNextKf()
		if not canEdit() then return end
		local A = cur()
		if A.static then selectKf(1) return end
		local nx
		for i, k in A.kfs do
			if k.t > S.t + 0.0105 then nx = i break end
		end
		selectKf(nx or 1)
	end
	local function stepFrame(d)
		if not canEdit() then return end
		local A = cur()
		if A.static then return end
		S.playing = false
		S.t = math.clamp((math.floor(S.t * FPS + 0.5) + d) / FPS, 0, A.dur)
		for i, k in A.kfs do
			if math.abs(k.t - S.t) < 0.017 then Work.sel = i break end
		end
		touch(); drawTimeline(); refreshKf(); refreshPose(); updateInfo(); refreshTransport()
	end
	local function copyKf()
		if not canEdit() then return end
		local k = curKf()
		Work.clip = {pose = copyPose(k.pose), w = k.w and table.clone(k.w) or nil, ease = k.ease, dir = k.dir}
		say("Keyframe copied.")
	end
	local function pasteKf(mode) -- "all" | "joint" | "mirror": into the keyframe at the playhead (created when missing)
		if not canEdit() then return end
		local c = Work.clip
		if not c then say("Clipboard is empty - copy a keyframe first.") return end
		local A = cur()
		pushUndo()
		local idx = 1
		if not A.static then
			idx = nil
			for i, k in A.kfs do
				if math.abs(k.t - S.t) < 0.02 then idx = i break end
			end
			if not idx then
				local n0 = #A.kfs
				addKf(true)
				if #A.kfs == n0 then table.remove(Work.hist) return end
				idx = Work.sel
			end
		end
		local k = A.kfs[idx]
		if mode == "joint" then
			for i = 1, 6 do k.pose[Work.part][i] = c.pose[Work.part][i] end
		elseif mode == "mirror" then
			k.pose = mirrorPose(c.pose)
		else
			k.pose = copyPose(c.pose)
			k.w = c.w and table.clone(c.w) or nil
			k.ease, k.dir = c.ease, c.dir
		end
		Work.sel = idx
		S.t, S.playing = A.static and 0 or k.t, false
		afterEdit()
		say("Pasted.")
	end
	function U.captureVanilla() -- starting pose: what the rig showed when the Studio took it over, written into the keyframe at the playhead (created when missing) as plain editor values; belongs to this project only
		if not canEdit() then return end
		local snap = S.vanilla
		if not snap then say("No pose was captured - start reanimation, then reopen Animation Studio.") return end
		local A = cur()
		pushUndo()
		local idx = 1
		if not A.static then
			idx = nil
			for i, k in A.kfs do
				if math.abs(k.t - S.t) < 0.02 then idx = i break end
			end
			if not idx then
				local n0 = #A.kfs
				addKf(true)
				if #A.kfs == n0 then table.remove(Work.hist) return end
				idx = Work.sel
			end
		end
		local k = A.kfs[idx]
		for _, n in PARTS do
			local v = snap[n]
			if v then
				for i = 1, 6 do k.pose[n][i] = v[i] end
			end
		end
		Work.sel = idx
		S.t, S.playing = A.static and 0 or k.t, false
		afterEdit()
		say("Vanilla pose captured into this keyframe.")
	end
	local function mirrorFrame()
		if not canEdit() then return end
		pushUndo()
		local k = curKf()
		k.pose = mirrorPose(k.pose)
		if k.w then
			local w2 = {}
			for n, v in k.w do w2[MIRROR[n]] = v end
			k.w = w2
		end
		S.playing, S.t = false, cur().static and 0 or k.t
		afterEdit()
		say("Keyframe mirrored (left / right swapped).")
	end
	local function cutSplit() -- on a keyframe: cut it (copy + delete); between keyframes: split the transition with a new keyframe
		if not canEdit() then return end
		local A = cur()
		if A.static then say("Static pose has a single frame.") return end
		local onKey
		for i, k in A.kfs do
			if math.abs(k.t - S.t) < 0.02 then onKey = i break end
		end
		if onKey then
			if #A.kfs <= 1 then say("An animation needs at least one keyframe.") return end
			Work.sel = onKey
			copyKf()
			delKf()
		else
			local n0 = #A.kfs
			addKf()
			if #A.kfs > n0 then say("Split: new keyframe at the playhead.") end
		end
	end
	local function zoom(f)
		local A = cur()
		local t0, span = viewRange()
		local d = math.max(A.dur, 0.05)
		local ns = math.clamp(span * f, math.min(0.1, d), d)
		local ph = S and S.t or t0
		local frac = math.clamp((ph - t0) / span, 0, 1)
		U.span = ns >= d - 1e-3 and nil or ns
		U.t0 = ph - frac * ns
		drawTimeline(); updateInfo()
	end
	local function fit()
		U.span, U.t0 = nil, 0
		drawTimeline(); updateInfo()
	end
	local function cyclSaved(d)
		if #Work.saved > 0 then
			Work.savedIdx = (Work.savedIdx - 1 + d) % #Work.saved + 1
			refreshAll()
		end
	end
	local function ensureKey() -- gizmo edits go to a keyframe AT the playhead: reuse the one there, or insert an interpolated one
		local A = cur()
		if A.static then return end
		if math.abs(curKf().t - S.t) < 0.02 then return end
		for i, k in A.kfs do
			if math.abs(k.t - S.t) < 0.02 then Work.sel = i return end
		end
		addKf(true)
	end
	local function setMode3(m)
		U.mode3 = m
		refreshTransport()
		if U.gzForce then U.gzForce() end
	end
	local function closeSlot()
		Studio.Leave()
		if U.closeFn then U.closeFn() end
	end
	local function onSave()
		if cleanName(U.nameBox.Text) == "" then
			openPopup("settings")
			say("Name your creation first, then press Save Changes.")
			return
		end
		doSave()
	end
	local exporting = false -- in-progress guard: a running export blocks a second one
	local function doExport() -- writes the current animation(s) as plain .anim files (no module / registration)
		if not canEdit() then return end
		if not authorized(true) then stopSession("Animation Studio: verified access is required to export.") return end
		if type(writefile) ~= "function" then say("This executor has no writefile function, so nothing can be exported.") return end
		if exporting then say("An export is already running - please wait for it to finish.") return end
		local base = cleanName(U.nameBox.Text)
		if base == "" then base = Work.mode == "dance" and "Dance" or "Moveset" end
		local slug = base:lower():gsub("[^%w]+", "_"):gsub("^_+", ""):gsub("_+$", ""):sub(1, 24)
		if slug == "" then slug = "export" end
		local stamp = string.format("%x", os.time())
		local list, same = {}, 0
		exporting = true -- released right after the pcall below, whether the export succeeded or failed
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			ensureFolders()
			for _, c in (Work.mode == "dance" and {"Dance"} or CATS) do
				local file = "AnimStudio_" .. slug .. "_" .. stamp .. "_" .. c .. ".anim"
				-- an identical animation that is already saved counts as exported; a different one on an occupied name gets the next free name
				local state, used = putAnim(file, exportTrack(Work.anims[c], "export_" .. c), "^AnimStudio_" .. slug .. "_%x+_" .. c .. "[_%d]*%.anim$")
				if state == "exists" then same += 1 end
				list[#list + 1] = used
			end
		end)
		exporting = false
		if ok and #list > 0 and same == #list then
			say("Already exported - identical .anim file(s) already saved, nothing rewritten: " .. table.concat(list, ", "))
		elseif ok then
			say("Exported " .. (#list - same) .. " .anim file(s): " .. table.concat(list, ", ") .. (same > 0 and (" (" .. same .. " already saved, unchanged)") or ""))
		else
			say("Export failed: " .. tostring(err))
		end
	end
	-- (screenshot function removed: the toolbar camera button is now the Freecam toggle, see FC.toggle)

	-- ----- 3D viewport helpers: limb picking + selection outline -----
	U.updateSel = function()
		local rig = S and S.char
		local part = rig and rig:FindFirstChild(Work.part)
		if not (U.root and U.root.Visible and part and part:IsA("BasePart")) then
			if U.selBox then pcall(function() U.selBox.Adornee = nil end) end
			return
		end
		pcall(function()
			if not U.selBox or not U.selBox.Parent then
				local sb = Util.Instance("SelectionBox", workspace.CurrentCamera)
				sb.Color3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 235, 255)
				sb.LineThickness = 0.03
				sb.SurfaceTransparency = 1
				U.selBox = sb
			end
			U.selBox.Adornee = part
		end)
	end
	local function pickAt(pos, auto)
		local rig = S and S.char
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not rig or not cam then return end
		local best, bd
		local ray = cam:ScreenPointToRay(pos.X, pos.Y)
		local rp = RaycastParams.new()
		rp.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Include
		rp.FilterDescendantsInstances = {rig}
		local res = workspace:Raycast(ray.Origin, ray.Direction * 1000, rp)
		if res then
			for _, n in PARTS do
				local p = rig:FindFirstChild(n)
				if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then
					local lp = p.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(res.Position)
					local h = p.Size / 2
					local d = Vector3.new(math.max(math.abs(lp.X) - h.X, 0), math.max(math.abs(lp.Y) - h.Y, 0), math.max(math.abs(lp.Z) - h.Z, 0)).Magnitude
					if res.Instance == p then d = -1 end
					if not bd or d < bd then best, bd = n, d end
				end
			end
		else
			if auto then return end
			local bestD = 70
			for _, n in PARTS do
				local p = rig:FindFirstChild(n)
				if p and p:IsA("BasePart") then
					local v, on = cam:WorldToScreenPoint(p.Position)
					if on then
						local d = (Vector2.new(v.X, v.Y) - Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y)).Magnitude
						if d < bestD then best, bestD = n, d end
					end
				end
			end
		end
		if best then
			selectPart(best)
			if not auto then say("Selected " .. best) end
		elseif not auto then
			say("No limb there - tap directly on your character.")
		end
		if not auto then setPick(false) end
	end
	function setPick(on)
		if on and not canEdit() then on = false end
		U.pick = on and true or false
		if U.hitCap then U.hitCap.Visible = U.pick end
		if U.pickBtn then sel(U.pickBtn, U.pick) end
		if U.pick then say("Tap a limb on your character to select it.") end
	end
	local hitCap = Util.Instance("TextButton", root)
	hitCap.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 235, 255)
	hitCap.BackgroundTransparency = 0.94
	hitCap.BorderSizePixel = 0
	hitCap.Text = ""
	hitCap.AutoButtonColor = false
	hitCap.Visible = false
	hitCap.ZIndex = 1
	hitCap.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	U.hitCap = hitCap
	hitCap.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		local ty = input.UserInputType
		if ty == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or ty == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then pickAt(input.Position) end
	end)
	local tapRec
	U.tapBegin = function(input, gp)
		local ty = input.UserInputType
		if gp or U.pick or not (S and S.char) or not root.Visible then return end
		if ty ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and ty ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
		tapRec = {ref = input, pos = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y), t = os.clock()}
	end
	U.tapEnd = function(input)
		local r = tapRec
		if not r then return end
		local ty = input.UserInputType
		if r.ref ~= input and not (ty == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and r.ref.UserInputType == ty) then return end
		tapRec = nil
		local pos = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
		if (pos - r.pos).Magnitude <= 10 and os.clock() - r.t <= 0.5 then pickAt(r.pos, true) end
	end

	-- ----- 3D gizmos: arrows / rings are projected onto the screen; dragging edits the selected keyframe's pose values -----
	local gzLayer = newFrame(root)
	gzLayer.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	gzLayer.ZIndex = 2
	local AXC = {Color3.fromRGB(232, 64, 64), Color3.fromRGB(72, 218, 84), Color3.fromRGB(74, 104, 255)}
	local AXV = {Vector3.xAxis, Vector3.yAxis, Vector3.zAxis}
	local NSEG = lowEnd() and 20 or 32
	local gz = {arrows = {}, rings = {}, dir = {}, ring = {}, shown = false}
	local function mkHandle(col, thick, head)
		local b = Util.Instance("TextButton", gzLayer)
		b.AutoButtonColor = false
		b.Text = ""
		b.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		b.BorderSizePixel = 0
		b.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		b.Visible = false
		local v = Util.Instance("Frame", b)
		v.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		v.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		v.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, thick)
		v.BackgroundColor3 = col
		v.BorderSizePixel = 0
		if head then
			local h = Util.Instance("Frame", b)
			h.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			h.Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.5)
			h.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18)
			h.Rotation = 45
			h.BackgroundColor3 = col
			h.BorderSizePixel = 0
		end
		return {btn = b, vis = v}
	end
	local function setSeg(h, ax, ay, bx, by, hit, extra)
		local dx, dy = bx - ax, by - ay
		h.btn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((ax + bx) / 2, (ay + by) / 2)
		h.btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) + extra, hit)
		h.btn.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx))
	end
	local function gzHide()
		if not gz.shown then return end
		gz.shown, gz.sig = false, nil
		for _, a in gz.arrows do
			a.pos.btn.Visible = false
			a.neg.btn.Visible = false
		end
		for _, r in gz.rings do
			for _, h in r do h.btn.Visible = false end
		end
	end
	-- where the engine puts a part THIS frame (parent chain through the Motor6D transforms): the gizmo never lags behind a limb that was just posed
	local motorOf, motorRig = {}, nil
	local function predCF(rig, part, depth)
		if motorRig ~= rig then
			motorRig, motorOf = rig, {}
			for _, d in rig:GetDescendants() do
				if d:IsA("Motor6D") and d.Part1 then motorOf[d.Part1] = d end
			end
		end
		local m = motorOf[part]
		if not m or not m.Part0 or depth > 3 then return part.CFrame end
		return predCF(rig, m.Part0, depth + 1) * m.C0 * m.Transform * m.C1:Inverse()
	end
	function gzUpdate(force)
		local s = S
		local rig = s and s.char
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		local part = rig and rig:FindFirstChild(Work.part)
		local par = rig and (Work.part == "Torso" and rig:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or rig:FindFirstChild("Torso"))
		if not (root.Visible and cam and s and not s.playing and not s.live and U.gzOn and part and par and part:IsA("BasePart") and par:IsA("BasePart")) then
			gzHide()
			return
		end
		if gz.hold and not PD then gz.hold = nil end
		local camCF, vp = cam.CFrame, cam.ViewportSize
		local pose = curKf().pose[Work.part]
		local mode = U.mode3
		local pCF, lCF = predCF(rig, par, 0), predCF(rig, part, 0)
		if (pCF.Position - par.Position).Magnitude > 4 then pCF = par.CFrame end
		if (lCF.Position - part.Position).Magnitude > 4 then lCF = part.CFrame end
		local C = gz.hold or lCF.Position
		-- GUI space vs viewport space: when the host GUI does not cover the whole viewport (inset), shift by the difference
		local ras = root.AbsoluteSize
		local ox, oy = vp.X - ras.X, vp.Y - ras.Y
		ox = (ox > 0.5 and ox < 300) and ox / 2 or 0
		oy = (oy > 0.5 and oy < 120) and oy or 0
		local sg = gz.sig
		if not force and gz.shown and sg and sg.cam == camCF and sg.C == C and sg.par == pCF and sg.mode == mode and sg.vy == vp.Y and sg.rx == pose[4] and sg.ry == pose[5] and sg.fov == cam.FieldOfView and sg.part == Work.part and sg.ox == ox and sg.oy == oy then return end
		gz.sig = {cam = camCF, C = C, par = pCF, mode = mode, vy = vp.Y, rx = pose[4], ry = pose[5], fov = cam.FieldOfView, part = Work.part, ox = ox, oy = oy}
		local depth = (C - camCF.Position):Dot(camCF.LookVector)
		if depth < 0.5 then gzHide() return end
		local pxPerStud = vp.Y / (2 * depth * math.tan(math.rad(cam.FieldOfView) / 2))
		local base = pCF.Rotation -- pose values live in the PARENT part's space, so the gizmo axes follow the parent
		local function P(w)
			local v = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(w)
			return v.X - ox, v.Y - oy, v.Z
		end
		gz.C, gz.shown = C, true
		if mode == "move" then
			for _, r in gz.rings do
				for _, h in r do h.btn.Visible = false end
			end
			-- arms reach ~3.6 studs to either side of the limb centre (like the reference), never smaller than ~80 px
			local armLen = math.min(math.max(3.6, 80 / pxPerStud), vp.Y * 0.42 / pxPerStud)
			gz.armLen = armLen
			local ax, ay, az = P(C)
			for i = 1, 3 do
				local d = base:VectorToWorldSpace(AXV[i])
				gz.dir[i] = d
				for sgn = 1, 2 do
					local h = sgn == 1 and gz.arrows[i].pos or gz.arrows[i].neg
					local bx, by, bz = P(C + d * (sgn == 1 and armLen or -armLen))
					if az > 0 and bz > 0 and (bx - ax) ^ 2 + (by - ay) ^ 2 > 100 then
						setSeg(h, ax, ay, bx, by, 30, 0)
						h.btn.Visible = true
					else
						h.btn.Visible = false
					end
				end
			end
		else
			for _, a in gz.arrows do
				a.pos.btn.Visible = false
				a.neg.btn.Visible = false
			end
			local R = math.min(math.max(2.6, 58 / pxPerStud), vp.Y * 0.32 / pxPerStud)
			local rx, ry = math.rad(pose[4]), math.rad(pose[5])
			-- rotation order is X, Y, Z (CFrame.Angles): the Y ring turns with X, the Z ring with X and Y
			local frames = {base, base * CFrame.Angles(rx, 0, 0), base * CFrame.Angles(rx, ry, 0)}
			local cd = camCF.Position - C
			local stepA = 2 * math.pi / NSEG
			for i = 1, 3 do
				local n = frames[i]:VectorToWorldSpace(AXV[i])
				local u = n:Cross(math.abs(n.Y) < 0.9 and Vector3.yAxis or Vector3.xAxis).Unit
				local v = n:Cross(u)
				gz.ring[i] = {C = C, n = n, u = u, v = v, R = R, px = R * pxPerStud}
				local pts = {}
				for k = 0, NSEG do
					local th = k * stepA
					pts[k] = Vector3.new(P(C + (u * math.cos(th) + v * math.sin(th)) * R))
				end
				local uc, vc = u:Dot(cd), v:Dot(cd)
				for k = 1, NSEG do
					local p, q, h = pts[k - 1], pts[k], gz.rings[i][k]
					if p.Z > 0 and q.Z > 0 then
						setSeg(h, p.X, p.Y, q.X, q.Y, 26, 2)
						local thm = (k - 0.5) * stepA
						h.vis.BackgroundTransparency = (uc * math.cos(thm) + vc * math.sin(thm) < 0) and 0.6 or 0.04
						h.btn.Visible = true
					else
						h.btn.Visible = false
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	U.gzForce = function() gz.sig = nil; gzUpdate(true) end
	-- begins a handle drag: i = axis (1..3), seg = +1 / -1 arrow half, or the ring segment grabbed
	local function gzBegin(kind, i, seg, input)
		local ty = input.UserInputType
		if ty ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and ty ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
		if PD or not canEdit() or not gz.shown or not gz.C then return end
		local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
		if not cam then return end
		local part = Work.part
		local idx = (kind == "move" and 0 or 3) + i
		local grabW, c0, ax, ring
		if kind == "move" then
			ax, c0 = gz.dir[i], gz.C
			if not ax then return end
			grabW = c0 + ax * (seg * gz.armLen * 0.55)
		else
			ring = gz.ring[i]
			if not ring then return end
			local th = (seg - 0.5) * 2 * math.pi / NSEG
			c0 = ring.C
			grabW = c0 + (ring.u * math.cos(th) + ring.v * math.sin(th)) * ring.R
		end
		local gv = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(grabW)
		if gv.Z <= 0 then return end
		local grab = Vector2.new(gv.X, gv.Y)
		local axisParam, planeAngle, s0, a0, tanS
		if kind == "move" then
			axisParam = function(pt) -- position along the axis line that is closest to the pointer ray
				local ray = cam:ViewportPointToRay(pt.X, pt.Y)
				local d = ray.Direction
				local w0 = c0 - ray.Origin
				local b = ax:Dot(d)
				local den = 1 - b * b
				if den < 1e-3 then return nil end
				return (b * d:Dot(w0) - ax:Dot(w0)) / den
			end
			s0 = axisParam(grab)
			if not s0 then return end
		else
			local rn, ru, rv = ring.n, ring.u, ring.v
			planeAngle = function(pt) -- angle of the pointer ray where it crosses the ring's plane
				local ray = cam:ViewportPointToRay(pt.X, pt.Y)
				local d = ray.Direction
				local den = d:Dot(rn)
				if math.abs(den) < 0.12 then return nil end
				local t = (c0 - ray.Origin):Dot(rn) / den
				if t < 0 then return nil end
				local r = ray.Origin + d * t - c0
				return math.atan2(r:Dot(rv), r:Dot(ru))
			end
			a0 = planeAngle(grab)
			if not a0 then -- ring seen edge-on: drag along the ring's screen tangent instead
				local tw = rn:Cross(grabW - c0).Unit
				local tv = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(grabW + tw * (ring.R * 0.1))
				local tdir = Vector2.new(tv.X, tv.Y) - grab
				if tdir.Magnitude < 0.5 then return end
				tanS = tdir.Unit
			end
		end
		pushUndo()
		S.playing = false
		ensureKey()
		local A, k = cur(), curKf()
		S.t = A.static and 0 or k.t
		touch(); updateInfo(); refreshTransport(); drawTimeline(); refreshKf()
		local v0 = k.pose[part][idx]
		local p0 = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
		local acc, last = 0, a0
		local started = beginPtr(input, function(pos)
			if not S or S.char == nil then return end
			local tgt = grab + (pos - p0)
			local nv
			if kind == "move" then
				local s = axisParam(tgt)
				if not s then return end
				nv = math.clamp(v0 + (s - s0), -POSLIM, POSLIM)
			else
				if tanS then
					acc = (pos - p0):Dot(tanS) / ring.px
				else
					local a = planeAngle(tgt)
					if not a then return end
					acc += (a - last + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi
					last = a
				end
				nv = (v0 + math.deg(acc) + 180) % 360 - 180
			end
			nv = tonumber(string.format("%.3f", nv))
			if k.pose[part][idx] == nv then return end
			k.pose[part][idx] = nv
			S.playing, S.t = false, A.static and 0 or k.t
			touch(); updateInfo(); refreshPose()
		end, function()
			gz.hold = nil
			gz.sig = nil
			if S then refreshPose(); drawTimeline() end
		end)
		if started and kind == "rot" then gz.hold = c0 end -- keep the ring still under the pointer while the limb turns
	end
	for i = 1, 3 do
		local hp, hn = mkHandle(AXC[i], 5, true), mkHandle(AXC[i], 5, true)
		gz.arrows[i] = {pos = hp, neg = hn}
		hp.btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input) gzBegin("move", i, 1, input) end)
		hn.btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input) gzBegin("move", i, -1, input) end)
		gz.rings[i] = {}
		for k = 1, NSEG do
			local r = mkHandle(AXC[i], 4, false)
			gz.rings[i][k] = r
			r.btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input) gzBegin("rot", i, k, input) end)
		end
	end

	-- ----- the floating "Rig Shift Animator" window -----

	titleBar.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(218, 218, 218)
	titleBar.Text = "Rig Shift Animator - Unnamed"
	U.winTitle = titleBar

	titleBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)

		if ty ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and ty ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then return end
		local p0 = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)

	function placeWin()
		local W, H = root.AbsoluteSize.X, root.AbsoluteSize.Y
		local ww, wh = U.winW or win.AbsoluteSize.X, U.winH or win.AbsoluteSize.Y
		if W <= 0 or H <= 0 then return end
		if Work.winX == nil then Work.winX, Work.winY = (W - ww) / 2, H * 0.26 end
		Work.winX = math.clamp(Work.winX, 0, math.max(0, W - ww))
		Work.winY = math.clamp(Work.winY, 0, math.max(0, H - wh))
		win.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(Work.winX), math.floor(Work.winY))
	end

		local nm = cleanName((U.nameBox and U.nameBox.Text) or Work.names[Work.mode] or "")
		titleBar.Text = "Rig Shift Animator - " .. (nm ~= "" and nm or "Unnamed")
	end
	U.catBtn = newBtn(titleBar, "Dance", function()
		if Work.mode == "moveset" then setCat(cycle(CATS, Work.cat)) else openPopup("settings") end

	U.catBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0, 78, 1, -8)
	U.catBtn.TextSize = 13

	-- header: settings + zoom on the left, numbered ruler on the right

	hBtn(GL.gear, function() openPopup("settings") end)

	local scroller, slay = newScroll(win)

		lb.ZIndex = 2
		Util.Instance("UIPadding", lb).PaddingLeft = UDim.new(0, r.up and 24 or 8)
		r.lbl = lb
		lb.Activated:Connect(function()
			if r.grp then
				U.coll[r.id] = not U.coll[r.id]
				applyRows()
			elseif r.kind == "part" then
				selectPart(r.part)
			else
				say("Camera tracks are not used by Dance / Moveset animations.")
			end
		end)
		if r.kind == "part" then
			local cb = Util.Instance("TextButton", row)
			cb.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0.5)
			cb.Position = UDim2.new(0.32, -8, 0.5, 0)
			cb.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(17, 17)
			cb.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(238, 238, 238)
			cb.BorderSizePixel = 0

			cb.Text = GL.check
			cb.ZIndex = 3
			Util.Instance("UICorner", cb).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 3)
			cb.Activated:Connect(function() toggleJoint(r.part) end)
			r.chk = cb
		end
		local lane = newFrame(row)
		lane.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.32, 0)
		lane.Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.68, 1)
		lane.ClipsDescendants = true
		local trk = newFrame(lane)
		trk.Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 0)
		trk.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, 0)
		r.lane = trk
		local hit = Util.Instance("TextButton", lane)
		hit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
		hit.BorderSizePixel = 0
		hit.Text = ""
		hit.AutoButtonColor = false
		hit.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		hit.ZIndex = 5
		local hp -- nil = any joint (Rig row), false = scrub only, "Part" = that joint
		if r.kind == "part" then hp = r.part elseif r.kind ~= "all" then hp = false end
		hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input) beginDrag(input, function(x, first) timelineDrag(x, first, hp) end) end)
		local sep = newFrame(row, Color3.fromRGB(68, 68, 68))
		sep.Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 1, -1)
		sep.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1)
		sep.ZIndex = 4
	end

		for _, r in ROWS do
			if r.up then r.row.Visible = not U.coll[r.up] end
			r.lbl.Text = r.grp and ((U.coll[r.id] and GL.right or GL.down) .. " " .. r.name) or r.name
		end
	end

		beginDrag(input, function(x)
			local t0, span = viewRange()
			local d = math.max(cur().dur, 0.05)
			if span >= d - 1e-3 then return end
			local bw = hb.AbsoluteSize.X
			if bw <= 0 then return end
			local frac = math.clamp((x - hb.AbsolutePosition.X) / bw, 0, 1)
			U.t0 = math.clamp(frac * d - span / 2, 0, d - span)
			drawTimeline(); updateInfo()
		end)
	end)
	U.wheel = function(z)
		if U.min or not (U.zoomed and win.Visible and S) then return end
		local m = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
		local p, s = win.AbsolutePosition, win.AbsoluteSize
		if m.X < p.X or m.X > p.X + s.X or m.Y < p.Y or m.Y > p.Y + s.Y then return end
		local t0, span = viewRange()
		U.t0 = t0 - z * span * 0.15
		drawTimeline(); updateInfo()
	end

	statusHook = function(t)
		if not U.status then return end
		t = tostring(t):gsub("&", "&amp;"):gsub("<", "&lt;"):gsub(">", "&gt;")

	-- ----- popups: settings (animation) / edit (keyframe values) / library (clipboard + saved data) -----
	local popups = {}
	local function newPopup(name, title, w, h)
		local f = Util.Instance("Frame", root)
		f.BackgroundColor3 = BG
		f.BorderSizePixel = 0
		f.Active = true
		f.Visible = false
		f.ZIndex = 30
		f.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		f.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
		Util.Instance("UICorner", f).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
		local st = Util.Instance("UIStroke", f)
		st.Color, st.Thickness = LINE, 2
		local t = newLabel(f, title, 16)
		t.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
		t.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 0)
		t.Size = UDim2.new(1, -56, 0, 34)
		local x = newBtn(f, "X", function() closePopups() end)
		x.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(1, 0)
		x.Position = UDim2.new(1, -6, 0, 4)
		x.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(28, 26)
		local sf = newScroll(f)
		sf.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 38)
		sf.Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -46)
		popups[name] = {frame = f, w = w, h = h}
		return sf
	end
	function closePopups()
		for _, p in popups do p.frame.Visible = false end
		U.popup = nil
	end
	function openPopup(name)
		local was = U.popup
		closePopups()
		local p = popups[name]
		if was == name or not p then return end
		local W, H = root.AbsoluteSize.X, root.AbsoluteSize.Y
		p.frame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.min(p.w, W - 16), math.min(p.h, H - 16))
		p.frame.Visible = true
		U.popup = name
		if name == "library" then
			pcall(Studio.RefreshSaved)
			U.refreshAssets()
		end
	end

	end

	do

		U.pose = {}
		U.evInfo = fill(newLabel(rowFrame(jt, 20), "", 13, TL, DIM))
		U.kfTimeBox = field(jt, "Key time (s)")
		U.kfTimeBox.FocusLost:Connect(function()
			local v = tonumber(U.kfTimeBox.Text)
