c = {top = 0, rest = 0}
cats[e.cat] = c
end
if e.weight > c.top then
c.rest += c.top
c.top = e.weight
else
c.rest += e.weight
end
if e.crit then
c.crit = true
crit = true
end
end
local total, ncat = 0, 0
for _, c in pairs(cats) do
local s = c.top + cfg.RestFactor * c.rest
if not c.crit and s > cfg.CategoryCap then s = cfg.CategoryCap end
if s >= 30 then ncat += 1 end
total += s
end
for _, c in ipairs(combos) do
total += c.weight
list[#list + 1] = c
if c.crit then crit = true end
end
table.sort(list, byWeight)
local verdict = "CLEAN"
if total >= cfg.MaliciousScore and (crit or #combos > 0 or ncat >= 2) then
verdict = "MALICIOUS"
elseif total >= cfg.SuspiciousScore then
verdict = "SUSPICIOUS"
end
local reasons = {}
for i, e in ipairs(list) do
reasons[i] = {id = e.id, cat = e.cat, weight = e.weight, desc = e.desc, line = lineOfAbs(state, e.abs), count = e.count, conf = math.min(0.99, 0.3 + e.weight / 150)}
end
local conf
if verdict == "CLEAN" then
conf = math.max(0.5, 1 - 0.5 * total / cfg.SuspiciousScore)
else
conf = 0.4 + 0.08 * math.min(#list, 5) + (#combos > 0 and 0.15 or 0) + (crit and 0.25 or 0)
conf = verdict == "MALICIOUS" and math.min(0.99, math.max(conf, 0.6)) or math.min(0.9, conf - 0.1)
end
local severity = "none"
if crit then
severity = "critical"
elseif verdict == "MALICIOUS" then
severity = "high"
elseif verdict == "SUSPICIOUS" then
severity = "medium"
elseif total >= cfg.LowScore then
severity = "low"
end
return {verdict = verdict, score = math.floor(total + 0.5), confidence = conf, severity = severity, reasons = reasons}
end
local memo, memoOrder = {}, {}
-- identical sources (verified SHA-256) are analysed once; the report is a pure function of the text
local function memoKey(content)
if #content <= cfg.SyncMax then return nil end
local x = Util.ExtGuard
if not (x and x.CanHash and x.SecHash and x.CanHash()) then return nil end
return x.SecHash(content)
end
function Security.Analyze(content, gen)
if type(content) ~= "string" then error("Security.Analyze expects a string") end
-- anything bigger than a few KB is analysed in bounded slices whenever the caller can yield, so a large source can never monopolise the frame
if gen == nil and #content > cfg.SyncMax and coroutine.isyieldable() then gen = true end
local key = memoKey(content)
local hit = key and memo[key]
if hit then return hit end
ensureClock()
local state = {ev = {}, flags = {}, esc = 0, escRuns = 0, hexid = 0, tiny = 0, t0 = os.clock(), gen = gen, bg = type(gen) == "number"}
local view = prepare(content, state, gen)
local report
if view then
state.view = view
if scanView(view, state, gen) then report = evaluate(state) end
end
Security._act[state] = nil
if report and key then
if not memo[key] then
memoOrder[#memoOrder + 1] = key
if #memoOrder > cfg.MemoMax then memo[table.remove(memoOrder, 1)] = nil end
end
memo[key] = report
end
return report
end
Security._emb, Security._embLen = {}, {}
-- internal only: the embedded Nameless Admin runner registers its own embedded sources (verified SHA-256 identity, so a modified or external copy never matches); the optional name is the verified chunk identity of that source
function Security.TrustEmbedded(src, name)
local x = Util.ExtGuard
if type(src) ~= "string" or #src < 64 or not (x and x.CanHash and x.CanHash()) then return end
local h = x.SecHash(src)
if h then
if Security._emb[h] == nil or Security._emb[h] == true then Security._emb[h] = (type(name) == "string" and name ~= "") and name or true end
Security._embLen[#src] = true
return true
end
end
-- returns (isEmbedded, verifiedChunkName or nil)
function Security.IsEmbedded(content)
if type(content) ~= "string" or not Security._embLen[#content] then return false end
local x = Util.ExtGuard
local h = x and x.SecHash and x.SecHash(content)
if h == nil or Security._emb[h] == nil then return false end
return true, type(Security._emb[h]) == "string" and Security._emb[h] or nil
end
function Security.Enabled() return SaveData.SecurityScan ~= false end
function Security.AutoDelete() return SaveData.SecurityAutoDelete == true end
local qSeq = 0
local function quarantineName(path)
qSeq += 1
local safe = (normalize(path):gsub("[^%w%._%-]", "_"))
if #safe > 80 then safe = safe:sub(-80) end
return string.format("%s/%s.%d.%d.quarantined", cfg.QuarantineDir, safe, os.time(), qSeq)
end
local function deleteFile(path, content)
if type(writefile) ~= "function" or type(delfile) ~= "function" or type(readfile) ~= "function" or type(isfile) ~= "function" then
return false, nil, "executor lacks the file functions needed for a safe quarantine"
end
pcall(makefolder, cfg.QuarantineDir)
if type(isfolder) == "function" then
local okF, isF = pcall(isfolder, cfg.QuarantineDir)
if not (okF and isF) then return false, nil, "quarantine folder is unavailable" end
end
local target
for _ = 1, 25 do
local t = quarantineName(path)
local okE, exists = pcall(isfile, t)
if okE and not exists then
target = t
break
end
end
if not target then return false, nil, "no free quarantine file name" end
local okW, errW = pcall(writefile, target, content)
if not okW then
pcall(delfile, target)
return false, nil, "quarantine write failed: " .. tostring(errW)
end
local okR, back = pcall(readfile, target)
if not (okR and back == content) then
pcall(delfile, target)
return false, nil, "quarantine copy failed verification"
end
local okO, now = pcall(readfile, path)
if not (okO and now == content) then return false, target, "file changed since the scan, kept in place" end
pcall(delfile, path)
local okG, still = pcall(isfile, path)
if not okG or still then return false, target, "delete did not remove the file" end
return true, target
end
local reported, byKey = {}, {}
local function respond(path, report, content, blocked)
local key = normalize(path) .. "|" .. report.verdict .. "|" .. report.score .. "|" .. #content
local first = not reported[key]
reported[key] = true
local why = reasonText(report)
local name = shortName(path)
local malicious = report.verdict == "MALICIOUS"
local deleted, qpath, dwhy = false, nil, nil
local prior = byKey[key]
if malicious and not (prior and prior.deleted) and Security.AutoDelete() and not under(path, cfg.ReportOnlyDirs) then
if report.confidence >= cfg.AutoDeleteMinConfidence then
deleted, qpath, dwhy = deleteFile(path, content)
else
dwhy = "confidence too low for auto-delete"
end
end
if qpath then Stats.Quarantined += 1 end
if first then
Stats.Flagged += 1
local ev, lines = {}, {}
for i = 1, math.min(8, #report.reasons) do
ev[i] = report.reasons[i]
if report.reasons[i].line then lines[#lines + 1] = report.reasons[i].line end
end
local finding = {path = path, verdict = report.verdict, score = report.score, why = why, deleted = deleted, time = os.time(), confidence = report.confidence, severity = report.severity, evidence = ev, lines = lines, quarantined = qpath, note = dwhy}
byKey[key] = finding
table.insert(Security.Findings, finding)
if #Security.Findings > cfg.MaxFindings then table.remove(Security.Findings, 1) end
elseif prior then
if deleted then prior.deleted = true end
if qpath then prior.quarantined = qpath end
if dwhy then prior.note = dwhy end
end
if deleted then
Stats.Deleted += 1
log("DELETED " .. path .. " [score " .. report.score .. "]: " .. why .. " (copy kept in " .. tostring(qpath) .. ")")
notify("Auto-deleted " .. name .. ": " .. why)
else
if dwhy and malicious then log("KEPT " .. path .. ": " .. dwhy) end
if first then
log(report.verdict .. " " .. path .. string.format(" [score %d, confidence %.2f, %s]: ", report.score, report.confidence, report.severity) .. why)
if malicious then
notify((blocked and "Blocked malicious module " or "Malicious file found: ") .. name .. ": " .. why)
elseif blocked then
notify("Suspicious module needs review: " .. name .. " (details in Init Logs)")
else
notify("Suspicious file: " .. name .. " (details in Init Logs)")
end
end
end
if first and malicious and Security.OnMalicious then
pcall(Security.OnMalicious, path, report)
end
return deleted
end
local function keep(list, item)
table.insert(list, item)
if #list > cfg.MaxLogged then table.remove(list, 1) end
end
local noted = {}
local function noteError(path, what, err)
Stats.Errors += 1
local key = tostring(path) .. "|" .. what
if noted[key] then return end
noted[key] = true
keep(Security.Errors, {path = path, what = what, err = tostring(err), time = os.time()})
log("ERROR " .. what .. ": " .. tostring(path) .. " (" .. tostring(err) .. ")")
end
local function noteSkip(path, reason)
local key = tostring(path) .. "|skip|" .. reason
if noted[key] then return end
noted[key] = true
Stats.Skipped += 1
keep(Security.Skipped, {path = path, reason = reason, time = os.time()})
log("SKIPPED " .. tostring(path) .. ": " .. reason)
end
function Security.GateModule(path, content)
if not Security.Enabled() or type(content) ~= "string" then return nil end
if #content > cfg.GateMaxBytes then
local msg = "module is larger than " .. cfg.GateMaxBytes .. " bytes and cannot be scanned"
noteSkip(path, msg)
if cfg.BlockOversize then return msg end
return nil
end
if Security.IsEmbedded(content) then return nil end
local ok, report = pcall(Security.Analyze, content)
if not ok or type(report) ~= "table" then
Stats.Errors += 1
local msg = "security scan failed: " .. tostring(report)
log("ERROR " .. tostring(path) .. ": " .. msg)
report = {verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", score = cfg.SuspiciousScore, confidence = 0.2, severity = "medium", reasons = {{id = "scan_error", cat = "error", weight = 0, desc = msg, conf = 0}}}
respond(path, report, content, true)
if cfg.BlockOnScanError then return msg end
return nil
end
if report.verdict == "CLEAN" then return nil end
respond(path, report, content, true)
if report.verdict == "MALICIOUS" then return reasonText(report) end
if report.verdict == "SUSPICIOUS" and cfg.SuspiciousPolicy == "block" then return reasonText(report) end
return nil
end
local function waitFrameHealthy(gen)
local waited = 0
while (Security._frame > cfg.MaxFrameTime or Security._fgActive()) and waited < 5 and Security._gen == gen do
task.wait(0.25)
waited += 0.25
end
end
local function fingerprint(content)
local n = #content
local h = n
local step = math.max(1, n // 48)
for i = 1, n, step do
local a, b, c, d = content:byte(i, i + 3)
h = (h * 31 + (a or 0) * 7 + (b or 0) * 5 + (c or 0) * 3 + (d or 0)) % 2147483647
end
local t = content:sub(-16)
for i = 1, #t do h = (h * 31 + t:byte(i)) % 2147483647 end
return n .. ":" .. h
end
local function spread(key)
local h = #key
for i = 1, math.min(#key, 24) do h = (h * 31 + key:byte(-i)) % 9973 end
return h % cfg.CacheFullRescanEvery
end
local function scanFile(path, gen)
local ok, content = pcall(readfile, path)
if not ok or type(content) ~= "string" then
noteError(path, "unreadable file", ok and ("readfile returned " .. type(content)) or content)
return
end
local size = #content
if size == 0 then
Stats.Scanned += 1
Stats.PassScanned += 1
return
end
if size > cfg.MaxFileBytes then
noteSkip(path, "larger than " .. cfg.MaxFileBytes .. " bytes (" .. size .. ")")
return
end
if Security.IsEmbedded(content) then
Stats.Scanned += 1
Stats.PassScanned += 1
return
end
local key, fp = normalize(path):lower(), fingerprint(content)
local cached, report = Security._cache[key], nil
if cached and cached.fp == fp and Stats.Passes - cached.pass < cfg.CacheFullRescanEvery then
report = cached.report
else
local okA, res = pcall(Security.Analyze, content, gen)
if not okA then
noteError(path, "scan failed", res)
return
end
if not res then return end
report = res
Security._cache[key] = {fp = fp, report = report, pass = Stats.Passes + spread(key)}
end
Stats.Scanned += 1
Stats.PassScanned += 1
if report.verdict ~= "CLEAN" then respond(path, report, content, false) end
end
local function runPass(gen)
local queue, head, tail, seen, nfiles, capped = {}, 1, 0, {}, 0, false
for _, root in ipairs(cfg.Roots) do
seen[normalize(root):lower()] = true
tail += 1
queue[tail] = {dir = true, path = root, depth = 0}
end
while head <= tail do
if Security._gen ~= gen then return false end
local item = queue[head]
queue[head] = false
head += 1
if item.dir then
local listable = true
if item.path ~= "" then
local okI, isF = pcall(isfolder, item.path)
listable = not (okI and not isF)
end
if listable then
local ok, list = pcall(listfiles, item.path)
if ok and type(list) == "table" then
for i, p in ipairs(list) do
local key = normalize(p):lower()
if not seen[key] then
seen[key] = true
if not under(p, cfg.SkipDirs) then
local okf, isdir = pcall(isfolder, p)
if okf and isdir then
if item.depth < cfg.MaxDepth then
tail += 1
queue[tail] = {dir = true, path = p, depth = item.depth + 1}
else
noteSkip(p, "folder deeper than " .. cfg.MaxDepth .. " levels")
end
elseif shouldScan(p) then
if nfiles < cfg.MaxFiles then
nfiles += 1
tail += 1
queue[tail] = {path = p}
elseif not capped then
capped = true
noteSkip(item.path, "file limit " .. cfg.MaxFiles .. " reached; remaining files not queued")
end
end
end
end
if i % 40 == 0 then task.wait() end
end
else
noteError(item.path, "cannot list folder", ok and "listfiles returned " .. type(list) or list)
end
end
task.wait(cfg.ListDelay)
else
waitFrameHealthy(gen)
if Security._gen ~= gen then return false end
status("Security: scanning " .. shortName(item.path))
local okS, errS = pcall(scanFile, item.path, gen)
if not okS then noteError(item.path, "scan crashed", errS) end
task.wait(cfg.FileDelay)
end
end
return true
end
local function loop(gen)
if not Security._booted then
Security._booted = true
local t0 = os.clock()
while Security._gen == gen and os.clock() - t0 < cfg.StartDelay do task.wait(1) end
end
while Security._gen == gen do
Stats.PassScanned = 0
if not runPass(gen) then return end
if Security._gen ~= gen then return end
Stats.Passes += 1
if Stats.Passes == 1 then
log("First full scan finished: " .. Stats.PassScanned .. " files checked, " .. Stats.Flagged .. " flagged.")
end
status("Security: idle (pass " .. Stats.Passes .. " done)")
Security._scanNow = false
Security._idle = true
local waited = 0
while Security._gen == gen and not Security._scanNow and waited < cfg.PassDelay do
task.wait(1)
waited += 1
end
if Security._gen == gen then Security._idle = false end
end
end
function Security.Start()
if not Security.Enabled() or Security._running then return end
Security._running = true
Security._gen += 1
local gen = Security._gen
ensureClock()
status("Security: starting")
task.spawn(function()
local ok, err = pcall(loop, gen)
if not ok then noteError("Security.loop", "background scan crashed", err) end
end)
end
function Security.Stop()
Security._gen += 1
Security._running = false
Security._idle = false
if Security._conn then
Security._conn:Disconnect()
Security._conn = nil
end
status("Security: background scan is OFF")
end
function Security.ScanNow()
if not Security._running then
notify("Turn on Background Malware Scan first")
elseif Security._idle then
Security._cache = {}
Security._scanNow = true
notify("Starting a new security scan")
else
notify("A security scan is already running")
end
end
return Security
end)
if built and type(sec) == "table" then
Util.Security = sec
else
warn("[Uhhhhhh] Security module failed to load: " .. tostring(sec))
end
end
-- Section: Security Protection - Part 1/5: external protection core (state, registry, caller identification, history)

do
local okA, errA = pcall(function()
local X = {
	Stats = {Intercepted = 0, Scanned = 0, MaliciousBlocked = 0, SuspiciousDetected = 0, PhishingBlocked = 0, RuntimeBlocked = 0},
	Findings = {}, History = {}, List = {}, Map = {}, Downloads = {}, NDown = 0, Trusted = {}, Approved = {}, CapLines = {},
	Limits = {
		"Scripts run from the executor's editor, clipboard or script hub are compiled by the executor itself before UH can see them: their source cannot be inspected (UNVERIFIED). Only their later calls through guarded functions are monitored.",
		"A script that cached an original function before UH loaded, or that reaches executor internals directly, can bypass a guard.",
		"Redirect chains are judged from the address text only: following hops would need requests, and UH Security makes none.",
		"require(assetId) and native Roblox services that are not reached through a guarded call are not intercepted.",
		"UH Admin's own runners (P.execute, runUrl, Nameless Admin, built-in modules) are intentionally excluded.",
		"CLEAN only means no known pattern was found. It is not a guarantee of safety.",
	},
	NScripts = 0, Seq = 0, NTrust = 0, Active = false,
	MaxFindings = 60, MaxHistory = 120, MaxSource = 4 * 1024 * 1024,
}
X.Overflow = {id = "EXT-OVER", name = "(too many scripts tracked)", origin = "overflow", verdict = "UNVERIFIED", status = "monitored", ops = 0, threads = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}), allow = {}}
Util.ExtGuard = X
X.Rank = {CLEAN = 0, UNVERIFIED = 1, SUSPICIOUS = 2, MALICIOUS = 3}

function X.On(key) return SaveData[key] ~= false end
function X.Esc(s)
	return (tostring(s):gsub("[&<>\"']", {["&"] = "&amp;", ["<"] = "&lt;", [">"] = "&gt;", ["\""] = "&quot;", ["'"] = "&apos;"}))
end
local pend = false
function X.Touch()
	if pend or not X.OnUpdate then return end
	pend = true
	task.delay(0.5, function()
		pend = false
		pcall(X.OnUpdate)
	end)
end
local function push(list, item, max)
	table.insert(list, 1, item)
	if #list > max then list[#list] = nil end
end
function X.Hist(kind, text, id)
	text = tostring(text)
	push(X.History, {t = os.time(), kind = kind, text = text:sub(1, 160), id = id}, X.MaxHistory)
	pcall(function() InitLogsText.Add("\n[EXTGUARD] " .. kind .. ": " .. text:sub(1, 200)) end)
	X.Touch()
end
function X.AddFinding(f)
	f.t = os.time()
	push(X.Findings, f, X.MaxFindings)
	X.Touch()
end
function X.Notify(text) task.defer(pcall, Util.UINotify, text) end

function X.FP(s)
	local n = #s
	local step = math.max(1, n // 2048)
	local h = 5381
	for i = 1, n, step do h = (h * 33 + string.byte(s, i)) % 4294967296 end
	return n .. ":" .. h
end
-- X.Hash (weak 32-bit) removed: it can no longer be used as an approval identity. X.FP stays for download association only.
-- X.SecHash returns "sha256:<length>:<hex>" or nil. An executor digest API is trusted only after it reproduces two NIST SHA-256
-- known-answer vectors, its output shape (hex / raw / base64) is verified, and it hashes "a\0b" and "a\0c" differently.
X.ApproveMax = 64
local SHA_KAT = {
	{"abc", "ba7816bf8f01cfea414140de5dae2223b00361a396177a9cb410ff61f20015ad"},
	{"abcdbcdecdefdefgefghfghighijhijkijkljklmklmnlmnomnopnopq", "248d6a61d20638b8e5c026930c3e6039a33ce45964ff2167f6ecedd419db06c1"},
}
local B64V = {}
do
	local a = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
	for i = 1, 64 do B64V[a:byte(i)] = i - 1 end
end
local function digestHex(r, fmt)
	if type(r) ~= "string" then return nil end
	if fmt == "hex" then
		if #r == 64 and not r:find("%X") then return r:lower() end
	elseif fmt == "raw" then
		if #r == 32 then return (r:gsub(".", function(c) return string.format("%02x", c:byte()) end)) end
	elseif fmt == "b64" then
		local s = (r:gsub("=+$", ""))
		if #s == 43 then
			local out, acc, bits = {}, 0, 0
			for i = 1, #s do
				local v = B64V[s:byte(i)]
				if not v then return nil end
				acc = acc * 64 + v
				bits += 6
				if bits >= 8 then
					bits -= 8
					out[#out + 1] = string.format("%02x", math.floor(acc / 2 ^ bits) % 256)
					acc = acc % 2 ^ bits
				end
			end
			if #out == 32 then return table.concat(out) end
		end
	end
	return nil
end
local function probeSha()
	local g = (type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv()) or _G
	local cand = {}
	local function add(label, f) cand[#cand + 1] = {label, f} end
	local cr = g.crypt
	if type(cr) == "table" then
		if type(cr.hash) == "function" then
			local hf = cr.hash
			add("crypt.hash", function(d) return hf(d, "sha256") end)
		end
		local cu = cr.custom
		if type(cu) == "table" and type(cu.hash) == "function" then
			local hf = cu.hash
			add("crypt.custom.hash", function(d) return hf("sha256", d) end)
		end
	end
	local sy = g.syn
	local sc = type(sy) == "table" and sy.crypt or nil
	if type(sc) == "table" then
		local cu = sc.custom
		if type(cu) == "table" and type(cu.hash) == "function" then
			local hf = cu.hash
			add("syn.crypt.custom.hash", function(d) return hf("sha256", d) end)
		end
		if type(sc.hash) == "function" then
			local hf = sc.hash
			add("syn.crypt.hash", function(d) return hf(d, "sha256") end)
		end
	end
	for _, c in ipairs(cand) do
		local f = c[2]
		local ok, r = pcall(f, SHA_KAT[1][1])
		local fmt
		if ok then
			for _, ft in ipairs({"hex", "raw", "b64"}) do
				if digestHex(r, ft) == SHA_KAT[1][2] then
					fmt = ft
					break
				end
			end
		end
		local good = fmt ~= nil
		if good then
			for i = 2, #SHA_KAT do
				local ok2, r2 = pcall(f, SHA_KAT[i][1])
				if not ok2 or digestHex(r2, fmt) ~= SHA_KAT[i][2] then
					good = false
					break
				end
			end
		end
		if good then
			local o1, r1 = pcall(f, "a\0b")
			local o2, r2 = pcall(f, "a\0c")
			local h1, h2 = o1 and digestHex(r1, fmt), o2 and digestHex(r2, fmt)
			good = (h1 and h2 and h1 ~= h2) and true or false
		end
		if good then return {f = f, fmt = fmt, label = c[1]} end
	end
	return nil
end
local shaCache
local function sha()
	if shaCache == nil then
		local okp, st = pcall(probeSha)
		shaCache = (okp and st) or false
	end
	return shaCache
end
function X.CanHash()
	local st = sha()
	if st then return true, st.label end
	return false
end
function X.SecHash(s)
	if type(s) ~= "string" then return nil end
	local st = sha()
	if not st then return nil end
	local ok, r = pcall(st.f, s)
	local hex = ok and digestHex(r, st.fmt) or nil
	if not hex then return nil end
	return "sha256:" .. #s .. ":" .. hex
end
function X.Download(url, body)
	if type(url) ~= "string" or type(body) ~= "string" or #body < 40 or #body > 8 * 1024 * 1024 then return end
	if X.NDown >= 200 then
		X.Downloads, X.NDown = {}, 0
	end
	X.Downloads[X.FP(body)] = url
	X.NDown += 1
end

local function norm(s)
	if type(s) ~= "string" then return nil end
	return (s:gsub("^[=@]", ""))
end
X.Norm = norm
local dinfo = (type(debug) == "table" and type(debug.info) == "function") and debug.info or nil
local dget = (type(debug) == "table" and type(debug.getinfo) == "function") and debug.getinfo or nil
local probe
if dinfo then
	probe = function(l) return dinfo(l, "fs") end
elseif dget then
	probe = function(l)
		local t = dget(l, "fS")
		if type(t) ~= "table" then return nil end
		return t.func, t.source
	end
end
X.CanIdentify = probe ~= nil
-- Returns the chunk name of whoever called the hook function "me" (first non-C frame above it).
function X.Caller(me)
	if not probe then return nil end
	local found = false
	for l = 3, 40 do
		local ok, f, s = pcall(probe, l)
		if not ok or f == nil then return nil end
		if found then
			s = norm(s)
			if s and s ~= "[C]" then return s end
		elseif f == me then
			found = true
		end
	end
	return nil
end
-- some executors prefix the chunk name they report back (e.g. "JJIQp@NA-split/common/part-001.lua" for a chunk compiled as "@NA-split/common/part-001.lua"); the tag is stripped for the lookup only, and an external script can never obtain a trusted name because X.Compile renames any requested chunk name whose stripped form is trusted
local function undeco(c)
	local tag, rest = c:match("^(%w+)[@=](.+)$")
	if tag and #tag >= 3 and #tag <= 12 then return rest end
	return nil
end
local function ownChunk(c) return c == "UhAdmin" or X.Trusted[c] == true or c:sub(1, 8) == "UhTrust#" end
function X.IsUH(chunk)
	if type(chunk) ~= "string" then return false end
	if ownChunk(chunk) then return true end
	local rest = undeco(chunk)
	return rest ~= nil and ownChunk(rest)
end
-- internal only: the embedded Nameless Admin runner registers its own chunk identities through this call before it compiles them
function X.TrustEmbedded(name)
	if type(name) == "string" and name ~= "" then X.Trusted[X.Norm(name)] = true end
end
-- internal only: called solely for functions compiled from a SHA-256-verified embedded source; records the chunk identity the executor really reports for them (accepted only when it is derived from the requested name, never a generic one)
X.NAlias = X.NAlias or 0
function X.TrustCompiled(f, req)
	if type(f) ~= "function" or type(req) ~= "string" or #req < 4 or X.NAlias >= 512 then return end
	local s
	if dinfo then
		local ok, r = pcall(dinfo, f, "s")
		if ok then s = r end
	elseif dget then
		local ok, r = pcall(dget, f, "S")
		if ok and type(r) == "table" then s = r.source end
	end
	if type(s) ~= "string" then return end
	s = X.Norm(s)
	if s and s ~= req and not X.Trusted[s] and s:sub(-#req) == req then
		X.NAlias += 1
		X.Trusted[s] = true
	end
end
function X.NameOf(chunk)
	chunk = tostring(chunk or "?")
	local first = chunk:match('^%[string "(.-)"%]$')
	if first then chunk = "chunk: " .. first end
	return chunk:sub(1, 48)
end
function X.NewScript(name, origin)
	if X.NScripts >= 600 then return X.Overflow end
	X.Seq += 1
	X.NScripts += 1
	local s = {id = string.format("EXT-%04d", X.Seq), name = name, origin = origin, verdict = "UNVERIFIED", status = "monitored", ops = 0, threads = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}), allow = {}, t0 = os.time()}
	X.List[#X.List + 1] = s
	X.Stats.Intercepted += 1
	X.Hist("intercept", s.id .. " " .. name .. " <- " .. origin, s.id)
	return s
end
function X.Actor(who)
	local key = who or "?"
	local s = X.Map[key]
	if not s then
		s = X.NewScript(X.NameOf(key), "executor-compiled script (editor / clipboard / hub): source not visible")
		X.Map[key] = s
		if type(getcallingscript) == "function" then
			local ok, inst = pcall(getcallingscript)
			if ok and typeof(inst) == "Instance" then
				s.inst = inst
				pcall(function() s.name = X.NameOf(inst:GetFullName()) end)
			end
		end
	end
	s.ops += 1
	local th = coroutine.running()
	if th then s.threads[th] = true end
	if s.killed then error("[UH Security] " .. s.id .. " was terminated by UH Security", 0) end
	return s
end
-- nil = UH's own call (or protection off): pass through untouched.
function X.Gate(who)
	if not X.Active or X.IsUH(who) or not X.On("ExtProtect") then return nil end
	return X.Actor(who)
end
function X.Kill(s)
	if s == X.Overflow or s.killed then return end
	s.killed = true
	s.status = "terminated"
	local cur = coroutine.running()
	for th in pairs(s.threads) do
		if th ~= cur then pcall(task.cancel, th) end
	end
	if s.inst then pcall(function() s.inst.Disabled = true end) end
end
function X.Incident(s, kind, detail, sev, critical, phish, url)
	local st = X.Stats
	if phish then st.PhishingBlocked += 1 else st.RuntimeBlocked += 1 end
	local host = "?"
	if url and X.ParseURL then host = (X.ParseURL(url) or {}).host or "?" end
	X.AddFinding({kind = kind, id = s.id, name = s.name, origin = s.origin, severity = sev, verdict = "BLOCKED", evidence = {{desc = detail}}, urls = url and {{url = url, host = host, verdict = "BLOCKED"}} or nil, decision = "BLOCKED" .. (critical and " + script terminated" or "")})
	X.Hist("runtime", s.id .. " blocked " .. kind .. ": " .. detail, s.id)
	if phish and url then
		X.Notify(string.format("[UH Security] PHISHING BLOCKED\nDestination: %s\nHost: %s\nReason: %s\nScript: %s (%s)", url:sub(1, 90), host, detail:sub(1, 100), s.name, s.id))
	else
		X.Notify(string.format("[UH Security] %s blocked (%s): %s", kind, s.id, detail:sub(1, 110)))
	end
	if critical then X.Kill(s) end
end
function X.Unverified(note)
	return {verdict = "UNVERIFIED", severity = "none", score = 0, reasons = {}, urls = {}, critical = false, note = note}
end
end)
if not okA then warn("[UH Security] external protection core failed: " .. tostring(errA)) end
end

-- Section: Security Protection - Part 2/5: anti-phishing URL analysis and URL extraction (decodes escapes, string joins and base64)

do
local okB, errB = pcall(function()
local X = Util.ExtGuard
local function S(t) local o = {} for _, v in ipairs(t) do o[v] = true end return o end
local OFFICIAL = S{"roblox.com", "rbxcdn.com", "robloxlabs.com"}
local TRUSTED = S{"github.com", "githubusercontent.com", "gitlab.com", "jsdelivr.net"}
local SHORT = S{"bit.ly", "tinyurl.com", "t.co", "goo.gl", "ow.ly", "is.gd", "cutt.ly", "rb.gy", "shorturl.at", "tiny.cc", "bit.do", "rebrand.ly", "v.gd", "t.ly", "s.id", "buff.ly", "clck.ru", "qr.net", "adf.ly", "shorte.st", "soo.gd", "u.to", "t2m.io"}
local IPLOG = S{"grabify.link", "iplogger.org", "iplogger.com", "iplogger.ru", "2no.co", "yip.su", "blasze.tk", "blasze.com", "leancoding.co", "stopify.co", "ps3cfw.com", "bmwforum.co", "quickmessage.us", "spottyfly.com", "freegiftcards.co", "joinmy.site", "curiouscat.club", "gamingfun.me", "02ip.ru", "iplis.ru", "ipgrabber.ru"}
local DISCORD = S{"discord.com", "discordapp.com"}
local HOOKPX = S{"webhook.lewisakura.moe", "hooks.hyra.io"}
local SENS = S{"auth.roblox.com", "accountsettings.roblox.com", "billing.roblox.com", "trades.roblox.com", "premiumfeatures.roblox.com"}
local BADTLD = S{"tk", "ml", "ga", "cf", "gq", "xyz", "top", "click", "icu", "buzz", "rest", "zip", "work", "cyou", "monster", "cam", "sbs", "cfd"}
local REDIR = S{"url", "u", "r", "redirect", "redirect_uri", "redirecturl", "return", "returnurl", "next", "dest", "destination", "goto", "target", "link", "to", "continue", "out"}
local TLD2 = S{"co", "com", "org", "net", "gov", "edu", "ac", "or", "ne"}
local CREDW = {"login", "log-in", "signin", "sign-in", "verify", "verification", "authenticate", "2fa", "captcha", "security-check", "recover", "unlock", "appeal", "validate"}
local LUREW = {"free-robux", "freerobux", "robux-gen", "get-robux", "robux-generator", "free-rbx", "rbx-gen", "free-limited", "robux4free", "claim-robux", "gift-card"}
local STEALW = {"cookie", "roblosecurity", "grabber", "stealer", "logger"}

local function hostIn(set, host)
	local l = {}
	for p in host:gmatch("[^%.]+") do l[#l + 1] = p end
	for i = 1, #l do
		if set[table.concat(l, ".", i)] then return true end
	end
	return false
end
local function unpct(s) return (s:gsub("%%(%x%x)", function(h) return string.char(tonumber(h, 16)) end)) end
local function privIP(ip)
	if ip:find("^127%.") or ip:find("^10%.") or ip:find("^192%.168%.") or ip:find("^0%.") then return true end
	local b = tonumber(ip:match("^172%.(%d+)%."))
	return b ~= nil and b >= 16 and b <= 31
end
local function deglyph(s)
	return (s:gsub("0", "o"):gsub("1", "l"):gsub("3", "e"):gsub("5", "s"):gsub("7", "t"):gsub("%$", "s"):gsub("@", "a"):gsub("|", "l"))
end
local function lev(a, b)
	local la, lb = #a, #b
	if math.abs(la - lb) > 2 then return 3 end
	local prev = {}
	for j = 0, lb do prev[j] = j end
	for i = 1, la do
		local cur = {[0] = i}
		for j = 1, lb do
			local c = (a:byte(i) == b:byte(j)) and 0 or 1
			cur[j] = math.min(prev[j] + 1, cur[j - 1] + 1, prev[j - 1] + c)
		end
		prev = cur
	end
	return prev[lb]
end
local function regDomain(host)
	local l = {}
	for p in host:gmatch("[^%.]+") do l[#l + 1] = p end
	local n = #l
	if n <= 2 then return host, l[1] or host end
	if #l[n] == 2 and TLD2[l[n - 1]] then
		return l[n - 2] .. "." .. l[n - 1] .. "." .. l[n], l[n - 2]
	end
	return l[n - 1] .. "." .. l[n], l[n - 1]
end
local function parseURL(u)
	if type(u) ~= "string" then return nil end
	local scheme, rest = u:match("^%s*(%a[%w%+%.%-]*)://(.*)$")
	if not scheme then return nil end
	local auth = rest:match("^([^/?#\\]*)") or ""
	local tail = rest:sub(#auth + 1)
	local userinfo, hostport = auth:match("^(.*)@(.*)$")
	hostport = hostport or auth
	local host = (hostport:gsub(":%d*$", "")):lower():gsub("%.$", "")
	local path, query = tail:match("^([^?#]*)%??([^#]*)")
	return {scheme = scheme:lower(), userinfo = userinfo, host = host, path = path or "", query = query or "", full = u}
end
X.ParseURL = parseURL

function X.AnalyzeURL(url, depth)
	depth = depth or 0
	local res = {url = tostring(url), host = "?", score = 0, reasons = {}, crit = false, verdict = "CLEAN", severity = "none"}
	local p = parseURL(url)
	if not p then return res end
	local host = p.host
	res.host = host
	local function R(id, w, desc, crit)
		res.score += w
		res.reasons[#res.reasons + 1] = {id = id, w = w, desc = desc}
		if crit then res.crit = true end
	end
	local reg, label = regDomain(host)
	local official = hostIn(OFFICIAL, host)
	local trusted = official or hostIn(TRUSTED, host)
	local hay = unpct(unpct(host .. p.path .. "?" .. p.query)):lower()
	if hostIn(IPLOG, host) then R("iplogger", 100, "IP-logger domain " .. reg) end
	if p.userinfo and p.userinfo ~= "" then
		if p.userinfo:find("%.") or p.userinfo:lower():find("roblox", 1, true) then
			R("userinfo", 70, "address hides the real host behind a user@ prefix")
		else
			R("userinfo", 20, "address embeds login-style user info")
		end
	end
	if host:find("^%d+%.%d+%.%d+%.%d+$") then
		R("iphost", privIP(host) and 10 or 45, "destination is a raw IP address")
	elseif host:find("^%[") or host:find("^0x%x+$") or host:find("^%d+$") then
		R("iphost", 55, "destination is an obfuscated or IPv6 literal address")
	end
	if host:find("xn%-%-") or host:find("[\128-\255]") then
		R("punycode", 55, "punycode / non-ASCII hostname (look-alike risk)")
	end
	if hostIn(SHORT, host) then R("shortener", 40, "URL shortener hides the real destination") end
	local tld = host:match("%.([%w%-]+)$")
	if tld and BADTLD[tld] and not trusted then R("tld", 15, "high-abuse top-level domain ." .. tld) end
	if not official then
		local flat = deglyph((host:gsub("[%-%.]", "")))
		local lab = deglyph((label:gsub("%-", "")))
		if lab:find("roblox", 1, true) or lab:find("rbxcdn", 1, true) then
			R("impersonation", 80, "impersonates a Roblox domain (" .. reg .. ")")
		elseif flat:find("roblox", 1, true) or flat:find("rbxcdn", 1, true) then
			R("brand_sub", 75, "uses the Roblox name inside another site's address (" .. reg .. ")")
		elseif #lab >= 5 and lab ~= "roblox" and (lev(lab, "roblox") <= 1 or lev(lab, "rbxcdn") <= 1) then
			R("typosquat", 70, "look-alike of a Roblox domain (" .. reg .. ")")
		end
	end
	if not trusted then
		for i = 1, #CREDW do
			if hay:find(CREDW[i], 1, true) then
				R("credwords", 25, "login / verification wording on a non-Roblox site")
				break
			end
		end
		for i = 1, #LUREW do
			if hay:find(LUREW[i], 1, true) then
				R("lure", 45, "free-Robux / giveaway lure")
				break
			end
		end
		for i = 1, #STEALW do
			if hay:find(STEALW[i], 1, true) then
				R("stealwords", 50, "cookie / stealer wording in the address")
				break
			end
		end
		if hay:find("roblox", 1, true) then R("brandtext", 20, "mentions Roblox but is not a Roblox site") end
	end
	if hay:find("roblosecurity", 1, true) or hay:find("_|warning:-do-not-share-this", 1, true) then
		R("cookie", 100, "address carries or asks for the Roblox login cookie", true)
	end
	local ck = p.query:match("[Cc][Oo][Oo][Kk][Ii][Ee]=([^&]+)")
	if ck and #ck > 40 then R("cookie", 100, "address sends a long cookie value", true) end
	if hay:find("authticket", 1, true) or hay:find("authenticationticket", 1, true) or hay:find("rbx-authentication-ticket", 1, true) then
		R("authticket", 100, "address carries a Roblox authentication ticket", true)
	end
	if official and (hostIn(SENS, host) or hay:find("/purchases/", 1, true) or hay:find("/payouts", 1, true)) then
		R("sensitive", 70, "touches a Roblox account / auth / billing endpoint")
	end
	if (hostIn(DISCORD, host) and hay:find("/api/webhooks/", 1, true)) or hostIn(HOOKPX, host) then
		R("webhook", 60, "Discord webhook endpoint (data leaves your device)")
	end
	if depth < 3 and p.query ~= "" then
		for k, v in p.query:gmatch("([^&=]+)=([^&]*)") do
			if REDIR[k:lower()] then
				local d = unpct(v)
				if d:find("^%a[%w%+%.%-]*://") then
					local sub = X.AnalyzeURL(d, depth + 1)
					R("redirect", 20 + (sub.score >= 40 and 40 or 0), "redirect parameter '" .. k .. "' leads to " .. sub.host)
					if sub.crit then res.crit = true end
					for _, r in ipairs(sub.reasons) do
						res.reasons[#res.reasons + 1] = {id = "via_" .. r.id, w = 0, desc = "(via " .. sub.host .. ") " .. r.desc}
					end
					break
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if res.crit or res.score >= 90 then
		res.verdict, res.severity = "MALICIOUS", res.crit and "critical" or "high"
	elseif res.score >= 40 then
		res.verdict, res.severity = "SUSPICIOUS", "medium"
	elseif res.score > 0 then
		res.severity = "low"
	end
	return res
end

local B64 = {}
do
	local a = "ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZabcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789+/"
	for i = 1, 64 do B64[a:byte(i)] = i - 1 end
end
local function unb64(s)
	s = s:gsub("=+$", "")
	local out, bits, acc = {}, 0, 0
	for i = 1, #s do
		local v = B64[s:byte(i)]
		if not v then return nil end
		acc = acc * 64 + v
		bits += 6
		if bits >= 8 then
			bits -= 8
			local b = math.floor(acc / 2 ^ bits)
			out[#out + 1] = string.char(b % 256)
			acc = acc % (2 ^ bits)
		end
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end
local URLPAT = "[Hh][Tt][Tt][Pp][Ss]?://[%w%-%._~:/%?#@!%$&%*%+,;=%%%[%]]+"
-- Returns {url, line} entries found in plain text, \x / \ddd escapes, "a".."b" joins and base64 strings.
function X.ExtractURLs(src)
	local out, seen, n, nb = {}, {}, 0, 0
	local S, sl = Util.Security, {t0 = os.clock()}
	local function add(u, ln)
		u = u:gsub("[%.,;:%)%]}\"']+$", "")
		if #u > 10 and not seen[u] and n < 60 then
			seen[u] = true
			n += 1
			out[n] = {url = u, line = ln}
		end
	end
	local ln = 0
	for l in src:gmatch("([^\n]*)\n?") do
		ln += 1
		if ln % 128 == 0 and coroutine.isyieldable() then
			if S and S.Slice then S.Slice(sl, true) elseif ln % 1500 == 0 then task.wait() end
		end
		if #l > 9 and n < 60 then
			local d = l
			if d:find("\\", 1, true) then
				d = d:gsub("\\x(%x%x)", function(h) return string.char(tonumber(h, 16)) end)
				d = d:gsub("\\(%d%d?%d?)", function(c)
					local v = tonumber(c)
					if v and v < 256 then return string.char(v) end
				end)
			end
			if d:find("..", 1, true) then
				for _ = 1, 8 do
					local c
					d, c = d:gsub("([\"'])%s*%.%.%s*([\"'])", "")
					if c == 0 then break end
				end
			end
			for u in d:gmatch(URLPAT) do add(u, ln) end
			if nb < 30 and #d >= 40 then
				for tok in d:gmatch("[A-Za-z0-9%+/=]+") do
					local tl = #tok
					if tl >= 40 and tl <= 8192 then
						nb += 1
						local dec = unb64(tok)
						if dec and dec:find("://", 1, true) then
							for u in dec:gmatch(URLPAT) do add(u, ln) end
						end
						if nb >= 30 then break end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if S and S.Done then S.Done(sl) end
	return out
end
end)
if not okB then warn("[UH Security] anti-phishing module failed: " .. tostring(errB)) end
end

-- Section: Security Protection - Part 3/5: universal third-party script checker (extends Util.Security.Analyze)

do
local okC, errC = pcall(function()
local X = Util.ExtGuard
local RANK = X.Rank
local SKIPURL = {webhook = true, sensitive = true, tld = true}
-- Relational rules (A trigger + B capability) match within WINDOW lines of comment-stripped code: same line / within NEAR lines = full weight, farther = 60%.
-- "code" rules ignore strings and comments, resolve ["name"] indexing, "a".."b" joins, escapes and simple "local alias = name" indirection.
-- Both lines (hook operation and related operation) are recorded as evidence with snippets.
local NEAR, WINDOW, MAXLINE = 6, 40, 100000
local EXTRA = {
	{id = "sec_hook", cat = "bypass", w = 60, code = true, desc = "hooks or restores functions that security tools guard, near code-execution, network, file, clipboard or persistence calls (security bypass)", la = "hook / restore operation", lb = "dangerous capability near the hook",
		A = {"hookfunction", "restorefunction", "replaceclosure"},
		B = {"loadstring", "request", "httpget", "httppost", "setclipboard", "toclipboard", "writefile", "appendfile", "queue_on_teleport", "queueonteleport"}},
	{id = "uh_tamper", cat = "bypass", w = 70, desc = "references UH Admin / UH Security internals (tampering attempt)",
		B = {"uhhhhhhloaded", "uhhhhhhsource", "util.security", "extguard", "uhtrust#"}},
	{id = "autoexec_persist", cat = "persist", w = 70, desc = "writes into an auto-execute folder (persistence)", la = "auto-execute folder reference", lb = "file write",
		A = {"autoexec"}, B = {"writefile", "appendfile"}},
	{id = "tele_remote", cat = "persist", w = 30, desc = "queues a remote or dynamic payload to re-run after teleport", la = "queue-on-teleport call", lb = "remote or dynamic payload",
		A = {"queue_on_teleport", "queueonteleport", "queueteleport"}, B = {"http", "loadstring"}},
	{id = "fs_wipe", cat = "fs", w = 90, desc = "deletes the whole workspace folder",
		B = {"delfolder(\"\")", "delfolder('')", "delfolder(\".\")", "delfolder('.')", "delfolder(\"/\")", "delfolder('/')"}},
	{id = "fs_walk_delete", cat = "fs", w = 45, code = true, desc = "walks the file list while deleting files", la = "file listing", lb = "file deletion",
		A = {"listfiles"}, B = {"delfile", "delfolder"}},
	{id = "debug_tamper", cat = "bypass", w = 30, desc = "rewrites other code at runtime (debug.setupvalue / setconstant)",
		B = {"debug.setupvalue", "setupvalue(", "debug.setconstant", "setconstant(", "setstack("}},
	{id = "clip_read", cat = "intel", w = 20, desc = "reads the clipboard", B = {"getclipboard", "readclipboard"}},
	{id = "auth_ticket", cat = "cred", w = 80, desc = "handles Roblox authentication tickets", B = {"rbx-authentication-ticket", "authenticationticket"}},
}
-- Identifier-like tokens of the "code" rules: these can be aliased through "local x = token".
local ATOK = {}
for _, r in ipairs(EXTRA) do
	if r.A and r.code then
		for _, list in ipairs({r.A, r.B}) do
			for _, t in ipairs(list) do
				if t:find("^[%a_][%w_]*$") then ATOK[t] = true end
			end
		end
	end
end
local ALLTOK, seenTok = {}, {}
for _, r in ipairs(EXTRA) do
	for _, list in ipairs({r.A or {}, r.B}) do
		for _, t in ipairs(list) do
			if not seenTok[t] then
				seenTok[t] = true
				ALLTOK[#ALLTOK + 1] = t
			end
		end
	end
end
local function has(v, list)
	for i = 1, #list do
		if v:find(list[i], 1, true) then return true end
	end
	return false
end
local function link(s, al, asn, bl, bsn)
	s.count += 1
	local d = al > bl and al - bl or bl - al
	if not s.best or d < s.best.d then
		s.best = {d = d, al = al, asn = asn, bl = bl, bsn = bsn}
	end
end
-- Removes comments (line and long-bracket) while respecting string literals. cst.close carries an open block comment across lines.
local function cstrip(line, cst)
	if not cst.close and not line:find("--", 1, true) then return line end
	local n, pos, parts = #line, 1, {}
	while pos <= n do
		if cst.close then
			local e = line:find(cst.close, pos, true)
			if not e then return table.concat(parts) end
			pos = e + #cst.close
			cst.close = nil
		else
			local q = line:find("[\"']", pos)
			local c = line:find("--", pos, true)
			if c and (not q or c < q) then
				parts[#parts + 1] = line:sub(pos, c - 1)
				local eq = line:match("^%[(=*)%[", c + 2)
				if not eq then return table.concat(parts) end
				cst.close = "]" .. eq .. "]"
				pos = c + 2 + #eq + 2
			elseif q then
				local qc = line:sub(q, q)
				local k, closed = q + 1, false
				while k <= n do
					local m = line:find("[\\" .. qc .. "]", k)
					if not m then break end
					if line:sub(m, m) == "\\" then
						k = m + 2
					else
						k = m + 1
						closed = true
						break
					end
				end
				if not closed then
					parts[#parts + 1] = line:sub(pos)
					return table.concat(parts)
				end
				parts[#parts + 1] = line:sub(pos, k - 1)
				pos = k
			else
				parts[#parts + 1] = line:sub(pos)
				break
			end
		end
	end
	return table.concat(parts)
end
-- Decodes \x / \ddd escapes and joins "a".."b" literals.
local function prep(c)
	if c:find("\\", 1, true) then
		c = c:gsub("\\x(%x%x)", function(h) return string.char(tonumber(h, 16)) end)
		c = c:gsub("\\(%d%d?%d?)", function(d)
			local v = tonumber(d)
			if v and v < 256 then return string.char(v) end
		end)
	end
	if c:find("..", 1, true) then
		for _ = 1, 8 do
			local n
			c, n = c:gsub("([\"'])%s*%.%.%s*([\"'])", "")
			if n == 0 then break end
		end
	end
	return c
end
-- Code-only view: ["name"] becomes .name, string literals are removed, lowercase.
local function codeOf(base)
	local v = base:gsub("%[%s*[\"']([%w_]+)[\"']%s*%]", ".%1")
	v = v:gsub("%[(=*)%[.-%]%1%]", "")
	v = v:gsub("\"[^\"]*\"", "")
	v = v:gsub("'[^']*'", "")
	return v:lower()
end

-- Inspects source text before it runs. Verdicts: CLEAN / SUSPICIOUS / MALICIOUS / UNVERIFIED.
local checkRaw
-- identical sources are analysed once (verified SHA-256 identity); a large source on a thread that cannot yield is analysed in the background instead of freezing the game
X.CheckCache, X.CheckOrder = {}, {}
-- large sources that cannot be scanned on the calling thread are queued and scanned one at a time in the background (identical sources are never queued twice)
X.BgQueue, X.BgKeys, X.BgBusy = {}, {}, false
function X.BgPump()
	if X.BgBusy then return end
	X.BgBusy = true
	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			local job = table.remove(X.BgQueue, 1)
			if not job then break end
			local ok, r = pcall(checkRaw, job.src, job.meta)
			X.BgKeys[job.key] = nil
			if ok then job.put(r) end
			task.wait(0.25)
		end
		X.BgBusy = false
	end)
end
function X.Check(src, meta)
	if type(src) == "string" and Util.Security and Util.Security.IsEmbedded and Util.Security.IsEmbedded(src) then
		local m = type(meta) == "table" and meta or {}
		return {verdict = "CLEAN", severity = "none", score = 0, reasons = {}, urls = {}, critical = false, name = m.name, origin = m.origin, note = "Verified embedded Nameless Admin source (byte-identical SHA-256 match): trusted, not inspected."}
	end
	if type(src) ~= "string" then return checkRaw(src, meta) end
	local n = #src
	if n > 4096 and n <= X.MaxSource then
		local key = X.CanHash() and X.SecHash(src) or nil
		local function put(r)
			if key and type(r) == "table" and r.verdict ~= "UNVERIFIED" then
				if not X.CheckCache[key] then
					X.CheckOrder[#X.CheckOrder + 1] = key
					if #X.CheckOrder > 64 then X.CheckCache[table.remove(X.CheckOrder, 1)] = nil end
				end
				X.CheckCache[key] = r
			end
		end
		local hit = key and X.CheckCache[key]
		if hit then return hit end
		local sc = Util.Security and Util.Security.Config
		local bgMin = (key and sc and sc.BgMin) or (sc and sc.BgMinNoHash) or 131072
		if n > bgMin and not coroutine.isyieldable() then
			local jk = key or X.FP(src)
			if X.BgKeys[jk] then return X.Unverified("this script is already being scanned in the background and was not inspected yet") end
			if #X.BgQueue >= 6 then return X.Unverified("too many large scripts are waiting for a background scan: this one was not inspected") end
			X.BgKeys[jk] = true
			X.BgQueue[#X.BgQueue + 1] = {src = src, meta = meta, key = jk, put = put}
			X.BgPump()
			return X.Unverified("script is larger than " .. math.floor(bgMin / 1024) .. " KB and cannot be inspected without yielding: it is being scanned in the background and was not inspected yet")
		end
		local r = checkRaw(src, meta)
		put(r)
		return r
	end
	return checkRaw(src, meta)
end
function checkRaw(src, meta)
	meta = meta or {}
	if type(src) ~= "string" or src == "" then return X.Unverified("source not visible") end
	if #src > X.MaxSource then return X.Unverified("script is larger than " .. X.MaxSource .. " bytes: not inspected") end
	local sec = Util.Security
	if not sec or type(sec.Analyze) ~= "function" then return X.Unverified("the static analysis engine is not available") end
	local ok, erep = pcall(sec.Analyze, src, coroutine.isyieldable() and true or nil)
	if not ok or type(erep) ~= "table" then return X.Unverified("static analysis failed or was interrupted: source inspection incomplete") end
	local reasons, cats = {}, {}
	local total, crit = erep.score or 0, erep.severity == "critical"
	local want = {}
	for _, r in ipairs(erep.reasons or {}) do
		reasons[#reasons + 1] = {id = r.id, cat = r.cat, desc = r.desc, line = r.line, w = r.weight or 0, src = "engine"}
		cats[r.cat or "?"] = true
		if r.line then want[r.line] = true end
	end
	local urls, urlScore = {}, 0
	for _, u in ipairs(X.ExtractURLs(src)) do
		local a = X.AnalyzeURL(u.url)
		local pw = 0
		for _, r in ipairs(a.reasons) do
			if not SKIPURL[r.id] then pw += r.w end
		end
		if pw >= 40 or a.crit then
			urls[#urls + 1] = {url = u.url, host = a.host, line = u.line, verdict = a.verdict}
			urlScore += math.min(100, pw)
			cats.phish = true
			if a.crit then crit = true end
			local best
			for _, r in ipairs(a.reasons) do
				if not SKIPURL[r.id] and (not best or r.w > best.w) then best = r end
			end
			reasons[#reasons + 1] = {id = "url", cat = "phish", desc = "suspicious address " .. a.host .. ": " .. (best and best.desc or "flagged"), line = u.line, w = math.min(100, pw), src = "url"}
			want[u.line] = true
		end
	end
	local snips = {}
	local st = {}
	for i = 1, #EXTRA do st[i] = {count = 0} end
	local cst = {close = nil}
	local aliasOf, nAlias = {}, 0
	local canYield = coroutine.isyieldable()
	local function scan(ln, l)
		local c = cstrip(l, cst)
		if not c:find("%S") then return end
		-- cheap pre-filter: a plain line (no escapes, no string joins) holding none of the rule tokens and no known alias cannot match any rule, so it skips the expensive code-view work
		if not c:find("\\", 1, true) and not c:find("[\"']%s*%.%.%s*[\"']") then
			local rv = (c:lower():gsub("%s+", ""))
			if not has(rv, ALLTOK) then
				if nAlias == 0 then return end
				local used = false
				for name in pairs(aliasOf) do
					if rv:find(name, 1, true) then
						used = true
						break
					end
				end
				if not used then return end
			end
		end
		local base = prep(c)
		local rawv = (base:lower():gsub("%s+", ""))
		local codev = codeOf(base)
		local ex = codev
		if nAlias > 0 then
			local pad, add = " " .. codev, nil
			for name, tk in pairs(aliasOf) do
				if pad:find("[^%w_%.:]" .. name .. "%f[^%w_]") then
					add = add or {}
					add[#add + 1] = tk
				end
			end
			if add then ex = codev .. " " .. table.concat(add, " ") end
		end
		local snip
		for i = 1, #EXTRA do
			local r, s = EXTRA[i], st[i]
			local v = r.code and ex or rawv
			if r.A then
				local ha, hb = has(v, r.A), has(v, r.B)
				if ha or hb then snip = snip or (l:gsub("^%s+", "")):sub(1, 140) end
				if ha then
					s.aLine, s.aSnip = ln, snip
					if not hb and s.bLine and ln - s.bLine <= WINDOW then link(s, ln, snip, s.bLine, s.bSnip) end
				end
				if hb then
					s.bLine, s.bSnip = ln, snip
					if s.aLine and ln - s.aLine <= WINDOW then link(s, s.aLine, s.aSnip, ln, snip) end
				end
			elseif has(v, r.B) then
				snip = snip or (l:gsub("^%s+", "")):sub(1, 140)
				s.count += 1
				if not s.first then s.first = {line = ln, snip = snip} end
			end
		end
		if nAlias < 24 then
			local nm, rhs = codev:match("^%s*local%s+([%a_][%w_]*)%s*=%s*(.+)$")
			if not nm then nm, rhs = codev:match("^%s*([%a_][%w_]*)%s*=%s*(.+)$") end
			if nm and #nm >= 2 and not aliasOf[nm] and rhs:sub(1, 1) ~= "=" then
				local r2 = rhs:gsub("get[gfr]env%s*%(%s*%d*%s*%)", "")
				if not r2:find("[%w_]%s*%(") then
					for tk in pairs(ATOK) do
						local a, b = rhs:find(tk, 1, true)
						if a and nm ~= tk and not rhs:find("^%s*%(", b + 1) then
							aliasOf[nm] = tk
							nAlias += 1
							break
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	local sl = {t0 = os.clock()}
	local ln = 0
	for l in src:gmatch("([^\n]*)\n?") do
		ln += 1
		if want[ln] then snips[ln] = (l:gsub("^%s+", "")):sub(1, 140) end
		if #l <= MAXLINE then
			scan(ln, l)
		else
			for i = 1, #l, MAXLINE do scan(ln, l:sub(i, i + MAXLINE - 1)) end
		end
		if canYield and ln % 128 == 0 then
			if sec.Slice then sec.Slice(sl, true) elseif ln % 3000 == 0 then task.wait() end
		end
	end
	if sec.Done then sec.Done(sl) end
	local mine = 0
	for i, r in ipairs(EXTRA) do
		local s = st[i]
		if r.A then
			local b = s.best
			if b then
				local w = b.d <= NEAR and r.w or math.floor(r.w * 0.6 + 0.5)
				local far = b.d > NEAR and (" (related code is " .. b.d .. " lines apart)") or ""
				mine += w
				cats[r.cat] = true
				if b.al == b.bl then
					reasons[#reasons + 1] = {id = r.id, cat = r.cat, desc = r.desc, line = b.al, w = w, snippet = b.asn, count = s.count, src = "extra"}
				else
					reasons[#reasons + 1] = {id = r.id, cat = r.cat, desc = r.desc .. " [" .. r.la .. "]" .. far, line = b.al, w = w, snippet = b.asn, count = s.count, src = "extra"}
					reasons[#reasons + 1] = {id = r.id .. "_rel", cat = r.cat, desc = r.desc .. " [" .. r.lb .. "]" .. far, line = b.bl, w = w - 0.01, snippet = b.bsn, src = "extra"}
				end
			end
		elseif s.first then
			mine += r.w
			cats[r.cat] = true
			reasons[#reasons + 1] = {id = r.id, cat = r.cat, desc = r.desc, line = s.first.line, w = r.w, snippet = s.first.snip, count = s.count, src = "extra"}
		end
	end
	for _, r in ipairs(reasons) do
		if not r.snippet and r.line then r.snippet = snips[r.line] end
	end
	table.sort(reasons, function(a, b) return (a.w or 0) > (b.w or 0) end)
	total = total + mine + urlScore
	local ncat = 0
	for _ in pairs(cats) do ncat += 1 end
	local v = "CLEAN"
	if crit or (total >= 100 and ncat >= 2) then
		v = "MALICIOUS"
	elseif total >= 60 then
		v = "SUSPICIOUS"
	end
	if (RANK[erep.verdict] or 0) > RANK[v] then v = erep.verdict end
	local sev = "none"
	if crit then sev = "critical" elseif v == "MALICIOUS" then sev = "high" elseif v == "SUSPICIOUS" then sev = "medium" elseif #reasons > 0 then sev = "low" end
	return {
		verdict = v, severity = sev, score = math.floor(total + 0.5), reasons = reasons, urls = urls, critical = crit,
		name = meta.name, origin = meta.origin,
		note = v == "CLEAN" and "CLEAN means no known malicious pattern was found. It is not a guarantee of safety." or nil,
	}
end
end)
if not okC then warn("[UH Security] script checker failed: " .. tostring(errC)) end
end

-- Section: Security Protection - Part 4/5: execution firewall (pause, findings panel, two typed confirmations)

do
local okD, errD = pcall(function()
local X = Util.ExtGuard
local PHRASE1, PHRASE2 = "I UNDERSTAND THE SECURITY RISKS", "RUN ANYWAY"
local function trim(s) return (tostring(s):gsub("^%s+", ""):gsub("%s+$", "")) end
local function mk(class, props, parent)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
	o.Parent = parent
	return o
end
local function guiParent()
	local ok, p = pcall(function() return gethiddengui and gethiddengui() end)
	if ok and p then return p end
	return CoreGui
end

function X.Subject(s, rep)
	local items = {}
	for _, r in ipairs(rep.reasons) do items[#items + 1] = {desc = r.desc, line = r.line, snippet = r.snippet} end
	for _, u in ipairs(rep.urls) do items[#items + 1] = {desc = "address " .. u.host .. " (" .. u.verdict .. ")", line = u.line, snippet = u.url:sub(1, 110)} end
	if #items == 0 then items[1] = {desc = rep.note or "no further detail"} end
	return {id = s.id, name = s.name, origin = s.origin, verdict = rep.verdict, severity = rep.severity, items = items, note = rep.note}
end

local function prompt(sub)
	local dec
	local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	local gui = mk("ScreenGui", {Name = "UhExtGuard", ResetOnSpawn = false, DisplayOrder = 2147483000, IgnoreGuiInset = true, ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling})
	local dim = mk("TextButton", {Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0), BackgroundTransparency = 0.35, AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", BorderSizePixel = 0}, gui)
	local card = mk("Frame", {AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5), Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5), Size = UDim2.fromScale(0.94, 0.92), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 28), BorderSizePixel = 0}, dim)
	mk("UISizeConstraint", {MaxSize = Vector2.new(520, 720)}, card)
	mk("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)}, card)
	mk("UIStroke", {Color = sub.verdict == "MALICIOUS" and Color3.fromRGB(235, 70, 70) or Color3.fromRGB(240, 170, 50), Thickness = 2}, card)
	local function lbl(text, pos, size, ts, parent)
		return mk("TextLabel", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, Position = pos, Size = size, Text = text, RichText = true, TextWrapped = true, Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = ts, TextColor3 = WHITE, TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top}, parent or card)
	end
	lbl("<b>UH SECURITY - EXECUTION PAUSED</b>", UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 8), UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 22), 15)
	lbl(string.format("Script: <b>%s</b>\nID: %s    Verdict: <b>%s</b>    Severity: %s\nOrigin: %s\nStatus: <b>PAUSED</b> - nothing runs until you decide", X.Esc(sub.name), sub.id, sub.verdict, sub.severity, X.Esc(sub.origin)), UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 34), UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 74), 13)
	local scroll = mk("ScrollingFrame", {Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 112), Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 1, -270), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(14, 14, 18), BorderSizePixel = 0, ScrollBarThickness = 6, AutomaticCanvasSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y, CanvasSize = UDim2.new()}, card)
	local parts = {}
	if sub.note then parts[#parts + 1] = "<b>" .. X.Esc(sub.note) .. "</b>\n" end
	for i, it in ipairs(sub.items or {}) do
		if i > 14 then
			parts[#parts + 1] = "... +" .. (#sub.items - 14) .. " more findings"
			break
		end
		parts[#parts + 1] = string.format('<b>%s</b>%s\n<font color="#9aa0aa">%s</font>', X.Esc(it.desc or ""), it.line and ("  (line " .. it.line .. ")") or "", it.snippet and ("  > " .. X.Esc(it.snippet)) or "")
	end
	local body = lbl(table.concat(parts, "\n\n"), UDim2.fromOffset(4, 2), UDim2.new(1, -8, 0, 0), 13, scroll)
	body.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
	local stageLabel = lbl("", UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, -152), UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 44), 13)
	local box = mk("TextBox", {Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, -104), Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 40), Text = "", PlaceholderText = "type the phrase here", ClearTextOnFocus = false, Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 14, TextColor3 = WHITE, PlaceholderColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(130, 130, 140), BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 50), BorderSizePixel = 0}, card)
	local block = mk("TextButton", {Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 1, -56), Size = UDim2.new(0.48, -10, 0, 44), Text = "BLOCK", Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 16, TextColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(60, 140, 80), BorderSizePixel = 0}, card)
	local confirm = mk("TextButton", {Position = UDim2.new(0.52, 0, 1, -56), Size = UDim2.new(0.48, -10, 0, 44), Text = "CONFIRM", Font = Enum.Font.Code, TextSize = 16, TextColor3 = WHITE, BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(170, 60, 60), BorderSizePixel = 0}, card)
	local stage = 1
	local function setStage()
		stageLabel.Text = "Type exactly: <b>" .. (stage == 1 and PHRASE1 or PHRASE2) .. "</b>  then press CONFIRM (" .. stage .. "/2)"
		box.Text = ""
	end
	setStage()
	confirm.Activated:Connect(function()
		local want = stage == 1 and PHRASE1 or PHRASE2
		if trim(box.Text) ~= want then
			stageLabel.Text = '<font color="#eb4646">Text does not match. Type exactly: <b>' .. want .. "</b></font>"
			return
		end
		if stage == 1 then
			X.Hist("confirm", sub.id .. ": confirmation 1/2 accepted", sub.id)
			stage = 2
			setStage()
		else
			dec = true
		end
	end)
	block.Activated:Connect(function() dec = false end)
	gui.Parent = guiParent()
	local deadline = os.clock() + 120
	while dec == nil and os.clock() < deadline and gui.Parent do task.wait(0.1) end
	pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end)
	X.Hist("confirm", sub.id .. (dec == true and ": confirmation 2/2 accepted, run authorized" or (dec == false and ": user chose BLOCK" or ": no response, blocked")), sub.id)
	return dec == true
end

-- Returns true to allow, false to block. Fails closed whenever it cannot pause or the prompt cannot show.
function X.Decide(sub)
	if not coroutine.isyieldable() then return false, "cannot pause this call to ask you: blocked" end
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while X.PromptBusy and os.clock() < X.PromptBusy and os.clock() - t0 < 130 do task.wait(0.2) end
	X.PromptBusy = os.clock() + 125
	local ok, res = pcall(prompt, sub)
	X.PromptBusy = nil
	if not ok then return false, "authorization prompt failed: " .. tostring(res) end
	if res then return true, "authorized by you (2 confirmations)" end
	return false, "blocked by you (or no response)"
end
end)
if not okD then warn("[UH Security] execution firewall failed: " .. tostring(errD)) end
end

-- Section: Security Protection - Part 5/5: interception hooks, runtime monitoring, capability report, install

do
local okE, errE = pcall(function()
local X = Util.ExtGuard
local ncc = (type(newcclosure) == "function") and newcclosure or function(f) return f end
local seen, guard, fallbacks = {}, {}, {}
local C = {}

local function mkHook(core)
	return function(call)
		local W
		W = function(...)
			return core(X.Caller(W), call, ...)
		end
		return W
	end
end
-- One reusable wrapper per original function (seen[f]); every table/key alias is guarded and tracked independently.
-- Returns: ok (this exact slot is guarded), route ("hookfunction" | "table" | nil), why (reason when not guarded).
local slotOf = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local function hookTarget(f, tbl, key, build)
	if type(f) ~= "function" then return false, nil, "not a function" end
	local slotted = type(tbl) == "table" and key ~= nil
	if slotted then
		local rec = slotOf[tbl] and slotOf[tbl][key]
		if rec then return rec.ok, rec.route, rec.why end
	end
	local e = seen[f]
	if not e then
		local holder = {old = f}
		e = {holder = holder, wrapper = ncc(build(function(...) return holder.old(...) end)), hooked = false, nslots = 0}
		seen[f] = e
		if type(hookfunction) ~= "function" then
			e.hookWhy = "hookfunction is not available"
		else
			local okh, old = pcall(hookfunction, f, e.wrapper)
			if okh and type(old) == "function" then
				holder.old = old
				e.hooked = true
			else
				e.hookWhy = okh and "hookfunction did not return the original function" or ("hookfunction refused: " .. tostring(old):sub(1, 60))
				if okh and type(restorefunction) == "function" then pcall(restorefunction, f) end
			end
		end
	end
	local ok, route, why = false, nil, nil
	if e.hooked then
		if not slotted then
			ok, route = true, "hookfunction"
		else
			local okr, cur = pcall(function() return tbl[key] end)
			if okr and (cur == f or cur == e.wrapper) then ok, route = true, "hookfunction" end
		end
	end
	if not ok then
		if slotted then
			local okw = pcall(function() tbl[key] = e.wrapper end)
			local okr, cur = pcall(function() return tbl[key] end)
			if okw and okr and cur == e.wrapper then
				ok, route = true, "table"
				e.nslots += 1
				fallbacks[#fallbacks + 1] = {t = tbl, k = key, w = e.wrapper}
			else
				why = (e.hookWhy or "hookfunction did not cover this alias") .. "; table replacement failed"
			end
		else
			why = (e.hookWhy or "hook not applied") .. "; no replaceable table slot for this function"
		end
	end
	if ok then guard[f], guard[e.wrapper] = true, true end
	if slotted then
		slotOf[tbl] = slotOf[tbl] or {}
		slotOf[tbl][key] = {ok = ok, route = route, why = why}
	end
	return ok, route, why
end

local CRED = {"_|warning:-do-not-share-this", "roblosecurity", "rbx-authentication-ticket"}
local function credHit(v, depth)
	if type(v) == "table" then
		if (depth or 0) > 2 then return false end
		for k, x in pairs(v) do
			if credHit(k, (depth or 0) + 1) or credHit(x, (depth or 0) + 1) then return true end
		end
		return false
	end
	if type(v) ~= "string" then return false end
	local n = #v
	if n < 13 then return false end
	if n > 1048576 then n = 1048576 end
	-- bounded pieces (with an overlap longer than any marker): the whole value is never lowercased in one copy
	local pos = 1
	while pos <= n do
		local piece = v:sub(pos, math.min(n, pos + 65535 + 40)):lower()
		for i = 1, #CRED do
			if piece:find(CRED[i], 1, true) then return true end
		end
		pos = pos + 65536
	end
	return false
end
local function lowp(p) return (tostring(p):gsub("\\", "/"):lower()) end

-- Central network guard. Returns nil to allow, or a message to block with.
function X.GuardNet(s, via, method, url, body, headers)
	if type(url) ~= "string" then return nil end
	local rt, ph = X.On("ExtRuntime"), X.On("ExtPhish")
	if not rt and not ph then return nil end
	local p = X.ParseURL(url)
	local host = p and p.host or "?"
	if rt and (credHit(body) or credHit(headers)) then
		X.Incident(s, "credential exfiltration", via .. " to " .. host .. " carries Roblox login / authentication data", "critical", true, false, url)
		return "Roblox login data may not leave this device"
	end
	local a = ph and X.AnalyzeURL(url) or nil
	if not a or a.verdict == "CLEAN" then
		if rt then
			s.net = s.net or {}
			if not s.net[host] then
				s.net[host] = true
				X.Hist("net", string.format("%s %s %s %s", s.id, via, method, url:sub(1, 90)), s.id)
			end
		end
		return nil
	end
	local hook, phishy, best = false, false, nil
	for _, r in ipairs(a.reasons) do
		if r.id == "webhook" then hook = true end
		if r.w > 0 and r.id ~= "webhook" and r.id ~= "sensitive" then phishy = true end
		if not best or r.w > best.w then best = r end
	end
	local why = best and best.desc or "suspicious destination"
	if hook and rt then
		local lb = type(body) == "string" and body:lower() or ""
		if lb:find("hwid", 1, true) or lb:find("clientid", 1, true) or lb:find("%d+%.%d+%.%d+%.%d+") then
			X.Incident(s, "webhook exfiltration", "device or IP identifiers sent to a webhook (" .. host .. ")", "high", true, false, url)
			return "device identifiers may not be sent to a webhook"
		end
	end
	if a.verdict == "MALICIOUS" then
		X.Incident(s, phishy and "phishing / dangerous link" or "dangerous destination", host .. ": " .. why, a.crit and "critical" or "high", a.crit, phishy, url)
		return "destination " .. host .. " is blocked"
	end
	if s.allow[host] then return nil end
	if not X.On("ExtFirewall") then
		X.Hist("net", s.id .. " suspicious destination allowed (firewall off): " .. host, s.id)
		return nil
	end
	local items = {}
	for _, r in ipairs(a.reasons) do items[#items + 1] = {desc = r.desc} end
	items[#items + 1] = {desc = "full address", snippet = url:sub(1, 160)}
	X.Stats.SuspiciousDetected += 1
	local okd, dwhy = X.Decide({id = s.id, name = s.name, origin = s.origin, verdict = "SUSPICIOUS", severity = "medium", items = items, note = "Network destination: " .. host})
	if okd then
		s.allow[host] = true
		X.Hist("decision", s.id .. " allowed destination " .. host .. " (" .. tostring(dwhy) .. ")", s.id)
		return nil
	end
	X.Incident(s, "suspicious destination", host .. ": " .. why, "medium", false, phishy, url)
	return "destination " .. host .. " was not authorized"
end

function X.Compile(call, s, chunk, src, ...)
	local cn = (type(chunk) == "string" and chunk ~= "") and chunk or ("=ExtScript#" .. s.id)
	-- an external script can never run under a trusted (UH / embedded Nameless Admin) chunk identity, even when it asks for the same name
	if X.IsUH(X.Norm(cn)) then cn = "=ExtScript#" .. s.id end
	s.chunk = X.Norm(cn)
	X.Map[s.chunk] = s
	local f, e = call(src, cn, ...)
	if f == nil and chunk == nil then f, e = call(src, chunk, ...) end
	return f, e
end

-- Compile-time firewall: inspect, decide, then compile with a unique chunk name so later calls are attributed to this script.
-- Approval identity is a verified SHA-256 (X.SecHash) only; without one nothing is cached and both phrases are required every time.
-- Critical threats are checked first and can never be overridden. File execution (loadfile/dofile) with an UNVERIFIED verdict is blocked.
function X.Approve(id)
	if type(id) ~= "string" or X.Approved[id] then return end
	local o = X.ApprovedOrder
	if not o then
		o = {}
		X.ApprovedOrder = o
	end
	o[#o + 1] = id
	X.Approved[id] = true
	while #o > X.ApproveMax do
		X.Approved[table.remove(o, 1)] = nil
	end
end

function X.GateLoad(call, kind, parent, origin, src, chunk, ...)
	-- the embedded Nameless Admin runtime: byte-identical to a source registered through Security.TrustEmbedded (verified SHA-256), so it keeps a trusted chunk identity even when its caller could not be identified; a modified or external copy never matches and is inspected as usual
	local isEmb, embName
	if type(src) == "string" and Util.Security and Util.Security.IsEmbedded then isEmb, embName = Util.Security.IsEmbedded(src) end
	if isEmb then
		local cn = chunk
		if type(cn) ~= "string" or not cn:find("^[=@]") then
			if embName then
				cn = embName
			else
				X.NTrust += 1
				cn = "=UhTrust#" .. X.NTrust
			end
		end
		X.Trusted[X.Norm(cn)] = true
		local f, e = call(src, cn, ...)
		X.TrustCompiled(f, X.Norm(cn))
		return f, e
	end
	local url = type(src) == "string" and X.Downloads[X.FP(src)] or nil
	local nm = url and (url:match("^%a+://([^?#]*)") or url) or origin or ("dynamic chunk from " .. parent.name)
	nm = tostring(nm):sub(1, 60)
	local s = X.NewScript(nm, url and ("URL: " .. url) or origin or ("compiled in memory by " .. parent.name .. " (" .. parent.id .. ")"))
	if not X.On("ExtChecker") then return X.Compile(call, s, chunk, src, ...) end
	X.Stats.Scanned += 1
	local rep
	if type(src) == "string" then
		local ok, r = pcall(X.Check, src, {name = nm, origin = s.origin})
		rep = ok and r or X.Unverified("scan error: " .. tostring(r))
	else
		rep = X.Unverified("the chunk source is not a string, so it cannot be inspected")
	end
	s.verdict = rep.verdict
	X.Hist("scan", string.format("%s %s -> %s (%s) via %s", s.id, nm, rep.verdict, rep.severity, kind), s.id)
	if rep.verdict == "CLEAN" then return X.Compile(call, s, chunk, src, ...) end
	if rep.verdict == "SUSPICIOUS" then X.Stats.SuspiciousDetected += 1 end
	local strictFile = (kind == "loadfile" or kind == "dofile") and rep.verdict == "UNVERIFIED"
	local allow, why, prompted = false, "", false
	local id = (not rep.critical and not strictFile and type(src) == "string") and X.SecHash(src) or nil
	if rep.critical then
		why = "critical threat: cannot be overridden"
	elseif strictFile then
		why = "UNVERIFIED (" .. tostring(rep.note or "inspection incomplete") .. "): blocked by the strict fail-closed policy for file execution"
	elseif id and X.Approved[id] then
		allow, why = true, "authorized earlier this session (same verified SHA-256)"
	elseif not X.On("ExtFirewall") then
		if rep.verdict == "MALICIOUS" then why = "malicious verdict (firewall is off, so there is no override prompt)" else allow, why = true, "firewall off: allowed without a prompt" end
	else
		allow, why = X.Decide(X.Subject(s, rep))
		prompted = true
		if allow and not id then why = tostring(why) .. "; approval not cached (no verified SHA-256 on this executor)" end
	end
	X.AddFinding({kind = "script", id = s.id, name = nm, origin = s.origin, severity = rep.severity, verdict = rep.verdict, evidence = rep.reasons, urls = rep.urls, note = rep.note, decision = (allow and "ALLOWED: " or "BLOCKED: ") .. tostring(why)})
	X.Hist(allow and "decision" or "blocked", s.id .. " " .. nm .. " " .. (allow and "allowed" or "blocked") .. ": " .. tostring(why), s.id)
	if allow then
		if prompted and id then X.Approve(id) end
		return X.Compile(call, s, chunk, src, ...)
	end
	s.status = "blocked"
	if rep.verdict == "MALICIOUS" then X.Stats.MaliciousBlocked += 1 end
	X.Notify(string.format("[UH Security] %s blocked (%s): %s", nm, rep.verdict, tostring(why)))
	return nil, "[UH Security] " .. s.id .. " blocked: " .. tostring(why)
end

C.load = function(kind)
	return function(who, call, src, chunk, ...)
		X.LastWho = who
		if not X.Active then return call(src, chunk, ...) end
		if X.IsUH(who) then
			if type(src) == "string" then
				local cn = chunk
				if type(cn) ~= "string" or cn == "" then
					X.NTrust += 1
					cn = "=UhTrust#" .. X.NTrust
				end
				X.Trusted[X.Norm(cn)] = true
				local f, e = call(src, cn, ...)
				if f == nil and chunk == nil then return call(src, chunk, ...) end
				return f, e
			end
			return call(src, chunk, ...)
		end
		local parent = X.Gate(who)
		if not parent then return call(src, chunk, ...) end
		return X.GateLoad(call, kind, parent, nil, src, chunk, ...)
	end
end
-- Fail-closed: with the Script Checker on, an unreadable / unidentifiable file is UNVERIFIED, recorded and blocked (never passed to the original).
-- UH's own calls (X.Gate == nil) and "checker intentionally off" keep the original pass-through behaviour.
C.loadfile = function(kind)
	return function(who, call, path, ...)
		local s = X.Gate(who)
		if not s then return call(path, ...) end
		local compile = X.RawLoad
		if not compile then
			local genv = (type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv()) or _G
			if type(genv.loadstring) == "function" then compile = genv.loadstring end
		end
		local content, why
		if type(path) ~= "string" then
			why = "the file path is not a string, so the file cannot be identified"
		elseif type(readfile) ~= "function" then
			why = "this executor exposes no readfile, so the source cannot be read for inspection"
		elseif not compile then
			why = "no compile function is available to run the inspected source"
		else
			local ok, c = pcall(readfile, path)
			if ok and type(c) == "string" then
				content = c
			else
				why = "the file could not be read: " .. (ok and "readfile returned no text" or tostring(c):sub(1, 80))
			end
		end
		if not content then
			if not X.On("ExtChecker") then return call(path, ...) end
			local nm = type(path) == "string" and path or ("<" .. type(path) .. ">")
			nm = nm:sub(1, 60)
			local fs = X.NewScript(nm, "file: " .. nm .. " (requested by " .. tostring(s.name) .. " " .. s.id .. ")")
			if fs ~= X.Overflow then fs.verdict, fs.status = "UNVERIFIED", "blocked" end
			local msg = "[UH Security] " .. fs.id .. " blocked (UNVERIFIED): " .. why
			X.AddFinding({kind = "script", id = fs.id, name = nm, origin = fs.origin, severity = "medium", verdict = "UNVERIFIED", evidence = {{desc = why}}, urls = {}, note = "The source could not be inspected before execution.", decision = "BLOCKED: " .. why .. " (strict fail-closed policy; caller " .. s.id .. ")"})
			X.Hist("blocked", fs.id .. " " .. nm .. " UNVERIFIED -> blocked: " .. why .. " (caller " .. s.id .. ")", fs.id)
			X.Notify(string.format("[UH Security] %s blocked (UNVERIFIED): %s", nm, why:sub(1, 100)))
			if kind == "dofile" then error(msg, 0) end
			return nil, msg
		end
		local f, e = X.GateLoad(compile, kind, s, "file: " .. path, content, "=" .. path)
		if kind == "dofile" then
			if not f then error(e, 0) end
			return f()
		end
		return f, e
	end
end
C.request = function(who, call, opts, ...)
	local s = X.Gate(who)
	if not s or type(opts) ~= "table" then return call(opts, ...) end
	local url = opts.Url or opts.URL or opts.url
	local m = X.GuardNet(s, "request", tostring(opts.Method or "GET"):upper(), url, opts.Body, opts.Headers)
	if m then error("[UH Security] " .. m, 0) end
	local res = call(opts, ...)
	if type(res) == "table" then X.Download(url, res.Body) end
	return res
end
C.reqAsync = function(who, call, self, opts, ...)
	local s = X.Gate(who)
	if not s or type(opts) ~= "table" then return call(self, opts, ...) end
	local url = opts.Url or opts.URL or opts.url
	local m = X.GuardNet(s, "RequestAsync", tostring(opts.Method or "GET"):upper(), url, opts.Body, opts.Headers)
	if m then error("[UH Security] " .. m, 0) end
	local res = call(self, opts, ...)
	if type(res) == "table" then X.Download(url, res.Body) end
	return res
end
C.get = function(name)
	return function(who, call, self, url, ...)
		local s = X.Gate(who)
		if not s then return call(self, url, ...) end
		local m = X.GuardNet(s, name, "GET", url)
		if m then error("[UH Security] " .. m, 0) end
		local res = call(self, url, ...)
		X.Download(url, res)
		return res
	end
end
C.post = function(name)
	return function(who, call, self, url, data, ...)
		local s = X.Gate(who)
		if not s then return call(self, url, data, ...) end
		local m = X.GuardNet(s, name, "POST", url, data)
		if m then error("[UH Security] " .. m, 0) end
		local res = call(self, url, data, ...)
		X.Download(url, res)
		return res
	end
end
C.nav = function(who, call, self, url, ...)
	local s = X.Gate(who)
	if not s or type(url) ~= "string" or not X.On("ExtPhish") then return call(self, url, ...) end
	local a = X.AnalyzeURL(url)
	if a.verdict ~= "CLEAN" then
		local best
		for _, r in ipairs(a.reasons) do
			if not best or r.w > best.w then best = r end
		end
		X.Incident(s, "browser navigation", a.host .. ": " .. (best and best.desc or "suspicious address"), a.crit and "critical" or "high", a.crit, true, url)
		error("[UH Security] navigation to " .. a.host .. " blocked", 0)
	end
	X.Hist("net", s.id .. " opened browser: " .. url:sub(1, 90), s.id)
	return call(self, url, ...)
end
C.setclip = function(who, call, text, ...)
	local s = X.Gate(who)
	if not s or not X.On("ExtRuntime") then return call(text, ...) end
	if credHit(text) then
		X.Incident(s, "clipboard", "Roblox login data copied to the clipboard", "critical", true)
		error("[UH Security] login data may not be copied", 0)
	end
	if type(text) == "string" and X.On("ExtPhish") then
		local u = text:match("[Hh][Tt][Tt][Pp][Ss]?://%S+")
		if u then
			local a = X.AnalyzeURL(u)
			if a.verdict == "MALICIOUS" then
				X.Incident(s, "clipboard hijack", a.host .. ": " .. ((a.reasons[1] or {}).desc or "dangerous link"), a.crit and "critical" or "high", a.crit, true, u)
				error("[UH Security] dangerous link blocked from the clipboard", 0)
			end
		end
	end
	s.clipN = (s.clipN or 0) + 1
	if s.clipN <= 3 then X.Hist("clipboard", s.id .. " wrote " .. (type(text) == "string" and #text or 0) .. " bytes to the clipboard", s.id) end
	return call(text, ...)
end
C.getclip = function(who, call, ...)
	local s = X.Gate(who)
	if s and X.On("ExtRuntime") and not s.clipRead then
		s.clipRead = true
		X.Hist("clipboard", s.id .. " read the clipboard", s.id)
	end
	return call(...)
end

local function inspectDrop(s, path, data)
	if not X.On("ExtChecker") or type(data) ~= "string" or #data < 40 or #data > X.MaxSource then return nil end
	local ext = lowp(path):match("%.([%w_]+)$")
	local allowed = (Util.Security and Util.Security.Config and Util.Security.Config.Extensions) or {lua = true, luau = true, txt = true}
	if not ext or not allowed[ext] then return nil end
	if ext == "txt" and not (data:find("loadstring", 1, true) or data:find("HttpGet", 1, true)) then return nil end
	local ok, rep = pcall(X.Check, data, {name = path, origin = s.id})
	if not ok then return nil end
	X.Stats.Scanned += 1
	if rep.verdict == "CLEAN" then return nil end
	local blockIt = rep.verdict == "MALICIOUS" or rep.critical
	X.AddFinding({kind = "payload", id = s.id, name = tostring(path), origin = s.origin, severity = rep.severity, verdict = rep.verdict, evidence = rep.reasons, urls = rep.urls, decision = blockIt and "BLOCKED (payload not written)" or "ALLOWED (flagged)"})
	if blockIt then
		X.Incident(s, "malicious payload", "refused to write " .. tostring(path):sub(1, 60) .. ": " .. ((rep.reasons[1] or {}).desc or rep.verdict), rep.severity, rep.critical, false)
		return "writing a malicious payload is blocked"
	end
	X.Stats.SuspiciousDetected += 1
	X.Hist("scan", s.id .. " wrote a suspicious payload: " .. tostring(path):sub(1, 60), s.id)
	return nil
end
-- UH Admin's own scoped writes. UH's internal code (Util.FS.Write with opt.Scope) opens a grant that covers ONE exact path, on the calling thread only, for the length of that single write.
-- The registry is a local of this scope (not a field of X, not a global); the rules only name UH's own generated-file locations. Anything else - in particular any external script writing into UhhhhhhReanim - still takes the blocking path in C.write below.
local grants = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"}) -- thread -> exact lower-case path
local scopeRule = {
	anim = function(p) return p:match("^uhhhhhhreanim/content/anims/[^/]+%.anim$") ~= nil end, -- Animation Studio .anim exports: that folder only, no sub-folders
	persist = function(p) -- built-in Custom Reanimation Methods: ".version" and "<method>/init.lua" only
		local r = p:match("^uhhhhhhreanim/custom reanimation methods/(.+)$")
		if not r then return false end
		local seg = r:match("^([^/]+)/init%.lua$")
		return r == ".version" or (seg ~= nil and not seg:find("^%.+$"))
	end,
}
