function X.WriteScope(name, path, fn)
	local rule, co = scopeRule[name], coroutine.running()
	local p = lowp(path)
	if not rule or not co or not rule(p) then return fn() end -- no grant: fn runs as an ordinary, fully checked call
	local prev = grants[co]
	grants[co] = p
	local res = table.pack(pcall(fn))
	grants[co] = prev
	if not res[1] then error(res[2], 0) end
	return table.unpack(res, 2, res.n)
end
local function granted(path)
	local co = coroutine.running()
	return co ~= nil and grants[co] ~= nil and grants[co] == lowp(path)
end
C.write = function(op)
	return function(who, call, path, data, ...)
		if granted(path) and not credHit(data) then return call(path, data, ...) end -- UH Admin's own authorised write (credential data is still refused below)
		local s = X.Gate(who)
		if not s or not X.On("ExtRuntime") then return call(path, data, ...) end
		local p = lowp(path)
		local m
		if p:find("uhhhhhhreanim", 1, true) then
			X.Incident(s, "file tampering", op .. " inside UH Admin's folder (" .. tostring(path):sub(1, 60) .. ")", "high", false)
			m = "writing into UH Admin's folder is blocked"
		elseif p:find("autoexec", 1, true) then
			X.Incident(s, "auto-execute persistence", op .. " into an auto-execute folder (" .. tostring(path):sub(1, 60) .. ")", "high", false)
			m = "writing into an auto-execute folder is blocked"
		elseif credHit(data) then
			X.Incident(s, "credential write", "Roblox login data written to " .. tostring(path):sub(1, 60), "critical", true)
			m = "login data may not be written to disk"
		else
			m = inspectDrop(s, path, data)
		end
		if m then error("[UH Security] " .. m, 0) end
		return call(path, data, ...)
	end
end
C.del = function(op)
	return function(who, call, path, ...)
		local s = X.Gate(who)
		if not s or not X.On("ExtRuntime") then return call(path, ...) end
		local p = lowp(path)
		local m
		if p == "" or p == "." or p == "./" or p == "/" or p == "workspace" or p == "workspace/" then
			X.Incident(s, "file deletion", op .. " would wipe the whole workspace folder", "high", false)
			m = "wiping the workspace folder is blocked"
		elseif p:find("uhhhhhhreanim", 1, true) or p:find("autoexec", 1, true) then
			X.Incident(s, "file deletion", op .. " inside UH Admin / auto-execute folders (" .. tostring(path):sub(1, 60) .. ")", "high", false)
			m = "deleting inside UH Admin / auto-execute folders is blocked"
		else
			local now = os.clock()
			local d = s.del
			if not d or now - d.t0 > 10 then
				d = {t0 = now, n = 0}
				s.del = d
			end
			d.n += 1
			if d.n > 12 then
				X.Incident(s, "mass deletion", "more than 12 files deleted in 10 seconds", "high", false)
				m = "mass file deletion is blocked"
			end
		end
		if m then error("[UH Security] " .. m, 0) end
		return call(path, ...)
	end
end
C.queue = function(who, call, code, ...)
	local s = X.Gate(who)
	if not s or not X.On("ExtRuntime") or type(code) ~= "string" then return call(code, ...) end
	local ok, rep = pcall(X.Check, code, {name = "queued teleport script", origin = s.id})
	if not ok then rep = X.Unverified("scan error") end
	X.Hist("persistence", s.id .. " queued a script for the next teleport (" .. rep.verdict .. ")", s.id)
	if rep.verdict == "MALICIOUS" or rep.critical then
		X.AddFinding({kind = "persistence", id = s.id, name = s.name, origin = s.origin, severity = rep.severity, verdict = rep.verdict, evidence = rep.reasons, urls = rep.urls, decision = "BLOCKED"})
		X.Incident(s, "persistence", "queued teleport script is " .. rep.verdict, rep.severity, rep.critical, false)
		error("[UH Security] queued script blocked", 0)
	elseif rep.verdict ~= "CLEAN" and X.On("ExtFirewall") then
		X.Stats.SuspiciousDetected += 1
		if not X.Decide(X.Subject(s, rep)) then
			X.Incident(s, "persistence", "queued teleport script (" .. rep.verdict .. ") was not authorized", "medium", false)
			error("[UH Security] queued script blocked", 0)
		end
	end
	return call(code, ...)
end
C.hookguard = function(who, call, target, ...)
	local s = X.Gate(who)
	if s and X.On("ExtRuntime") and guard[target] then
		X.Incident(s, "security bypass", "tried to hook or restore a function that UH Security guards", "high", false)
		error("[UH Security] hooking guarded functions is blocked", 0)
	end
	return call(target, ...)
end

-- __namecall route (game:HttpGet(...) style calls). Only used when getnamecallmethod and setnamecallmethod exist.
local NC = {
	HttpGet = C.get("HttpGet"), HttpGetAsync = C.get("HttpGetAsync"), HttpPost = C.post("HttpPost"), HttpPostAsync = C.post("HttpPostAsync"),
	RequestAsync = C.reqAsync, GetAsync = C.get("HttpService.GetAsync"), PostAsync = C.post("HttpService.PostAsync"), OpenBrowserWindow = C.nav,
	__UhProbe = function(who) X.ProbeWho = who return true end,
}
local HSVC = {RequestAsync = true, GetAsync = true, PostAsync = true}
local function installNamecall()
	if type(hookmetamethod) ~= "function" or type(getnamecallmethod) ~= "function" or type(setnamecallmethod) ~= "function" then return false end
	local old, inner
	inner = function(self, ...)
		local m = getnamecallmethod()
		local core = NC[m]
		if not core or not X.Active or not X.NCOK then return old(self, ...) end
		if HSVC[m] then
			local okc, cn = pcall(function() return self.ClassName end)
			if not (okc and cn == "HttpService") then
				setnamecallmethod(m)
				return old(self, ...)
			end
		end
		local who = X.Caller(inner)
		if m == "__UhProbe" then return core(who) end
		return core(who, function(...)
			setnamecallmethod(m)
			return old(...)
		end, self, ...)
	end
	X.NCOK = true
	local ok, prev = pcall(hookmetamethod, game, "__namecall", ncc(inner))
	if not ok or type(prev) ~= "function" then
		X.NCOK = false
		return false
	end
	old = prev
	X.ProbeWho = nil
	pcall(function() return game:__UhProbe() end)
	if not X.ProbeWho or not X.IsUH(X.ProbeWho) then
		X.NCOK = false
		return false, "caller identification through __namecall failed"
	end
	return true
end

function X.Install()
	if X.Installed then return end
	X.Installed = true
	local L = X.CapLines
	if not X.CanIdentify then
		L[#L + 1] = "[DISABLED] this executor has no debug.info / debug.getinfo, so UH Security cannot tell UH's own calls from third-party calls. Interception is OFF to keep UH working."
		return
	end
	local g = (type(getgenv) == "function" and getgenv()) or _G
	local function T(x) return type(x) == "table" and x or nil end
	local sy, ht, fl = T(g.syn), T(g.http), T(g.fluxus)
	local TN = {[g] = ""}
	if sy then TN[sy] = "syn." end
	if ht then TN[ht] = "http." end
	if fl then TN[fl] = "fluxus." end
	local function group(label, list)
		local have, okc = 0, 0
		local gHave, gOk, tHave, tOk, viaH, viaT = 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0
		local fns, nfn, bad = {}, 0, {}
		for _, j in ipairs(list) do
			local f, tbl, key = j[1], j[2], j[3]
			if type(f) == "function" then
				have += 1
				if not fns[f] then
					fns[f] = true
					nfn += 1
				end
				local nested = tbl ~= g
				if nested then tHave += 1 else gHave += 1 end
				local ok, route, why = hookTarget(f, tbl, key, j[4])
				if ok then
					okc += 1
					if nested then tOk += 1 else gOk += 1 end
					if route == "hookfunction" then viaH += 1 else viaT += 1 end
				else
					bad[#bad + 1] = (TN[tbl] or "?.") .. tostring(key) .. " (" .. tostring(why or "not guarded") .. ")"
				end
			end
		end
		if have == 0 then
			L[#L + 1] = "[N/A] " .. label .. ": not provided by this executor"
			return
		end
		local fh, ft = 0, 0
		for f in pairs(fns) do
			local e = seen[f]
			if e and e.hooked then
				fh += 1
			elseif e and e.nslots > 0 then
				ft += 1
			end
		end
		local tag = okc == have and "[OK]" or (okc > 0 and "[PARTIAL]" or "[NOT INTERCEPTABLE]")
		L[#L + 1] = string.format("%s %s: aliases guarded %d/%d (global %d/%d, executor-table %d/%d; via hookfunction %d, table replacement %d) | underlying functions: %d, hooked %d, table-only %d, unguarded %d", tag, label, okc, have, gOk, gHave, tOk, tHave, viaH, viaT, nfn, fh, ft, nfn - fh - ft)
		for _, b in ipairs(bad) do
			L[#L + 1] = "[NOT INTERCEPTABLE] " .. label .. " alias " .. b
		end
	end
	local function bLoad(kind)
		local b = mkHook(C.load(kind))
		return function(call)
			if kind == "loadstring" then X.RawLoad = call end
			return b(call)
		end
	end
	group("loadstring / load (dynamic + nested compile, firewall)", {{g.loadstring, g, "loadstring", bLoad("loadstring")}, {g.load, g, "load", bLoad("load")}})
	group("loadfile / dofile (file execution)", {{g.loadfile, g, "loadfile", mkHook(C.loadfile("loadfile"))}, {g.dofile, g, "dofile", mkHook(C.loadfile("dofile"))}})
	local rq = mkHook(C.request)
	group("HTTP requests (request / http_request)", {{g.request, g, "request", rq}, {g.http_request, g, "http_request", rq}, {sy and sy.request, sy, "request", rq}, {ht and ht.request, ht, "request", rq}, {fl and fl.request, fl, "request", rq}})
	group("clipboard write", {{g.setclipboard, g, "setclipboard", mkHook(C.setclip)}, {g.toclipboard, g, "toclipboard", mkHook(C.setclip)}, {g.set_clipboard, g, "set_clipboard", mkHook(C.setclip)}})
	group("clipboard read", {{g.getclipboard, g, "getclipboard", mkHook(C.getclip)}, {g.readclipboard, g, "readclipboard", mkHook(C.getclip)}})
	group("file writes (writefile / appendfile)", {{g.writefile, g, "writefile", mkHook(C.write("writefile"))}, {g.appendfile, g, "appendfile", mkHook(C.write("appendfile"))}})
	group("file deletes (delfile / delfolder)", {{g.delfile, g, "delfile", mkHook(C.del("delfile"))}, {g.delfolder, g, "delfolder", mkHook(C.del("delfolder"))}})
	local qb = mkHook(C.queue)
	group("teleport persistence (queue_on_teleport)", {{g.queue_on_teleport, g, "queue_on_teleport", qb}, {g.queueonteleport, g, "queueonteleport", qb}, {g.queueteleport, g, "queueteleport", qb}, {sy and sy.queue_on_teleport, sy, "queue_on_teleport", qb}, {fl and fl.queue_on_teleport, fl, "queue_on_teleport", qb}})

	-- Calibration: a call made by UH itself must be recognised as UH. If not, interception is switched off so UH keeps working.
	X.Active = true
	local who
	if type(g.loadstring) == "function" and guard[g.loadstring] then
		X.LastWho = nil
		pcall(g.loadstring, "return 1")
		who = X.LastWho
	else
		local P
		P = function() return X.Caller(P) end
		local okp, w = pcall(ncc(P))
		who = okp and w or nil
	end
	if not who or who == "[C]" then
		X.Active = false
		L[#L + 1] = "[DISABLED] UH Security could not identify the caller of a hooked function on this executor, so all interception is OFF to keep UH working."
		return
	end
	X.Trusted[who] = true
	do
		local okh, how = X.CanHash()
		if okh then
			L[#L + 1] = "[OK] approval cache: verified SHA-256 via " .. tostring(how) .. " (bounded to " .. X.ApproveMax .. " entries)"
		else
			L[#L + 1] = "[LIMIT] approval cache DISABLED: no verified SHA-256 API on this executor, so both confirmation phrases are required again for every suspicious script"
		end
	end

	local okn, nwhy = installNamecall()
	if okn then
		L[#L + 1] = "[OK] game:HttpGet / HttpPost / HttpService / OpenBrowserWindow colon-calls (__namecall hook)"
	else
		L[#L + 1] = "[NOT INTERCEPTABLE] colon-call form game:HttpGet(...): " .. (nwhy or "this executor lacks hookmetamethod / getnamecallmethod / setnamecallmethod")
	end
	-- Colon-call coverage = __namecall hook only. Dot-call coverage = direct hookfunction, or table replacement ONLY for plain Lua tables.
	local MR = {}
	local function method(obj, label, name, builder)
		local r = {label = label, name = name, colon = okn == true and NC[name] ~= nil}
		local okf, f = pcall(function() return obj[name] end)
		if okf and type(f) == "function" then
			r.present = true
			local tbl = type(obj) == "table" and obj or nil
			r.dot, r.route, r.why = hookTarget(f, tbl, tbl and name or nil, builder)
		end
		MR[#MR + 1] = r
	end
	method(game, "game", "HttpGet", mkHook(C.get("HttpGet")))
	method(game, "game", "HttpGetAsync", mkHook(C.get("HttpGetAsync")))
	method(game, "game", "HttpPost", mkHook(C.post("HttpPost")))
	method(game, "game", "HttpPostAsync", mkHook(C.post("HttpPostAsync")))
	method(HttpService, "HttpService", "RequestAsync", mkHook(C.reqAsync))
	method(HttpService, "HttpService", "GetAsync", mkHook(C.get("HttpService.GetAsync")))
	method(HttpService, "HttpService", "PostAsync", mkHook(C.post("HttpService.PostAsync")))
	method(GuiService, "GuiService", "OpenBrowserWindow", mkHook(C.nav))
	L[#L + 1] = "[INFO] method-hook capabilities: hookfunction=" .. tostring(type(hookfunction) == "function") .. ", newcclosure=" .. tostring(type(newcclosure) == "function") .. ", __namecall hook=" .. tostring(okn == true) .. ", table-slot fallback=plain Lua tables only (Roblox objects are never overwritten)"
	local order, groups = {}, {}
	for _, r in ipairs(MR) do
		local sig = r.present and (tostring(r.colon) .. "|" .. tostring(r.dot) .. "|" .. tostring(r.route or r.why)) or "NA"
		local gp = groups[sig]
		if not gp then
			gp = {r = r, names = {}}
			groups[sig] = gp
			order[#order + 1] = gp
		end
		gp.names[#gp.names + 1] = r.label .. ":" .. r.name
	end
	for _, gp in ipairs(order) do
		local r = gp.r
		local names = table.concat(gp.names, ", ")
		if not r.present then
			L[#L + 1] = "[N/A] " .. names .. ": method not exposed by this executor"
		else
			local cs = r.colon and "OK (__namecall)" or "[NOT INTERCEPTABLE] (no verified __namecall hook)"
			local ds = r.dot and ("OK (" .. (r.route == "hookfunction" and "direct hookfunction" or "table replacement") .. ")") or ("[NOT INTERCEPTABLE] (" .. tostring(r.why) .. ")")
			local tag = (r.colon and r.dot) and "[OK]" or ((r.colon or r.dot) and "[PARTIAL]" or "[NOT INTERCEPTABLE]")
			L[#L + 1] = string.format("%s %s | colon-call obj:Method(): %s | dot-call obj.Method(obj, ...): %s", tag, names, cs, ds)
		end
	end
	group("hook protection (hookfunction / restorefunction)", {{g.hookfunction, g, "hookfunction", mkHook(C.hookguard)}, {g.restorefunction, g, "restorefunction", mkHook(C.hookguard)}})
	L[#L + 1] = "[LIMIT] editor / clipboard / script-hub scripts are compiled by the executor before UH sees them: UNVERIFIED, runtime monitoring only"

	task.spawn(function()
		while X.Active do
			task.wait(2)
			for _, fb in ipairs(fallbacks) do
				local okr, cur = pcall(function() return fb.t[fb.k] end)
				if okr and cur ~= fb.w then
					pcall(function() fb.t[fb.k] = fb.w end)
					X.Stats.RuntimeBlocked += 1
					X.Hist("runtime", "guarded function '" .. tostring(fb.k) .. "' was replaced by another script: attempt to disable monitoring, guard restored")
				end
			end
			if Util.ExtGuard ~= X then Util.ExtGuard = X end
		end
	end)
	X.Hist("setting", "external script protection installed")
end
X.Install()
end)
if not okE then warn("[UH Security] external script hooks failed: " .. tostring(errE)) end
end

local UserModulesListor = {}
Util.UserModulesListor = UserModulesListor
Util.ModuleProgress = {Done = 0, Total = 7}
Util.StaleBuiltins = {}
Util.BuiltinDir = "UhhhhhhReanim/BuiltinModules"
Util.BuiltinCache = {}
Util.EnsureBuiltinDir = function()
local cur = ""
for seg in string.gmatch(Util.BuiltinDir, "[^/]+") do
cur = cur == "" and seg or cur .. "/" .. seg
local okF, ex = pcall(isfolder, cur)
if not (okF and ex) then pcall(makefolder, cur) end
end
end
Util.ReadBuiltin = function(name)
local okF, ex = pcall(isfile, Util.BuiltinDir .. "/" .. name)
if okF and ex then
local okR, data = pcall(readfile, Util.BuiltinDir .. "/" .. name)
if okR and type(data) == "string" and data ~= "" then return data end
end
return Util.BuiltinCache[name]
end
Util.WriteBuiltin = function(name, content)
if type(content) ~= "string" or content == "" then return false end
Util.BuiltinCache[name] = content
local path = Util.BuiltinDir .. "/" .. name
for attempt = 1, 2 do
Util.EnsureBuiltinDir()
if pcall(writefile, path, content) then
local okR, data = pcall(readfile, path)
if okR and type(data) == "string" and data ~= "" then return true end
end
if attempt == 1 then task.wait(0.1) end
end
return false
end
Util.LoadMap = function(name)
local src = Util.ReadBuiltin(name)
if not src and Util.FetchBuiltin then
src = Util.FetchBuiltin(name, 3)
if src then Util.WriteBuiltin(name, src) end
end
if not src then error("BuiltinModules/" .. name .. " is unavailable (download failed)", 0) end
return loadstring(src, "Uhhhhhh :: " .. name)()
end
Util.MapsPresent = function()
for _, n in {"d_limbmap.lua", "d_hatsmap.lua"} do
if not Util.BuiltinCache[n] then
local ok, ex = pcall(isfile, Util.BuiltinDir .. "/" .. n)
if not (ok and ex) then return false end
end
end
return true
end
Util.GetModuleStatus = function()
local P = Util.ModuleProgress or {Done = 0, Total = 0}
if IsUhhhhhhFullyLoaded then
return string.format("MODULES READY  |  %d MOVESETS  |  %d DANCES", #MovementStyles, #DanceableDances)
end
return string.format("LOADING MODULES %d/%d  |  %d MOVESETS  |  %d DANCES", math.min(P.Done, P.Total), P.Total, #MovementStyles, #DanceableDances)
end
Util.PreloadModules = function(slow)
local run = (Util.PreloadRun or 0) + 1
Util.PreloadRun = run
Util.PreloadIds = {}
task.spawn(function()
local queue, seen, fails = {MovementStyles[MovementStyleIndex]}, {}, 0
for _, list in {MovementStyles, DanceableDances} do
for _, m in list do queue[#queue + 1] = m end
end
for _, m in queue do
if Util.PreloadRun ~= run then return end
if not seen[m] and type(m.Assets) == "table" then
seen[m] = true
local ok = pcall(function()
local ready, w = AssetEnsure(m.Assets), 0
while not ready and w < 24 and Util.PreloadRun == run do
task.wait(0.5)
w += 1
ready = AssetEnsure(m.Assets)
end
if not ready then error("assets unavailable", 0) end
for _, entry in m.Assets do
local name = type(entry) == "string" and string.split(entry, "@")[1]
if name and name:sub(-5) ~= ".anim" and name:sub(-6) ~= ".anims" then
AssetGetContentId(name)
task.wait()
end
end
end)
fails = ok and 0 or fails + 1
if fails >= 3 then return end
task.wait(slow and 0.5 or 0.2)
end
end
end)
end
local function DoModuleReload(force)
IsUhhhhhhFullyLoaded = false
Util.PreloadRun = (Util.PreloadRun or 0) + 1
Util.PreloadIds = nil
Util.ModuleProgress = {Done = 0, Total = 7}
Util.StaleBuiltins = {}
do
local cur = MovementStyles[MovementStyleIndex]
if cur and cur.Hash then SaveData.MovesetHash = cur.Hash end
Util.MovesetPickedByUser = false
end
InitLogsText.Text = "Init Logs -- This is where you check what happened."
ClearModules()
table.clear(UserModulesListor)
Util.UINotify("Checking hashes...", 0.05)
InitLogsText.Add("\n[LOG] Checking SHA1 hashes...")
local filesofbuiltins = {"v_moveset1.lua", "v_moveset2.lua", "v_moveset3.lua", "v_dance1.lua", "v_dance2.lua", "d_limbmap.lua", "d_hatsmap.lua"}
local filesofbuiltins_m = {"v_moveset1.lua", "v_moveset2.lua", "v_moveset3.lua", "v_dance1.lua", "v_dance2.lua"}
local filesofbuiltins_d = {"d_limbmap.lua", "d_hatsmap.lua"}
SaveData.ContentHash = SaveData.ContentHash or {}
local hashFresh = force == false and type(SaveData.ContentHashAt) == "number" and next(SaveData.ContentHash) ~= nil
and math.abs(os.time() - SaveData.ContentHashAt) < 600
if hashFresh then
InitLogsText.Add("\n[LOG] SHA1 hashes were checked recently, skipping the repo request.")
elseif force ~= "SKIPHASH" then
xpcall(function()
local s, resp = pcall(request, {
Method = "GET",
Url = "https://api.github.com/repos/STEVE-916-create/Uhhhhhh/contents/content/",
})
if s and resp and resp.StatusCode == 200 then
s, resp = pcall(HttpService.JSONDecode, HttpService, resp.Body)
if s and resp then
SaveData.ContentHashAt = os.time()
for _,file in resp do
if file.name and file.sha then
if SaveData.ContentHash[file.name] ~= file.sha then
SaveData.ContentHash[file.name] = file.sha
if table.find(filesofbuiltins, file.name) then
local path = "UhhhhhhReanim/BuiltinModules/" .. file.name
if isfile(path) then
InitLogsText.Add("\n[LOG] BuiltinModules/" .. file.name .. " has been updated on the repo.")
Util.StaleBuiltins[file.name] = true
end
else
local path = AssetGetPathFromFilename(file.name)
if isfile(path) then
InitLogsText.Add("\n[LOG] Downloaded Asset " .. file.name .. " removed because outdated.")
delfile(path)
end
end
end
end
end
end
end
InitLogsText.Add("\n[LOG] Checked all SHA1 hashes...")
end, function()
InitLogsText.Add("\n[WARN] SHA1 hashes check failed!")
end)
else
InitLogsText.Add("\n[WARN] Chill. We are just reloading user modules.")
InitLogsText.Add("\n[LOG] Checked all SHA1 hashes...")
end
local wasold = false
if SaveData.VanillaModuleCache then
wasold = true
SaveData.VanillaModuleCache = nil
end
local loadMode = tonumber(SaveData.ModuleLoadMode)
if loadMode ~= 2 and loadMode ~= 3 and loadMode ~= 4 and loadMode ~= 5 then loadMode = 1 end
local SLOW_STEP_DELAY = 0.35
local function SlowPause()
if loadMode == 4 then
task.wait(SLOW_STEP_DELAY)
end
end
local lowTier = ((type(_G) == "table" and type(_G.UHDevProfile) == "table" and tonumber(_G.UHDevProfile.Tier)) or 3) <= 2
local FRAME_BUDGET, sliceT = lowTier and 0.003 or 0.006, os.clock()
local function FetchContent(x, tries)
for a = 1, tries do
local content = _contentgetgithubraw(x)
if type(content) == "string" and content ~= "" then return content end
if a < tries then task.wait(0.6 * a) end
end
return nil
end
Util.FetchBuiltin = FetchContent
local function Breathe()
if os.clock() - sliceT >= FRAME_BUDGET then
task.wait()
sliceT = os.clock()
end
end
InitLogsText.Add("\n[LOG] Module load mode: " .. ({"Default", "Splitted (2 at a time)", "Instant", "Slow (1 at a time, paced)", "Pre-load (assets cached ahead of time)"})[loadMode])
if loadMode == 4 then
InitLogsText.Add("\n[LOG] Slow mode: one module at a time with a short pause between each, this takes longer.")
end
local function RunPhase(items, work, apply)
local rawApply = apply
local function bump()
local P = Util.ModuleProgress
if P then P.Done = P.Done + 1 end
end
apply = function(i, x, data)
if rawApply then
local okA, errA = pcall(rawApply, i, x, data)
if not okA then InitLogsText.Add("\n[ERROR] Load step failed: " .. tostring(errA)) end
end
bump()
end
if loadMode == 4 then
for i, x in items do
local ok, data = pcall(work, i, x)
if not ok then
InitLogsText.Add("\n[ERROR] Slow load: reading step failed: " .. tostring(data))
data = nil
bump()
else
SlowPause()
end
if ok and apply then
local okA, errA = pcall(apply, i, x, data)
if not okA then
InitLogsText.Add("\n[ERROR] Slow load: load step failed: " .. tostring(errA))
end
SlowPause()
end
end
return
end
if loadMode == 1 or loadMode == 5 then
for i, x in items do
local okW, data = pcall(work, i, x)
if not okW then
InitLogsText.Add("\n[ERROR] Load step failed, skipping this file: " .. tostring(data))
bump()
elseif apply then
task.wait()
apply(i, x, data)
end
end
return
end
local size = (loadMode == 2 or lowTier) and 2 or math.max(1, #items)
local i = 1
while i <= #items do
local last = math.min(i + size - 1, #items)
local results, pending = {}, last - i + 1
for k = i, last do
task.spawn(function()
local ok, res = pcall(work, k, items[k])
results[k] = (ok and res) or ""
pending -= 1
end)
end
while pending > 0 do
task.wait()
end
if apply then
sliceT = os.clock()
for k = i, last do
if k > i then Breathe() end
apply(k, items[k], results[k])
results[k] = nil
end
end
if loadMode == 2 then
task.wait()
end
i = last + 1
end
end

local function LoadExtensionFolder(folder, label, register)
local okl, files = pcall(listfiles, folder)
if not okl or type(files) ~= "table" then return 0 end
local loaded = 0
for _,path in files do
local okF, isF = pcall(isfile, path)
if okF and isF and path:lower():match("%.lua$") then
local x = path:match("[^/\\]+$") or path
xpcall(function()
InitLogsText.Add("\n[LOG] Reading " .. label .. " " .. x .. "...")
local data = readfile(path)
local blocked = Util.Security and Util.Security.GateModule(path, data)
if blocked then
InitLogsText.Add("\n[SECURITY] Blocked " .. label .. " " .. x .. " from loading: " .. blocked)
return
end
local func, comperr = loadstring(data, "Uhhhhhh :: " .. label .. " :: " .. x)
if not func then error("COMPILE FAILED: " .. tostring(comperr)) end
register(func(), x)
loaded += 1
end, function(msg)
InitLogsText.Add("\n[ERROR] Failed to load " .. label .. " " .. x .. ": " .. tostring(msg))
end)
SlowPause()
Breathe()
end
end
return loaded
end

local CRM = {}
function CRM.LowEnd()
local ok, v = pcall(function() return FX.IsLowEnd() end)
return (ok and v == true) or (UIS.TouchEnabled and not UIS.KeyboardEnabled)
end
function CRM.Tick(hz, fn)
local acc, step = 0, 1 / hz
return RS_.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
acc += dt
if acc >= step then
local d = acc
acc = 0
pcall(fn, d)
end
end)
end
function CRM.Trim() pcall(collectgarbage, "step", 64) end
local function Hook(kind, R, def)
local S = SaveData.Reanimator
local key = "Custom" .. kind .. "Enabled"
S[key] = not not S[key]
local origStart, origConfig = R.Start, R.Config
R.Start = function(...)
local on, st, conn = S[key], nil, nil
if on then
if def.Begin then
local okb, r = pcall(def.Begin, R, S, CRM)
st = okb and r or nil
end
if def.Tick then conn = CRM.Tick(def.TickRate or 1, function(dt) def.Tick(R, S, st, dt) end) end
end
local ok, err = pcall(origStart, ...)
if conn then conn:Disconnect() end
if on and def.End then pcall(def.End, R, S, st, CRM) end
if not ok then error(err, 0) end
end
R.Config = function(parent, ...)
origConfig(parent, ...)
pcall(function()
UI.CreateText(parent, def.Description or def.Name, 10, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
UI.CreateSwitch(parent, "Use " .. def.Name, S[key]).Changed:Connect(function(v) S[key] = v end)
end)
end
end

local haveNooby = false

if pm.Name == "Nooby's style" then haveNooby = true break end
end
if not haveNooby then
local okn, errn = pcall(function()
LimbReanimator.RegisterMode((function()
local STREAM_DEPTH = 16
local DEEP_DEPTH = 64
local FLOOR_MARGIN = 32
local DEFAULT_FPDH = -500
local SMOOTH_TIME_XZ = 0.20
local SMOOTH_TIME_Y = 0.40
local STREAM_LEASH = 8
local DEEP_LEASH = 48
local TELEPORT_DIST = 200
local MAX_DT = 0.1
local DEFAULT_DT = 1 / 60
local MAX_COORD = 1e8
local MAX_VEL = 1e5
local MAX_FAILS = 30
local OMEGA_XZ = 2 / SMOOTH_TIME_XZ
local OMEGA_Y = 2 / SMOOTH_TIME_Y
local sqrt, min, max = math.sqrt, math.min, math.max
local ready = false
local sx, sy, sz = 0, 0, 0
local vx, vy, vz = 0, 0, 0
local lastT = nil
local fails = 0
local function finite(n)
return type(n) == "number" and n == n and n > -MAX_COORD and n < MAX_COORD
end
local function readPosition(part)
return part.Position
end
local function samplePart(part)
if typeof(part) ~= "Instance" or part.Parent == nil then return nil end
local ok, pos = pcall(readPosition, part)
if not ok or typeof(pos) ~= "Vector3" then return nil end
local x, y, z = pos.X, pos.Y, pos.Z
if finite(x) and finite(y) and finite(z) then return x, y, z end
return nil
end
local function damp(cur, target, vel, omega, dt)
local x = omega * dt
local e = 1 / (1 + x + 0.48 * x * x + 0.235 * x * x * x)
local change = cur - target
local temp = (vel + omega * change) * dt
return target + (change + temp) * e, (vel - omega * temp) * e
end
local function step(ctx)
local fpdh = ctx.FallenPartsDestroyHeight
if not finite(fpdh) then fpdh = DEFAULT_FPDH end
local floorY = fpdh + FLOOR_MARGIN
local px, py, pz = samplePart(ctx.RootPart)
if px == nil then px, py, pz = samplePart(ctx.Torso) end
local t = ctx.Time
local dt = DEFAULT_DT
if finite(t) and lastT ~= nil and t >= lastT then
dt = min(t - lastT, MAX_DT)
end
if finite(t) then lastT = t end
if px ~= nil then
local streaming = ctx.Streaming == true
local tx, tz = px, pz
local ty = max(py - (streaming and STREAM_DEPTH or DEEP_DEPTH), floorY)
local dx, dy, dz = tx - sx, ty - sy, tz - sz
local dist = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz)
local stateOk = finite(sx) and finite(sy) and finite(sz)
and finite(vx) and finite(vy) and finite(vz)
if not ready or dist > TELEPORT_DIST or not stateOk then
sx, sy, sz = tx, ty, tz
vx, vy, vz = 0, 0, 0
ready = true
else
sx, vx = damp(sx, tx, vx, OMEGA_XZ, dt)
sz, vz = damp(sz, tz, vz, OMEGA_XZ, dt)
sy, vy = damp(sy, ty, vy, OMEGA_Y, dt)
local leash = streaming and STREAM_LEASH or DEEP_LEASH
dx, dy, dz = tx - sx, ty - sy, tz - sz
local rem = sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy + dz * dz)
if rem > leash then
local k = (rem - leash) / rem
sx, sy, sz = sx + dx * k, sy + dy * k, sz + dz * k
end
if vx > MAX_VEL or vx < -MAX_VEL or vy > MAX_VEL or vy < -MAX_VEL or vz > MAX_VEL or vz < -MAX_VEL then
vx, vy, vz = 0, 0, 0
end
end
if sy < floorY then
sy = floorY
if vy < 0 then vy = 0 end
end
elseif not ready then
sx, sy, sz = 0, floorY, 0
vx, vy, vz = 0, 0, 0
ready = true
else
vx, vy, vz = 0, 0, 0
end
return CFrame.new(sx, sy, sz)
end
return {
Name = "Nooby's style",
GetRootCFrame = function(ctx)
local ok, cf = pcall(step, ctx)
if ok and typeof(cf) == "CFrame" then
fails = 0
return cf
end
fails = fails + 1
if fails > MAX_FAILS then
error("Nooby's style failed repeatedly: " .. tostring(cf), 0)
end
if ready and finite(sx) and finite(sy) and finite(sz) then
return CFrame.new(sx, sy, sz)
end
return CFrame.new(0, DEFAULT_FPDH + FLOOR_MARGIN, 0)
end,
}
end)(), "built-in")
end)
if not okn then InitLogsText.Add("\n[ERROR] Failed to register built-in Nooby's style: " .. tostring(errn)) end
end
end

pcall(HatReanimator.ResolveSavedFling)
pcall(Reanimate.HairReanimator.ResolveSavedFling)
pcall(Reanimate.HatHairReanimator.ResolveSavedFling)
pcall(Reanimate.AccessoriesReanimator.ResolveSavedFling)
InitLogsText.Add("\n[LOG] Loaded " .. #LimbReanimator.PluginModes .. " RootPart plugin(s), " .. #HatReanimator.PluginFlingMethods .. " fling method(s).")
if Util.RefreshReanimatorConfig then pcall(Util.RefreshReanimatorConfig) end
end

pcall(RefreshKeybinds)
InitLogsText.Add("\n[LOG] Loaded " .. (#MovementStyles + #DanceableDances) .. " modules - " .. #MovementStyles .. " Movesets, " .. #DanceableDances .. " Dances.")
InitLogsText.Add("\n[LOG] Init complete!")

end
end

end
return ok
end

local order, pos, last = {}, 0, nil
local function nextQuote()
local n = #Q
if pos >= #order then
for i = 1, n do order[i] = i end
for i = n, 2, -1 do
local j = math.random(i)
order[i], order[j] = order[j], order[i]
end
if n > 1 and order[1] == last then order[1], order[n] = order[n], order[1] end
pos = 0
end
pos = pos + 1
last = order[pos]
return Q[last]
end
local function notifOff() return ((Util.FX and Util.FX.Cfg) or {}).NotifMode == 4 end
local function idle()
return IsUhhhhhhFullyLoaded and not (Util.IntroRunning or (Util.FX and Util.FX.IntroActive)) and os.clock() >= JQ.busyUntil
end
local function loop(gen)
while JQ.Gen == gen do
task.wait(JQ.Min + math.random() * (JQ.Max - JQ.Min))
while JQ.Gen == gen and not notifOff() and not idle() do task.wait(5) end
if JQ.Gen ~= gen then return end
if not notifOff() then
local text = nextQuote()
local hold = math.clamp(#text / 14 + 3, 6, 15)
pcall(jarvisShow, text, hold)
JQ.busyUntil = os.clock() + hold + 1
end
end
end
function JQ.Set(v)
v = v and true or false
if v == JQ.Enabled then return end
JQ.Enabled, JQ.Gen = v, JQ.Gen + 1
local t = JQ.Thread
JQ.Thread = nil
if t then pcall(task.cancel, t) end
if v then JQ.Thread = task.spawn(loop, JQ.Gen) end
end
pcall(function()
local g = getgenv()
if type(g.__JarvisQuotesStop) == "function" then pcall(g.__JarvisQuotesStop) end
g.__JarvisQuotesStop = function() JQ.Set(false) end
end)
JQ.Set(SaveData.JarvisQuotes ~= false)
end)

notify = function(_, text)
text = tostring(text)
local hold = math.clamp(#text / 14 + 3, 6, 15)
local jq = Util.JarvisQuotes
if jq then jq.busyUntil = os.clock() + hold + 2 end
return jarvisShow(text, hold), hold
end,

	-- Turning a protection OFF is never silent: a confirmation dialog is shown first and SaveData is only changed after the user confirms.
	local confirmOpen = false
	local function confirmOff(title, message, onKeep, onOff)
		if confirmOpen then pcall(onKeep) return end
		confirmOpen = true
		local decided = false
		local gui
		local function decide(off)
			if decided then return end
			decided = true
			confirmOpen = false
			if gui then pcall(function() gui:Destroy() end) end
			if off then pcall(onOff) else pcall(onKeep) end
		end
		local built = pcall(function()
			local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
			gui = Util.Instance("ScreenGui")
			gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
			gui.DisplayOrder = 2147483000
			gui.IgnoreGuiInset = true
			gui.ZIndexBehavior = Enum.ZIndexBehavior.Sibling
			local dim = Util.Instance("TextButton", gui)
			dim.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
			dim.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
			dim.BackgroundTransparency = 0.35
			dim.AutoButtonColor = false
			dim.Text = ""
			dim.BorderSizePixel = 0
			local card = Util.Instance("Frame", dim)
			card.Active = true
			card.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
			card.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
			card.Size = UDim2.new(0.94, 0, 0, 0)
			card.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
			card.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 28)
			card.BorderSizePixel = 0
			local cons = Util.Instance("UISizeConstraint", card)
			cons.MaxSize = Vector2.new(480, 100000)
			Util.Instance("UICorner", card).CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, 8)
			local stroke = Util.Instance("UIStroke", card)
			stroke.Color = Color3.fromRGB(235, 70, 70)
			stroke.Thickness = 2
			local pad = Util.Instance("UIPadding", card)
			pad.PaddingTop, pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 12), UDim.new(0, 12)
			pad.PaddingLeft, pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 12), UDim.new(0, 12)
			local list = Util.Instance("UIListLayout", card)
			list.Padding = UDim.new(0, 10)
			list.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder
			local function label(text, size, order)
				local l = Util.Instance("TextLabel", card)
				l.LayoutOrder = order
				l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
				l.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 0)
				l.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
				l.RichText = true
				l.TextWrapped = true

				l.TextColor3 = WHITE
				l.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
				l.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
				l.Text = text
				return l
			end
			label("<b>" .. title .. "</b>", 17, 1)
			label(message, 14, 2)
			local function button(text, color, order)
				local b = Util.Instance("TextButton", card)
				b.LayoutOrder = order
				b.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 46)
				b.BackgroundColor3 = color

				return b
			end
			local keep = button("KEEP PROTECTION ON", Color3.fromRGB(60, 140, 80), 3)
			local off = button("TURN OFF PROTECTION", Color3.fromRGB(170, 60, 60), 4)
			keep.Activated:Connect(function() decide(false) end)

			dim.Activated:Connect(function() decide(false) end)

			if gethiddengui then
				parented = pcall(function() gui.Parent = gethiddengui() end) and gui.Parent ~= nil
			end
			if not parented then gui.Parent = CoreGui end
		end)
		-- Fail safe: if the dialog cannot be shown, protection stays ON.
		if not built or not gui or not gui.Parent then decide(false) end
	end
	local function sw(label, key, title, warn)
		local lever = UI.CreateSwitch(MainPage, label, X.On(key))
		if SaveData[key] == nil then SaveData[key] = true end
		lever.Changed:Connect(function(value)
			-- Same as the saved setting (e.g. the switch being restored after a cancel): nothing to do.
			if value == X.On(key) then return end
			if value then
				SaveData[key] = true
				X.Hist("setting", label .. " ON")
				return
			end
			-- Switch was flipped OFF: SaveData is NOT changed until the user confirms.
			confirmOff(title, warn, function()
				lever.Value = true
				X.Hist("setting", label .. " OFF cancelled, kept ON")
			end, function()
				SaveData[key] = false
				lever.Value = false
				X.Hist("setting", label .. " OFF (confirmed by user)")
			end)
		end)
	end

	local function refresh()
		local st = X.Stats
		local mon = 0
		for _, s in ipairs(X.List) do
			if s.status == "monitored" then mon += 1 end
		end
		stat.Text = string.format("<b>Statistics</b>  [%s]\nScripts intercepted: %d | scanned: %d\nMalicious blocked: %d | suspicious detected: %d\nPhishing links blocked: %d | runtime ops blocked: %d\nCurrently monitored scripts: %d", X.Active and "ACTIVE" or "INACTIVE - see capabilities", st.Intercepted, st.Scanned, st.MaliciousBlocked, st.SuspiciousDetected, st.PhishingBlocked, st.RuntimeBlocked, mon)
		if fnd.Parent.Visible then
			local out = {"<b>Security Findings</b> (latest " .. math.min(6, #X.Findings) .. ")"}
			for i = 1, math.min(6, #X.Findings) do
				local f = X.Findings[i]
				out[#out + 1] = string.format("\n[%s] %s %s | %s\norigin: %s\ndecision: %s", string.upper(f.severity or "?"), f.id or "?", X.Esc(f.name or "?"), f.verdict or f.kind or "", X.Esc(f.origin or "?"), X.Esc(f.decision or "?"))
				local ev = f.evidence or {}
				for j = 1, math.min(3, #ev) do
					local e = ev[j]
					out[#out + 1] = "  - " .. X.Esc(e.desc or "") .. (e.line and (" (line " .. e.line .. ")") or "") .. (e.snippet and ("\n    > " .. X.Esc(string.sub(e.snippet, 1, 90))) or "")
				end
				local us = f.urls or {}
				for j = 1, math.min(2, #us) do
					out[#out + 1] = "  url: " .. X.Esc(string.sub(us[j].url or "", 1, 90))
				end
			end
			fnd.Text = table.concat(out, "\n")
		end
		if his.Parent.Visible then
			local out = {"<b>Security History</b> (latest " .. math.min(12, #X.History) .. ")"}
			for i = 1, math.min(12, #X.History) do
				local h = X.History[i]
				out[#out + 1] = os.date("%H:%M:%S", h.t) .. " " .. h.kind .. ": " .. X.Esc(h.text)
			end
			his.Text = table.concat(out, "\n")
		end
		if cap.Parent.Visible then
			local out = {"<b>Executor capabilities</b>"}
			for _, l in ipairs(X.CapLines) do out[#out + 1] = X.Esc(l) end
			out[#out + 1] = "\n<b>Limits</b>"
			for _, l in ipairs(X.Limits) do out[#out + 1] = "- " .. X.Esc(l) end
			cap.Text = table.concat(out, "\n")
		end
	end
	local function toggle(text, label)
		UI.CreateButton(MainPage, text, 15).Activated:Connect(function()
			label.Parent.Visible = not label.Parent.Visible
			refresh()
		end)
	end
	toggle("Security Findings", fnd)
	toggle("Security History", his)
	toggle("Executor Capabilities & Limits", cap)
	UI.CreateButton(MainPage, "Clear Findings & History", 15).Activated:Connect(function()
		table.clear(X.Findings)
		table.clear(X.History)
		refresh()
	end)
	X.OnUpdate = refresh
	refresh()
end
end

UI.CreateText(MainPage, "\n\n\n<b>DANGER ZONE</b>", 15, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center)
local clearcontenthash, clearcontenthashtext = UI.CreateButton(MainPage, "CLEAR ALL DOWNLOADED CONTENT", 15)

-- ===== BUILDING LIMB BLOCKS: shared controller (Util.LimbBlocks) =====
-- One controller for both reanimation methods. The adapters are two tiny hooks: Limb Reanimator -> Reanimate.SafeLimbPose (LB.LimbPose), Hat Reanimator -> GetHatMappedCFrame (LB.HatPose).
-- Offsets are studs / degrees in the animated Torso's axes; rotation turns a limb around its own centre. No connection is owned except a 1 s status poll that only runs while the page is open.
xpcall(function()
local LB = {}
Util.LimbBlocks = LB
LB.Warning = "Creating inappropriate builds with your limbs is extremely prohibited, do not attempt to build inappropriate stuff or you can get blacklisted entirely from the script."
LB.Limbs = {"Head", "Torso", "Left Arm", "Right Arm", "Left Leg", "Right Leg"}
-- every limb reanimation variant: they all pose limbs through Reanimate.SafeLimbPose, so they share the Limb adapter (LB.LimbPose); Hat Reanimator keeps its own adapter (LB.HatPose)
LB.LimbMethods = {Limbs = true, Ragdoll = true, Unanchored = true, ["Servo-Joint"] = true, ["Hybrid-Joint"] = true, ["Skeletal Retargeting"] = true, ["Kinematic Reanimation"] = true, ["Velocity-Interpolated"] = true}
LB.On, LB.Ack, LB.Sel, LB.GzMode = false, false, 1, "move"
LB.Off, LB.Live, LB.Seen = {}, {}, {}
local IDX, CFnew, idcf = {}, CFrame.new, CFrame.identity
for i, n in ipairs(LB.Limbs) do
IDX[n] = i
LB.Off[n] = {0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0}
end
local function say(t) pcall(Util.UINotify or Util.Notify, t) end
local function rebuild(name)
local o = LB.Off[name]
if o[1] == 0 and o[2] == 0 and o[3] == 0 and o[4] == 0 and o[5] == 0 and o[6] == 0 then
LB.Live[name] = nil
else
LB.Live[name] = {P = Vector3.new(o[1], o[2], o[3]), R = CFrame.Angles(math.rad(o[4]), math.rad(o[5]), math.rad(o[6]))}
end
end
function LB.Set(name, k, val)
local o = LB.Off[name]
if not o or not o[k] then return end
val = tonumber(val) or 0
if val ~= val then val = 0 end
local lim = k <= 3 and 100 or 360
o[k] = math.clamp(val, -lim, lim)
rebuild(name)
end
function LB.Reset(name)
for _, n in ipairs(LB.Limbs) do
if not name or n == name then
LB.Off[n] = {0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0}
LB.Live[n] = nil
end
end
end
-- fr = rotation-only frame (animated torso axes), live = {P = offset, R = rotation}: translate along fr, rotate around base's own position
local function place(base, fr, live)
return CFnew(base.Position + fr * live.P) * ((fr * live.R * fr:Inverse()) * base.Rotation)
end
-- drops every piece of feature state: Building Mode off, offsets reset, adapters forgotten (stop / character replaced / method changed)
function LB.Clear()
local was = LB.On
LB.On = false
if LB.GizmoSync then LB.GizmoSync() end
LB.TM, LB.TV = nil, nil
LB.Reset()
table.clear(LB.Seen)
if LB.OnClear then pcall(LB.OnClear, was) end
end
-- returns "Limbs" / "Hats" while one of the two supported methods runs; any change of method or fake character clears the feature state
function LB.Gate()
local cur = Reanimate.Current
local n = cur and cur.Name
if LB.LimbMethods[n] then n = "Limbs" elseif n ~= "Hats" then n = nil end
local rc = n and Reanimate.Character or nil
if cur ~= LB._cur or rc ~= LB._rc then
LB._cur, LB._rc = cur, rc
LB.Clear()
end
return n
end
-- Limb Reanimator adapter: cf = the finished (animated + sanitized) Motor6D pose Part0 -> Part1 of one real joint. Offsets are layered on top of it, never stored into the animation data
function LB.LimbPose(map, v, RC, RootPart, tcf, cf)
if LB.Gate() ~= "Limbs" then return cf end
local n1 = map.RPart1
if not IDX[n1] then return cf end
LB.Seen[n1] = map
if not LB.On or cf == idcf or not Reanimate.FiniteCF(cf) then return cf end
local hl = Reanimate.HiddenLimbs
if hl and (hl[n1] or hl.Torso) then return cf end
local live = LB.Live[n1]
if n1 == "Torso" then
if map.RPart0 ~= "ROOT" then return cf end
LB.TM, LB.TV = map, v
if not live then return cf end
return place(cf, cf.Rotation, live)
end
local tm, lt = LB.TM, LB.Live.Torso
if map.RPart0 ~= "Torso" or not tm or not (live or lt) then return cf end
-- every limb joint hangs on the torso joint: rebuild the limb in root space from the UNMOVED animated torso, then re-express it relative to the (possibly moved) torso so limbs stay independent
local ct = Reanimate.LimbPoseCFrame(tm, LB.TV, RC, RootPart, tcf)
if ct == idcf or not Reanimate.FiniteCF(ct) then return cf end
local fr = ct.Rotation
local lr = ct * cf
if live then lr = place(lr, fr, live) end
local nt = lt and place(ct, fr, lt) or ct
return nt:Inverse() * lr
end
-- Hat Reanimator adapter: lcf = world CFrame of the animated fake limb that a mapped hat follows. Every hat keeps its own limb link, so each limb moves together with the hats mapped to it
function LB.HatPose(RC, name, lcf)
if LB.Gate() ~= "Hats" then return lcf end
local live = LB.Live[name]
if not live then return lcf end
if name == "Torso" then return place(lcf, lcf.Rotation, live) end
local torso = RC and RC:FindFirstChild("Torso")
if not (torso and torso:IsA("BasePart")) then return lcf end
return place(lcf, torso.CFrame.Rotation, live)
end
-- a limb is only controllable when the running method really has something mapped to it
function LB.Available(name)
local cur = Reanimate.Current
local n = cur and cur.Name
if LB.LimbMethods[n] then n = "Limbs" end
if n == "Limbs" then
local hl = Reanimate.HiddenLimbs
return LB.Seen[name] ~= nil and not (hl and (hl[name] or hl.Torso))
elseif n == "Hats" and cur.GetHatMap then
local ok, hm = pcall(cur.GetHatMap)
if ok and type(hm) == "table" then
for _, e in ipairs(hm) do
if e.Limb == name then return true end
end
end
end
return false
end
-- ===== 3D gizmo: the same screen-projected move arrows / rotation rings as Animation Studio (same colours, projection and drag maths), editing the selected limb's offsets =====
local UIS, RS = game:GetService("UserInputService"), game:GetService("RunService")
local AXC = {Color3.fromRGB(232, 64, 64), Color3.fromRGB(72, 218, 84), Color3.fromRGB(74, 104, 255)}
local AXV = {Vector3.xAxis, Vector3.yAxis, Vector3.zAxis}
local NSEG, POSLIM = 32, 30
do
local okL, low = pcall(function() return Util.FX.IsLowEnd() end)
if okL and low == true then NSEG = 20 end
end
local MB1, TOUCH = Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1, Enum.UserInputType.Touch
local gz, PD = nil, nil
local function mkHandle(layer, col, thick, head)
local b = Util.Instance("TextButton", layer)
b.AutoButtonColor = false
b.Text = ""
b.BackgroundTransparency = 1
b.BorderSizePixel = 0
b.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
b.Visible = false
local v = Util.Instance("Frame", b)
v.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
v.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
v.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, thick)
v.BackgroundColor3 = col
v.BorderSizePixel = 0
if head then
local h = Util.Instance("Frame", b)
h.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
h.Position = UDim2.fromScale(1, 0.5)
h.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(18, 18)
h.Rotation = 45
h.BackgroundColor3 = col
h.BorderSizePixel = 0
end
return {btn = b, vis = v}
end
local function setSeg(h, ax, ay, bx, by, hit, extra)
local dx, dy = bx - ax, by - ay
h.btn.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((ax + bx) / 2, (ay + by) / 2)
h.btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.sqrt(dx * dx + dy * dy) + extra, hit)
h.btn.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(dy, dx))
end
local function gzHide()
local g = gz
if not g or not g.shown then return end
g.shown, g.sig = false, nil
for _, a in g.arrows do
a.pos.btn.Visible = false
a.neg.btn.Visible = false
end
for _, r in g.rings do
for _, h in r do h.btn.Visible = false end
end
end
-- the selected limb of the fake (visible) character plus its torso, whose axes are the building frame
local function gzTarget()
local RC = Reanimate.Character
local name = LB.Limbs[LB.Sel]
local part = RC and RC:FindFirstChild(name)
local torso = RC and RC:FindFirstChild("Torso")
if part and torso and part:IsA("BasePart") and torso:IsA("BasePart") then return name, part, torso, RC end
end
-- where the engine puts a part THIS frame (parent chain through the Motor6D transforms) - same prediction as Animation Studio's predCF: the gizmo never lags behind a limb that was just posed
local motorOf, motorRig = {}, nil
local function predCF(rig, part, depth)
if motorRig ~= rig then
motorRig, motorOf = rig, {}
for _, d in rig:GetDescendants() do
if d:IsA("Motor6D") and d.Part1 then motorOf[d.Part1] = d end
end
end
local m = motorOf[part]
if not m or not m.Enabled or not m.Part0 or depth > 3 then return part.CFrame end
return predCF(rig, m.Part0, depth + 1) * m.C0 * m.Transform * m.C1:Inverse()
end
local function gzUpdate()
local g = gz
if not g then return end
local method = LB.Gate()
if gz ~= g then return end
local cam, page = workspace.CurrentCamera, LB.Page
local name, part, torso, rig = gzTarget()
if not (method and LB.On and LB.GzMode and cam and name and page and page.Visible) then gzHide() return end
local now = os.clock()
if g.avName ~= name or now - g.avAt > 0.5 then g.avName, g.avAt, g.av = name, now, LB.Available(name) end
if not g.av then gzHide() return end
local off, live = LB.Off[name], LB.Live[name]
-- predicted (this frame's) torso frame and limb centre; fall back to the real part when the prediction is far off
local pCF, lCF = predCF(rig, torso, 0), predCF(rig, part, 0)
if (pCF.Position - torso.Position).Magnitude > 4 then pCF = torso.CFrame end
if (lCF.Position - part.Position).Magnitude > 4 then lCF = part.CFrame end
if g.hold and not PD then g.hold = nil end
local fr = pCF.Rotation
local C = g.hold or (lCF.Position + (live and fr * live.P or Vector3.zero))
local camCF, vp = cam.CFrame, cam.ViewportSize
-- GUI space vs viewport space: when the host GUI does not cover the whole viewport (inset), shift by the difference
local ras = g.layer.AbsoluteSize
local ox, oy = vp.X - ras.X, vp.Y - ras.Y
ox = (ox > 0.5 and ox < 300) and ox / 2 or 0
oy = (oy > 0.5 and oy < 120) and oy or 0
local mode = LB.GzMode
local sg = g.sig
if g.shown and sg and sg.cam == camCF and sg.C == C and sg.fr == fr and sg.mode == mode and sg.vy == vp.Y and sg.rx == off[4] and sg.ry == off[5] and sg.fov == cam.FieldOfView and sg.part == name and sg.ox == ox and sg.oy == oy then return end
g.sig = {cam = camCF, C = C, fr = fr, mode = mode, vy = vp.Y, rx = off[4], ry = off[5], fov = cam.FieldOfView, part = name, ox = ox, oy = oy}
local depth = (C - camCF.Position):Dot(camCF.LookVector)
if depth < 0.5 then gzHide() return end
local pxPerStud = vp.Y / (2 * depth * math.tan(math.rad(cam.FieldOfView) / 2))
local function P(w)
local v = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(w)
return v.X - ox, v.Y - oy, v.Z
end
g.C, g.shown = C, true
if mode == "move" then
for _, r in g.rings do
for _, h in r do h.btn.Visible = false end
end
-- arms reach ~3.6 studs to either side of the limb centre, never smaller than ~80 px
local armLen = math.min(math.max(3.6, 80 / pxPerStud), vp.Y * 0.42 / pxPerStud)
g.armLen = armLen
local ax, ay, az = P(C)
for i = 1, 3 do
local d = fr:VectorToWorldSpace(AXV[i])
g.dir[i] = d
for sgn = 1, 2 do
local h = sgn == 1 and g.arrows[i].pos or g.arrows[i].neg
local bx, by, bz = P(C + d * (sgn == 1 and armLen or -armLen))
if az > 0 and bz > 0 and (bx - ax) ^ 2 + (by - ay) ^ 2 > 100 then
setSeg(h, ax, ay, bx, by, 30, 0)
h.btn.Visible = true
else
h.btn.Visible = false
end
end
end
else
for _, a in g.arrows do
a.pos.btn.Visible = false
a.neg.btn.Visible = false
end
local R = math.min(math.max(2.6, 58 / pxPerStud), vp.Y * 0.32 / pxPerStud)
local rx, ry = math.rad(off[4]), math.rad(off[5])
-- rotation order is X, Y, Z (CFrame.Angles): the Y ring turns with X, the Z ring with X and Y
local frames = {fr, fr * CFrame.Angles(rx, 0, 0), fr * CFrame.Angles(rx, ry, 0)}
local cd = camCF.Position - C
local stepA = 2 * math.pi / NSEG
for i = 1, 3 do
local n = frames[i]:VectorToWorldSpace(AXV[i])
local u = n:Cross(math.abs(n.Y) < 0.9 and Vector3.yAxis or Vector3.xAxis).Unit
local v = n:Cross(u)
g.ring[i] = {C = C, n = n, u = u, v = v, R = R, px = R * pxPerStud}
local pts = {}
for k = 0, NSEG do
local th = k * stepA
pts[k] = Vector3.new(P(C + (u * math.cos(th) + v * math.sin(th)) * R))
end
local uc, vc = u:Dot(cd), v:Dot(cd)
for k = 1, NSEG do
local p, q, h = pts[k - 1], pts[k], g.rings[i][k]
if p.Z > 0 and q.Z > 0 then
setSeg(h, p.X, p.Y, q.X, q.Y, 26, 2)
local thm = (k - 0.5) * stepA
h.vis.BackgroundTransparency = (uc * math.cos(thm) + vc * math.sin(thm) < 0) and 0.6 or 0.04
h.btn.Visible = true
else
h.btn.Visible = false
end
end
end
end
end
-- pointer drag for the handles: connections exist only while a handle is held. move(pos) gets the pointer position, done() runs on release
local function beginPtr(input, move, done)
local ty = input.UserInputType
if PD or (ty ~= MB1 and ty ~= TOUCH) then return false end
local conns = {}
local function finish()
if not PD then return end
PD = nil
for _, c in conns do c:Disconnect() end
pcall(done)
end
conns[1] = UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
local t = i.UserInputType
if (t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and ty == MB1) or (t == TOUCH and i == input) then
if t == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and not UIS:IsMouseButtonPressed(MB1) then
finish()
return
end
local okM, err = pcall(move, Vector2.new(i.Position.X, i.Position.Y))
if not okM then warn("[LimbBlocks] " .. tostring(err)) end
end
end)
conns[2] = UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
if i == input or (i.UserInputType == MB1 and ty == MB1) then finish() end
end)
PD = {finish = finish}
return true
end
-- begins a handle drag: i = axis (1..3), seg = +1 / -1 arrow half, or the ring segment grabbed
local function gzBegin(kind, i, seg, input)
local ty = input.UserInputType
if ty ~= MB1 and ty ~= TOUCH then return end
local g = gz
if PD or not LB.On or not g or not g.shown or not g.C then return end
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
if not cam then return end
local name = LB.Limbs[LB.Sel]
local idx = (kind == "move" and 0 or 3) + i
local grabW, c0, ax, ring
if kind == "move" then
ax, c0 = g.dir[i], g.C
if not ax then return end
grabW = c0 + ax * (seg * g.armLen * 0.55)
else
ring = g.ring[i]
if not ring then return end
local th = (seg - 0.5) * 2 * math.pi / NSEG
c0 = ring.C
grabW = c0 + (ring.u * math.cos(th) + ring.v * math.sin(th)) * ring.R
end
local gv = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(grabW)
if gv.Z <= 0 then return end
local grab = Vector2.new(gv.X, gv.Y)
local axisParam, planeAngle, s0, a0, tanS
if kind == "move" then
axisParam = function(pt) -- position along the axis line that is closest to the pointer ray
local ray = cam:ViewportPointToRay(pt.X, pt.Y)
local d = ray.Direction
local w0 = c0 - ray.Origin
local b = ax:Dot(d)
local den = 1 - b * b
if den < 1e-3 then return nil end
return (b * d:Dot(w0) - ax:Dot(w0)) / den
end
s0 = axisParam(grab)
if not s0 then return end
else
local rn, ru, rv = ring.n, ring.u, ring.v
planeAngle = function(pt) -- angle of the pointer ray where it crosses the ring's plane
local ray = cam:ViewportPointToRay(pt.X, pt.Y)
local d = ray.Direction
local den = d:Dot(rn)
if math.abs(den) < 0.12 then return nil end
local t = (c0 - ray.Origin):Dot(rn) / den
if t < 0 then return nil end
local r = ray.Origin + d * t - c0
return math.atan2(r:Dot(rv), r:Dot(ru))
end
a0 = planeAngle(grab)
if not a0 then -- ring seen edge-on: drag along the ring's screen tangent instead
local tw = rn:Cross(grabW - c0).Unit
local tv = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(grabW + tw * (ring.R * 0.1))
local tdir = Vector2.new(tv.X, tv.Y) - grab
if tdir.Magnitude < 0.5 then return end
tanS = tdir.Unit
end
end
local v0 = LB.Off[name][idx]
local p0 = Vector2.new(input.Position.X, input.Position.Y)
local acc, last = 0, a0
local started = beginPtr(input, function(pos)
if not gz or not LB.On then return end
local tgt = grab + (pos - p0)
local nv
if kind == "move" then
local s = axisParam(tgt)
if not s then return end
nv = math.clamp(v0 + (s - s0), -POSLIM, POSLIM)
else
if tanS then
acc = (pos - p0):Dot(tanS) / ring.px
else
local a = planeAngle(tgt)
if not a then return end
acc += (a - last + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi
last = a
end
nv = (v0 + math.deg(acc) + 180) % 360 - 180
end
nv = tonumber(string.format("%.3f", nv))
if LB.Off[name][idx] == nv then return end
LB.Set(name, idx, nv)
if LB.OnEdit then pcall(LB.OnEdit, false) end
end, function()
if gz then gz.hold, gz.sig = nil, nil end
if LB.OnEdit then pcall(LB.OnEdit, true) end
end)
if started and kind == "rot" and gz then gz.hold = c0 end -- keep the ring still under the pointer while the limb turns
end
local function gzBuild()
local layer = Util.Instance("Frame", Util.TopGui)
layer.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
layer.BackgroundTransparency = 1
layer.BorderSizePixel = 0
layer.ZIndex = 2147483646 -- just under the main UI (2147483647): handles never cover the script window
local g = {layer = layer, arrows = {}, rings = {}, dir = {}, ring = {}, shown = false, avAt = 0}
gz = g
for i = 1, 3 do
local hp, hn = mkHandle(layer, AXC[i], 5, true), mkHandle(layer, AXC[i], 5, true)
g.arrows[i] = {pos = hp, neg = hn}
hp.btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input) gzBegin("move", i, 1, input) end)
hn.btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input) gzBegin("move", i, -1, input) end)
g.rings[i] = {}
for k = 1, NSEG do
local r = mkHandle(layer, AXC[i], 4, false)
g.rings[i][k] = r
r.btn.InputBegan:Connect(function(input) gzBegin("rot", i, k, input) end)
end
end
end
-- the render-step binding exists only while a gizmo exists AND the Building Limb Blocks page is open: closing the page hides the gizmo, ends any drag and drops the binding (offsets stay untouched)
local bound = false
local function gzUnbind()
bound = false
pcall(function() RS:UnbindFromRenderStep("LimbBlocksGizmo") end)
end
local function gzPageSync()
local page = LB.Page
if gz and page and page.Visible then
if not bound then
bound = true
pcall(function() RS:UnbindFromRenderStep("LimbBlocksGizmo") end)
RS:BindToRenderStep("LimbBlocksGizmo", Enum.RenderPriority.Last.Value, function() pcall(gzUpdate) end) -- after the camera has moved this frame
end
else
gzUnbind()
if PD then PD.finish() end
gzHide()
end
end
local function gzStop()
gzUnbind()
if PD then PD.finish() end
local g = gz
gz = nil
motorOf, motorRig = {}, nil
if g then pcall(function() g.layer:Destroy() end) end
end
-- builds / removes the gizmo to match Building Mode + the Gizmo setting, then binds / unbinds it to match the page being open
function LB.GizmoSync()
local want = LB.On and LB.GzMode ~= nil
if want and not gz then
gzBuild()
elseif not want and (gz or PD) then
gzStop()
end
gzPageSync()
end
function LB.Attach(page, closeFn)
LB.Page = page
local C = Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
UI.CreateButton(page, "&lt; Back", 20).Activated:Connect(closeFn)
UI.CreateText(page, "<b>BUILDING LIMB BLOCKS</b>", 15, C)
UI.CreateText(page, "<font color=\"#FF4B4B\"><b>[ WARNING ]</b></font>", 15, C)
UI.CreateText(page, "<font color=\"#FF4B4B\"><b>" .. LB.Warning .. "</b></font>", 12, C)
UI.CreateSeparator(page)
UI.CreateText(page, "<font color=\"#AAAAAA\">Use your reanimated limbs as building blocks to create custom formations and constructions.\nWorks with Limb Reanimation and Hats Reanimation. Start one of them first.</font>", 10, C)
local ack = UI.CreateSwitch(page, "I have read the warning above", LB.Ack)

for i, name in ipairs(LB.Limbs) do
local t = name .. (LB.Live[name] and " (moved)" or "") .. (LB.Available(name) and "" or " - UNAVAILABLE (nothing mapped)")
if i == sel.Value then
t = "<b><font color=\"#FFE066\">&gt; " .. t .. "  [SELECTED]</font></b>"
else
t = "<font color=\"#AAAAAA\">   " .. t .. "</font>"
end
lines[#lines + 1] = t
end

end
local function syncSliders()

loading = false
end

if loading then return end
local name = LB.Limbs[sel.Value]
LB.Set(name, k, val)
local c = LB.Off[name][k]
if c ~= val then
loading = true
sl[k].Value = c
loading = false
end
refresh()
end)
end

MainPage.Visible = false
MainPage.Interactable = true
end
if below then below.Visible = false end

busy = false
end)

p.Visible = false
if below then below.Interactable = true else MainPage.Interactable = true end
busy = false
end)

local okPM, errPM = pcall(function()
local Stats = game:GetService("Stats")
local reg = RegisterTextLabel or function() end
local WHITE = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
local L, R = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Enum.TextXAlignment.Right
local N = 40
local function themeCol() return (UITextColor and UITextColor.Value) or WHITE end
local function fmtMB(v) if v >= 1024 then return string.format("%.2f GB", v / 1024) end return string.format("%.0f MB", v) end
local function readMem()
local ok, v = pcall(Stats.GetTotalMemoryUsageMb, Stats)
if ok and type(v) == "number" and v > 0 then return v end
end
local function readLua()
local ok, v = pcall(collectgarbage, "count")
if ok and type(v) == "number" and v > 0 then return v / 1024 end
end
local cpuItem
local function readCpuMs()
if not cpuItem or not cpuItem.Parent then
local ps = Stats:FindFirstChild("PerformanceStats")
cpuItem = ps and ps:FindFirstChild("CPU")
if not cpuItem then return nil end
end
local ok, s = pcall(cpuItem.GetValueString, cpuItem)
if not ok or type(s) ~= "string" then return nil end
local num, unit = s:match("([%d%.]+)%s*(%a+)")
num = tonumber(num)
if num and unit == "ms" then return num end
end
local hw
local function safe(f, ...) local ok, v = pcall(f, ...) if ok then return v end end
local function clean(s) if type(s) == "string" then return (s:gsub("[<>&]", ""):sub(1, 48)) end end
local function readHW()
if hw then return hw end
hw = {}
hw.platform = safe(function() return (tostring(game:GetService("UserInputService"):GetPlatform()):gsub("^Enum%.Platform%.", "")) end)
hw.exec = clean(safe(function() return (identifyexecutor()) end))
local ts = safe(function() return settings():GetService("TaskScheduler") end)
if ts then
hw.pool = safe(function() local v = ts.ThreadPoolSize return type(v) == "number" and v > 0 and v or nil end)
hw.poolCfg = safe(function() return (tostring(ts.ThreadPoolConfig):gsub("^Enum%.ThreadPoolConfig%.", "")) end)
end
local dev = (FX and FX.Device) or _G.UHDevProfile
if type(dev) == "table" and type(dev.RAM) == "number" then hw.ram, hw.ramConf = dev.RAM, dev.Confidence end
local env = type(genv) == "table" and genv or _G
local function scan(t, d)
for k, v in pairs(t) do
local ks = type(k) == "string" and k:lower() or ""
if type(v) == "table" then
if d < 2 then scan(v, d + 1) end
elseif type(v) == "string" and #v > 2 and (ks:find("cpu", 1, true) or ks:find("processor", 1, true)) and (ks:find("name", 1, true) or ks:find("model", 1, true) or ks:find("brand", 1, true) or ks == "cpu" or ks == "processor") then
hw.cpuName = hw.cpuName or clean(v)
elseif type(v) == "number" and v >= 1 and v <= 256 and v % 1 == 0 then
if ks:find("thread", 1, true) or ks:find("logical", 1, true) then hw.threads = hw.threads or v
elseif ks:find("core", 1, true) and not ks:find("score", 1, true) then hw.cores = hw.cores or v end
end
end
end
for _, n in ipairs({"getdeviceinfo", "getsysteminfo", "getcpuinfo", "getprocessorinfo"}) do
local fn = env[n] or _G[n]
if type(fn) == "function" then
local r = safe(fn)
if type(r) == "table" then scan(r, 0)
elseif type(r) == "string" and #r > 2 and n:find("cpu", 1, true) then hw.cpuName = hw.cpuName or clean(r) end
end
end
return hw
end
local function hwText()
local h = readHW()
local thr = {}
if h.threads then thr[#thr + 1] = h.threads .. " logical threads (executor)" end
if h.cores then thr[#thr + 1] = h.cores .. " cores (executor)" end
if h.pool then thr[#thr + 1] = "Roblox scheduler pool " .. h.pool .. (h.poolCfg and (" [" .. h.poolCfg .. "]") or "") end
return "<b>Hardware</b> (read locally)\n"
.. "CPU: " .. (h.cpuName or "name not exposed") .. "\n"
.. "Threads: " .. (#thr > 0 and table.concat(thr, ", ") or "not exposed") .. "\n"
.. "RAM: " .. (h.ram and string.format("%.1f GB (%s confidence)", h.ram, tostring(h.ramConf or "?")) or "not exposed") .. "\n"
.. "Platform: " .. (h.platform or "?") .. "  |  Executor: " .. (h.exec or "?")
end

local ftH, memH = table.create(N, 0), table.create(N, 0)
local w, pkAvg, pkWorst, pkMem, pkLua = 1, 0, 0, 0, 0
local cpuMode, lastCpuMs, lastCpuPct, pkCpu, hwDone = false, 0, 0, 0, false
local function draw(bars, hist, top)
for i = 1, N do
bars[i].Size = UDim2.new(1 / N, -1, math.clamp(hist[(w + i - 2) % N + 1] / top, 0, 1), 0)
end
end
local function sample(avgMs, fps, worst)
if avgMs > pkAvg then pkAvg = avgMs end
if worst > pkWorst then pkWorst = worst end
local cpuMs, cpuPct
if cpuMode then
cpuMs = readCpuMs()
if cpuMs then
cpuPct = math.clamp(cpuMs / avgMs * 100, 0, 100)
lastCpuMs, lastCpuPct = cpuMs, cpuPct
if cpuPct > pkCpu then pkCpu = cpuPct end
else
cpuMs, cpuPct = lastCpuMs, lastCpuPct
end
end
local m, l = readMem(), readLua()
ftH[w], memH[w] = cpuMode and cpuPct or avgMs, m or 0
if m and m > pkMem then pkMem = m end
if l and l > pkLua then pkLua = l end
w = w % N + 1
if not MainPage.Visible then return end
local topF, topM = cpuMode and 100 or 33.4, 1
for i = 1, N do
if not cpuMode and ftH[i] > topF then topF = ftH[i] end
if memH[i] > topM then topM = memH[i] end
end
topM = topM * 1.15
draw(barsA, ftH, topF)
draw(barsB, memH, topM)
local h = readHW()
local pct = m and h.ram and (h.ramConf == "exact" or h.ramConf == "high") and m / (h.ram * 1024) * 100
mScale.Text = "max " .. fmtMB(topM)
if cpuMode then
fScale.Text = "max 100%"
fVal.Text = string.format("%d%%  %.1f ms", math.floor(cpuPct + 0.5), cpuMs)
fDet.Text = string.format("Peak %d%%  |  Frame %.1f ms  %d FPS\nSystem-wide CPU %%: not exposed", math.floor(pkCpu + 0.5), avgMs, math.floor(fps + 0.5))
else
fScale.Text = string.format("max %d ms", math.ceil(topF))
fVal.Text = string.format("%.1f ms  %d FPS", avgMs, math.floor(fps + 0.5))
fDet.Text = string.format("Peak avg %.1f ms  |  Worst %.1f ms\nCPU %%: not exposed by Roblox", pkAvg, pkWorst)
end
mVal.Text = m and (fmtMB(m) .. (pct and string.format("  (%d%%)", math.floor(pct + 0.5)) or "")) or "unavailable"
mDet.Text = (m and ("Peak " .. fmtMB(pkMem)) or "Peak n/a") .. "  |  Device RAM " .. (h.ram and string.format("%.1f GB", h.ram) or "n/a") .. "\n"
.. (l and string.format("Lua heap %.1f MB  |  Peak %.1f MB", l, pkLua) or "Lua heap: unavailable")
end
local opened, paused, conn, interval = false, false, nil, 1
local t, fsum, n, mx = 0, 0, 0, 0
local function setStatus() status.Text = paused and "PAUSED" or string.format("LIVE  %ds", interval) end
local function stop() if conn then conn:Disconnect() conn = nil end end
local function start()
if conn or not opened or paused then return end
interval = 1
pcall(function() if Util.FX.IsLowEnd() then interval = 2 end end)
local c = readCpuMs()
if (c ~= nil) ~= cpuMode then
cpuMode = c ~= nil
for i = 1, N do ftH[i] = 0 end
end
if c then lastCpuMs = c end
fTitle.Text = cpuMode and "<b>CPU</b> frame load" or "<b>Frame time</b> (CPU n/a)"
t, fsum, n, mx = math.max(0, interval - 0.2), 0, 0, 0
conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
t += dt; fsum += dt; n += 1
if dt > mx then mx = dt end
if t >= interval then
local a, c, m = fsum / n * 1000, n / fsum, mx * 1000
t, fsum, n, mx = 0, 0, 0, 0
sample(a, c, m)
end
end)
end
setStatus()
btn.Activated:Connect(function()
opened = not opened
if opened and not hwDone then hwDone = true hwLabel.Text = hwText() end
boxCont.Visible = opened
btnText.Text = opened and "Hide Performance Monitor" or "Performance Monitor &gt;"
if opened then start() else stop() end
setStatus()
end)
pbtn.Activated:Connect(function()
paused = not paused
ptext.Text = paused and "Resume" or "Pause"
if paused then stop() else start() end
setStatus()
end)
local btnCont = btn.Parent
local function findRow(needle)
for _, k in ipairs(MainPage:GetChildren()) do
if k:IsA("GuiObject") and k ~= btnCont and k ~= boxCont then
for _, d in ipairs(k:GetDescendants()) do
if (d:IsA("TextLabel") or d:IsA("TextButton")) and d.Text:find(needle, 1, true) then return k end
end
end
end
end
local anchor = findRow("Feature Center &gt;") or findRow("Back to cool scene")
if anchor then
local base = anchor.LayoutOrder
for _, k in ipairs(MainPage:GetChildren()) do
if k:IsA("GuiObject") and k ~= btnCont and k ~= boxCont and k.LayoutOrder > base then
k.LayoutOrder = k.LayoutOrder + 2
end
end
btnCont.LayoutOrder, boxCont.LayoutOrder = base + 1, base + 2
end
end)
if not okPM then warn("[perf-monitor] failed to build: " .. tostring(errPM)) end
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")

local Stats = game:GetService("Stats")
local FX = Util.FX
local W = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
local C = {
card = Color3.fromRGB(16, 16, 22), text = Color3.fromRGB(245, 245, 250), mute = Color3.fromRGB(150, 150, 164),
blue = Color3.fromRGB(56, 140, 255), cyan = Color3.fromRGB(40, 170, 200), purple = Color3.fromRGB(128, 84, 235),
pink = Color3.fromRGB(240, 80, 150), green = Color3.fromRGB(60, 200, 120), amber = Color3.fromRGB(250, 170, 60),
}
local BOLD, MED = Enum.Font.GothamBold, Enum.Font.GothamMedium
local LEFT, RIGHT, CENTER = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left, Enum.TextXAlignment.Right, Enum.TextXAlignment.Center
local function new(class, props, parent)
local o = Instance.new(class)
for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
o.Parent = parent
return o
end
local function calm()
return (FX.Settings and FX.Settings.Transitions == false) or (FX.IsLowEnd and FX.IsLowEnd()) or false
end
local function tw(o, t, props, style, dir)
if calm() then
for k, v in pairs(props) do pcall(function() o[k] = v end) end
return
end
t = t / math.max(0.2, (FX.Cfg and FX.Cfg.UIAnimSpeed) or 1)
local ok, tn = pcall(function()
return TweenService:Create(o, TweenInfo.new(t, style or Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, dir or Enum.EasingDirection.Out), props)
end)
if ok and tn then
tn:Play()
return tn
end
end
local function corner(o, r)
return new("UICorner", {CornerRadius = r or UDim.new(0, 14)}, o)
end
local function stroke(o, tr, col)
return new("UIStroke", {Color = col or W, Transparency = tr or 0.84, Thickness = 1, ApplyStrokeMode = Enum.ApplyStrokeMode.Border}, o)
end
local function rim(st)
if not (FX.IsLowEnd and FX.IsLowEnd()) then
new("UIGradient", {Rotation = 38, Transparency = NumberSequence.new({NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0, 0), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.32, 0.68), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(0.68, 0.68), NumberSequenceKeypoint.new(1, 0.08)})}, st)
end
return st
end
local function label(parent, text, size, color, font, xa, extra)
local l = new("TextLabel", {
BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Text = text, TextSize = size, TextColor3 = color or C.text,
Font = font or MED, TextXAlignment = xa or LEFT, TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Center,
TextTruncate = Enum.TextTruncate.AtEnd,
}, parent)
if extra then
for k, v in pairs(extra) do l[k] = v end
end
return l
end
local function note(t)
pcall(function() Util.UINotify(t) end)
end
local function feel(b, base, hover, lift)
lift = lift or 1.025
local rest = UserInputService.TouchEnabled and 1 or lift
local sc = new("UIScale", {Scale = 1}, b)
b.MouseEnter:Connect(function()
tw(b, 0.2, {BackgroundTransparency = hover})
tw(sc, 0.35, {Scale = lift}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
end)
b.MouseLeave:Connect(function()
tw(b, 0.25, {BackgroundTransparency = base})
tw(sc, 0.3, {Scale = 1})
end)
b.MouseButton1Down:Connect(function() tw(sc, 0.08, {Scale = 0.94}, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad) end)
b.MouseButton1Up:Connect(function() tw(sc, 0.5, {Scale = rest}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end)
end
local function glass(parent, pos, size, color, tr, r)
local f = new("Frame", {
BackgroundColor3 = color or C.card, BackgroundTransparency = tr or 0.4, BorderSizePixel = 0,
Position = pos or UDim2.new(), Size = size or UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
}, parent)
corner(f, UDim.new(0, r or 16))
rim(stroke(f, 0.78))
if not calm() then new("UIGradient", {Rotation = 90, Color = ColorSequence.new(Color3.new(1, 1, 1), Color3.fromRGB(176, 176, 190))}, f) end
return f
end
local function tile(parent, pos, size, title, sub, tint, cb)
local b = new("TextButton", {
AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", BackgroundColor3 = tint, BackgroundTransparency = 0.5, BorderSizePixel = 0,
Position = pos, Size = size,
}, parent)
corner(b, UDim.new(0, 14))
rim(stroke(b, 0.76, tint:Lerp(W, 0.45)))
local t1 = label(b, title, 13, W, BOLD, LEFT, {Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, -15), Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 16)})
local t2 = label(b, sub or "", 10, C.text, MED, LEFT, {Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0.5, 2), Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 13), TextTransparency = 0.3})
feel(b, 0.5, 0.35)
b.Activated:Connect(function()
if cb then task.spawn(cb) end
end)
return b, t1, t2
end

thumbs[uid] = url
if img.Parent then img.Image = url end
end
end)
end
local function rootOf(plr)
local ch = plr.Character
if plr == Player then
local ok, rc = pcall(function() return Reanimate and Reanimate.Character end)
if ok and rc and rc.Parent then ch = rc end
end
return ch and (ch:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or ch:FindFirstChild("Torso") or ch:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso"))
end
local rowReg = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})
local function rowOf(page, h)
local r = new("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, h), LayoutOrder = #page:GetChildren()}, page)
local holder = new("Frame", {BackgroundTransparency = 1, BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0), Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 1, -6)}, r)
local reg = rowReg[page]
if not reg then reg = {} rowReg[page] = reg end
reg[#reg + 1] = holder
return holder, r
end
local Nav = {Closers = setmetatable({}, {__mode = "k"})}
Util.Nav = Nav
local function press(btn)
if not btn then return false end
if type(firesignal) == "function" and pcall(firesignal, btn.Activated) then return true end
if type(getconnections) == "function" then
local ok = pcall(function()
for _, c in ipairs(getconnections(btn.Activated)) do
if c.Fire then c:Fire() elseif c.Function then c.Function() end
end
end)
if ok then return true end
end
return false
end
function Nav.TopPage()
local best
for _, p in ipairs(Util.AllPages or {}) do
if p ~= MainPage and p.Parent and p.Visible and math.abs(p.Position.X.Offset) < 2 and p.Position.X.Scale == 0.5 then
if not best or p.ZIndex >= best.ZIndex then best = p end
end
end
return best
end
function Nav.Open(p)
p.Interactable = false
p.Visible = true
MainPage.Interactable = false
local goal = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
if calm() then
p.Position = goal
p.Interactable = true
return
end
local t = TweenService:Create(p, TweenInfo.new(0.5, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.Out), {Position = goal})
t:Play()
t.Completed:Connect(function() p.Interactable = true end)
pcall(Nav.Stagger, p)
end
function Nav.Close(p)
p.Interactable = false
MainPage.Interactable = false
local away = UDim2.new(0.5, 360, 0.5, 0)
local function done()
MainPage.Interactable = true
p.Visible = false
end
if calm() then
p.Position = away
done()
return
end
local t = TweenService:Create(p, TweenInfo.new(0.42, Enum.EasingStyle.Quint, Enum.EasingDirection.In), {Position = away})
t:Play()
t.Completed:Connect(done)
end
function Nav.Stagger(page)
if calm() then return end
local reg = rowReg[page]
if not reg then return end
for i, h in ipairs(reg) do
if i > 12 then break end
if h.Parent then
local sc = h:FindFirstChild("PopScale") or new("UIScale", {Name = "PopScale"}, h)
sc.Scale = 0.92
h.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 20)
task.delay(0.045 * (i - 1), function()
if not h.Parent then return end
tw(sc, 0.55, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
tw(h, 0.5, {Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 0)})
end)
end
end
end
function Nav.CloseTop()
local p = Nav.TopPage()
if not p then return false end
local c = Nav.Closers[p]
if c then
c()
return true
end
local back = Util.BackBtns and Util.BackBtns[p]
if back then return press(back) end
return false
end
local function newPage()
local p = UI.CreatePage()
p.ZIndex = 1
p.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 360, 0.5, 0)
p.Interactable = false
p.Visible = false
UI.CreateButton(p, "&lt; Back", 20).Activated:Connect(function() Nav.Close(p) end)
Nav.Closers[p] = function() Nav.Close(p) end
return p
end
local function toggleMusic()
local snd = UISound.Music
if snd.IsPlaying then
pcall(function() snd:Pause() end)
elseif snd.IsPaused then
pcall(function() snd:Resume() end)
else
pcall(function() snd:Play() end)
end
end
local fpsVal = 60
do
local acc, n = 0, 0
RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
acc += dt
n += 1
if acc >= 0.5 then
fpsVal = math.floor(n / acc + 0.5)
acc, n = 0, 0
end
end)
end
local friends, friendBusy = {}, {}
local function queueFriend(plr, after)
if plr == Player or friends[plr.UserId] ~= nil or friendBusy[plr.UserId] then return end
friendBusy[plr.UserId] = true
task.spawn(function()
local ok, res = pcall(function() return Player:IsFriendsWith(plr.UserId) end)
friends[plr.UserId] = ok and res == true
friendBusy[plr.UserId] = nil
if after then after() end
end)
end
local function friendsHere(after)
local out = {}
for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
if plr ~= Player then
queueFriend(plr, after)
if friends[plr.UserId] then out[#out + 1] = plr end
end
end
return out
end
local function fmtTime(s)
s = math.max(0, math.floor(s))
if s >= 3600 then return string.format("%dh %02dm", s // 3600, (s % 3600) // 60) end
return string.format("%dm %02ds", s // 60, s % 60)
end

local function setSpectate(plr)
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
if not cam then return end
local hum
if plr then
hum = plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
else
local ok, rc = pcall(function() return Reanimate and Reanimate.Character end)
hum = (ok and rc and rc:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")) or (Player.Character and Player.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid"))
end
if hum then cam.CameraSubject = hum end
end

local function rebuild()
for _, r in ipairs(rows) do r:Destroy() end
rows = {}
local q = string.lower(search.Text or "")
local list = Players:GetPlayers()
table.sort(list, function(a, b)
if a == Player then return true end
if b == Player then return false end
return a.Name:lower() < b.Name:lower()
end)
local shown = 0
local myRoot = rootOf(Player)
for _, plr in ipairs(list) do
queueFriend(plr, function() refresh() end)
local okQ = q == "" or plr.Name:lower():find(q, 1, true) ~= nil or plr.DisplayName:lower():find(q, 1, true) ~= nil
local okF = true
if filter == "Friends" then
okF = friends[plr.UserId] == true
elseif filter == "Nearby" then
local r = rootOf(plr)
okF = plr ~= Player and r ~= nil and myRoot ~= nil and (r.Position - myRoot.Position).Magnitude <= 150
end
if okQ and okF then
shown += 1
local sel = selected == plr
local b = new("TextButton", {AutoButtonColor = false, Text = "", BackgroundColor3 = C.card, BackgroundTransparency = sel and 0.2 or 0.45, BorderSizePixel = 0, Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 40), LayoutOrder = shown}, listFrame)
corner(b, UDim.new(0, 14))
stroke(b, sel and 0.5 or 0.88)
local av = new("ImageLabel", {BackgroundColor3 = W, BackgroundTransparency = 0.88, BorderSizePixel = 0, AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5), Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0.5, 0), Size = UDim2.fromOffset(26, 26), Image = ""}, b)
corner(av, UDim.new(1, 0))
loadAvatar(av, plr.UserId)
label(b, plr.DisplayName .. (plr == Player and "  (you)" or ""), 13, C.text, BOLD, LEFT, {Position = UDim2.new(0, 42, 0, 4), Size = UDim2.new(1, -96, 0, 16)})
label(b, "@" .. plr.Name, 10, C.mute, MED, LEFT, {Position = UDim2.new(0, 42, 0, 21), Size = UDim2.new(1, -96, 0, 13)})
if friends[plr.UserId] then
label(b, "Friend", 10, C.green, BOLD, RIGHT, {Position = UDim2.new(1, -58, 0, 0), Size = UDim2.new(0, 48, 1, 0)})
end
feel(b, sel and 0.2 or 0.45, 0.3)
b.Activated:Connect(function()
selected = plr
specSpec = false
specT1.Text = "Spectate"
updateDetail()
refresh()
end)
rows[#rows + 1] = b
end
end
countL.Text = shown .. " of " .. #list
end

local function syncShadow()

shadow.Visible = UIMainWindow.Visible
end

Util.GlassFit = function()
local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
if not cam then return 1 end
local vp = cam.ViewportSize
return math.clamp(math.min(vp.X / 392, vp.Y / 320), 0.6, 1)
end

local cam = workspace.CurrentCamera
if cam then
cam:GetPropertyChangedSignal("ViewportSize"):Connect(function()
pcall(Util.UIPlus.ApplyScale)
task.defer(syncShadow)
end)
end
Util.UIPlus.ApplyScale()
task.defer(syncShadow)
end)

if key == activeKey then return end

for name, d in pairs(parts) do

tw(d.ico, 0.3, {TextColor3 = on and W or C.mute})

if on and not calm() then
d.isc.Scale = 1.4
tw(d.isc, 0.5, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
end
end
end

local function popDock()
if calm() then return end
pillF.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 24)
tw(pillF, 0.55, {Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back)
for i, key in ipairs(KEYS) do
local d = parts[key]
d.sc.Scale = 0.2
task.delay(0.04 * i, function() tw(d.sc, 0.45, {Scale = 1}, Enum.EasingStyle.Back) end)
end
end
local function syncDock()
local v = WindowContent.Visible
if v and not dock.Visible then pcall(popDock) end
dock.Visible = v
end

function Nav.CurrentKey()
local p = Nav.TopPage()
if not p then return "Menu" end
if p == cards then return "Home" end
if p == pp then return "Players" end
if Util.NavLast == "Music &gt;" then return "Music" end
if Util.NavLast == "Customization &gt;" then return "Settings" end
return "Menu"
end
function Nav.Go(key)
if Nav.Busy then return end
Nav.Busy = true
task.spawn(function()
pcall(function()
local same = Nav.CurrentKey() == key and key ~= "Cmds"
local closed = Nav.CloseTop()
if closed then task.wait(0.65) end
if not same then
local fn = Nav.Targets[key]
if fn then fn() end
end
end)
task.wait(0.25)
Nav.Busy = false
end)
end

while dock.Parent do
pcall(function()
setActive(Nav.CurrentKey())
local ac = FX.GetColor and FX.GetColor()

dockStroke.Color = tint
local d = parts[activeKey]
if d then d.st.Color = tint end
end
end)
task.wait(0.2)
end
end)
end, function(e)
warn("[GlassUI] " .. tostring(e))
end)
